https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R73u.label: Time Limitation of Public Benefit
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R73u.definition: Time limitation of public benefit refers to a policy that restricts the duration for which an individual or family can receive financial assistance or services from a specific public benefit program. This is designed to encourage recipients to become self-sufficient and reduce long-term dependency on government aid.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R73u.label: Pheasants
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R73u.definition: Pheasants are a group of large, colorful birds belonging to the family Phasianidae, often raised for their meat, ornamental value, and hunting purposes. Known for their striking plumage and game bird status, pheasants are commonly found in agricultural and wild settings, contributing to both culinary and recreational activities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R73w.label: Chamic languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R73w.definition: Chamic languages are a group of languages that belong to the larger category of languages and are spoken in Southeast Asia, including Cambodia, Vietnam, and Thailand.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R73y.label: Conversion Disorder
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R73y.definition: Conversion Disorder involves the presence of one or more symptoms of altered motor or sensory function that are inconsistent with or cannot be fully explained by medical or neurological conditions. The symptoms cause significant distress or impairment in social, occupational, or other important areas of functioning.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R740.label: Kyegegwa
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R740.definition: Kyegegwa is a district in Uganda.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R740.label: Asset Voting Right
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R740.definition: An Asset Voting Right is the entitlement of an individual or entity to participate in the decision-making process of a company or organization by casting a vote. It is a fundamental attribute of equity ownership, often associated with an entity's shares or ownership units.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R741.label: Early Warning Report
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R741.definition: An Early Warning Report, also known as a Beneficial Ownership Report, is a document filed by significant shareholders or entities who acquire a considerable stake in a company. It alerts the market and regulators about changes in ownership that may affect control of the company.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R741.label: Santarem
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R741.definition: Santarem is a city in Portugal.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R742.label: Meru
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R742.definition: Meru is a location in Kenya.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R742.label: Surxondaryo
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R742.definition: Surxondaryo is a region in Uzbekistan.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R742.label: Arusha
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R742.definition: Arusha is a city in Tanzania, United Republic of.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R743.label: Excessive Fine Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R743.definition: An excessive fine claim is a legal argument asserting that a monetary penalty imposed on an individual is disproportionately large or harsh, violating the Eighth Amendment of the United States Constitution, which prohibits the imposition of excessive fines. These claims seek to challenge fines that are deemed to be unreasonable or overly punitive in relation to the nature and severity of the offense committed.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R744.label: Ternopilska oblast
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R744.definition: Ternopilska oblast is a region in Ukraine.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R745.label: Adygeya, Respublika
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R745.definition: Adygeya, Respublika is a region within the Russian Federation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R745.label: Luba-Lulua
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R745.definition: A Bantu language spoken in the Democratic Republic of Congo, specifically in the Kasai region.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R747.label: United States Copyright Office
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R747.definition: The United States Copyright Office (sometimes abbreviated USCO), a part of the Library of Congress, is the official U.S. government body that maintains records of copyright registration in the United States, including a Copyright Catalog.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74B.label: Vorumaa
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74B.definition: Vorumaa is a region in Estonia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74C.label: Western Cape
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74C.definition: The Western Cape is a province in South Africa.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74D.label: Jubbada Dhexe
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74D.definition: Jubbada Dhexe is a region in Somalia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74D.label: Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74D.definition: The Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau, statutorily named the Tax and Trade Bureau and frequently shortened to TTB, is a bureau of the United States Department of the Treasury, which regulates and collects taxes on trade and imports of alcohol, tobacco, and firearms within the United States.
english_labels: Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74F.label: Race-Fram
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74F.definition: Race-Fram refers to a specific legal concept related to the legal system in Slovenia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74M.label: Prepayment Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74M.definition: A prepayment clause is a provision in a contract that allows the debtor to pay off a debt before it is due without incurring a penalty.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74M.label: Biometric Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74M.definition: A Biometric Claim refers to a legal assertion or action brought under laws regulating the collection, use, and storage of biometric data, such as fingerprints, facial recognition, and other unique biological attributes. Many jurisdictions have enacted legislation setting strict consent and protection standards for biometric data.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74N.label: Leafy Vegetables
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74N.definition: Leafy vegetables, also known as greens, are a category of vegetables harvested primarily for their edible leaves, which are rich in vitamins, minerals, and dietary fiber. They are consumed raw or cooked and are valued for their nutritional benefits, including high levels of vitamins A, C, and K, as well as antioxidants and phytonutrients.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74P.label: Engagement Names
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74P.definition: Engagement Names refer to the specific names or titles given to legal engagements for providing legal services, such as docket numbers, formal engagement names, litigation identifiers, and billing matter names.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74T.label: Event Due Date
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74T.definition: A Due Date Event refers to the specified deadline by which a particular task, action, or submission is required to be completed. In immigration contexts, it could pertain to the submission of documents, responses to inquiries, or meeting other requirements within the prescribed timeframe set by immigration authorities or relevant parties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74W.label: Genderfluid
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74W.definition: Genderfluid refers to a gender identity or expression that may change over time or depending on circumstances, signifying a fluid or dynamic experience of gender rather than a fixed or static identity. In legal contexts, understanding and accommodations regarding genderfluid identities can intersect with discussions and policies related to anti-discrimination, gender recognition, and inclusivity

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74e.label: Appellate Court Judicial Opinion
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74e.definition: An Appellate Court Judicial Opinion is a written decision by a higher court that reviews and affirms, reverses, or modifies the decision of a lower court, and provides legal reasoning and analysis for the decision.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74f.label: Mortgagor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74f.definition: A Mortgagor is an individual or entity that borrows money to purchase property, securing the loan with the property itself as collateral. In this arrangement, the mortgagor holds ownership of the property but the lender (mortgagee) has the right to take possession if the loan is not repaid according to the agreed terms.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74g.label: Indictment Proceeding
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74g.definition: A legal process in which a formal accusation is made against an individual or entity for a criminal offense, typically initiated by a grand jury or prosecutor.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74g.label: Mutual Mistake in Contract
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74g.definition: A mutual mistake in contract is a type of mistake made by both parties in a contract, where they both have a mistaken understanding of a material fact that is essential to the agreement, and as a result, the contract may be voidable or rescinded.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74k.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Webster County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74k.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Webster County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Webster County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74l.label: Religious Property - Real Estate Asset
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74l.definition: A Religious Property is a property and real estate asset used by a religious organization for worship and religious activities. This property can include the main worship building, additional structures, and the surrounding land.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74n.label: South Carolina Commission on Judicial Conduct
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74n.definition: The South Carolina Commission on Judicial Conduct is a state agency responsible for investigating complaints against judges and taking disciplinary action when necessary.
english_labels: South Carolina Commission on Judicial Conduct

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74p.label: California Court of Appeal - 3d Dist.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74p.definition: The California Court of Appeal - 3d Dist. is a specific division of the California Court of Appeal that hears appeals from trial courts in the third appellate district of California.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74q.label: Georgia Superior Court - Randolph County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74q.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Randolph County is a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Randolph County, Georgia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74q.label: Motion to Assume
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74q.definition: A "Motion to Assume" is a request made in a bankruptcy case for the debtor to take over a contract or lease that was previously entered into by the debtor or the bankruptcy estate.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74q.label: Sexual Orientation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74q.definition: Sexual orientation refers to an individual's enduring pattern of emotional, romantic, and/or sexual attractions to men, women, both genders, or neither. It is distinct from a person's gender identity, which refers to one's internal sense of being male, female, or something else. Sexual orientation is often a protected characteristic under anti-discrimination laws, which aim to ensure that individuals are treated fairly and equally regardless of their orientation. In many jurisdictions, these laws prohibit discrimination based on sexual orientation in areas such as employment, housing, education, and public services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74r.label: Answer with Cross-Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R74r.definition: Answer with Cross-Claims refers to a legal response to a complaint or claim made by a defendant against a co-defendant in a lawsuit, asserting that the co-defendant is responsible for all or part of the damages being claimed.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R750.label: Lori
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R750.definition: Lori is a region in Armenia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R752.label: U.S. Bankruptcy Court - D. Maine
english_labels: United States Bankruptcy Court, D. Maine

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R752.label: Virgin Islands Territory Courts
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R752.definition: The Virgin Islands Territory Courts are a subset of U.S. Territory Courts and include the Virgin Islands Police Court, Virgin Islands Supreme Court, Superior Court of the Virgin Islands, Virgin Islands Territorial Court, and Virgin Islands Municipal Court.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R753.label: Federal Air Marshal Service
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R753.definition: The Federal Air Marshal Service (FAMS) is a United States federal law enforcement agency under the supervision of the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) of the United States Department of Homeland Security (DHS).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R753.label: PenaltyStatement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R753.definition: A PenaltyStatement is a type of logical formula within the context of the OASIS ontology.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R754.label: U.S. Temporary Emergency Court of Appeals

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R757.definition: Perak is a state in Malaysia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R759.label: Bureau of Reclamation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R759.definition: Established in 1902, the Bureau of Reclamation is best known for the dams, powerplants, and canals it constructed in the 17 western states. These water projects led to homesteading and promoted the economic development of the West. Reclamation has constructed more than 600 dams and reservoirs including Hoover Dam on the Colorado River and Grand Coulee on the Columbia River.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75B.definition: Dar es Salaam is a city in Tanzania, United Republic of.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75B.definition: Otjozondjupa is a region in Namibia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75B.label: Nonpossessory Interest
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75B.definition: Nonpossessory Interest refers to a type of property interest that grants certain rights to use or enjoy the property without possessing it. This includes interests such as easements, covenants, and profits à prendre, where the holder has limited rights related to the property owned by another person.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75C.label: Oyo
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75C.definition: Oyo is a location in Nigeria.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75C.label: Actual Authority
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75C.definition: Actual Authority refers to the power given to an agent by a principal to act on their behalf, which is explicitly or implicitly granted and can be proven.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75D.label: Office of Child Support Enforcement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75D.definition: The Office of Child Support Enforcement (OCSE) is a United States government office responsible for overseeing the U.S. child support program.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75E.label: Kaliningradskaya oblast'
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75E.definition: Kaliningradskaya oblast' is a region in the Russian Federation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75E.label: National Highway Traffic Safety Administration
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75E.definition: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) is an agency of the Executive Branch of the U.S. government, part of the Department of Transportation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75N.label: Co-Sureties Contributing on Debt Default
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75N.definition: Co-Sureties Contributing on Debt Default: A legal concept where multiple parties agree to be jointly responsible for a debt, and if one party defaults, the other parties are responsible for contributing to the payment of the debt.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75N.label: Cyclist
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75N.definition: A cyclist is a person who rides a bicycle, utilizing it for transportation, recreation, or competitive purposes on various types of terrain and roads. This includes adhering to specific traffic laws and cycling regulations to maintain safety and coordination with other road users.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75O.label: Civil Protection Claim / Domestic Restraining Order
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75O.definition: A Civil Protection Claim / Domestic Restraining Order is a legal order issued by a court that prohibits an individual from contacting or coming near another person, typically a family member, in order to protect them from harm or abuse.
english_labels: Civil Protection Claim / Domestic Restraining Order

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75U.label: Termination At Will Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75U.definition: A Termination At Will Clause is a provision in a contract that allows either party to end the agreement without cause or reason.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75X.label: Home Insurance Policy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75X.definition: A home insurance policy is a contract between a homeowner and an insurance provider that offers financial protection against damages to the home, its contents, or liability claims arising from injuries on the property. The policy outlines the covered perils, such as fire, theft, or natural disasters, and requires the payment of premiums for the coverage to remain active.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75X.label: Indefinite Term Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75X.definition: An indefinite term clause is a provision in a contract that does not specify a specific duration or end date for the agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75Y.label: Gender Rights
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75Y.definition: Gender rights refer to the entitlements and protections aimed at ensuring equality between genders, including the right to be free from discrimination based on gender identity or expression. These rights encompass issues such as equal pay, reproductive rights, and protection from gender-based violence, and are often enshrined in both international treaties and national laws.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75b.label: Nondelegable Duty
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75b.definition: A nondelegable duty is a legal obligation that cannot be transferred or assigned to another party, even if that party is an agent or representative of the original party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75q.label: New York City Court - Port Jervis
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75q.definition: A court located in Port Jervis, New York, which is a subdivision of the New York City Court system.
english_labels: New York City Court - Port Jervis

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75s.label: Motion to Remove Trustee
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75s.definition: A Motion to Remove Trustee is a legal request made in a bankruptcy case to remove the trustee appointed to oversee the debtor's assets and affairs.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75v.label: CLIENT_ADDRESS_2
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75v.definition: The term CLIENT_ADDRESS_2 refers to a specific field within the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard for electronic legal invoicing, which pertains to a secondary address for the client.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75w.label: Special Master
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75w.definition: An independent person usually appointed by a judge or judicial body to exercise certain powers, as defined by that judge or judicial body.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75y.label: Stipulated Voluntary Dismissal without Prejudice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R75y.definition: A Stipulated Voluntary Dismissal without Prejudice is a legal agreement between parties in a lawsuit where the plaintiff agrees to dismiss the case voluntarily, without prejudice, meaning that they can refile the case in the future if necessary.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R761.label: 'Amran
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R761.definition: 'Amran is a city located in Yemen.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R761.label: Niederosterreich
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R761.definition: Niederosterreich is a region in Austria.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R765.label: National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R765.definition: The National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH) is the United States federal agency responsible for conducting research and making recommendations for the prevention of work-related injury and illness.
english_labels: National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R766.label: Low German; Low Saxon; German, Low; Saxon, Low
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R766.definition: A West Germanic language spoken mainly in Northern Germany and the eastern part of the Netherlands, characterized by its low pitch and stress accent; often used in legal documents and proceedings in the regions where it is spoken.
english_labels: Low German; Low Saxon; German, Low; Saxon, Low

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R767.label: Currency
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R767.definition: A standardization of money that is used, circulated, or exchanged (e.g., banknotes, coins).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R768.label: Jambi
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R768.definition: Jambi is a province in Indonesia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76A.label: Elazig
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76A.definition: Elazig is a city located in Turkey.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76A.label: Certificate of Formation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76A.definition: A Certificate of Formation is a legal document filed with a state's Secretary of State or similar government agency to officially register a new corporation, limited liability company (LLC), or other legal entity. It typically includes information such as the entity's name, purpose, registered agent, and the names of its initial directors or members.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76A.label: Software Patent
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76A.definition: A software patent is a legal protection granted to inventors of new and useful software, algorithms, or computer-implemented processes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76C.label: Maramures
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76C.definition: Maramures is a region in Romania.

english_labels: United States Bankruptcy Court, N.D. Illinois

english_labels: U.S. District Court - D. North Dakota

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76I.label: Voting Rights Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76I.definition: A Voting Rights Claim is a legal assertion that an individual's right to vote has been violated, often based on discrimination or unequal treatment, and seeks to remedy the harm caused by such violation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76L.label: Litigation Docket Number
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76L.definition: A Litigation Docket Number is a unique identifier assigned to a legal case that is used to track and manage the case within the court system.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76R.label: Bias
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76R.definition: Bias refers to a preconceived opinion or inclination that affects an individual's ability to make fair, objective, and impartial judgments. In a legal context, bias can compromise the fairness of legal proceedings and may be grounds for disqualification of an Actor (e.g., juror, witness, prosecutor, judge).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76S.label: Real Estate Broker's Liability to Purchaser for Intentional Nondisclosure of Material Facts
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76S.definition: Real Estate Broker's Liability to Purchaser for Intentional Nondisclosure of Material Facts: The legal responsibility of a real estate broker to a purchaser for intentionally withholding important information about a property that would have affected the purchaser's decision to buy, and the resulting legal claims that may be brought against the broker for such actions.
english_labels: Real Estate Broker's Liability to Purchaser for Intentional Nondisclosure of Material Facts

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76U.label: Visa for Skilled Workers and Specialty Occupations
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76U.definition: A Specialty Occupation Visa is a type of visa that allows foreign nationals to work in a job that requires specialized knowledge or expertise, typically at a professional level that requires at least a bachelor's degree or equivalent. This visa category is often designed to address specific labor shortages or to attract individuals with specialized skills to contribute to a country's economy.
english_labels: Visa for Skilled Workers and Specialty Occupations

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76U.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Pulaski Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76U.definition: The Arkansas Circuit Court - Pulaski Cty. is a specific court within the Arkansas Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over cases in Pulaski County, Arkansas.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76W.label: Release of Liability Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76W.definition: A Release of Liability Clause is a legal provision that relieves one party from responsibility for any harm or damage caused to another party, typically in the context of a contract or agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76Z.label: Compilation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76Z.definition: Compilation in copyright law is a work formed by assembling, selecting, or organizing pre-existing material or data, creating a unique intellectual creation through this process. It requires that the compilation's arrangement or selection of contents be original, even if the individual elements are not.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76Z.label: Not in Destination Country
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76Z.definition: In the context of immigration law, "Not in Destination Country" refers to an individual who is not in the United States but may be in the process of seeking admission or has intentions to travel there. This term is commonly used to distinguish individuals who are abroad and may be subject to different legal procedures or criteria for entering the U.S., as opposed to those already within the country.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76f.label: Kidney Failure Complications
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76f.definition: Complications of Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) refer to the various health issues that arise due to the progressive loss of kidney function. These complications can affect multiple body systems and may include cardiovascular problems, anemia, bone mineral disorders, and fluid imbalances.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76f.label: Student Housing - Real Estate Asset
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76f.definition: Student Housing - Real Estate Asset: A type of real estate asset that is specifically designed and used for student housing purposes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76h.label: Ear Nose Throat Malpractice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76h.definition: ENT Malpractice refers to a type of medical malpractice claim that arises from the negligent or wrongful actions of a healthcare provider in the diagnosis, treatment, or management of conditions related to the ear, nose, or throat.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76l.label: San Manuel Band of Mission Indians, California
english_labels: San Manuel Band of Mission Indians, California

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76q.label: Statement of Financial Affairs
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76q.definition: A Statement of Financial Affairs is a document required in bankruptcy cases that provides information about an individual or entity's financial history, including assets, liabilities, income, and expenses.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76q.label: Wire Fraud
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76q.definition: The use of an electric or electronic communications facility to intentionally transmit a false and/or deceptive message in furtherance of a fraudulent activity.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R76r.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Sumter County is a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Sumter County, Georgia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R775.label: Permanent Resident Card
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R775.definition: A Permanent Resident Card, commonly known as a Green Card, is an identification card that signifies the holder's lawful permanent resident status in the destination country (e.g., United States). The card grants the individual the right to live, work, and study in the destination country indefinitely, subject to certain conditions and responsibilities, such as the requirement to renew the card periodically.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R775.label: Ravne na Koroskem
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R775.definition: Ravne na Koroskem is a town located in Slovenia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77C.label: Ajaria
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77C.definition: Ajaria is a region in Georgia, located in Asia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77C.label: U.S. Agency for Global Media
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77C.definition: The U.S. Agency for Global Media, formerly the Broadcasting Board of Governors (BBG), is an independent agency of the United States government. The BBG supervises Voice of America (VOA), Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty, Radio y Television Marti, Radio Free Asia, and the Middle East Broadcast Networks.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77D.label: Kingston
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77D.definition: Kingston is a city in Jamaica.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77E.label: Pirotski okrug
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77E.definition: Pirotski okrug is a district located in Serbia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77F.label: Benguet
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77F.definition: Benguet is a province located in the Philippines.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77I.label: Washington Superior Court - Garfield County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77I.definition: Washington Superior Court - Garfield County refers to a specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Garfield County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77J.label: Tomatoes
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77J.definition: Tomatoes are fruit vegetables from the Solanum lycopersicum species, known for their juicy flesh, sweet-tart flavor, and versatility in culinary applications. Widely cultivated and consumed globally, tomatoes are valued for their high vitamin C and antioxidant content, including lycopene, which is linked to various health benefits.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77Q.label: Memorandum Brief
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77Q.definition: A Memorandum Brief is a written legal document submitted to an appellate court that summarizes the facts and legal arguments of a case, and provides a recommendation for a decision to be made.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77R.label: Minnesota District Court - Benton County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77R.definition: Minnesota District Court - Benton County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Benton County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77X.label: New Jersey Superior Court - Resentencing Panel
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77X.definition: A New Jersey Superior Court Resentencing Panel is a specialized division within the New Jersey Superior Court Appellate Division that is responsible for reviewing and potentially adjusting the sentences of certain criminal defendants.
english_labels: New Jersey Superior Court - Resentencing Panel

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77f.label: Myasthenia Gravis
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77f.definition: Myasthenia Gravis (MG) is a chronic autoimmune neuromuscular disorder characterized by weakness and rapid fatigue of voluntary muscles. It occurs when the immune system produces antibodies that interfere with the communication between nerves and muscles, leading to muscle weakness, especially after periods of activity.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77n.label: Legal Argument
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77n.definition: A legal argument is a structured presentation of facts and law aimed at persuading a court to reach a specific ruling or judgment. It can be made orally in court, written in briefs, or submitted electronically, and typically includes citations to statutes, regulations, and case law to support the position taken.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77n.label: L300 Discovery
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77n.definition: The L300 Discovery concept refers to the process of obtaining evidence and information through various methods such as depositions, written discovery, expert discovery, and document production, among others, as categorized under the UTBMS Litigation code set.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77n.label: M&A F8 Tax Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77n.definition: M&A F8 Tax Practice refers to the specialized legal services provided by a legal services provider in the area of tax law related to mergers and acquisitions within the M&A F Regulatory and Specialty Matters Practice.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77p.label: Debtor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77p.definition: A debtor is a general term for any individual, company, or other entity who owes money, goods, or services to another party. Also, a debtor in a bankruptcy proceeding.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77r.label: Debts
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77r.definition: Debts are financial obligations that require an individual or entity to repay borrowed money or assets to a lender according to agreed-upon terms. These obligations can take various forms, including loans, bonds, or promissory notes, and may accrue interest over time.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77x.label: Debenture
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77x.definition: A Debenture is a type of long-term debt instrument that is not secured by physical assets or collateral but is backed only by the general creditworthiness and reputation of the issuer. Debentures are used by companies to borrow money at a fixed rate of interest and are commonly issued under corporate seal.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77x.label: Development Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77x.definition: A Development Agreement is a legally binding contract between parties that outlines the terms and conditions for the development of a specific property or project.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77z.label: Rescission of Reaffirmation Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77z.definition: The Rescission of Reaffirmation Agreement is a legal concept that refers to the cancellation or annulment of a previously agreed-upon reaffirmation of debt in a bankruptcy case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77z.label: Sales Commission
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R77z.definition: A sales commission is a form of payment that individuals receive based on a percentage of the sales they generate or the business they bring in. It serves as an incentive for salespeople and others to actively promote products or services and is directly tied to their sales performance

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R780.label: Naxcivan
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R780.definition: Naxcivan is a region in Azerbaijan.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R782.label: Hofudborgarsvaedi
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R782.definition: Hofudborgarsvaedi refers to the capital region of Iceland, which includes Reykjavik and its surrounding municipalities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R782.label: Incarceration for Time Served
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R782.definition: The concept of "Incarceration for Time Served" refers to the legal practice of releasing a prisoner from custody after they have served the full length of their sentence, including any time spent in pre-trial detention or custody.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R783.label: U.S. Dept. of Housing and Urban Development
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R783.definition: The United States Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) is a Cabinet department in the Executive branch of the United States federal government. HUD's mission is to create strong, sustainable, inclusive communities and quality affordable homes for all. HUD is working to strengthen the housing market to bolster the economy and protect consumers; meet the need for quality affordable rental homes; utilize housing as a platform for improving quality of life; build inclusive and sustainable communities free from discrimination, and transform the way HUD does business.
english_labels: Department of Housing and Urban Development
U.S. Dept. of Housing and Urban Development

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R784.label: State Department Office of the Inspector General
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R784.definition: The State Department Office of the Inspector General (OIG) inspects more than 260 embassies, diplomatic posts, and international broadcasting installations throughout the world to determine whether policy goals are being achieved and whether the interests of the United States are being represented and advanced effectively. Additionally, OIG performs specialized security inspections and audits in support of the Department's mission to provide effective protection to our personnel, facilities, and sensitive information.
english_labels: State Department Office of the Inspector General

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R785.label: Cybersecurity Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R785.definition: Law and rules related to the protection of information and information systems.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R785.label: Nitriansky kraj
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R785.definition: Nitriansky kraj is a region in Slovakia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R785.label: Mayuge
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R785.definition: Mayuge is a district in Uganda.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R785.label: Varna
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R785.definition: Varna is a city in Bulgaria.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R786.label: Illinois State Courts
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R786.definition: Illinois State Courts are the judicial branches of the Illinois government responsible for interpreting and enforcing the law within the state's jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R786.label: Keelung
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R786.definition: Keelung is a city located in Taiwan.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R787.label: Chhukha
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R787.definition: Chhukha is a district in Bhutan.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R787.label: County Governmental Body
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R787.definition: A county governmental body oversees governance at the county level, which is typically a subdivision of a state or province, but above local city or town governments. County governments handle administrative and regulatory responsibilities that span multiple municipalities within their boundaries. These responsibilities can include law enforcement (through county sheriff's departments), maintaining county roads and infrastructure, overseeing public health and welfare programs, managing property records, and conducting elections.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R788.label: Business Schools and Computer and Management Training Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R788.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in one of the following: (1) offering courses in office procedures and secretarial and stenographic skills and may offer courses in basic office skills, such as word processing; (2) conducting computer training (except computer repair); or (3) offering an array of short duration courses and seminars for management and professional development. Instruction may be provided in diverse settings, such as the establishment's or client's training facilities, educational institutions, the workplace, or the home, and through diverse means, such as correspondence, television, the Internet, or other electronic and distance-learning methods. The training provided by these establishments may include the use of simulators and simulation methods.
english_labels: Business Schools and Computer and Management Training Industry
Business Schools and Management Training Industry

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R788.label: California Superior Court - Appellate Division
english_labels: Appellate Division of the Superior Court of California

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R789.label: Bulawayo
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R789.definition: Bulawayo is a city in Zimbabwe.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R789.label: Committee on Foreign Investment in the U.S.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R789.definition: The Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States (CFIUS) is an inter-agency committee of the United States Government that reviews the national security implications of foreign investments in U.S. companies or operations.
english_labels: Committee on Foreign Investment in the U.S.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78F.label: Suchitepequez
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78F.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) manufacturing and/or rebuilding locomotives, locomotive frames and parts; (2) manufacturing railroad, street, and rapid transit cars and car equipment for operation on rails for freight and passenger service; and (3) manufacturing rail layers, ballast distributors, rail tamping equipment and other railway track maintenance equipment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78G.label: Training Materials
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78G.definition: Documents (e.g., slides) used to train others, either internally or externally.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78J.label: Florida Circuit Court - Leon County - 2nd Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78J.definition: A court located in Leon County, Florida that is part of the Florida Circuit Court system and handles cases within the 2nd Circuit.
english_labels: Florida Circuit Court - Leon County - 2nd Circuit Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78K.label: Corn
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78K.definition: Corn, also known as maize, is a cereal crop belonging to the species Zea mays, widely grown for its edible kernels that are used as food for humans and livestock, and as raw material in industrial products. Known for its versatility, corn is a staple in many diets and a key ingredient in products such as cornmeal, corn syrup, and ethanol.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78P.label: Nordic Law System
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78P.definition: Nordic Law is a legal system found in Scandinavian countries, characterized by a blend of civil law principles with elements of customary and case law. It emphasizes codified statutes while also allowing judicial decisions to influence the interpretation and application of laws.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78P.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Crawford County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78P.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Crawford County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that handles minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil cases involving amounts up to $12,000.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Crawford County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78P.label: Vote
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78P.definition: A vote is the act or process of expressing a choice or preference in a decision-making procedure, often within a formal setting such as an election or a meeting. In democratic systems, voting is the primary mechanism through which citizens influence the selection of their representatives or the outcome of specific issues.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78U.label: Asexual
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78U.definition: In the context of human sexuality, asexual refers to a lack of sexual attraction to others or low or absent interest in engaging in sexual activity. It is also an orientation that forms part of the LGBTQIA+ spectrum, although individual experiences and definitions can vary.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78Z.label: Indiana Superior Court - Dubois County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78Z.definition: Indiana Superior Court - Dubois County refers to a specific court within the Indiana Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Dubois County, Indiana.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78a.label: Incarceration for Life
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78a.definition: A sentence of imprisonment for the remainder of a person's life, typically imposed as a punishment for a serious criminal offense.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78a.label: Fallopian Tube Cancer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78a.definition: Fallopian tube cancer is a rare malignant tumor originating in the fallopian tubes, the structures that connect the ovaries to the uterus. This type of cancer can cause symptoms such as abdominal pain, unusual vaginal discharge, and pelvic masses, and is often treated with surgery, chemotherapy, and radiation therapy.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78b.label: Dormant Commerce Clause Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78b.definition: A Dormant Commerce Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a state law or regulation violates the United States Constitution by burdening or discriminating against interstate commerce. This claim is based on the interpretation that the Commerce Clause not only grants Congress the power to regulate commerce but also implies a limitation on state interference with interstate commerce.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78f.label: Connecticut Probate Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78f.definition: The Connecticut Probate Court is a specialized court within the Connecticut State Courts system that handles matters related to the administration of estates, trusts, and guardianships.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78s.label: Breach of Implied Warranty of Habitability by Home Seller
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78s.definition: The Breach of Implied Warranty of Habitability by Home Seller refers to the failure of a home seller to provide a livable and safe dwelling to the buyer, which was not disclosed during the sale, resulting in legal action against the seller.
english_labels: Breach of Implied Warranty of Habitability by Home Seller

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78u.label: Classical Syriac
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78u.definition: Classical Syriac is a historical language that belongs to the Language top-level class and is characterized by its use in ancient Syriac literature and liturgy.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78v.label: Navajo; Navaho
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78v.definition: Navajo is a Native American language spoken primarily in the southwestern United States, characterized by its complex grammar and use of tone.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78v.label: Military Deployment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78v.definition: Military deployment refers to the movement of armed forces and their logistical support infrastructure to a specific location or theater of operations. It can be in response to an international crisis, as part of routine exercises, or for other strategic purposes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78x.label: Canada Variants
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R78x.definition: Canada Variants refers to a collection of specific legal areas within Canadian law, including Employment Law, Condominium Law, Municipal Law, Disability Insurance Law, Custody Law, Accident Benefits Law, Pay Equity Law, Private Equity, Franchise Law, Employment Contracts Law, Independent Contractor Law, Private Equity, Hedge Funds and Venture Capital Law.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R791.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Putnam County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R791.definition: A Missouri Circuit Court in Putnam County is a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Putnam County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R792.label: Georgia Superior Court - Wayne County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R792.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Wayne County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Wayne County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R795.label: Jendouba
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R795.definition: Jendouba is a city located in the country of Tunisia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R795.label: Behavioral Market Segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R795.definition: A behavioral market segment is a group of consumers classified based on their behavior patterns, including their benefits sought, as well as their usage (of products or services). This segmentation relates to how groups of consumers seek out and interact with products or services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R797.label: Phalombe
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R797.definition: Phalombe is a district in Malawi.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R799.label: Nakasongola
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R799.definition: Nakasongola is a district in Uganda.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R799.label: Mutual Waiver of Subrogation Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R799.definition: A Mutual Waiver of Subrogation Clause is a provision in a contract where both parties agree to waive their right to seek reimbursement from the other party's insurance company in the event of a loss or damage.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79B.label: Motion for New Trial - Errors in Trial
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79B.definition: A Motion for New Trial based on Errors in Trial is a request made to a higher court to review a trial court's decision due to mistakes made during the trial, such as incorrect application of the law or improper admission or exclusion of evidence.
english_labels: Motion for New Trial - Errors in Trial

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79B.label: Utility Negligence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79B.definition: Utility Negligence refers to the legal claim that a public utility company has breached its duty of care to its customers, resulting in harm or damages.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79C.label: War
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79C.definition: War and Conflicts refer to armed hostilities between states, nations, or groups, characterized by the use of military force and violence. These engagements can range from full-scale wars between countries to smaller conflicts such as civil wars, insurgencies, and guerrilla warfare, often resulting in significant human, economic, and political consequences.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79C.label: U.S. Bankruptcy Court - W.D. Missouri
english_labels: United States Bankruptcy Court, W.D. Missouri

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79D.label: Mouhoun
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79D.definition: Mouhoun is a region in Burkina Faso.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79E.label: New York Supreme Court - Appellate Division
english_labels: Appellate Division of the Supreme Court of the State of New York
New York Supreme Court - Appellate Division

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79F.label: Normandie
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79F.definition: Normandie is a region in France.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79F.label: Sirdaryo
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79F.definition: Sirdaryo is a region in Uzbekistan.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79F.label: Prachuap Khiri Khan
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79F.definition: Prachuap Khiri Khan is a province in Thailand.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79K.label: Necessary Further Actions Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79K.definition: A Necessary Further Actions Clause is a provision in a contract that requires one or both parties to take additional actions beyond those already specified in the agreement in order to fulfill their obligations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79K.label: Indiana Superior Court - Noble County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79K.definition: Indiana Superior Court - Noble County refers to a specific court within the Indiana Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Noble County, Indiana.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79K.label: Nubian languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79K.definition: A group of languages spoken in parts of Sudan and southern Egypt, including Nobiin, Kenzi-Dongola, and Midob, among others.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79L.label: Litigation Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79L.definition: Matters that include official proceedings (e.g., court case, arbitration, mediation)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79P.label: Alternative Dispute Resolution Venues
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79P.definition: Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) Venues are organizations or government entities that provide a forum for parties to resolve disputes outside of traditional court proceedings, such as through arbitration or mediation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79Q.label: Interest Payment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79Q.definition: An Interest Payment is a periodic payment made by a borrower to a lender as compensation for the use of borrowed funds. This payment is typically a percentage of the principal amount and is agreed upon at the time of the loan agreement, representing the cost of borrowing money.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79R.label: Pregnancy Discrimination
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79R.definition: Discrimination against a woman because of her pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions, in violation of anti-discrimination laws.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79R.label: Writ of Certiorari
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79R.definition: A Writ of Certiorari is a legal document filed with an appellate court requesting that the court review a lower court's decision.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79U.label: Class Representative
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79U.definition: The party or parties in a class action lawsuit who represents the interests of the entire class of similarly situated individuals or entities. This representative is responsible for acting on behalf of the class in legal proceedings and making decisions that impact all class members.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79W.label: Indigenous People's Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79W.definition: Legal procedures and regulations specific to indigenous peoples' rights.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79W.label: Client Business Manager
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79W.definition: The buyer's lead business representative for the matter (can be attorney or operations or otherwise)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79Z.label: Public Benefits Objectives
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79Z.definition: Public benefits objectives refer to legal services related to the accurate and efficient distribution of public assistance to eligible recipients. For example, underpayment objectives focus on identifying and rectifying instances where beneficiaries receive less than they are entitled to, often due to administrative errors or oversight. Overpayment objectives aim to detect and recover funds that have been erroneously disbursed in excess of eligibility, to maintain the integrity and sustainability of the benefit program.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79Z.label: Patent Subject-Matter Classifications
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79Z.definition: Patent Subject-Matter Classifications are a system of categorizing patents and patent applications based on the technical fields or subject matter they pertain to, such as chemical, mechanical, electrical, and life sciences. This classification system facilitates the organization, search, and examination of patents by grouping similar inventions together.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79a.label: Data Format
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79a.definition: The data structure that gives the file its meaning; in the context of legal data, the format of the legal-data file (e.g., Microsoft Word Document, Adobe Acrobat PDF, Microsoft Excel file).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79a.label: Motion for Summary Disposition
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79a.definition: A Motion for Summary Disposition is a request made to an appellate court to dispose of a case without a full trial, based on the evidence and arguments presented in the record.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79d.label: Aplastic Anemia
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79d.definition: Aplastic anemia is a condition characterized by the failure of the bone marrow to produce sufficient quantities of blood cells, leading to pancytopenia (low levels of red blood cells, white blood cells, and platelets). This disorder results in symptoms such as fatigue, increased susceptibility to infections, and bleeding tendencies due to the lack of healthy blood cells.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79g.label: Blackfeet Tribe of the Blackfeet Indian Reservation of Montana
english_labels: Blackfeet Tribe of the Blackfeet Indian Reservation of Montana

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79h.label: Subcontracting Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79h.definition: A Subcontracting Clause is a provision in a contract that allows one party to hire another party to perform some or all of the work outlined in the original contract.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79i.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Perry County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79i.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Perry County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that handles minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil cases involving amounts up to $12,000.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Perry County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79j.label: Motions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79j.definition: A motion is a written request made to a court asking for a specific action to be taken in a legal case, such as a request for a ruling or a request for evidence to be excluded.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79l.label: Enforcement of Visitation Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79l.definition: The Enforcement of Visitation Claim is the legal process of ensuring that a parent's right to visit their child is upheld, typically through court orders and legal remedies.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79o.label: Personal Day
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79o.definition: A Personal Day is a type of paid time off provided by employers that allows employees to take leave for personal reasons without specifying the nature of the absence. This benefit is typically separate from vacation days or sick leave, offering flexibility for employees to address personal matters, appointments, or mental health needs without detailed explanation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79p.label: Sale of Goods Breached by Buyer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79p.definition: The Sale of Goods Breached by Buyer refers to a legal concept where a buyer fails to fulfill their obligations under a contract for the sale of goods, resulting in a breach of the agreement.
english_labels: Sale of Goods Breached by Buyer

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79q.label: DEPRECATED Matter Identifier, in favor of `Matter ID` https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUgWyAVlkn9ysIUzCG1Ahb
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79q.definition: Matter identifier (e.g., IRIs, UUIDs, GUIDs) within the systems of stakeholders (e.g., vendors, sellers, buyers, courts).
english_labels: DEPRECATED Matter Identifier, in favor of `Matter ID` https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUgWyAVlkn9ysIUzCG1Ahb

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79r.label: Tourist Visa
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79r.definition: A visa for leisure visitors, often referred to as a tourist visa, is a short-term visa that allows individuals to enter a foreign country for the purpose of tourism, recreation, or visiting friends and family. This type of visa typically does not permit the holder to engage in employment or business activities and is usually valid for a limited period, ranging from a few weeks to several months.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79u.label: Binge-Eating Disorder
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79u.definition: Binge-Eating Disorder is an eating disorder characterized by recurrent episodes of eating large quantities of food in a short period, accompanied by feelings of loss of control during the binge and significant distress or impairment. Unlike Bulimia Nervosa, individuals with Binge-Eating Disorder do not regularly engage in compensatory behaviors such as vomiting or excessive exercise to offset the binge eating.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79v.label: No Conflict of Interest Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79v.definition: A "No Conflict of Interest Clause" is a provision in a contract that prohibits any conflicting interests that may interfere with the parties' ability to fulfill their obligations under the contract.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79x.label: Zoological Taxonomy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79x.definition: Zoological Taxonomy is the scientific classification of animals based on their evolutionary relationships, anatomical structures, and genetic similarities, organizing them into hierarchical categories such as phyla, classes, orders, families, genera, and species. This system helps in understanding the diversity of animal life and their biological characteristics.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79x.label: Managed Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R79x.definition: Managed Services: A type of alternative legal service that involves the outsourcing of legal work to a third-party provider who manages and performs the work on behalf of the client.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7A0.label: Florida County Court - Wakulla County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Ij.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that has the power to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases, located specifically in Steuben County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Ij.label: Extortion
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Ij.definition: To unlawfully obtain money, property, or any other thing of value, either tangible or intangible, through the use or threat of force, misuse of authority, threat of criminal prosecution, threat of destruction of reputation or social standing, or through other coercive means.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7In.label: tax_on_tax
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7In.definition: """Tax-on-Tax"" is a situation where one or more taxes in a tax jurisdiction are based on the sum of the corresponding invoice line item totals AND any other tax amount previously applied to those line item totals. For example, formerly n both Quebec and Prince Edward Island Canada had specific taxes calculated on the sum of the line items plus the federal tax paid on those line items. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Io.label: Bankruptcy Plan Confirmation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Io.definition: The Bankruptcy Plan Confirmation (Event) is the legal process of approving a debtor's proposed plan for reorganizing their finances and repaying their debts, which occurs within the context of a bankruptcy case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Iq.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Warren County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Iq.definition: A court located in Warren County, Indiana that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its designated area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7It.label: Chronic Bronchitis
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7It.definition: Chronic bronchitis is a type of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) characterized by persistent inflammation of the bronchial tubes, leading to a chronic cough and production of mucus over a period of at least three months per year for two consecutive years. This condition results in narrowed airways and impaired airflow, causing difficulty in breathing and frequent respiratory infections.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7It.label: Geese
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7It.definition: Geese are domesticated waterfowl belonging to the genus Anser and Branta, commonly raised for their meat, eggs, feathers, and down. Known for their grazing habits and strong flocking instincts, geese are often utilized in agriculture for weeding and as guard animals, as well as for their high-quality meat and egg production.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Iu.label: Supersedeas Bond Payment Event
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Iu.definition: A Supersedeas Bond Payment is the payment of a type of surety bond required by a court from an appellant who seeks to delay payment of a judgment until the appeal is resolved. This bond ensures that the appellee will be compensated if the appellant fails to meet the judgment after the appeal.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Iy.label: Fishing License
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Iy.definition: A fishing license is an official permit issued by a governing authority that allows individuals to legally catch fish in specific bodies of water during certain times. The purpose of such licenses is to regulate and conserve fish populations, ensuring sustainable practices. To acquire a fishing license, individuals usually pay a fee, and in some jurisdictions, they might also need to complete an educational course or adhere to certain regulations, such as bag and size limits.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7J2.label: Texas District Court - Tarrant County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7J2.definition: A Texas District Court located in Tarrant County, which is a trial court of general jurisdiction in Texas handling civil and criminal cases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7J4.label: Deposition Transcripts Expense
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7J4.definition: The Deposition Transcripts Expense refers to the cost incurred by a party in a legal matter for obtaining a written record of a witness's testimony given under oath outside of court proceedings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7J5.label: Out of Immigration Status
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7J5.definition: "Out of Status" refers to the condition where an individual has violated the terms of their visa or other immigration authorization. This could involve overstaying the duration specified on their visa, working without proper authorization, or failing to maintain enrollment in a study program, among other infractions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7J7.label: Buyer Consent Requirement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7J7.definition: Buyer Consent Requirement is a legal concept that refers to the obligation of a party to obtain the consent of the buyer before taking certain actions, subject to certain conditions and limitations, as specified in a negative covenant.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7J9.label: Texas District Court - Kaufman County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7J9.definition: A Texas District Court located in Kaufman County, which has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7JH.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Marion County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7JH.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Marion County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Marion County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7JJ.label: Virgin Islands Supreme Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7JJ.definition: The Virgin Islands Supreme Court is the highest court in the Virgin Islands Territory Courts system, responsible for hearing appeals and making final decisions on legal disputes within the territory.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7JK.label: Defamation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7JK.definition: Defamation is a civil claim and tort claim that involves the communication of a false statement that harms the reputation of an individual or entity.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7JN.label: "Confidential Information" Definition - Exceptions - Becomes Known by Disclosure Not in Breach
english_labels: "Confidential Information" Definition - Exceptions - Becomes Known by Disclosure Not in Breach

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7JN.label: Qualified Immunity
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7JN.definition: Qualified Immunity: A legal doctrine that shields government officials from liability for civil damages in cases where their actions did not violate clearly established statutory or constitutional rights of which a reasonable person would have known.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7JV.label: Motion for Hardship Discharge
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7JV.definition: A Motion for Hardship Discharge is a legal request made in a bankruptcy case, seeking to discharge the debtor from their remaining debts due to extreme financial hardship.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7JW.label: End User License Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7JW.definition: An End User License Agreement is a legal contract between a software application author or publisher and the user of that application. The EULA details how the software can be used and any restrictions on its use.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7JX.label: Indiana Superior Court - Clay County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7JX.definition: The Indiana Superior Court - Clay County is a specific court within the Indiana Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Clay County, Indiana.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7JY.label: Sorbian languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7JY.definition: Sorbian languages refer to a group of Slavic languages spoken in eastern Germany, and are a subcategory of the broader concept of Language.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7JZ.label: Alternative Dispute Resolution Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7JZ.definition: An Alternative Dispute Resolution Clause is a provision in a contract that requires parties to resolve any disputes through methods other than litigation, such as mediation or arbitration.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Jd.label: Homeowner
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Jd.definition: A Homeowner is an individual or entity that holds legal title to a residential property. This term is typically used in contexts such as property tax assessment, real estate transactions, and asset evaluation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Jg.label: Northern Cherokee Nation of Missouri and Arkansas
english_labels: Northern Cherokee Nation of Missouri and Arkansas

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Ji.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Sullivan County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Ji.definition: The Indiana Circuit Court - Sullivan County is a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system, which has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Sullivan County, Indiana.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Jj.label: New Jersey Superior Court - Salem County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Jj.definition: The New Jersey Superior Court - Salem County is a court of general jurisdiction within the New Jersey state court system, located in Salem County and serving as a trial court for civil and criminal cases.
english_labels: New Jersey Superior Court - Salem County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Jl.label: Appellate Briefing Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Jl.definition: Appellate Briefing Practice refers to the specialized legal practice of preparing written arguments and submissions to a higher court for the purpose of appealing a lower court's decision.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Jo.label: Periodical
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Jo.definition: A Periodical is a regularly published work that includes a collection of articles, stories, photographs, and advertisements, typically focusing on specific subjects or areas of interest.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Jo.label: Reorganization Bankruptcy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Jo.definition: This is a process where a company, individual, or any other entity rearranges its debts in order to remain viable. The debtor typically retains their assets and continues to operate the business, while working out a plan to repay creditors over time.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Jo.label: Instant Runoff Electoral System
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Jo.definition: The instant runoff electoral system, also known as ranked-choice voting, is a voting method where voters rank candidates by preference. If no candidate wins a majority of first-preference votes, the candidate with the fewest votes is eliminated, and their votes are redistributed according to the voters' next preferences, continuing until one candidate achieves a majority.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Jp.label: Infectious Disease Specialist Malpractice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Jp.definition: Negligent or wrongful conduct by a medical professional who specializes in the diagnosis and treatment of infectious diseases, resulting in harm or injury to a patient.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Jp.label: Massachusetts Trial Court - Housing Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7Jp.definition: The Massachusetts Trial Court - Housing Court is a specialized court within the Massachusetts Trial Court system that handles cases related to housing disputes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7K2.label: Funds Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7K2.definition: Funds Practice involves the legal aspects of forming, managing, and regulating investment funds, including private equity funds, hedge funds, and venture capital funds. This practice area covers fund structuring, compliance with financial regulations, investor relations, and transactional activities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7K5.label: Substance Abuse and Drug Testing Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7K5.definition: Drug Testing & Substance Abuse Law refers to the legal framework governing the testing of individuals for the presence of drugs and the regulation of substance abuse. It includes policies, procedures, and regulations related to the detection, prevention, and treatment of drug use and addiction.
english_labels: Substance Abuse and Drug Testing Law

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7K8.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Warren County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7K8.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Warren County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Warren County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7KA.label: Informally Consulted Expert
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7KA.definition: An expert whom a party approaches informally for consultation, but the party never retains or engages the expert.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7KD.label: Hittite
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7KD.definition: A language used by the ancient Hittite civilization, which is now extinct.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7KG.label: Warrant Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7KG.definition: A warrant claim refers to a legal assertion involving the issuance, execution, or validity of a warrant, which is an official document issued by a judicial officer that authorizes law enforcement to perform certain acts, such as an arrest, a search, or a seizure. A warrant claim can take many forms, including claims that a warrant was improperly issued, executed, or lacked sufficient cause.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7KH.label: Debtor's Statement Regarding Pending Proceeding
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7KH.definition: A Debtor's Statement Regarding Pending Proceeding is a written document submitted in a bankruptcy or restructuring case that provides information about any ongoing legal proceedings involving the debtor.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7KJ.label: Georgia District Court - Carroll County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7KJ.definition: Georgia District Court - Carroll County refers to a specific court within the Georgia District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Carroll County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7KK.label: Surveillance Device Warrant
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7KK.definition: A Surveillance Device Warrant is a legal document issued by a court that authorizes law enforcement agencies to install and use surveillance devices, such as wiretaps, cameras, or tracking devices, to monitor and gather evidence on suspected criminal activities. This type of warrant is typically subject to strict legal standards and oversight to protect individuals' privacy rights.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7KL.label: L330 Depositions
