https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7pZ.label: Motion to Extend Time - Appellate Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7pZ.definition: A Motion to Extend Time in an Appellate Court is a request made by a party to the court to extend the deadline for filing a document or taking an action beyond the original deadline set by the court.
english_labels: Motion to Extend Time - Appellate Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7pa.label: Denial Event
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7pa.definition: A Regulatory Denial Event refers to the situation where an application, request, or submission made to a regulatory authority is declined or denied, often due to not meeting the specified criteria or requirements. In immigration, this could entail the rejection of an immigration application, visa request, or other related matters based on assessment by the relevant authorities

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7pd.label: Failure to Satisfy Conditions Precedent
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7pd.definition: The Failure to Satisfy Conditions Precedent is a legal defense in civil litigation where the defendant argues that the plaintiff did not fulfill the necessary requirements before bringing the lawsuit.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7pe.label: Montana Workers Compensation Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7pe.definition: The Montana Workers Compensation Court is a specialized court within the Montana State Courts system that handles cases related to workers' compensation disputes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7pg.label: Non-Responsive Objection
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7pg.definition: A Non-Responsive Objection is raised when a party in a legal proceeding believes that a witness's response does not directly address the question asked. This objection seeks to ensure that the testimony remains relevant and focused on the issues at hand.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7pj.label: By Reverse Contingency
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7pj.definition: Engagement fee model where a client pays a fee represented by the percentage of the amount of money that a client saved in litigation — often expressed as the difference between a third party's originally demanded amount (from the client) and the client's ultimate payment amount.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7pm.label: Tonga
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7pm.definition: A language spoken in the Tonga Islands, characterized by its own grammar and vocabulary.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7pp.label: Improper Lay Opinion Objection
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7pp.definition: An Improper Lay Opinion Objection is raised when a party believes that a non-expert witness is offering an opinion without sufficient basis, exceeding the bounds of their direct perception or not aiding in understanding or determining a fact in issue (e.g., Federal Rule of Evidence 701). Lay witnesses can offer opinions if they have personal knowledge and a rational basis for their conclusions, such as describing someone's appearance without speculating on their thoughts. However, they may not testify to someone else's thoughts, specific medical conditions, or other technical matters beyond their knowledge.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7q2.label: Pilot Ruleset
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7q2.definition: A Pilot Ruleset is a specific type of legal rule that is used for testing or experimental purposes before being fully implemented.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7q3.label: Illinois Circuit Court - McHenry County (22nd Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - McHenry County (22nd Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7q3.label: Future Consideration Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7q3.definition: A Future Consideration Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines an obligation to perform an action or provide compensation at a later date, based on certain conditions being met.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7q5.label: Schedule of Post-Petition Debts
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7q5.definition: A Schedule of Post-Petition Debts is a list of debts incurred by a debtor after filing for bankruptcy, which must be disclosed to the court and creditors.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qD.label: Physical Examination Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qD.definition: Physical Examination Practice refers to the specialized knowledge and skills used by experts in conducting physical examinations as part of their legal work.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qE.label: International Swaps and Derivatives Association Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qE.definition: An ISDA Agreement is a standardized contract established by the International Swaps and Derivatives Association to regulate over-the-counter derivatives transactions. It standardizes terms, reduces risk, and clarifies mutual responsibilities between parties.
english_labels: International Swaps and Derivatives Association Agreement

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qF.label: Knowledge Representation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qF.definition: Knowledge Representation is the method of encoding information about the world in a format that an AI system can use to solve complex tasks, including reasoning and inference. This involves using various symbolic or sub-symbolic techniques to model entities, relationships, and rules within a specific domain.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qH.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Stone Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qH.definition: The Arkansas Circuit Court - Stone Cty. is a specific court within the Arkansas Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Stone County, Arkansas.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qH.label: Quechan Tribe of the Fort Yuma Indian Reservation, California and Arizona
english_labels: Quechan Tribe of the Fort Yuma Indian Reservation, California and Arizona

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qJ.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Schuyler County (8th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Schuyler County (8th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qL.label: Visa for Dependent of Vocational Student
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qL.definition: The visa for dependents of vocational students (in the U.S., the M-2 visa) is a non-immigrant visa that allows spouses and minor children of vocational students (i.e., M-1 visa holders) to accompany them during their stay in the destination country (e.g., U.S.). In the United States, unlike the M-1 visa holder, M-2 dependents are generally not authorized to work but may engage in full- or part-time study
english_labels: Visa for Dependent of Vocational Student

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qN.label: 465 Other Immigration Actions (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qN.definition: Action (Immigration-related) that do not involve Naturalization Applications or petitions for Writ of Habeas Corpus, such as complaints alleging failure to adjudicate an application to adjust immigration status to permanent resident.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qO.label: Vermont Supreme Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qO.definition: The Vermont Supreme Court is the highest court in the state of Vermont, responsible for hearing appeals from lower state courts and interpreting state law.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qQ.label: Fee Credit Amount
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qQ.definition: A fee credit amount is a type of discount or credit applied to legal services fees.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qV.label: Voluntary Bankruptcy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qV.definition: Voluntary Bankruptcy occurs when a debtor initiates bankruptcy proceedings by filing a petition with the bankruptcy court. It contrasts with Involuntary Bankruptcy, where creditors initiate the process against a debtor.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qY.label: Negligent Provision of Required Safeguards or Precautions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qY.definition: The Negligent Provision of Required Safeguards or Precautions refers to a failure to provide necessary safety measures or precautions, resulting in harm or injury, in the context of industrial injury claims.
english_labels: Negligent Provision of Required Safeguards or Precautions

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qd.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Lake County (19th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Lake County (19th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qf.label: Involuntary Employment Termination Event
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qf.definition: Involuntary employment termination event refers to the act of an employer initiating the separation of an employee from their job. Reasons can range from downsizing and organizational restructuring to performance issues or misconduct.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qf.label: Project Communication Plan
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qf.definition: A plan for communicating status, progress, change management, and other considerations to a project's stakeholders.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qg.label: Reprieve
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qg.definition: A reprieve is a temporary delay or suspension of a punishment or sentence, especially in the context of the death penalty. It serves as a postponement of the execution of a sentence, often to allow the defendant more time to seek a new trial, appeal, or another form of relief. However, a reprieve does not change the underlying conviction or sentence; it only delays its enforcement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qh.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Colfax County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qh.definition: A court located in Colfax County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases.
english_labels: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Colfax County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qi.label: Medical Test
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qi.definition: A Medical Test is a clinical procedure performed to detect, diagnose, or monitor diseases, disease processes, susceptibility, or to determine a course of treatment. Examples include blood tests, DNA tests, drug tests, and paternity tests.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qj.label: Collective Work
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qj.definition: Collective Work in copyright law refers to a work consisting of individual contributions assembled into a collective whole, where each contribution retains its individual copyright but the collection as a whole is also protected. This concept is common in anthologies, encyclopedias, and periodicals, where the collective arrangement is subject to copyright, separate from the individual works.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qk.label: Washington Superior Court - Yakima County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qk.definition: Washington Superior Court - Yakima County refers to a specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Yakima County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qr.label: ODR - Machine Facilitation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qr.definition: ODR - Machine Facilitation refers to the use of technology to assist in resolving disputes through an online platform, within the context of an Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) Forum.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qs.label: Payroll Tax Payment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qs.definition: A Payroll Tax Payment, also known as Taxes on Payroll and Workforce, refers to the taxes an employer withholds from employees' wages and pays on their behalf, as well as the employer's own contribution to social security and other employee benefits. These payments include income tax withholdings, social security contributions, Medicare taxes, and unemployment insurance taxes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qs.label: Future Earning Capacity
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qs.definition: The concept of "Future Earning Capacity" refers to the potential income that an individual could have earned in the future, had they not been injured or suffered damages, and is used to calculate economic damages in legal cases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qt.label: Additional Insured Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qt.definition: An Additional Insured Clause is a provision in a contract that extends insurance coverage to a party who is not originally named as an insured under the policy.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qu.label: Motion for Access to Tax Documents
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qu.definition: A Motion for Access to Tax Documents is a legal request made in a bankruptcy case seeking permission to obtain and review tax-related records or documents.
english_labels: Motion for Access to Tax Documents

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qw.label: Novation Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qw.definition: A novation clause is a provision in a contract that allows for the substitution of a new party for one of the original parties, thereby releasing the original party from their obligations and transferring them to the new party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qx.label: Cattle
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7qx.definition: Cattle are domesticated bovine animals that belong to the species Bos taurus, commonly raised for their meat, milk, and hides, as well as for labor. This group includes both cows (females) and bulls (males), and they play a significant role in agriculture and human economies.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7r0.label: Bail Bondsman
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7r0.definition: A Bail Bondsman is a licensed professional who provides bail money for a fee, typically a percentage of the bail amount, to defendants who cannot afford to make bail themselves. The bondsman ensures the court of the defendant's appearance and may be liable for the full bail amount if the defendant fails to appear for their court date.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7r2.label: Leave Law Notice Violation Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7r2.definition: A leave law notice violation claim is a legal action initiated by an employee against their employer for not providing required notice of an employee's rights under applicable leave laws. These laws may include the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA), the California Family Rights Act (CFRA), or other state and local laws that provide protected leave for certain reasons, such as for the employee's own serious health condition, to care for a seriously ill family member, or for the birth or adoption of a child. The claim typically arises when an employer fails to provide required notice of an employee's leave rights, which can result in the employee not being aware of their rights or not being able to take leave to which they are entitled.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7r3.label: Petition for Visa for Nurses and Medical Professionals
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7r3.definition: In the United States, this was a petition for the H-1A visa category, which was previously available for foreign nurses coming to the United States to work in healthcare positions that required the skills of a registered nurse. The H-1A program was discontinued in 1995. The Nursing Relief for Disadvantaged Areas (NRDAA) program was created to replace the H-1A program, and foreign nurses are now typically eligible for H-1B visas if they meet the necessary requirements for specialty occupation positions. It's important to note that the information provided here might not be up-to-date, so it's recommended to check with official U.S. government sources or legal experts for the most current information regarding visa categories for nurses and healthcare professionals
english_labels: Petition for Visa for Nurses and Medical Professionals

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7r4.label: D.O. (Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7r4.definition: A D.O. (Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine) is a medical degree awarded after completing osteopathic medical school, emphasizing a holistic approach to healthcare. It signifies qualifications to practice medicine and perform surgery similar to M.D. (Doctor of Medicine) holders

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7r4.label: Cruelty to Animals
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7r4.definition: The intentional infliction of harm or suffering on animals, including neglect, abuse, and torture, which is prohibited by law and may result in criminal charges and penalties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7r8.label: Motorcycle
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7r8.definition: A motorcycle is a two-wheeled motorized vehicle typically powered by an internal combustion engine. Motorcycles are designed for personal transportation and come in various styles, including sport bikes, cruisers, touring bikes, and off-road motorcycles.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7r9.label: Time and Materials Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7r9.definition: A Time and Materials Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies that the client will pay for the actual time and materials used by the contractor to complete the project, rather than a fixed price.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7rE.label: Fee and Employment Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7rE.definition: Fee and Employment Practice (Bankruptcy) refers to the legal work related to the compensation of professionals and employment issues in the context of bankruptcy proceedings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7rF.label: Temporary Protected Status
english_labels: Temporary Protected Status (TPS) is a temporary immigration status granted to eligible nationals of designated countries that are experiencing ongoing armed conflict, environmental disaster, or other extraordinary conditions. In the United States, individuals granted TPS are allowed to live and work in the U.S. for a limited period and are protected from deportation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7rG.label: New York Supreme Court - Allegany County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7rG.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Allegany County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Allegany County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of civil and criminal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.
english_labels: New York Supreme Court - Allegany County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7rM.label: Alford Plea
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7rM.definition: An Alford plea (aka best-interests plea) is a type of guilty plea in which a defendant maintains their innocence but acknowledges that the prosecution has enough evidence to likely secure a conviction. This plea allows the defendant to accept punishment without admitting guilt.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7rO.label: Tax Disclaimer Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7rO.definition: A Tax Disclaimer Clause is a specific type of contractual clause that disclaims any liability or responsibility for tax-related matters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7rQ.label: Sickle Cell Disease
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7rQ.definition: Sickle Cell Disease is a genetic disorder characterized by the production of abnormally shaped red blood cells that resemble a crescent or sickle. These malformed cells can obstruct blood flow, causing pain, anemia, and a range of complications affecting various organs.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7rQ.label: Confederated Tribes of Siletz Indians of Oregon
english_labels: Confederated Tribes of Siletz Indians of Oregon

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7rS.label: Syndicate
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7rS.definition: A Syndicate refers to a group of individuals or organizations that come together for a common purpose, often to pool resources, share risks, and achieve a collective goal in various industries. In a financial transactions, a syndicate refers to a group of financial institutions or investors that come together to collectively finance a large loan or underwrite a security issuance, spreading the risk among all participants. In the context of a syndicated loan, the syndicate includes multiple lenders who each contribute a portion of the loan amount, with one or more lead banks coordinating the transaction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ra.label: tax_tier_total_tax
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ra.definition: "The sum of all TAX_TIERS.tax_tier_amount for this tx_id expressed in INVOICE.inv_currency. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7rj.label: Orthopedic Negligence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7rj.definition: Orthopedic Negligence: A type of medical negligence claim that arises when a healthcare provider fails to provide appropriate care for injuries or conditions related to the musculoskeletal system.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7rn.label: Long Form Complaint
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7rn.definition: A Long Form Complaint, also known as a Master Long Form Complaint, is a detailed legal document that outlines the plaintiff's claims and allegations against the defendant in a civil lawsuit.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7rr.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Benton County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7rr.definition: Oregon Circuit Court - Benton County: A specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system located in Benton County, with jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7rx.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Marshall County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7rx.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Marshall County refers to a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Marshall County, Indiana.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7rz.label: Relief from Stay
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7rz.definition: Relief from Stay is a legal concept that refers to a court order allowing a creditor to take action against a debtor or their property despite the automatic stay that is put in place when a bankruptcy case is filed.
english_labels: Order Granting Motion for Relief from Stay

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7s9.label: Mutual General Release Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7s9.definition: A Mutual General Release Clause is a provision in a contract that releases both parties from any claims or liabilities arising from the contract.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7sB.label: Operative Dates
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7sB.definition: Operative Dates include various time points that are significant in legal and regulatory contexts. These include the effective date, when a law or regulation becomes active; the expiration date, when a document or status ceases to be valid; and the issuance date, when an official document is provided.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7sF.label: Time-Off Benefits
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7sF.definition: Time-off benefits encompass policies or perks that allow employees to take time away from work for various reasons, such as vacation, illness, or personal needs, often with pay.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7sH.label: Individual Person Characteristics
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7sH.definition: Individual person characteristics refer to the distinct attributes or qualities that define a person's identity and differentiate them from others. These characteristics can include things like age, gender, race, ethnicity, national origin, and disability.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7sK.label: Matter Percentage Shared Fees
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7sK.definition: A Matter Percentage Shared Fee is a type of Engagement Fee Detail in which the legal fees are shared between the client and the law firm based on a percentage of the total amount recovered or saved in a legal matter.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7sM.label: Land Contract Foreclosure
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7sM.definition: Land Contract Foreclosure is the legal process initiated by a seller to reclaim property when a buyer defaults on payments under a land contract, also known as an "installment sale agreement." Unlike mortgage foreclosures, the process and rights of the parties involved may differ significantly, depending on state laws and the terms of the land contract itself. In states that recognize land contracts as a form of property ownership, failure to meet the terms of the land contract can result in foreclosure.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7sT.label: Engineering Expert
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7sT.definition: An expert in an area of engineering (e.g., mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, civil engineering).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7sW.label: Temporary Maintenance
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7sW.definition: Temporary Maintenance: A type of financial support requested by a party in a matrimonial emergency application, which provides for the payment of expenses and support during the pendency of the legal proceedings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7sa.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Stoddard County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7sa.definition: A Missouri Circuit Court - Stoddard County is a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Stoddard County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7sb.label: Potatoes
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7sb.definition: Potatoes are starchy tubers derived from the Solanum tuberosum plant, widely cultivated for their edible underground stems. They are a staple food in many cultures, known for their versatility in cooking and high nutritional value, particularly as a source of carbohydrates, vitamins, and minerals.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7si.label: General Indemnity Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7si.definition: A General Indemnity Clause is a provision in a contract where one party agrees to protect and compensate the other party for any losses, damages, or liabilities that may arise from the contract, regardless of fault or cause.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7sm.label: Fraud by Nondisclosure
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7sm.definition: The concept of Fraud by Nondisclosure refers to a type of fraud claim where one party intentionally fails to disclose important information to another party, which causes harm or damages to the other party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7so.label: Breach of Employment Contract with No Specified Term
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7so.definition: The Breach of Employment Contract with No Specified Term refers to a violation of an employment agreement that does not have a specific end date.
english_labels: Breach of Employment Contract with No Specified Term

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7sr.label: Clerk's Notice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7sr.definition: A Clerk's Notice is a written communication issued by a court clerk, informing parties of a court action or decision.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7sr.label: Intellectual Property Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7sr.definition: A provision in a contract that outlines the ownership and rights of intangible creations, such as inventions, literary and artistic works, and symbols.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ss.label: Animal Attack Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ss.definition: A claim for damages resulting from an animal's attack on a person, which falls under the broader categories of animal claims and personal injury claims.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7st.label: Program Design and Delivery Risk
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7st.definition: The threats and opportunities associated with an organization's design and delivery of specific programs, which may impact the organization's overall objectives — including the potential for negative outcomes arising from the inadequate planning, development, or execution of an organization's projects or initiatives. This can result from poor project management, ineffective stakeholder engagement, unrealistic expectations, or insufficient resources, potentially leading to delays, cost overruns, unmet objectives, or reputational damage, ultimately impacting the organization's overall performance and success

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7st.label: Komi
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7st.definition: A language spoken by the Komi people, primarily in the Komi Republic of Russia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7sz.label: JJ20 Applications for an injunction or committal (UK J-CODE)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7sz.definition: Work performed related to applications for an injunction or committal.
english_labels: JJ20 Applications for an injunction or committal (UK J-CODE)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7t2.label: Timber Rights
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7t2.definition: Timber rights provide the holder with the authority to harvest trees from a designated area of land. These rights can be sold or leased independently of the land itself.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7t6.label: Municipal Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7t6.definition: Municipal Law refers to the body of law that governs the administration of local government and the relationship between municipalities and their residents.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7t9.label: Motion to Remove Debtor as Debtor in Possession
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7t9.definition: A Motion to Remove Debtor as Debtor in Possession is a legal request made in a bankruptcy case to remove the current debtor from their role as the debtor in possession, typically due to a conflict of interest or other issue that may hinder the administration of the bankruptcy estate.
english_labels: Motion to Remove Debtor as Debtor in Possession

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7tE.label: Florida County Court - Hamilton County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7tE.definition: Florida County Court - Hamilton County refers to the specific court located in Hamilton County, Florida that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within that county.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7tF.label: No Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7tF.definition: For those matters (e.g., personal injury) and clients (e.g., individuals) where an `Industry` is not applicable.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7tK.label: Legal Services Provider - Person
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7tK.definition: A Legal Services Provider - Person is an individual who provides legal services and is associated with specific invoice data, including their provider level, timekeeper ID, first name, and last name.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7tL.label: tax_tier_amount_tax
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7tL.definition: "Tax amount resulting from TAX_TIER_DETAIL.tax_tier_rate* TAX_TIER_DETAIL.tax_tier_taxable_amount expressed in INVOICE.inv_currency. If TAX.increase_decrease = Decrease for this TAX.tx_id, this will be a negative number. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7tN.label: Licensed Rights Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7tN.definition: A Licensed Rights Clause is a provision in a contract that grants permission to use or distribute a specific product or service, subject to certain conditions and limitations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7tf.label: Bailment (Agreement)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7tf.definition: An agreement in which one party delivers personal property to another party for safekeeping, with the understanding that the property will be returned upon demand or at a specified time.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ti.label: Provider Level
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ti.definition: Provider Level refers to the classification of a person who provides legal services, which can be further categorized as either a timekeeper or non-timekeeper level.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7tm.label: Easement Agreement Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7tm.definition: A provision in a contract that grants a non-possessory interest in another's land, allowing the holder to use the land for a specific purpose.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7tn.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Erie County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7tn.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Erie County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Erie County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7tr.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Sevier Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7tr.definition: A court located in Sevier County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7tw.label: Brief Analysis Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7tw.definition: Brief Analysis Management is the process of organizing and managing legal research and litigation information in a concise and efficient manner.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7tx.label: Broadcasting Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7tx.definition: Broadcasting Law governs the transmission of television and radio programs, including the regulation of content, licensing, and the management of broadcasting rights. It ensures that broadcasters comply with standards for public interest, decency, and fairness.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ty.label: Insects
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ty.definition: Insects are a class of invertebrate animals within the phylum Arthropoda, characterized by a three-part body (head, thorax, and abdomen), three pairs of jointed legs, compound eyes, and one pair of antennae. Insects are the most diverse group of animals on Earth, inhabiting nearly all environments and playing crucial roles in ecosystems as pollinators, decomposers, and prey for other animals.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7u0.label: Waiver of Right to Sue Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7u0.definition: A Waiver of Right to Sue Clause is a provision in a legal agreement where one party agrees to give up their right to bring a lawsuit against the other party in the event of a dispute.
english_labels: Waiver of Right to Sue Clause

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7u1.label: Criminal Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7u1.definition: Criminal Claims refer to legal claims made in a court of law against an individual or entity for committing a crime, including offenses against people, property, the government, and the public.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7u2.label: Non-Contributory Benefit
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7u2.definition: A type of social security benefit funded by general tax revenues rather than individual contributions, typically provided to eligible individuals based on criteria such as age, disability, or income level. Non-contributory benefits aim to provide a basic level of social protection and poverty alleviation for those who may not have contributed sufficiently to qualify for contributory benefits.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7uB.label: Good Faith Negotiation Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7uB.definition: A Good Faith Negotiation Clause is a provision in a contract that requires the parties to negotiate in good faith when attempting to resolve disputes or reach an agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7uF.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Mississippi County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7uF.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Mississippi County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Mississippi County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7uJ.label: Defined Terms Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7uJ.definition: Defined Terms Management refers to the process of organizing and maintaining a collection of specific terms and their definitions within legal documents, distinct from general document management.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7uV.label: Religious Discrimination
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7uV.definition: Discrimination based on a person's religion or religious beliefs.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ub.label: Georgia District Court - Tattnall County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ub.definition: A court located in Tattnall County, Georgia that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ue.label: Financial Elder Abuse
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ue.definition: The unlawful or unethical exploitation of an elderly person's financial resources, assets, or property by a perpetrator who has a relationship of trust or authority with the victim.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ug.label: NATO-1 Visa
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ug.definition: A International Military Personnel Visa (aka NATO-1 visa) is issued to members of the armed forces of NATO countries stationed in the U.S. for official duties and their immediate family members. This visa category is for individuals who are part of the NATO alliance and are deployed under the provisions of the NATO agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ui.label: Appellant
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ui.definition: An appellant is a person, company or entity that applies to a higher court for a reversal of the decision of a lower court.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ul.label: Internal Use Only Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ul.definition: An Internal Use Only Clause is a provision in a contract that restricts the use of certain information or materials to only those within the organization or entity that is a party to the contract.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7um.label: Minnesota District Court - Wilkin County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7um.definition: Minnesota District Court - Wilkin County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Wilkin County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7uq.label: Indiana Superior Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7uq.definition: The Indiana Superior Court is a court of general jurisdiction in the state of Indiana that hears civil and criminal cases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7uy.label: Domain Name Registration Process
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7uy.definition: The domain name registration process is a series of steps that an individual or entity must follow to acquire a unique internet domain name. This process typically involves choosing a domain name, checking its availability, and registering it with a domain name registrar.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7uz.label: ALL American Arbitration Association Rules
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7uz.definition: Procedural rules governing arbitrations in the American Arbitration Association.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7v3.label: Motion to Release Funds
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7v3.definition: A Motion to Release Funds is a request made in a bankruptcy case to allow the debtor to access certain funds that are currently being held by the court or a trustee.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7v4.label: Consumer Credit Billing Error
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7v4.definition: A consumer credit billing error is a mistake made by a creditor in the billing statement of a consumer, which can include incorrect charges, interest rates, or fees, and can be the basis for a legal claim under consumer credit and contract laws.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7v7.label: Application to Waive Requirement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7v7.definition: An Application to Waive Requirement is a request made in a bankruptcy proceeding to be excused from fulfilling a particular obligation or condition.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7vB.label: Bankruptcy Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7vB.definition: Bankruptcy Claims refer to the legal claims made by creditors against a debtor who has filed for bankruptcy, seeking to recover the debts owed to them.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7vC.label: Change of Immigration Status
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7vC.definition: "Change of Immigration Status" (COS) refers to the process of applying to alter an individual's existing immigration category or status while already within the destination country, typically requiring submission of relevant documents and approval from immigration authorities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7vI.label: Ordinary Mandate
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7vI.definition: An Ordinary Mandate is a type of writ of mandamus that is issued by a court to compel a public official or entity to perform a duty that is required by law.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7vJ.label: Litigation Defenses
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7vJ.definition: Legal argument or theory seeking to defeat a legal action, based on either legal or factual grounds.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7vP.label: Taxing Jurisdiction Locality
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7vP.definition: A Taxing Jurisdiction Locality is a specific geographic area that has the authority to impose and collect taxes, and is a subcategory of Tax Detail.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7vR.label: Emolument Clause Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7vR.definition: An Emolument Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a government official, typically the President, has violated the Emoluments Clause of the United States Constitution. This claim contends that the official has received improper financial benefits, such as gifts, payments, or other advantages, from foreign governments or entities, which is prohibited by the Emoluments Clause to prevent conflicts of interest and foreign influence on public officials.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7vY.label: Superior Offer - Minimum Necessary Amount of Assets
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7vY.definition: A "Superior Offer - Minimum Necessary Amount of Assets" is a specific threshold within the broader concept of "Superior Offer" that requires a minimum amount of assets to be included in an offer in order for it to be considered superior to other offers in a legal matter.
english_labels: Superior Offer - Minimum Necessary Amount of Assets

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ve.label: New York Supreme Court - Oswego County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ve.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Oswego County is a court of general jurisdiction in the state of New York, with authority over civil and criminal cases within Oswego County.
english_labels: New York Supreme Court - Oswego County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7vf.label: M&A A Preliminary Matters Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7vf.definition: M&A A Preliminary Matters Practice refers to the legal work involved in the initial stages of a merger or acquisition, such as conducting due diligence and negotiating preliminary agreements.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7vl.label: Visas for Support Staff
english_labels: Visas for support staff often refer to non-immigrant visas that allow individuals to accompany and assist principal visa holders in the United States. For example, O-2 visas are issued to individuals who will accompany O-1 visa holders to assist in their performances or events. These visas are generally tied to the duration and conditions of the principal visa holder's status.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7w2.label: tax_total_detail_fees
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7w2.definition: "Total taxable amount of fees attributable to this tx_id, including amounts associated with MATTER_DISC_CRED where disc_cred_category = ""Fee"". Using the Math Statement on the next tab: The total for pre-split fee items for this tx_id + The total for post-split fee items for this tx_id tax_total_detail_fees If tx_id is a Tiered Tax, the value in this field should be 0. Certain taxes are calculated not only on line items, but also include another tax for these line items -- a ""tax on tax"" situation. For example, in Canada both Quebec and Prince Edward Island have specific taxes calculated on the sum of the line items plus the federal tax paid on those line items. In situations like this, the tax_total_detail_fees figure should include the other tax attributable to the line items so that the math statement for total_tax_on_fees is correct. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7w4.label: Minnesota District Court - Winona County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7w4.definition: A court located in Winona County, Minnesota that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7w5.label: Enterprise Legal Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7w5.definition: Enterprise Legal Management refers to the process of managing legal operations within a business or organization, including tasks such as legal project management, budgeting, and vendor management.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wA.label: Meals Expense
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wA.definition: Meals Expense refers to the cost incurred for food and beverages consumed during a business trip or entertainment event, which is considered as a type of expense in financial accounting and tax law.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wF.label: Hearsay Objection
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wF.definition: A Hearsay Objection is raised when a party in a legal proceeding believes that a statement being offered as evidence was made outside of the current trial or hearing and is being used to prove the truth of the matter asserted. This objection aims to exclude secondhand information that has not been subjected to cross-examination and may not be reliable.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wJ.label: First-Degree Murder
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wJ.definition: The intentional killing of another person with malice aforethought, which is planned and premeditated, and is considered the most serious form of murder.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wL.label: Appellate Filings - Correspondence and Forms
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wL.definition: Appellate Filings - Correspondence and Forms are written or electronic documents submitted to a higher court for review, including letters, requests, certificates, statements, and updates related to a legal case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wM.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Lane County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wM.definition: Oregon Circuit Court - Lane County is a specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Lane County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wN.label: Georgia Superior Court - Morgan County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wN.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Morgan County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Morgan County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wO.label: Non-Household Motor Vehicle Tax Payment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wO.definition: Non-Household Motor Vehicle Tax Payment refers to user taxes levied on motor vehicles owned by entities other than households, such as businesses, organizations, and government agencies. These taxes are typically paid at regular intervals and may include vehicle registration fees, road use taxes, and other related charges required for the legal operation of motor vehicles by non-household entities.
english_labels: Taxes paid by others in respect of motor vehicles

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wQ.label: Loss of Consortium
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wQ.definition: The concept of Loss of Consortium refers to the damages suffered by a spouse or parent due to the injury or death of their loved one, which includes the loss of companionship, affection, and support.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wZ.label: Agent Liability
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wZ.definition: Agent Liability refers to the legal responsibility of an individual or entity acting as an agent for another party, for any harm caused to a third party due to their negligence or breach of fiduciary duty.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wd.label: L611 Preservation order
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wd.definition: Activities and actions related to ensuring that data is preserved in accordance with requirements and assist with any efforts to seek relief from preservation order that may be issued by the court. Includes notice letters to other parties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7we.label: Oats
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7we.definition: Oats are a cereal crop belonging to the species Avena sativa, known for their edible seeds that are highly nutritious and commonly used in food products such as oatmeal, granola, and oat milk. They are valued for their high fiber content, particularly beta-glucan, and are grown primarily in temperate regions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wi.label: Split Dollar Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wi.definition: A Split Dollar Agreement is a contract that details how the premiums, death benefits, and cash values of a life insurance policy are split between two parties. Typically, one party owns the policy, while the other has a vested interest in the death benefit or cash value.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wi.label: Divorce Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wi.definition: Divorce Claims refer to legal actions taken by a party to end a marriage and obtain a legal dissolution of the marital relationship, including issues related to property division, spousal support, and child custody.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wj.label: Jail
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wj.definition: A Jail is a local government-run facility designed to detain individuals who are awaiting trial, sentencing, or serving short-term sentences typically for minor offenses. It serves as a temporary holding place for pretrial detainees and inmates convicted of misdemeanors, emphasizing security, custody, and limited rehabilitation services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wp.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Clearfield County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wp.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Clearfield County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in Clearfield County, Pennsylvania.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Clearfield County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wr.label: Oral Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7wr.definition: An Oral Agreement is a contract or agreement that is spoken and not written, where the parties express their mutual intentions and promises through verbal communication. While enforceable in many legal contexts, proving the terms and existence of an oral agreement can be more challenging than a written one.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ws.label: Tender Offer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ws.definition: A tender offer is a type of M&A deal structure where the acquiring company offers to purchase a significant portion or all of the target company's shares at a premium price, usually with the goal of gaining control of the target company.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ww.label: Assiniboine and Sioux Tribes of The Fort Peck Indian Reservation, Montana
english_labels: Assiniboine and Sioux Tribes of The Fort Peck Indian Reservation, Montana

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ww.label: Waiver of Exemptions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ww.definition: A waiver of exemptions is a legal document that relinquishes a debtor's right to claim certain property as exempt from seizure or sale in bankruptcy proceedings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7x6.label: Additur
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7x6.definition: Additur refers to a court's power to increase the amount of damages awarded by a jury if the judge finds the award insufficient. This practice is primarily used in the United States and is not recognized in federal courts due to constitutional concerns regarding the Seventh Amendment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7x9.label: Chippewa Cree Indians of the Rocky Boy’s Reservation, Montana
english_labels: Chippewa Cree Indians of the Rocky Boy’s Reservation, Montana

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xB.label: Efforts Standards
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xB.definition: Efforts Standards are a set of obligations that require a party to use a certain level of effort or diligence in fulfilling their obligations under a contract, with variations including Flat Covenant, Commercially Reasonable Efforts Standard, and Reasonable Best Efforts Standard.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xH.label: Coyote Valley Band of Pomo Indians of California
english_labels: Coyote Valley Band of Pomo Indians of California

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xJ.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Johnson County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xJ.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Johnson County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Johnson County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xM.label: Intentional Spoliation of Evidence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xM.definition: The intentional destruction or alteration of evidence by a party in a legal matter.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xO.label: Minnesota District Court - Stearns County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xO.definition: A Minnesota District Court located in Stearns County, which is a trial court of general jurisdiction in Minnesota, handling civil and criminal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xX.label: First Day Declaration
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xX.definition: A First Day Declaration in bankruptcy is a legal document filed by a debtor that provides information about the debtor's financial situation and the reasons for filing for bankruptcy.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xX.label: Legal Services Related Attributes
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xX.definition: Legal Services Related Attributes refer to the characteristics and classifications of tasks performed by a legal service provider that determine whether the activities are billable or non-billable to the client. These attributes help identify the financial impact and efficiency of the services provided, influencing billing practices and revenue generation for the firm.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xY.label: Privacy Principles
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xY.definition: These privacy principles, developed by the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD), provide the most commonly used privacy framework, they are reflected in existing and emerging privacy and data protection laws, and serve as the basis for the creation of leading practice privacy programs and additional principles. These principles are part of the OECD Guidelines on the Protection of Privacy and Transborder Flows of Personal Data, which was developed in the late 1970s and adopted in 1980.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xe.label: Accumulation Fund
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xe.definition: An Accumulation Fund is an investment fund that typically reinvests its investment profits back into the fund, rather than distributing them to shareholders. This reinvestment strategy aims to enhance the fund's value over time, providing potential for capital growth.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xi.label: Export Clause Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xi.definition: An Export Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a law or government action violates the Export Clause of the United States Constitution, which prohibits states from imposing excessive burdens or discriminatory measures on interstate or international trade and commerce, thereby interfering with the free flow of goods and services across borders

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xj.label: Data Security Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xj.definition: A Data Security Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the measures and responsibilities for protecting sensitive information from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, modification, or destruction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xj.label: ADR Mini-Trial Forum
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xj.definition: An ADR Mini-Trial Forum is a specific type of Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) Forum where parties present their case to a panel of experts who then provide a non-binding evaluation of the dispute.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xk.label: Turnover of property by a custodian
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xk.definition: The turnover of property by a custodian refers to the legal action taken to recover assets that were wrongfully transferred or held by a custodian, as part of an avoidance action claim.
english_labels: Turnover of property by a custodian

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xl.label: Information Technology Risk
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xl.definition: The threats and opportunities associated with an organization's capacity and sustainability of information technology, both the infrastructure and utilization of technological applications — including the potential for negative consequences arising from an organization's reliance on technology systems, infrastructure, and processes. This can result from technology failures, cyber attacks, data breaches, or inadequate IT management practices, potentially leading to operational disruptions, financial losses, reputational damage, or legal liabilities, ultimately impacting the organization's overall performance and competitiveness.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xm.label: Effective Tangible Net Worth Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xm.definition: An Effective Tangible Net Worth Clause is a provision in a contract that requires a party to maintain a certain level of tangible assets in relation to their liabilities, in order to ensure their financial stability and ability to fulfill their obligations under the contract.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xp.label: Poultry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xp.definition: Poultry refers to domesticated birds raised primarily for their meat, eggs, and feathers. This category includes chickens, turkeys, ducks, and geese, and these birds are integral to agriculture, providing a significant source of protein and other products for human consumption.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xq.label: Loan
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xq.definition: A transaction whereby property is lent or given to another on condition of return or, where the loan is of money, repayment. In a loan of money, the money lent becomes the property of the borrower during the period of the loan against an undertaking to return a sum of an equivalent amount either on demand or on a specified date or in accordance with an agreed schedule of repayments.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xq.label: Passport Issuing Country
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xq.definition: Passport Issuing Country refers to the nation that issued an individual's passport. This information is a key element of the passport and is used to establish the individual's nationality and citizenship. It is important for identification, travel, and various legal and administrative purposes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xr.label: Written Asynchronous Communication
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xr.definition: A communication that occurs in writing and does not require that the users be synchronous (communicating at the same time).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xv.label: Timing of Acquisition Proposal Closing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7xv.definition: The Timing of Acquisition Proposal Closing refers to the specific period during which a proposal for acquisition must be closed, as determined by the Tail Period Fee Triggers, and includes the conditions of being signed, closed, not opposed, or approved during that period.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7y4.label: Fee Simple Absolute
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7y4.definition: Fee Simple Absolute is the highest form of ownership interest one can acquire in real estate, granting the holder complete and unrestricted rights to the property. This ownership is inheritable and free of any conditions or limitations beyond standard government-imposed restrictions like zoning and taxes

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yF.label: Negligence of Notary Public & Sureties
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yF.definition: The failure of a notary public and their guarantors to exercise reasonable care and diligence in performing their duties, resulting in harm or loss to a party involved in a real estate transaction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yG.label: Delaware Industrial Accident Board
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yG.definition: The Delaware Industrial Accident Board is a specialized court within the Delaware State Courts system that handles cases related to workplace injuries and accidents.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yI.label: DEPRECATED: Litigation Engagement Scope
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yI.definition: DEPRECATED: Litigation Engagement Scope refers to the scope of work and services provided by a law firm to a client in a litigation matter, including the tasks and responsibilities of the law firm and the expected outcomes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yK.label: Stolen Property Offenses
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yK.definition: Receiving, buying, selling, possessing, concealing, or transporting any property with the knowledge that it has been unlawfully taken, as by Burglary, Embezzlement, Fraud, Larceny, Robbery, etc.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yQ.label: Tlingit
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yQ.definition: A Native American language spoken by the Tlingit people of Alaska and Canada, characterized by its complex grammar and extensive use of consonant clusters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yQ.label: Simple Procedure
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yQ.definition: Defendant is not required to tell the plaintiff of dangers of a simple procedure where it is commonly understood the dangers are not likely to occur.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yS.label: Service Sales Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yS.definition: Services sales practice is the area of law focused on the legal aspects and agreements related to the sale and provision of services, rather than assets. This practice encompasses contract formation, regulatory compliance, liability issues, and the protection of intellectual property related to service transactions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yU.label: Receivership Creation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yU.definition: Receivership creation refers to the judicial appointment of a receiver to take control of and manage a company's assets during financial distress or litigation. This process aims to protect and preserve the assets while a resolution is sought, often leading to restructuring, liquidation, or sale.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yY.label: Assamese
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yY.definition: Assamese (Language) refers to a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Assam region of India.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yZ.label: Probate Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yZ.definition: A Probate Court is a specialized court that deals with the administration of estates and the distribution of assets after a person's death.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yc.label: Court-Approved Fee
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yc.definition: Used where the fees of the participant (e.g., Bankruptcy Trustee, Special Master) must be approved by the court.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yc.label: Monitoring
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yc.definition: The process of monitoring developments in the law, including judicial decisions, agency opinions, and statutory and regulatory enactments usually for the purpose of establishing up-to-date policies and protocols.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yd.label: Notice of Assignment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yd.definition: A Notice of Assignment is a written notification that informs a debtor that their debt has been assigned to a third party for collection or other purposes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yd.label: New York City Court - Hudson
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yd.definition: New York City Court - Hudson is a specific court located in New York City that operates under the jurisdiction of the New York City Court.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yi.label: Governing Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yi.definition: The law that applies to a given legal matter, which may differ from the location of (1) the client and (2) the legal work being performed. This may be contractual (e.g., "governing law is Delaware") or it may be a function of law (e.g., "negligence claim is governed by Arkansas law").

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yj.label: European Council
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yj.definition: The European Council is a key institution of the European Union that comprises the heads of state or government of the member states, the President of the European Council, and the President of the European Commission. It plays a crucial role in setting the EU's overall political direction and priorities, but does not have legislative power.
english_labels: Council of the European Union Heads of State

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yk.label: Appellate Final Form Brief
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yk.definition: A written legal argument submitted to an appellate court as a final attempt to persuade the court to rule in favor of the submitting party, following the submission of previous briefs and oral arguments.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yr.label: Workplace Violence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yr.definition: Workplace Violence: Any physical or verbal abuse, harassment, intimidation, or threatening behavior that occurs in a work setting, which may result in harm or injury to employees or damage to property.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yu.label: Negligently Providing Alcohol
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yu.definition: The concept of Negligently Providing Alcohol refers to the legal claim that holds a person responsible for providing alcohol to someone who is not legally allowed to consume it or who is already intoxicated, resulting in harm or injury to that person or others.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yx.label: National Business Identification Number
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yx.definition: National Business Identifiers are a unique identification numbers that governments assign to a business entity for regulatory, tax, and reporting purposes. In the United States, this is commonly known as the Federal Employer Identification Number (EIN), which is used to identify businesses for government purposes (e.g., tax, immigration).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yy.label: Formation Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7yy.definition: A Formation Agreement is a type of legal agreement that outlines the terms and conditions of a business arrangement between parties, specifically related to the creation or formation of a new entity or venture.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7z0.label: Geographic Market Segments
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7z0.definition: Geographic market attributes refer to the characteristics of a market that are defined by the geographical scope and location of consumers and businesses. These attributes can include the national, international, and local reach of a market, and they play a crucial role in shaping marketing strategies and product offerings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7z0.label: Xhosa
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7z0.definition: A Bantu language spoken in South Africa, characterized by its use of click consonants.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7z8.label: Urinary and Reproductive System Disorders
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7z8.definition: Genitourinary disorders encompass a range of conditions affecting the organs of the reproductive and urinary systems, including the kidneys, bladder, ureters, urethra, and reproductive organs. These disorders can be congenital or acquired and may involve functional impairment, structural abnormalities, or systemic diseases impacting the genitourinary system.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7z9.label: Motions Regarding Counsel
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7z9.definition: A Motion Regarding Counsel is a formal request made to an appellate court by a party in a legal case to change or remove their legal representation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zC.label: International Organization Meeting Visa For Non-Member Governments
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zC.definition: A International Organization Meeting Visa For Non-Member Governments (in the U.S., a G-3 visa) is issued to representatives of non-recognized or non-member foreign governments traveling to the U.S. to attend meetings of designated international organizations. This visa category also includes their immediate family members.
english_labels: International Organization Meeting Visa For Non-Member Governments

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zF.label: Contingent Convertible Share
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zF.definition: A Contingent Convertible Share, often referred to as a CoCo bond, is a type of debt security that automatically converts into equity when a predefined trigger event occurs, typically related to the issuer's financial health or regulatory capital thresholds. These instruments are designed to provide additional capital to the issuer during periods of financial stress, thereby enhancing financial stability.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zH.label: Naturalization Application
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zH.definition: The Naturalization Application is a legal claim related to immigration that seeks to obtain citizenship for a non-citizen by fulfilling the requirements set forth by the government.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zJ.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Scott County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zJ.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Scott County: A specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Scott County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zO.label: Right of Antichresis
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zO.definition: The Right of Antichresis in civil law refers to a security arrangement where a debtor provides a creditor with the right to the fruits or income generated by a real property, usually land or a building, as a means to service or secure a debt. This right allows the creditor to apply the income generated from the property toward repayment of the debt, without transferring ownership of the property itself

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zR.label: Waste
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zR.definition: Waste refers to the destruction, damage, or misuse of property by a person who is not the owner, resulting in harm or loss to the owner.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zS.label: Nonconsolidation Letter
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zS.definition: An opinion letter stating that a property will not be subject to “substantive consolidation” in situations where a restructuring or liquidation may involve the property’s owner.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zV.label: Forward-looking MAE Application - "Adverse impact on target's business" Language
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zV.definition: A Forward-looking MAE Application - "Adverse impact on target's business" Language is a specific application of the Forward-looking Material Adverse Effect (MAE) Standard that focuses on the potential negative effects on the target company's business in the future.
english_labels: Forward-looking MAE Application - "Adverse impact on target's business" Language

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zW.label: Transgender
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zW.definition: Transgender: A person whose gender identity differs from the sex they were assigned at birth.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zW.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Ford County (11th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Ford County (11th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zY.label: Cross Indemnity Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zY.definition: A Cross Indemnity Clause is a provision in a contract where each party agrees to indemnify and hold harmless the other party from any claims or damages arising from the other party's actions or omissions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7za.label: Social Host Liability
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7za.definition: The legal concept of Social Host Liability refers to the responsibility of a person who provides alcohol to others, particularly minors, and can be held liable for any harm or damages caused by the intoxicated individuals.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zd.label: JE10 Issue and Serve Proceedings and Preparation of Statement of Case (UK J-CODE)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zd.definition: Work related to effecting service, including dealing with process servers or the foreign process office. Work in preparation of claims, petitions and any other originating process, Statements of Case, Part 20 proceedings, including reviewing those of other parties whether or not a responsive document is served. Includes all work with counsel thereon and all dealings with client and others in connection therewith. In appeals includes Appellants’ and Respondents’ Notices and supporting skeleton arguments.
english_labels: JE10 Issue and Serve Proceedings and Preparation of Statement of Case (UK J-CODE)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ze.label: M.F.A. (Master of Fine Arts)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ze.definition: An M.F.A. (Master of Fine Arts) is an advanced degree typically earned in creative or performing arts disciplines, such as visual arts, writing, or theater. It signifies a high level of proficiency and specialization in artistic endeavors

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ze.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Mora County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7ze.definition: A court located in Mora County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases.
english_labels: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Mora County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zm.label: Legal Assistance Document
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zm.definition: A legal assistance document refers to informational materials designed to guide individuals through legal processes, often without the need for direct representation by a lawyer. Examples include legal self-help guides, online court legal information portals, and standardized forms that provide step-by-step instructions for common legal procedures.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zm.label: Household Size
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zm.definition: Household size refers to the number of individuals who reside together as a single economic unit. This number is relevant for determining eligibility for certain benefits, exemptions, or deductions, and it impacts calculations related to taxes, bankruptcy means tests, and other legal considerations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zq.label: Affirmative Action Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zq.definition: An affirmative action claim is a legal assertion or case related to the enforcement of policies that promote opportunities for historically excluded groups in employment, education, and other areas, often involving allegations of discrimination or non-compliance with governmental regulations on diversity and equal opportunity.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zu.label: Motion to Redact
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zu.definition: A Motion to Redact is a formal request made in a trial court or bankruptcy court to remove or conceal certain information from a document or record.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zv.label: Trial Court Practice Documents
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R7zv.definition: Trial Court Practice Documents are written or presented materials used in the litigation process, including exhibits, reports, affidavits, motions, stipulations, and other procedural documents created or used in trial courts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R802.label: Mozirje
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R802.definition: Mozirje is a town located in Slovenia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R805.label: Georgia Superior Court - Pulaski County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R805.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Pulaski County is a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Pulaski County, Georgia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R806.label: Atacora
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R806.definition: Atacora is a region in Benin.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R806.label: S Corporation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R806.definition: An S Corporation is a type of corporation that meets certain Internal Revenue Service requirements and is taxed differently than a regular corporation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R807.label: Interrogatories Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R807.definition: Interrogatories Practice refers to the specific legal practice of using written questions to obtain information from the opposing party in a legal matter, falling under the broader category of Written Discovery Practice.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80C.label: Mosta
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80C.definition: Mosta is a locality in Malta.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80F.label: Ammochostos
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80F.definition: Ammochostos is a city located in the country of Cyprus.
