https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80I.label: Mixed Distribution Fund
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80I.definition: A Mixed Distribution Fund is an investment fund that allocates its investment profits by partially distributing them to shareholders and partially reinvesting them back into the fund. This balanced approach aims to provide both income and capital growth to investors.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80L.label: M&A D Ancillary Documents Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80L.definition: A practice area within M&A law that focuses on the drafting and negotiation of ancillary documents related to mergers and acquisitions, such as non-disclosure agreements and transition services agreements.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80N.label: Non-Filing Spouse
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80N.definition: A person who is the spouse of someone in bankruptcy, but who is not a part of that bankruptcy.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80O.label: Special Conditions Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80O.definition: A Special Conditions Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines specific terms or requirements that are unique to that particular agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80Q.label: Florida County Court - Bradford County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80Q.definition: Florida County Court - Bradford County is a specific court within the Florida County Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Bradford County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80T.label: Visa for Dependent of Individuals with Extraordinary Ability or Achievement or their Staff
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80T.definition: The Visa for Dependent of Individuals with Extraordinary Ability or Achievement or their Staff (in the U.S., the O-3 Visa) is designated for dependents of Extraordinary Ability or Achievement or their staff (in the U.S., O-1 and O-2 visa holders). In the United States, this includes spouses and unmarried children under the age of 21. While O-3 visa holders are not permitted to work in the U.S., they are allowed to study. The duration of the O-3 visa is typically tied to that of the principal O-1 or O-2 visa holder
english_labels: Visa for Dependent of Individuals with Extraordinary Ability or Achievement or their Staff

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80T.label: Washington Superior Court - Cowlitz County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80T.definition: A court located in Cowlitz County, Washington that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80Z.label: Birds
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80Z.definition: Birds are a class of vertebrate animals characterized by feathers, beaks without teeth, and a high metabolic rate. Most birds are capable of flight, although some species are flightless, and they lay hard-shelled eggs, exhibit complex behaviors, and are found in a variety of environments worldwide.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80k.label: Motion to Amend Protective Order
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80k.definition: A Motion to Amend Protective Order is a formal request to modify a court order that limits access to certain information or materials in a legal case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80n.label: Gender
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80n.definition: Gender (Self-Identified) refers to an individual's personal identification of their gender, regardless of their biological sex, and may include non-binary, transgender, female, or male identities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80r.label: Contracts Clause Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80r.definition: A Contracts Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that the law or action impairs the obligations of existing contracts, either by retroactively changing the terms or by unduly burdening the parties' ability to enforce or perform their contractual rights and obligations. The Contracts Clause prohibits the impairment of contractual rights by the government without a legitimate and substantial public purpose.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80s.label: Subpoena Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R80s.definition: Subpoena Practice refers to the legal work involved in issuing and serving a subpoena, including the preparation and filing of necessary documents and the coordination of responses from relevant parties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R811.label: Maha Sarakham
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R811.definition: Maha Sarakham is a province in Thailand.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R812.label: U.S. Bankruptcy Court - D. Colorado
english_labels: United States Bankruptcy Court, D. Colorado

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R814.label: Gbarpolu
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R814.definition: Gbarpolu is a region in Liberia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R815.label: Masindi
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R815.definition: Masindi is a town in Uganda.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R815.label: Minnesota District Court - Renville County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R815.definition: Minnesota District Court - Renville County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Renville County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R816.label: Defense Health Agency
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R816.definition: The Defense Health Agency (DHA) is a joint, integrated Combat Support Agency that enables the U.S. Army, U.S. Navy, and U.S. Air Force medical services to provide a medically ready force and ready medical force to Combatant Commands in both peacetime and wartime.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R817.label: Camarines Norte
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R817.definition: Camarines Norte is a province in the Philippines.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R819.label: New York City Court - Schenectady
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R819.definition: A court located in Schenectady, New York that operates under the jurisdiction of the New York City Court.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R819.label: No Warranties Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R819.definition: A No Warranties Clause is a provision in a contract that disclaims any guarantees or assurances regarding the quality or performance of a product or service, and places the risk of use solely on the user.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R819.label: Plateaux
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R819.definition: A plateau is a raised area of land with a flat top and steep sides, located in the country of Togo.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81A.label: Al Hasakah
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81A.definition: Al Hasakah is a city in Syria.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81A.label: Bonus Certificate
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81A.definition: A Bonus Certificate, also known as a Structured Note, is a financial instrument that allows participation in the development of the underlying asset or assets with certain protective features. The minimum redemption value is equal to the nominal value, provided a specified barrier has not been breached; if the barrier is breached, the product converts into a tracker certificate. With greater risk, multiple underlying assets (worst-of) allow for a higher bonus level or lower barrier, offering reduced risk compared to a direct investment in the underlying assets.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81B.label: 895 Freedom of Information Act (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81B.definition: Action filed under the Freedom of Information Act 5:552.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81E.label: Chiayi
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81E.definition: Chiayi is a city located in Taiwan.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81E.label: Civilian Agency Acquisition Council
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81E.definition: The Civilian Agency Acquisition Council (CAAC) Assists the Administrator of General Services in developing and maintaining the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) System by developing or reviewing all proposed changes to the FAR.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81F.label: Isabela
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81F.definition: Isabela is a province in the Philippines.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81H.label: New York Supreme Court - Chemung County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81H.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Chemung County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Chemung County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal disputes within its geographic jurisdiction.
english_labels: New York Supreme Court - Chemung County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81H.label: Jury Selection Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81H.definition: Jury Selection Management refers to the process of selecting and managing a jury for a trial, including the screening of potential jurors and the final selection of those who will serve on the jury.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81Q.label: Motion to Substitute Party
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81Q.definition: A Motion to Substitute Party is a legal request made in a trial or appellate court to replace one party in a case with another party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81Q.label: A104 Review/analyze
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81Q.definition: The concept of A104 Review/analyze refers to the specific activity of examining and evaluating information or data in order to gain a better understanding or make informed decisions, and is a subcategory of the broader category of A100 Activities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81S.label: Lessor’s Breach of Implied Warranty on Goods
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81S.definition: The Lessor's Breach of Implied Warranty on Goods refers to the failure of a party who leases goods to provide goods that are fit for their intended purpose, which was not explicitly stated in the lease agreement.
english_labels: Lessor’s Breach of Implied Warranty on Goods

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81S.label: Indemnification for Third Party Claims Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81S.definition: A provision in a contract that requires one party to compensate and defend the other party against any claims made by a third party.
english_labels: Indemnification for Third Party Claims Clause

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81T.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Washington County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81T.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Washington County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, located in Washington County.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Washington County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81U.label: Withdrawal of Objection
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81U.definition: A Withdrawal of Objection is a formal action taken by a party in legal proceedings to rescind or retract a previously filed objection, effectively signaling agreement or no further contest to the matter at issue. This action can occur in various legal contexts, including litigation, administrative proceedings, and bankruptcy cases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81U.label: Public Offering
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81U.definition: Public Debt Offering, also known as Retail Distributions, refer to the sale of non-convertible debt securities directly to individual investors or through channels that cater to non-institutional buyers. This method of distribution makes debt securities accessible to the general public, often in smaller denominations than those typically offered to institutional investors. This process allows governments or corporations to raise capital from a broad base of retail investors, often involving simplified issuance procedures.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81U.label: Physical Accessibility Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81U.definition: A physical accessibility claim is made when a physical space or infrastructure, like a building, public space, or facility, is not accessible or usable by individuals with disabilities. This might involve a lack of ramps, inappropriately designed restrooms, or inaccessible public areas.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81U.label: Visa for Individuals with Extraordinary Ability or Achievement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81U.definition: Visas for individuals with extraordinary ability or achievement in fields such as sciences, arts, education, business, or athletics (in the U.S., an O-1 visa), is a non-immigrant visa allows recipients to work temporarily in the destination country (e.g., U.S.). In the United States, that duration is typically for up to three years, with the possibility of extensions in one-year increments as long as they continue to maintain their "extraordinary" status.
english_labels: Visa for Individuals with Extraordinary Ability or Achievement

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81V.label: Grand Jury Proceedings Unlawfully Disclosed
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81V.definition: The concept of "Grand Jury Proceedings Unlawfully Disclosed" refers to the illegal act of revealing information about a grand jury investigation, which is supposed to be kept confidential, without proper authorization or legal justification.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81a.label: Copying Expense
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81a.definition: The Copying Expense concept refers to the costs incurred for reproducing documents or materials, which are necessary for a legal matter and are considered as an expense.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81c.label: Prison Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81c.definition: Prison Law refers to the body of laws and regulations that govern the rights and responsibilities of prisoners, including their treatment and conditions of incarceration. It also encompasses the rules and policies that regulate the management and organization of prison facilities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81e.label: Terrorism
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81e.definition: The concept of Terrorism refers to the use of violence and intimidation in pursuit of political aims, often targeting civilians and carried out by individuals or groups against a government or society.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81g.label: Exchange Debt for Equity
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81g.definition: An asset exchange where a party replaces debt with equity — or equity with debt — in a company. Replacing debt with equity often occurs during restructuring to improve financial stability. Replacing equity with debt can help raise capital while avoiding dilution of ownership.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81j.label: Work Order Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81j.definition: A Work Order Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the specific tasks or services to be performed by one party for another, often including details such as timelines, deliverables, and compensation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81k.label: Emancipation of a Minor (Remedy)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81k.definition: Emancipation of a minor refers to a legal process through which a minor becomes legally independent from their parents or guardians, thereby assuming most adult responsibilities. Once emancipated, the minor is no longer under the care or control of their parents or guardians, and they can make legal decisions on their own behalf.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81n.label: Business Development Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81n.definition: Business Development Management refers to the strategic planning and implementation of initiatives aimed at expanding and improving the business operations of a law firm or legal organization.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81o.label: Judgment of Arbitration
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81o.definition: A Judgment of Arbitration is a decision made by an arbitrator or panel of arbitrators in a dispute resolution process, which is binding on the parties involved.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81q.label: Disability Public Benefit
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81q.definition: Disability public benefit refers to government-provided financial assistance specifically aimed at individuals who are unable to work due to a disability. These benefits are designed to provide a safety net by replacing lost income or covering additional costs associated with the disability. In the United States, this can include Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI), Social Security disability insurance, and Supplemental Security Income (SSI).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81s.label: Central American Indian languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81s.definition: Central American Indian languages are a group of languages spoken by indigenous peoples in Central America, including languages such as K'iche', Mam, and Nahuatl.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81v.label: Intended Spouse
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81v.definition: An Intended Spouse is a person who is engaged to be married and has a clear intention to enter into a legally recognized marriage. This status often involves legal considerations, such as immigration benefits, where the intended spouse may apply for a visa to join their partner in another country for the purpose of marriage.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81w.label: Responses to Requests for Production
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81w.definition: Responses to Requests for Production are documents produced in response to a formal request for information during the discovery phase of a legal proceeding.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81y.label: Collaboration Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R81y.definition: A Collaboration Agreement is a legal document that outlines the terms and conditions of a partnership between two or more parties for the purpose of working together towards a common goal.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R820.label: Janub al Batinah
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R820.definition: Janub al Batinah is a region in Oman.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R820.label: Phatthalung
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R820.definition: Phatthalung is a province in Thailand.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R823.label: Poaching
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R823.definition: Poaching is the illegal hunting, capturing, or killing of wildlife, often in violation of local, national, or international conservation laws. This activity typically targets endangered or protected species for their meat, fur, or body parts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R824.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Pike County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R824.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Pike County refers to a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Pike County, Indiana.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R824.label: Mon
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R824.definition: A Mon is an ethnic group native to Myanmar and neighboring countries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R824.label: Saint Ann
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R824.definition: Saint Ann is a geographic location in Jamaica.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R826.label: Motion in Limine to Exclude Hearsay Witness
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R826.definition: A Motion in Limine to Exclude Hearsay Witness is a legal request made by one party to prevent the other party from presenting testimony from a witness who will testify about statements made by someone else out of court, which are being offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted.
english_labels: Motion in Limine to Exclude Hearsay Witness

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R826.label: Massachusetts Superior Court - Berkshire County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R826.definition: The Massachusetts Superior Court - Berkshire County is a specific court within the Massachusetts Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases in Berkshire County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R828.label: Pecki okrug
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R828.definition: Pecki okrug is a region located in Serbia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82B.label: Vila Real
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82B.definition: Vila Real is a city in Portugal.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82D.label: Non-Hearsay Evidentiary Objective
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82D.definition: A Non-Hearsay Evidentiary Objective refers to a purpose for admitting an out-of-court statement that is specifically exempted from the hearsay rule due to its inherent reliability or fairness in the context of the adversarial process. These objectives include party admissions, prior statements by witnesses under oath, and prior identifications made by witnesses.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82F.label: Palladium
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82F.definition: A one troy ounce unit of the precious metal palladium, which is used as a standard of exchange.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82I.label: Affidavit of Prejudice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82I.definition: An Affidavit of Prejudice is a legal document filed by a party in a case, alleging that the decision maker assigned to the case is biased or prejudiced against them, and requesting that the decision maker be disqualified from the case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82U.label: Joint Will
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82U.definition: A Joint Will is a single testamentary document executed by two or more individuals, typically spouses, which combines their respective wills into one instrument. This document outlines how the collective assets of the testators will be distributed upon the death of both or all parties, often including provisions that the surviving party cannot alter the will after the first person's death.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82Y.label: Funds, Trusts, and Other Financial Vehicles Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82Y.definition: Industries in the Funds, Trusts, and Other Financial Vehicles subsector group legal entities (i.e., funds, plans, and/or programs) organized to pool securities or other assets on behalf of shareholders or beneficiaries of employee benefit or other trust funds. The portfolios are customized to achieve specific investment characteristics, such as diversification, risk, rate of return, and price volatility. These entities earn interest, dividends, and other investment income, but have little or no employment and no revenue from the sale of services. Establishments with employees devoted to the management of funds are classified in Industry Group 5239, Other Financial Investment Activities. Establishments primarily engaged in holding the securities of (or other equity interests in) other firms are classified in Sector 55, Management of Companies and Enterprises. Equity real estate investment trusts (REITs) that are primarily engaged in leasing buildings, dwellings, or other real estate property to others are classified in Subsector 531, Real Estate.
english_labels: Funds, Trusts, and Other Financial Vehicles Industry

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82Y.label: Nursing Home Liability
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82Y.definition: Nursing Home Liability refers to the legal responsibility of a nursing home for any harm caused to its residents due to negligence or misconduct, specifically in cases where the nursing home is managed by a third-party entity.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82i.label: Administrative Judgment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82i.definition: An administrative judgment is a decision made by a government agency or administrative body, typically in regards to a specific case or issue.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82i.label: No-Shop Covenant - Fiduciary Exception Triggering Event
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82i.definition: A No-Shop Covenant - Fiduciary Exception Triggering Event is an exception to a no-shop covenant in a merger or acquisition agreement that allows a target company's board of directors to consider alternative acquisition proposals from third parties if they are deemed to be in the best interest of the company's shareholders.
english_labels: No-Shop Covenant - Fiduciary Exception Triggering Event

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82k.label: Cost or Fee Awarded - Amount Reduced
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82k.definition: A reduction in the amount of costs or fees awarded, which is a part of the broader concepts of cost shifting and fee shifting in legal matters.
english_labels: Cost or Fee Awarded - Amount Reduced

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82l.label: New York City Court - White Plains
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82l.definition: A court located in White Plains, New York that operates under the jurisdiction of the New York City Court.
english_labels: New York City Court - White Plains

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82m.label: Publicity Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82m.definition: A Publicity Clause is a provision in a contract that governs the use of a party's name, image, or likeness for promotional purposes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82s.label: Fatality Indicator
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82s.definition: T/F - True if an incident involves a fatality

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82u.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Mercer County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82u.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Mercer County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that handles minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil cases involving amounts up to $12,000.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Mercer County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82u.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Somerset County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82u.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Somerset County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering civil and criminal proceedings at the county level in Pennsylvania.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Somerset County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82x.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Ashley Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R82x.definition: A court located in Ashley County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its designated geographical area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R831.label: Motion for Separate Trials
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R831.definition: A Motion for Separate Trials is a legal request to have different issues or parties in a lawsuit tried separately, rather than together in one trial.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R831.label: extend_header
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R831.definition: "Used for client and/or firm specific extensions to the FIRM Segment (See EXTEND_HEADER Segment below). If no extensions are defined, this element will not be present. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R832.label: Extension of Agreement Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R832.definition: An Extension of Agreement Clause is a provision in a contract that allows for the continuation of the agreement beyond its original expiration date.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R833.label: Logatec
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R833.definition: Logatec is a town located in Slovenia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R836.label: Gorj
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R836.definition: Gorj is a region in Romania.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R836.label: U.S. Bankruptcy Court - W.D. Tennessee
english_labels: United States Bankruptcy Court, W.D. Tennessee

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R839.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Tazewell County (10th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Tazewell County (10th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R839.label: Bayburt
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R839.definition: Bayburt is a city in Turkey.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83A.label: Stockholms lan
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83A.definition: Stockholms lan is a political subdivision of Sweden located in the eastern part of the country.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83A.label: U.S. Bankruptcy Court - D. Guam
english_labels: United States Bankruptcy Court, D. Guam

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83A.label: Fraud and Deceit Based on Concealment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83A.definition: Fraud and Deceit Based on Concealment refers to a legal claim that arises when one party intentionally hides or fails to disclose important information from another party, with the intention of deceiving them and causing them harm.
english_labels: Fraud and Deceit Based on Concealment

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83C.label: Napak
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83C.definition: Napak is a geographical location in Uganda.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83D.label: Painting
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83D.definition: A Painting is a visual artistic work created by applying pigments on a surface such as canvas, paper, or walls, often intended to express ideas, emotions, or aesthetic beauty. Paintings are protected under copyright law, giving the artist exclusive rights to reproduce, distribute, and display their work.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83D.label: Act or Omission by Public Employee
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83D.definition: An act or failure to act by a government employee that results in harm or injury to another person, which may give rise to a legal claim for damages under the doctrine of governmental tort liability.
english_labels: Act or Omission by Public Employee

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83E.label: Failure to Arbitrate
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83E.definition: The Failure to Arbitrate is a legal defense that arises when a party fails to comply with an agreement to resolve a dispute through arbitration, instead choosing to pursue litigation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83F.label: Fee Examiner
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83F.definition: A Fee Examiner is an expert who specializes in reviewing and analyzing fees charged in legal matters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83J.label: CLIENT_TAX_ID
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83J.definition: A unique identification number assigned to a client for tax purposes, as defined within the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83K.label: Indiana Superior Court - Wabash County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83K.definition: A court located in Wabash County, Indiana that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83L.label: Gaelic; Scottish Gaelic
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83L.definition: A language spoken in Scotland, also known as Scottish Gaelic.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83L.label: Corrected Brief
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83L.definition: A corrected brief is a written legal document submitted to an appellate court that revises errors or mistakes in a previously filed brief.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83N.label: Ad Hoc/Unofficial Committee
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83N.definition: An ad hoc committee is formed for a specific purpose, usually to solve a particular problem. In U.S. bankruptcy law, an Unofficial Committee means the informal committee comprised of certain of the debtors' larger unsecured creditors that was formed and active prior to the commencement date.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83Q.label: Interview
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83Q.definition: An interview is a type of discovery event where a person is questioned to obtain information relevant to a legal matter, including fact witness interviews and expert interviews.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83Q.label: US Chapter 11 Bankruptcy - Streamlined
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83Q.definition: Provision used for less complex entities (e.g., small businesses). As defined by Subchapter V (11 USC 1181)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83U.label: Lawful Temporary Resident
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83U.definition: A Lawful Temporary Resident is a foreign national who has been granted permission to reside in a country on a temporary basis under a specific visa or immigration status. This status allows the individual to live and possibly work in the host country for a limited period as defined by the terms of their visa or temporary residency permit.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83U.label: Termination of Trust Agreement Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83U.definition: A Termination of Trust Agreement Clause is a provision in a legal document that outlines the conditions under which a trust agreement can be terminated.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83U.label: Waiver of Homestead Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83U.definition: A Waiver of Homestead Clause is a legal provision that relinquishes the right to claim a homestead exemption in a property, typically used in mortgage agreements.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83V.label: Electrical Equipment, Appliance, and Component Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83V.definition: Industries in the Electrical Equipment, Appliance, and Component Manufacturing subsector manufacture products that generate, distribute, and use electrical power. Electric Lighting Equipment Manufacturing establishments produce lighting fixtures, electric light bulbs, and parts (except glass parts and light emitting diodes (LEDs)), and other lighting equipment. Household Appliance Manufacturing establishments make both small and major electrical appliances and parts. Electrical Equipment Manufacturing establishments make goods, such as electric motors, generators, transformers, and switchgear apparatus. Other Electrical Equipment and Component Manufacturing establishments make devices for storing electrical power (e.g., batteries), for transmitting electricity (e.g., insulated wire), and wiring devices (e.g., electrical outlets, fuse boxes, and light switches).
english_labels: Electrical Equipment, Appliance, and Component Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83b.label: Personal Jurisdiction by Fairness
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83b.definition: Personal Jurisdiction by Fairness refers to the authority of a court to hear a case based on the fairness of doing so, even if the defendant does not have sufficient minimum contacts with the forum state.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83c.label: Schizophrenia
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83c.definition: Schizophrenia is a chronic and severe mental health disorder characterized by disturbances in thought processes, perceptions, emotional responsiveness, and social interactions. Symptoms include hallucinations, delusions, disorganized thinking, and impaired functioning, which can significantly affect daily life and require long-term treatment and support.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83h.label: Separation Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83h.definition: A Separation Agreement is a written document that outlines the terms and conditions agreed upon by parties who are separating or divorcing, including issues such as property division, child custody, and support.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83j.label: Motion for Jury Trial
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83j.definition: A Motion for Jury Trial is a formal request made by a party in a legal case to have a trial by jury rather than a trial by judge.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83p.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Conway Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83p.definition: The Arkansas Circuit Court - Conway County is a specific court within the Arkansas Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Conway County, Arkansas.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83r.label: Condominium Real Estate Asset
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83r.definition: A condominium real estate asset refers to a type of property ownership where an individual owns a unit within a larger building or complex and shares ownership of common areas with other unit owners. Unlike a single-family home, where the owner controls the entire property, in a condominium, the individual unit ownership is coupled with a proportional interest in communal facilities like hallways, gardens, and amenities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83s.label: Large Trader Identification Form
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83s.definition: A Large Trader Identification Form is a filing required by the financial regulator (e.g., U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)) from large traders, defined as those whose transactions in National Market System (NMS) securities equal or exceed specified thresholds. The form provides the financial regulator with information about the large trader's identity, business activities, and affiliates to enhance market surveillance and analyze the impact of large traders on the securities market.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83s.label: LegalXML OASIS SCHEMA
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83s.definition: A LegalXML OASIS Schema is a standardized format for representing legal information and documents, developed by the Organization for the Advancement of Structured Information Standards (OASIS), and is a component of the Standards Compatibility ontology.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83u.label: Limited Voting System
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83u.definition: The limited voting system is an electoral method where voters have fewer votes than the number of available seats, allowing for the possibility of minority representation. This system is designed to prevent any single group from winning all the seats and is often used to promote more diverse representation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83u.label: CFIUS Clearance
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83u.definition: CFIUS Clearance is the approval granted by the Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States for a foreign investment in a US business, which is subject to review and scrutiny to ensure that it does not pose a threat to national security.
english_labels: Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83x.label: Business Record Document
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83x.definition: A business record document is a written or electronic record created and maintained by a business organization in the regular course of its activities, which can be used as evidence in legal proceedings. These records are considered reliable and admissible in court under the business records exception to the hearsay rule.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83y.label: Thyroid Gland Disorders
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R83y.definition: Thyroid gland disorders affect the thyroid's ability to regulate metabolism and influence the sympathetic nervous system. These disorders can lead to cardiovascular issues, weight fluctuations, cerebrovascular accidents, cognitive impairments, mood disorders, and anxiety.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R841.label: Si Sa Ket
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R841.definition: Si Sa Ket is a province in Thailand.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R842.label: Obligor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R842.definition: An obligor is a person, organization, or entity that is legally bound to perform a specific duty or pay a certain amount to another party, known as the obligee. The term is commonly used in contract law, finance, and other legal contexts to identify the party with the obligation to fulfill the terms of a contract, loan, or other legal arrangement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R842.label: JC10 Factual investigation (UK J-CODE)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R842.definition: Work required to understand the facts of the case including instructions from the client and the identification of potential witnesses

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R845.label: Clare
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R845.definition: Clare refers to a specific location in Ireland, which is a county situated in the mid-west region of the country.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R845.label: Right to Collect Rent
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R845.definition: The Right to Collect Rent refers to the legal authority granted to a property owner or designated agent to receive a specified sum from tenants in exchange for the use of a property. This right is typically outlined in a lease agreement, and failure by the tenant to pay rent may result in legal actions such as eviction, subject to terms of the lease and applicable law

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R847.label: Isla
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R847.definition: An "Isla" is a landmass that is surrounded by water and smaller than a continent, specifically referring to the island of Malta.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R848.label: Motion to Limit Exclusivity Period
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R848.definition: A Motion to Limit Exclusivity Period is a request made in a bankruptcy case to shorten the time period during which only the debtor can file a reorganization plan, allowing other parties to propose their own plans.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84A.label: DUPLICATE Motion to Withdraw as Attorney
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84A.definition: A "Duplicate Motion to Withdraw as Attorney" refers to a request made by an attorney to withdraw from representing a client in a legal matter, which has already been filed previously and is a duplicate of the original motion.
english_labels: DUPLICATE Motion to Withdraw as Attorney

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84B.label: Shaviyani
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84B.definition: Shaviyani is a subdivision of the Maldives, located in the northern part of the country.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84C.label: Lodzkie
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84C.definition: Lodzkie is a region in Poland.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84C.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Henry County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84C.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Henry County: A specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Henry County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84C.label: Kaberamaido
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84C.definition: Kaberamaido is a district in Uganda.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84K.label: Analysis of Pre-Petition Lien Issues
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84K.definition: Analysis of Pre-Petition Lien Issues refers to the examination and evaluation of any legal claims or encumbrances on property that arise before the filing of a bankruptcy petition.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84N.label: Intentional Infliction of Emotional Distress
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84N.definition: The intentional causing of severe emotional distress through extreme and outrageous conduct, resulting in harm to the victim.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84O.label: Systemic Vasculitis
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84O.definition: Vasculitis is an inflammation of blood vessels. It may occur acutely in association with adverse drug reactions, certain chronic infections, and occasionally, malignancies. More often, it is chronic and the cause is unknown. Symptoms vary depending on which blood vessels are involved. Systemic vasculitis may also be associated with other autoimmune disorders; for example, SLE or dermatomyositis.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84Q.label: UTBMS MI00 Integration Matters
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84Q.definition: The UTBMS MI00 Integration Matters concept refers to the specific task code used in the UTBMS Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) category for legal billing, which covers the integration of two or more entities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84R.label: Seizure
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84R.definition: Seizure, within the legal domain, refers to the act of legally taking possession of persons or property by law enforcement or other authorities, typically because the persons or property are suspected of being involved in, or evidence of, illegal activity.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84T.label: Social Security Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84T.definition: A claim made under the Social Security program, which provides benefits to eligible individuals based on their contributions to the program, or in some cases, based on their status as a dependent or survivor of a contributor.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84V.label: Granulocytopenia
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84V.definition: Granulocytopenia is a condition characterized by an abnormally low level of granulocytes, a type of white blood cell crucial for fighting infections. This deficiency can lead to increased susceptibility to infections, delayed wound healing, and other complications due to the impaired immune response.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84W.label: Involuntary Intoxication
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84W.definition: Involuntary intoxication is a legal defense where the defendant claims they were forced or unknowingly induced to consume intoxicating substances, rendering them unable to understand the nature of their actions. This defense can negate criminal liability if the intoxication prevented the formation of intent or awareness necessary to commit the crime.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84g.label: Texas Court of Appeals - 2d
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84g.definition: The Texas Court of Appeals - 2d is a specific intermediate appellate court in Texas that hears appeals from lower courts within its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84i.label: Texas District Court - Parker County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84i.definition: Texas District Court - Parker County: A court of law in Texas that has jurisdiction over legal cases within Parker County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84j.label: International Organization Representative Visa
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84j.definition: An International Organization Representative Visa (in the U.S., a G-1 visa) is issued to principal resident representatives of foreign governments recognized by the U.S. to international organizations, their staff, and immediate family members. It allows them to enter and remain in the U.S. to perform official duties related to their organization.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84q.label: South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84q.definition: SAARC (South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation): An economic and geopolitical organization of eight countries in South Asia, aimed at fostering mutual understanding and improving the quality of life for the peoples of the member states.
english_labels: South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84q.label: Association of Southeast Asian Nations
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84q.definition: ASEAN (Association of Southeast Asian Nations): A regional intergovernmental organization comprising ten Southeast Asian countries, promoting political and economic cooperation and regional stability.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84q.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Faulkner Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84q.definition: The Arkansas Circuit Court - Faulkner Cty. is a specific court within the Arkansas Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Faulkner County, Arkansas.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84w.label: Discharge of Mortgage
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R84w.definition: The Discharge of Mortgage is a legal concept that refers to the release of a mortgage lien on a property, typically after the mortgage has been paid in full or otherwise satisfied.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R851.label: Yukon
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R851.definition: Yukon is a territory in Canada, located in the northwest region of the country.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R851.label: Thaba-Tseka
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R851.definition: Thaba-Tseka is a district in Lesotho.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R852.label: U.S. Bankruptcy Court - W.D. Wisconsin
english_labels: United States Bankruptcy Court, W.D. Wisconsin

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R854.label: Narayani
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R854.definition: Narayani refers to a specific location in Nepal, which is a province or a district within the country.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R855.label: Castilla y Leon
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R855.definition: Castilla y Leon is a region in Spain.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R855.label: Work Holiday
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R855.definition: A Work Holiday is a designated day off from regular work duties, typically established by law, custom, or employer policy, where employees are not required to work but usually receive pay. These days often commemorate significant cultural, historical, or religious events and are intended to provide workers with time for celebration, remembrance, or rest.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R856.label: Bureau of Prisons
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R856.definition: The Federal Bureau of Prisons (BOP) is a United States federal law enforcement agency. A subdivision of the U.S. Department of Justice, the BOP is responsible for the administration of the federal prison system.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R856.label: Printing and Related Support Activities Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R856.definition: Industries in the Printing and Related Support Activities subsector print products, such as newspapers, books, labels, business cards, stationery, business forms, and other materials, and perform support activities, such as data imaging, platemaking services, and bookbinding. The support activities included here are an integral part of the printing industry, and a product (a printing plate, a bound book, or a computer disk or file) that is an integral part of the printing industry is almost always provided by these operations. Processes used in printing include a variety of methods used to transfer an image from a plate, screen, film, or computer file to some medium, such as paper, plastics, metal, textile articles, or wood. The printing processes employed include, but are not limited to, lithographic, gravure, screen, flexographic, digital, and letterpress. In contrast to many other classification systems that locate publishing of printed materials in manufacturing, NAICS classifies the publishing of printed products in Subsector 513, Publishing Industries. Though printing and publishing are often carried out by the same enterprise, it is less and less the case that these distinct activities are carried out in the same establishment. When publishing and printing are done in the same establishment, the establishment is classified in Subsector 513, Publishing Industries, in the appropriate NAICS industry even if the receipts for printing exceed those for publishing. This subsector includes printing on clothing because the production process for that activity is printing, not clothing manufacturing. For instance, the printing of T-shirts is included in this subsector. In contrast, printing on fabric (or grey goods) is not included. This activity is part of the process of finishing the fabric and is included in Industry 31331, Textile and Fabric Finishing Mills. Excluded from this subsector are establishment primarily engaged in manufacturing bare printed circuit boards. These establishments print, perforate, plate, screen, etch, or photoprint interconnecting pathways for electric current on laminates and are classified in Industry 33441, Semiconductor and Other Electronic Component Manufacturing. Establishments primarily providing printing brokerage services are classified in Industry 56199, All Other Support Services.
english_labels: Printing and Related Support Activities Industry

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R858.label: Salavan
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R858.definition: Salavan is a province in the Lao People's Democratic Republic.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R859.label: Mine Safety and Health Administration
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R859.definition: The Mine Safety and Health Administration (MSHA) is an agency of the United States Department of Labor which administers the provisions of the Federal Mine Safety and Health Act of 1977 (Mine Act) to enforce compliance with mandatory safety and health standards as a means to eliminate fatal accidents, to reduce the frequency and severity of nonfatal accidents, to minimize health hazards, and to promote improved safety and health conditions in the nation's mines.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85A.label: Washington Superior Court - Pend Oreille County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85A.definition: Washington Superior Court - Pend Oreille County refers to a specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Pend Oreille County.
english_labels: Washington Superior Court - Pend Oreille County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85B.label: Administrative Proceeding Forum
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85B.definition: An Administrative Proceeding Forum is a type of Dispute Forum that is responsible for overseeing legal proceedings related to administrative law, such as tax, workers' compensation, and immigration cases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85D.label: Summit Lake Paiute Tribe of Nevada 6059 Susanville Indian Rancheria, California
english_labels: Summit Lake Paiute Tribe of Nevada 6059 Susanville Indian Rancheria, California

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85D.label: Governmental Representative
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85D.definition: A governmental representative is an individual elected or appointed to act on behalf of a larger group of citizens within a governmental system. Examples include presidents, prime ministers, legislators, or council members, each holding specific roles and responsibilities within their respective branches of government.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85F.label: Dornod
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85F.definition: Dornod is a region in Mongolia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85F.label: Administrative Conference of the United States
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85F.definition: ACUS is an independent U.S. federal agency charged with convening expert representatives from the public and private sectors to recommend improvements to administrative process and procedure. ACUS initiatives promote efficiency, participation, and fairness in the promulgation of federal regulations and in the administration of federal programs.
english_labels: Administrative Conference of the United States

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85G.label: JG20 Reviewing Other Party witness statement (UK J-CODE)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85G.definition: Considering Other Party(s)' witness statements, affidavits, witness summaries, Civil Evidence Act or similar notices, reviewing same in context of other evidence and material, considering strategy to deal with issues raised.
english_labels: JG20 Reviewing Other Party witness statement (UK J-CODE)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85G.label: Industrial Injury Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85G.definition: Industrial Injury Claims refer to legal claims made by individuals who have suffered harm or injury while working in an industrial setting, such as a factory or construction site.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85H.label: Alternative Dispute Resolution Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85H.definition: The use of methods such as mediation and arbitration to resolve a dispute instead of litigation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85I.label: Intracompany Transferee Petition
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85I.definition: An Intracompany Transferee Petition, also known as an L Petition in the U.S., allows a U.S. employer to transfer an executive, manager, or employee with specialized knowledge from one of its affiliated foreign offices to an office in the U.S. This petition facilitates the entry of qualified employees under the L-1 visa category for intracompany transfers.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85K.label: Environmental Social & Governance Report
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85K.definition: ESG Reporting refers to the disclosure of data covering a company's operations in three areas: environmental impact, social responsibility, and governance practices. It provides stakeholders with information on how the company manages risks and opportunities related to sustainability and ethical impact.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85M.label: Firearms License
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85M.definition: A firearms license is an official document granted by a governing authority that permits an individual to purchase, possess, or carry firearms, subject to certain conditions and regulations. The requirements, procedures, and restrictions for obtaining and maintaining such a license vary by jurisdiction, often involving background checks, safety courses, and other criteria.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85O.label: Wrapper
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85O.definition: A Wrapper, in legal and financial documentation, refers to a summary or cover document that encapsulates key information about a set of documents or financial products. It's typically used to provide a concise overview, often for compliance with regulatory requirements or to present information uniformly across different jurisdictions, without altering the content of the primary documents.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85O.label: Dispute Forum
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85O.definition: A Dispute Forum is a type of organization or government entity that oversees legal proceedings related to conflicts or disagreements between parties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85P.label: Senior Market Segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85P.definition: The senior market segment refers to a division of the market that is specifically targeted towards senior citizens or older adults as consumers. This segment encompasses products, services, and marketing strategies that are designed to cater to the needs, preferences, and interests of seniors, taking into account factors such as health, mobility, and lifestyle.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85R.label: Georgia Superior Court - Crisp County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85R.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Crisp County refers to a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over criminal and civil cases in Crisp County, Georgia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85T.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Malheur County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85T.definition: The Oregon Circuit Court - Malheur County is a specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Malheur County, Oregon.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85V.label: Employment Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85V.definition: An Employment Agreement is a legally binding contract between an employer and an employee that outlines the terms and conditions of their working relationship, including compensation, benefits, and responsibilities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85W.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Cook County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85W.definition: Illinois Circuit Court - Cook County refers to a specific court within the Illinois Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Cook County, Illinois.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85Z.label: Georgia District Court - Cobb County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85Z.definition: Georgia District Court - Cobb County: A specific court within the Georgia District Court system located in Cobb County, responsible for administering legal proceedings within its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85d.label: Renewal Option Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85d.definition: A Renewal Option Clause is a provision in a contract that grants one or both parties the right to extend the term of the agreement for an additional period of time upon the expiration of the initial term.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85e.label: Bankruptcy Initial Routine Motions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85e.definition: Bankruptcy Initial Routine Motions refer to the standard motions filed at the beginning of a bankruptcy case, such as motions for relief from automatic stay or to use cash collateral, which are typically granted without a hearing.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85i.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - White Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85i.definition: A court located in White County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its designated geographical area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85j.label: Société Anonyme
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85j.definition: Société anonyme (and variants in other languages; English: Anonymous society; shortened to S.A. or SA) designates a type of corporation in countries that mostly employ civil law. Depending on language, it means anonymous company, anonymous partnership, share company, or joint-stock company, roughly equivalent to a public limited company in common law jurisdictions. It is different from partnerships and private limited companies.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85m.label: Budget Market Segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85m.definition: The budget segment refers to a specific portion of the market that is characterized by consumers who seek affordable, cost-effective products and services. This segment caters to price-sensitive consumers who prioritize value for money and functionality over luxury and exclusivity.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85u.label: Parliamentary Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85u.definition: Rules and precedents governing the proceedings of parliaments and other similar organizations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85u.label: Insider Report
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85u.definition: An Insider Report is a document filed by company insiders, such as executives or directors, to disclose their trades in company stock. This report is required by securities regulators to ensure transparency and prevent insider trading.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85x.label: Confidential Information Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85x.definition: A Confidential Information Clause is a provision in a contract that requires parties to keep certain information private and not disclose it to others without permission.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85y.label: Florida Circuit Court - Martin County - 19th Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85y.definition: A court located in Martin County, Florida that is part of the larger Florida Circuit Court system.
english_labels: Florida Circuit Court - Martin County - 19th Circuit Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85z.label: Return to Parent
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R85z.definition: Return to Parent refers to the process of reuniting a child who has been placed in foster care with their biological parent(s) after the necessary steps have been taken to ensure the safety and well-being of the child.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R860.label: New York District Court - Nassau County - 2nd District
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R860.definition: New York District Court - Nassau County (2d Dist.) is a specific court within the New York District Court system located in Nassau County and is also referred to as 2d Dist.
english_labels: New York District Court - Nassau County - 2nd District

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R861.label: UTBMS MF00 Regulatory and Specialty Matters
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R861.definition: A category within the UTBMS coding system used to classify legal services related to regulatory and specialty matters, which falls under the broader category of Mergers and Acquisitions.
english_labels: UTBMS MF00 Regulatory and Specialty Matters

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R862.label: Mbeya
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R862.definition: Mbeya is a city located in Tanzania, United Republic of.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R864.label: Muyinga
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R864.definition: Muyinga is a city in Burundi.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R864.label: Berat
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R864.definition: Berat is a city in Albania.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R866.label: Buyende
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R866.definition: Buyende is a district located in Uganda.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R868.label: Sant Julia de Loria
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R868.definition: Sant Julia de Loria is a town located in the country of Andorra.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86A.label: Al Jawf
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86A.definition: A region in Saudi Arabia known as Al Jawf.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86A.label: Matter Expense Discount or Credit
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86A.definition: A Matter Expense Discount or Credit is a type of discount or credit applied to expenses incurred during the provision of legal services for a specific matter.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86B.label: Non-Competition Covenant
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86B.definition: A "Non-Competition Covenant" is a contractual agreement in which one party agrees not to engage in business activities that would compete with another party, typically for a specified period and within a defined geographic region. Such covenants are often used in employment contracts, business sale agreements, and partnerships to protect trade secrets, customer relationships, and other valuable business assets from potential competition by the restricted party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86C.label: Federal Service Impasses Panel
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86C.definition: The Federal Service Impasses Panel resolves impasses between federal agencies and unions representing federal employees arising from negotiations arising under the Federal Service Labor-Management Relations Statute and the Federal Employees Flexible and Compressed Work Schedules Act.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86C.label: Federal Judicial Center
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86C.definition: The Federal Judicial Center is the education and research agency of the United States federal courts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86D.label: Office of Intelligence and Analysis
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86D.definition: The Office of Intelligence and Analysis (I&A) is an agency of the United States Department of Homeland Security.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86G.label: Plaintiff's Felonious Conduct
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86G.definition: Plaintiff's felonious conduct may prevent liability for damages based on negligence if plaintiff's injuries were in part caused by plaintiff's commission of a felony and plaintiff has been convicted of said felony.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86H.label: Samaritan Aramaic
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86H.definition: Samaritan Aramaic is a dialect of Aramaic used by the Samaritan community in their religious texts and liturgy.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86J.label: Lack of Foundation Objection
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86J.definition: A Lack of Foundation Objection is raised when a party in a legal proceeding believes that the evidence being presented has not been properly introduced or contextualized. This objection aims to ensure that evidence is admitted only when its relevance and reliability have been established through a sufficient foundation.
english_labels: Objection to Evidence Without Proper Context

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86K.label: Abuse of Adults
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86K.definition: The mistreatment or harm of an adult who is dependent on another person, which can result in civil claims. This includes abuse of adults who are dependent on their children or elderly individuals.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86c.label: Washington Superior Court - Jefferson County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86c.definition: Washington Superior Court - Jefferson County refers to a specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Jefferson County, Washington.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86i.label: Department Store Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86i.definition: This industry group comprises establishments known as department stores primarily engaged in retailing a wide range of the following new products with no one merchandise line predominating: apparel, furniture, appliances and home furnishings; and selected additional items, such as paint, hardware, toiletries, cosmetics, photographic equipment, jewelry, toys, and sporting goods. Merchandise lines are normally arranged in separate departments.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86j.label: Business Visitor Visa
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86j.definition: A visa for temporary business visitors is a short-term visa that allows individuals to enter a foreign country for specific business-related activities, such as attending meetings, conferences, or trade shows. This type of visa generally does not permit the holder to engage in gainful employment in the host country and has a limited validity period, often ranging from a few days to several months.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86p.label: Energy Infrastructure - Real Estate Asset
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86p.definition: Energy Infrastructure - Real Estate Asset refers to properties and facilities used for the production, storage, and distribution of energy. This includes power plants, solar farms, wind farms, and other installations essential for generating and managing energy resources.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86r.label: Service Animals
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86r.definition: A Service Animal is a specially trained animal that performs tasks or provides assistance to individuals with disabilities, enhancing their ability to perform daily activities. These animals are typically trained to support physical, sensory, psychiatric, or intellectual disabilities and are legally recognized to accompany their handlers in most public places.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86y.label: Minnesota District Court - Nobles County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R86y.definition: A court located in Nobles County, Minnesota that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R870.label: Invoice Payable by Client ID
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R870.definition: An invoice payable by client ID is a specific type of fee invoice detail that identifies the client responsible for payment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R871.label: Wills Claims
