Employees may also bring pension and benefits claims if their employer retaliates against them for asserting their rights to these benefits.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Tn.label: Adoption of an Adult
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Tn.definition: Adoption of an Adult refers to the legal process where one adult formally becomes the child of another adult, establishing a new legal family relationship. This can be done for various reasons, such as formalizing an existing parent-child relationship, ensuring inheritance rights, or providing care for an adult with disabilities

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Tn.label: Motion to Vacate Discharge
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Tn.definition: A Motion to Vacate Discharge is a legal request to set aside or cancel a previous discharge order in a bankruptcy case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Tn.label: Ysleta Del Sur Pueblo of Texas
english_labels: Ysleta Del Sur Pueblo of Texas

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Tv.label: Sex Offenses
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Tv.definition: Any sexual act directed against another person, without the consent of the victim including instances where the victim is incapable of giving consent.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8U5.label: Statement of Disposable Income
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8U5.definition: A Statement of Disposable Income is a financial document submitted in bankruptcy and restructuring proceedings that outlines the debtor's income and expenses to determine their ability to repay debts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8U7.label: Purse Snatching Theft
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8U7.definition: The grabbing or snatching of a purse, handbag, etc., from the physical possession of another person

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8U8.label: Florida County Court - Jackson County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8U8.definition: A Florida County Court in Jackson County is a specific court within the Florida County Court system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within Jackson County, Florida.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8U9.label: Virginia State Bar District Subcommittee
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8U9.definition: A Virginia State Bar District Subcommittee is a specialized group within the Virginia State Courts responsible for overseeing and managing legal proceedings within a specific district.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8UB.label: Proprietary Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8UB.definition: A Proprietary Clause is a provision in a contract that establishes ownership rights over certain property or information, and restricts its use or disclosure by others.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8UE.label: Conditions to Closing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8UE.definition: Conditions to Closing refer to the specific requirements and obligations that must be fulfilled by parties involved in a merger or acquisition in order for the transaction to be completed, including obtaining clearance from CFIUS, ensuring the absence of litigation, complying with covenants, and providing representations and warranties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8UG.label: Market Segment Attributes
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8UG.definition: Market Attributes refer to the features and qualities of a market that are shaped by consumer preferences and demand. These characteristics can include the types of products and services sought by consumers. These can include consumers' preferences for luxury or commodity goods, their interest in specific industry sectors such as technology or finance, their preference for regional or national businesses, and similar demand-side attributes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8UI.label: Motion to Limit Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8UI.definition: A Motion to Limit Claims is a formal request made during a trial to restrict the scope of claims or issues that can be raised by a party, typically to prevent undue prejudice or confusion.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8UR.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Ralls County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8UR.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Ralls County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Ralls County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8UT.label: Carrying a Concealed Weapon
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8UT.definition: The concept of "Carrying a Concealed Weapon" refers to the act of possessing a weapon, such as a gun or firearm, in a hidden or disguised manner, which is considered a criminal offense under certain circumstances.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8UU.label: Statute of Repose
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8UU.definition: A Statute of Repose is a legal time limit that restricts the period within which a lawsuit can be filed, regardless of when the injury or harm occurred or was discovered. It is usually tied to the completion of a specific event or transaction, such as the sale of a product or the completion of construction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8UY.label: Sexual Harassment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8UY.definition: Sexual Harassment: Unwelcome sexual advances, requests for sexual favors, and other verbal or physical conduct of a sexual nature that creates a hostile or offensive work environment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Ue.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Clay County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Ue.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Clay County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Clay County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Ug.label: Summoned / Cited
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Ug.definition: Summoned/Cited refers to the legal act of compelling a person to appear in court or before a judge, typically as a result of an arrest.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Ul.label: Loyalty Clause Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Ul.definition: A Loyalty Clause claim refers to a legal argument based on a loyalty clause within a contract, employment agreement, or constitutional provision, asserting that individuals or entities have a duty to demonstrate loyalty and allegiance to a specific party, organization, or governing body. It aims to enforce loyalty obligations and may involve consequences or remedies for breaches of loyalty, such as termination of employment or legal action.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Un.label: Discrimination Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Un.definition: Discrimination Claims refer to legal actions taken by individuals who have been subjected to unfair treatment based on their protected characteristics, such as race, gender, religion, disability, or age, in various contexts such as employment, housing, or public accommodations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Un.label: Arachnids
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Un.definition: Arachnids are a class of joint-legged invertebrate animals within the phylum Arthropoda, characterized by having eight legs and no antennae. This class includes spiders, scorpions, ticks, and mites, and they are primarily terrestrial, occupying a wide range of habitats worldwide.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Ur.label: Project Finance Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Ur.definition: Legal procedures and regulations specific to the development, equity and non-recourse debt financing, construction, operation, and maintenance of major industrial and infrastructure projects.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Uy.label: Arizona Superior Court - Maricopa Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Uy.definition: Arizona Superior Court - Maricopa Cty. is a specific court within the Arizona Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over cases in Maricopa County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8V0.label: matter_disc_bill_pct_exp
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8V0.definition: "MATTER_DISC_CRED.disc_cred_percent_exp where MATTER_DISC_CRED.disc_credit_type equals ""Percent"" and MATTER_DISC_CRED.disc_credit_category equals ""Exp"" and MATTER_DISC_CRED.disc_cred equals ""MIDB"" "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8V2.label: Election Commission
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8V2.definition: An Election Commission is an official body responsible for organizing, overseeing, and ensuring the integrity of elections within a specific jurisdiction. This independent agency is typically charged with administering electoral processes, enforcing election laws, and maintaining the fairness and transparency of democratic voting procedures.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8V5.label: Clergy Sex Abuse
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8V5.definition: Sexual abuse committed by members of the clergy, including priests, ministers, and other religious officials.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8V9.label: Recurrent Arrhythmias
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8V9.definition: Recurrent arrhythmias refer to persistent or frequently recurring abnormal heart rhythms that disrupt the normal heart rate and rhythm, leading to symptoms such as palpitations, dizziness, or syncope (fainting). These arrhythmias are severe enough to necessitate medical intervention, including medication, electrical cardioversion, or implantation of a cardiac device, to manage or control the abnormal heart rhythms.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8V9.label: Payment Modality
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8V9.definition: "Payment Modality" refers to the specific method or medium employed to execute the transfer of funds for the settlement of financial obligations or transactions. It encompasses a range of electronic, paper-based, and physical means, such as wire transfers, checks, and cash, used to facilitate payments between parties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8VD.label: Kansas District Court - Wilson County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8VD.definition: Kansas District Court - Wilson County: A specific court within the Kansas District Court system located in Wilson County, with jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8VD.label: Bankruptcy Second Day Motions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8VD.definition: Bankruptcy Second Day Motions are requests made by a debtor in a bankruptcy case within the first few days after filing for bankruptcy, seeking relief from certain requirements or restrictions imposed by the bankruptcy code or court rules.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8VJ.label: Florida Circuit Court - St. Lucie County - 19th Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8VJ.definition: The Florida Circuit Court - St. Lucie County (19th Circuit Court) is a specific court within the Florida Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in St. Lucie County.
english_labels: Florida Circuit Court - St. Lucie County - 19th Circuit Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8VL.label: 130 Miller Act (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8VL.definition: Action based on performance and payment bonds agreed to by contractors on federal construction projects as required under the Miller Act, 40 U.S.C. § 3131-3134.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8VM.label: New York City Court - Oneonta
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8VM.definition: A court located in Oneonta, New York that has jurisdiction over cases within its designated area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8VN.label: Obligee
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8VN.definition: An obligee is the party in a legal contract or relationship who is entitled to receive a specified performance or payment from another party, known as the obligor. In various contexts such as contract law, bonds, or loans, the obligee holds the right to claim the fulfillment of the obligation set forth in the agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8VN.label: Sexual Assault with an Object
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8VN.definition: To use an object or instrument to unlawfully penetrate, however slightly, the genital or anal opening of the body of another person, forcibly and/or against that person’s will or not forcibly or against the person’s will in instances where the victim is incapable of giving consent because of his/her youth or because of his/her temporary or permanent mental or physical incapacity.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8VO.label: Affidavit
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8VO.definition: An Affidavit is a written statement made under oath or affirmation, typically used as evidence in a legal proceeding, and falls under the category of Trial Court Practice Documents and Bankruptcy and Restructuring Documents.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8VW.label: Environmental Permit Violation Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8VW.definition: An Environmental Permit Violation Claim is a legal action alleging that an individual, company, or entity has failed to comply with the terms and conditions of an environmental permit issued by a regulatory authority. Such claims typically assert that the permit holder has exceeded allowed emission levels, discharged prohibited substances, or failed to implement required environmental protection measures.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8VY.label: Definition of Confidential Information Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8VY.definition: A Definition of Confidential Information Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the types of information that are considered confidential and the obligations of the parties to protect such information from disclosure to third parties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8VZ.label: Liquidation of Assets
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8VZ.definition: The liquidation of assets refers to the process of selling off a debtor's property in order to satisfy a judgment or debt, as part of the enforcement of a court order.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Vc.label: work_location_country
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Vc.definition: "The country of where work associated with the fee item was performed, to support the taxes appearing in the TAX_ITEM_EXPENSE Segment. Use ISO 3166 country code set forth by International Standards Organization (www.iso.org.) "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Vd.label: Negligent Selection of a Contractor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Vd.definition: The Negligent Selection of a Contractor refers to a situation where an employer fails to exercise reasonable care in choosing a contractor, resulting in harm or injury to an employee.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Ve.label: Indiana Superior Court - Marshall County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Ve.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that has the authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within Marshall County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Vq.label: Disclosure Statement Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Vq.definition: A Disclosure Statement Clause is a specific provision within a contract that requires one party to reveal certain information to the other party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Vw.label: Parenting Expert
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Vw.definition: An expert in the area of parenting.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Vx.label: Asynchronous Broadcast Transmission
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Vx.definition: An Asynchronous Broadcast Transmission, also known as a "Pre-Recorded Broadcast," is the dissemination of audio and/or video content that has been recorded prior to its scheduled broadcast time. This form of broadcasting includes pre-recorded TV shows, radio programs, and other content that is not transmitted live but is played back at a designated time.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8W0.label: Consultant
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8W0.definition: One who gives professional advice or services in the field of that person's special knowledge or training, such as a consulting physician or engineer. Montgomery County v. MicroVote Corp., 175 F.3d 296 (3rd Cir. 1999)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8W4.label: CLIENT_MATTER_ID
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8W4.definition: A unique identifier assigned to a specific matter by a client, as defined in the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8W8.label: Changes in Target's Securities or Credit Rating Language
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8W8.definition: Changes in Target's Securities or Credit Rating Language refers to a provision in a legal agreement that outlines the circumstances under which a material adverse effect (MAE) will be triggered due to changes in the securities or credit rating of the target company.
english_labels: Changes in Target's Securities or Credit Rating Language

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8W9.label: Patent Assets
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8W9.definition: Patent Assets are a type of Intellectual Property Asset that includes Design Patent Assets, Utility Patent Assets, and Plant Patent Assets.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8WA.label: Liability Disclaimer Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8WA.definition: A Liability Disclaimer Clause is a statement in a legal document that limits or eliminates the liability of one party for damages or losses incurred by another party, often used in contracts or agreements.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8WK.label: Indiana Circuit Court - DeKalb County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8WK.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in DeKalb County, Indiana, with the power to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8WN.label: Future Medical Expenses
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8WN.definition: Future Medical Expenses: Costs for medical treatment or care that are anticipated to be incurred by an individual at a later time due to an injury or illness.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8WO.label: Blockchain
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8WO.definition: Blockchain refers to a decentralized and distributed digital ledger technology that securely records transactions across multiple nodes. It is commonly employed for digital currencies but can also be used to record contracts, property titles, and other types of data.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8WO.label: Georgia Superior Court - Thomas County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8WO.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Thomas County is a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases in Thomas County, Georgia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8WQ.label: In-Person Communication
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8WQ.definition: A communication that occurs where at least two of the communicators are at the same physical location.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8WS.label: matter_disc_credit_fees
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8WS.definition: "Sum of all MATTER_DISC_CRED.disc_credit_amount where MATTER_DISC_CRED.disc_credit_type equals ""FEE"" and (MATTER_DISC_CRED.disc_cred is not ""MISF"", ""MIDB"" or ""MIFA""). Excludes discounts or credits applied to fee line items as these are already part of matter_total_detail_fees. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8WU.label: Syriac
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8WU.definition: Aramaic language used historically in the Middle East, particularly in Syria and Mesopotamia, and still spoken by some communities today.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8WV.label: Lentils
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8WV.definition: Lentils are small, lens-shaped seeds from the Lens culinaris species, part of the legume family (Fabaceae). Known for their high protein and fiber content, lentils are a staple in many global cuisines and are valued for their nutritional benefits, including essential vitamins and minerals such as iron, folate, and magnesium.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8WV.label: Florida County Court - Madison County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8WV.definition: A court located in Madison County, Florida that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8WY.label: Demand Letter Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8WY.definition: Demand Letter Practice refers to the legal practice of drafting and sending formal letters demanding payment or action from a party, typically used as a precursor to litigation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Wc.label: BBPLC Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Wc.definition: A BBPLC Clause is a specific type of contractual clause that is used in legal agreements drafted by the law firm Berwin Leighton Paisner (BLP).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8We.label: Deferral Agreement Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8We.definition: A Deferral Agreement Clause is a provision in a contract that allows for the postponement of certain obligations or payments to a later date, as agreed upon by the parties involved.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Wf.label: Visa for Dependent of Intended Spouse of Citizen
english_labels: Visa for Dependent of Intended Spouse of Citizen

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Wh.label: Stone Fruits
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Wh.definition: Stone fruits, also known as drupes, are fruits characterized by a fleshy exterior surrounding a hard pit or "stone" that encases the seed. They are typically grown in temperate climates and are valued for their sweet, juicy flesh and nutritional content, which includes vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Wn.label: 625 Drug Related Seizure of Property 21 U.S.C. § 881 (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Wn.definition: Action (Forfeiture) by which property itself is accused of wrongdoing and is forfeited to the government as a result.
english_labels: 625 Drug Related Seizure of Property 21 U.S.C. § 881 (PACER NoS)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Wr.label: Red Cliff Band of Lake Superior Chippewa
english_labels: Red Cliff Band of Lake Superior Chippewa

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8X3.label: Health Rights
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8X3.definition: Health rights refer to the legal and ethical entitlements aimed at ensuring access to a minimum standard of healthcare and well-being for individuals. These rights can include access to medical treatment, preventative care, and essential medications, and are often supported by both international treaties and national healthcare policies.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8XA.label: Workplace Safety Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8XA.definition: A workplace safety claim is a legal action initiated by an employee against their employer for not providing a safe working environment. The claim typically arises when an employer does not comply with applicable safety regulations, which can result in dangerous or hazardous working conditions for employees. Workplace safety claims can involve issues such as inadequate safety equipment, lack of proper training, or unsafe working conditions. Employees may bring workplace safety claims for injuries or illnesses suffered as a result of their employer's failure to provide a safe working environment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8XB.label: IP Analytics Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8XB.definition: IP Analytics Management refers to the process of organizing and analyzing intellectual property data to make informed business decisions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8XE.label: Myelofibrosis
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8XE.definition: Myelofibrosis is a rare type of bone marrow disorder characterized by the replacement of normal bone marrow tissue with fibrous scar tissue. This leads to the impaired production of blood cells and can result in anemia, enlarged spleen (splenomegaly), and other systemic symptoms.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8XI.label: Cultural Rights
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8XI.definition: Cultural rights pertain to the freedom and ability of individuals or groups to maintain, develop, and share their culture, language, and heritage. These rights are often protected by international law and may include access to cultural and educational resources, protection of cultural heritage, and freedom to engage in cultural practices

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8XM.label: Animal Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8XM.definition: Animal Claims refer to legal claims related to harm caused by or to animals, including liability for injury to pets, cruelty to animals, animal attacks, trespassing livestock causing harm, dangerous domesticated animals, injury caused by wild animals, and negligent handling of animals.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8XQ.label: New York Community Justice Center - Redhook
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8XQ.definition: A specialized court in New York City that aims to reduce crime and improve public trust in the justice system, located in the Redhook neighborhood.
english_labels: New York Community Justice Center - Redhook

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8XS.label: Geothermal Rights
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8XS.definition: Geothermal rights grant ownership or control over the heat energy stored beneath the earth's surface in a specific area. The holder of these rights can harness this energy for power generation or other purposes and may lease, sell, or transfer these rights to another entity.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8XU.label: Motion to Stay the Mandate
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8XU.definition: A Motion to Stay the Mandate is a request made to a higher court to temporarily suspend the enforcement of a decision made by a lower court until the appeal process is completed.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8XY.label: Payor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8XY.definition: A person legally obligated to pay.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Xb.label: Financial Reporting Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Xb.definition: Financial Reporting Law encompasses the regulations and standards governing the disclosure of financial information by entities. It ensures transparency, accuracy, and consistency in financial statements, facilitating informed decision-making by stakeholders.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Xh.label: Motion to Hear
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Xh.definition: A Motion to Hear is a formal request made by a party in a trial court to have a specific matter or issue heard by the court.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Xi.label: Ship
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Xi.definition: A Ship is a large watercraft designed for deep-water navigation, typically used for transporting goods, passengers, or military personnel over long distances. Ships are equipped with various facilities and systems for navigation, safety, and cargo handling.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Xo.label: Motion to File Appendix
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Xo.definition: A Motion to File Appendix is a formal request made to a court to include additional documents or evidence in the record of a case, beyond what has already been submitted.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Xq.label: Arkansas District Court - Carroll Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Xq.definition: A court located in Carroll County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its designated geographic area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Xr.label: Intellectual Property Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Xr.definition: Intellectual Property Management refers to the process of managing and protecting intangible assets such as patents, trademarks, copyrights, and domain names.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Xw.label: Extendible Asset
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Xw.definition: An Extendible Asset is a financial instrument that allows the redemption date to be extended at the option of the issuer or the holder. This feature provides additional flexibility, enabling the extension of the asset's maturity under predefined conditions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Xx.label: Default Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Xx.definition: A default clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the consequences if one party fails to fulfill their obligations under the agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Y9.label: Efik
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Y9.definition: Efik is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a member of the Language class.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8YA.label: Household Appliances and Electrical and Electronic Goods Merchant Wholesalers Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8YA.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of electrical apparatus and equipment, wiring supplies, and related equipment; household appliances, electric housewares, and consumer electronics; and other electronic parts and equipment.
english_labels: Household Appliances and Electrical and Electronic Goods Merchant Wholesalers Industry

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8YB.label: Treaty Skilled Worker Visa
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8YB.definition: This visa category (in the U.S., TN-2 Visa) applies to skilled professionals in treaty-signatory countries. In the United States, this non-immigrant visa allows the individual to work in the U.S. under the provisions of the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA), which was replaced by the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA). The initial period of stay is up to three years, but extensions can be granted in three-year increments

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8YB.label: Notify Consulate Abroad
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8YB.definition: "Notifying Consulate Abroad" involves informing a consulate or embassy in a foreign country about an individual's intent to apply for a visa or immigration benefit, initiating the process of obtaining the necessary documentation and approval for entry or residency in the destination country.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8YE.label: Adult
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8YE.definition: An adult is an individual who has reached the age of maturity as defined by law, typically marking the transition from childhood to full legal autonomy and responsibility. The specific age at which this transition occurs varies by jurisdiction, but it is commonly 18 or 21 years old.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8YH.label: State of Emergency
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8YH.definition: A State of Emergency is a governmental declaration that suspends normal constitutional procedures to address a crisis, disaster, or other extraordinary situation. This status grants special powers to authorities to implement measures necessary to manage the emergency, often involving restrictions on normal civil liberties and government operations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8YJ.label: Real Estate Broker's Constructive Fraud
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8YJ.definition: Real Estate Broker's Constructive Fraud: A type of constructive fraud that occurs when a real estate broker misrepresents or conceals material facts with the intent to deceive, causing harm to the client.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8YK.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Lackawanna County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8YK.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Lackawanna County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Lackawanna County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8YM.label: Recruitment Commission
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8YM.definition: A commission for recruitment refers to a fee or payment that recruiters or staffing agencies receive for successfully finding and placing candidates in job positions for employers. This compensation is typically a percentage of the candidate's first-year salary and serves as an incentive for recruiters to match suitable candidates with job opportunities

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8YO.label: tax_tier_total_taxable_amount
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8YO.definition: "The sum of all TAX_TIERS.tax_tier_taxable_amount for this tx_id expressed in INVOICE.inv_currency. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8YP.label: Recreational Vehicle
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8YP.definition: A recreational vehicle (RV) is a motorized or towable vehicle equipped with living accommodations, typically including sleeping, cooking, and bathroom facilities. RVs are used for travel, camping, and recreation, providing a mobile home away from home for individuals and families.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8YQ.label: Actions Taken with Consent or Approval of Buyer Language
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8YQ.definition: Actions Taken with Consent or Approval of Buyer Language refers to the specific language in a legal agreement that outlines the actions that can be taken by one party with the consent or approval of the other party, typically in the context of a Material Adverse Effect (MAE) carveout.
english_labels: Actions Taken with Consent or Approval of Buyer Language

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Yb.label: Motion to File Addendum
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Yb.definition: A Motion to File Addendum is a formal request made to an appellate court to allow the submission of additional information or evidence to be included in the record on appeal.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Yb.label: tax_tiers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Yb.definition: """tax_tiers"" = Y only where there are different tax rates applicable to billed tiers. If Tiered Tax = ""Y"", the LEDES invoice should contain only one matter; multiple matters/invoice are not allowed for Tiered Taxes. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Yf.label: Skin Cancer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Yf.definition: Skin cancer is a type of cancer that begins in the cells of the skin. It includes various forms, such as basal cell carcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, and melanoma, each requiring specific treatments like surgery, radiation therapy, chemotherapy, and immunotherapy.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Yi.label: Public and Administrative Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Yi.definition: Law which governs relationships between individuals and the government, and the activities of administrative agencies of government including rule making, adjudication, or the enforcement of a specific regulatory agenda.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Yn.label: Somatic Symptom and Related Disorders
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Yn.definition: These disorders are characterized by physical symptoms or deficits that are not intentionally produced or feigned, and that, following clinical investigation, cannot be fully explained by a general medical condition, another mental disorder, the direct effects of a substance, or a culturally sanctioned behavior or experience. These disorders may also be characterized by a preoccupation with having or acquiring a serious medical condition that has not been identified or diagnosed. Symptoms and signs may include, but are not limited to, pain and other abnormalities of sensation, gastrointestinal symptoms, fatigue, a high level of anxiety about personal health status, abnormal motor movement, pseudoseizures, and pseudoneurological symptoms, such as blindness or deafness.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Yo.label: Substantial Prejudice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Yo.definition: Substantial Prejudice: A legal concept used in appellate standards of review that refers to an error or action that had a significant impact on the outcome of a case and resulted in an unfair disadvantage to one of the parties involved.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Yp.label: Precedent
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Yp.definition: Precedent refers to a legal decision or judgment passed in a previous case, used as an authoritative rule or example in subsequent similar cases. It serves as a guiding principle, helping courts decide future cases with similar issues or facts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Yp.label: Punitive Damages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Yp.definition: Monetary damages awarded in addition to compensatory damages, intended to punish the defendant for their wrongful conduct and to deter similar conduct in the future.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Yr.label: Disclosure Statement - Small Business
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Yr.definition: A Disclosure Statement - Small Business is a written document that provides information about a small business to potential investors or buyers, including financial information, risks, and other relevant details.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Yv.label: Arabic
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Yv.definition: Arabic (Language) refers to the written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Arabic language.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Z1.label: Neapolitan
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Z1.definition: A dialect of Italian spoken in the region of Naples and surrounding areas.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Z1.label: Petition for Skilled Workers - Bachelor's Cap
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Z1.definition: In the United States, the H-1B Bachelor's cap petition involves employers filing Form I-129 on behalf of prospective H-1B employees with a bachelor's degree who are subject to the annual H-1B visa cap, typically requiring a random lottery if the cap is exceeded. This process determines the selection of beneficiaries who can receive H-1B visas for specialty occupation employment in the U.S.
english_labels: Petition for Skilled Workers - Bachelor's Cap

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Z5.label: Draw Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Z5.definition: A Draw Clause is a provision in a contract that allows a party to withdraw funds from a specified account or line of credit.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Z6.label: Prior Art
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Z6.definition: Prior Art refers to any evidence that your invention is already known. It includes everything made public in any form before a given date that might be relevant to a patent's claims of originality.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Z8.label: Debt Settlement Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Z8.definition: A Debt Settlement Agreement is a legally binding contract between a debtor and a creditor that outlines the terms for resolving a debt for less than the original amount owed. The agreement specifies the reduced amount to be paid, the schedule for payment, and conditions under which the remaining debt will be forgiven or considered settled.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ZB.label: Reinvestment Risk
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ZB.definition: The risk that an investor will be unable to reinvest cash flows (like interest payments) at a rate comparable to their current rate of return.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ZE.label: Employee Matters Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ZE.definition: An Employee Matters Agreement is a legal document that outlines various aspects of the employment relationship between a company and its executives or key employees. It typically covers matters such as job responsibilities, compensation, benefits, confidentiality, non-competition clauses, and dispute resolution procedures. This agreement is designed to define the rights, obligations, and expectations of both the employer and the employee in a clear and legally binding manner.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ZG.label: Demand Letter
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ZG.definition: A demand letter is a written document sent by one party to another, typically in a legal context, requesting specific action or payment to resolve a dispute.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ZH.label: Cash Interest Payment (for Sukuk Certificates)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ZH.definition: A Cash Interest Payment, in the context of sukuk certificates, refers to the distribution of profits generated from Sharia-compliant investments to certificate holders. This payment structure involves the periodic distribution of actual cash returns derived from the underlying assets or business activities, as opposed to interest in the conventional sense, ensuring compliance with Islamic finance principles.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ZJ.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Centre County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ZJ.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Centre County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that handles minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil cases involving amounts up to $12,000.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Centre County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ZL.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Grant County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ZL.definition: A court located in Grant County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases.
english_labels: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Grant County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ZM.label: Genetic Photosensitivity Disorders
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ZM.definition: Genetic photosensitivity disorders are conditions where an individual's genetic makeup causes an abnormal sensitivity to ultraviolet (UV) light, leading to skin damage upon exposure. These disorders often result in symptoms such as skin lesions, rashes, or an increased risk of skin cancer.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ZQ.label: Levy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ZQ.definition: A Levy is a legal seizure of property to satisfy a debt, usually initiated by a governmental authority such as the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) for unpaid taxes. The process involves officially taking possession of assets like bank accounts, wages, or physical property, and is typically executed after a court order or other legal authorization

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ZS.label: Capitalization - Other Representation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ZS.definition: The concept of "Capitalization - Other Representation" refers to a statement made in a legal agreement regarding the ownership structure of a company, which may include information about the number and type of shares issued, outstanding debts, and other financial details, but is not specifically covered by the representations and warranties clause.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ZW.label: Sovereign State
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ZW.definition: In international law, a sovereign state, sovereign country, or simply state, is a nonphysical juridical entity that is represented by one centralized government that has sovereignty over a geographic area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ZY.label: Foreign Ownership, Control, or Influence Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ZY.definition: A Foreign Ownership, Control, or Influence (FOCI) Claim arises when a company or entity is alleged to be under foreign ownership, control, or influence, potentially compromising national security. This claim involves evaluating the extent of foreign involvement and its impact on the entity's operations, particularly in sectors critical to national security.
english_labels: Foreign Ownership, Control, or Influence Claim

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ZZ.label: Illegal Dumping
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ZZ.definition: The act of disposing of waste materials in an unauthorized or illegal manner, which is classified as a minor criminal offense.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Za.label: Two Spirit
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Za.definition: Two Spirit is a term used within some Indigenous cultures in North America to describe a person who embodies characteristics of both masculine and feminine genders, or holds a unique gender role within their community. Legally, Two Spirit individuals may encounter unique challenges or require specific recognition and protection under laws pertaining to gender, cultural identity, and Indigenous rights.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Zc.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Edwards County (2nd Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Edwards County (2nd Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Zd.label: Federal Mail Fraud
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Zd.definition: The concept of Federal Mail Fraud refers to a criminal act of using the United States Postal Service or other interstate mail carrier to carry out a fraudulent scheme or plan with the intent to deceive or defraud another person or entity.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Zf.label: Hate Speech
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Zf.definition: Hate Speech refers to communication, whether spoken, written, or behavioral, that attacks or discriminates against a person or group based on attributes such as race, religion, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or gender. This type of speech is intended to incite hatred, violence, or prejudice against the targeted group and is often subject to legal restrictions and penalties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Zh.label: Commercial Finance Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Zh.definition: Law supporting the function of providing loans or other financing to businesses.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Zl.label: Dividend Payment Types
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Zl.definition: Dividend Payment Types refer to the various forms of dividend payments that shareholders are entitled to receive from an organization. These types of income can include cash dividends, stock dividends, property dividends, and special dividends, each providing different benefits and methods of distribution to shareholders.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Zm.label: Countervailing Duty Payment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Zm.definition: A Countervailing Duty (CVD) Payment refers to the payment made by importers to the government as a result of countervailing duties imposed on imported goods that benefit from foreign government subsidies. These payments aim to counteract the effects of such subsidies, ensuring fair competition for domestic producers.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Zn.label: Washington Superior Court - Benton County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Zn.definition: Washington Superior Court - Benton County refers to a specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Benton County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Zp.label: Grindstone Indian Rancheria of Wintun-Wailaki Indians
english_labels: Grindstone Indian Rancheria of Wintun-Wailaki Indians

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Zr.label: Tenancy Retaliation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Zr.definition: The act of a landlord seeking revenge against a tenant for exercising their legal rights, such as complaining about unsafe living conditions or requesting repairs.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Zs.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Montgomery County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Zs.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Montgomery County: A court of law in Missouri that has jurisdiction over legal cases within Montgomery County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Zt.label: Bond
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Zt.definition: A bond (agreement) is a legally binding contract between two or more parties that outlines the terms and conditions of a financial arrangement, typically involving the lending or borrowing of money.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Zw.label: Specific Service Tax Payment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Zw.definition: Specific Service Tax Payment includes taxes assessed on payments for specific services, such as insurance premiums, banking services, gambling and betting stakes (e.g., from horse races, football pools, lottery tickets), transportation, entertainment, restaurant services, and advertising charges. It also covers taxes on entry to casinos, races, and similar events or venues, as well as stamp taxes on specific services. Additionally, it encompasses taxes levied on the gross income of companies providing these services, including bank levies and payments to deposit insurance and financial stability schemes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Zx.label: Default Interest Rate Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8Zx.definition: A Default Interest Rate Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the interest rate that will apply if one party fails to fulfill their obligations under the contract.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8a6.label: Mortgage Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8a6.definition: A transaction in which the owner pledges his/her/its title to real property to a lender as security for a loan described in a promissory note.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8a7.label: Marketing Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8a7.definition: A Marketing Agreement is a legally binding contract between two or more parties that outlines the terms and conditions of a marketing campaign or promotional activity.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8a7.label: Public Health and Welfare Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8a7.definition: Law relating to the authority of the government at various jurisdictional levels to improve the health of the general population within societal limits and norms.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8aB.label: Medicaid Fraud
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8aB.definition: The intentional deception or misrepresentation of information related to Medicaid, a government-funded healthcare program, for personal gain or to cause financial harm to the program.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8aC.label: Responsible Attorney
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8aC.definition: A responsible attorney is the lawyer who is designated as the primary person in charge of overseeing and managing a specific legal matter or case. This attorney is accountable for the progress, strategy, communication, and overall handling of the case, and may delegate tasks to other attorneys or support staff under their supervision.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8aE.label: Turnips
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8aE.definition: Turnips are root vegetables belonging to the Brassica rapa species, characterized by their round or elongated shape with a white or purple skin and white flesh. They are cultivated for their edible taproot and leaves, both of which are used in various culinary applications and are valued for their nutritional content and storage capabilities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8aH.label: Arizona Superior Court - La Paz Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8aH.definition: Arizona Superior Court - La Paz Cty. is a specific court within the Arizona Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in La Paz County, Arizona.
english_labels: Arizona Superior Court - La Paz Cty.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8aL.label: Termination for Convenience Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8aL.definition: A Termination for Convenience Clause is a provision in a contract that allows one party to terminate the agreement without cause or fault of the other party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8aM.label: Right of Last Refusal Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8aM.definition: A Right of Last Refusal Clause is a provision in a contract that gives a party the option to purchase property or assets before they are offered to others.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8aN.label: Compensation Metrics
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8aN.definition: Compensation Metrics are quantitative measures used to assess the financial rewards provided to employees. Examples include salaries, bonuses, and commissions, which help evaluate and compare the monetary value individuals receive for their work contributions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8aQ.label: Peremptory Challenge
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8aQ.definition: A peremptory challenge is a motion made during a trial to remove a potential juror or judge without stating a reason, typically limited in number, and used to ensure a fair and impartial trial.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8aV.label: Semi-Proportional Electoral System
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8aV.definition: A semi-proportional electoral system is a voting method that seeks to balance majority rule with proportional representation, allowing for more accurate reflection of voter preferences while still favoring larger parties. Examples include limited voting, cumulative voting, single non-transferable vote, and modified Borda count, which each employ different mechanisms to achieve this balance.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8aV.label: Key Personnel Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8aV.definition: A Key Personnel Clause is a provision in a contract that identifies specific individuals who are essential to the performance of the contract and outlines the consequences if those individuals are not available or are replaced.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8aW.label: Securities Expert
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8aW.definition: An expert in the area of securities, including stocks and investments.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8aY.label: Flandreau Santee Sioux Tribe of South Dakota
english_labels: Flandreau Santee Sioux Tribe of South Dakota

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8aZ.label: Washington Superior Court - Stevens County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8aZ.definition: Washington Superior Court - Stevens County refers to a specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Stevens County, Washington.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ab.label: Venda
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ab.definition: Venda (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Venda people of South Africa.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ae.label: E122 Local counsel
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ae.definition: E122 Local counsel refers to the expenses incurred for hiring an attorney who is licensed to practice law in a specific jurisdiction and who provides legal representation and advice to a client in that jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8af.label: Anti-Corruption Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8af.definition: Law addressing bribery of public officials.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ag.label: Notifications of Certain Matters
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ag.definition: "Notifications of Certain Matters" refers to a contractual obligation wherein one party must inform the other party about specific events or developments, especially those that could impact the terms, conditions, or value of a deal. Depending on the agreement, these notifications may be required during the negotiation and execution phases of the deal, or after its completion, ensuring transparency and facilitating timely responses to any material changes or unforeseen circumstances.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ah.label: Kansas District Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ah.definition: The Kansas District Court is a court of law within the Kansas State Courts system that has jurisdiction over a specific geographic area and handles civil and criminal cases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ah.label: Analysis of Documents Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ah.definition: The Analysis of Documents Practice is a legal service that involves the examination and evaluation of documents in the context of a legal matter, and is a subset of the Document Collection and Production Practice.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ak.label: Lac Courte Oreilles Band of Lake Superior Chippewa
english_labels: Lac Courte Oreilles Band of Lake Superior Chippewa

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8al.label: Personal Injury Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8al.definition: Personal Injury Claims are civil claims or tort claims seeking compensation for physical or emotional harm caused by the negligence or intentional actions of another party, including but not limited to slip-and-fall accidents, medical malpractice, and motor vehicle accidents.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8am.label: Failure of Tender Condition
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8am.definition: The Failure of Tender Condition refers to a situation where a party fails to meet the conditions required for a tender offer to be successful, resulting in the offer being terminated.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ao.label: Visual Disability
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ao.definition: A Visual Disability is a condition that impairs an individual's ability to see, which can range from partial vision loss to complete blindness. This impairment affects daily activities, communication, and mobility, and may require the use of assistive devices or adaptations to improve quality of life.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8av.label: Specific Jurisdiction
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8av.definition: Specific Jurisdiction refers to the authority of a court to hear and decide a case involving a defendant who has minimum contacts with the forum state, but only with respect to the specific claims at issue in the case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8az.label: Easement Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8az.definition: An Easement Agreement allows one party the right to use a portion of another party's property for a specific purpose, like utilities or driveway access, without owning or possessing it.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8b2.label: Answer with Counterclaims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8b2.definition: Answer with Counterclaims: A response to a legal claim that includes additional claims made by the defendant against the plaintiff.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8b3.label: Legally Compelled Disclosure Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8b3.definition: A Legally Compelled Disclosure Clause is a provision in a contract that requires one or both parties to disclose information if legally required to do so.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8b4.label: 315 Airplane Product Liability (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8b4.definition: Action alleging personal injury or death from an air crash or other occurrence involving an airplane and caused by a defective product.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8b5.label: Paramedic Negligence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8b5.definition: Paramedic Negligence refers to a legal claim of medical negligence against a paramedic or emergency medical technician for failing to provide the appropriate standard of care during emergency medical treatment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bD.label: Objection to Confirmation of the Plan
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bD.definition: An Objection to Confirmation of the Plan is a formal statement made by a party in a bankruptcy case, expressing opposition to the approval of a proposed plan for reorganization or liquidation of the debtor's assets.
english_labels: Objection to Confirmation of the Plan

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bE.label: Airport - Real Estate Asset
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bE.definition: An Airport - Real Estate Asset refers to the land, buildings, and infrastructure associated with an airport, including runways, terminals, and other facilities. This type of asset involves both operational and non-operational properties that contribute to the airport's functionality and revenue generation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bG.label: disc_cred_note
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bG.definition: Identification of the discount or credit identified in the disc_credit field as "Other", using codes specified by the client.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bI.label: inv_total_net_due_other_iso
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bI.definition: "For mixed currency situations only where it is mandated that the total invoice must also be reported in a different currency ISO. The sum of all MATTER.matter_total_due for this inv_id in the ISO identified in INVOICE.inv_other_iso. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bI.label: Discharge in Bankruptcy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bI.definition: The concept of Discharge in Bankruptcy refers to the release of a debtor from the obligation to pay certain debts, as ordered by a bankruptcy court.
english_labels: Payment, release, satisfaction, discharge in bankruptcy

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bJ.label: DEPRECATED: Supplement (in favor of "Amended Document")
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bJ.definition: A Supplement in legal and financial contexts refers to an additional document that amends, updates, or adds to the information contained in a primary document. It is commonly used in the realm of legal contracts, investment documents, and regulatory filings to incorporate new information or reflect changes without superseding the original document.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bK.label: Connecticut Court of Appeals
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bK.definition: The Connecticut Court of Appeals is a specific intermediate appellate court within the Connecticut State Courts system, responsible for hearing appeals from lower courts in the state.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bM.label: Antitrust - Vertical Integration Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bM.definition: Antitrust - Vertical Integration Claims: Allegations made in a legal matter that a company has engaged in anti-competitive behavior by acquiring or merging with another company in the same supply chain, thereby limiting competition and potentially harming consumers.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bM.label: DEPRECATED Budgeting and Project Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bM.definition: Deprecated Budgeting and Project Management refers to the outdated process of planning and controlling financial resources and activities related to a specific project, which is no longer in use.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bN.label: Driver
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bN.definition: A driver is an individual who operates a motor vehicle, controlling its direction and speed on public or private roads. This role requires adherence to traffic laws and regulations to ensure safety and order on thoroughfares.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bO.label: Omnibus Claims Objections
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bO.definition: Omnibus Claims Objections are procedural tools used in bankruptcy proceedings to object to multiple claims simultaneously through a single motion or filing. This method is efficient for addressing numerous similar claims or issues in a streamlined manner, helping to expedite the resolution process in complex bankruptcy cases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bP.label: Tatar
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bP.definition: Tatar (Language) is a specific written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a member of the Language top-level class.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bQ.label: New York City Court - Norwich
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bQ.definition: A court located in Norwich, New York City that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bS.label: Deal Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bS.definition: Deal Management refers to the process of managing various legal activities involved in a transaction, such as due diligence, virtual data room management, legal project management, deal collaboration management, closing management, and structure diagram management.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bT.label: Citation to Parliamentary Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bT.definition: A document's citations to laws of a parliament.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bd.label: Indiana Superior Court - Lake County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bd.definition: A court located in Lake County, Indiana that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bf.label: Nuclear Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bf.definition: Law regulating nuclear power and nuclear materials.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bg.label: Younger Abstention
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bg.definition: A legal doctrine known as Younger Abstention, which falls under the category of Abstention Doctrines, requires federal courts to abstain from hearing cases that involve ongoing state court proceedings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bi.label: Motion to Dismiss Document
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bi.definition: A Motion to Dismiss Document is a written request submitted to a court asking for a case to be dismissed, typically due to a lack of legal basis or jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bj.label: New York City Court - Dunkirk
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bj.definition: A court located in Dunkirk, New York that operates under the jurisdiction of the New York City Court.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bp.label: Director Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bp.definition: A Director Agreement is a contract between a corporation and its directors that stipulates the terms of their relationship, such as duties, compensation, and any confidentiality or non-compete clauses.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8br.label: Shan
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8br.definition: A language spoken by the Shan people, primarily in Myanmar, Thailand, and China.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8br.label: Voter Suppression Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8br.definition: A Voter Suppression Claim refers to an allegation that actions were taken to intentionally prevent or discourage certain groups of people from voting. This can include tactics such as stringent voter ID laws, closing polling places in certain areas, purging voter rolls, or disseminating false information about voting procedures.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bs.label: Post-Trial Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bs.definition: Post-Trial Practice refers to the legal work performed after a trial has concluded, including motions and submissions related to the outcome of the trial.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bz.label: Irish, Middle
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8bz.definition: Middle Irish is a language spoken in Ireland between 900 and 1200.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8c1.label: Appliances Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8c1.definition: A clause in a contract that specifies the appliances or equipment included in the agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8c2.label: Three Affiliated Tribes of Ft. Berthold Reservation, North Dakota
english_labels: Three Affiliated Tribes of Ft. Berthold Reservation, North Dakota

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8c4.label: Kansas District Court - Chautauqua County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8c4.definition: A court located in Chautauqua County, Kansas that has jurisdiction over cases within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8c4.label: Sisseton-Wahpeton Oyate of the Lake Traverse Reservation, South Dakota
english_labels: Sisseton-Wahpeton Oyate of the Lake Traverse Reservation, South Dakota

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8cA.label: Birth
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8cA.definition: Birth, in a legal context, refers to the moment when an individual comes into existence, typically at the moment of delivery from the mother's womb. It marks the beginning of a person's legal identity and carries various legal implications, including citizenship and inheritance rights.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8cG.label: Immigration Processing Types
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8cG.definition: "Immigration processing type" refers to the specific stage or procedure within the immigration process, such as visa applications, port of entry checks, change of status requests, or extensions, each with its own requirements and documentation. These steps are crucial for determining an individual's eligibility for entry, residency, or other immigration-related benefits in a destination country.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8cP.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Lake County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8cP.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Lake County refers to a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Lake County, Indiana.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8cX.label: 196 Franchise (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8cX.definition: Action arising from a dispute over a franchise agreement, typically alleging breach of contract, misrepresentation or unfair trade practices.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ca.label: Escrow Agent Improperly Disbursing Funds
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ca.definition: The improper release of funds by an escrow agent, who is responsible for holding and distributing funds in a legal matter, resulting in potential liability for the agent.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8cc.label: Abandonment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8cc.definition: The concept of Abandonment (Divorce) refers to the act of one spouse leaving the marital home and refusing to return, which can be used as grounds for divorce.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ch.label: Futures Commission Merchant
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ch.definition: A Futures Commission Merchant (FCM) is a firm or individual that solicits or accepts orders to buy or sell futures contracts, options on futures, retail foreign exchange contracts, or swaps and accepts money or other assets from customers to support such orders. FCMs are registered and regulated by financial authorities to ensure compliance with trading regulations and the safeguarding of customer funds.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8cj.label: Property Rights
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8cj.definition: Property rights refer to the legal entitlements associated with the ownership, use, and disposition of property, including land, buildings, and other immovable assets. These rights generally include the ability to possess, control, lease, sell, and bequeath the property, subject to certain limitations imposed by law

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8co.label: New Hampshire Superior Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8co.definition: The New Hampshire Superior Court is a court of general jurisdiction within the New Hampshire State Courts system, with the authority to hear and decide a wide range of civil and criminal cases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8d4.label: Abnormal Dangers on Land
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8d4.definition: Abnormal Dangers on Land refers to hazardous conditions or situations that exist on a property, which are not typical or expected, and may pose a risk of harm to children who are attracted to the property.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8d8.label: New York Supreme Court - Erie County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8d8.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Erie County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Erie County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal disputes within its geographical jurisdiction.
english_labels: New York Supreme Court - Erie County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8dF.label: Border Crossing Card
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8dF.definition: A Border Crossing Card (BCC) allows residents of bordering countries to enter a neighboring country for short visits, typically for tourism, shopping, or family visits. This card simplifies the entry process and is often valid for multiple entries over an extended period.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8dF.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Monroe County Circuit 5
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8dF.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that has the authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within Monroe County.
english_labels: Indiana Circuit Court - Monroe County Circuit 5

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8dL.label: Corporate Officer Participating in Tort
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8dL.definition: A Corporate Officer Participating in Tort is an individual who holds a position of authority within a corporation and is involved in a wrongful act or injury caused to another person or entity, resulting in legal liability for the corporation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8dL.label: Employee
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8dL.definition: An employee is a person who is hired for a wage, salary, fee or payment to perform work for an employer.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8dV.label: Standstill Provision Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8dV.definition: A Standstill Provision Clause is a contractual clause that temporarily suspends legal action or obligations between parties, often used in the context of mergers and acquisitions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8dZ.label: Document and File Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8dZ.definition: Document and File Management refers to the process of organizing and maintaining legal documents and files related to a specific legal matter, including their creation, storage, retrieval, and disposal.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8df.label: Friendly Fact Witness Interview
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8df.definition: A "Friendly Fact Witness Interview" is a type of interview conducted with a witness who is not hostile or adverse to the party conducting the interview, and is intended to gather information about the facts of a case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8df.label: Interest Rate Risk
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8df.definition: The risk that an investment's value will change due to a change in the absolute level of interest rates.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8dg.label: Freedom of the Press
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8dg.definition: A freedom of the press claim is a legal action initiated by a journalist, news organization, or other entity alleging that their right to freedom of the press, as protected by the First Amendment of the United States Constitution, has been violated by the government or a government actor. A freedom-of-the-press claim may arise in various contexts, such as when a government body enacts a law or regulation that unduly restricts press freedom, when a journalist is punished or threatened for their reporting, or when access to public information or events is improperly denied.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8di.label: Easement by Implication
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8di.definition: An easement by implication is a type of easement that arises when the circumstances surrounding the creation of a property suggest that the parties intended for an easement to exist, even though it was not explicitly granted or reserved in the deed or other legal document.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8dk.label: Mon-Khmer languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8dk.definition: Mon-Khmer languages are a group of languages spoken in Southeast Asia, including Cambodian and Vietnamese.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8dn.label: Motion in Limine to Exclude Expert Testimony
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8dn.definition: A Motion in Limine to Exclude Expert Testimony is a legal request made by one party to prevent the other party from presenting testimony from an expert witness during trial.
english_labels: Motion in Limine to Exclude Expert Testimony

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8du.label: disc_cred_type
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8du.definition: "Type of discount or credit, applied to the matter/invoice. Valid values are ""Percent"" and ""Flat"". If disc_cred equals ""MIDHR"" or ""Other"", disc_cred_type must be ""Flat"". "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8dw.label: Motion to Extend Time to File Mediation Questionnaire
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8dw.definition: A Motion to Extend Time to File Mediation Questionnaire is a formal request made to the appellate court to allow additional time for a party to submit a questionnaire related to mediation.
english_labels: Motion to Extend Time to File Mediation Questionnaire

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8dx.label: Forgery
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8dx.definition: (Definition of "Counterfeiting/Forgery") The altering, copying, or imitation of something, without authority or right, with the intent to deceive or defraud by passing the copy or thing altered or imitated as that which is original or genuine; or the selling, buying, or possession of an altered, copied, or imitated thing with the intent to deceive or defraud.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8dz.label: Claims Filing Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8dz.definition: A Claims Filing Practice (Bankruptcy) is a legal practice that involves the preparation and submission of claims in a bankruptcy case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8e0.label: 540 Mandamus & Other (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8e0.definition: Action by prisoner currently in custody for a writ of mandamus to compel action by a judge or government official relating to the prisoner’s confinement, including conditions of confinement. This category also includes any actions other than mandamus brought by a prisoner currently in custody, whether or not it relates to his confinement, if it is not classifiable under any other nature of suit category under Prisoner Petitions (for example, action by prisoner to recover property taken by the government in a criminal case).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8e4.label: Augustine Band of Cahuilla Indians, California
english_labels: Augustine Band of Cahuilla Indians, California

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8e6.label: Resource Lease
