https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8nR.definition: The Misappropriation of Name is a legal claim that arises when someone uses another person's name or likeness for commercial gain without their consent.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8nR.label: Actor Attributes
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8nR.definition: Actor Attributes: Characteristics or qualities that define the role or position of a person involved in a legal matter, including their level of involvement (inside, outside, lead, local, supporting).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8nR.label: Chronic Heart Failure
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8nR.definition: Chronic heart failure (CHF) is a condition where the heart is unable to pump blood effectively to meet the body’s needs, leading to symptoms such as dyspnea (shortness of breath), fatigue, and fluid retention. It is characterized by the need for ongoing, consistent medical management, including treatments like diuretics, ACE inhibitors, and beta-blockers, and may require significant lifestyle modifications or assistance with daily activities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8nS.label: 362 Personal Injury - Medical Malpractice (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8nS.definition: Action alleging personal injury or wrongful death caused bynegligence in medical care provided by a doctor or other health careprofessional.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8nS.label: New Jersey Superior Court - Hunterdon County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8nS.definition: The New Jersey Superior Court - Hunterdon County is a court of general jurisdiction within the New Jersey court system that hears civil and criminal cases at the county level.
english_labels: New Jersey Superior Court - Hunterdon County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8nU.label: Warehouse/Logistics - Real Estate Asset
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8nU.definition: A Warehouse/Logistics - Real Estate Asset is a type of industrial and logistics real estate that is used for the storage and distribution of goods.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8nU.label: Alternative Liability
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8nU.definition: A legal concept where multiple parties may be held liable for damages or harm caused to another, even if it is unclear which specific party was responsible for the harm.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8nV.label: Medical Malpractice Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8nV.definition: Medical Malpractice Claims refer to legal claims made against medical professionals or institutions for negligence or failure to provide adequate care resulting in harm or injury to a patient.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8nW.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Madison County 3
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8nW.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Madison County, Indiana, with authority over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8nr.label: By Goal Success
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8nr.definition: Engagement fee model where a client pays a predetermined fee by a specific goal (e.g., closing, dismissal) that is successful.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8nv.label: Immigration Process Modifications
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8nv.definition: "Immigration Process Modifications" encompass actions such as amendments, renewals, and extensions within the immigration process, where changes are made to existing immigration applications or statuses, allowing individuals to update, extend, or renew their legal presence or rights within the destination country. These actions usually involve submitting necessary documents and obtaining approval from immigration authorities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8nw.label: Requirements Contract Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8nw.definition: A requirements contract clause is a provision in a contract that obligates one party to purchase goods or services exclusively from the other party for a specified period of time, based on the buyer's needs.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ny.label: Pipeline Transportation Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ny.definition: Industries in this group use transmission pipelines to transport products, such as crude oil, natural gas, refined petroleum products, and slurry.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ny.label: Debt Financing Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ny.definition: Debt financing occurs when a firm raises money for working capital or capital expenditures by selling debt instruments to individuals and/or institutional investors. In return for lending the money, the individuals or institutions become creditors and receive a promise that the principal and interest on the debt will be repaid.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8nz.label: Evasion Attack
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8nz.definition: An evasion attack is one of the most common attacks on machine learning models performed during production. It involves designing an input that appears normal to a human but is misclassified by ML models, affecting their behavior; a typical example includes altering pixels in an image to cause an image recognition system to fail in classification.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8o0.label: Agency Service Provider
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8o0.definition: An Agency Service Provider in project finance transactions acts as an intermediary between the various parties involved, ensuring smooth communication and coordination. This entity manages administrative tasks, facilitates financial transactions, and ensures compliance with contractual obligations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8o3.label: Application for Copyright Registration
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8o3.definition: An Application for Copyright Registration is a formal submission to a copyright office to secure legal protection for an original work of authorship. The application generally includes a copy of the work being copyrighted, relevant personal and work details, and the appropriate fees, serving as the basis for granting or denying copyright protection.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8o5.label: Active Inducement of Patent Infringement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8o5.definition: The Active Inducement of Patent Infringement refers to the intentional and knowing encouragement or assistance provided by one party to another in the act of infringing a patent.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8o6.label: Operational Efficiency
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8o6.definition: Operational Efficiency is the measure of how effectively a business converts inputs into outputs. It gauges the optimal utilization of resources to maximize revenue. Commonly calculated as the ratio of output to input within a specific time period, operational efficiency is often expressed as a percentage. If that percentage is higher, then the business is more operationally efficient.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8o7.label: Unconscionability Permitting Contract Rescission
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8o7.definition: Unconscionability Permitting Contract Rescission refers to the legal concept that allows a contract to be cancelled or voided due to the presence of unfair or oppressive terms or circumstances that make it impossible for one party to fully understand or consent to the agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8o8.label: Fees of Court Reporter
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8o8.definition: Fees of Court Reporter: The charges incurred for the services provided by a court reporter, such as recording and transcribing court proceedings, which are included in the overall court costs.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8oB.label: Antitrust - Horizontal Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8oB.definition: Antitrust - Horizontal Claims refer to legal claims made against companies that engage in anti-competitive behavior with their direct competitors, such as price-fixing or market allocation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8oH.label: Motion for Prehearing Conference
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8oH.definition: A Motion for Prehearing Conference is a formal request made by a party in an appellate case to schedule a meeting with the court before the actual hearing to discuss procedural matters and streamline the process.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8oI.label: Minnesota District Court - Koochiching County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8oI.definition: Minnesota District Court - Koochiching County refers to a specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Koochiching County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8oJ.label: North Dakota Supreme Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8oJ.definition: The North Dakota Supreme Court is the highest court in the state of North Dakota, responsible for hearing appeals from lower state courts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8oK.label: tax_type
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8oK.definition: "Type of tax. Based on a value specified by the client. Examples in US: ""Federal"", ""State"", ""Local"". Examples in Canada: ""GST"", ""HST"", ""PST"", ""TVQ"". "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8oK.label: New Jersey Superior Court - Atlantic County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8oK.definition: The New Jersey Superior Court - Atlantic County is a trial court within the New Jersey court system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases in Atlantic County.
english_labels: New Jersey Superior Court - Atlantic County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8oN.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Dona Ana County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8oN.definition: A court located in Dona Ana County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases.
english_labels: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Dona Ana County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8oP.label: Delivery Services/Messengers Expense
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8oP.definition: Expenses related to the cost of delivery services or messengers used in a legal matter.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8oR.label: Investment Advisor Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8oR.definition: Rules regarding investment advisor duties and responsibilities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8oY.label: Contentious
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8oY.definition: Contentious negotiation refers to a negotiation process characterized by conflict, disagreement, and adversarial tactics, where parties have opposing interests and may use aggressive strategies to achieve their goals. These negotiations often involve high stakes, significant pressure, and a competitive atmosphere, where parties may prioritize winning over compromise.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8oh.label: Hualapai Indian Tribe of the Hualapai Indian Reservation
english_labels: Hualapai Indian Tribe of the Hualapai Indian Reservation

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ok.label: Minnesota District Court - Otter Tail County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ok.definition: Minnesota District Court - Otter Tail County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Otter Tail County.
english_labels: Minnesota District Court - Otter Tail County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ol.label: Parking Ticket
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ol.definition: A "Parking Ticket" is a notice issued by an authority (like a city or municipality) indicating a violation of parking regulations, such as parking in a no-parking zone or overstaying a metered space. It usually carries a monetary penalty that the vehicle owner must pay.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ol.label: Motion to Extend Plan Payments
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ol.definition: A Motion to Extend Plan Payments is a request made in a bankruptcy case to prolong the period of time for making payments under a previously approved payment plan.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ol.label: Motion to Extend Time to File Record on Appeal
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ol.definition: A Motion to Extend Time to File Record on Appeal is a request made to the appellate court to allow additional time for the filing of the record on appeal beyond the original deadline.
english_labels: Motion to Extend Time to File Record on Appeal

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8oo.label: CLIENT_POSTCODE
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8oo.definition: A client's postal code as defined in the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard for electronic legal invoicing.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8op.label: Nyamwezi
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8op.definition: Nyamwezi is a structured system of communication, belonging to the Bantu language family, spoken by the Nyamwezi people in Tanzania.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8oq.label: Georgia District Court - Appling County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8oq.definition: Georgia District Court - Appling County: A court of law in the state of Georgia that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Appling County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8or.label: Florida Court of Appeals - 5th District
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8or.definition: The Florida Court of Appeals - 5th District is a specific court within the Florida District Court of Appeals that hears appeals from trial courts in its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ow.label: Analysis of Severance Arrangement Issues
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ow.definition: Analysis of Severance Arrangement Issues refers to the examination and evaluation of legal obligations and potential liabilities related to the specific terms and conditions of severance agreements.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ow.label: Foreign Direct Investment Review
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ow.definition: Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) Review refers to the process of evaluating and assessing the potential national security risks associated with foreign investments in the United States, typically conducted by the Committee on Foreign Investment in the U.S. (CFIUS) and falls under the broader category of Investigation Practice.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ox.label: D.C. Superior Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ox.definition: The D.C. Superior Court is a court of general jurisdiction in the District of Columbia that hears civil and criminal cases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8oy.label: Minnesota District Court - Clearwater County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8oy.definition: Minnesota District Court - Clearwater County is a specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Clearwater County, Minnesota.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8p1.label: Strict Product Liability
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8p1.definition: Strict Product Liability is a legal concept that holds manufacturers and sellers responsible for any harm caused by their products, regardless of fault or negligence, if the product is found to be defective.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8p2.label: Covenant Not to Compete Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8p2.definition: A Covenant Not to Compete Clause, also known as a Noncompete Clause, is a contractual clause that prohibits an individual from engaging in certain competitive activities with another party for a specified period of time and within a specific geographic area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8p4.label: charge_desc
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8p4.definition: "Narrative description of the service provided for this line item. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8p5.label: Washington Superior Court - Walla Walla County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8p5.definition: Washington Superior Court - Walla Walla County: A specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Walla Walla County.
english_labels: Washington Superior Court - Walla Walla County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8p7.label: Treasury Securities
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8p7.definition: Treasury securities are debt instruments issued by a government to raise funds and are backed by the full faith and credit of that government. They come in various forms, including Treasury bills, notes, and bonds, each with different maturity lengths and yield characteristics, and are considered among the safest investments due to their low default risk

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pJ.label: Estonian
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pJ.definition: Estonian (Language) is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary used in Estonia and by Estonian speakers worldwide.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pM.label: Social Media Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pM.definition: A social media clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the expectations and limitations regarding the use of social media by the parties involved.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pN.label: Lessor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pN.definition: A lessor is a person or entity that leases or lets a property to another; a landlord.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pO.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Madison County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pO.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Madison County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Madison County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pO.label: Washington Superior Court - Adams County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pO.definition: Washington Superior Court - Adams County refers to a specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Adams County, Washington.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pX.label: Creoles and pidgins, Portuguese-based
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pX.definition: A creole or pidgin language that is based on Portuguese, used as a means of communication between groups with different native languages.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pa.label: Disorders of Thrombosis and Hemostasis
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pa.definition: Disorders of thrombosis and hemostasis are conditions affecting the body's ability to form and dissolve blood clots. These disorders include both excessive clotting (thrombosis) and problems with blood clotting (hemorrhage), leading to an increased risk of either unwanted clot formation or bleeding.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pb.label: Southern Ute Indian Tribe of the Southern Ute Reservation
english_labels: Southern Ute Indian Tribe of the Southern Ute Reservation

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pe.label: Budget
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pe.definition: A Budget is a financial plan that outlines expected income and expenditures for a specific period, usually a month or a year. It serves as a tool for managing finances by allocating resources to various categories such as housing, food, transportation, and savings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pf.label: Total Amount - Fee or Expense
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pf.definition: Total, cumulative amount paid — in fees and/or expenses.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pf.label: Physical Therapy Malpractice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pf.definition: Physical Therapy Malpractice refers to a type of medical malpractice claim that arises from the negligent or improper actions of a physical therapist, resulting in harm or injury to a patient.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ph.label: Trademark and Trade Dress Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ph.definition: Law protecting a business' commercial identity or brand by or product design discouraging other businesses from adopting a name, logo or design that is "confusingly similar" to an existing trademark or design.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pi.label: Copyright Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pi.definition: Copyright Management refers to the process of managing and protecting the exclusive rights granted to the owner of an original work, such as a literary, musical, or artistic creation, including the right to reproduce, distribute, and display the work.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pj.label: tax_tier_min
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pj.definition: "The minimum amount of this tax tier expressed in INVOICE.inv_currency. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pp.label: "Consistent with Past Practice" Language
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pp.definition: A provision in a legal agreement that requires a party to act in accordance with their previous actions or behaviors.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pp.label: Right to Subcontract Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8pp.definition: The Right to Subcontract Clause is a provision in a contract that allows one party to delegate or assign their obligations to a third party without the consent of the other party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8q0.label: Fort McDermitt Paiute and Shoshone Tribe of Nevada and Oregon
english_labels: Fort McDermitt Paiute and Shoshone Tribe of Nevada and Oregon

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8q2.label: Chapter 11 Streamlined Bankruptcy Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8q2.definition: A Subchapter 5 Bankruptcy Claim refers to a financial obligation or debt owed by a small business debtor undergoing a reorganization process under Subchapter 5 of Chapter 11 of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code. Creditors holding such claims may have different priorities and rights based on the terms of the Subchapter 5 reorganization plan, which aims to streamline the bankruptcy process for small businesses

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8q7.label: Transportation Equipment Manufacturing Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8q7.definition: Industries in the Transportation Equipment Manufacturing industry group produce equipment for transporting people and goods.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qB.label: Secured Credit Arrangement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qB.definition: A Secured Credit Arrangement is a financial agreement where the borrower pledges assets as collateral to secure a loan. This collateral reduces the lender's risk, as they have a claim on the asset if the borrower defaults, potentially resulting in lower interest rates and more favorable loan terms for the borrower.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qE.label: Long-term Spousal Support
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qE.definition: Long-term Spousal Support, also known as permanent alimony or maintenance, is financial support that one spouse may be required to pay to the other spouse following a divorce or separation for an extended period, often until the recipient spouse remarries or the paying spouse passes away. This type of support is typically awarded when there is a significant income disparity between the spouses and the recipient spouse is unable to achieve financial self-sufficiency. The duration and amount of long-term spousal support are determined by court decisions or agreements between the parties and may consider factors such as the length of the marriage and the recipient spouse's needs.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qI.label: Communication Modality
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qI.definition: Entities' chosen communication method (e.g., written, email, telephone, portal), as well as time (e.g., synchronous, asynchronous).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qJ.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Monroe County Circuit 4
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qJ.definition: The Indiana Circuit Court - Monroe County Circuit 4 is a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Monroe County.
english_labels: Indiana Circuit Court - Monroe County Circuit 4

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qO.label: Trees
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qO.definition: Trees are perennial woody plants characterized by a single main stem or trunk, supporting branches and leaves. They play a critical role in ecosystems by providing oxygen, habitats, and food for various species, and are essential for maintaining environmental balance.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qP.label: Repossession of Goods / Reclamation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qP.definition: The concept of Repossession of Goods/Reclamation refers to the legal process of taking back possession of property or goods that were sold or leased, due to a breach of contract or failure to make payments, and the rights and liabilities of the parties involved in such a process.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qP.label: disc_cred_percent
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qP.definition: "A percentage number expressing the percent discount provided to this charge, i.e. ""0.15"" reflects a 15% discount to the charge. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qP.label: Motion to Supplement or Amend Mediation Questionnaire
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qP.definition: A Motion to Supplement or Amend Mediation Questionnaire is a formal request made in appellate courts to modify or add information to a previously submitted mediation questionnaire.
english_labels: Motion to Supplement or Amend Mediation Questionnaire

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qR.label: Fee Charge Date
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qR.definition: The Fee Charge Date is a specific detail within the broader concept of Engagement Fee Detail, referring to the date on which a fee for legal services is charged or becomes due.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qT.label: Plastic Surgery Negligence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qT.definition: Plastic Surgery Negligence refers to a legal claim for damages resulting from a medical professional's failure to provide the appropriate standard of care during a plastic surgery procedure.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qX.label: Analysis of Monthly Operating Reports
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qX.definition: The concept of "Analysis of Monthly Operating Reports" refers to the examination and evaluation of financial reports that detail a company's monthly operations, with the purpose of identifying trends and making informed decisions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qY.label: Minnesota District Court - Pine County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qY.definition: Minnesota District Court - Pine County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Pine County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qY.label: Audit Report
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qY.definition: An audit report is a formal document issued at the conclusion of an audit, summarizing the findings, conclusions, and recommendations. It provides an opinion on the fairness and accuracy of an organization's compliance with applicable laws, standards, and regulations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qa.label: Native Village of Barrow Inupiat Traditional Government
english_labels: Native Village of Barrow Inupiat Traditional Government

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ql.label: Little Shell Tribe of Chippewa Indians of Montana
english_labels: Little Shell Tribe of Chippewa Indians of Montana

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ql.label: Request for Notice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ql.definition: A Request for Notice is a type of Bankruptcy and Restructuring Document that is filed with the court to ensure that the filer receives notice of any important events or actions in the bankruptcy case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qr.label: D.C. Bar Legal Ethics Opinions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qr.definition: D.C. Bar Legal Ethics Opinions are official statements issued by the District of Columbia Courts regarding the ethical responsibilities of lawyers practicing in the District of Columbia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qw.label: Shareholding Structure Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8qw.definition: A Shareholding Structure Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the ownership and distribution of shares in a company among its shareholders.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8r0.label: Motion to Stay Proceedings
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8r0.definition: A Motion to Stay Proceedings is a formal request made to a court or tribunal to temporarily halt or pause legal proceedings, typically until a certain condition is met or a specific event occurs.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8r2.label: inv_image_file_name
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8r2.definition: "It may be that there is a statutory, regulatory or client-mandated requirement to also provide an electronic image (.pdf, Word, etc.) of this invoice or of receipts for expenses included in this invoice. If this is the case, use this field to indicate the name of the file with this invoice image so that it can be located by the client. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8r3.label: Compliance with Law Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8r3.definition: A Compliance with Law Clause is a provision in a contract that requires the parties to comply with all applicable laws and regulations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8r4.label: Florida Circuit Court - Highlands County - 10th Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8r4.definition: A court located in Highlands County, Florida that is part of the larger Florida Circuit Court system.
english_labels: Florida Circuit Court - Highlands County - 10th Circuit Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8r6.label: Uterus Cancer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8r6.definition: Uterus cancer refers to malignant tumors originating in the tissues of the uterus, including the endometrium (lining of the uterus) and the myometrium (muscular layer of the uterus). It encompasses various subtypes, with endometrial carcinoma being the most common, and can cause symptoms such as abnormal vaginal bleeding, pelvic pain, and weight loss.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8r7.label: Romance languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8r7.definition: Romance languages are a group of languages that evolved from Latin and are primarily spoken in Western Europe and Latin America.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rA.label: Design Patent Registration
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rA.definition: The concept of Design Patent Registration refers to the legal process of obtaining exclusive rights to a new, original, and ornamental design for an article of manufacture.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rF.label: 893 Environmental Matters (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rF.definition: Action filed under Air Pollution Control Act 42:1857-57L, Clean Air Act 42:1857:57L, Federal Environment Pesticide Control Act, Federal Insecticide, Fungicide & Rodenticide Act 7:135, Federal Water Pollution Control Act 33:1151 et seq., Land & Water Conservation Fund Act 16:4602,460 1-4, Motor Vehicle Air Pollution Control Act 42:1857F-1-8, National Environmental Policy Act 42:4321, 4331-35G, 4341-47, River & Harbor Act penalty 3:401-437, 1251.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rH.label: Analysis of Financial Reports
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rH.definition: Analysis of Financial Reports refers to the process of examining and evaluating financial statements and other financial information to assess the financial health and performance of an individual or organization, as part of the broader legal obligation analysis.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rI.label: Private Fund Reporting Form
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rI.definition: Private Fund Reporting Form (in the U.S., Form PF) is a regulatory filing required by the regulatory authority (e.g., U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)) for private fund advisers managing hedge funds and other private funds, providing detailed information about their activities and assets under management. In the U.S., this form aims to assist the Financial Stability Oversight Council (FSOC) in monitoring systemic risk in the financial markets.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rK.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Baxter Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rK.definition: A court located in Baxter County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rN.label: 751 Family and Medical Leave Act (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rN.definition: Action filed under the Family Medical Leave Act, 29 U.S.C. § 2601
english_labels: 751 Family and Medical Leave Act (PACER NoS)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rN.label: Contract Review Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rN.definition: Contract Review Management refers to the process of systematically examining and analyzing contracts to ensure compliance with legal requirements and organizational policies, as well as identifying and mitigating potential risks and liabilities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rR.label: Motion for Summary Reversal
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rR.definition: A Motion for Summary Reversal is a legal request made to a higher court to overturn a lower court's decision without a full appeal, based on the argument that the lower court made a legal error.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rV.label: JM30 Hearings (UK J-CODE)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rV.definition: Includes preparation for and attendance at hearings for directions and interim certificate applications as well as the detailed assessment itself

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rX.label: Tajik
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rX.definition: Tajik (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is spoken or written in Tajikistan and parts of Uzbekistan, Afghanistan, and China.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rg.label: Fiduciary Exemption to Change of Recommendation Covenant
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rg.definition: A fiduciary exemption to change of recommendation covenant is a legal concept that allows a fiduciary to deviate from a previously agreed-upon recommendation in certain circumstances, without breaching their fiduciary duty.
english_labels: Fiduciary Exemption to Change of Recommendation Covenant

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rm.label: Trusts and Estate Planning Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rm.definition: Trusts and Estate Planning Law involves the legal planning and management of a person's assets and property during their lifetime and after their death, including the creation and administration of trusts, wills, and other estate planning documents.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rp.label: 555 Prison Condition (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rp.definition: Action by current prisoner, or former prisoner or their families alleging a civil rights, Federal Tort Claims Act, or state law claim with respect to a condition of prison life, whether general circumstances or particular episodes. Examples: inadequate medical care or excessive force by prison guards. Includes non-habeas actions by alien detainees alleging unlawful prison conditions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rp.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Lafayette County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rp.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Lafayette County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Lafayette County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ru.label: Primary Election
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ru.definition: A primary election is a preliminary election in which voters of a political party select candidates for a subsequent general election. Primary elections can also determine party delegates for nominating conventions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rv.label: Remote Trial Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rv.definition: Remote Trial Management refers to the process of managing a legal case remotely, including tasks such as scheduling, document management, and communication, typically conducted through virtual means.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rx.label: Loss of Parental Consortium
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8rx.definition: The loss of a parent's ability to provide love, affection, guidance, and support to their child due to injury or death caused by the negligence of another party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8s0.label: Assisting and Participating
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8s0.definition: Assisting and Participating refers to the act of aiding or supporting someone in the commission of a crime or other wrongful act, without necessarily being directly involved in the act itself.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8s2.label: cl_name
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8s2.definition: "The name of the client as required by the client in the electronic submission. Used as a key by the receiving system. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sB.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Monroe County Circuit 2
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sB.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Monroe County Circuit 2 is a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over cases in Monroe County.
english_labels: Indiana Circuit Court - Monroe County Circuit 2

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sE.label: O-2 Visa
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sE.definition: An O-2 visa is issued to individuals who provide essential support services to O-1 visa holders, allowing them to enter the U.S. to assist in the performance of the O-1 visa holder’s work. This visa category includes personnel whose skills are integral to the successful performance of the O-1 visa holder.
english_labels: Support Staff Visa For Extraordinary Talent

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sH.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Indiana County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sH.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Indiana County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases within Indiana County.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Indiana County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sI.label: Leguminous Vegetables
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sI.definition: Leguminous vegetables, also known as legumes or pulses, are a category of vegetables from the legume family (Fabaceae), known for their pod-bearing growth habit and nutrient-rich seeds. They are consumed as a protein source in diets worldwide and are valued for their high protein, fiber, vitamin, and mineral content, as well as their role in improving soil fertility through nitrogen fixation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sI.label: Grass Roots Organization and Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sI.definition: Grass Roots Organization and Management involves providing legal advice and support for the creation, development, and governance of community-based, often volunteer-driven, organizations. This practice includes structuring the organization, ensuring regulatory compliance, and facilitating effective grassroots campaigns and advocacy efforts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sL.label: Secondary Offering Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sL.definition: Secondary Offering Practice involves the sale of shares by existing shareholders, typically through a public offering, after the company's initial public offering (IPO). It includes the legal and regulatory processes to ensure compliance with securities laws and protect investors' interests.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sM.label: Religion
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sM.definition: Religion refers to a set of beliefs, practices, and values centered around the worship of one or more deities, a higher power, or a guiding moral or ethical principle. In many jurisdictions, including the United States, it is unlawful to discriminate against individuals based on their religion or religious beliefs in various contexts, such as employment, housing, and public services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sP.label: Medical Transport Negligence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sP.definition: Medical transport negligence refers to a claim of medical malpractice that arises from the negligent transportation of a patient, such as by ambulance or air transport.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sT.label: Florida Circuit Court - Union County - 8th Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sT.definition: A court located in Union County, Florida that is part of the 8th Circuit Court system.
english_labels: Florida Circuit Court - Union County - 8th Circuit Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sX.label: Cremation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sX.definition: Cremation is the process of reducing a deceased person's body to ashes through high-temperature burning. This practice serves as an alternative to traditional burial and is often chosen for cultural, religious, or practical reasons.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sZ.label: New York Appellate Division - 4th Dept.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sZ.definition: The New York Appellate Division - 4th Dept. is a specific court within the New York Supreme Court - Appellate Division that hears appeals from lower courts in the western part of the state.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sZ.label: Minnesota District Court - Red Lake County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sZ.definition: A court located in Red Lake County, Minnesota that has jurisdiction over cases within its geographical area.
english_labels: Minnesota District Court - Red Lake County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sd.label: Vertebrate Animal
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sd.definition: A Vertebrate Animal is a member of the subphylum Vertebrata within the phylum Chordata, characterized by having a backbone or spinal column. Vertebrates include a diverse group of animals such as mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, and fish, all of which possess a well-defined internal skeleton and complex organ systems.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sf.label: Lead Plaintiff
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sf.definition: A plaintiff, usually among a group of plaintiffs (e.g., class action), who leads the plaintiff group.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sg.label: Social Assistance Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8sg.definition: Industries in this group provide a wide variety of social assistance services directly to their clients. These services do not include residential or accommodation services, except on a short stay basis.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ss.label: Asset Depreciation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ss.definition: Asset Depreciation is the systematic decrease in the recorded value of an asset over time, typically due to wear and tear, obsolescence, or the passage of time. This accounting method allocates the cost of tangible assets over their useful life, reflecting the reduction in the asset's economic value.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8t2.label: Tail Period Fee Triggers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8t2.definition: Tail Period Fee Triggers: A provision in a deal protection agreement that entitles the target company to receive a fee if a potential acquirer makes a bid within a certain period after the termination of the agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8t3.label: Real Property Defect Concealed by Seller
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8t3.definition: The concept of "Real Property Defect Concealed by Seller" refers to a situation in which a seller of real estate fails to disclose a known defect in the property to the buyer, which can result in legal claims related to the property and potential liability for the seller.
english_labels: Real Property Defect Concealed by Seller

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8t5.label: Sale of Goods
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8t5.definition: The Sale of Goods is a legal concept that refers to the transfer of ownership of tangible personal property in exchange for money or other consideration, and is a type of contract or quasi-contract claim.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8t5.label: Ohio Municipal Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8t5.definition: Ohio Municipal Court is a court of limited jurisdiction in Ohio that handles minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil cases within a specific geographic area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8t6.label: Language Access Right
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8t6.definition: Language Access Right refers to the legal entitlement of individuals to receive assistance in understanding and communicating in the jurisdiction's dominant language (e.g., English) when interacting with government agencies or accessing public services. This right aims to eliminate language barriers that may prevent individuals, particularly those who are not proficient in the dominant language, from fully participating in civic activities or obtaining necessary services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8t7.label: Expert Fields
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8t7.definition: The fields in which a person is an expert.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8tE.label: Motion for Injunction
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8tE.definition: A Motion for Injunction is a legal request made to a court to order a person or entity to stop doing a certain action or behavior, typically to prevent harm or damage to another party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8tH.label: Term Life Insurance
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8tH.definition: Term life insurance is a policy that provides coverage for a specified period, or "term," usually ranging from 10 to 30 years. If the insured individual dies within this term, the death benefit is paid out to the beneficiaries; however, if the term expires and the policyholder is still alive, there is generally no payout.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8tH.label: Tax Tier Tax Percent
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8tH.definition: Tax Tier Tax Percent refers to the percentage of tax applied to a specific tier of income or value, as a part of the Tax Tier Detail concept in legal services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8tP.label: Rincon Band of Luiseno Mission Indians
english_labels: Rincon Band of Luiseno Mission Indians

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8tR.label: Zaza; Dimili; Dimli; Kirdki; Kirmanjki; Zazaki
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8tR.definition: A language spoken in parts of Turkey and Iran, including dialects such as Zaza, Dimili, Dimli, Kirdki, Kirmanjki, and Zazaki.
english_labels: Zaza; Dimili; Dimli; Kirdki; Kirmanjki; Zazaki

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8tS.label: Bill of Attainder Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8tS.definition: A Bill of Attainder claim is a legal argument that a government has passed a bill of attainder: a law that legislatively determines guilt and inflicts punishment upon an individual without a judicial trial. This claim may arise when a law or action is perceived to inflict punishment without a trial, thus violating this provision.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8te.label: Basque
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8te.definition: Basque is a written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a member of the Language top-level class.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8tn.label: Provider Identifier
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8tn.definition: Identifier (e.g., IRIs, UUIDs, GUIDs) of the Provider (e.g., law firm, ALSP) within the systems of stakeholders (e.g., vendors, sellers, buyers, courts).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8tr.label: Motion to Exclude Evidence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8tr.definition: A Motion to Exclude Evidence is a formal request made to a court to prevent certain evidence from being presented at trial, typically on the grounds that it was obtained illegally or is otherwise inadmissible.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8tu.label: Tips
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8tu.definition: Tips refer to additional payments received by service industry workers, such as waitstaff, bartenders, or delivery drivers, as a gratuity from customers for the provided service. They are considered a form of income and are often shared among staff or reported to tax authorities as part of an individual's earnings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8tw.label: Noncontravention Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8tw.definition: A Noncontravention Clause is a provision in a contract that ensures that the actions of one party will not violate any laws or agreements with third parties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8u1.label: Environmental Report
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8u1.definition: An Environmental Report is a structured document that provides an assessment of the environmental impact of a company's operations, projects, or activities. It often includes data on emissions, waste management, and compliance with environmental regulations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8u4.label: Parkinson's Disease
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8u4.definition: Parkinson's disease is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by the loss of dopamine-producing neurons in the brain, leading to motor symptoms such as tremors, rigidity, bradykinesia (slowness of movement), and postural instability. It also includes non-motor symptoms like cognitive impairment, mood disorders, and autonomic dysfunction, requiring comprehensive medical and supportive care.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8u6.label: A110 Manage data/files
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8u6.definition: The concept of A110 Manage data/files refers to the activity of organizing and controlling electronic or physical information and documents.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8u7.label: Audit
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8u7.definition: An audit is a systematic examination and verification of an organization's financial and non-financial records, operational procedures, or a system's compliance with regulatory standards, usually carried out by an independent body.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8u8.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Lancaster County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8u8.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Lancaster County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering civil and criminal proceedings at the county level in Pennsylvania.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Lancaster County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uB.label: Fee Simple Determinable Interest
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uB.definition: A fee simple determinable interest is a type of freehold estate in real property that automatically ends and reverts to the grantor upon the occurrence or non-occurrence of a specified event or condition. This estate is characterized by a possibility of reverter, where the original owner (or their heirs) has the right to reclaim ownership if the condition is breached.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uC.label: ZIP
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uC.definition: A file type that usually contains other files or directories that have been compressed.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uM.label: Speculative Grade
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uM.definition: Speculative Grade refers to a category of credit rating that indicates a higher risk of default, making the debt securities less suitable for conservative investors. These ratings are assigned by credit rating agencies and generally include ratings below BBB on the Standard & Poor's and Fitch scales, and below Baa3 on the Moody's scale.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uM.label: Florida Circuit Court - Osceola County - 9th Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uM.definition: A Florida Circuit Court located in Osceola County that operates within the 9th Circuit Court jurisdiction.
english_labels: Florida Circuit Court - Osceola County - 9th Circuit Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uP.label: Suit on Sworn Account
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uP.definition: A Suit on Sworn Account is a legal claim that arises from a written statement made under oath by a party who seeks to recover a debt or demand payment for goods or services provided, and is based on a contractual or quasi-contractual relationship between the parties involved.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uP.label: Antitrust - Refusal to Deal Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uP.definition: The concept of "Antitrust - Refusal to Deal Claims" refers to legal claims made against a company for refusing to do business with another company, in violation of antitrust laws.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uU.label: Tax Agreements
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uU.definition: A Tax Related Agreement is a contract outlining the terms, conditions, and responsibilities of parties concerning taxation matters. This agreement can address issues like the allocation of tax liabilities, indemnifications, and procedures for handling tax-related disputes or inquiries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uV.label: Creativity
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uV.definition: Creativity in copyright law refers to the requirement that a work must display some level of original thought or artistic expression. It distinguishes copyrightable works from mere mechanical reproductions, ensuring protection is afforded only to creations that embody the author's intellectual effort.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uW.label: Solvency Risk
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uW.definition: The risk that the company will not have sufficient assets to meet its liabilities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uW.label: Bonus Opportunity Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uW.definition: A Bonus Opportunity Clause is a provision in a contract that provides an additional chance for a party to receive a bonus or reward based on certain conditions being met.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uW.label: Termination of Contract Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uW.definition: A Termination of Contract Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the circumstances under which the agreement may be ended by one or both parties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uY.label: JE40 Amendment of Statements of Case (UK J-CODE)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uY.definition: Preparing and considering amendments to originating process, Statements of Case, Part 20 proceedings. In appeals refers to amendments to Appellants’ and Respondents’ Notices and supporting skeleton arguments.
english_labels: JE40 Amendment of Statements of Case (UK J-CODE)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uZ.label: Matter Narrative Description
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uZ.definition: A textual narrative description, detailing a matter's factual and legal details.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ua.label: Trucking Negligence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ua.definition: Trucking Negligence refers to the failure of a common carrier engaged in the transportation of goods by truck to exercise reasonable care, resulting in harm or injury to others.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ua.label: Lost Capacity in Living Resulting from Tort
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ua.definition: The concept of Lost Capacity in Living Resulting from Tort refers to the reduction in a person's ability to enjoy life due to injuries caused by someone else's wrongful act, for which compensation may be sought in a personal injury claim under the category of non-economic damages.
english_labels: Lost Capacity in Living Resulting from Tort

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uo.label: Work Environment Harassment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uo.definition: Work Environment Harassment refers to a type of employment harassment claim that involves creating a hostile work environment through unwelcome and discriminatory behavior or conduct.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ut.label: Social Anxiety Disorder
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8ut.definition: Social Anxiety Disorder, also known as social phobia, is a mental health condition characterized by an intense, persistent fear of social or performance situations where one may be scrutinized or judged by others. This fear often leads to significant distress and avoidance of social interactions, affecting daily functioning and quality of life.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uu.label: Lettuce
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8uu.definition: Lettuce is a leafy vegetable from the Lactuca sativa species, known for its crisp texture and mild, refreshing flavor. It is commonly consumed raw in salads and sandwiches and is valued for its low-calorie content and nutritional benefits, including vitamins A, C, and K, as well as fiber.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8v0.label: Child Support Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8v0.definition: A Child Support Court is a specialized court or division within the legal system that handles cases related to child support obligations. These courts oversee matters such as the establishment, modification, enforcement, and collection of child support payments.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8v6.label: Florida Circuit Court - Flagler County - 7th Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8v6.definition: A court located in Flagler County, Florida that is part of the larger Florida Circuit Court system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings within the state.
english_labels: Florida Circuit Court - Flagler County - 7th Circuit Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8v7.label: Assessment of Eligibility for Public Benefits
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8v7.definition: Assessment of eligibility for public benefits by a lawyer or other legal service provider involves a comprehensive review and analysis of an individual's or family's financial, social, and legal circumstances to determine their qualification for specific government assistance programs. This pre-application assessment typically includes gathering documentation, evaluating against program criteria, and providing legal advice on how best to present the case to maximize chances of approval
english_labels: Assessment of Eligibility for Public Benefits

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8v8.label: Asset Ownership, Transfer, or Sales Restrictions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8v8.definition: Asset Ownership, Transfer, or Sales Restrictions refer to the special conditions and regulatory constraints that limit the ownership, transfer, or sale of securities. These restrictions often include country-specific regulations, legal requirements, and contractual limitations designed to control the distribution and ownership of financial assets.
english_labels: Asset Ownership, Transfer, or Sales Restrictions

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vA.label: Political Rights
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vA.definition: Political rights are the rights that enable individuals to freely participate in the civic and political life of a society, including voting, running for public office, and engaging in public discourse. These rights are typically guaranteed by a country's constitution or laws and are essential for the functioning of a democratic system.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vC.label: Profit Margin
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vC.definition: Profit Margin is a financial metric that measures the profitability of a business or a product. It is calculated by dividing net profit by total revenue and is usually expressed as a percentage, serving as a universal measure of business profitability.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vD.label: Acquiree
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vD.definition: An acquiree is a company or entity that is being acquired or purchased in a merger or acquisition transaction. The acquiree is also known as the target firm during a takeover scenario.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vE.label: Motion/Brief Exhibit
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vE.definition: A Motion/Brief Exhibit is a type of Exhibit that is presented to a court or other legal authority in support of a motion or brief, typically containing evidence or arguments in favor of a particular position.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vF.label: Classical Newari; Old Newari; Classical Nepal Bhasa
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vF.definition: A language spoken in Nepal, including Classical Newari, Old Newari, and Classical Nepal Bhasa.
english_labels: Classical Newari; Old Newari; Classical Nepal Bhasa

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vJ.label: Machine Authorship
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vJ.definition: Machine Authorship in copyright law pertains to works created by machines or computer algorithms, typically without direct human creative input. This concept raises significant questions about the applicability of copyright laws to works generated by artificial intelligence or other automated processes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vM.label: Ph.D. (Doctor of Philosophy)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vM.definition: The suffix "Ph.D." stands for "Doctor of Philosophy" and is used after a person's name to indicate that they have earned the highest academic degree awarded by universities in most fields of study. The use of this suffix signifies the individual's expertise and authority in a specific subject area and is often used in academic, research, and professional settings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vM.label: Partnership Representative Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vM.definition: A Partnership Representative Clause is a provision in a contract that designates a representative to act on behalf of a partnership in tax matters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vS.label: Analysis of Benefits Plans
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vS.definition: The concept of "Analysis of Benefits Plans" refers to the examination and evaluation of employee benefits plans, such as health insurance and retirement plans, to determine their effectiveness and compliance with legal requirements.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vi.label: Unfair Competition Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vi.definition: Unfair Competition Claims refer to legal actions taken by businesses against competitors who engage in deceptive or unfair practices that harm their business, such as trademark infringement, trade secret misappropriation, or deceptive trade practices.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vj.label: Security Deposit Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vj.definition: A Security Deposit Clause is a provision in a contract that requires one party to provide a sum of money to the other party as a guarantee of performance or payment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vo.label: Joint Defense Group
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vo.definition: A group of parties who participate in a Joint Defense Agreement, usually separate parties (though in a similar position) who are defendants in a civil lawsuit.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vo.label: Variable Costs
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vo.definition: Variable costs are expenses that change in direct proportion to the level of goods or services that a business produces. Examples include raw materials, direct labor, subcontractor fees, and shipping costs, which increase or decrease as production volumes change. This metric is important for scalability analysis.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vq.label: Motion for Damages for Creditor Misconduct
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vq.definition: A Motion for Damages for Creditor Misconduct is a legal request made in a bankruptcy case by the debtor to seek compensation for any harm caused by the creditor's wrongful actions.
english_labels: Motion for Damages for Creditor Misconduct

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vr.label: Right of First Refusal Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vr.definition: A Right of First Refusal Clause is a provision in a contract that grants a party the opportunity to purchase or lease property before it is offered to others.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8vx.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Woodford County (11th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Woodford County (11th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8w2.label: Misleading Objection
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8w2.definition: A Misleading Objection (aka Confusion Objection) is raised when a party in a legal proceeding believes that a question or statement is designed to deceive or confuse the witness or the court. This objection is often related to Federal Rule of Evidence 403, which allows the exclusion of evidence if its probative value is substantially outweighed by the risk of causing confusion, misleading the jury, or wasting time.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8w3.label: Georgia Superior Court - Catoosa County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8w3.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia, located in Catoosa County and presided over by a judge.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8w3.label: Disparate Impact Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8w3.definition: Disparate Impact refers to a situation where a seemingly neutral employment or legal policy, rule, or practice has a disproportionately adverse effect on a specific group defined by race, gender, age, or other protected characteristic. While the policy may not be intentionally discriminatory, the end result creates inequality, often prompting legal scrutiny.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8w3.label: Liability For Unlicensed Subcontractors
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8w3.definition: Liability for Unlicensed Subcontractors refers to the legal responsibility of a company or individual for any harm caused by a subcontractor who does not possess the required license or permit to perform the work they were hired for.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8w3.label: Bench Trial
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8w3.definition: A bench trial is a trial by judge or panel of judges, as opposed to a trial by jury.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8w5.label: Document Management Add-On
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8w5.definition: A Document Management Add-On is a specialized tool or feature that enhances the functionality of a Document Management system. It is a software component that can be added to an existing Document Management system to provide additional capabilities or improve existing ones.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8w6.label: Death Penalty
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8w6.definition: The Death Penalty (Capital Punishment) is a form of criminal penalty that involves the execution of a person who has been convicted of a capital crime.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8w9.label: X118 Eviction Costs
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8w9.definition: Any other costs specifically associated with an eviction action not already provided for within the expense codes

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wA.label: Machine Learning
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wA.definition: Machine Learning (ML) is a branch of Artificial Intelligence (AI) that focuses on developing systems capable of learning from data to perform tasks without being explicitly programmed. Learning involves optimizing model parameters through computational techniques to enhance the model's performance for specific training tasks

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wA.label: 423 Withdrawal of Reference 28 USC § 157 (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wA.definition: Action held in bankruptcy court requesting withdrawal under the provisions of 28 U.S.C. § 157

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wC.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Monroe County Circuit 3
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wC.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Monroe County Circuit 3 is a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over cases in Monroe County.
english_labels: Indiana Circuit Court - Monroe County Circuit 3

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wE.label: Brief / Memorandum of Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wE.definition: A Brief/Memorandum of Law is a written document submitted to a court that summarizes the legal arguments and relevant facts of a case, typically prepared by an attorney for a client.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wJ.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Morgan County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wJ.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Morgan County: A court of general jurisdiction in Morgan County, Indiana, with the authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wM.label: Lawful Permanent Resident
english_labels: A Lawful Permanent Resident (LPR) is an individual who has been legally granted the right to live and work indefinitely within the destination country (e.g., United States). LPR status provides many of the same benefits as citizenship, such as the ability to work and travel freely, but unlike citizens, LPRs may lose their status under certain conditions like committing serious crimes or abandoning their destination-country residence (e.g., U.S. residence).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wO.label: Entity Registration Document
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wO.definition: An entity registration document is a formal document issued by a governmental or authorized body, confirming that an individual, organization, or product meets specific standards or regulations. This certificate serves as legal evidence of compliance and may be required for certain professional practices, business operations, or product distributions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wX.label: Indivisible Harm Caused by Separate Tortfeasors
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wX.definition: Indivisible Harm Caused by Separate Tortfeasors: A legal concept where multiple parties are responsible for causing harm to an individual, and the harm cannot be divided or attributed to any one party individually.
english_labels: Indivisible Harm Caused by Separate Tortfeasors

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wb.label: Health Maintenance Organization Act Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wb.definition: Claims brought under the Health Maintenance Organization Act, which regulates the operation and structure of health maintenance organizations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8we.label: Florida Circuit Court - Miami-Dade County - 11th Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8we.definition: The Florida Circuit Court - Miami-Dade County (11th Circuit Court) is a specific court within the Florida Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Miami-Dade County.
english_labels: Florida Circuit Court - Miami-Dade County - 11th Circuit Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wg.label: Indiana Superior Court - Sullivan County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wg.definition: The Indiana Superior Court - Sullivan County is a specific court within the Indiana Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Sullivan County, Indiana.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wi.label: Northern Sami
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wi.definition: A language spoken by the indigenous Sami people in northern Scandinavia, Finland, and Russia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wi.label: Criminal Matter Identifiers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wi.definition: Criminal Matter Identifiers are unique codes or numbers used to track and identify criminal cases, including information such as law enforcement arrest tracking numbers, fatality indicators, commercial motor vehicle indicators, law enforcement incident tracking numbers, and traffic accident indicators.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wl.label: Values and Ethics Risk
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wl.definition: Values and Ethics Risk refers to the potential for negative consequences arising from an organization's failure to adhere to its stated values, principles, or ethical standards in its operations, decision-making, or behaviors. This can result from unethical practices, inadequate oversight, or cultural issues, potentially leading to reputational damage, legal liabilities, or loss of stakeholder trust, ultimately impacting the organization's overall performance, credibility, and sustainability

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wn.label: Georgia Superior Court - Habersham County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wn.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia, located in Habersham County and responsible for hearing civil and criminal cases within its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wo.label: Aggravation of a Pre-Existing Ailment or Condition
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wo.definition: The aggravation of a pre-existing ailment or condition refers to the worsening or exacerbation of a medical condition that existed prior to an incident or accident, resulting in non-economic damages.
english_labels: Aggravation of a Pre-Existing Ailment or Condition

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wt.label: Litigation Agreements
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8wt.definition: Litigation Related Agreements are contracts associated with disputes, their resolution, and related legal processes. These agreements can dictate the terms, conditions, and procedures to avoid or end litigation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8x0.label: Promissory Note
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8x0.definition: A promissory note is a written agreement in which one party promises to pay a specific amount of money to another party at a future date or on demand.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8x4.label: Property Disparagement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8x4.definition: The act of making false or misleading statements about someone's property, which causes harm to their reputation or financial interests, and can result in legal action under the categories of defamation, property, and premises liability claims.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8x5.label: International Trade Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8x5.definition: International Trade Practice involves the legal frameworks and regulations governing the exchange of goods, services, and capital across international borders. This area includes trade agreements, customs regulations, export and import controls, trade compliance, and dispute resolution in global commerce.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8x6.label: MD
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8x6.definition: Markdown is a lightweight markup language with plain text formatting syntax. It is commonly used to format readme files, for writing messages in online discussion forums, and to create rich text using a plain text editor.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8x7.label: "'Violation' of fiduciary duties" Language
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8x7.definition: The "Violation" of fiduciary duties refers to a breach of the legal obligation of loyalty and care that a fiduciary owes to their client or beneficiary, often resulting in harm or loss to the latter.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8xB.label: Law of Obligations
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8xB.definition: The Law of Obligations in civil law systems refers to a set of rules governing the duties, responsibilities, and rights of parties engaged in contractual or quasi-contractual relationships. It provides the legal framework for various types of obligations, such as contractual obligations, torts, and unjust enrichment, specifying how these obligations arise, are performed, or can be extinguished.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8xI.label: Modern Rape
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8xI.definition: Non-consensual sexual intercourse that involves physical force, coercion, or the inability to give consent, and which is prosecuted under contemporary legal definitions and standards.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8xS.label: Drug Test
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8xS.definition: A drug test is a technical analysis of a biological specimen, such as urine, hair, blood, breath, sweat, or oral fluid/saliva, to determine the presence or absence of specified drugs or their metabolites. These tests are often used by employers, sports organizations, legal and law enforcement agencies, and in healthcare settings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8xV.label: New York Recorder's Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8xV.definition: A court in New York State that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and traffic violations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8xa.label: Citizen
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8xa.definition: A citizen is a member of a political community or nation, endowed with certain rights and responsibilities under the governing laws of that jurisdiction. Citizenship status is typically conferred by birth within a certain territory, descent from citizens, or naturalization

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8xb.label: Anti-Virus Certificate
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8xb.definition: A certificate issued by an anti-virus software company verifying that a computer system is free of viruses or malware, typically used as evidence in legal proceedings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8xc.label: Urogynecology Malpractice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8xc.definition: Urogynecology Malpractice refers to a type of medical malpractice claim that involves injuries or harm caused by the negligence or misconduct of a urogynecologist, who specializes in the treatment of pelvic floor disorders in women.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8xe.label: Motion to File
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8xe.definition: A Motion to File is a request made to a court to allow a party to submit a document or pleading that is not currently part of the official record in a case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R8xg.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Reynolds County
