https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9HE.label: Twi
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9HE.definition: Twi is a language spoken in Ghana and is a subcategory of the Language class in the ontology.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9HK.label: Certificate of Deposit
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9HK.definition: A Certificate of Deposit (CD) is a time-bound deposit made with a bank or financial institution that offers a fixed interest rate over a specified period. Unlike a regular savings account, funds in a CD are usually locked in for the term of the CD and early withdrawal may result in penalties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9HL.label: Pathology Malpractice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9HL.definition: Pathology Malpractice refers to a type of medical malpractice claim that arises from errors or negligence in the examination and diagnosis of tissue samples and bodily fluids by pathologists.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9HN.label: Interference with Leave Rights Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9HN.definition: An interference with leave rights claim is a legal action initiated by an employee against their employer for interfering with their right to take protected leave under applicable laws. These laws may include the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA), the California Family Rights Act (CFRA), or other state and local laws that provide protected leave for certain reasons, such as for the employee's own serious health condition, to care for a seriously ill family member, or for the birth or adoption of a child. The claim typically arises when an employer denies or discourages an employee from taking leave or retaliates against an employee for taking protected leave.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9HP.label: Securitization Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9HP.definition: The financial practice of pooling various types of contractual debt such as residential mortgages, commercial mortgages, auto loans or credit card debt obligations (or other non-debt assets which generate receivables) and selling their related cash flows to third party investors as securities, which may be described as bonds, pass-through securities, or collateralized debt obligations (CDOs).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9HP.label: Out-of-Court Restructuring
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9HP.definition: An out-of-court restructuring or workout is a nonjudicial process through which a financially troubled company and its significant creditors reach an agreement for adjusting the company's obligations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9HP.label: Leasehold Estate
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9HP.definition: A Leasehold is an estate in real property where a lessee is granted the exclusive right to occupy and use a property for a predetermined period, typically in exchange for rent or other consideration. Unlike fee simple ownership, leasehold interests are temporary and revert back to the lessor at the end of the lease term

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9HR.label: Railway Labor Act Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9HR.definition: A Railway Labor Act Claim involves legal proceedings or disputes arising under the Railway Labor Act (RLA), which governs labor relations in the railway and airline industries in the United States. These claims typically address issues such as collective bargaining, union representation, and the resolution of labor disputes.
english_labels: Rail and Air Transport Labor Dispute

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9HS.label: Errata
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9HS.definition: Errata refers to a document filed with a court that corrects errors or omissions in a previously filed document, and is categorized under Trial Court Practice Documents and Appellate Practice Documents.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9HT.label: Aircraft
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9HT.definition: An Aircraft is a vehicle capable of atmospheric flight due to its interaction with the air, primarily through the generation of lift. This category includes various types of flying machines such as airplanes, helicopters, gliders, and drones.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9HV.label: Arbitrator
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9HV.definition: An arbitrator is an independent person or body appointed to hear a dispute in arbitration.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9HV.label: Tax Matters Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9HV.definition: A Tax Matters Agreement delineates the rights, responsibilities, and obligations of parties in relation to tax matters, particularly when companies undergo a separation or spin-off. It specifies how the entities will address shared tax liabilities, benefits, and the management of tax-related procedures post-separation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9HY.label: Estate, Inheritance, and Gift Tax Payment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9HY.definition: Estate, Inheritance, and Gift Taxes are levies imposed on the transfer of wealth through various means, either during a person's life or upon their death. Estate taxes are applied to the total value of a deceased person's estate before distribution to heirs, inheritance taxes are imposed on beneficiaries receiving assets, and gift taxes are applied to transfers of wealth during an individual's lifetime that exceed certain thresholds.
english_labels: Estate, Inheritance, and Gift Tax Payment

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9HZ.label: Visa for Artist or Entertainer in a Culturally Unique Program
english_labels: This visa (in the U.S., the P-3 visa) is intended for artists or entertainers who come to perform, teach, or coach as part of a culturally unique program. In the United States, this non-immigrant visa is typically granted for the time needed to complete the specific event, performance, or production, up to a maximum of one year, with the possibility for extensions.
Visa for Artist or Entertainer in a Culturally Unique Program

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ha.label: Paiute-Shoshone Tribe of the Fallon Reservation and Colony, Nevada
english_labels: Paiute-Shoshone Tribe of the Fallon Reservation and Colony, Nevada

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Hh.label: Writ of Mandamus
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Hh.definition: A Writ of Mandamus is a legal order issued by a court that commands a government official or agency to perform a specific duty or act that they are legally obligated to do.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Hh.label: Cherokee Bear Clan of South Carolina
english_labels: Cherokee Bear Clan of South Carolina

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Hi.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Ste. Genevieve County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Hi.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Ste. Genevieve County: A specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Ste. Genevieve County.
english_labels: Missouri Circuit Court - Ste. Genevieve County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Hl.label: Diplomat
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Hl.definition: A diplomat is an individual appointed by a state to conduct negotiations, represent interests, and maintain diplomatic relations with other states or international organizations. Diplomats often enjoy certain privileges and immunities under international law, which allow them to perform their duties more effectively while residing in a foreign country

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ho.label: Annulment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ho.definition: The legal process of declaring a marriage null and void, as if it never existed, typically due to some defect or impediment that existed at the time of the marriage.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ht.label: Assignment Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ht.definition: An Assignment Agreement is a legal contract that transfers rights, benefits, or obligations from one party to another. This agreement outlines the conditions under which the assignment takes place, including the responsibilities of each party and any limitations or requirements that must be met for the assignment to be effective.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Hu.label: Evidence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Hu.definition: Evidence refers to information, data, or physical items presented in a legal proceeding to support or refute a claim or charge. Its purpose is to prove or disprove the existence of an alleged fact. Evidence can take many forms, including witness testimony, documents, photographs, and forensic findings, and its admissibility in court is governed by a set of legal standards and rules.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Hv.label: Sick Leave
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Hv.definition: Sick leave is a form of paid time off that allows employees to take time away from work when they are ill or need medical care. It is designed to ensure that employees can recover from illness without losing income.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Hv.label: Definition of Material Damage Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Hv.definition: A Material Damage Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the responsibilities and liabilities of the parties involved in the event of physical harm or destruction to the subject matter of the contract.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Hw.label: JA00 Funding (UK J-CODE)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Hw.definition: All work relating to reviewing funding options, securing funding and reports to funders during the life of the case

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9I0.label: Hunting License
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9I0.definition: A hunting license is an official permit issued by a governing authority that grants individuals the legal right to hunt specific species of wildlife within designated areas and during specified seasons. To obtain a hunting license, applicants often must complete a hunter education course and adhere to established regulations, bag limits, and conservation measures. The license may have stipulations based on species, weapon type, and region.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9I1.label: Motion to Expedite Appeal
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9I1.definition: A Motion to Expedite Appeal is a legal request made to a higher court to speed up the process of reviewing a lower court's decision.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9I2.label: Timberland Real Estate Asset
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9I2.definition: In the context of legal services, Timberland refers to a parcel of land with specific legal considerations surrounding the growth, management, and harvesting of timber. Legal issues may include property rights, environmental regulations, and contractual obligations between parties involved.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9I5.label: Asset Distribution Policy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9I5.definition: Asset Distribution Policy refers to the strategy a fund employs to manage and allocate its investment profits. This policy includes income funds, which regularly distribute profits to investors; accumulation funds, which reinvest profits back into the fund; and mixed funds, which combine both strategies by partially distributing and partially reinvesting profits.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9I7.label: Military Enrollment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9I7.definition: Military Enrollment refers to the process by which individuals join the armed forces, either voluntarily or through conscription. This initial phase includes a series of steps such as application, background checks, and basic training to prepare the individual for service.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9IB.label: Negligent Spoliation of Evidence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9IB.definition: The intentional or reckless destruction or alteration of evidence by a party who had a duty to preserve it, resulting in the inability to use the evidence in a legal proceeding, due to their negligence.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9IC.label: Moral Rights
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9IC.definition: Moral Rights in copyright law refer to the rights of creators to protect the personal and reputational value of their works. These rights typically include the right to claim authorship, the right to prevent distortion or mutilation, and the right to withdraw or alter the work.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9IN.label: Civil Arrest
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9IN.definition: The concept of Civil Arrest refers to the act of detaining a person by legal authority in order to enforce a civil judgment against them.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9IO.label: Disclaimer for Lack of Cooperation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9IO.definition: A disclaimer for lack of cooperation is a statement made by an insurance company indicating that they are not liable for a claim due to the policyholder's failure to cooperate with the investigation or provide necessary information.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9IQ.label: Illinois Circuit Court - McLean County (11th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - McLean County (11th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9IS.label: Trademark Regulatory Objectives
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9IS.definition: Trademark Regulatory Objectives: The specific aims, goals, plans, and intentions related to the regulation of trademarks, including the legal frameworks and policies that support their execution.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9IU.label: Tax Tier Maximum
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9IU.definition: The Tax Tier Maximum is a specific detail within the broader concept of Tax Tier Detail, which sets the maximum amount of tax that can be charged for legal services provided under a particular engagement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ic.label: Application
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ic.definition: In the context of litigation, an Application refers to a formal request or motion submitted to a court or judicial body, seeking a specific order, relief, or direction as part of legal proceedings. This procedural instrument is fundamental in advocating for a party's interests, setting the stage for judicial review and decision-making.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Id.label: Evidentiary Objection
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Id.definition: An evidentiary objection is a formal protest raised by a party in a legal proceeding, challenging the admissibility of specific evidence. Common grounds for such objections include lack of foundation, hearsay, irrelevance, and prejudicial nature.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9If.label: Trade Association
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9If.definition: A trade association is an organization founded and funded by businesses that operate in a specific industry. These associations advocate for the interests of their members, provide industry standards, and offer networking opportunities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ih.label: Credit Risk
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ih.definition: The risk that a borrower will not repay a loan or that a counterparty will not meet its financial obligations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ii.label: Bankruptcy Motions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ii.definition: Bankruptcy Motions are written requests made by parties in a bankruptcy case to the court for various purposes, such as to approve a plan, extend time, pay debts, or dismiss a case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ij.label: Florida County Court - Hardee County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ij.definition: A court located in Hardee County, Florida that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ik.label: Novelty
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ik.definition: Novelty in legal terms signifies that an invention must be new or original, not previously known or used, to be patentable. It ensures that patents are granted only for genuinely new advancements, not for modifications of existing ones.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Il.label: Infliction of Emotional Distress
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Il.definition: Infliction of Emotional Distress refers to the intentional or negligent act of causing severe emotional distress to another person, resulting in mental anguish, suffering, or trauma. It is a type of personal injury claim that can arise from intentional or unintentional actions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Io.label: Export Controls Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Io.definition: Export Controls Practice involves the legal frameworks and regulations governing the export of goods, services, and technology from a country. This practice area includes compliance with export control laws, export licensing, restrictions on certain goods and technologies, and enforcement of export regulations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Iq.label: 463 Alien Detainee (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Iq.definition: Immigration habeas petition under 28 U.S.C. § 2241. All cases filed with this nature of suit code are restricted to case participants and public terminals. Petition is filed by an alien detainee.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ir.label: Breach of Confidence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ir.definition: A breach of confidence has occurred if the defendant discloses or uses a novel idea that the plaintiff previously disclosed to the defendant in confidence and that the defendant voluntarily received.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9It.label: Georgia Superior Court - Webster County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9It.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Webster County refers to a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Webster County, Georgia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Iz.label: vendor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Iz.definition: "Used to name a vendor the data is associated with, e.g. ""E-Billing Vendor"" or ""Realestate.com"" "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9J3.label: Survival Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9J3.definition: A Survival Claim is a legal claim made on behalf of a deceased person's estate for damages or losses that the person suffered before their death and that survived them.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9J5.label: Equity Compensation Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9J5.definition: An Equity Compensation Clause is a provision in a contract that grants ownership in a company to an individual as a form of payment or incentive, typically in the form of stock options or restricted stock units.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9JB.label: Libel
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9JB.definition: A false and malicious statement that is published or communicated to a third party, which harms the reputation of an individual or entity.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9JD.label: matter_disc_cred segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9JD.definition: The "matter_disc_cred segment" is a component of the LEDES XML E-Billing Ver. 2.2 standard that includes information related to discounts or credits applied to a matter, such as the type, amount, and category of the discount or credit.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9JH.label: Mari
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9JH.definition: Mari is a written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a specific language within the context of legal matters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9JH.label: Affidavit / Declaration Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9JH.definition: Affidavit/Declaration Practice refers to the legal work involved in preparing and submitting written statements made under oath or affirmation, typically used as evidence in a legal proceeding, and is a subcategory of Litigation Practice.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9JI.label: Representations and Warranties Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9JI.definition: A Representations and Warranties Clause is a contractual provision in which one party makes certain statements about the subject matter of the contract, and warrants that those statements are true and accurate, thereby providing assurance to the other party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9JJ.label: Vehicle Equipment Violation Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9JJ.definition: A Vehicle Equipment Violation Claim involves allegations that a vehicle's equipment does not meet the regulatory standards required by law, which may include issues with lighting, brakes, tires, or emissions controls. These claims are crucial for ensuring road safety and environmental compliance, and they can result in mandatory repairs, fines, or other enforcement actions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9JM.label: Severability Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9JM.definition: A severability clause is a provision in a contract that states that if any part of the contract is found to be invalid or unenforceable, the rest of the contract will remain in effect.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9JP.label: Common-Law Sodomy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9JP.definition: The act of engaging in non-procreative sexual intercourse between persons of the same sex, which is prohibited by common law.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9JR.label: tax_invoice_cl_name
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9JR.definition: "The name of the party paying VAT on the invoice. The legal name of the party paying VAT on the invoice may be different from the value required by the receiving system in the CLIENT.cl_name field. In some jurisdictions it may be required by law to provide this information. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9JS.label: Stipulation to Reject
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9JS.definition: A Stipulation to Reject is a legal agreement between parties in which they agree to reject or disallow certain evidence or arguments in a case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9JY.label: Motion to Proceed in Forma Pauperis
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9JY.definition: A Motion to Proceed in Forma Pauperis is a legal request made by an individual who is unable to afford the fees associated with a court case, asking the court to waive or defer those fees.
english_labels: Motion to Proceed in Forma Pauperis

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9JZ.label: Maritime Lien
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9JZ.definition: A maritime lien is a type of lien that gives a creditor the right to seize a vessel as collateral for unpaid debts related to the vessel's operation or maintenance.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ja.label: Income Tax Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ja.definition: Income tax practice refers to the area of law where lawyers assist clients in matters related to personal or corporate income tax, including compliance, filing, and dispute resolution with tax authorities. Lawyers in this field often advise on effective tax planning strategies to minimize liability while adhering to applicable laws and regulations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Jc.label: Child Support
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Jc.definition: Child support is a legal obligation for a parent to provide financial assistance to their child, typically paid by the non-custodial parent to the custodial parent.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Jh.label: 835 Patent – Abbreviated New Drug Application (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Jh.definition: Action filed in support or to dispute a patent claim involving an Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA). These cases are also known as “Hatch-Waxman” cases.
english_labels: 835 Patent – Abbreviated New Drug Application (PACER NoS)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Jh.label: Georgia Superior Court - Quitman County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Jh.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Quitman County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Jh.label: Georgia Superior Court - Upson County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Jh.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Upson County refers to a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Upson County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Jj.label: Accountability Principle
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Jj.definition: Accountability is the privacy principle that a data controller should be accountable for complying with measures which give effect to the principles stated above.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Jk.label: Corporate and Partnership Liability Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Jk.definition: Corporate and Partnership Liability Claims refer to legal claims made against corporations or partnerships for their actions or inactions that result in harm or injury to others, including claims related to breach of fiduciary duty, wrongful interference, debt liability, freeze-out of minority shareholders, and piercing the corporate veil.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Jk.label: Liquidation Bankruptcy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Jk.definition: This is a type of bankruptcy where an individual's or company's assets are sold to pay off creditors. The debtor is typically absolved of further responsibility for the debts once the assets are liquidated, and the proceeds are distributed amongst the creditors.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Jr.label: Invoice End Date
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Jr.definition: The "Invoice End Date" is a specific detail within the broader category of "Fee Invoice Detail" and refers to the date on which an invoice for legal services is due to be paid.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Js.label: City Council
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Js.definition: A City Council is the legislative body of a municipal government, typically composed of elected officials representing various districts or the city at large. This governing body is responsible for enacting local ordinances, approving budgets, and setting policies that directly affect the day-to-day operations and long-term development of a city or town.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Jt.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Los Alamos County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Jt.definition: A court located in Los Alamos County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases.
english_labels: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Los Alamos County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Jt.label: Missouri Circuit Court - St. Francois County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Jt.definition: A Missouri Circuit Court - St. Francois County is a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in St. Francois County, Missouri.
english_labels: Missouri Circuit Court - St. Francois County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Jv.label: Alternative Legal Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Jv.definition: Alternative Legal Services refers to non-traditional legal services that are provided by entities other than law firms, such as managed services, eDiscovery services, and contracting management services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Jw.label: Minnesota District Court - Cook County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Jw.definition: Minnesota District Court - Cook County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Cook County, Minnesota.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9K0.label: Refugee Parole Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9K0.definition: In immigration law, refugee parole refers to the temporary admission of a foreign national into a country for humanitarian reasons, urgent medical treatment, or other special circumstances, without formally admitting them as permanent residents.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9K2.label: Georgia District Court - Habersham County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9K2.definition: A court located in Habersham County, Georgia that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9K9.label: Limited Partner
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9K9.definition: A limited partner is a part-owner of a company whose liability for the firm's debts cannot exceed the amount that individual invested in the company. Limited partners are often called silent partners.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9KA.label: Remand Stipulation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9KA.definition: A Remand Stipulation is a legal agreement between parties in an appellate case that outlines the terms and conditions for the case to be sent back to the lower court for further proceedings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9KB.label: Indiana Superior Court - DeKalb County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9KB.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that hears civil and criminal cases within DeKalb County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9KC.label: Weapon, Gun, and Firearms Crimes
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9KC.definition: The violation of laws or ordinances prohibiting the manufacture, sale, purchase, transportation, possession, concealment, or use of firearms, cutting instruments, explosives, incendiary devices, or other deadly weapons.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9KE.label: Signatory
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9KE.definition: A signatory is an individual or entity that has the authority to sign a legal document, such as a contract or agreement, thereby committing to its terms. The act of signing typically signifies consent, approval, or acceptance of the document's conditions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9KK.label: Sino-Tibetan languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9KK.definition: A group of languages spoken in East Asia, including Mandarin, Cantonese, and Tibetan, among others.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9KN.label: Elevator Liability
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9KN.definition: A legal claim for damages resulting from injuries or harm suffered by individuals while using elevators or escalators.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9KP.label: DUPE Report
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9KP.definition: A DUPE Report (Document) is a type of document that is no longer in use and is associated with DEPRECATED NODES.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9KR.label: Common-Law Rape
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9KR.definition: Common-Law Rape is a type of rape that is defined by the common law legal system, which includes elements such as lack of consent and use of force or threat of force.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ka.label: "Actual Knowledge" Language
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ka.definition: "Actual Knowledge" Language refers to a clause in a contract that outlines the specific circumstances under which a party can terminate the agreement if there is a significant negative impact on the financial condition or operations of the other party, and the party seeking to terminate has actual knowledge of such impact.
english_labels: Material Adverse Effect Definition - "Actual Knowledge" Language

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Kc.label: Criminal Harassment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Kc.definition: Criminal Harassment is a type of crime against individuals that involves intentionally and persistently causing fear, alarm, or distress to another person through various forms of behavior, such as stalking, cyberbullying, or making terroristic threats.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Kc.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Erie County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Kc.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Erie County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering civil and criminal proceedings at the county level in Pennsylvania.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Erie County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Kd.label: Indiana Superior Court - Kosciusko County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Kd.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that has the power to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within Kosciusko County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Kd.label: Asset Enhanced Voting Right
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Kd.definition: An Asset Enhanced Voting Right grants a shareholder more than one vote per share, giving them greater influence in the decision-making process of a company or organization. This attribute often serves to concentrate voting power and control within a select group of shareholders, typically founders or major stakeholders.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Kf.label: Confidential Matter Narrative
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Kf.definition: A confidential version of a matter narrative.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ki.label: Application for Compensation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ki.definition: An Application for Compensation is a formal request made by a professional, such as a bankruptcy trustee or attorney, to be reimbursed for their services and expenses related to a bankruptcy case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Kn.label: Criminal Contempt
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Kn.definition: Criminal Contempt refers to the intentional disobedience or disregard of a court order or judgment, which is punishable by fines or imprisonment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Kr.label: Michigan District Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Kr.definition: The Michigan District Court is a court of limited jurisdiction in the state of Michigan that handles civil and criminal cases within its designated geographic area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Kv.label: Fundraising
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Kv.definition: Fundraising refers to the process of gathering monetary contributions from individuals, businesses, charitable foundations, or governmental agencies. It is often undertaken by non-profit organizations, political campaigns, startup companies, or for specific causes or projects.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Kv.label: Trust
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Kv.definition: A trust, in estate planning, is a legal entity that holds and manages assets for the benefit of specific individuals or entities, known as beneficiaries. It's established by a grantor (or settlor) and is overseen by a trustee who ensures the assets are managed and distributed according to the grantor's instructions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9L2.label: Computer and Electronic Product Manufacturing Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9L2.definition: Industries in the Computer and Electronic Product Manufacturing subsector group establishments that manufacture computers, computer peripherals, communications equipment, and similar electronic products, and establishments that manufacture components for such products. The Computer and Electronic Product Manufacturing industries are combined in the hierarchy of NAICS because of their economic significance to the economies of all three North American countries. For industries in this subsector, the manufacturing processes are fundamentally different from the manufacturing processes of other machinery and equipment. The design and use of integrated circuits and the application of highly specialized miniaturization technologies are common elements in the production technologies of the Computer and Electronic Product Manufacturing subsector.
english_labels: Computer and Electronic Product Manufacturing Industry

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9L4.label: Specific Goods and Services Tax Payment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9L4.definition: Specific Goods and Services Tax Payment includes excises, profits generated and transferred from fiscal monopolies, customs and import duties, as well as taxes on exports, foreign exchange transactions, investment goods, betting stakes, and special taxes on services. These taxes do not form part of a general consumption tax but are instead targeted at specific goods and services.
english_labels: Specific Goods and Services Tax Payment
Taxes on specific goods and services

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9L7.label: Florida County Court - Jefferson County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9L7.definition: A court located in Jefferson County, Florida that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9L7.label: Motion to File Supplemental Brief
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9L7.definition: A Motion to File Supplemental Brief is a formal request made to a court or tribunal seeking permission to submit additional written arguments or evidence beyond what was originally allowed in a case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9L7.label: Election Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9L7.definition: Election Claims refer to allegations or assertions made regarding the integrity, conduct, or results of an electoral process. These claims can include accusations of voter fraud, election interference, vote suppression, or procedural errors and are often investigated to ensure the fairness and legitimacy of the election.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9L8.label: Synchronous Broadcast Transmission
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9L8.definition: A Synchronous Broadcast Transmission, also known as "Live" transmission, is the real-time dissemination of audio and/or video content to an audience as the events occur. This form of broadcasting includes live TV and radio, providing immediate coverage of events, news, sports, and other live performances.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9L9.label: Data Augmentation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9L9.definition: Data Augmentation is a technique used to enhance the size and quality of a training dataset by applying various transformations and alterations to existing data. This process helps in creating diverse training examples, which improves the robustness and performance of machine learning models.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9LA.label: Bylaws
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9LA.definition: Bylaws are internal regulations adopted by an organization to manage its operations and procedures. They detail roles of officers, meeting protocols, and other organizational rules.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9LB.label: Esophagus or Stomach Cancer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9LB.definition: Esophagus or stomach cancer refers to malignant tumors that originate in the esophagus or stomach, significantly impacting the digestive system. These cancers can affect swallowing, digestion, and nutrient absorption, often requiring a combination of treatments such as surgery, chemotherapy, and radiation therapy.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9LF.label: E110 Out-of-town travel
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9LF.definition: Expenses incurred for travel outside of the employee's usual work location.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9LJ.label: Horses
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9LJ.definition: Horses are large domesticated mammals belonging to the species Equus ferus caballus, known for their strength, speed, and endurance. They have been utilized by humans for transportation, labor, recreation, and competitive sports, and come in a variety of breeds adapted for specific purposes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9LL.label: Indiana Town Court - Lake County, Merrillville Town
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9LL.definition: A court located in Merrillville Town, Lake County, Indiana that has limited jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and small claims cases within its geographical area.
english_labels: Indiana Town Court - Lake County, Merrillville Town

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9LQ.label: Contact First Name
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9LQ.definition: Contact First Name refers to the given name of an individual in a contact list, which is a subset of Contact Information in the context of Engagement Terms.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9LV.label: Statutory and Regulatory Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9LV.definition: Statutory and Regulatory Claims are legal claims that arise from violations of specific laws or regulations, such as the False Claims Act or the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9LW.label: Navy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9LW.definition: A Navy is the maritime branch of a nation's armed forces, responsible for naval warfare, sea control, and projection of power across bodies of water. This military organization operates various types of warships, submarines, and aircraft to defend a nation's territorial waters, protect maritime interests, and conduct operations at sea.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9LZ.label: Passport Issued Date
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9LZ.definition: Passport Issued Date refers to the specific day, month, and year on which an individual's passport was issued by the relevant government authority. This information is recorded in the passport and is used for identification and verification purposes during travel and various legal processes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ld.label: Osage
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ld.definition: Osage (Language) is a specific written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, belonging to the Language top-level class, and used in legal matters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ld.label: Fishing, Hunting and Trapping Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ld.definition: Industries in this group harvest fish and other wild animals from their natural habitats and are dependent upon a continued supply of the natural resource.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Le.label: Employment Authorization Document Application
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Le.definition: The Employment Authorization Document (EAD) application, commonly known as Form I-765 in the United States, is used by certain non-immigrants, refugees, and asylees who are eligible to work legally in the U.S. The EAD, also referred to as a work permit, allows individuals to engage in employment during their authorized stay in the U.S. This application typically requires the submission of necessary documentation, appropriate fees, and proof of eligibility. Once approved, the applicant receives an EAD card that authorizes them to work for a specified period

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Lg.label: Bear River Band of Rohnerville Rancheria
english_labels: Bear River Band of Rohnerville Rancheria

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Li.label: Motion to Stay Temporary Restraining Order
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Li.definition: A Motion to Stay Temporary Restraining Order is a request made to a court to temporarily suspend or delay the enforcement of a previously issued restraining order.
english_labels: Motion to Stay Temporary Restraining Order

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Lp.label: Applied AI Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Lp.definition: Applied AI Services refers to the provision of consulting and management services that utilize artificial intelligence technology to solve practical problems and improve business operations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Lq.label: Indiana Superior Court - Orange County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Lq.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that hears civil and criminal cases within Orange County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Lr.label: Separation and Distribution Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Lr.definition: A Separation and Distribution Agreement outlines the terms under which a parent company will spin off, or separate, one of its businesses into an independent entity. It defines the assets, liabilities, and equity that will be transferred to the new entity and the manner of distribution.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ls.label: Motion for Judge Recusal
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ls.definition: A Motion for Judge Recusal, also known as a Motion to Reassign, is a legal document filed by a party in a case requesting that the presiding judge be removed from the case due to a conflict of interest or bias.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Lu.label: Mutual Nondisparagement Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Lu.definition: A mutual nondisparagement clause is a provision in a contract that prohibits both parties from making negative or derogatory statements about each other.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9M1.label: New York Court of Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9M1.definition: The New York Court of Claims is a specialized court within the New York State Courts system that has jurisdiction over claims against the state, including personal injury and property damage cases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9M2.label: Real Estate Developer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9M2.definition: A Real Estate Developer is a professional or company that acquires land, finances real estate deals, builds or renovates properties, and arranges for their sale or lease. This role involves various stages of development, including market research, site selection, obtaining permits, and managing construction projects.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9M8.label: Arkansas District Court - Prairie Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9M8.definition: A court located in Prairie County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9M9.label: Chronic Kidney Disease
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9M9.definition: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) is a progressive condition characterized by the gradual loss of kidney function over time. This decline can lead to kidney failure, requiring treatments such as dialysis or kidney transplantation to manage the condition.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9M9.label: 190 Other Contract (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9M9.definition: Action primarily based on rights and obligations under a contract not classifiable elsewhere under the specific natures of suit under “Contract.”

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9MA.label: New Mexico Metropolitan Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9MA.definition: The New Mexico Metropolitan Court is a court of limited jurisdiction within the New Mexico State Courts system, located in Bernalillo County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9MD.label: Records Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9MD.definition: The concept of Records Management refers to the systematic and efficient control of an organization's records, including their creation, maintenance, use, and disposition, in order to meet legal, regulatory, and business requirements.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9MI.label: Motion for Abstention
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9MI.definition: A Motion for Abstention is a request made in a bankruptcy case asking the court to abstain or refrain from hearing the case, usually because it would be more appropriate for another court to handle it.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ML.label: Legal Project Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ML.definition: Legal Project Management refers to the process of planning, organizing, and managing legal projects, including tasks such as budgeting, resource allocation, and risk management, with the goal of achieving successful outcomes within the constraints of time, cost, and quality.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9MM.label: Mentoring
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9MM.definition: Mentoring refers to the process of providing guidance and support to an individual who has been subject to criminal disposition conditions, with the aim of helping them successfully reintegrate into society.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9MN.label: Resolutions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9MN.definition: Resolutions are formal decisions or actions adopted by an organization's governing body, usually ratified through a voting process. They serve to document and implement specific actions, policies, or organizational changes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9MP.label: Bank Mishandling Funds Transfer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9MP.definition: Bank Mishandling Funds Transfer refers to a legal claim made by a creditor against a bank for improperly handling the transfer of funds, which may involve commercial paper and banking regulations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9MU.label: Motion to Dismiss Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9MU.definition: A Motion to Dismiss Claim is a formal request made by a party in a legal case to have a claim against them dismissed by the court.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9MV.label: No-Shop Covenant
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9MV.definition: A No-Shop Covenant is a provision in a business deal that restricts one party from seeking other offers or engaging in negotiations with other potential buyers, in order to protect the interests of the other party involved in the deal.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9MZ.label: A.A.S. (Associate of Applied Science)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9MZ.definition: An A.A.S. (Associate of Applied Science) is a two-year degree emphasizing practical skills and vocational training, awarded by community colleges and technical institutions. It signifies proficiency in a specific field and prepares individuals for direct entry into the workforce.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Md.label: Texas District Court - Hood County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Md.definition: Texas District Court - Hood County: A court of law in the state of Texas with jurisdiction over legal matters within Hood County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Mf.label: Filer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Mf.definition: A Filer is a person or entity who submits a legal document to a court or other authority for consideration or action.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Mg.label: Court Forum Level
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Mg.definition: Court Forum Level refers to a specific level within the Court Forum hierarchy, which includes Trial Court Forum and Appellate Court Forum.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Mk.label: Intervenor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Mk.definition: A person who intervenes or seeks to intervene in a civil action.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Mm.label: Small Claims / Conciliation Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Mm.definition: A Small Claims/Conciliation Court is a specific type of court forum that has jurisdiction over disputes involving small amounts of money or property and aims to resolve them through conciliation rather than traditional litigation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Mp.label: Unlawful Picketing Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Mp.definition: An unlawful picketing claim is a legal action initiated by an employer, individual, or entity alleging that a labor union or group of employees has engaged in picketing activities that violate the law or infringe upon their rights. Picketing typically involves organized protests by workers outside a workplace to express grievances, support labor disputes, or raise awareness about certain issues. While picketing is generally protected under the National Labor Relations Act (NLRA) and the First Amendment, it may be deemed unlawful if it involves activities such as violence, threats, intimidation, mass picketing that obstructs access to a business, or secondary picketing targeting neutral parties not involved in the labor dispute. An unlawful picketing claim may be filed with the National Labor Relations Board (NLRB) or pursued through the court system.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Mw.label: Islamic Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Mw.definition: Sharia Law is an Islamic legal system based on the Quran and the teachings and practices of the Prophet Muhammad, governing aspects of both personal and communal life.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Mx.label: Tereno
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Mx.definition: A Tereno language is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is spoken by the Terena people in Brazil.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Mz.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Snyder County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Mz.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Snyder County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings at the county level in Pennsylvania.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Snyder County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Mz.label: Minnesota District Court - Sherburne County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Mz.definition: Minnesota District Court - Sherburne County: A court of law in Minnesota that has jurisdiction over legal cases and disputes specifically within Sherburne County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Mz.label: X134 Arbitrators/Mediators
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Mz.definition: Any Arbitrator/Mediator fees and any fees associated with the Arbitration/Mediation process

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9N6.label: Secondment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9N6.definition: Secondment refers to an arrangement where an employee is temporarily assigned to work for another organization or department, while still remaining an employee of their original employer, as part of an engagement for providing legal services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9NA.label: Forum Selection Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9NA.definition: A forum selection clause is a contractual provision that designates a specific jurisdiction or court where any disputes arising from the contract will be resolved.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9NB.label: Celtic languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9NB.definition: A group of languages spoken in parts of Europe, including Ireland, Scotland, and Wales, that share a common linguistic and cultural heritage.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9NI.label: Montenegrin
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9NI.definition: Montenegrin is a written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a specific language within the context of legal matters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9NQ.label: Immigration Sponsor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9NQ.definition: An immigration sponsor is a citizen or lawful permanent resident of a destination country (e.g., United States) who takes legal responsibility for supporting a foreign national seeking to enter or remain in the destination country (e.g., U.S.). The sponsor usually submits an affidavit of support, which is a legally enforceable contract stating that they will financially support the immigrant to ensure they do not become a public charge.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9NT.label: Transit Visa to the United Nations
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9NT.definition: A Transit Visa to the United Nations is a specialized type of transit visa issued to individuals who need to pass through the United States en route to the United Nations headquarters in New York City for official UN business. This visa allows the holder to enter and transit through the U.S. solely for the purpose of conducting activities related to the United Nations and is generally valid for a limited period.
english_labels: Transit Visa to the United Nations

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9NT.label: L110 Fact Investigation/Development
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9NT.definition: The concept of L110 Fact Investigation/Development refers to the process of gathering and developing factual information relevant to a legal case, which is a part of the broader process of assessing, developing, and administering a case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ni.label: Karachay-Balkar
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ni.definition: Karachay-Balkar is a language that belongs to the Language top-level class and is spoken by the Karachay-Balkar people in the North Caucasus region of Russia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ni.label: Assisting or Encouraging
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ni.definition: Assisting or Encouraging refers to the act of aiding or abetting someone in the commission of a crime or wrongdoing.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9No.label: Merger Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9No.definition: A Merger Agreement is a legal document that outlines the terms and conditions of the merger between two or more companies.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Nw.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Caldwell County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Nw.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Caldwell County: A court of law in Missouri that has jurisdiction over legal cases and disputes specifically within Caldwell County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Nx.label: Kazakh
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Nx.definition: A language spoken in Kazakhstan and some neighboring countries, belonging to the Turkic language family.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ny.label: Adverse Possession of Property
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ny.definition: The concept of Adverse Possession of Property refers to a legal defense used in civil litigation cases involving property disputes, where a person claims ownership of a property by occupying it continuously and openly for a certain period of time, without the permission of the legal owner.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Nz.label: Breach of Agreement Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Nz.definition: A Breach of Agreement Clause is a specific type of contractual clause that outlines the consequences and remedies in the event that one party fails to fulfill their obligations as outlined in the agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9O1.label: Segregation Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9O1.definition: A segregation claim is a legal assertion that a person or group has been subjected to discrimination or unequal treatment based on race, ethnicity, or other protected characteristics, leading to their separation or isolation from others. Such claims are often made in the context of civil rights litigation to challenge practices or policies that perpetuate segregation and unequal access to opportunities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9O1.label: Quality Assurance Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9O1.definition: A Quality Assurance Clause is a provision in a contract that ensures that the goods or services provided meet certain standards and specifications.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9O3.label: Zhuang; Chuang
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9O3.definition: A language spoken by the Zhuang people, primarily in the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region of southern China.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9O8.label: Litigation Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9O8.definition: Litigation Management involves the management of various aspects of a legal case, including but not limited to, retention and litigation hold management, redaction management, expert witness management, brief analysis management, jury selection management, citation check management, remote trial management, eDiscovery services, exhibit management, and costs and settlement management.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9OC.label: Georgia District Court - Richmond County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9OC.definition: Georgia District Court - Richmond County is a specific court within the Georgia District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Richmond County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9OD.label: Immigration Regulatory Objectives
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9OD.definition: Immigration Regulatory Objectives: The specific aims, goals, plans, and intentions related to the regulation of immigration, including the legal frameworks and policies.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9OF.label: Motion in Limine to Exclude Witness
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9OF.definition: A Motion in Limine to Exclude Witness is a pretrial motion requesting the court to prohibit a specific witness from testifying or presenting evidence at trial.
english_labels: Motion in Limine to Exclude Witness

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9OI.label: Outside Counsel Guidelines
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9OI.definition: Outside Counsel Guidelines are a set of expectations set by a company or organization for the external law firms or attorneys it hires, detailing billing, communication, conflicts of interest, confidentiality, and other work-related parameters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9OJ.label: Adult Entertainer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9OJ.definition: An adult entertainer is an individual who performs in sexually-oriented shows or activities, often for an audience at specialized venues like strip clubs. The legal regulations governing adult entertainers vary by jurisdiction but commonly include age restrictions, licensing requirements, and zoning laws for the venues where they perform.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9OP.label: Swati
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9OP.definition: Swati is a written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a member of the language family.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9OQ.label: 560 Civil Detainee - Conditions of Confinement (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9OQ.definition: Action by former prisoner who was involuntarily committed to a non criminal facility after expiration of his or her prison term alleging unlawful conditions of confinement while in the non-criminal facility. This category includes, for example, an action by a former prisoner classified as a Sexually Dangerous Person or Sexually Violent Predator alleging civil rights violations during his detention in a medical facility. (Excludes actions by alien detainees)
english_labels: 560 Civil Detainee - Conditions of Confinement (PACER NoS)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9OQ.label: Friendly Co-Party
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9OQ.definition: A co-party in a legal or transactional matter whose interests and actions align with those of a specific client, even though they may be formally independent. Friendly co-parties generally cooperate and collaborate to achieve shared or mutually supportive outcomes within the matter.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9OV.label: Real Estate Documents
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9OV.definition: Real Estate Documents are written or recorded representations of property ownership, transfer, or use, including but not limited to deeds, mortgages, and leases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9OV.label: Motion for New Trial - Improper Jury Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9OV.definition: A Motion for New Trial - Improper Jury Practice is a request made by a party to a lawsuit asking the court to set aside the verdict due to misconduct or improper behavior by the jury during the trial.
english_labels: Motion for New Trial - Improper Jury Practice

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9OV.label: Security Deposit
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9OV.definition: A security deposit is a sum of money held by a landlord or lessor as collateral to cover potential damages or unpaid rent by a tenant or lessee. It is typically refundable if the terms of the lease are met and no damages occur.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9OV.label: Jewish Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9OV.definition: Jewish Law, often referred to as Halakha, is the collective body of Jewish religious laws derived from the Torah and developed through centuries of rabbinical interpretation and tradition.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9OY.label: Voting Rights
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9OY.definition: Voting rights refer to the legal entitlement that enables eligible citizens to participate in the electoral process to choose their representatives in government. These rights are commonly protected by national constitutions and international treaties like the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, and may include provisions to prevent discrimination based on race, gender, or other factors.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Of.label: Endocrinology Malpractice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Of.definition: Endocrinology Malpractice refers to a type of medical malpractice claim that arises from the failure of an endocrinologist to provide appropriate care or treatment to a patient, resulting in harm or injury.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Oh.label: Dismissal Without Prejudice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Oh.definition: Dismissal Without Prejudice: A court order dismissing a case that does not prevent the plaintiff from bringing the same case again in the future.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ot.label: Unit per Hour
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ot.definition: A "Unit per Hour" is a type of unit used to measure the cost of legal services, where the fee is based on the amount of time spent providing the service.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ov.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - McKean County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ov.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in McKean County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - McKean County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Oz.label: Lender
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Oz.definition: A person or institution who lends money.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9P1.label: Risk of Regulatory Change
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9P1.definition: Risk of Regulatory Change refers to the potential for negative consequences arising from changes in laws, regulations, or industry standards that may affect an organization's operations, products, or services. These risks can stem from various sources, such as shifts in political or economic priorities, emerging technologies, or public pressure for increased transparency and accountability, potentially leading to compliance challenges, increased costs, or reduced market opportunities, ultimately impacting the organization's overall performance and sustainability.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9P6.label: Insider
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9P6.definition: A statutorily created role, where that Insider (e.g., C-suite executive, activist shareholder) can influence the Debtor. Relevant Statute: 11 USC 101(31).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9P9.label: Florida Circuit Court - Glades County - 20th Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9P9.definition: A court located in Glades County, Florida that is part of the larger Florida Circuit Court system.
english_labels: Florida Circuit Court - Glades County - 20th Circuit Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9PC.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Montour County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9PC.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Montour County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Montour County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9PF.label: M&A K Deal Management Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9PF.definition: A specialized area within the M&A Practice Components that focuses on the management of K (knowledge) deals.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9PH.label: JC30 Pre-action protocol work (UK J-CODE)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9PH.definition: Communications at an initial stage in compliance with pre-action protocol including letters before action and responses.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9PL.label: CRM Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9PL.definition: CRM Management refers to the process of managing customer relationships and interactions with a law firm, including the use of technology and data analysis to improve client satisfaction and retention.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9PN.label: L220 Preliminary Injunctions/Provisional Remedies
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9PN.definition: A preliminary injunction is a temporary court order that prohibits a party from taking certain actions until a final decision is made in a legal case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9PQ.label: Time
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9PQ.definition: Time refers to the measurement of duration or the sequence of events in a particular order.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9PT.label: Boat
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9PT.definition: A Boat is a small to medium-sized watercraft designed for travel on water, commonly used for personal recreation, fishing, or short-distance transportation. Boats vary in size and type, including motorboats, sailboats, and rowboats, each serving specific purposes and environments.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9PY.label: Legal Rights
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9PY.definition: Legal rights are entitlements or privileges conferred by law that provide an individual or entity with certain freedoms, protections, or benefits. These rights can be civil, political, or social in nature and are enforceable by the judiciary, serving as the basis for legal claims or actions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Pd.label: Antitrust - Vertical Market Allocation Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Pd.definition: Antitrust - Vertical Market Allocation Claims refer to legal claims that allege an agreement between competitors to divide a market based on vertical lines, such as by customer type or geographic area, in violation of antitrust laws.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Pf.label: oasis:LegalRuleMLDocument
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Pf.definition: A LegalRuleMLDocument is a type of metadata that identifies an actor in the legal domain, specifically related to the OASIS LegalRuleML standard.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Pi.label: Cheyenne River Sioux Tribe of the Cheyenne River Reservation, South Dakota
english_labels: Cheyenne River Sioux Tribe of the Cheyenne River Reservation, South Dakota

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Pj.label: Oversight Board
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Pj.definition: An Oversight Board is a governing body within an organization specifically tasked with monitoring and ensuring compliance with standards, policies, and legal requirements. This board maintains accountability, reviews organizational practices, and provides independent assessments of organizational performance and adherence to rules and regulations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ps.label: Minnesota District Court - Yellow Medicine County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ps.definition: A Minnesota District Court located in Yellow Medicine County, which is responsible for hearing and deciding civil and criminal cases within its jurisdiction.
english_labels: Minnesota District Court - Yellow Medicine County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Pu.label: Negligent Misrepresentation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Pu.definition: Negligent Misrepresentation is a legal claim that arises when a party makes a false statement or omits important information, which they should have known was false or misleading, and that causes harm to another party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Pv.label: Probate Reason of Death/Incapacity/No longer Willing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Pv.definition: A legal reason for filing a subsequent probate, which includes the death, incapacity, or unwillingness of the original probate filer.
english_labels: Probate Reason of Death/Incapacity/No longer Willing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Pv.label: Felony Murder
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Pv.definition: Felony Murder is a type of murder where a death occurs during the commission of a felony, regardless of whether the death was intentional or not.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Pw.label: Exhibit Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Pw.definition: Exhibit Management refers to the process of organizing and presenting evidence in a legal case, including the collection, tracking, and presentation of physical and digital exhibits.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Px.label: Anesthesiology Malpractice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Px.definition: Anesthesiology Malpractice refers to a type of medical malpractice claim that arises from the administration of anesthesia during a medical procedure.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Py.label: Christian Religion
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Py.definition: The Christian Religion is a monotheistic faith centered around the teachings, life, death, and resurrection of Jesus Christ, as documented in the Bible. In legal contexts, it often relates to the protection of religious freedoms, the recognition of Christian holidays and symbols, and the accommodation of Christian practices in diverse societal settings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Q0.label: Food and Drug Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Q0.definition: Laws regulating food, drugs, and cosmetics.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Q4.label: Motion to File Nonstandard Brief
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Q4.definition: A Motion to File Nonstandard Brief is a formal request to submit a legal document that does not conform to the standard formatting requirements set forth by the court.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Q4.label: Fund Formation Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Q4.definition: Fund Formation (Service) refers to the legal work performed by a Legal Services Provider in the process of creating a new investment fund, including the drafting of necessary documents and compliance with regulatory requirements.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Q7.label: Quiet Enjoyment Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Q7.definition: A Quiet Enjoyment Clause is a provision in a contract that guarantees a tenant's right to use and enjoy the leased property without interference from the landlord or any third party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Q9.label: Broker
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Q9.definition: A broker is an individual or firm employed by others to plan and organize sales or negotiate contracts for a commission.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9QB.label: Head and Neck Soft Tissue Cancer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9QB.definition: Soft tissue cancer of the head and neck refers to malignant neoplastic diseases originating in the soft tissues, including muscles, fat, fibrous tissues, blood vessels, and other connective tissues of the head and neck. This category encompasses a variety of aggressive cancers that can impact critical functions such as breathing, swallowing, and speaking.
english_labels: Head and Neck Soft Tissue Cancer
Head and Neck Soft Tissue Sarcoma
Malignant Neoplasm of Soft Tissue in Head and Neck

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9QC.label: OASISThing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9QC.definition: OASISThing refers to a type of data structure used in LegalXML OASIS SCHEMA, which can have specific functions and roles within the schema.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9QD.label: New York Community Justice Center
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9QD.definition: A specialized court program in New York State that aims to reduce crime and improve public trust in the justice system, by providing community-based services and alternative sentencing options.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9QE.label: New York City Court - Hornell
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9QE.definition: A court located in Hornell, New York City that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9QN.label: Earned Income
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9QN.definition: Earned income refers to the money an individual receives from working, including wages, salaries, bonuses, and commissions. It excludes income from investments, gifts, or other non-work-related sources, and serves as a basis for calculating taxes and assessing eligibility for certain benefits or deductions

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9QQ.label: Competitor Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9QQ.definition: A Competitor Clause is a provision in a contract that restricts one party from engaging in business activities that compete with the other party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9QT.label: Overpayment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9QT.definition: An overpayment occurs when a payer disburses more money than is owed to a recipient, which can happen in various contexts such as payroll, social benefits, or vendor payments. This typically necessitates corrective actions, including repayment or adjustment, to rectify the excess amount disbursed.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9QU.label: Asset Exchange Attributes
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9QU.definition: Asset Exchange Attributes encompass various methods by which financial assets are traded or converted to achieve specific strategic objectives. These attributes involve transactions where assets like debt and equity are exchanged to improve financial structure, raise capital, or consolidate ownership.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9QV.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Lycoming County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9QV.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Lycoming County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in Lycoming County, Pennsylvania.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Lycoming County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Qc.label: Legal Operations
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Qc.definition: Legal Operations refers to the management of legal processes and resources within a legal department or organization, including matter management, project management, spend management, and other related activities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Qf.label: Littering
