https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Qf.definition: Littering is the act of improperly disposing of waste materials in public or private spaces, rather than in designated trash receptacles. This behavior results in environmental pollution, health hazards, and can lead to significant fines and penalties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Qk.label: Motion to Dismiss for Lack of Personal Jurisdiction
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Qk.definition: A Motion to Dismiss for Lack of Personal Jurisdiction is a legal request made by a defendant to dismiss a case on the grounds that the court does not have the authority to hear the case due to the defendant not having sufficient contacts with the jurisdiction.
english_labels: Motion to Dismiss for Lack of Personal Jurisdiction

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Qn.label: Yerington Paiute Tribe of the Yerington Colony and Campbell Ranch, Nevada
english_labels: Yerington Paiute Tribe of the Yerington Colony and Campbell Ranch, Nevada

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Qp.label: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Qp.definition: A Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Claim is a legal claim related to the privacy of personal health information and the rights of individuals to access and control their own health information under the HIPAA law.
english_labels: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act Claim

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Qr.label: Stock Options
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Qr.definition: Stock options are a benefit where employees are given the opportunity to purchase shares of the company's stock at a predetermined price, often serving as an incentive or bonus.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Qx.label: Pedestrian
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Qx.definition: A pedestrian refers to any person who is on foot, traveling on a surface intended for human passage. This includes individuals walking, running, hiking, or moving via other human-powered means on pathways, sidewalks, crosswalks, or similar public thoroughfares.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9R6.label: TIMEKEEPER_CLASSIFICATION
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9R6.definition: A classification system used in the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard for categorizing timekeepers based on their roles and responsibilities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9R6.label: Absence of Litigation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9R6.definition: The absence of litigation refers to the state of not having any ongoing legal disputes or lawsuits related to a particular matter, which is a condition that must be met in order to close a legal transaction or agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9R6.label: Suspect
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9R6.definition: A suspect is an individual believed to have committed a crime or offense, based on preliminary evidence, witness statements, or other indications. However, until proven guilty through due legal process, a suspect retains the presumption of innocence.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9RC.label: Analysis of Insurance Considerations
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9RC.definition: Analysis of Insurance Considerations refers to the process of evaluating the potential impact of insurance policies on a legal obligation, such as a contract or tort liability.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9RE.label: Exempted Company
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9RE.definition: A company that does not have to pay tax or act according to the usual regulations of the country in which it is established. Exempted companies fall on the tax laws of countries and territories including are the Cayman Islands, Bermuda, and Gibraltar.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9RF.label: Tennessee Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9RF.definition: The Tennessee Circuit Court is a court within the Tennessee State Courts system that has jurisdiction over certain civil and criminal cases within a specific geographic area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9RJ.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Marion Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9RJ.definition: A court located in Marion County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9RK.label: Legal Effect Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9RK.definition: A Legal Effect Clause is a clause within a contract that has the power to create legal obligations or rights for the parties involved.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9RO.label: Accessibility Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9RO.definition: A disability access claim, also known as an accessibility claim, is a legal action initiated by a person with a disability against a business or property owner for not complying with disability access laws. These laws require that public accommodations, such as stores, restaurants, and other businesses, be accessible to individuals with disabilities, and provide accommodations such as accessible parking, ramps, and signage. The claim typically arises when a business does not comply with applicable disability access laws, which can result in barriers to access for individuals with disabilities. Businesses can face liability for violating disability access laws, which can result in significant damages for the affected individual and required changes to make the premises accessible.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9RR.label: Musical Composition
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9RR.definition: A Musical Composition is a creation that combines melodies, harmonies, rhythms, and lyrics (if any) to form a complete musical piece intended for performance or recording. Unlike a sound recording, the musical composition is a song's underlying composition (e.g., notated melodies, harmonies, rhythms, lyrics).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9RR.label: Summary Judgment in Lieu of Complaint
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9RR.definition: A Summary Judgment in Lieu of Complaint is a legal procedure in which a plaintiff seeks a judgment without filing a formal complaint, typically used in cases involving banking, commercial paper, and creditor claims.
english_labels: Summary Judgment in Lieu of Complaint

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9RS.label: Asset Restricted Voting Right
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9RS.definition: An Asset Restricted Voting Right refers to a limited voting entitlement associated with certain classes of shares, where the shareholder may possess fewer voting rights compared to standard voting shares, often less than one vote per share. This attribute allows for differentiated control mechanisms within a company's equity structure, balancing economic interest with limited decision-making power.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9RV.label: Shareholders Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9RV.definition: A Shareholders Agreement is a contract among the shareholders of a company, defining their rights, obligations, and protections, as well as the management and operational procedures of the company.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9RW.label: Pricing Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9RW.definition: Pricing Management refers to the process of setting and adjusting the fees charged by a law firm for its services, and is a subcategory of the broader Business of Law concept.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ra.label: Kru languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ra.definition: The Kru languages are a group of languages that belong to the Language top-level class and are spoken by the Kru people in West Africa.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Rg.label: Compliance Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Rg.definition: Compliance Management refers to the process of ensuring that an organization adheres to all relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ri.label: Trade Creditors Committee
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ri.definition: A Trade Creditors Committee is formed primarily in bankruptcy proceedings to represent the interests of trade creditors, who are suppliers and vendors that have provided goods or services to the bankrupt entity on credit. This committee negotiates claims and settlements to ensure fair treatment and maximization of recoverable assets for its members during the reorganization or liquidation process.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Rm.label: Discharge for Cause Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Rm.definition: A Discharge for Cause Clause is a provision in a contract that allows one party to terminate the agreement if the other party breaches a material term or engages in specified misconduct.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ro.label: Discharge for Refusing to Commit Illegal Act
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ro.definition: An employee's termination from their job due to their refusal to engage in illegal activities requested by their employer.
english_labels: Discharge for Refusing to Commit Illegal Act

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ro.label: Exemplar Document
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ro.definition: Real-world example of a prior document, to be used as reference while drafting a new document.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Rx.label: Hosting Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Rx.definition: A Hosting Agreement is a legally binding contract between a host and a guest, outlining the terms and conditions of the hosting arrangement, such as payment, duration, and responsibilities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9S0.label: Sherwood Valley Rancheria of Pomo Indians of California
english_labels: Sherwood Valley Rancheria of Pomo Indians of California

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9S2.label: Analysis of Use of Cash
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9S2.definition: Analysis of Use of Cash: A detailed examination and evaluation of the way in which money is being utilized in a legal matter, including the identification of any potential issues or concerns.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9S4.label: Unfair Labor Practice Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9S4.definition: An Unfair Labor Practice Claim is a legal claim filed by an individual, union, or labor organization alleging that an employer or union has engaged in activities prohibited by labor laws, such as discriminating against employees for union activities or refusing to bargain in good faith.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9S9.label: Accord and Satisfaction Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9S9.definition: An Accord and Satisfaction Clause is a provision in a contract that allows parties to settle a dispute by agreeing to different terms than originally agreed upon.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9SA.label: Correctional Facility Official
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9SA.definition: A Prison Official is an individual responsible for the management, oversight, and operation of a correctional facility, ensuring security, order, and compliance with regulations. These officials oversee the staff, inmate population, and administrative functions, playing a critical role in maintaining the safety and rehabilitation efforts within the prison.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9SF.label: Language of Agreement Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9SF.definition: A Language of Agreement Clause is a specific provision within a contract that outlines the language that will be used to interpret and enforce the agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9SJ.label: inv_payment_terms
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9SJ.definition: "Discount applied to the invoice if it is paid within the stated number of days. ""10.00/30"" would indicate that the firm will accept a 10% discount of inv_total_net_due if paid within 30 days of the invoice_date. CAN NOT be used if any tax is charged against any matter/invoice that is part of this inv_id because there may be a legal requirement that the tax amount charged should not be modified. Law firm can not apply this reduction to the invoice because it is dependent on the payment turnaround by the client; represents an additional discount that must be applied by the client's accounts payable system or third party e-billing vendor if the payment terms are met. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9SS.label: Summer Associate
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9SS.definition: A Summer Associate is a law student working in a law firm over the summer, often to assess mutual fit between the student and the firm. The experience often culminates in the firm extending an offer for a permanent position upon the student's graduation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9SX.label: Georgia Superior Court - Dooly County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9SX.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Dooly County refers to a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Dooly County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9SY.label: Corporate Disclosure Statement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9SY.definition: A Corporate Disclosure Statement is a document filed by a corporation in a legal proceeding that provides information about the corporation's ownership, affiliates, and potential conflicts of interest.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Sc.label: Project Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Sc.definition: The concept of Project Management, within the context of Legal Operations and the Business of Law, involves the planning, organizing, and overseeing of legal projects to ensure successful completion within the given constraints of time, budget, and resources.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Sc.label: New Jersey Superior Court - Ocean County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Sc.definition: The New Jersey Superior Court - Ocean County is a trial court within the New Jersey court system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases in Ocean County.
english_labels: New Jersey Superior Court - Ocean County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Sg.label: Texas District Court - Cameron County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Sg.definition: Texas District Court - Cameron County: A court of law in the state of Texas that has jurisdiction over cases within Cameron County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Si.label: Report & Recommendation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Si.definition: A Report & Recommendation is a written document that provides an evaluation or analysis of a situation or issue, and suggests a course of action to be taken.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Sn.label: Winner-Take-All Electoral System
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Sn.definition: A winner-take-all electoral system is a voting method in which the candidate or party receiving the most votes wins all available seats or electoral votes, without any proportional distribution. This system is often used in single-member districts and can lead to a significant advantage for the majority party, potentially underrepresenting minority groups.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Sq.label: Attornment Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Sq.definition: An attornment clause is a provision in a contract that requires a tenant to recognize a new landlord as the rightful owner of the property.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Sq.label: Housing Discrimination
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Sq.definition: The unfair treatment of individuals or groups in the housing market based on their race, ethnicity, gender, religion, or other protected characteristics.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ss.label: Governmental Entity
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ss.definition: Any government or any governmental agency, semi-governmental or judicial entity or authority (including, without limitation, any stock exchange or any self-regulatory organization established under statute).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Sy.label: Smart Drafting Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Sy.definition: Smart Drafting Management is the process of efficiently creating and managing legal documents using advanced technology and tools, and is a subcategory of Document Management.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Sz.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Pike County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Sz.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Pike County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in Pike County, Pennsylvania.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Pike County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9T7.label: New York Supreme Court - Ontario County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9T7.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Ontario County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Ontario County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal disputes within its geographic jurisdiction.
english_labels: New York Supreme Court - Ontario County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9T8.label: Order on Alternative Dispute Resolution
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9T8.definition: An Order on Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) is a legal directive issued by a court or other authority that requires parties to attempt to resolve their dispute through methods such as mediation or arbitration, rather than through traditional litigation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9T8.label: Unlawful Assembly
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9T8.definition: An Unlawful Assembly is a criminal offense against the public, where a group of people gather with the intention of committing a crime or engaging in violent behavior.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9TB.label: Citation to Secondary Legal Authority
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9TB.definition: A document's citations to non-primary - secondary - legal authority (e.g., treatises, law journals, jury instructions).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9TC.label: Litigation Case - Short Name
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9TC.definition: A shortened name for a specific legal case that is currently in the process of being litigated.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9TD.label: WC310 Written Discovery
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9TD.definition: Preparing/Identifying, Reviewing response to written discovery, Preparing summary/analysis of written discovery

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9TD.label: Student Loan
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9TD.definition: A Student Loan, also known as an Educational Loan, is a type of loan designed to help students pay for post-secondary education and associated fees, such as tuition, books, and living expenses. These loans typically offer favorable terms such as lower interest rates and flexible repayment options to assist borrowers in managing educational costs.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9TD.label: Mississippi Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9TD.definition: The Mississippi Circuit Court is a court within the Mississippi State Courts system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases at the trial level.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9TO.label: Jury Trial
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9TO.definition: A jury trial, or trial by jury, is a lawful proceeding in which a jury makes a decision or findings of fact. It is distinguished from a bench trial in which a judge or panel of judges makes all decisions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9TV.label: Hindi
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9TV.definition: Hindi (Language) is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary used in legal matters, specifically referring to the language spoken in India and other parts of South Asia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ta.label: TR499 Other Trademark Prosecution - Domestic
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ta.definition: Use only for trademark prosecution activities for applications that are to be initially filed in the ("domestic") home country or region of the applicant, and that can not be included under a previous code, or as instructed by the client.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Tb.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Chariton County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Tb.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Chariton County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Chariton County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Tc.label: Georgia Superior Court - Barrow County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Tc.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Barrow County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Barrow County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Tf.label: Seller's Jurisdiction
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Tf.definition: Seller's jurisdiction refers to the legal and regulatory environment in which the seller of a business, asset, or security operates. This jurisdiction, typically defined by the country, state, or other governing body, establishes the laws, regulations, and rules that govern business transactions, tax implications, and other aspects related to the sale.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Th.label: Recoupment for Contract Breach Harming Outsider
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Th.definition: Recoupment for Contract Breach Harming Outsider: A legal claim for restitution or compensation sought by a third party who has suffered harm as a result of a breach of contract between two other parties.
english_labels: Recoupment for Contract Breach Harming Outsider

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Th.label: Offshore Wind Energy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Th.definition: Offshore Wind Energy refers to the generation of electricity from wind turbines located in bodies of water, usually on the continental shelf. This form of energy generation typically requires specific regulatory approvals due to its impact on marine environments and international waters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Tk.label: Name and Likeness Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Tk.definition: A Name and Likeness Clause is a provision in a contract that allows one party to use the name and image of another party for commercial purposes, subject to certain limitations and conditions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Tp.label: Maintenance Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Tp.definition: A Maintenance Agreement is a type of agreement that outlines the terms and conditions for the upkeep and repair of a particular item or property.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Tr.label: Factoring Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Tr.definition: A Factoring Agreement is a financial arrangement where a business sells its accounts receivable, or invoices, to a third-party factoring company at a discount. This agreement outlines the terms and conditions under which the factoring company will advance funds, collect payments, and charge fees, providing immediate liquidity to the original business.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ts.label: Nyoro
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ts.definition: Nyoro is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a language within the context of legal matters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ty.label: Bank
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ty.definition: A bank is a financial institution licensed to receive deposits, make loans, and provide various financial services such as wealth management, currency exchange, and safe deposit boxes. Banks play a crucial role in the economy by facilitating financial transactions, providing credit, and offering investment products.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ty.label: Substance Abuse Policy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ty.definition: A substance abuse policy is a formal document established by an organization to outline its stance on the use, possession, and distribution of drugs and alcohol in the workplace. It aims to ensure a safe and productive work environment by defining prohibited behaviors, setting forth procedures for testing and handling violations, and providing resources for prevention and treatment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9U7.label: Newspaper
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9U7.definition: A Newspaper is a periodical publication that provides news, information, and advertisements, typically printed on low-cost paper and distributed regularly, such as daily or weekly.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9UC.label: Organization of American States
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9UC.definition: OAS (Organization of American States): An international organization founded on 30 April 1948, for the purposes of regional solidarity and cooperation among its member states within the Americas.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9UI.label: Georgia Superior Court - Calhoun County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9UI.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Calhoun County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9UJ.label: Breach of Contract Containing Satisfaction Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9UJ.definition: A breach of contract containing satisfaction clause refers to a violation of a contractual agreement that includes a provision allowing the injured party to terminate the contract if they are not satisfied with the performance of the other party.
english_labels: Breach of Contract Containing Satisfaction Clause

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9UP.label: Expert Deposition Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9UP.definition: Expert Deposition Practice refers to the specialized legal practice of conducting and preparing expert witness depositions for use in legal proceedings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9UV.label: Rail Transportation Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9UV.definition: Industries in this group provide rail transportation of passengers and/or cargo using railroad rolling stock. The railroads in this subsector primarily either operate on networks, with physical facilities, labor force, and equipment spread over an extensive geographic area, or operate over a short distance on a local rail line.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9UX.label: Amendment Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9UX.definition: An Amendment Agreement is a legal document that modifies, adds to, or deletes specific terms and conditions of an existing contract. It must be agreed upon and signed by the same parties who executed the original agreement, ensuring that the changes are legally binding.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ua.label: Motion for Judgment of Acquittal
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ua.definition: A Motion for Judgment of Acquittal is a legal request made by the defense in a criminal trial, asking the judge to dismiss the charges against the defendant due to lack of evidence or legal basis.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ua.label: Affirmative Asylum
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ua.definition: Affirmative asylum is a form of asylum sought by individuals who are already in the destination country (e.g., United States) and have not been placed in removal proceedings. The applicant initiates this process by submitting an asylum application to destination country's agency (e.g., U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS)) rather than presenting their case before an immigration judge.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ub.label: Motion to Extend Time to File Agency Record
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ub.definition: A Motion to Extend Time to File Agency Record is a request made to an appellate court to allow additional time for a party to submit the necessary documents and evidence from an administrative agency in a legal case.
english_labels: Motion to Extend Time to File Agency Record

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Uc.label: 863 DIWC/DIWW (405(g)) (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Uc.definition: Action filed with regard to social security benefits provided to disabled individuals: worker or child, or widow

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Uc.label: Debt Instrument Attributes
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Uc.definition: Debt Instrument Attributes refer to specific characteristics and features that define various aspects of debt instruments, such as bonds, loans, and other forms of borrowing. These attributes include terms related to pricing, structure, and type of debt, which impact the instrument’s value, risk, and marketability.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ue.label: Michigan Circuit Court - Wayne Cty 3d Jud. Cir.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ue.definition: A court located in the third judicial circuit of Wayne County, Michigan, responsible for hearing civil and criminal cases within its jurisdiction.
english_labels: Michigan Circuit Court - Wayne Cty 3d Jud. Cir.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Uh.label: Just Compensation Clause Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Uh.definition: A Just Compensation Clause claim is a legal assertion related to the Fifth Amendment of the United States Constitution, which states that private property cannot be taken for public use without just compensation. If the government takes private property for public use and the property owner believes they have not received fair market value or other appropriate compensation, they may file a Just Compensation Clause claim to seek additional compensation or challenge the taking.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Uk.label: New York Court of Special Sessions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Uk.definition: The New York Court of Special Sessions is a court within the New York State Courts system that handles minor criminal cases and traffic violations.
english_labels: New York Court of Special Sessions

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Um.label: Zoning Document Amendments
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Um.definition: Zoning Document Amendments pertain to the formal changes made to official zoning documents such as zoning maps and zoning ordinance text. These amendments can be initiated by private individuals, developers, or government bodies and usually require a comprehensive legal and regulatory review process, often including public hearings and official approvals.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Un.label: Claimant
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Un.definition: A person who asserts a claim, particularly the right or title to property (e.g., a claimant to an estate)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Uo.label: Dementia
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Uo.definition: Dementia is a broad category of brain diseases characterized by a decline in memory, thinking, behavior, and the ability to perform everyday activities. It is a progressive condition that often leads to significant impairment in social and occupational functioning, requiring comprehensive medical and supportive care.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Up.label: Apache languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Up.definition: A group of Native American languages spoken primarily in the southwestern United States, including Navajo and Apache.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Up.label: Amount in Controversy - expressed as "up to"
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Up.definition: The maximum amount in controversy, where the actual amount in dispute is below that maximum. Example: Small-claims courts (also known as "conciliation courts" frequently have a maximum amount of controversy (e.g., $1,000 or $10,000) — over which the case must be argued in a higher court (e.g., state district court).
english_labels: Amount in Controversy - expressed as "up to"

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ut.label: Engagement Location - Country
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ut.definition: Country where the engagement was originated (e.g., client location).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Uw.label: Burglary
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Uw.definition: The unlawful entry into a building or other structure with the intent to commit a felony or a theft.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9V2.label: Right to Transfer Building
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9V2.definition: The Right to Transfer Building allows the owner of a structure to sell, bequeath, or otherwise convey the building independently of the land on which it stands. This right is typically subject to contractual agreements, zoning laws, and other legal restrictions, and is more commonly found in jurisdictions that recognize separate ownership of buildings and land.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9V6.label: Indiana Town Court - St. Joseph County, Walkerton Town
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9V6.definition: A court located in Walkerton Town, St. Joseph County, Indiana that has limited jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and small claims cases within its geographical area.
english_labels: Indiana Town Court - St. Joseph County, Walkerton Town

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9V6.label: Florida Circuit Court - Charlotte County - 20th Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9V6.definition: The Florida Circuit Court - Charlotte County (20th Circuit Court) is a specific court within the Florida Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Charlotte County.
english_labels: Florida Circuit Court - Charlotte County - 20th Circuit Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9VB.label: Offer of Judgment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9VB.definition: An Offer of Judgment is a legal document submitted by one party to another during a lawsuit, proposing a settlement amount to resolve the case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9VD.label: Modification Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9VD.definition: A Modification Clause is a provision in a contract that allows the parties to change or amend the terms of the agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9VJ.label: Texas Court of Appeals - 5th
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9VJ.definition: The Texas Court of Appeals - 5th is a specific intermediate appellate court in Texas that hears appeals from lower courts within its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9VN.label: DEPRECATED Legislative Governmental Leader - FAVORING National Legislator
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9VN.definition: A legislative governmental leader is an elected official who serves in a legislative body, participating in the process of crafting, debating, and voting on laws. Examples include members of parliament, senators, members of houses of representatives, each representing their constituents and playing a role in the legislative branch of their respective governments.
english_labels: DEPRECATED Legislative Governmental Leader - FAVORING National Legislator

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9VN.label: Construction Negligence Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9VN.definition: Construction Negligence Claims: Legal claims brought against construction companies or contractors for their failure to exercise reasonable care in the construction process, resulting in harm or damage to individuals or property.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9VP.label: Significant Shareholder Disclosure
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9VP.definition: Significant Shareholder Disclosure is an investor's filing with the financial regulator (e.g., U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)), providing detailed information about the investor's identity, background, source of funds, and intentions regarding the company, serving as a transparency measure to inform the market and the company's management. It's often triggered by an ownership threshold.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9VU.label: 110 Insurance (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9VU.definition: Action alleging breach of insurance contract, tort claim, or other cause related to an insurance contract, except for maritime insurance contracts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9VV.label: Kale
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9VV.definition: Kale is a leafy green vegetable from the Brassica oleracea species, known for its curly or flat leaves and robust, earthy flavor. It is consumed raw or cooked and is valued for its exceptional nutritional content, including high levels of vitamins A, C, and K, as well as calcium and antioxidants.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Vd.label: fee segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Vd.definition: "The fee items included in the matter/invoice. There will be 0 or more FEE segments per MATTER segment. All fee items are subject to the same MATTER_DISC_CRED.disc_cred MISF (Matter/Invoice Shared Fee) and MIDB (Matter/Invoice Discounted Bill) as all expense items for this matter/invoice. If fee items are not subject to the same MISF or MIDB, they should be billed in a separate invoice. E-Billing system rules that limit law firms to submitting only one invoice per quarter (or other time period) will need to change their logic so that bills of this type will be accommodated."

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Vg.label: Class
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Vg.definition: All those persons in the same category, level of rights (e.g. heirs of dead person who are related by the same degree), or who were injured by the same incident (e.g., class action lawsuit). Whether a person is part of a class often determines who can sue on behalf of the people who have been similarly damaged or collect his/her share if a class action judgment is entered.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Vk.label: Entity Formation Document
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Vk.definition: An Entity Formation Document is a legal document filed with a governmental authority, such as a state's Secretary of State, to officially establish a legal entity, such as a limited liability company (LLC), corporation, or limited partnership. It typically includes essential details like the entity's name, purpose, registered agent, and the names of its initial members, directors, or partners.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Vm.label: Independent Medical Examination
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Vm.definition: An Independent Medical Examination (IME) is a medical evaluation performed by a neutral third-party physician to assess an individual's injuries or medical condition, often used in legal proceedings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Vm.label: XLSX
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Vm.definition: Microsoft Excel document file that was introduced by Microsoft with the release of Microsoft Office 2007.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Vr.label: Stock Legends Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Vr.definition: A Stock Legends Clause is a provision in a contract that requires the disclosure of certain information related to the sale or transfer of securities, such as restrictions on resale or ownership.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Vs.label: Radiology Negligence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Vs.definition: Radiology Negligence refers to a type of medical malpractice claim that arises when a radiologist fails to provide the appropriate standard of care in interpreting medical images, resulting in harm to the patient.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9W0.label: Indiana Town Court - Marion County, Warren Twp.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9W0.definition: A court located in Marion County, Warren Township, Indiana that has limited jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and small claims cases.
english_labels: Indiana Town Court - Marion County, Warren Twp.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9W2.label: Georgia Superior Court - Treutlen County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9W2.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over legal matters within Treutlen County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9W3.label: Positive Youth Development Activity
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9W3.definition: A positive youth development activity is an action or program designed to promote the healthy development and well-being of young people, particularly in areas such as education, social skills, and emotional regulation. This concept is specifically related to the conditions that parents must meet as part of a criminal disposition.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9W6.label: Body Fluid Evidence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9W6.definition: Body fluid evidence encompasses biological substances like blood, semen, saliva, and sweat found at crime scenes. Through forensic analysis, these fluids can provide DNA or other biochemical information, linking a person to a location, object, or another individual.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9W9.label: Duala
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9W9.definition: Duala is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary, and is a member of the language family.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9WA.label: Firm Discovery Personnel
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9WA.definition: Firm Discovery Personnel refers to individuals within a legal service provider who are responsible for conducting discovery activities on behalf of the firm, but who are not billable timekeepers.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9WH.label: Motion for Bail Pending Appeal
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9WH.definition: A Motion for Bail Pending Appeal is a request made to an appellate court to release a defendant from custody while their appeal is pending, allowing them to remain free until a final decision is made on their case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9WI.label: Tinted Windows Violation Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9WI.definition: A Tinted Windows Violation Claim involves allegations that a vehicle's window tinting exceeds the legally allowed darkness or reflectivity, violating regulations that ensure driver visibility and law enforcement's ability to see inside vehicles for safety reasons. Such claims typically result in fines and may require the removal or replacement of the window tint.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9WJ.label: Minnesota District Court - Anoka County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9WJ.definition: A court located in Anoka County, Minnesota that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9WO.label: Court Appointed
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9WO.definition: "Court-appointed" refers to an attribute where a judge selects and assigns an Actor (e.g., attorney, expert, professional), often to an individual who cannot afford legal representation. These appointments are often made in criminal cases or civil matters involving indigent parties to ensure access to legal counsel.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9WR.label: Cereal Crops
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9WR.definition: Cereal Crops are a category of cultivated grasses grown primarily for their edible grains or seeds, which are staple foods for a significant portion of the global population. These crops provide essential carbohydrates, proteins, and other nutrients, forming the basis of many diets and playing a vital role in food security and agriculture.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9WS.label: Texas Court of Appeals - 13th
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9WS.definition: The Texas Court of Appeals - 13th is a specific court within the Texas Court of Appeals system that hears appeals from trial courts in certain counties and has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9WU.label: Probation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9WU.definition: Probation is a period of supervision over an offender in lieu of incarceration.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9WU.label: Retirement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9WU.definition: Retirement is an event when an individual ceases regular employment or career activity, typically due to age or meeting certain financial criteria. It is often associated with receiving a regular income from savings, pensions, or government benefits in lieu of employment earnings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9WY.label: State or Province of Birth
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9WY.definition: State or Province of Birth refers to the specific state, province, or other regional division where an individual was born. This information is often used for identification and may be required for legal or governmental purposes. It is commonly included on birth certificates and may also appear in other official documents.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9WY.label: Holding Company
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9WY.definition: A Holding Company is a business entity created to own and control the shares of other companies, thereby allowing it to exert influence or outright control over the management and policies of those companies. It does not typically engage in producing goods or services itself but generates revenue through dividends, interest, and capital gains from its subsidiaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Wa.label: Employment Health and Safety Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Wa.definition: Law governing the health and safety of employees.
english_labels: Disability, Leave, and Health Management Law

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9We.label: Analysis of Pre-Petition Debt Agreements
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9We.definition: Analysis of Pre-Petition Debt Agreements refers to the examination and evaluation of agreements related to debts that were made before the filing of a bankruptcy petition.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Wf.label: Billing Application Version Number
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Wf.definition: The Billing Application Version Number is a subcategory of the Billing Application Name class, and refers to the specific version of the billing software used to manage financial transactions related to legal services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Wh.label: Motion to Stay Proceedings Pending Inter Partes Review
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Wh.definition: A Motion to Stay Proceedings Pending Inter Partes Review is a request to temporarily halt legal proceedings while a third party reviews the validity of a patent.
english_labels: Motion to Stay Proceedings Pending Inter Partes Review

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Wh.label: Use of Logo Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Wh.definition: The Use of Logo Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the conditions under which a party may use the other party's logo or trademark.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Wp.label: Minnesota District Court - Wright County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Wp.definition: Minnesota District Court - Wright County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system located in Wright County, responsible for administering legal proceedings within its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Wu.label: Kutenai
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Wu.definition: Kutenai (Language) is a structured system of communication used by the Kutenai people, consisting of its own unique grammar and vocabulary.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ww.label: Arid Market Segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ww.definition: The arid market segment targets consumers or businesses located in regions characterized by dry, desert-like conditions with minimal rainfall. Businesses catering to this segment often focus on products and services that address the challenges of living in arid climates, such as water conservation, cooling solutions, and sun protection.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9X7.label: Leave of Absence Status
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9X7.definition: Leave of Absence Status refers to a period during which an employee is formally allowed to be away from work for a specific reason, such as medical issues, maternity leave, or personal matters. During this time, the employment relationship is maintained, but the employee may or may not receive full benefits and compensation, depending on company policy and the nature of the leave

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9XC.label: Florida County Court - Broward County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9XC.definition: A court located in Broward County, Florida that handles civil and criminal cases within its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9XH.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Columbia County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9XH.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Columbia County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Columbia County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9XK.label: Incest
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9XK.definition: Nonforcible sexual intercourse between persons who are related to each other within the degrees wherein marriage is prohibited by law.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9XM.label: Superseding Agreement Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9XM.definition: A Superseding Agreement Clause is a provision in a contract that states that any previous agreements between the parties are no longer valid and that the current contract is the only binding agreement between them.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9XP.label: ADR Summary Jury Trial Forum
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9XP.definition: An ADR Summary Jury Trial Forum is a type of Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) Forum where parties present their case to a panel of jurors who then provide a non-binding verdict to help the parties reach a settlement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9XQ.label: Buyer Consent Requirement Applies Only to Specified Negative Covenants
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9XQ.definition: A provision in a contract that requires the buyer's approval only for certain restrictions on the property, rather than all restrictions, as specified in the agreement.
english_labels: Buyer Consent Requirement Applies Only to Specified Negative Covenants

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9XZ.label: Vulva or Vagina Cancer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9XZ.definition: Vulva or vagina cancer refers to malignant tumors originating in the external female genitalia (vulva) or the vaginal canal. These cancers can cause symptoms such as abnormal bleeding, itching, and pain, and often require a combination of treatments including surgery, radiation, and chemotherapy.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xb.label: Overpayment of Public Benefit
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xb.definition: Overpayment of public benefit occurs when an individual or family receives more financial assistance or services than they are entitled to under a specific public benefit program. This can happen due to administrative errors, fraud, or changes in the recipient's eligibility status, and often necessitates actions like repayment plans or legal proceedings to recover the excess funds.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xg.label: Caribbean Community
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xg.definition: CARICOM (Caribbean Community): An organization of Caribbean nations and dependencies aiming for economic integration and cooperation among its members, ensuring that the benefits of integration are equitably shared, and coordinating foreign policy.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xh.label: Arizona Superior Court - Apache Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xh.definition: The Arizona Superior Court - Apache Cty. is a specific court within the Arizona Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Apache County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xh.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Lincoln County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xh.definition: The New Mexico Magistrate Court - Lincoln County is a specific court within the New Mexico Magistrate Court system that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters in Lincoln County, New Mexico.
english_labels: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Lincoln County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xi.label: Bananas
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xi.definition: Bananas are a tropical fruit crop produced by various species of large herbaceous plants in the Musa genus, known for their elongated shape and sweet, creamy flesh. Consumed worldwide, they serve as a vital source of nutrients, including potassium and vitamins B6 and C, and are used in a wide range of culinary applications.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xk.label: Motion to Dismiss
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xk.definition: A Motion to Dismiss is a formal request made to a court, asking the judge to dismiss a case or claim due to a specific reason, such as lack of jurisdiction or failure to state a claim.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xl.label: Binding Arbitration Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xl.definition: A binding arbitration clause is a specific type of contractual clause that requires parties to resolve disputes through arbitration rather than through the court system.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xn.label: Payee Name - Expenses
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xn.definition: A payee name associated with expenses incurred during the provision of legal services, distinct from fees charged by the payee for their services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xo.label: Equitable Distribution Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xo.definition: An Equitable Distribution Claim is a legal action taken during divorce proceedings to determine the fair and equitable division of marital assets and debts between spouses. The goal is to distribute property in a manner that is just and reasonable, taking into account factors such as the length of the marriage, each spouse's contributions, and their financial needs. It aims to ensure a fair division of assets and debts accrued during the marriage, which may include real estate, financial accounts, personal property, and more.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xp.label: Employee Retirement Income Security Act Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xp.definition: A claim made under the Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA) which regulates employee benefit plans, including pension and health insurance plans, offered by private employers.
english_labels: Employee Retirement Income Security Act Claim

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xq.label: Discovery Events
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xq.definition: Discovery Events refer to the specific events that occur during the discovery phase of litigation, including interviews, physical examinations, depositions, and document collection and production events.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xs.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Lincoln County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xs.definition: Oregon Circuit Court - Lincoln County: A specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system located in Lincoln County, responsible for administering legal proceedings within its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xx.label: Indigenous Peoples' Rights
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xx.definition: Indigenous Peoples' Rights refer to the collective and individual entitlements of indigenous communities to protect their cultural heritage, land, and natural resources. These rights are often recognized in international law, such as the United Nations Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples, and may include the right to self-determination, cultural preservation, and equitable participation in political and economic activities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xz.label: Meeting
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Xz.definition: A meeting is a type of communication event where individuals come together to discuss a specific topic or agenda.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Y0.label: Voluntary Manslaughter
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Y0.definition: The unlawful killing of a person without malice aforethought, committed intentionally but in the heat of passion or under adequate provocation, and without premeditation or deliberation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Y0.label: Corporate Articles
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Y0.definition: Corporate Articles, also known as Articles of Incorporation, are legal documents filed with a government body to officially establish a corporation. They outline fundamental information such as the corporation's name, purpose, and stock structure.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Y2.label: Acknowledgement Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Y2.definition: An Acknowledgement Clause is a provision in a contract where one party acknowledges that they have received and understood certain information or terms, but does not necessarily indicate agreement or acceptance of those terms.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Y4.label: Logging Real Estate Asset
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Y4.definition: A logging real estate asset refers to a property that contains or is primarily used for the extraction of timber through logging activities. This asset is crucial in the context of forestry law, environmental law, and property law, as it involves the rights to harvest, manage, and sell timber resources.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9YA.label: Ohio Court of Common Pleas - Montgomery County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9YA.definition: The Ohio Court of Common Pleas - Montgomery County is a specific court within the Ohio Court of Common Pleas system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within Montgomery County, Ohio.
english_labels: Ohio Court of Common Pleas - Montgomery County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9YA.label: By Time with Discounted Rates
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9YA.definition: A billing method for legal services where the fees are calculated based on the amount of time spent on the work, with a discounted rate applied.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9YB.label: Payee Name - Fees
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9YB.definition: The concept of "Payee Name - Fees" refers to the specific name of the individual or entity who is receiving payment for legal services rendered, and the amount of fees charged for those services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9YD.label: Planned Unit Development
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9YD.definition: A Planned Unit Development (PUD) is a type of land-use zoning classification that allows for mixed-use residential, commercial, and sometimes industrial areas to be developed according to a single, comprehensive master plan. PUDs often feature more flexible zoning and design standards, aimed at achieving a more integrated and functional community layout.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9YD.label: Gender Non-Conforming
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9YD.definition: Gender Non-Conforming (GNC) refers to a gender expression or identity that does not adhere to the traditional societal expectations or binaries of male or female. In legal scenarios, protections for gender non-conforming individuals against discrimination, harassment, and other injustices are often discussed within the broader framework of gender and LGBTQ+ rights and inclusivity.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9YF.label: Broadcasting and Content Providers Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9YF.definition: Industries in the Broadcasting and Content Providers subsector include establishments that create content or acquire the right to distribute content and subsequently broadcast or distribute that content. The industry groups (Radio and Television Broadcasting Stations and Media Streaming Distribution Services, Social Networks, and Other Media Networks and Content Providers) are based on differences in the methods of communication and the nature of services provided. The Radio and Television Broadcasting Stations industry group includes establishments that operate radio or television broadcasting stations for the programming and transmission of programs to the public. Programming may originate in their own studio, from an affiliated network, or from external sources. The Media Streaming Distribution Services, Social Networks, and Other Media Networks and Content Providers industry group includes establishments providing media streaming distribution services, operating social network sites, operating media broadcasting and cable television networks, and supplying information, such as news reports, articles, pictures, and features, to the news media. The establishments classified in this subsector are often engaged in the production and purchase of programs and other textual, audio, and/or video content, and they typically generate revenues from the sale of advertising space and air time, subscriptions, donations, subsidies, and/or the sale of programs. Establishments operating telecommunications facilities and infrastructure and distributing audio and video programming, including cable and satellite television subscription programming, are included in Subsector 517, Telecommunications. Establishments primarily engaged as independent contractors in the installation and maintenance of broadcasting systems are classified in Sector 23, Construction. Establishments primarily engaged in the production, or production and distribution, of motion pictures and sound recordings are included in Subsector 512, Motion Picture and Sound Recording Industries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9YF.label: Kletsel Dehe Band of Wintun Indians
english_labels: Kletsel Dehe Band of Wintun Indians

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9YG.label: Chapter 11 Bankruptcy Plan - Streamlined
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9YG.definition: A Subchapter 5 Bankruptcy Plan is a specialized form of Chapter 11 bankruptcy that caters to small business debtors, offering a more streamlined and less expensive path to debt restructuring and reorganization. Unlike traditional Chapter 11 cases, a Subchapter 5 Plan often allows the business owners to retain ownership and control while confirming a plan to repay creditors, and it usually eliminates the need for a creditors' committee.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9YJ.label: Violation of a Restraining Order
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9YJ.definition: The violation of a restraining order refers to the act of disregarding a court order that prohibits contact with a particular person or entering a specific area, which can result in criminal charges for harassment or misdemeanor offenses.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9YM.label: Grapes
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9YM.definition: Grapes are small, round fruits that grow in clusters on woody vines belonging to the genus Vitis. They are consumed fresh or processed into a variety of products, including wine, juice, raisins, and jellies, and are valued for their sweet flavor, high antioxidant content, and nutritional benefits.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9YT.label: Georgia Superior Court - Candler County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9YT.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Candler County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Candler County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9YU.label: Income from Business Ventures (Not Actively Managed)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9YU.definition: Income from Business Ventures (Not Actively Managed) refers to earnings derived from business activities in which the owner does not participate in the day-to-day operations or management. This passive business income can come from investments in limited partnerships, silent partnerships, or other business arrangements where the investor's role is primarily financial.
english_labels: Income from Business Ventures (Not Actively Managed)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ya.label: Confidential Informant Privilege
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ya.definition: The Confidential Informant Privilege is a legal protection that allows individuals who provide information to law enforcement agencies to remain anonymous and keep their identities confidential.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ye.label: Other Than Honorable Discharge
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Ye.definition: An Other Than Honorable Discharge typically results from a pattern of behavior that falls below the military's accepted standards but is not severe enough to warrant a dishonorable discharge. It may disqualify the individual from receiving certain veteran benefits.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Yg.label: Wound Care Malpractice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Yg.definition: Negligent or improper treatment of a patient's wounds by a healthcare professional, resulting in harm or injury, which may lead to a legal claim for medical malpractice.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Yg.label: Khoisan languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Yg.definition: Khoisan languages are a group of languages spoken by the Khoisan people in southern Africa, characterized by the use of click consonants.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Yi.label: Mobile Payment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Yi.definition: Mobile Payment is the use of mobile devices, such as smartphones and tablets, to conduct financial transactions, typically facilitated by a mobile payment application. This modality enables convenient, remote access to funds for both online and in-person transactions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Yo.label: Washoe Tribe of Nevada and California
english_labels: Washoe Tribe of Nevada and California

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Yu.label: Audit Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Yu.definition: An audit clause is a provision in a contract that allows one party to inspect and review the financial records of the other party to ensure compliance with the terms of the agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Yw.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Luzerne County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Yw.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Luzerne County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in Luzerne County, Pennsylvania.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Luzerne County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Yx.label: Legal Services Engagement Documents
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Yx.definition: Legal Services Engagement Documents are written agreements between a client and a law firm that outline the terms and conditions of the legal services to be provided, including the scope of work, fees, and responsibilities of each party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Yy.label: Registration of Investment Security Transfer Denied
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Yy.definition: The concept of "Registration of Investment Security Transfer Denied" refers to the legal denial of the registration of a transfer of investment securities, which includes banking, commercial paper, and creditor claims.
english_labels: Registration of Investment Security Transfer Denied

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Z7.label: Warranty Obligations
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Z7.definition: Warranty Obligations, also known as Warranty Liabilities, are commitments made by a company to repair, replace, or refund products that are found to be defective within a specified period. These obligations are recognized as a liability on the company's balance sheet, and an expense is recorded in the income statement to match the estimated future costs of honoring the warranties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ZB.label: Georgia Superior Court - Camden County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ZB.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Camden County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Camden County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ZC.label: Madurese
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ZC.definition: Madurese is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary, and is a specific language within the context of legal matters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ZM.label: Stock Purchase Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ZM.definition: A Stock Purchase Agreement is a contract between a buyer and a seller that outlines the terms for the purchase and sale of shares (or stock) in a company. This agreement specifies the number of shares being sold, the purchase price per share, representations and warranties of both parties, and other crucial terms and conditions of the sale.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ZN.label: Commencement Letter Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ZN.definition: A Commencement Letter Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the terms and conditions for the issuance of a commencement letter, which is a document that officially starts a project or work under the contract.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ZN.label: Indo-European languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ZN.definition: Indo-European languages are a group of languages that share a common ancestor and are spoken in Europe, parts of Asia, and parts of the Indian subcontinent.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ZP.label: Construction Permit
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ZP.definition: A Construction Permit is an official authorization issued by a governmental body that allows the holder to commence construction, modification, or demolition of a building or structure. It ensures that the proposed work complies with local building codes, zoning laws, and safety regulations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ZQ.label: Georgia Superior Court - Oglethorpe County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ZQ.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Oglethorpe County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Zc.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Roosevelt County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Zc.definition: A court located in Roosevelt County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases, such as traffic violations and misdemeanors.
english_labels: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Roosevelt County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Zi.label: Washington Superior Court - Mason County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Zi.definition: Washington Superior Court - Mason County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Washington that handles civil and criminal cases within Mason County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Zl.label: Baseball Arbitration Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Zl.definition: A baseball arbitration clause is a specific type of contractual clause that requires disputes to be resolved through a process similar to baseball salary arbitration, where each party submits a proposed resolution and an arbitrator chooses one of the proposals without modification.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Zm.label: Ambulance Negligence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Zm.definition: Ambulance Negligence refers to a legal claim for damages resulting from the failure of ambulance personnel to provide appropriate medical care or transport in emergency situations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Zn.label: Claim for Falling Down Stairs
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Zn.definition: A claim for falling down stairs is a legal action brought by a plaintiff who has suffered injuries as a result of a slip-and-fall incident on a staircase, and is based on the legal theory of negligence.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Zn.label: Contract Fraud
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Zn.definition: The wrongful and intentional misrepresentation or concealment of material facts related to a contract, with the intent to induce another party to enter into the contract, resulting in damages to the deceived party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Zp.label: Counterfeiting
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Zp.definition: (Definition of "Counterfeiting/Forgery") The altering, copying, or imitation of something, without authority or right, with the intent to deceive or defraud by passing the copy or thing altered or imitated as that which is original or genuine; or the selling, buying, or possession of an altered, copied, or imitated thing with the intent to deceive or defraud.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Zr.label: Motions on Oral Argument
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Zr.definition: Motions on Oral Argument refer to requests made by parties in appellate courts to reschedule, present by video, submit on briefs, or obtain oral argument.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Zr.label: Aortic Aneurysm
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Zr.definition: An aneurysm of the aorta or major branches is an abnormal dilation or bulging in the wall of the aorta or its major branches due to weakened vessel walls. According to the SSA definition, these aneurysms can lead to life-threatening complications such as rupture, requiring surgical intervention or ongoing management to prevent catastrophic outcomes.
english_labels: Aneurysm of Aorta or Major Branches

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Zx.label: 220 Foreclosure (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Zx.definition: Action to enjoin foreclosure on real property by mortgage lender.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Zy.label: Jury Sworn In
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9Zy.definition: Jury Sworn In: The specific event in a trial where the jury is officially selected and sworn in to hear the case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9a0.label: Manufacturing Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9a0.definition: A Manufacturing Agreement is a legal contract between two parties that outlines the terms and conditions for the production of goods by one party on behalf of the other.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9a5.label: Theft of Motor Vehicle Parts/Accessories
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9a5.definition: The theft of any part or accessory affixed to the interior or exterior of a motor vehicle in a manner which would make the item an attachment of the vehicle, or necessary for its operation

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9a7.label: Matter Net Fees
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9a7.definition: Matter Net Fees are the fees charged for legal services provided in a specific matter, after deducting any expenses or disbursements incurred by the lawyer.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9aA.label: Human Authorship
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9aA.definition: Human Authorship in copyright law refers to the requirement that a work must be created by a human individual to be eligible for copyright protection. This criterion emphasizes the human intellect and creativity as the fundamental source of copyrightable material, excluding works created by automated processes or non-human entities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9aA.label: Transit and Ground Passenger Transportation Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9aA.definition: Industries in this group include a variety of passenger transportation activities, such as urban transit systems; chartered bus, school bus, and interurban bus transportation; and taxis.
english_labels: Transit and Ground Passenger Transportation Industry

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9aA.label: Traumatic Brain Injury
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9aA.definition: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) is a disruption in normal brain function caused by an external mechanical force, such as a blow or jolt to the head. TBI can result in temporary or permanent cognitive, physical, and psychological impairments, requiring immediate medical attention and often long-term rehabilitation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9aH.label: Application for Patent Registration
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9aH.definition: An Application for Patent Registration is a formal request submitted to a patent office for the grant of a patent on a specific invention or discovery. The application typically includes a written specification describing the invention in detail, any applicable drawings, and claims that define the scope of the protection sought

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9aP.label: Night Blindness
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9aP.definition: Night Blindness, also known as Nyctalopia, is a visual impairment that affects an individual's ability to see in low light or darkness. This condition can result from various underlying issues such as retinal disorders, vitamin A deficiency, or cataracts, and significantly impacts activities that require good vision in dim lighting.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9aS.label: Location
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9aS.definition: The name of a position on the Earth, usually in the context of continents, countries, and their political subdivisions (e.g., regions, states or provinces, cities, towns, villages).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9aV.label: Other Miscellaneous Manufacturing Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9aV.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in miscellaneous manufacturing, such as jewelry and silverware manufacturing, sporting and athletic goods manufacturing, doll, toy, and game manufacturing, office supplies (except paper) manufacturing, sign manufacturing, and all other miscellaneous manufacturing.
english_labels: Leisure Goods, Musical Instrument, and Book Industry
Leisure Goods, Musical Instrument, and Books

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9aV.label: Answer to Application or Cross-Application for Enforcement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9aV.definition: An Answer to Application or Cross-Application for Enforcement is a legal document filed in response to a request for enforcement or rehearing, typically in an appellate court.
english_labels: Answer to Application or Cross-Application for Enforcement

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9aW.label: Georgia Superior Court - Terrell County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9aW.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Terrell County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Terrell County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ac.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Union County
