https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ac.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Union County refers to a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Union County, Indiana.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ae.label: Fact Witness Interviews
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ae.definition: Fact Witness Interviews are conversations between an interviewer and a witness who has personal knowledge of the facts relevant to a legal case, and can be either friendly, unfriendly, or neutral in nature.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9am.label: Mergers and Acquisitions Events
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9am.definition: Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) Events refer to the specific events and phases involved in the process of merging or acquiring one company by another, including the due diligence and closing events.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ar.label: Guam Supreme Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ar.definition: The Guam Supreme Court is the highest court in the Guam Territory Court system, responsible for hearing appeals and making final decisions on legal disputes within Guam.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9au.label: Patient
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9au.definition: A Patient is an individual who receives medical care, treatment, or other health services from a healthcare provider or institution. This person is under professional care due to illness, injury, or for preventive health measures, and is the recipient of medical attention, diagnosis, and therapeutic interventions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9aw.label: Antitrust - Pricing Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9aw.definition: Antitrust - Pricing Claims refer to allegations of anti-competitive behavior related to pricing practices, such as price-fixing or predatory pricing, in violation of antitrust laws.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ax.label: Animals
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ax.definition: Domesticated animals that are bought, sold, or traded as commercial products. This category includes pets, livestock, and other animals considered personal property within the context of commercial transactions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9b1.label: Minnesota District Court - Pennington County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9b1.definition: A court located in Pennington County, Minnesota that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9b4.label: Estimate of Damages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9b4.definition: Estimate by the client and/or provider as to the amount of damages

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9b5.label: Agency & Vicarious Liability
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9b5.definition: Agency & Vicarious Liability refers to the legal responsibility of one party for the actions of another party who is acting on their behalf or under their control, such as an employer being held liable for the actions of their employee.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9b7.label: Lezghian
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9b7.definition: Lezghian is a written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a member of the Language top-level class.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9b9.label: Pending Acquisition Proposal
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9b9.definition: A pending acquisition proposal is a legal concept that refers to an offer made by one party to acquire another party's assets or business, which has not yet been accepted or rejected, and is subject to certain conditions and triggers, such as tail period fee triggers.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bC.label: Estate Management Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bC.definition: Estate Management Practice refers to the administration and oversight of a person's estate, including assets, liabilities, and financial affairs, both during their lifetime and after their death. It encompasses tasks such as estate planning, executing wills, managing trusts, and ensuring compliance with legal and tax obligations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bD.label: Motion to Transfer Venue
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bD.definition: A Motion to Transfer Venue is a formal request made to a court to change the location of a legal proceeding to a different jurisdiction or court for reasons such as convenience or fairness.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bE.label: Arkansas District Court - Craighead Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bE.definition: A court located in Craighead County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bG.label: Arkansas District Court - Yell Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bG.definition: Arkansas District Court - Yell Cty. is a specific court within the Arkansas District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Yell County, Arkansas.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bM.label: Personal Jurisdiction by Residence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bM.definition: The concept of "Personal Jurisdiction by Residence" refers to the authority of a court to hear a case based on the fact that the defendant resides within the court's geographic jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bM.label: 16th Amendment Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bM.definition: A 16th Amendment claim is a legal assertion related to the Sixteenth Amendment of the United States Constitution, which authorizes Congress to levy an income tax without apportioning it among the states or basing it on the United States Census. This amendment gives the federal government the power to tax individual and corporate incomes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bN.label: Somali
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bN.definition: Somali (Language) is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary used in Somalia and other regions, and is a subcategory of the Language class.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bP.label: Motion to Quash
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bP.definition: A Motion to Quash is a legal request to invalidate or nullify a legal document (e.g., subpoena, service of process, order). It is typically filed on procedural or jurisdictional grounds to prevent further legal proceedings based on the challenged document.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bR.label: Anti-SLAPP Motion
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bR.definition: An Anti-SLAPP Motion is a legal motion filed in trial courts that seeks to dismiss a lawsuit that is aimed at suppressing the defendant's First Amendment rights.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bT.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Knox County (9th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Knox County (9th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bU.label: Dental Malpractice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bU.definition: Negligent or improper conduct by a dental professional, resulting in harm or injury to a patient, which may give rise to a legal claim for damages.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bU.label: Inventor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bU.definition: An inventor is a person who creates a new and useful process, machine, manufacture, or composition of matter, and is recognized as the original source of that invention in a legal matter.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9be.label: JF30 Preparing and serving disclosure lists (UK J-CODE)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9be.definition: Preparing and serving disclosure lists (applicable to both manual and e-disclosure).
english_labels: JF30 Preparing and serving disclosure lists (UK J-CODE)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9be.label: U.S. House of Representatives
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9be.definition: The U.S. House of Representatives is the lower chamber of Congress, responsible for initiating revenue-related legislation and representing the population of the states based on proportional representation. The House exercises legislative power, oversight, and the authority to impeach federal officials.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bh.label: Slovak
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bh.definition: Slovak (Language) is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary used in Slovakia and by Slovak communities around the world.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bh.label: Standby Guardianship of Minor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bh.definition: Standby Guardianship of a Minor allows parents to designate an individual to care for their child in the event of sudden incapacity, death, immigration actions, or other unforeseen circumstances. While this arrangement permits temporary guardianship, parents retain their parental rights and can revoke the guardianship consent at any time.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bj.label: Option to Renew Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bj.definition: An Option to Renew Clause is a provision in a contract that grants one party the right to extend the term of the agreement for an additional period of time upon the expiration of the initial term.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bk.label: House Arrest
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bk.definition: House Arrest: A criminal penalty that requires an individual to remain confined to their residence, typically with electronic monitoring, as a substitute for imprisonment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bm.label: Texas District Court - Fannin County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bm.definition: A court located in Fannin County, Texas that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bq.label: Traditional Warrant
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bq.definition: A Traditional Warrant is a financial instrument issued by the issuer of the underlying asset, granting the holder the right to purchase the underlying asset at a specific price within a certain period. This type of warrant provides the holder with a potential opportunity for profit if the price of the underlying asset rises above the exercise price.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9br.label: Merkel Cell Carcinoma
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9br.definition: Merkel cell carcinoma (MCC) is a rare and aggressive type of skin cancer that originates in the Merkel cells, which are found at the base of the epidermis and are associated with the sense of touch. It tends to grow quickly and spread to other parts of the body, requiring treatments such as surgery, radiation therapy, and chemotherapy.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bt.label: Loyalty Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bt.definition: A loyalty clause is a provision in a contract that requires one party to act in the best interest of another party and not engage in activities that may harm the other party's interests.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bu.label: Reinsurer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bu.definition: A reinsurer is a company that provides financial protection to insurance companies by accepting portions of their insurance liabilities. This process allows the primary insurance company to mitigate risks, ensuring that it can meet its financial obligations to policyholders even in the event of particularly large or numerous claims.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bw.label: Proceeding Consolidated
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9bw.definition: The concept of "Case Consolidated" refers to the legal status of a dispute where multiple cases have been combined into a single case for the purpose of efficiency and convenience in the legal process.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9c0.label: Equity Valuation Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9c0.definition: Equity Valuation Management is the process of determining the value of a company's stock and managing it accordingly, within the context of Legal Point Solutions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9c1.label: Motion to Seal
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9c1.definition: A Motion to Seal is a request made to a court to keep certain information or documents confidential and not available to the public or other parties involved in a legal proceeding.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9c3.label: Motion to Extend Time to File Appellant Designation of Reporters Transcript
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9c3.definition: A Motion to Extend Time to File Appellant Designation of Reporters Transcript is a request made to the appellate court to allow additional time for the appellant to designate the portions of the trial transcript that will be included in the appeal.
english_labels: Motion to Extend Time to File Appellant Designation of Reporters Transcript

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9c3.label: Investment Asset Attributes
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9c3.definition: Investment Asset Attributes refer to the specific characteristics and features that define an investment asset. These attributes include aspects such as voting rights, redemption rights, transfer rights, income rate, form, instrument dependency, distribution methods, repayment methods, underlying assets, and guarantees.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9c9.label: Fee Discount or Credit Type
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9c9.definition: A Fee Discount or Credit Type is a specific type of discount or credit offered in the context of legal services, which reduces the amount of fees charged to the client.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9cB.label: Actions Taken by Buyer Language
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9cB.definition: Actions Taken by Buyer Language refers to the specific provisions and clauses included in a contract by the buyer to protect themselves from any negative consequences that may arise after the acquisition of a company, and which are exempted from the Material Adverse Effect definition.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9cE.label: RICO Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9cE.definition: A claim brought under the Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organization Act (RICO), which is a federal law that provides for extended criminal penalties and a civil cause of action for acts performed as part of an ongoing criminal organization.
english_labels: Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organization Act Claims

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9cX.label: Vice-Principal Liability
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9cX.definition: The legal concept of Vice-Principal Liability refers to the responsibility of a person or entity, such as a company, for the actions of their subordinates or agents, even if the person in charge did not directly participate in the wrongdoing.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9cc.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Schuylkill County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9cc.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Schuylkill County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that handles minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil cases involving amounts up to $12,000.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Schuylkill County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9cd.label: Class Action Certification Event
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9cd.definition: A Class Action Certification Event is a specific event within the context of litigation where a court determines whether a lawsuit can proceed as a class action.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ce.label: Financial Obligations
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ce.definition: Financial Obligations (Financial Liabilities) refer to any monetary commitments or liabilities an individual or entity is responsible for, such as paying off debts, fulfilling contract terms, or covering recurring expenses. These obligations can be short-term or long-term and failing to meet them could result in financial penalties or legal consequences

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ch.label: Non-Governmental Organization
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ch.definition: Non-governmental organizations (NGOs) are usually non-profit and sometimes international organizations independent of governments and international governmental organizations (though often funded by governments) that are active in humanitarian, educational, health care, public policy, social, human rights, environmental, and other areas to effect changes according to their objectives.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ch.label: Georgia Superior Court - Elbert County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ch.definition: A court located in Elbert County, Georgia that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ci.label: Executive Bonus Plan Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ci.definition: An Executive Bonus Plan Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the terms and conditions of a compensation arrangement for executives, typically involving bonuses or other incentives.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9cp.label: Arapaho
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9cp.definition: Arapaho (Language) refers to the written or spoken structured system of communication used by the Arapaho people, which consists of its own unique grammar and vocabulary.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9cr.label: Gastroenterology Negligence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9cr.definition: Negligence in the field of gastroenterology, which involves the failure of a medical professional to provide the appropriate standard of care in the diagnosis, treatment, or management of gastrointestinal conditions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9cr.label: Motion for New Trial - Misconduct of Counsel
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9cr.definition: A Motion for New Trial based on Misconduct of Counsel is a legal request to have a new trial granted due to unethical or illegal behavior by the opposing party's attorney during the original trial.
english_labels: Motion for New Trial - Misconduct of Counsel

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9cu.label: Invoice Image File Name
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9cu.definition: A file name that identifies an image of an invoice for legal services rendered, which is a subcategory of the more general concept of fee invoice details.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9d2.label: UTBMS Mergers and Acquisitions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9d2.definition: UTBMS Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) refers to the standardized codes used to categorize legal tasks and expenses related to the process of merging or acquiring companies, including matters such as due diligence, purchase agreements, antitrust issues, and post-closing disputes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9d3.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Jasper County (4th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Jasper County (4th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9d6.label: Skolt Sami
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9d6.definition: Skolt Sami is a written or spoken structured system of communication used by the Skolt Sami people, which belongs to the Language top-level class.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9d6.label: Periodicity of Project Management Document
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9d6.definition: Temporal detail of how frequently a particular Project-Management Document recurs — for example, a document (e.g., budget, schedule, plan) can be weekly, monthly, quarterly.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9d9.label: Statement of Interest
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9d9.definition: A Statement of Interest is a written document submitted to a court or other legal authority expressing a party's position or opinion on a particular matter, typically in relation to an appeal or other legal proceeding.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dA.label: Motion to Impose Automatic Stay
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dA.definition: A Motion to Impose Automatic Stay is a request made in a bankruptcy case to stop creditors from taking any further collection actions against the debtor or the debtor's property without first obtaining permission from the bankruptcy court.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dA.label: Motion for Summary Affirmance
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dA.definition: A Motion for Summary Affirmance is a legal document requesting a court to affirm a lower court's decision without a full appeal process, based on the belief that the decision was correct and legally sound.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dE.label: Appellate Filings - Stipulations
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dE.definition: A stipulation filed in an appellate court, which is an agreement between parties involved in a case that resolves a specific issue or aspect of the case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dF.label: Florida Circuit Court - Sumter County - 5th Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dF.definition: A court located in Sumter County, Florida that is part of the larger Florida Circuit Court system.
english_labels: Florida Circuit Court - Sumter County - 5th Circuit Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dG.label: Regulatory Research Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dG.definition: Regulatory Research Management refers to the process of conducting legal research specifically related to regulations and compliance, including tracking and managing changes to regulatory requirements.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dH.label: California Superior Court - Ventura Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dH.definition: California Superior Court - Ventura Cty. is a specific court located in Ventura County, California that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographic area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dO.label: Florida County Court - Hillsborough County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dO.definition: A court located in Hillsborough County, Florida that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dP.label: Director
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dP.definition: A director is the head of an organization, either elected or appointed, who generally has certain powers and duties relating to management or administration. A corporation's board of directors is composed of a group of people who are elected by the shareholders to make important company policy decisions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dY.label: Afro-Asiatic languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dY.definition: Afro-Asiatic languages are a group of languages spoken in Africa and parts of Asia, including Arabic, Hebrew, and Amharic.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dY.label: Misclassification of Independent Contractor Status Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dY.definition: A misclassification of independent contractor status claim is a legal assertion that an employer has incorrectly classified an employee as an independent contractor, thereby denying them employee benefits and protections under labor laws. Such claims seek to rectify the classification and obtain compensation for denied benefits and protections.
english_labels: Misclassification of Independent Contractor Status Claim

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dZ.label: Motion to Compel Assumption or Rejection of Executory Contract or Unexpired Lease
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dZ.definition: A Motion to Compel Assumption or Rejection of Executory Contract or Unexpired Lease is a legal request made in bankruptcy proceedings to force a party to either accept or reject a contract or lease that is still in effect.
english_labels: Motion to Compel Assumption or Rejection of Executory Contract or Unexpired Lease

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9db.label: Chatbot Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9db.definition: Chatbot Management refers to the process of overseeing and optimizing the use of chatbots in the legal industry, with the goal of improving efficiency and effectiveness in legal processes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dd.label: Trial Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dd.definition: Trial Practice refers to the set of legal skills and procedures involved in presenting a case before a court of law, including witness examination, jury selection, trial preparation, testimony, and motion practice.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9df.label: Motion to Reinstate Retiree Benefits
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9df.definition: A Motion to Reinstate Retiree Benefits is a legal request made in a bankruptcy case to restore previously terminated benefits for retired individuals.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dn.label: Criminal Gang Participation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dn.definition: Participation in a group or organization that engages in criminal activities, such as drug trafficking or extortion, and is considered a crime against the public.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9do.label: UTBMS MG00 Shareholder/Board Matters
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9do.definition: A legal billing code used to classify tasks related to shareholder or board matters in the context of mergers and acquisitions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dq.label: Georgia Superior Court - McDuffie County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dq.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia, located in McDuffie County and presided over by a judge.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dr.label: Freedom to Petition
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dr.definition: A freedom to petition claim is a legal action initiated by an individual or group alleging that their right to petition the government for a redress of grievances, as protected by the First Amendment of the United States Constitution, has been violated by the government or a government actor. The First Amendment guarantees that the government shall not abridge the freedom to petition, which includes the right to make requests or complaints to the government, access courts, and participate in other forms of advocacy without fear of retaliation or punishment. A freedom to petition claim may arise in various contexts, such as when a government body enacts a law or regulation that unduly restricts the right to petition, when an individual or group is retaliated against for filing a complaint or lawsuit, or when access to legal processes or governmental decision-making is improperly denied.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dr.label: Georgia Superior Court - Hancock County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9dr.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Hancock County is a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Hancock County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ds.label: Sindhi
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ds.definition: Sindhi (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is spoken in the Sindh province of Pakistan and parts of India.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9e1.label: Military Serviceperson
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9e1.definition: A military serviceperson is an individual who serves or has served in the armed forces of a country, which can include the army, navy, air force, or other branches of service. Military servicepersons may hold various ranks and perform a wide range of duties, depending on their training and assignment. In many countries, including the United States, laws such as the Uniformed Services Employment and Reemployment Rights Act (USERRA) protect service members from discrimination based on their military status in areas like employment and benefits.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9e4.label: White
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9e4.definition: White (Ethnicity and Race) refers to a social construct that categorizes individuals based on their physical characteristics and cultural heritage, specifically those who identify as having European ancestry and are perceived as having light skin color.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9e7.label: Trade Libel
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9e7.definition: Trade Libel, also known as Injurious Falsehood, is a type of defamation that involves making false statements about a business or its products or services, which results in financial harm to the business.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9eF.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Henry County 1
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9eF.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Henry County, Indiana, with the authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9eL.label: Nzima
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9eL.definition: Nzima is a language that is spoken and written, and is a member of the Language top-level class.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9eN.label: Total Tax on Expense
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9eN.definition: The Total Tax on Expense is a subcategory of Tax Detail in legal knowledge management, referring to the complete amount of tax imposed on a particular expense.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9eR.label: JJ60 Permission applications (UK J-CODE)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9eR.definition: All permission applications where permission to proceed is required, such as in judicial review proceedings or on appeal.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9eR.label: Judicial Branch
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9eR.definition: The judicial branch interprets and applies the law, ensuring it aligns with a nation's constitution or legal principles. It is comprised of courts, with higher courts, often called supreme or constitutional courts, having the final say on legal disputes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9eW.label: Car
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9eW.definition: A car is a motorized vehicle designed for the transportation of passengers or cargo. It comes in various body styles, including sedan, coupe, convertible, and hatchback, each with distinct features and configurations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9eW.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Harrison County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9eW.definition: The Indiana Circuit Court - Harrison County is a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Harrison County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9eX.label: Paralysis
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9eX.definition: Paralysis is the loss of muscle function in part or most of the body, often accompanied by sensory loss, due to nerve damage or disruption in the spinal cord or brain. It can be temporary or permanent and requires comprehensive medical treatment and rehabilitation to manage symptoms and improve quality of life.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ee.label: Witness Fees Expense
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ee.definition: A witness fees expense is a type of expense that refers to the compensation paid to a person who provides testimony in a legal proceeding, which may include fees for travel, lodging, and other related expenses.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ee.label: California Superior Court - San Francisco Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ee.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in San Francisco County, California, with the power to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases.
english_labels: California Superior Court - San Francisco Cty.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ej.label: Credit Union
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ej.definition: A credit union is a member-owned financial cooperative that provides traditional banking services, including accepting deposits, making loans, and offering other financial products to its members. Unlike banks, credit unions operate on a not-for-profit basis, returning profits to members in the form of lower loan rates, higher savings yields, and lower fees.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ek.label: Regulatory Notice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ek.definition: A Regulatory Notice is an official communication issued by a governmental or regulatory body to inform organizations or the public about new laws, updates to existing regulations, or other important compliance-related matters. It serves as a mechanism to ensure that affected parties are aware of their legal obligations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9em.label: Preemptive Rights Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9em.definition: A preemptive rights clause is a provision in a contract that grants a party the right to purchase additional shares of stock in a company before they are offered to the public, thereby maintaining their percentage of ownership.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9eu.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Sullivan County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9eu.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Sullivan County: A court of law in Missouri that has jurisdiction over legal cases within Sullivan County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ew.label: Washington Pollution Control Hearings Board
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ew.definition: The Washington Pollution Control Hearings Board is a specialized court within the Washington State Courts system that hears cases related to environmental pollution and enforces regulations to protect the environment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9f5.label: Invoice Date Sent
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9f5.definition: The "Invoice Date Sent" concept refers to the specific date on which an invoice for legal services was sent to the client.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fE.label: Educational Accountability and Standards Regulation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fE.definition: Educational Accountability and Standards Regulation refers to the set of legal standards and requirements imposed on educational institutions to ensure consistent quality of education, student performance, and transparency in reporting outcomes. This encompasses mandates related to standardized testing, proficiency benchmarks, obligations of schools to disclose student progress metrics, and mechanisms to hold schools responsible for delivering high-quality education, as seen in acts like the No Child Left Behind and the Every Student Succeeds Act.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fK.label: Artistic Work
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fK.definition: An Artistic Work is a creation that expresses artistic or aesthetic value through visual or audio mediums, protected under copyright law. This includes paintings, sculptures, photographs, and other visual arts, granting the creator exclusive rights to reproduce, distribute, and display their work.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fP.label: Minnesota District Court - Washington County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fP.definition: Minnesota District Court - Washington County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Washington County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fU.label: Motion for Voluntary Dismissal by Stipulation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fU.definition: A Motion for Voluntary Dismissal by Stipulation is a legal document filed by parties in a lawsuit that requests the court to dismiss the case by agreement of all parties involved.
english_labels: Motion for Voluntary Dismissal by Stipulation

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fU.label: Carve-out
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fU.definition: A carve-out divestiture is a corporate action in which a company partially divests a business unit, division, or subsidiary by selling a minority stake, often through an initial public offering (IPO). The parent company retains majority ownership and control of the carved-out entity, while the new shareholders hold a minority stake. Carve-out divestitures are typically executed to raise capital, unlock value, or allow the separated entity to focus on its core competencies while maintaining a strategic relationship with the parent company.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fX.label: Antitrust - Horizontal Agreement/Conspiracy Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fX.definition: A claim made under antitrust law alleging an agreement or conspiracy between competitors operating at the same level of the market to restrain trade, limit competition, or fix prices.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fd.label: Florida County Court - Marion County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fd.definition: Florida County Court - Marion County is a specific court located in Marion County, Florida that handles civil and criminal cases within its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fe.label: Minnesota District Court - Kittson County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fe.definition: Minnesota District Court - Kittson County: A court of law in the state of Minnesota that has jurisdiction over legal cases and disputes specifically within Kittson County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fi.label: Consideration - Mixed Cash and Stock - Election
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fi.definition: A mixed cash and stock election consideration is a type of consideration in a legal matter where the party receiving payment has the option to choose between receiving cash or stock as part of the payment.
english_labels: Consideration - Mixed Cash and Stock - Election

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fr.label: Georgia Superior Court - Wilcox County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fr.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Wilcox County is a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Wilcox County, Georgia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fs.label: Partnership Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fs.definition: A Partnership Claim is a legal action brought by one or more partners against the partnership or other partners for breach of partnership agreement or other wrongdoing.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ft.label: Analysis of DIP Financing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ft.definition: Analysis of DIP Financing refers to the examination and evaluation of the debtor-in-possession financing obtained by a company during bankruptcy proceedings, as a means of determining the best use of available cash.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fx.label: Danish
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fx.definition: Danish (Language) is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary used in Denmark and parts of Greenland and the Faroe Islands.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fy.label: Fiber Evidence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fy.definition: Fiber evidence comprises tiny threads or fragments from textiles found at crime scenes or on objects. Forensic analysis can determine the type, source, and sometimes specific origin of the fiber, potentially connecting a suspect to a location or another piece of evidence.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fz.label: Failure to Identify to a Police Officer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9fz.definition: The failure of an individual to disclose their identity to a police officer, which is categorized as a criminal misdemeanor offense.
english_labels: Failure to Identify to a Police Officer

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9g0.label: Aragonese
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9g0.definition: Aragonese (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Aragonese region of Spain.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9g0.label: Contractual Standardization
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9g0.definition: Contractual Standardization refers to the extent to which the terms of a contract are standardized or custom-tailored. Standardized contracts have predefined terms and conditions that are universally applied, facilitating easier trading and regulatory compliance, while non-standardized contracts are customized to meet specific needs of the contracting parties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9g6.label: Patent Infringement - Design Patents
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9g6.definition: The unauthorized use or imitation of a unique ornamental design protected by a patent.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9g6.label: Spinocerebellar Degeneration
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9g6.definition: Spinocerebellar degeneration is a group of progressive neurological disorders characterized by the degeneration of the spinal cord and cerebellum, leading to impaired motor coordination, balance, and sensory functions. This condition often manifests with symptoms such as ataxia, gait disturbances, and loss of coordination.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gC.label: Indiana Superior Court - Tippecanoe County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gC.definition: The Indiana Superior Court - Tippecanoe County is a specific court within the Indiana Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over cases within Tippecanoe County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gD.label: Mixed Use - Real Estate Asset
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gD.definition: Properties containing more than one Real Estate Asset (as listed in this category).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gF.label: Motion to Remove Professional
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gF.definition: A Motion to Remove Professional is a request made in a bankruptcy case to remove a professional, such as an attorney or accountant, from their role in the case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gF.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Pope Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gF.definition: The Arkansas Circuit Court - Pope Cty. is a specific court within the Arkansas Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Pope County, Arkansas.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gO.label: Service Waiting
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gO.definition: Service Waiting refers to the period during which a task is on hold, pending completion of work by an external party. This could include waiting for a court ruling, receiving documents from opposing counsel, or other necessary actions by third parties that are required to proceed.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gV.label: Criminal Lineup
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gV.definition: A criminal lineup is a procedure used by law enforcement in which a witness or victim of a crime is presented with a series of individuals, one of whom is the suspect, to determine if the witness can identify the perpetrator. The lineup can be live, with individuals standing in person, or photo-based, using pictures of potential suspects. Proper protocols are essential to ensure fairness and avoid unintentional suggestion or bias.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gW.label: South Carolina Administrative Law Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gW.definition: The South Carolina Administrative Law Court is a specialized court within the South Carolina State Courts system that hears cases related to administrative law disputes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gZ.label: Tennessee Supreme Court - Special Workers' Compensation Appeals Panel
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gZ.definition: The Tennessee Supreme Court - Special Workers' Compensation Appeals Panel is a specialized division of the Tennessee Supreme Court that handles appeals related to workers' compensation cases.
english_labels: Tennessee Supreme Court - Special Workers' Compensation Appeals Panel

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gc.label: Suicide and "Right to Die" Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gc.definition: The concept of "Suicide and 'Right to Die' Claims" refers to legal claims and arguments related to intentional self-harm or assisted suicide, including cases involving prisoners and allegations of negligence.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gd.label: New York Supreme Court - Genesee County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gd.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Genesee County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Genesee County, New York, which hears civil and criminal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.
english_labels: New York Supreme Court - Genesee County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gf.label: Relief from Stay Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gf.definition: Relief from Stay Practice (Adequate Protection) refers to the legal practice of ensuring that a creditor's interest in property is protected during a bankruptcy proceeding, by providing adequate protection to the creditor's collateral.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gh.label: Redemption Rights Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gh.definition: A Redemption Rights Clause is a provision in a contract that grants the holder the right to redeem or repurchase the subject of the contract, typically property or securities, under certain conditions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gq.label: U.S. Trademark Trial and Appeal Board
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gq.definition: The U.S. Trademark Trial and Appeal Board (TTAB) is a specialized administrative tribunal within the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) that hears and decides disputes related to trademark registration and infringement.
english_labels: U.S. Trademark Trial and Appeal Board

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gq.label: Child Dependency Permanency
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gq.definition: Dependency Permanency refers to the legal remedies, relief, and penalties related to the options available for a child's living arrangements when they cannot remain with their biological parents, including APPLA, return to parent, TPR, and adoption.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gy.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Steuben County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gy.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Steuben County, Indiana, with the power to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gz.label: Intellectual Property Representation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9gz.definition: Intellectual Property Representation is a clause in merger and acquisition agreements where the selling party confirms the ownership, validity, and enforceability of the intellectual property assets held by the target company. It serves to assure the buyer that the target's intellectual property, including patents, trademarks, copyrights, and trade secrets, is free from encumbrances, infringements, or disputes, and that they hold significant value for the acquisition.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9h0.label: Motion to Redeem
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9h0.definition: A Motion to Redeem is a legal request made in a bankruptcy case by a debtor to retain ownership of a property by paying off the creditor's claim in full.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9h5.label: Payment Document
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9h5.definition: A Payment Document is a record that substantiates a financial transaction between parties, such as payments made or received. Examples include invoices, receipts, and payment confirmations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9h9.label: Freedom of Movement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9h9.definition: Freedom of movement is a fundamental human right that allows individuals to travel, reside, and work within their own country or internationally without unjustified restrictions. Protected by various international human rights instruments, such as the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (Article 13) and the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights (Article 12), this right encompasses both the liberty to move within a country's borders and the freedom to leave and return to one's own country or to enter and reside in another country, subject to certain limitations for reasons of national security, public order, or public health.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9h9.label: "Material Adverse Effect" Definition - Exceptions - Consummation of the Transaction
english_labels: "Material Adverse Effect" Definition - Exceptions - Consummation of the Transaction

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hC.label: TR399 Other Domestic Trademark Application Preparation and Filing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hC.definition: Use only for trademark application preparation activities that can not be included under a previous code or as instructed by the client.
english_labels: TR399 Other Domestic Trademark Application Preparation and Filing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hJ.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Huntingdon County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hJ.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Huntingdon County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Huntingdon County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hM.label: News Aggregator Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hM.definition: News Aggregator Management refers to the process of organizing and managing the collection and distribution of news articles from various sources, within the context of legal research.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hR.label: Discovery Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hR.definition: Discovery Practice refers to the process of obtaining evidence and information from the opposing party in a legal matter, including document collection and production, written discovery, depositions, and discovery motion practice.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hT.label: Milestone Objectives
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hT.definition: Milestone Objectives are specific goals or targets that must be achieved within a project, serving as markers of progress towards the overall project management objectives.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hV.label: Insurer Wrongfully Disclosing Confidential Information
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hV.definition: The unauthorized release of private information by an insurance company.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hW.label: Morongo Band of Mission Indians, California
english_labels: Morongo Band of Mission Indians, California

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hX.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Whitley County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hX.definition: A court located in Whitley County, Indiana that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographic area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hX.label: Usurpation of Corporate Opportunity
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hX.definition: The Usurpation of Corporate Opportunity is a claim made against a corporation or partnership for taking advantage of a business opportunity that rightfully belongs to the company, thereby depriving the company of the opportunity to pursue it.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hY.label: Sailboat
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hY.definition: A Sailboat is a watercraft propelled primarily by sails, using wind power to navigate and maneuver. Sailboats are commonly used for recreation, sport, and racing, and vary in size from small dinghies to large cruising yachts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hZ.label: Minnesota District Court - McLeod County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hZ.definition: Minnesota District Court - McLeod County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within McLeod County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ha.label: Treaty Clause Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ha.definition: A Treaty Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a particular action or law violates the Treaty Clause of the United States Constitution. This claim contends that the action or law undermines or contradicts the authority granted to the President and the Senate in making and implementing treaties, which requires Senate approval and compliance with the constitutional procedures outlined in the Treaty Clause.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ha.label: Vendor ID of Legal Services Provider
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ha.definition: The ID of the provider used by the client.
english_labels: Vendor ID of Legal Services Provider

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hh.label: Avoidance of Statutory liens
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hh.definition: The concept of "Avoidance of Statutory Liens" refers to the legal action taken to prevent the enforcement of liens that are created by statute.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hi.label: Pregnancy Status
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hi.definition: Pregnancy status refers to the condition of a woman being pregnant, which is the period during which she carries a developing fetus within her uterus. In many jurisdictions, including the United States, discrimination based on pregnancy status is unlawful in various contexts, such as employment, housing, and public services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hi.label: President
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hi.definition: A president is the elected head of state and, in many systems, also the head of government, responsible for executing laws, directing foreign and domestic policy, and representing the nation both domestically and internationally. The specific powers and duties of a president vary by country and are usually defined by a constitution or similar foundational legal document.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hr.label: Near Par
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hr.definition: Near Par refers to the trading price of a financial instrument, such as a bond or loan, that is close to its face value or nominal value. This indicates that the market price is approximately equal to the par value, typically within a narrow range above or below par.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hr.label: Academic Transcript
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9hr.definition: An Academic Transcript is an official record provided by an educational institution that details a student's academic performance and history. It typically lists courses taken, grades received, credits earned, and any honors or awards conferred, serving as a comprehensive account of a student's academic achievements throughout their time at that institution.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9i2.label: Buyer Consent Not Unreasonably Conditioned
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9i2.definition: Buyer Consent Not Unreasonably Conditioned: A legal concept that requires a buyer's consent to be freely given without any unreasonable conditions imposed by the seller.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9i2.label: New York Supreme Court - Wayne County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9i2.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Wayne County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Wayne County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of civil and criminal cases.
english_labels: New York Supreme Court - Wayne County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9i3.label: Accountant
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9i3.definition: An expert in the field of accounting.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9i4.label: Minnesota District Court - Wabasha County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9i4.definition: Minnesota District Court - Wabasha County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system located in Wabasha County, responsible for administering legal proceedings within its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9iC.label: South Carolina Office of the Attorney General
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9iC.definition: The South Carolina Office of the Attorney General is a government entity responsible for providing legal advice and representation to the state of South Carolina, operating under the jurisdiction of the South Carolina State Courts.
english_labels: South Carolina Office of the Attorney General

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9iG.label: Go-Shop Covenant
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9iG.definition: A Go-Shop Covenant is a provision in a deal protection agreement that allows the target company to seek out alternative offers from other potential buyers during a specified period of time, while still honoring the original offer.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9iH.label: Limited Probate
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9iH.definition: Limited Probate is a type of filing in the probate process that is restricted in scope and typically involves a specific aspect of an estate, such as the distribution of a particular asset or the appointment of a temporary administrator.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9iI.label: Blissymbols; Blissymbolics; Bliss
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9iI.definition: A system of symbols used for communication, originally developed for individuals with communication disabilities, now used more broadly for international communication.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9iN.label: Exchange Equity for Equity
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9iN.definition: An asset exchange where a party swaps one type of equity for another. This can occur during mergers or acquisitions to consolidate ownership interests.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9iQ.label: Peripheral Vision Loss
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9iQ.definition: Contraction of the visual field in the better eye refers to a significant reduction in the area of vision around the point of fixation. This condition is characterized by one or more specific measurements indicating severe restriction in the visual field.
english_labels: Contraction of the Visual Field in the Better Eye

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9iR.label: Family & Parenting Market Segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9iR.definition: The family & parenting market segment refers to a division of the market that is specifically targeted towards consumers who are parents or caregivers, focusing on products and services that cater to the needs of families and children. This segment encompasses a wide range of offerings, from child-rearing essentials to family-oriented activities, all designed to support the well-being, development, and enjoyment of family life.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9iT.label: Tutoring
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9iT.definition: Tutoring refers to the provision of educational assistance or instruction by a tutor to a student, as a condition of a criminal disposition imposed on the student's parents.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9iU.label: Equitable Relief
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9iU.definition: Equitable Relief refers to a type of legal remedy sought in civil cases that aims to provide fairness and justice to the parties involved, often through actions such as injunctions, specific performance, or rescission.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9iX.label: Workers' Compensation Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9iX.definition: A Workers' Compensation Court is a specific type of administrative proceeding forum that handles disputes related to workers' compensation claims.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9iX.label: Whole Life Insurance
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9iX.definition: Whole life insurance is a type of permanent life insurance that provides coverage for the insured's entire lifetime. The policy includes a death benefit and typically a cash value component that grows over time, and the premiums are generally fixed and paid for the life of the policy.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ig.label: Entertainment Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ig.definition: Entertainment Law encompasses the legal services and regulations that govern the entertainment industry, including film, television, music, theater, and digital media. It deals with matters such as intellectual property, contracts, labor relations, and litigation related to entertainment activities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ih.label: Public Health Insurance Policy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ih.definition: Public health insurance is a government-sponsored program designed to provide healthcare coverage to eligible individuals or populations. Examples in the United States include Medicare, for older adults, and Medicaid, for low-income individuals. Coverage and eligibility criteria are determined by the government.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ik.label: Authority
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ik.definition: Authority is the legal power or right to give orders, make decisions, and enforce obedience.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9im.label: Florida County Court - Calhoun County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9im.definition: A court located in Calhoun County, Florida that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9im.label: Luo
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9im.definition: A language spoken in Kenya and Tanzania, characterized by its unique grammar and vocabulary.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ip.label: Hardship Discharge
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ip.definition: A Military Hardship Discharge is granted when a service member faces extreme and unforeseeable personal or financial hardships that significantly affect their ability to continue serving. The hardships could include serious illness of a family member or severe financial strain, and they must be conditions that have developed or dramatically worsened after enlisting.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ir.label: Stipulation to Convert Case from Chapter 13 to Chapter 7
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ir.definition: A Stipulation to Convert Case from Chapter 13 to Chapter 7 is a legal agreement between a debtor and creditor that allows the debtor to change their bankruptcy case from Chapter 13 to Chapter 7.
english_labels: Stipulation to Convert Case from Chapter 13 to Chapter 7

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9j2.label: Waiver of Right of First Refusal Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9j2.definition: A Waiver of Right of First Refusal Clause is a provision in a contract that allows a party to give up their right to be the first to purchase or lease a property or asset before it is offered to others.
english_labels: Waiver of Right of First Refusal Clause

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jG.label: Mineral Rights
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jG.definition: Mineral rights pertain to the ownership and control of the minerals (like coal, oil, and gas) beneath a plot of land. The owner of mineral rights can lease, sell, or transfer these rights to others.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jJ.label: Independent Creation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jJ.definition: Independent Creation in copyright law refers to the creation of a work without copying from other sources, relying solely on the author's own skill, judgment, and creativity. It emphasizes the requirement that a work must originate from the author and not be replicated from existing materials.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jL.label: Terroristic Threats
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jL.definition: The concept of "Terroristic Threats" refers to the act of making threats to cause serious harm or death to individuals or groups of people, with the intention of creating fear and panic in society.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jN.label: Negligent Interference with Good Samaritan
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jN.definition: Negligent Interference with Good Samaritan: A claim of negligence that arises when a person who is rendering aid to another is prevented from doing so by the negligent actions of a third party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jO.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - DeBaca County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jO.definition: A court in DeBaca County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases.
english_labels: New Mexico Magistrate Court - DeBaca County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jP.label: Stipulation for Adequate Protection
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jP.definition: A Stipulation for Adequate Protection is a legal agreement between parties that ensures a creditor's interest in property is protected during bankruptcy proceedings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jQ.label: Sovereign Issuer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jQ.definition: A Sovereign Issuer refers to a national government or its agencies that issue debt securities to raise capital for public expenditures, such as infrastructure projects or budget deficits. These securities, often called government bonds, are backed by the full faith and credit of the issuing government.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jR.label: O-1 Visa
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jR.definition: An O-1 visa is issued to individuals with extraordinary ability in the sciences, arts, education, business, or athletics, recognized at a national or international level. This visa allows them to enter the U.S. to continue work in their field of expertise.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jX.label: Local Counsel Expense
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jX.definition: The term "Local Counsel Expense" refers to the costs incurred by a party in a legal matter for hiring an attorney who is licensed to practice in a specific jurisdiction where the legal matter is pending.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jj.label: Motion to Stay Deportation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jj.definition: A Motion to Stay Deportation is a legal request to temporarily halt the process of removing an individual from a country, typically filed by an individual facing deportation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jl.label: Georgia District Court - Henry County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jl.definition: Georgia District Court - Henry County: A specific court within the Georgia District Court system located in Henry County, responsible for administering legal proceedings within its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jp.label: Judgment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jp.definition: A Judgment is a written decision by a court or other tribunal determining the rights and obligations of the parties involved in a legal dispute, often following a trial or other legal proceeding.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jx.label: Criminal Claim Modifiers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jx.definition: Criminal Claim Modifiers are specific types of claims made in a legal matter related to criminal activity, including threatened, attempted, and aggravated claims.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jy.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Barry County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9jy.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Barry County: A specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Barry County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9k5.label: Hupa
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9k5.definition: Hupa is a Native American language spoken by the Hupa people in California, characterized by its unique phonology and grammar.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9k6.label: Multinational Manager or Executive Immigrant Petition
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9k6.definition: A Multinational Manager or Executive Immigrant Petition (in the U.S., the I-140 EB-1) allows multinational companies to sponsor foreign nationals who have been employed abroad in a managerial or executive capacity to apply for permanent residency in the United States. Applicants must have been employed outside the United States for at least one year in the three years preceding the petition or the most recent lawful nonimmigrant admission if already working for the U.S. petitioning employer. The U.S. petitioner must have been doing business for at least one year, have a qualifying relationship to the entity the applicant worked for outside the U.S., and intend to employ the applicant in a managerial or executive capacity.
english_labels: Multinational Manager or Executive Immigrant Petition

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9k6.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Cleburne Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9k6.definition: The Arkansas Circuit Court - Cleburne Cty. is a specific court within the Arkansas Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Cleburne County, Arkansas.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9k6.label: Union Certification Election
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9k6.definition: A formal process by which the regulator (e.g., National Labor Relations Board (NLRB)) certifies a union or other employee organization as the official representative of a group of employees, typically after an election. Certification occurs when the union wins the majority of votes cast in a secret-ballot election overseen by the regulator (e.g., NLRB).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9k8.label: Data Privacy Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9k8.definition: Data Privacy Management refers to the process of ensuring that personal information is collected, used, and shared in compliance with applicable laws and regulations, as well as industry best practices.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9k9.label: Motion for Sale of Property
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9k9.definition: A Motion for Sale of Property is a legal request made in a bankruptcy case seeking court approval to sell assets or property, often to pay off creditors.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9kB.label: Gallbladder Cancer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9kB.definition: Gallbladder cancer is a type of cancer that originates in the gallbladder, a small organ beneath the liver that stores bile. It is often diagnosed at an advanced stage due to its asymptomatic nature in early stages, and typically requires treatments such as surgery, chemotherapy, and radiation therapy.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9kK.label: American Arbitration Association
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9kK.definition: The American Arbitration Association (AAA) is an alternative dispute resolution venue that provides administration and management of arbitration proceedings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9kP.label: Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa Indians of North Dakota
english_labels: Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa Indians of North Dakota

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9kP.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Dauphin County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9kP.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Dauphin County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in the state of Pennsylvania.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Dauphin County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9kR.label: Fiscal Monopoly Profit Payment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9kR.definition: Fiscal Monopoly Profit Payment refers to the portion of profits generated by government-controlled monopolies that is transferred to the general government or used to finance government expenditures. These profits are considered part of government revenue and are recorded when they are either transferred to the government or used to cover government expenditures.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9kR.label: Lack of Capacity
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9kR.definition: In criminal law, a "lack of capacity" refers to a defendant's inability, due to mental illness, cognitive impairment, or other factors, to understand the nature and consequences of their actions or to conform their behavior to the requirements of the law. If proven, this lack of capacity can be a defense in some cases, as it may negate the defendant's criminal responsibility for the alleged actions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9kW.label: Kannada
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9kW.definition: Kannada (Language) is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary used in the Indian state of Karnataka and by Kannada-speaking communities around the world.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9kX.label: Matter Funds Applied
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9kX.definition: The concept of "Matter Funds Applied" refers to the portion of an engagement fee that is specifically allocated to cover expenses related to a particular legal matter, as opposed to the fee being applied generally to the overall engagement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9kY.label: Control of Property Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9kY.definition: A Control of Property Clause is a provision in a contract that grants one party the authority to manage or regulate a specific property or asset, typically for the duration of the contract.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9kj.label: Medical Expenses
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9kj.definition: Medical Expenses refer to the costs incurred for medical treatment and care, including both past and future expenses, as a result of an injury or illness, and are considered a type of economic damage in legal cases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9kk.label: Rent Coverage Ratio Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9kk.definition: A Rent Coverage Ratio Clause is a provision in a contract that requires a tenant to maintain a certain level of income in order to ensure they can afford to pay rent.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9km.label: 365 Personal Injury - Product Liability (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9km.definition: Action alleging personal injury or death resulting from a defective product. (Excludes a marine or airplane product)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9km.label: Engagement Attributes
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9km.definition: Engagement Attributes are specific aspects that define the scope, nature, and terms of a legal service engagement, including both internally facing provisions for the legal services provider and externally facing terms for the legal services buyer. These attributes encompass the specifics of the legal services to be provided, the responsibilities of each party, and the financial arrangements.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9kp.label: Central Vision Loss
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9kp.definition: Central vision loss refers to the significant impairment or complete loss of vision in the central part of the visual field, while peripheral vision remains intact. This condition often results from diseases affecting the macula or the central retina, leading to difficulties with tasks that require detailed vision, such as reading or recognizing faces, despite maintaining peripheral awareness.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9kr.label: Document Provenance
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9kr.definition: Source of a particular document, which could include Forums (e.g., courts, government agencies), Actors (e.g., Plaintiff, Lender), vendors (e.g., Thomson Reuters, LexisNexis, vLex, Fastcase, Docket Alarm), or many others.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ks.label: General Fiduciary Exemption Language
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ks.definition: General Fiduciary Exemption Language refers to a legal provision that exempts fiduciaries from liability for certain actions or decisions that may be inconsistent with their fiduciary duties, as long as they were made in good faith and with reasonable care.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ku.label: Taxes Representation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ku.definition: Taxes Representation is a provision in merger and acquisition agreements where the selling party attests to the accuracy and completeness of the target entity's tax returns, payments, and compliance with all applicable tax laws and regulations. It serves to assure the buyer that the target company has no undisclosed tax liabilities or issues, and that all tax obligations up to the date of the agreement have been appropriately addressed.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9kv.label: Blackberries
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9kv.definition: Blackberries are aggregate fruits composed of small drupelets, characterized by their dark purple to black color and sweet-tart flavor. Widely cultivated and foraged in temperate regions, blackberries are consumed fresh, processed into jams and desserts, and valued for their high antioxidant content.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ky.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Union County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ky.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Union County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within Union County, Pennsylvania.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Union County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9lF.label: Robbery
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9lF.definition: The taking, or attempting to take, anything of value under confrontational circumstances from the control, custody, or care of another person by force or threat of force or violence and/or by putting the victim in fear of immediate harm.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9lG.label: Deposition Transcript
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9lG.definition: A deposition transcript is a written record of the spoken testimony given by a witness under oath during a legal proceeding.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9lI.label: Sales Tax Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9lI.definition: Sales tax practice refers to the specialized legal service in which lawyers advise businesses on the collection, remittance, and reporting of sales tax, as well as represent them in disputes with tax authorities. The practice covers understanding jurisdictional differences, ensuring compliance with state and local regulations, and managing audits or assessments.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9lL.label: Polish
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9lL.definition: Polish (Language) is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary used in Poland and by Polish speakers worldwide.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9lW.label: Voluntary Dismissal
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9lW.definition: A voluntary dismissal is a legal action taken by a plaintiff to end a case without prejudice, meaning they can refile the case at a later time.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9lZ.label: Bills of Costs
