https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9wj.definition: The act of seducing someone through deceit or manipulation, resulting in harm or damages, which can be legally pursued as a tort claim.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9wl.label: Motion to Intervene
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9wl.definition: A Motion to Intervene is a legal request made by a non-party to join an ongoing case in order to protect their interests or rights.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9wm.label: Motion to Refer Case to Mediation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9wm.definition: A Motion to Refer Case to Mediation is a formal request made by a party in a legal case to have the case referred to a mediator for resolution, rather than proceeding to trial or appeal.
english_labels: Motion to Refer Case to Mediation

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9x0.label: Previous Testimony
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9x0.definition: Prior Under-Oath Statements are statements made by a witness under oath in a previous legal proceeding or deposition that are admissible as non-hearsay evidence in a current trial or hearing. These statements are considered reliable because they were made under the penalty of perjury and subject to cross-examination at the time they were originally given.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9x5.label: Wild Animal
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9x5.definition: A Wild Animal is a species that lives and thrives in its natural habitat without direct dependence on or control by humans. These animals have not been domesticated and typically rely on their instincts and the environment to find food, shelter, and survive.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9x6.label: Legal Services Provider
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9x6.definition: A person or entity that is providing legal services to another person or entity

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9x9.label: Ainu
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9x9.definition: Ainu (Language) refers to the language spoken by the Ainu people, an indigenous group from Japan and Russia, and is a subcategory of the Language class in the ontology.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xB.label: JM10 Preparing costs claim (UK J-CODE)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xB.definition: Includes the reconciliation of the costs claimed to any approved budget in and the preparation of the bill of costs for detailed assessment

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xC.label: eDiscovery Technology Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xC.definition: eDiscovery Technology Management refers to the process of managing electronic discovery tools and technologies in the context of litigation management.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xE.label: Prison Guard
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xE.definition: A Prison Guard is a security officer responsible for maintaining order, enforcing rules, and ensuring the safety of inmates and staff within a correctional facility. They perform duties such as monitoring inmate activities, conducting searches, and responding to emergencies to prevent disturbances and uphold security protocols.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xI.label: Order Denying Request
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xI.definition: An Order Denying Request is a legal document issued by a court that denies a request made by one party to the court by providing a decision against the request.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xI.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Allegheny County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xI.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Allegheny County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within Allegheny County.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Allegheny County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xO.label: Personal Injury Ruleset
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xO.definition: A Personal Injury Ruleset is a set of legal rules and guidelines that specifically pertain to cases involving physical or emotional harm caused by another party's negligence or intentional actions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xP.label: Certificate of Service of Tax Information to Requestor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xP.definition: A Certificate of Service of Tax Information to Requestor is a written document that confirms the delivery of tax information to the person who requested it.
english_labels: Certificate of Service of Tax Information to Requestor

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xQ.label: Public Matter Narrative
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xQ.definition: A public version of a matter narrative.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xT.label: Texas Court of Appeals - 12th
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xT.definition: The Texas Court of Appeals - 12th is a specific intermediate appellate court in Texas that hears appeals from lower courts within its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xX.label: Insolvent Lessor Having Leased Goods
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xX.definition: An Insolvent Lessor Having Leased Goods refers to a legal claim arising from a contract or quasi-contract where the lessor of goods is unable to pay their debts and has leased the goods to another party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xc.label: Homestead Exemption
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xc.definition: In a homestead exemption, a property is protected from being sold to pay off debts in a bankruptcy case, as it is considered essential for the debtor's basic needs and livelihood.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xe.label: Minnesota District Court - Marshall County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xe.definition: Minnesota District Court - Marshall County is a specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Marshall County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xg.label: Buyer Consent Requirement Application
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xg.definition: A Buyer Consent Requirement Application is a specific instance where a buyer's consent is necessary for the execution of a negative covenant, either for all negative covenants or only for specified ones.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xj.label: Motion to Amend Judgment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xj.definition: A Motion to Amend Judgment is a legal request to modify or correct a court's decision or order, typically made after a judgment has been entered.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xm.label: Yakut
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xm.definition: Yakut (Language) is a specific written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, used in legal matters, and is a subcategory of the Language class.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xo.label: Termination of Parental Rights Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xo.definition: Termination of Parental Rights (TPR) Claim is a legal action taken to permanently end a parent's legal rights and responsibilities towards their child, typically due to abuse, neglect, or abandonment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xr.label: Complete Agreement Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xr.definition: A Complete Agreement Clause is a provision in a contract that states that the written agreement represents the entire understanding between the parties and supersedes any prior negotiations or agreements.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xw.label: Georgia Superior Court - Newton County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9xw.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia, located in Newton County and having authority over civil and criminal cases within its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9y2.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Clinton County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9y2.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Clinton County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Clinton County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9y5.label: Manual
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9y5.definition: A Manual is a comprehensive document that provides guidelines, instructions, or procedures for a particular activity or function within an organization or system. Types of manuals can range from employee handbooks to board manuals, each tailored to meet the specific needs of its intended audience.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9y9.label: Employee Breach of Fiduciary Duty
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9y9.definition: An Employee Breach of Fiduciary Duty refers to a situation where an employee violates their legal obligation to act in the best interest of their employer by engaging in actions that benefit themselves or a third party, resulting in harm to the employer.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9yA.label: Single Joint Expert
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9yA.definition: An expert who prepares a report or testimony on behalf of two or more parties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9yU.label: Law Under Review
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9yU.definition: Law Under Review refers to legal rules or regulations that are currently being evaluated or reconsidered for their validity or effectiveness, and are not yet fully in force or effect.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9yX.label: CFIUS Covenant
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9yX.definition: A CFIUS Covenant is a provision in a legal agreement that outlines the conditions and requirements for approval by the Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States (CFIUS) for a foreign investment in a US company.
english_labels: Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States Covenant

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9yY.label: Visa for Intended Spouse of Citizen
english_labels: This non-immigrant visa category for the intended spouse or fiancé(e) of a destination-country citizen (in the U.S., the K-1 visa) allows the foreign-citizen fiancé(e) to travel to the destination country for the purpose of marrying their citizen sponsor within a short period (e.g., within 90 days of arrival), after which they can apply for adjustment of status to become a lawful permanent resident
Visa for Fiancé(e) of U.S. Citizen
Visa for Intended Spouse of Citizen

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9yZ.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Lebanon County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9yZ.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Lebanon County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that handles minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil cases involving amounts up to $12,000.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Lebanon County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ya.label: Social Security Number
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9ya.definition: A Social Security Number (SSN) is a nine-digit identification number issued by the U.S. Social Security Administration. Primarily used for tracking individuals for taxation purposes, the SSN has also become a de facto national identification number used for various other legal, financial, and personal identification activities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9yi.label: Hearsay Avoidance Objectives
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9yi.definition: Hearsay Avoidance Objectives refer to the various purposes or exceptions that allow out-of-court statements to be admitted into evidence during a legal proceeding, thereby avoiding the exclusion of such statements under the hearsay rule. These objectives include direct testimony, present sense impression, excited utterance, and situations where the declarant is unavailable to testify in person.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9yj.label: Reasonable Suspicion
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9yj.definition: Reasonable Suspicion is a legal standard that requires an officer to have a belief, based on specific and articulable facts, that a person is involved in criminal activity or is about to be involved in criminal activity.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9yj.label: Subrogation Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9yj.definition: A subrogation clause is a provision in a contract that allows one party to step into the shoes of another party and assume their legal rights and remedies in the event of a loss or damage.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9yk.label: Tamil
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9yk.definition: Tamil (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Tamil language, used in legal matters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9yq.label: Estate Planning Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9yq.definition: Estate Planning Practice involves the preparation and arrangement of an individual's estate to manage and distribute assets during their lifetime and after death. It includes creating legal documents such as wills, trusts, and powers of attorney to ensure that an individual's wishes are followed and to minimize taxes and legal complications.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9yt.label: Processing of Documents Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9yt.definition: The Processing of Documents Practice refers to the specific legal work involved in collecting and producing documents in the course of a legal matter, and is a subcategory of the Document Collection and Production Practice.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9yx.label: Virtual Reality
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9yx.definition: A Virtual Reality Experience is an immersive, interactive environment created using computer technology that simulates a real or imagined world, allowing users to engage with the environment through specialized hardware such as VR headsets.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9yz.label: Notice of Appearance and Request for Notice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9yz.definition: A Notice of Appearance and Request for Notice is a legal document filed by an attorney to inform the court and opposing counsel that they are representing a party in a case and to request that all future notices and documents related to the case be sent to them.
english_labels: Notice of Appearance and Request for Notice

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9z1.label: Warranty of Title Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9z1.definition: A Warranty of Title Clause is a provision in a contract that guarantees the seller's legal ownership of the property being sold and promises to defend the buyer against any claims made by third parties regarding the title.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9z5.label: Judicial Recommendation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9z5.definition: A judicial recommendation is a document created by a trial court that provides guidance or advice to a higher court or decision-making body.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9z7.label: Intervening Event - Unknown at Signing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9z7.definition: An "Intervening Event - Unknown at Signing" is a circumstance or occurrence that happens after the signing of a legal agreement, which was not anticipated or known at the time of signing and may affect the performance or outcome of the agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9z8.label: Motion for New Trial - Clerical Error
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9z8.definition: A Motion for New Trial - Clerical Error is a legal request made by a party to a case asking the court to reconsider its decision due to a mistake made in the court's records or paperwork, rather than an error in the trial proceedings themselves.
english_labels: Motion for New Trial - Clerical Error

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9z9.label: Pennsylvania District and County Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9z9.definition: A Pennsylvania District and County Court is a court within the Pennsylvania State Courts system that has jurisdiction over cases within a specific district or county.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zA.label: Bad River Band of the Lake Superior Tribe
english_labels: Bad River Band of the Lake Superior Tribe

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zH.label: Consumer Credit Protection Act Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zH.definition: A Consumer Credit Protection Act (CCPA) claim is a legal action initiated by a consumer, alleging that a creditor, employer, or other covered entity has violated their rights under the CCPA. The CCPA is a federal law enacted in 1968 to safeguard consumers' credit rights by regulating various credit practices and providing protections in areas such as wage garnishment, truthful lending disclosures, and debt collection practices. The CCPA encompasses several statutes, including the Truth in Lending Act (TILA), Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), Equal Credit Opportunity Act (ECOA), and the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA). A CCPA claim may involve issues such as improper wage garnishment, inaccurate credit reporting, discrimination in credit decisions, or abusive debt collection tactics.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zN.label: Condominium Association
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zN.definition: A condominium association is a governing body or organization established within a condominium complex or community. It is typically composed of unit owners within the condominium development. The association's primary responsibilities include managing and maintaining common areas and facilities, enforcing rules and regulations outlined in the condominium's governing documents, and collecting fees or assessments from unit owners to cover shared expenses. It plays a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation and upkeep of the condominium community.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zO.label: New York Supreme Court - Essex County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zO.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Essex County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Essex County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal disputes within its geographical jurisdiction.
english_labels: New York Supreme Court - Essex County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zW.label: Leased Premises Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zW.definition: A Leased Premises Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the terms and conditions of a lease agreement for a specific property.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zW.label: New York Supreme Court - Chautauqua County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zW.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Chautauqua County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Chautauqua County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of civil and criminal cases.
english_labels: New York Supreme Court - Chautauqua County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zY.label: Bambara
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zY.definition: A language spoken primarily in Mali and neighboring countries, belonging to the Mande branch of the Niger-Congo language family.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zc.label: Administration of Economic Programs Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zc.definition: The Administration of Economic Programs subsector groups government establishments primarily engaged in the administration of economic programs.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zd.label: Federal Employers Liability Act Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zd.definition: A Federal Employers Liability Act Claim is a legal claim brought by an employee against their employer for injuries sustained on the job due to the employer's negligence, and is governed by federal law.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zf.label: Employment Location Type
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zf.definition: Employment Location Type describes where an employee performs their job duties and can include categories such as onsite, offsite, remote, roving, or third-party placement. These classifications help define the employee's working environment and may impact job responsibilities, oversight, and eligibility for certain benefits or allowances

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zg.label: Mediation Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zg.definition: Mediation is a process wherein the parties meet with a mutually selected impartial and neutral person who assists them in the negotiation of their differences. Mediation leaves the decision power totally and strictly with the parties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zh.label: oasis:function
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zh.definition: A function within the OASIS framework.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zl.label: Irrevocable Trust
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zl.definition: An Irrevocable Trust is a legal entity that, once established, cannot be altered, amended, or revoked by the grantor without the consent of the beneficiaries. Assets transferred into this trust are permanently removed from the grantor's estate, offering potential tax benefits and protection from creditors.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zp.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Socorro County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zp.definition: A court located in Socorro County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases.
english_labels: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Socorro County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zs.label: UTBMS MJ00 Post-Closing Requirements, Disputes & Adjustments
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zs.definition: A category within the UTBMS Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) classification for legal services related to post-closing requirements, disputes, and adjustments.
english_labels: UTBMS MJ00 Post-Closing Requirements, Disputes & Adjustments

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zt.label: Root Vegetables
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zt.definition: Root vegetables are edible plants whose underground parts, such as roots, tubers, and bulbs, are consumed as food. They are known for their nutritional content, including vitamins, minerals, and fiber, and are a staple in many cuisines worldwide due to their versatility and storability.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zw.label: Motion to Waive Appearance at 341 Meeting
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zw.definition: A Motion to Waive Appearance at 341 Meeting is a request made in a bankruptcy case to excuse the debtor from attending the meeting of creditors, which is typically required by law.
english_labels: Motion to Waive Appearance at 341 Meeting

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zy.label: Credit Enhancement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zy.definition: Credit Enhancement refers to strategies employed to improve the credit risk profile of a financial transaction or asset, thereby increasing its credit rating and reducing the risk to investors. Techniques include guarantees, insurance, reserve funds, and collateralization to protect against potential losses.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zy.label: Wildlife Permit
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R9zy.definition: A wildlife permit, such as a hunting or fishing license, is an official authorization granted by a governing authority that allows individuals to legally pursue, capture, or kill specific types of wildlife during designated seasons or under certain conditions. These permits are often used to manage and conserve wildlife populations, and their issuance typically requires payment of a fee, completion of safety courses, and adherence to specified regulations and quotas.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RA03.label: Bushenyi
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RA03.definition: Bushenyi is a district in Uganda.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RA03.label: U.S. Bankruptcy Court - D. South Dakota
english_labels: U.S. Bankruptcy Court - D. South Dakota
United States Bankruptcy Court, D. South Dakota

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RA04.label: Vayoc Jor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RA04.definition: Vayoc Jor is a region in Armenia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RA04.label: Federal Acquisition Service
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RA04.definition: The Federal Acquisition Service (FAS) provides comprehensive solutions for products and services across the government. GSA assists with procurement work for other government agencies. As part of this effort, it maintains the large GSA Schedules, which other agencies can use to buy goods and services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RA05.label: Sukhothai
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RA05.definition: Sukhothai is a city in Thailand.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RA06.label: Ryazanskaya oblast'
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RA06.definition: Ryazanskaya oblast' refers to a region in the Russian Federation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RA06.label: Zagrebacka zupanija
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RA06.definition: Zagrebacka zupanija is a region in Croatia, located in the northwestern part of the country.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RA08.label: Lofa
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RA08.definition: Lofa is a region in Liberia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RA08.label: Suceava
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RA08.definition: Suceava is a city in Romania.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RA08.label: Religious, Grantmaking, Civic, Professional, and Similar Organizations
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RA08.definition: Industries in the Religious, Grantmaking, Civic, Professional, and Similar Organizations subsector group establishments that organize and promote religious activities; support various causes through grantmaking; advocate various social and political causes; and promote and defend the interests of their members. The industry groups within the subsector are defined in terms of their activities, such as establishments that provide funding for specific causes or for a variety of charitable causes; establishments that advocate and actively promote causes and beliefs for the public good; and establishments that have an active membership structure to promote causes and represent the interests of their members. Establishments in this subsector may publish newsletters, books, and periodicals for distribution to their members.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB54.label: Mental Incapacity
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB54.definition: Mental incapacity refers to a condition in which an individual's mental state affects their ability to understand, reason, or make decisions about their own affairs. Mental incapacity can be temporary or permanent and can result from various factors, including age, injury, illness, or developmental disability. In a legal context, mental incapacity can have important implications for an individual's ability to enter into contracts, make decisions about medical treatment, or manage their own affairs. In such cases, a court may appoint a guardian or conservator to act on behalf of the individual with mental incapacity, in order to protect their interests and ensure that their affairs are managed appropriately. Legal proceedings involving mental incapacity can be complex and may require medical evaluations, assessments of decision-making capacity, and other expert testimony.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB55.label: U.S. Medicaid and CHIP Payment and Access Commission

The U.S. Comptroller General appoints MACPAC's 17 commissioners, who come from diverse regions across the United States and bring broad expertise and a wide range of perspectives on Medicaid and CHIP.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB5g.label: Property Air Right

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB5o.definition: The threats and opportunities associated with an organization's design, implementation, and compliance with its own internal policies, procedures, or guidelines. https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB6d.label: Retirement Plan Disclosure
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB6d.definition: A Retirement Plan Disclosure, known in the U.S. as a Form 11-K, is an annual report detailing the financial statements and other information regarding an employee benefit plan sponsored by a publicly traded company. The 11-K provides transparency into the assets, liabilities, income, expenses, and operations of the retirement plan. Form 11-K is a specialized financial disclosure document filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), detailing the financial status of a company's employee benefit plans, such as 401(k) plans. It is an American regulatory requirement aimed at providing transparency concerning the financial health of these plans.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB6e.label: Individual Retirement Account
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB6e.definition: An Individual Retirement Account (IRA) is a personal savings account that offers tax advantages for individuals to save money for retirement. It allows contributions to grow tax-deferred until withdrawal, either in traditional IRAs (pre-tax contributions) or Roth IRAs (after-tax contributions), with different tax implications depending on the type chosen

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB6g.label: Motion for Moratorium

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB6k.label: Kentucky Supreme Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB6m.label: Digestive Disorders

This claim contends that the government entity has breached its duty to provide a comprehensive and accurate account of public funds and expenditures as required by the relevant constitutional provision or statutory requirement

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB7I.label: Educational Services Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB7I.definition: The Educational Services industry group comprises establishments that provide instruction and training in a wide variety of subjects. This instruction and training is provided by specialized establishments, such as schools, colleges, universities, and training centers. These establishments may be privately owned and operated for profit or not for profit, or they may be publicly owned and operated.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB7J.label: Temp Placement Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB7J.definition: Temp Placement Management refers to the management of temporary employees, including their recruitment, hiring, training, and supervision, within the context of overall people management.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB7Q.label: D.V.M. (Doctor of Veterinary Medicine)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB7Q.definition: The suffix "D.V.M." stands for "Doctor of Veterinary Medicine" and is used after a person's name to indicate that they have completed the educational and licensing requirements to practice veterinary medicine. This designation signifies the individual's credentials in animal healthcare and is commonly used in medical, academic, and professional settings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB7S.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Ohio County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB7S.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Ohio County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Indiana, located in Ohio County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB7U.label: Insurance Claims Form
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB7U.definition: An Insurance Claims Form is a standardized document used by a policyholder to request reimbursement or coverage for a loss or event that is insured under their policy. The form usually includes fields for providing details about the claim such as the incident, damages, and other relevant documentation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB7X.label: State Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB7X.definition: A State Court is a legal venue that has jurisdiction over cases within a specific state or county.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB7Z.label: Motion to Correct the Record on Appeal
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB7Z.definition: A Motion to Correct the Record on Appeal is a legal request made to a higher court to amend or supplement the record of a lower court proceeding in order to accurately reflect the facts presented during the trial.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB7h.label: Social Media
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB7h.definition: Social Media includes online services or sites that facilitate the creation, sharing, and interaction of user-generated content through virtual communities and networks. These platforms enable users to communicate, collaborate, and engage with content in real-time, fostering social connections and information exchange.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB7j.label: Bankruptcy Prepack
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB7j.definition: A bankruptcy prepack, or prepackaged bankruptcy, is a type of bankruptcy filing where the debtor negotiates and obtains creditor approval for a reorganization plan before filing for bankruptcy. This streamlined process aims to expedite the bankruptcy proceedings and minimize disruptions to the debtor's operations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB7o.label: Race Discrimination
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB7o.definition: The concept of Race Discrimination refers to the unfair treatment or prejudice against an individual or group based on their race or ethnicity, which is prohibited by law and can be the basis for a discrimination claim.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB7z.definition: A102 Research refers to the specific activity of conducting a systematic investigation or inquiry aimed at discovering new knowledge or information, and is a subcategory of the broader category of A100 Activities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB7z.definition: Acquisition Proposal Language refers to the specific terms and conditions included in a proposal for the acquisition of a company, which may trigger fiduciary exceptions, tail period fee triggers, or breakup fee triggers in a no-shop covenant.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB86.label: En Banc
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB86.definition: An en banc judicial filing refers to a legal submission to a court in which the case is heard before all judges of the court rather than by a panel of judges selected from them. This type of filing is typically reserved for complex cases or those of exceptional public importance, where a full court's review is deemed necessary to ensure a consistent and authoritative judicial decision.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB8f.label: Motion to Appear Nunc Pro Tunc
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB8f.definition: A Motion to Appear Nunc Pro Tunc is a request made to a court to allow a party to appear and act as if they had appeared on an earlier date, typically due to an excusable mistake or neglect.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB8g.label: Passport
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB8g.definition: A passport is a government-issued document that certifies the identity and nationality of the holder, primarily for the purpose of international travel. It contains personal information such as the individual's name, date of birth, and photograph, and is used by authorities to verify identity and citizenship when crossing borders.

These expenses can include items such as travel costs, mileage, or required tools and equipment, and the claim arises when an employer neglects or refuses to reimburse the employee as required by law or the terms of their employment agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB8r.label: U.S. Patent and Trademark Office
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB8r.definition: The United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) is an agency in the U.S. Department of Commerce that issues patents to inventors and businesses for their inventions, and trademark registration for product and intellectual property identification.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB8s.label: Crisis Communications Practice

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB8t.label: Response to Third-Party Complaint

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB9D.definition: An account stated is a legal claim that arises when two parties have agreed on the amount of a debt owed and the debtor has promised to pay it. It falls under the category of contract and quasi-contract claims.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB9E.label: Bali
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB9E.definition: Bali is an Indonesian island known for its beautiful beaches, coral reefs, and cultural landmarks.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB9J.definition: A de novo review is a type of appellate review where the reviewing court considers the matter anew, without giving deference to the lower court's decision.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB9N.label: Amphibians
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB9N.definition: Amphibians are a class of vertebrate animals characterized by their ability to live both in water and on land, undergoing metamorphosis from a larval stage with gills to an adult stage with lungs. https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB9c.label: Merchant Wholesalers, Nondurable Goods Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB9c.definition: Industries in the Merchant Wholesalers, Nondurable Goods industry group sell nondurable goods to other businesses. Nondurable goods merchant wholesale trade establishments are engaged in wholesaling products, such as paper and paper products, chemicals and chemical products, drugs, textiles and textile products, apparel, footwear, groceries, farm products, petroleum and petroleum products, alcoholic beverages, books, magazines, newspapers, flowers and nursery stock, and tobacco products.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB9k.label: No-Shop Covenant - Fiduciary Standard

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB9l.label: Legislative Research Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB9l.definition: Legislative Research Management is the process of organizing and managing legal research specifically related to legislative materials, such as bills, statutes, and regulations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB9n.label: Probable Cause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB9n.definition: Probable Cause is a legal concept that refers to the reasonable belief that a crime has been or is being committed, based on facts and circumstances that would lead a reasonable person to believe so.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB9o.label: Completed and Accepted Doctrine
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB9o.definition: A Completed and Accepted Doctrine is a legal theory within civil litigation that has been fully developed and recognized by the courts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RB9o.label: Sanskrit

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAE.definition: The Treasury Inspector General for Tax Administration (TIGTA) was established under the IRS Restructuring and Reform Act of 1998 to provide independent oversight of IRS activities. TIGTA promotes the economy, efficiency, and effectiveness in the administration of the internal revenue laws. It is also committed to the prevention and detection of fraud, waste, and abuse within the IRS and related entities.
english_labels: Treasury Inspector General for Tax Administration

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAF.label: National Council on Disability
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAF.definition: The National Council on Disability (NCD) is an independent federal agency of the United States government. NCD's membership is composed of five presidential appointees, four congressional appointees, an executive director appointed by the chairperson, and a full-time professional staff.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAH.label: Side Letter
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAH.definition: A Side Letter is a legal document that supplements a primary contract or agreement, usually to make amendments, grant exceptions, or specify additional terms for a particular party. Unlike amendments that change the main contract for all parties, a side letter typically applies to specific arrangements between two parties within the broader agreement's context.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAH.label: Quid Pro Quo Sexual Harassment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAH.definition: The exchange of sexual favors for employment benefits or opportunities, which is a form of sexual harassment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAI.label: Test of Physical Evidence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAI.definition: A Test of Physical Evidence is a type of Physical Examination that involves analyzing and evaluating physical evidence to determine its properties and characteristics.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAK.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Van Buren Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAK.definition: The Arkansas Circuit Court - Van Buren Cty. is a specific court within the Arkansas Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Van Buren County, Arkansas.
english_labels: Arkansas Circuit Court - Van Buren Cty.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAP.label: Accounting Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAP.definition: A claim for payment of a debt arising from an agreement or legal obligation related to financial records and transactions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAY.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Tippecanoe County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAY.definition: The Indiana Circuit Court - Tippecanoe County is a court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that hears civil and criminal cases within Tippecanoe County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAY.label: IRS Revenue Rulings
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAY.definition: IRS Revenue Rulings are official interpretations by the Internal Revenue Service of the tax laws, which are issued to provide guidance to taxpayers and their advisors on how to comply with the tax laws.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAZ.label: Breach of Contract for Failure to Perform
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAZ.definition: The failure to perform a contractual obligation, resulting in a violation of the terms of the agreement.
english_labels: Breach of Contract for Failure to Perform

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAc.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Clinton County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAc.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Clinton County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Clinton County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAf.label: Time Is of the Essence Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAf.definition: A Time Is of the Essence Clause is a provision in a contract that requires strict adherence to deadlines and timelines specified in the agreement.
english_labels: Time Is of the Essence Clause

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAh.label: Go To Market Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAh.definition: Go To Market Services refers to a set of consulting and management services that help businesses launch and promote their products or services in the market.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAh.label: A107 Communicate - other outside counsel
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAh.definition: Communicate (other outside counsel) refers to the act of exchanging information or ideas with lawyers or law firms that are not part of the same organization or legal team.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAi.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Daviess County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAi.definition: A Missouri Circuit Court in Daviess County is a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Daviess County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAn.label: Obstructed License Plate Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAn.definition: An Obstructed License Plate Claim involves allegations that a vehicle's license plate was not clearly visible or was intentionally obscured, violating traffic regulations that require license plates to be unobstructed and legible. Such claims are essential for ensuring that vehicles can be properly identified by law enforcement and traffic cameras, and they often result in fines or corrective orders.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAn.label: Motion to Reopen Chapter 12 Case
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAn.definition: A Motion to Reopen Chapter 12 Case is a request made to the court to reopen a previously closed bankruptcy case under Chapter 12 of the Bankruptcy Code.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAo.label: Affirmative Defenses
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAo.definition: Affirmative Defenses are legal arguments raised by a defendant in response to a plaintiff's claim, which if proven, can defeat or mitigate the plaintiff's claim, and must be asserted by the defendant in their answer or other responsive pleading.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAr.label: Contact Prior Name
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAr.definition: Contact Prior Name refers to any previous full name used by an individual before it was legally changed. This could be due to reasons like marriage, divorce, or a personal decision to change one's name. When applicable, the prior name may be included in formal documentation or databases for complete identification or historical tracking.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAr.label: Patent Opposition Process
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAr.definition: The patent opposition process is a legal procedure that allows third parties to challenge the validity of a patent or patent application. This process is intended to ensure that patents are only granted for inventions that meet the criteria of novelty, inventiveness, and industrial applicability.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAs.label: Government Relations
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAs.definition: Government relations refers to the management of interactions and communication between an organization and government entities, including legislative bodies, regulatory agencies, and policymakers. It involves advocating for policies, regulations, or actions that benefit the organization or its stakeholders, and may include lobbying, monitoring legislative developments, and engaging in public affairs activities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAv.label: No-Knock Warrant
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAv.definition: A No-Knock Warrant is a legal authorization that allows law enforcement officers to enter a property without prior notification to the occupants, typically in the context of a raid or search. This type of warrant is issued when announcing their presence is believed to pose a threat to officer safety or could lead to the destruction of evidence.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAx.label: Background Check Discrimination Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAx.definition: A background check claim is a legal action initiated by an individual who alleges they have been unfairly treated or denied employment, housing, or other opportunities based on the results of a background check. Background checks typically involve the examination of an individual's criminal record, credit history, employment history, or other personal information. These claims often arise when an employer, landlord, or other decision-maker violates the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) or other applicable laws by not providing proper notice, failing to obtain consent, or using the background check information in a discriminatory manner.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAz.label: General Political or Social Conditions Language
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBAz.definition: General Political or Social Conditions Language refers to a provision in a legal agreement that allows a party to terminate or modify the agreement if there are significant changes in the political or social conditions of a particular region or country, which may affect the performance of the agreement.
english_labels: General Political or Social Conditions Language

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBB1.label: Karonga
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBB1.definition: Karonga is a town located in Malawi.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBB3.label: Beograd
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBB3.definition: Beograd is a city in Serbia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBB3.label: Satu Mare
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBB3.definition: Satu Mare is a city in Romania.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBB3.label: Dodoma
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBB3.definition: Dodoma is a city in Tanzania, United Republic of.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBB3.label: E121 Arbitrators/mediators
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBB3.definition: Arbitrators/Mediators refer to the expenses incurred in the process of resolving disputes outside of court through a neutral third party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBB5.label: Indiana Town Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBB5.definition: Indiana Town Court is a local court in Indiana that has limited jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and small claims cases within a specific town or township.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBB6.label: Distributed Denial-of-Service Attack
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBB6.definition: A DDoS attack involves multiple compromised computer systems working together to flood a target, such as a website or online service, with a massive amount of traffic. The coordinated assault overwhelms the target's infrastructure, causing interruptions or complete shutdown of the service, making it inaccessible to legitimate users.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBB7.label: Motion to File Late Petition for Rehearing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBB7.definition: A Motion to File Late Petition for Rehearing (To File Motion and Petition for Rehearing Together) is a request made to an appellate court to allow a party to submit a petition for rehearing after the deadline has passed, while also submitting the motion and petition together.
english_labels: Motion To File Motion and Petition for Rehearing Together
Motion to File Late Petition for Rehearing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBB9.label: Luqa
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBB9.definition: Luqa is a locality in Malta.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBB.label: Warminsko-mazurskie
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBB.definition: Warminsko-mazurskie refers to a region in Poland.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBD.label: Baalbek-Hermel
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBD.definition: Baalbek-Hermel is a region in Lebanon.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBF.label: Post-Argument Letter Brief
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBF.definition: A Post-Argument Letter Brief is a written document submitted to an appellate court after oral arguments have been made, providing additional information or arguments in support of a party's position.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBI.label: Motion to Enforce Stay
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBI.definition: A Motion to Enforce Stay is a legal request made in bankruptcy proceedings to ensure that creditors do not take any action to collect debts from the debtor, as required by the automatic stay provision of the bankruptcy code.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBJ.label: Surprise
english_labels: Surprise is an emotion experienced when something unexpected happens, characterized by a brief state of astonishment or shock.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBN.label: Tribes
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBN.definition: In the legal and societal context, tribes refer to groups of people sharing a common culture, language, or ancestry, often organized around familial or kinship structures and governed by customary laws or tribal chiefs. Tribal governance and jurisdiction may operate within, alongside, or outside the legal framework of a surrounding nation, with varying degrees of recognized sovereignty and legal authority

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBP.label: Right to Compulsory Process
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBP.definition: The right to compulsory process is a legal principle that grants individuals involved in a criminal trial the ability to obtain witnesses or evidence in their favor through the power of the court. This right, protected by the Sixth Amendment of the United States Constitution, ensures that defendants have a fair opportunity to present their case and gather supporting testimony or materials, even if it requires compelling unwilling witnesses to appear in court or obtaining documents that may be difficult to acquire voluntarily.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBQ.label: Surveyor Negligence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBQ.definition: Surveyor Negligence is a legal claim of negligence against a surveyor who fails to exercise reasonable care and skill in the performance of their duties, resulting in harm or loss to their client.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBS.label: Bankruptcy Case Closure Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBS.definition: The practice of completing the necessary legal procedures and actions to formally close a bankruptcy case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBU.label: Massachusetts Trial Court - Probate and Family Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBU.definition: The Massachusetts Trial Court - Probate and Family Court is a specific court within the Massachusetts Trial Court system that handles legal matters related to family and probate law.
english_labels: Massachusetts Trial Court - Probate and Family Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBZ.label: Skin Color
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBZ.definition: Skin color is the particular shade of a person's skin. In legal contexts, skin color might relate to allegations that an individual has experienced unequal treatment or discrimination based on the color of their skin, rather than their broader racial or ethnic background. These claims can arise in various contexts, such as employment, housing, or public services, and are prohibited under anti-discrimination laws.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBf.label: Berries
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBf.definition: Berries are small, pulpy, and often edible fruits, typically produced by perennial plants and shrubs, known for their rich colors and sweet to tart flavors. These fruits are valued for their high nutritional content, including antioxidants, vitamins, and dietary fiber, and are consumed fresh, dried, or processed into a variety of food products.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBi.label: Corporate Representative Witness
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBi.definition: A Corporate Representative Witness is a witness who testifies on behalf of a corporation in a legal matter, providing information about the corporation's policies, practices, or actions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBm.label: New York Supreme Court - Yates County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBm.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Yates County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Yates County, New York, which is a subdivision of the New York Supreme Court.
english_labels: New York Supreme Court - Yates County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBn.label: Breach of Implied-in-Fact Contract
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBn.definition: The Breach of Implied-in-Fact Contract refers to a situation where one party fails to fulfill the obligations that were not explicitly stated but were understood by both parties to be a part of their agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBo.label: Ex Post Facto Clause Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBo.definition: An Ex Post Facto Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a law or action violates the Ex Post Facto Clause of the United States Constitution. This claim contends that the law or action retroactively imposes punishment or changes the legal consequences of an act, which is prohibited by the Ex Post Facto Clause.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBq.label: Maintenance and Cure
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBq.definition: Maintenance and Cure refers to the legal concept in Admiralty and Maritime Claims where an injured seaman is entitled to receive compensation for necessary medical treatment and living expenses until they reach maximum medical improvement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBr.label: Major Depressive Disorder
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBr.definition: Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) is a mental health condition characterized by persistent and intense feelings of sadness, hopelessness, and loss of interest or pleasure in nearly all activities. These symptoms significantly impair daily functioning and can be accompanied by changes in sleep, appetite, energy levels, concentration, and self-worth.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBs.label: Lojban
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBs.definition: Lojban is a constructed language designed for clear and unambiguous communication, often used in technical or scientific contexts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBt.label: Georgia Superior Court - Coffee County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBt.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Coffee County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Coffee County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBt.label: Assignment Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBt.definition: An Assignment Clause is a provision in a contract that allows one party to transfer their rights or obligations to another party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBt.label: Cross-Claimant
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBt.definition: A litigant who makes a cross-claim

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBu.label: Co-Party Coordination
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBBu.definition: Co-Party Coordination (e.g., Joint Defense Groups) refers to the collaborative efforts of multiple parties in a legal matter, such as forming a joint defense group, to coordinate their defense strategy and share information.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBC0.label: Bekes
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBC0.definition: Bekes is a region in Hungary.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBC0.label: JAMS International Arbitration Rules
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBC0.definition: Procedural rules governing arbitrations in JAMS (Judicial Arbitration and Mediation Services).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBC1.label: Hallands lan
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBC1.definition: Hallands lan is a county located in the southwestern part of Sweden.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBC1.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Douglas County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBC1.definition: Oregon Circuit Court - Douglas County: A specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system located in Douglas County, responsible for administering legal proceedings within its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBC3.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Warren County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBC3.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Warren County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Warren County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBC4.label: Susquehanna River Basin Commission
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBC4.definition: The Susquehanna River Basin Commission (SRBC) is federal-interstate compact commission created by the Susquehanna River Basin Compact between three U.S states: (Pennsylvania, New York, and Maryland), and the federal government to lead the conservation, development, and administration of the Basin's resources that would preserve and enhance its value as a scenic and recreational asset for the people who live in the Basin.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBC6.label: Van
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBC6.definition: "Van" is a city and province located in the eastern part of Turkey, known for its stunning natural beauty, including Lake Van, the largest lake in the country. It also holds historical significance and cultural heritage, with ancient ruins and monuments scattered throughout the region.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBC7.label: Postage Expense
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBC7.definition: Postage Expense refers to the cost incurred by an individual or organization for sending mail or packages through a postal service, which is considered as an expense in accounting and financial records.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCA.label: Canakkale
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCA.definition: Canakkale is a city in Turkey.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCA.label: Indiana Superior Court - Grant County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCA.definition: Indiana Superior Court - Grant County refers to a specific court within the Indiana Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Grant County, Indiana.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCA.label: Termination for Cause Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCA.definition: A Termination for Cause Clause is a provision in a contract that allows one party to end the agreement if the other party breaches a specific condition or obligation outlined in the contract.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCB.label: Novosibirskaya oblast'
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCB.definition: Novosibirskaya oblast' is a region in the Russian Federation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCC.label: Hoa Binh
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCC.definition: Hoa Binh is a province in Vietnam.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCD.label: U.S. Bankruptcy Court - S.D. California
english_labels: United States Bankruptcy Court, S.D. California

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCD.label: DEPRECATED Structural Risk (Deprecated as too vague, in favor of other taxonomical variations)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCD.definition: Risk to an entity's structure, such as (1) potential changes in the industry that threaten the entity's existence, (2) potential changes to the entity's reputation as a result of a lawsuit or other regulatory action, or (3) other potential changes to the entity itself that might threaten the entity's structure.
english_labels: DEPRECATED Structural Risk (Deprecated as too vague, in favor of other taxonomical variations)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCG.label: state_province
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCG.definition: "The state or province of parent. Required except in countries without an equivalent address component. Use accepted abbreviations mandated by the parent country's postal service. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCH.label: Intervenor Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCH.definition: An Intervenor Claim is a legal pleading filed by a third party who seeks to join an ongoing lawsuit because they have a direct interest in the outcome of the case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCI.label: Document Text
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCI.definition: Document text refers to a document's full-text contents, including the body's paragraphs and headings, as well as captions, footnotes, and appendices.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCO.label: Resignation for Good Reason Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCO.definition: A Resignation for Good Reason Clause is a provision in a contract that allows an employee to resign from their position due to certain specified reasons, such as a significant change in job duties or a reduction in compensation, without being considered to have voluntarily resigned.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCU.label: Declaratory Judgment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCU.definition: A Declaratory Judgment is a written or recorded statement issued by a court that declares the rights, duties, or obligations of parties involved in a legal dispute, without ordering any specific action or awarding damages.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCV.label: Asylee
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCV.definition: An asylee is an individual who has been granted asylum, a form of international protection, after proving a well-founded fear of persecution in their home country due to race, religion, nationality, membership in a particular social group, or political opinion. Once granted asylum, the asylee has the right to remain in the host country and may be eligible for certain benefits like work authorization.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCV.label: New York Surrogate Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCV.definition: The New York Surrogate Court is a specialized court within the New York State Courts system that handles matters related to wills, estates, and trusts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCY.label: Dishonorable Discharge
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCY.definition: A Dishonorable Discharge is the most severe form of military separation and is given as a result of court-martial for serious offenses such as desertion, conduct unbecoming, or criminal activity. This type of discharge can have significant negative implications for the individual's post-military life.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCa.label: Assignment of Claims Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCa.definition: An Assignment of Claims Clause is a provision in a contract that allows one party to transfer their right to receive payment from another party to a third party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCk.label: Curyung Tribal Council (Native Village of Dillingham)
english_labels: Curyung Tribal Council (Native Village of Dillingham)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCk.label: Motion to Supplement or Amend Designation of Reporter Transcript
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCk.definition: A Motion to Supplement or Amend Designation of Reporter Transcript is a legal request to modify or add to the previously designated transcript of a court proceeding, typically filed after the original transcript has been produced.
english_labels: Motion to Supplement or Amend Designation of Reporter Transcript

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCl.label: Lingala
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCl.definition: Lingala is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary, used in legal matters, that is a member of the language family and is spoken primarily in the Democratic Republic of Congo and the Republic of Congo.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCm.label: Washington Superior Court - Snohomish County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCm.definition: Washington Superior Court - Snohomish County refers to a specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Snohomish County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCn.label: Probate due to Medical Condition
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCn.definition: The concept of "Probate due to Medical Condition" refers to the legal process of distributing the assets of a deceased person who passed away due to a medical condition, such as a terminal illness or a chronic disease, in accordance with their will or state law.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCp.label: Tax Credit
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCp.definition: A Tax Credit is a monetary amount that taxpayers can subtract directly from their tax liability, reducing the total amount of tax owed. It differs from a tax deduction in that it provides a dollar-for-dollar reduction in tax liability, rather than reducing taxable income.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCr.label: Tuvalu
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCr.definition: Tuvalu (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Tuvalu islands.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCr.label: Igbo
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCr.definition: A language spoken primarily in southeastern Nigeria, characterized by its tonality and use of high and low pitch accents.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCz.label: Regulatory Document
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBCz.definition: A regulatory document is a formal record, report, or submission related to or required by governmental agencies or other regulatory bodies to ensure that companies or organizations comply with applicable laws, rules, and regulations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBD0.label: Augmented Reality
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBD0.definition: An Augmented Reality Experience overlays digital information, such as images, sounds, or other data, onto the real-world environment, enhancing the user's perception and interaction with their surroundings. Protected under copyright law, augmented reality experiences grant creators exclusive rights to reproduce, distribute, and display the content.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBD4.label: National Mediation Board
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBD4.definition: The National Mediation Board (NMB) is an independent agency of the United States government that coordinates labor-management relations within the U.S. railroads and airlines industries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBD6.label: Az Zahirah
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBD6.definition: Az Zahirah is a region in Oman.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBD7.label: Silver
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBD7.definition: A one troy ounce piece of silver that is used as a standardized form of currency.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBD7.label: Intent to Cure Default
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBD7.definition: A document that expresses the intention to cure a default in a bankruptcy or restructuring proceeding.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBD8.label: Caras-Severin
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBD8.definition: Caras-Severin is a county in Romania.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBD9.label: Pahang
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBD9.definition: Pahang is a state in Malaysia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDA.label: Karas
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDA.definition: Karas is a region in Namibia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDC.label: Jawa Tengah
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDC.definition: Société en Commandite Simple is a form of business in which a limited partner provides the bulk of the funds but entrusts the administration of the company to the general partner, who has increased prerogatives from the larger corporations. It should be distinguished from the more frequent limited partnership (SCA).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDC.label: Borski okrug
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDC.definition: Borski okrug is a district located in Serbia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDC.label: oasis:TemporalCharacteristic
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDC.definition: A characteristic of an entity that relates to time, such as its duration or frequency.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDD.label: Harare
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDD.definition: Harare is the capital city of Zimbabwe.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDD.label: Sisacko-moslavacka zupanija
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDD.definition: Sisacko-moslavacka zupanija is a region in Croatia, identified by the code HR+03.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDF.label: Central Equatoria
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDF.definition: Central Equatoria is a region in South Sudan.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDF.label: Georgia Superior Court - Coweta County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDF.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Coweta County: A specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases in Coweta County, Georgia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDG.label: Structured Settlement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDG.definition: A structured settlement is a type of settlement agreement that provides for periodic payments over time, rather than a lump sum payment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDH.label: Motion to Vacate Sentence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDH.definition: A Motion to Vacate Sentence is a legal request to set aside or nullify a previously imposed sentence.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDN.label: Lawful AI
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDN.definition: Lawful AI refers to AI systems designed and operated in full compliance with all applicable laws and regulations. This ensures that AI systems adhere to legal standards across jurisdictions, including privacy laws, anti-discrimination statutes, data protection regulations, and industry-specific legal requirements.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDP.label: Professional Limited Liability Company
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDP.definition: A professional limited liability company ('PLLC') is a U.S. business entity designed for licensed professionals, such as lawyers, doctors, architects, engineers, accountants, and chiropractors. While many businesses choose to form a limited liability company ('LLC') because of the tax, limited liability, and other benefits, some states don't allow LLCs to be owned by professionals whose occupation requires a license. In these states, licensed professionals who want the benefits of an LLC must form a PLLC instead.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDR.label: Ratification
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDR.definition: Plaintiff approved the acts of the defendant and cannot now complain.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDT.label: Spendthrift Trust
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDT.definition: A Spendthrift Trust is a trust established to provide financial support to a beneficiary while protecting the trust assets from the beneficiary's creditors or reckless spending. The trustee has control over the distribution of funds to ensure they are used for the beneficiary's welfare in accordance with the trust's terms.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDU.label: Partial Payment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDU.definition: Partial Payment refers to a financial transaction where only a portion of the total amount due has been paid. This status indicates that the obligation is not yet fully satisfied and includes arrangements such as installment payments.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDb.label: Commitment Letter
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDb.definition: A Commitment Letter is a formal, written document from a lender that outlines the terms under which the lender agrees to provide a loan to a borrower. The letter specifies important details like the loan amount, interest rate, and repayment terms, and it often requires the borrower's acceptance to become binding.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDf.label: Social Security Funding Objective
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDf.definition: The social security funding objective aims to ensure the financial sustainability of a social security system, which provides benefits such as retirement income, disability payments, and healthcare coverage. This objective involves strategies for collecting sufficient revenues through taxes or contributions and managing expenditures to maintain long-term solvency.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDg.label: Visa for Dependents of Treaty Skilled Workers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDg.definition: This visa classification (in the U.S., TD visa) is designed for the dependents of Treaty Skilled Worker Visa (in the U.S., TN) holders, including spouses and unmarried children under the age of 21. In the United States, this visa allows these dependents to accompany or join the principal TN visa holder during their period of stay in the U.S. While TD visa holders are not authorized to work, they are permitted to attend school.
english_labels: Visa for Dependents of Treaty Skilled Workers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDh.label: Litigation Objectives
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDh.definition: Legal elements to be proven or disproven (e.g., claims, defenses, remedies, burdens, standards of review).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDj.label: Driving with a Suspended License
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDj.definition: Driving on a Suspended or Revoked License: Operating a motor vehicle while one's driver's license has been temporarily or permanently revoked or suspended by the state due to a prior traffic offense or violation.
english_labels: Driving on a Suspended or Revoked License

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDo.label: New York District Court - Suffolk County - 3rd District
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDo.definition: A court located in Suffolk County, New York that is part of the larger New York District Court system.
english_labels: New York District Court - Suffolk County - 3rd District

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDq.label: Slander
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDq.definition: The spoken or oral communication of false statements that harm the reputation of another person, which can result in legal action against the speaker.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDq.label: Ethnicity
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDq.definition: Ethnicity refers to the identification or affiliation with a particular group based on shared cultural traits, ancestry, or historical background. Unlike race, which is often seen as an externally imposed classification, ethnicity is generally considered a self-identified construct linked to a sense of shared community and heritage.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDu.label: Regulatory Petitioner
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDu.definition: A Regulatory Petitioner refers to an individual or entity formally requesting legal or official approval from a regulatory body, often through a structured application process. This encompasses a wide array of requests, from immigration status changes to the issuance of permits for business operations or environmental actions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDv.label: Taken Into Custody
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDv.definition: Taken Into Custody: The act of a law enforcement officer taking a person into custody, typically for the purpose of charging them with a crime.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDv.label: Agent
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDv.definition: A person authorized to act on behalf of another person or a government, including employees and representatives.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDw.label: Matter Description
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDw.definition: The textual description of the work performed in the billing period.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBDx.label: Employment Objection Process
