https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBWa.definition: The Texas Court of Appeals - 11th is a specific intermediate appellate court in Texas that hears appeals from lower courts within its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBWe.label: Some Credible Evidence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBWe.definition: Some Credible Evidence: Evidence that is trustworthy and reliable, and has the potential to persuade a fact-finder of the truth of a proposition, which is required to be presented by a party in a legal dispute in order to meet their burden of proof.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBWh.label: Renter's Insurance Policy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBWh.definition: Renter's insurance provides coverage for a tenant's personal belongings within a rented property and may offer liability coverage for injuries that occur within the rental unit. This type of insurance does not cover the structure of the building itself, which is the responsibility of the landlord.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBWk.label: Pulmonology Malpractice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBWk.definition: Negligence or wrongdoing by a medical professional in the field of pulmonology, resulting in harm or injury to a patient.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBWm.label: Lahnda
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBWm.definition: A language spoken in Pakistan and India, primarily in the Punjab region.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBWo.label: Regulatory Services (Non-Dispute)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBWo.definition: Any process that results in filing something with governmental entity.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBWp.label: Georgia Superior Court - DeKalb County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBWp.definition: The Georgia Superior Court - DeKalb County is a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases in DeKalb County, Georgia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBWt.label: Document Collection Event
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBWt.definition: A Document Collection Event is an occurrence related to the gathering and production of documents.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBWu.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Madison County 1
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBWu.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Madison County, Indiana, with the authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBWv.label: Contact Name Suffix - Jr. (Junior)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBWv.definition: The suffix "Jr." stands for "Junior" and is used after a person's full name to distinguish a son from his father when they share the same name. The usage helps to identify which individual is being referred to in documents and correspondence, especially in formal or legal settings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBWv.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Westmoreland County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBWv.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Westmoreland County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within Westmoreland County, Pennsylvania.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Westmoreland County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBX1.label: Credit Intermediation and Related Activities Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBX1.definition: Industries in the Credit Intermediation and Related Activities subsector group establishments that (1) lend funds raised from depositors; (2) lend funds raised from credit market borrowing; or (3) facilitate the lending of funds or issuance of credit by engaging in such activities as mortgage and loan brokerage, clearinghouse and reserve services, and check cashing services.
english_labels: Credit Intermediation and Related Activities Industry

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBX2.label: regulatory_statement segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBX2.definition: "As e-billing expands around the world, it is likely that local, regional or national regulations require specific information to be included on electronic invoices. This section is designed to accommodate those requirements, to the extent that they apply to the matter/invoice level, without needing to adjust the format. In that this information is required by statute or regulation to be provided, all information provided in this segment should be captured by the receiving system and displayed during bill review. There will be 0 or more REGULATORY_STATEMENT segments per INVOICE segment. The EXTEND_HEADER option was purposely omitted from this segment. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBX7.label: Breach of Implied Warranty of Suitability
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBX7.definition: The Breach of Implied Warranty of Suitability refers to a violation of an unspoken guarantee that a product or service is appropriate for its intended use, resulting in harm or damage to the user.
english_labels: Breach of Implied Warranty of Suitability

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBX7.label: Belarusian
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBX7.definition: Belarusian (Language) refers to the written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Belarusian language, which is a member of the Slavic language family.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXA.label: Subcontractor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXA.definition: A "Subcontractor" is a company or individual hired by a primary contractor to perform specific tasks or provide services as part of a larger project. Subcontractors are typically responsible for a specialized aspect of the project, and they are not directly employed by the client but rather by the primary contractor. This arrangement is common in construction, manufacturing, and various other industries where a project involves multiple specialized tasks.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXB.label: Provider Office Location
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXB.definition: Office location for the particular engagement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXH.label: Performance Warranty Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXH.definition: A Performance Warranty Clause is a type of Warranty Clause that guarantees the quality and functionality of a product or service for a specific period of time.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXI.label: By Portfolio
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXI.definition: Engagement fee model where a client pays a predetermined fee for legal services that cover two or more matters (i.e., a portfolio of matters).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXL.label: Subordination Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXL.definition: A "Subordination Agreement" is a contractual arrangement where a creditor agrees to rank its claim on a debtor's assets below the claims of one or more other creditors. This legal document outlines the conditions and circumstances under which the subordinated creditor will be repaid, typically in the event of a liquidation, default, or insolvency of the debtor.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXL.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Mercer County (14th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Mercer County (14th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXL.label: Request
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXL.definition: A request is a type of trial court practice document that is filed with the court to ask for a specific action or relief.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXM.label: Ballistics Evidence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXM.definition: Ballistics evidence refers to the study and analysis of firearms, bullets, and the patterns of damage they cause, particularly when a weapon is discharged. It is used in criminal investigations to link projectiles and casings found at a crime scene to a specific weapon or to determine other details of a shooting incident, such as the trajectory or distance from which a shot was fired. Expert ballisticians can match unique markings on a bullet or casing to the specific firearm that fired it, providing critical evidence in firearm-related cases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXO.label: Occupational Safety and Health Act Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXO.definition: An Occupational Safety and Health Act (OSHA) claim is a legal action initiated by an employee or group of employees against an employer, alleging that the employer has violated safety and health regulations, failed to maintain a safe work environment, or retaliated against employees for reporting safety concerns or exercising their rights under the OSHA. The OSHA is a federal law enacted in 1970 to ensure safe and healthy working conditions for employees in the United States by setting and enforcing safety standards and regulations. Employers have a general duty under the OSH Act to provide their employees with work and a workplace free from recognized, serious hazards.
english_labels: Occupational Safety and Health Act Claim

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXO.label: Noise Violation Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXO.definition: A Noise Violation Claim involves allegations that an individual or entity has exceeded legally established noise levels, leading to disruptions or disturbances in residential, commercial, or public areas. These claims are handled through administrative or legal proceedings and can result in fines, orders to cease the noise, or other corrective actions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXS.label: New Hampshire Supreme Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXS.definition: The New Hampshire Supreme Court is the highest court in the state of New Hampshire and serves as the final court of appeal for all legal cases within the state's jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXU.label: New York Supreme Court - Oneida County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXU.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Oneida County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Oneida County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal disputes within its geographical jurisdiction.
english_labels: New York Supreme Court - Oneida County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXU.label: Spend Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXU.definition: Spend Management refers to the process of controlling and optimizing the expenses incurred by an organization, typically through the use of technology and data analysis.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXV.label: Conflict of Interest Risk
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXV.definition: Conflict of Interest Risk refers to the potential for ethical, legal, or reputational issues arising when an individual's personal interests, relationships, or obligations compromise their ability to make impartial decisions on behalf of their organization or role. These conflicts can lead to biased decision-making, decreased trust, or even regulatory penalties, ultimately impacting the organization's integrity and performance

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXV.label: Runaway
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXV.definition: A person under 18 years of age who has left home without permission of his/her parent(s) or legal guardian

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXY.label: Change in Law Language
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXY.definition: A change in law language refers to a provision in a legal agreement that outlines the impact of any modifications or alterations made to existing laws on the agreement, specifically within the context of carveouts related to material adverse effect (MAE) definitions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXY.label: Stipulation to Appoint Resolution Advocate
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXY.definition: A Stipulation to Appoint Resolution Advocate is a legal agreement between parties in a dispute, where they agree to appoint a neutral third party to help resolve the dispute.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXa.label: Natural Law System
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXa.definition: The Natural Law System is a legal philosophy asserting that laws are derived from a set of inherent moral principles and universal truths that govern human behavior, existing independently of human-made laws. It posits that these principles are discoverable through reason and are inherent to human nature, providing a basis for evaluating and guiding positive law.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXe.label: European Commission
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXe.definition: The European Commission is the executive branch of the European Union, responsible for proposing legislation, implementing decisions, and managing the day-to-day operations of the EU. It represents the interests of the EU as a whole, rather than individual member states.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXe.label: Special Purpose Entity
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXe.definition: A Special Purpose Entity (SPE) is a legal entity created for a specific, limited purpose, particularly in financial transactions. This entity is often used to isolate financial risk by legally segregating certain activities, assets, or investments from the main organization, thereby facilitating transaction security and credit enhancement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXl.label: Pandemic or Other Public Health Event Language
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXl.definition: Language included in a contract that defines the impact of a pandemic or other public health event on the material adverse effect (MAE) clause, which outlines exceptions to the clause in the event of certain circumstances.
english_labels: Pandemic or Other Public Health Event Language

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXl.label: Individual Contributor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXl.definition: An Individual Contributor is an employee who specializes in performing specific tasks or roles within an organization but does not have managerial responsibilities over a team. Individual Contributors focus on executing their specialized skill sets and are evaluated based on their own performance rather than the performance of a group.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXl.label: 864 SSID Title XVI (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXl.definition: Action filed with regard to social security benefits provided to Supplemental Security Income Disability under Title XVI

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXo.label: Health-Conscious Market Segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXo.definition: The health-conscious segment refers to a portion of the market that is characterized by consumers who prioritize health and wellness in their purchasing decisions. This segment includes products and services that are designed to promote physical, mental, and emotional well-being, catering to individuals who seek a healthy lifestyle.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXo.label: Small Intestine Cancer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXo.definition: Small intestine cancer is a malignant neoplasm originating in the small intestine, which includes the duodenum, jejunum, and ileum. This type of cancer can cause symptoms such as abdominal pain, weight loss, and bowel obstruction and may include various subtypes such as adenocarcinoma, carcinoid tumors, and gastrointestinal stromal tumors (GISTs).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXp.label: Death on High Seas Act Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXp.definition: The Death on High Seas Act (DOHSA) is a legal concept that falls under the categories of Statutory and Regulatory Claims, as well as Admiralty and Maritime Claims. It provides a framework for compensation in cases of death that occur on the high seas.
english_labels: Death on High Seas Act Claim

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXr.label: Schizoid Personality Disorder
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXr.definition: Schizoid Personality Disorder is characterized by a pervasive pattern of detachment from social relationships and a restricted range of emotional expression. Individuals with this disorder often appear aloof, indifferent, and emotionally cold, and they typically have a limited desire for social interactions or engagement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXu.label: In-home Supportive Service Disability Benefit
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXu.definition: In-home supportive service disability benefit is a specific type of public assistance program designed to help individuals with disabilities receive essential care and services within their own homes rather than in institutional settings. These benefits can cover a range of services including personal care, meal preparation, and medical monitoring, and aim to enhance the quality of life for disabled individuals by enabling them to live more independently.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXv.label: Timne
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBXv.definition: Timne is a language that belongs to the Language top-level class, which is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary used in legal matters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBY1.label: Amicus
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBY1.definition: An entity that is not involved in litigation but provides the court with input, testimony, and/or briefing.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBY4.label: Employment Classification
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBY4.definition: Worker Classification refers to the categorization of an employee's work status within an organization, often defined as full-time, part-time, or contractor. These classifications dictate the terms of employment, including benefits eligibility, tax implications, and legal obligations between the employer and employee.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBY8.label: Expert Fees
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBY8.definition: Expert Fees refer to the costs incurred by a party in a legal matter for the services of a professional with specialized knowledge or skills, such as a medical expert or a forensic accountant.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYA.label: R.N. (Registered Nurse)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYA.definition: The suffix "R.N." stands for "Registered Nurse" and is used after a person's name to indicate that they are licensed to practice nursing. This designation confirms that the individual has met the educational and licensing requirements set forth by a nursing board or authority and is commonly used in healthcare settings, academic environments, and formal documents

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYA.label: By Portfolio - By Work Type
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYA.definition: A method of categorizing legal work based on the type of work being done within a specific portfolio or area of practice.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYD.label: Kansas District Court - Clay County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYD.definition: A court located in Clay County, Kansas that has jurisdiction over cases within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYH.label: Legal Design Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYH.definition: Legal Design Services: A type of consulting and management service that focuses on the application of design thinking and user-centered design principles to legal processes and systems.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYH.label: Corporate Governance Analysis
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYH.definition: Corporate Governance Analysis refers to the examination and evaluation of the internal policies, procedures, and practices of a corporation to ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements, and to promote transparency and accountability.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYQ.label: Motion for Exemption from Means Test
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYQ.definition: A Motion for Exemption from Means Test is a request made in a bankruptcy case to be excused from taking the means test, which is a calculation used to determine eligibility for Chapter 7 bankruptcy based on income.
english_labels: Motion for Exemption from Means Test

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYU.label: Fund Formation Management Products and Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYU.definition: Fund Formation Management (Products and Services) refers to the legal services and products related to the creation and management of investment funds.
english_labels: Fund Formation Management Products and Services

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYc.label: New York City Court - Watervliet
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYc.definition: New York City Court - Watervliet is a specific court located in Watervliet, New York, which operates under the jurisdiction of the New York City Court system.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYh.label: Billing Attorney
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYh.definition: A billing attorney is the lawyer responsible for keeping track of billable hours and expenses associated with a legal matter, and for preparing and issuing invoices to clients. This attorney ensures that the client is accurately billed for legal services provided, and may also address any billing inquiries or disputes that may arise.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYh.label: 470 Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organizations (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYh.definition: Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organization Act, RICO 18:1961-1968
english_labels: 470 Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organizations (PACER NoS)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYh.label: Manobo languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYh.definition: Manobo languages are a group of languages spoken by the Manobo people in the Philippines.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYh.label: Georgia Superior Court - Dade County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYh.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Dade County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYj.label: Fitness & Exercise Market Segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYj.definition: The fitness & exercise market segment refers to a division of the market that is specifically targeted towards consumers who are interested in physical fitness and exercise. This segment encompasses products, services, and marketing strategies that are designed to cater to the needs, preferences, and interests of individuals who seek to maintain or improve their physical health, fitness level, and overall well-being through various forms of exercise.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYl.label: Regulatory Taking Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYl.definition: The concept of Regulatory Taking refers to a situation where a government regulation or law results in the taking of private property or its use, without providing just compensation to the owner.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYl.label: Motion to Dismiss the Case Voluntarily
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYl.definition: A Motion to Dismiss the Case Voluntarily is a formal request made by the plaintiff or petitioner to end the case without prejudice, meaning that the plaintiff or petitioner can refile the case at a later time.
english_labels: Motion to Dismiss the Case Voluntarily

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYr.label: Niger-Kordofanian languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYr.definition: Niger-Kordofanian languages are a group of languages that belong to the Language top-level class and are spoken in West Africa.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYr.label: Expert Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYr.definition: Expert Practice refers to the specialized legal work performed by an individual with advanced knowledge and experience in a particular field, typically involving the preparation and presentation of expert testimony in a legal matter.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYu.label: JF00 Disclosure (UK J-CODE)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYu.definition: Work relating to gathering and reviewing documents for potential disclosure, preparing disclosure lists and practical steps of disclosure.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYu.label: Motion to Compel Written Discovery
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYu.definition: A Motion to Compel Written Discovery is a legal request made by one party to another party in a lawsuit, asking the recipient to provide written responses to specific questions or produce certain documents that are relevant to the case, when the recipient has failed to do so voluntarily.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYu.label: Beja; Bedawiyet
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYu.definition: A language spoken by the Beja people, primarily in Sudan and Eritrea.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYv.label: Promotion Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYv.definition: A Promotion Agreement is a type of legal agreement that outlines the terms and conditions of a promotional campaign or event, typically between a company and a third party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYy.label: Appellate Reply Brief
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBYy.definition: An appellate reply brief is a written legal document submitted by the appellant in response to the appellee's brief, presenting arguments and evidence in support of their appeal to a higher court.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZ2.label: Legal Marketplace Solutions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZ2.definition: Legal Marketplace Solutions refers to a specific type of Legal Platform Solutions that provide a platform for legal professionals and clients to connect and exchange legal services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZ5.label: Jurisdiction Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZ5.definition: A jurisdiction clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the court or legal system that will have jurisdiction over any disputes arising from the contract.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZ6.label: Unemployment Public Benefits
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZ6.definition: Unemployment public benefits refer to government programs that provide financial assistance to individuals who have lost their jobs and are actively seeking new employment. These benefits are typically time-limited and contingent on meeting certain eligibility criteria like work history and reason for unemployment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZ6.label: LINE_ITEM_NUMBER
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZ6.definition: A LINE_ITEM_NUMBER is a specific identifier assigned to each individual item listed in a legal invoice, according to the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZ6.label: Exchanges Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZ6.definition: Rules regarding market places or facilities for bringing together purchasers and sellers of securities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZ9.label: Amicable Settlement Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZ9.definition: An amicable settlement clause is a provision in a contract that requires the parties to attempt to resolve any disputes through negotiation or mediation before pursuing legal action.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZL.label: tax segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZL.definition: "A lookup segment for the taxes charged in the file. There will be 0 or more TAX segments per file. If items are not taxed, no TAX section would be included in the file. The EXTEND_HEADER option was purposely omitted from this segment. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZN.label: Ukrainian
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZN.definition: The Ukrainian language is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary, and is a member of the Slavic language family.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZP.label: Tumbuka
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZP.definition: Tumbuka is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary, used in legal matters as a language of a document, artifact, evidence, testimony, proceeding, or any other legal aspect.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZX.label: State Governmental Leader
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZX.definition: A State Governmental Leader is the highest-ranking official in a state, province, or similar sub-national administrative division. This individual is typically responsible for executing state laws, overseeing state agencies, proposing legislation, and representing the state's interests at both national and international levels.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZa.label: Licensee
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZa.definition: A licensee is a person or entity to whom a license is granted. A licensee has the license to use someone else's specified property such as a building, a land or intellectual property.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZd.label: Islamic Law System
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZd.definition: Sharia Law is a legal system based on Islamic principles derived from the Quran, Hadith (sayings of Prophet Muhammad), and other Islamic texts. This system governs both personal and communal aspects of life, integrating moral and legal guidelines.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZf.label: Lump Sum Payment of Public Benefit
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZf.definition: Lump sum payment of public benefit refers to the disbursement of financial assistance in a single, large payment rather than through ongoing, smaller payments. This approach is often used as part of a diversion objective to encourage recipients to use the funds for specific purposes like securing housing or job training, with the goal of reducing long-term dependency on public benefits.
english_labels: Lump Sum Payment of Public Benefit

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZf.label: Denial-of-Service Attack
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZf.definition: A denial-of-service attack, also known as a DoS attack, aims to disrupt a computer system or network by flooding it with an overwhelming amount of traffic, rendering the service unavailable to legitimate users.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZg.label: Immigration Removal Proceeding
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZg.definition: Immigration Removal Proceeding is a legal process in which an individual is brought before an immigration court to determine their eligibility to remain in a country. If found to be in violation of immigration laws, the individual may be ordered to leave the country, commonly known as deportation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZi.label: Capitalization Table
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZi.definition: A Capitalization Table (Cap Table) is a document that outlines the ownership structure of a company, including the number and type of shares held by each shareholder.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZi.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Schuyler County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZi.definition: A Missouri Circuit Court in Schuyler County is a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Schuyler County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZk.label: Greek, Ancient
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZk.definition: The language used in ancient Greece up to the year 1453, including its grammar and vocabulary, as it relates to legal matters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZk.label: Georgia Superior Court - Montgomery County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZk.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Montgomery County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Montgomery County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZn.label: Primary Lateral Sclerosis
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZn.definition: Primary lateral sclerosis (PLS) is a rare neurodegenerative disorder characterized by the gradual degeneration of upper motor neurons in the brain and spinal cord. This condition leads to progressive muscle stiffness, spasticity, and weakness, primarily affecting voluntary movements while sparing lower motor neurons.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZs.label: Customs and Import Duty Payment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZs.definition: Customs and Import Duty Payment refers to taxes, stamp duties, and surcharges levied exclusively on imported products. This includes specific levies on agricultural imports in European Union member countries and payments under the Monetary Compensation Accounts (MCA) system. Customs duties collected by EU member states on behalf of the European Union are also reported under this heading. These taxes are distinct from general goods and services taxes or excises that apply to both imported and domestically produced goods.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZv.label: Duty to Mitigate Damages Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZv.definition: A Duty to Mitigate Damages Clause is a provision in a contract that requires the injured party to take reasonable steps to minimize their losses or damages resulting from a breach of contract by the other party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZy.label: Riparian Rights
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBZy.definition: Rooted in common law, riparian rights refer to the rights of landowners whose property borders a natural watercourse. Under riparian doctrine, these landowners have the right to make reasonable use of the water adjacent to or flowing over their land, provided they don't unreasonably interfere with the rights of downstream users.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBa6.label: Matter Complexity
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBa6.definition: Classification for a given' matter's complexity, either textually (e.g., low, medium, high) or numerically (e.g., 1 through 10).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBaC.label: 490 Cable/Satellite TV (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBaC.definition: Action filed involving unauthorized reception of cable/satellite TV service under 47 U.S.C. § 553 (unauthorized reception of cable/satellite TV), or 47 U.S.C. § 605 (e)(3) (unauthorized use or publication of a communication)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBaC.label: Motion Objecting to Discharge
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBaC.definition: A Motion Objecting to Discharge is a legal request made in a bankruptcy case to prevent the debtor from being released from certain debts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBaD.label: Probate due to Death / Testamentary
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBaD.definition: Probate due to Death / Testamentary refers to the legal process of administering the estate of a deceased person according to their will or testament.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBaG.label: Oncology Negligence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBaG.definition: Negligence in the field of oncology, where a healthcare provider fails to provide the appropriate standard of care in the diagnosis, treatment, or management of cancer.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBaJ.label: Bar Date Motion
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBaJ.definition: A Bar Date Motion in Bankruptcy is a legal request made by a debtor to set a deadline for creditors to file claims against the debtor's estate.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBaK.label: Pretrial Conference
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBaK.definition: A pretrial conference is a court-mandated meeting between parties involved in a legal case before the trial, where they discuss the case and attempt to reach a settlement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBaL.label: Guarani
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBaL.definition: Guarani (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, spoken in Paraguay and parts of Brazil and Argentina.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBaL.label: Trademark Assets
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBaL.definition: Trademark Assets are a type of Intellectual Property Assets that refer to any distinctive sign, symbol, or expression used to identify and distinguish the goods or services of one party from those of others.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBaZ.label: New York City Court - Sherrill
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBaZ.definition: New York City Court - Sherrill: A specific court within the New York City Court system that handles legal proceedings related to the town of Sherrill.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBaa.label: Ijo languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBaa.definition: Ijo languages are a group of languages that belong to the Language top-level class and are spoken by the Ijo people in Nigeria and Equatorial Guinea.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBah.label: New York District Court - Suffolk County - 4th District
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBah.definition: A court located in Suffolk County, New York, which is part of the larger New York District Court system.
english_labels: New York District Court - Suffolk County - 4th District

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBam.label: Florida Circuit Court - Okeechobee County - 19th Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBam.definition: A court located in Okeechobee County, Florida that is part of the 19th Circuit Court system.
english_labels: Florida Circuit Court - Okeechobee County - 19th Circuit Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBao.label: Black
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBao.definition: Black (Ethnicity and Race) refers to a social and cultural identity associated with people of African descent, often used to describe individuals or groups who identify as Black or African American.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBar.label: Biological Parent
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBar.definition: A Biological Parent, also known as a birth parent, is an individual from whom a child inherits their genetic material. This refers to the mother, from whom a child is born, and the father, who contributes to the child's conception, distinguishing them from adoptive or step-parents.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBax.label: Whistleblower Retaliation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBax.definition: Retaliation against an employee who reports illegal or unethical behavior by their employer.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBax.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Delaware County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBax.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Delaware County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Delaware County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBb1.label: Court-Mandated Conference
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBb1.definition: A Court-Mandated Conference is a legal event that is required by a court order, typically held before a trial, where parties involved in a lawsuit meet to discuss the case and attempt to reach a settlement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBb2.label: Active Employment Status
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBb2.definition: Active Employment refers to the current, ongoing employment relationship between an employee and an employer, where the employee is actively engaged in work and fulfilling job responsibilities. This status usually means that the employee is eligible for all the benefits, salary, and protections provided by the employer

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBb3.label: Arizona Superior Court - Graham Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBb3.definition: Arizona Superior Court - Graham Cty. is a specific court within the Arizona Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Graham County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBb7.label: Florida Circuit Court - Seminole County - 18th Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBb7.definition: The Florida Circuit Court - Seminole County (18th Circuit Court) is a specific court within the Florida Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Seminole County.
english_labels: Florida Circuit Court - Seminole County - 18th Circuit Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBbC.label: Bridge Loan
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBbC.definition: A Bridge Loan is a short-term financing option used to bridge the gap between the purchase of a new asset and the sale of an existing one. Typically utilized in real estate transactions, bridge loans provide immediate cash flow for the borrower until permanent financing can be arranged or the existing asset is sold.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBbK.label: Date of Birth
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBbK.definition: Date of Birth is the specific day, month, and year on which an individual was born. It is a key piece of identifying information used in various legal, medical, and financial contexts, often required for verification of age, eligibility, and identity.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBbK.label: Animal Domestication Type
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBbK.definition: Animal Domestication Type refers to the classification of animals based on their relationship and dependence on humans, distinguishing between those that have been domesticated for companionship, labor, or product provision, and those that live and thrive in the wild without human intervention.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBbL.label: Addendum Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBbL.definition: An addendum clause is a provision added to a contract that modifies or supplements the original terms of the agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBbP.label: lf_matter_id
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBbP.definition: "The law firm assigned matter id or case reference number. Multiple lf_matter_id's can be billed in the same invoice. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBbW.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Iron County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBbW.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Iron County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Iron County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBbW.label: Sweat Evidence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBbW.definition: Sweat evidence refers to the traces of perspiration found on surfaces or objects. While sweat itself contains limited DNA, the skin cells often shed within it can be analyzed for DNA, potentially connecting a person to a specific location or item.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBbZ.label: Coalition Formation and Management Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBbZ.definition: Coalition Formation and Management Practice involves providing legal advice and support for the creation, organization, and governance of coalitions, whether they be political, corporate, or industry-specific. This practice includes drafting agreements, navigating regulatory compliance, and facilitating collaborative strategies among coalition members.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBbZ.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Madison County (3rd Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Madison County (3rd Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBba.label: Georgia Superior Court - Clay County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBba.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Clay County refers to a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Clay County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBbj.label: Providing Alcohol to Minor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBbj.definition: The act of giving or serving alcoholic beverages to an individual who is under the legal drinking age, which may result in legal consequences such as charges of negligence or violation of liquor laws.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBbk.label: Motion to Dismiss for Failure to State a Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBbk.definition: A Motion to Dismiss for Failure to State a Claim is a legal request made by a defendant to dismiss a case on the grounds that the plaintiff has failed to allege sufficient facts to support a legal claim.
english_labels: Motion to Dismiss for Failure to State a Claim

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBbk.label: Skin Disorders
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBbk.definition: Skin disorders encompass a range of conditions affecting the skin's structure and function, including inflammatory, infectious, and neoplastic diseases. These disorders can cause symptoms such as rashes, lesions, and systemic effects that impair the skin's ability to protect the body.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBbk.label: Buyer Consent Requirement Language
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBbk.definition: A requirement for the buyer's explicit agreement to certain terms or conditions, which is included in an affirmative covenant.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBbm.label: Unlawful Wage Garnishment Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBbm.definition: An unlawful wage garnishment claim is a legal action initiated by an employee against their employer for not complying with the legal requirements for wage garnishment. Wage garnishment occurs when a creditor obtains a court order to deduct a portion of an employee's wages to satisfy a debt. The claim typically arises when an employer improperly withholds too much of an employee's wages or does not follow the proper legal procedures for wage garnishment, which can result in financial harm to the employee. Employers can also face liability for not protecting employees from unlawful garnishment orders.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBby.label: Mechanics' Lien
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBby.definition: A Mechanics' Lien is a type of lien that allows a contractor or supplier to place a claim on a property they have worked on if they have not been paid for their services or materials.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBc0.label: City Liability
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBc0.definition: City Liability refers to the legal responsibility of a municipality for any harm or damage caused to individuals or property due to the actions or negligence of the city or its employees.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBc2.label: Fort Sill apache Tribe of Oklahoma
english_labels: Fort Sill apache Tribe of Oklahoma

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBc4.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Piatt County (6th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Piatt County (6th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBc5.label: Telecommunications Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBc5.definition: Industries in this group provide telecommunications and the services related to that activity (e.g., telephony, including Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP); cable and satellite television distribution services; Internet access; telecommunications reselling services). The group is primarily engaged in operating, and/or providing access to facilities for the transmission of voice, data, text, sound, and video.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBc6.label: L350 Discovery Motions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBc6.definition: A legal motion made during the discovery phase of a lawsuit, specifically related to requesting information or evidence from the opposing party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBc6.label: Holdover Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBc6.definition: A holdover clause is a provision in a contract that allows a tenant to remain in possession of a property after the lease has expired, usually on a month-to-month basis, until either party terminates the agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBc6.label: Speech and Debate Clause Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBc6.definition: A Speech and Debate Clause claim refers to a legal argument based on the constitutional provision that grants legislators immunity from civil or criminal liability for statements made during legislative proceedings. This claim protects legislators from being sued or prosecuted for defamation, libel, or other legal actions arising from their speech or debate in the legislative context.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBc8.label: Criminal Trespass
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBc8.definition: To unlawfully enter land, a dwelling, or other real property.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBcC.label: Deferred Appendix
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBcC.definition: A deferred appendix is a section of a document that is not included in the main body but is added as an attachment or supplement at a later time.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBcD.label: B.S. (Bachelor of Science)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBcD.definition: The suffix "B.S." stands for "Bachelor of Science" and is used after a person's name to indicate that they have earned an undergraduate degree in a science or technology-related field. This designation signifies the individual's foundational knowledge and skills in their area of study, and is commonly used in academic, professional, and formal settings

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBcG.label: Exempted Limited Partnership
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBcG.definition: An exempted limited partnership (ELP) is a Cayman partnership that is registered under the Exempted Limited Partnership Law. The ELP Law specifically preserves relevant provisions of the Partnership Law and provides that the principles of common law and equity applicable to partnerships shall apply to ELPs.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBcL.label: 890 Other Statutory Actions (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBcL.definition: Action primarily based on Statutes that cannot be classified under any other nature of suit, such as: Foreign Agents Registration Act 22:611- 621, Klamath Termination Act 25:564-564W-L, Federal Aid Highway Act 23:101-142, Federal Corrupt Practices Act 2:241-256, Federal Election Campaign Act, Highway Safety Act 23:401 Immigration & Nationality Act 8:1503, Natural Gas Pipeline Safety Act 49:1671-1700, Naturalization Acts 8:1421/18:911, 1015, 1421, et seq., 3282 or Federal Aviation Act 49:1301 et seq.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBcS.label: Privacy Risk
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBcS.definition: Privacy Risk refers to the potential for negative consequences arising from an organization's failure to protect the privacy and confidentiality of personal or sensitive information entrusted to it by individuals or other organizations. These risks can result from inadequate data security measures, cyber attacks, or noncompliance with privacy regulations, potentially leading to data breaches, loss of trust, or legal liabilities, ultimately impacting the organization's overall performance, reputation, and sustainability.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBca.label: A109 Appear for/attend
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBca.definition: To "Appear for/attend" refers to the act of physically being present at a scheduled event or proceeding, such as a court hearing or meeting, as a participant or observer.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBcc.label: Armed Forces Branch
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBcc.definition: The Armed Forces Branch is a division of the government responsible for national defense and military operations. It encompasses all military branches, including the army, navy, air force, and other specialized units, ensuring the protection and security of the nation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBcg.label: Interpleader
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBcg.definition: A person who compels other parties making the same claim against him to litigate the matter between themselves to prove whose claim is good.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBcj.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - McKinley County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBcj.definition: A court located in McKinley County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases, such as traffic violations and misdemeanors.
english_labels: New Mexico Magistrate Court - McKinley County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBck.label: Amicus Brief
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBck.definition: An amicus brief is a written legal argument submitted to a court by a non-party who has a strong interest in the outcome of a case, typically to provide additional information or perspective on the legal issues at hand.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBck.label: Employment Eligibility Verification Form
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBck.definition: The Employment Eligibility Verification Form (in the U.S., the I-9) is a form required by the government for all employees to verify their identity and authorization to work in the country. Employers must complete and retain an Employment Eligibility Verification Form for each person they hire, and the form must be available for inspection by authorized government officers.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBcq.label: Financial System Risk
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBcq.definition: The risk that the failure of a financial institution or a group of institutions can cause a systemic crisis.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBcu.label: Raspberries
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBcu.definition: Raspberries are aggregate fruits from the Rubus genus, characterized by their juicy drupelets and sweet-tart flavor. Widely grown in temperate regions, raspberries are consumed fresh, frozen, or processed into various products such as jams, jellies, and desserts, valued for their high vitamin C and fiber content.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBcw.label: New York Supreme Court - Franklin County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBcw.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Franklin County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Franklin County, New York, which is a subdivision of the New York Supreme Court.
english_labels: New York Supreme Court - Franklin County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBcy.label: Massachusetts Superior Court - Hampshire County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBcy.definition: The Massachusetts Superior Court - Hampshire County is a court of general jurisdiction in Massachusetts that hears civil and criminal cases within Hampshire County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBcz.label: Texas Court of Appeals - 3d
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBcz.definition: The Texas Court of Appeals - 3d is a specific intermediate appellate court in Texas that hears appeals from lower courts within its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBd1.label: Arrearage
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBd1.definition: Arrearage refers to the amount of money that is overdue in a payment obligation, often accumulating as a result of missed or partial payments. Failure to clear arrearages can lead to penalties, higher interest rates, and legal actions such as repossession or foreclosure.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBd2.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Potter County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBd2.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Potter County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases within Potter County.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Potter County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBd6.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Franklin County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBd6.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Franklin County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Franklin County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBd6.label: Motor Vehicle Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBd6.definition: Law covering all the aspects of registering and titling motor vehicles, and licensing drivers.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBd9.label: Family Offenses - Nonviolent
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBd9.definition: Unlawful, nonviolent acts by a family member (or legal guardian) that threaten the physical, mental, or economic well-being or morals of another family member and that are not classifiable as other offenses, such as Assault, Incest, Statutory Rape, etc.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdA.label: Motion for Default Judgment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdA.definition: A Motion for Default Judgment is a formal request made to a court asking for a judgment in favor of the moving party when the opposing party has failed to take action or respond to the case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdK.label: 410 Antitrust (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdK.definition: Action brought under the Clayton Act 15 U.S.C. § 12 - 27 alleging undue restriction of trade and commerce by designated methods that limit free competition in the market place amongst consumers such as anti-competitive price discrimination, corporate mergers, interlocking directorates or tying and exclusive dealing contracts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdQ.label: Texas District Court - Denton County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdQ.definition: A Texas District Court located in Denton County, which has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdQ.label: Georgia Superior Court - Lamar County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdQ.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Lamar County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Lamar County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdR.label: Post-Closing Covenants
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdR.definition: "Post-Closing Covenants" are promises or obligations that parties agree to adhere to after the completion of a transaction, such as a merger. In merger agreements, these covenants typically address ongoing commitments, actions, or restrictions to ensure a smooth transition and integration, or to protect the interests of the involved parties after the deal has closed.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdW.label: B.F.A. (Bachelor of Fine Arts)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdW.definition: A B.F.A. (Bachelor of Fine Arts) is a four-year undergraduate degree focused on artistic disciplines such as visual arts, performing arts, or design. It represents proficiency in creative and artistic endeavors.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdX.label: Mende
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdX.definition: Mende (Language) is a structured system of communication that belongs to the Niger-Congo language family and is primarily spoken in Sierra Leone and Liberia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdZ.label: Otomian languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdZ.definition: Otomian languages are a group of indigenous languages spoken in Mexico, characterized by their unique grammar and vocabulary.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdb.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Torrance County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdb.definition: A court located in Torrance County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases.
english_labels: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Torrance County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdb.label: Motion for Contempt
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdb.definition: A Motion for Contempt is a legal request made in a bankruptcy case to hold someone in contempt of court for failing to comply with a court order or violating a court rule.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdb.label: NATO-4 Visa
english_labels: A NATO-4 visa is issued to officials of NATO and their immediate family members, allowing them to enter the U.S. to perform official duties related to NATO. This visa category includes high-ranking officials, diplomats, and their dependents.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdc.label: Virginia Supreme Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdc.definition: The Virginia Supreme Court is the highest court in the state of Virginia, responsible for hearing appeals and making final decisions on legal disputes within the state's court system.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdf.label: Fiber Crops
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdf.definition: Fiber crops are plants grown specifically for their fibers, which are used in the production of textiles, ropes, and other materials. These crops are cultivated for their natural fibers, which are harvested and processed into usable products for industrial and consumer purposes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdi.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - San Juan County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdi.definition: A court located in San Juan County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases, such as traffic violations and misdemeanors.
english_labels: New Mexico Magistrate Court - San Juan County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdu.label: Resource Conservation and Recovery Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdu.definition: A Resource Conservation and Recovery Claim is a legal claim related to the management and disposal of hazardous waste, aimed at ensuring the protection of human health and the environment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdv.label: Temperate Market Segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdv.definition: The temperate market segment refers to consumers or businesses located in regions characterized by moderate temperatures, typically experiencing distinct seasonal changes. This segmentation allows businesses to cater to the needs of individuals living in areas with a temperate climate, offering products and services suitable for varying weather conditions throughout the year.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdx.label: New York City Court - Kingston
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdx.definition: New York City Court - Kingston is a specific court located in Kingston, New York that falls under the broader category of New York City Court.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdy.label: Public Disclosure of Private Facts
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdy.definition: The public disclosure of private facts is a type of privacy claim that involves the dissemination of personal information that is not of legitimate public concern, and that would be highly offensive to a reasonable person. This includes the practice of "doxing" (aka "doxxing"), which refers to the act of publicly revealing private or identifying information about an individual without their consent, typically with malicious intent. This information can include addresses, phone numbers, email addresses, or other personal details, and the practice is often associated with online harassment or cyberbullying.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdz.label: Motion to Extend Time - Trial Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBdz.definition: A Motion to Extend Time - Trial Court is a request made to a trial court to extend the deadline for a specific action or filing in a legal case.
english_labels: Motion to Extend Time - Trial Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBe3.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Wabash County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBe3.definition: A court located in Wabash County, Indiana that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographic area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBe3.label: Tax Deduction
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBe3.definition: A Tax Deduction is a reduction of a taxpayer's taxable income, lowering the amount of income subject to taxation. It operates by subtracting specific expenses or allowances from gross income, thereby decreasing the tax base before the tax rate is applied

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBe8.label: Student Visa
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBe8.definition: A Student Visa is a type of visa issued to foreign nationals who wish to enter a country for the purpose of pursuing academic studies at an accredited educational institution. The visa typically stipulates conditions such as the level of study, the duration of the course, and sometimes even the specific institution the student must attend, and it generally does not permit the holder to engage in full-time employment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBe9.label: Class Action Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBe9.definition: A Class Action Claim is a type of civil claim where a group of individuals collectively bring a lawsuit against a defendant, typically seeking compensation for damages or harm caused by the defendant's actions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBeA.label: Trespass to Real Property
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBeA.definition: The concept of Trespass to Real Property refers to the intentional and unauthorized entry onto someone else's land or property, causing damage or interference with the owner's right to exclusive possession.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBeC.label: Stroke
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBeC.definition: A vascular insult to the brain, commonly referred to as a stroke or cerebrovascular accident, occurs when blood flow to a part of the brain is disrupted, leading to tissue damage and neurological deficits. This condition can result from either ischemia (lack of blood flow) or hemorrhage (bleeding) within the brain.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBeH.label: sequence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBeH.definition: "Used to define a sequence of use. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBeO.label: Musical Work
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBeO.definition: A Musical Work is a composition that consists of a combination of melodies, harmonies, rhythms, and lyrics (if any), intended to be performed or recorded. Protected under copyright law, musical works grant composers and lyricists exclusive rights to reproduce, distribute, perform, and display the composition.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBeW.label: Proration of Rent Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBeW.definition: A proration of rent clause is a provision in a contract that specifies how rent will be divided and calculated when a tenant moves in or out of a property during a rental period.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBeZ.label: Collaborative Communication Platform
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBeZ.definition: A communication that occurs on a platform that permits users to communicate in writing, collaboratively, and asynchronously (e.g., Slack, Teams written messages, client portal).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBeZ.label: Environmental Law Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBeZ.definition: Environmental Law Claims refer to legal actions brought under civil, statutory, and regulatory frameworks to address harm caused by pollution or other environmental damage, including claims related to nuisance, resource conservation and recovery, clean water, groundwater contamination, oil spills, clean air, and soil contamination.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBea.label: bill_to_cl_id
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBea.definition: "The tax id number for the INVOICE.bill_to_cl_name. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBeb.label: Exempt Securities Notification
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBeb.definition: An Exempt Securities Notification is a notice of exempt offering of securities filed with the financial regulator (e.g., U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)) by companies that have sold securities without registration, in reliance on an exemption (e.g., provided by Regulation D or Section 4(a)(5) of the Act). The form provides information about the issuer, the offering, and the investors, and is used to inform regulators and the public about the exempt offering.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBec.label: Standstill Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBec.definition: A Standstill Agreement is a contract in which one party agrees not to take specific actions against another party for a set period. It's often used in business contexts where one company agrees not to acquire more shares or make a takeover bid for another company for a specified duration.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBec.label: Yomba Shoshone Tribe of the Yomba Reservation, Nevada
english_labels: Yomba Shoshone Tribe of the Yomba Reservation, Nevada

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBed.label: pre_post_split
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBed.definition: "Identifies whether the disc_cred is applied before (""Pre-Split"") or after (""Post-Split) the MISF and MIDB percentages are applied to the invoice. ""NA"" (Not applicable) should be used for splits indicated by disc_cred ""MISF"" and ""MIDB"". "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBef.label: Tetum
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBef.definition: Tetum is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary, used in legal matters, that is a member of the Language class.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBek.label: Indiana Superior Court - Hancock County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBek.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that has the power to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within Hancock County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBeo.label: Local Governmental Representative
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBeo.definition: A Local Governmental Representative is an elected or appointed official who serves in a governmental capacity at the municipal or community level. This individual is responsible for making decisions, implementing policies, and representing the interests of their constituents within a specific local jurisdiction, such as a city, town, county, or school district.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBep.label: New York Supreme Court - Sullivan County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBep.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Sullivan County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Sullivan County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of civil and criminal cases.
english_labels: New York Supreme Court - Sullivan County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBer.label: Georgia Magistrate Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBer.definition: Georgia Magistrate Court is a court of limited jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that handles civil claims of $15,000 or less, certain minor criminal offenses, and other legal matters as authorized by law.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBey.label: Arbitration Award
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBey.definition: An arbitration award is a decision made by an arbitrator or panel of arbitrators to resolve a dispute between parties, which is binding and enforceable by law.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBez.label: Bring Down Certificate Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBez.definition: A Bring Down Certificate Clause is a provision in a contract that requires a party to provide updated information or documentation at a later time to ensure the accuracy of the original representations and warranties made in the contract.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBf8.label: Limited Warranty Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBf8.definition: A limited warranty clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the extent to which a seller is responsible for repairing or replacing a product that fails to meet certain standards within a specified period of time.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBf9.label: Not Liable
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBf9.definition: "Not liable" is a legal determination in civil cases indicating that a party has been found not legally responsible or accountable for a particular harm, injury, or legal obligation. It means that the court has not established the party's liability for the claims brought against them, and they are not required to provide compensation or remedies to the plaintiff in the case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfB.label: Koasek (Cowasuck) Traditional Band of the Sovereign Abenaki Nation
english_labels: Koasek (Cowasuck) Traditional Band of the Sovereign Abenaki Nation

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfD.label: Indiana Superior Court - St. Joseph County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfD.definition: The Indiana Superior Court - St. Joseph County is a specific court within the Indiana Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over cases within St. Joseph County, Indiana.
english_labels: Indiana Superior Court - St. Joseph County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfF.label: Pigs
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfF.definition: Pigs are domesticated omnivorous animals belonging to the species Sus scrofa domesticus, commonly raised for their meat (pork), lard, and hides. Known for their intelligence and versatile diet, pigs are a crucial part of agricultural practices and are bred in various environments worldwide.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfG.label: Discovery Motions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfG.definition: Discovery Motions are requests made by parties in a legal case to obtain information or evidence from the opposing party, which may include motions to compel production of documents, depositions, or responses, as well as motions for protective orders or sanctions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfH.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Lee County (15th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Lee County (15th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfJ.label: Fiduciary Breaching Duty
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfJ.definition: The failure of a fiduciary to fulfill their legal obligation to act in the best interest of their client or beneficiary.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfQ.label: Interference with Parent-Child Relationship
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfQ.definition: The concept of "Interference with Parent-Child Relationship" refers to the intentional or negligent actions of a third party that disrupt or damage the relationship between a parent and their child, leading to emotional distress or harm.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfV.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Lehigh County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfV.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Lehigh County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Lehigh County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfV.label: Indiana Superior Court - Wayne County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfV.definition: A court located in Wayne County, Indiana that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfY.label: Non Circumvention Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfY.definition: A Non Circumvention Clause is a provision in a contract that prohibits the parties from bypassing each other and making direct contact or doing business with each other's contacts or associates.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfZ.label: Right to Liberty
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfZ.definition: The right to liberty refers to the fundamental human right to freedom from unlawful or arbitrary arrest, detention, or other forms of physical restraint. This right is enshrined in international legal instruments such as the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights, and aims to protect individual autonomy and freedom from state interference.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfZ.label: Pennsylvania Municipal Court - Philadelphia County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfZ.definition: A court in Philadelphia County that handles minor criminal and traffic offenses, as well as civil cases involving amounts up to $12,000.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfc.label: Washington Superior Court - Whitman County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfc.definition: Washington Superior Court - Whitman County is a specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Whitman County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfc.label: Credit Theft
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfc.definition: The act of taking someone's personal information without their consent and using it to obtain credit or loans in their name.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfg.label: Temporary Employee
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfg.definition: A Temporary Employee is an individual hired for a specific, limited period, often to assist with seasonal workloads or to fill in for a regular employee who is absent. Temporary employees may or may not have access to company benefits, and their employment is generally terminated when the specified period or project is completed.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfi.label: Confabulation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfi.definition: Confabulations, also known as "hallucinations," occur when generative AI systems produce inaccurate or false responses that appear plausible to the user. This phenomenon often involves the invention of erroneous information, such as historical or biographical details, and results from statistical prediction, repetition of training data, or learned patterns.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfj.label: Beets
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfj.definition: Beets, also known as beetroot, are root vegetables from the Beta vulgaris species, characterized by their deep red color and sweet, earthy flavor. They are consumed raw, cooked, or juiced and are valued for their high nutritional content, including vitamins A and C, potassium, manganese, and dietary fiber, as well as their antioxidant properties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfm.label: Investment Advisory Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfm.definition: An Investment Advisory Agreement is a contract between an investor and an advisor, where the advisor provides investment recommendations, portfolio management, or other advisory services. The agreement specifies fees, the scope of advice, and fiduciary responsibilities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfr.label: Indiana Superior Court - Hamilton County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfr.definition: Indiana Superior Court - Hamilton County is a specific court within the Indiana Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over cases in Hamilton County, Indiana.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfr.label: app
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfr.definition: "Used to name an application the data is associated with, e.g. ""E-Billing"" or ""Realestate Online"" "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBfw.label: Dealer
