The traditional activity of the National Postal Service is described in this subsector. Subcontractors include rural post offices on contract to the Postal Service. Bulk transportation of mail on contract to the Postal Service is not included here, because it is usually done by transportation establishments that carry other customers' cargo as well. Establishments that provide courier and express delivery services without operating under a universal service obligation are classified in Subsector 492, Couriers and Messengers.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBpV.label: Animal Production and Aquaculture Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBpV.definition: Industries in this group raise or fatten animals for the sale of animals or animal products and/or raise aquatic plants and animals in controlled or selected aquatic environments for the sale of aquatic plants, animals, or their products. The group includes establishments, such as ranches, farms, and feedlots primarily engaged in keeping, grazing, breeding, or feeding animals. These animals are kept for the products they produce or for eventual sale.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBpY.label: Tenant
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBpY.definition: A person or entity who leases, rents, or occupies property (from a landlord).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBpY.label: Editor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBpY.definition: An Editor is a specific role in a document, responsible for reviewing and making changes to the content, as defined by the OASIS standard.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBpd.label: School Suspension
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBpd.definition: School suspension is a disciplinary action taken by educational institutions in response to student misconduct or rule violations. It involves the temporary removal of a student from regular classes and school activities for a specified period as a consequence for their behavior.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBpe.label: Heterosexual
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBpe.definition: Heterosexual refers to a sexual orientation in which an individual is attracted to members of the opposite sex. It is often considered the societal norm, although it is just one of many sexual orientations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBpf.label: Multi-Jurisdictional Objective
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBpf.definition: Multi-Jurisdictional Objective pertains to legal principles and strategies that involve multiple jurisdictions, including international, regional, and inter-state/provincial laws. It encompasses the application, coordination, and conflict of laws across different legal systems to address multi-jurisdictional issues.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBph.label: UTBMS MF70 Securities Regulatory Matters
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBph.definition: A category within the UTBMS coding system used to classify legal services related to securities regulation, which is a subcategory of the broader category of legal services related to mergers and acquisitions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBpi.label: Other Professionals Expense
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBpi.definition: Expenses incurred by professionals other than lawyers, such as accountants or expert witnesses, that are necessary and reasonable for the proper handling of a legal matter.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBpk.label: Société à Responsabilité Limitée
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBpk.definition: A Société à responsabilité limitée (short SARL and variations thereof; lit. "society with limited responsibility") is a form of private company that exists mainly in French-speaking countries, such as France, Luxembourg, Monaco, Algeria, Morocco, Tunisia, Madagascar, Lebanon, and Switzerland (where it is also designated by GmbH or Sagl).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBpp.label: Fact Deposition Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBpp.definition: Fact Deposition Practice refers to the specific practice of conducting depositions to gather factual information in a legal matter.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBpq.label: Hunting Rights
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBpq.definition: These rights grant an individual or entity the permission to hunt wildlife on a specific piece of land. They can be acquired through leases, permits, or land ownership.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBps.label: Repapering Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBps.definition: Repapering Management refers to the process of updating legal documents and agreements to comply with new regulations or changes in the law, and falls under the broader category of Legal Operations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBq0.label: Consideration - Cash
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBq0.definition: A payment made in cash in exchange for something of value, which is a component of the broader legal concept of consideration.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBq1.label: Coconut
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBq1.definition: Coconuts are large, fibrous fruits from the Cocos nucifera palm, known for their versatile applications in food, cosmetics, and industrial products. The fruit is valued for its water, milk, meat, and oil, providing essential nutrients and serving as a staple food source in tropical regions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBq3.label: Employer-Sponsored Health Plan
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBq3.definition: This is a health insurance plan selected and partially funded by an employer as part of the benefits package for employees. The employer usually pays a portion of the premium, and the employee's share is often deducted from their paycheck.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBq6.label: Georgia District Court - Clarke County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBq6.definition: Georgia District Court - Clarke County: A court of law in the state of Georgia that has jurisdiction over legal disputes and criminal cases within Clarke County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBq8.label: Non-Person Declarant
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBq8.definition: A Non-Person Declarant refers to a source of information or statement that is not a human being, such as a machine, device, animal, or inanimate object. The output or "statement" produced by a non-person declarant is not considered hearsay because the hearsay rule only applies to statements made by a person.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqB.label: Oral Copulation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqB.definition: Oral copulation is a sexual act involving the stimulation of the genitals by the mouth, which is considered a sex offense under the law.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqP.label: Cannabis Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqP.definition: Cannabis Law refers to the legal rules and regulations governing the use, possession, sale, cultivation, and distribution of cannabis, both for medical and recreational purposes. These laws vary significantly between jurisdictions, ranging from total prohibition to decriminalization or full legalization, and they may involve aspects of criminal, business, and health law among others

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqQ.label: Northern Frisian
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqQ.definition: A language spoken in the northern region of the Frisian Islands, primarily in Germany, characterized by its unique grammar and vocabulary.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqT.label: U.S. Patent Trial and Appeal Board
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqT.definition: The U.S. Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB) is a specialized administrative body within the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) that oversees post-grant review proceedings, inter partes review proceedings, and covered business method review proceedings.
english_labels: U.S. Patent Trial and Appeal Board

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqT.label: Limited Lifetime Warranty Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqT.definition: A Limited Lifetime Warranty Clause is a provision in a warranty agreement that limits the duration of coverage to the lifetime of the product, but with certain restrictions or conditions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqU.label: Trial Court Filing Event
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqU.definition: The Trial Court Filing Event refers to the act of submitting legal documents to initiate a lawsuit in a court of law.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqX.label: Incorporation by Reference Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqX.definition: An Incorporation by Reference Clause is a provision in a contract that refers to another document or agreement, making its terms and conditions a part of the current contract.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqa.label: Business and Financial Crimes Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqa.definition: Fraud, embezzlement, ponzi, etc. False Claims Act.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqe.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Lawrence Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqe.definition: The Arkansas Circuit Court - Lawrence Cty. is a specific court within the Arkansas Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Lawrence County, Arkansas.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqf.label: Stay of Arbitration
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqf.definition: A stay of arbitration is a provisional remedy that temporarily suspends the arbitration process until a certain condition is met or a court ruling is made.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqi.label: Guam Territory Courts
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqi.definition: The Guam Territory Courts are a subset of the U.S. Territory Courts and include the Guam Supreme Court.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBql.label: Food Liability Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBql.definition: A food liability claim is a civil claim related to harm caused by consuming contaminated or poisoned food products.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqm.label: Early Neutral Evaluation Forum
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqm.definition: An Early Neutral Evaluation Forum is a type of Mediation Forum where a neutral third party evaluates the strengths and weaknesses of each party's case and provides a non-binding assessment to help the parties reach a settlement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqx.label: WC480 Alternative Fee Arrangements
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqx.definition: This code includes all non-hourly or other alternative fee arrangements for tasks and activities in this phase.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqy.label: Interference with Contractual Relationship
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqy.definition: Interference with Contractual Relationship is the intentional or negligent interference by a third party with a contractual relationship between two parties, resulting in damages to one or both parties.
english_labels: Business Intentionally Interfered With by Outsider
Contract Performance Interfered with by Outsider

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqz.label: Citation to Statutes
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqz.definition: A document's citations to statutes and other enacted laws.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqz.label: Texas Court of Civil Appeals
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBqz.definition: The Texas Court of Civil Appeals is a specific court within the Texas State Courts system that hears appeals in civil cases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBr6.label: International Organization Visa - Employees and Their Families
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBr6.definition: An International Organization Visa for employees and their families is a specialized visa category that allows staff members of international organizations, as well as their immediate family members, to reside in a host country for the duration of their assignment. This visa often comes with certain privileges and immunities to facilitate the employees' work and may allow family members to engage in limited employment or educational activities, depending on the host country's regulations.
english_labels: International Organization Visa - Employees and Their Families

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrB.label: DEPRECATED: M&A Target Industry - Favoring two tags: (1) Acquiree and (2) Industry from Mergers and Acquisitions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrB.definition: A M&A Target Industry is a specific sector or area of business that a party aims to acquire or merge with as part of their overall Mergers and Acquisitions objectives.
english_labels: DEPRECATED: M&A Target Industry - Favoring two tags: (1) Acquiree and (2) Industry from Mergers and Acquisitions

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrB.label: Chemical Manufacturing Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrB.definition: This industry group is based on the transformation of organic and inorganic raw materials by a chemical process and the formulation of products. It industry group includes establishments that make: chemicals, synthetic dyes, rubber, synthetic fibers, pesticides, fertilizers, paint, and cleaning materials.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrF.label: Hotel Liability for Personalty Loss
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrF.definition: Hotel Liability for Personalty Loss refers to the legal responsibility of a hotel to compensate for the loss or damage of personal property belonging to its guests.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrQ.label: Reimbursement of Expenses Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrQ.definition: A Reimbursement of Expenses Clause is a provision in a contract that requires one party to compensate the other for any expenses incurred in the performance of the contract.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrS.label: Neurological Collapse States
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrS.definition: Neurological Collapse States refer to conditions characterized by severe impairment of brain function, leading to a significant reduction or absence of conscious awareness and neurological activity. These states can arise from various causes, including trauma, disease, or systemic failure, and are critical in determining legal and medical decisions regarding life support and end-of-life care.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrU.label: Texas Court of Appeals - 8th
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrU.definition: The Texas Court of Appeals - 8th is a specific intermediate appellate court in Texas that hears appeals from lower courts within its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrU.label: Civil Contract Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrU.definition: Civil Contract Law refers to a subset of Civil Caw (e.g., civil law countries) that deals with agreements between private entities, as opposed to public or governmental entities. This body of law encompasses the creation, interpretation, and enforcement of these agreements, as well as resolution of disputes related to contract performance, breach, or termination.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrV.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Butler County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrV.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Butler County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Butler County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrV.label: Land Banking
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrV.definition: Land Banking involves the strategic acquisition and holding of parcels of land by individuals, companies, or government entities with the intent of future sale or development. This practice aims to control the use and development of land, often leading to increased land value over time.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrb.label: JM00 Costs Assessment (UK J-CODE)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrb.definition: Work related to the assessment or agreement of costs following trial or settlement of the underlying action

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrd.label: Iloko
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrd.definition: A language spoken in the Philippines, specifically in the Ilocos Region, characterized by its unique vocabulary and grammar.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrj.label: Inquiry Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrj.definition: Inquiry Practice refers to the legal and procedural framework governing the conduct of formal investigations into matters of public concern, often initiated by government bodies or legislative entities. These inquiries aim to uncover facts, make recommendations, and provide accountability, typically involving extensive fact-finding, evidence gathering, and public hearings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrk.label: Kachin; Jingpho
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrk.definition: A language spoken by the Kachin and Jingpho people, characterized by its unique grammar and vocabulary.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrk.label: Successors and Assigns Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrk.definition: A Successors and Assigns Clause is a provision in a contract that allows the rights and obligations of the parties to be transferred to another person or entity in the event of a merger, acquisition, or other change in ownership.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrr.label: Georgia Superior Court - Screven County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrr.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Screven County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Screven County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrs.label: Political Risk
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrs.definition: The threats and opportunities associated with the political climate and operating context of an organization — such as the potential for negative consequences arising from political events, decisions, or changes in the regulatory environment that may affect an organization's operations, investments, or overall business climate. These risks can include policy shifts, government instability, geopolitical tensions, or trade restrictions, potentially leading to financial losses, operational disruptions, or reduced market opportunities

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrt.label: Lease Termination Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBrt.definition: A Lease Termination Agreement is a mutual agreement between the landlord and tenant to end the lease before its typical expiration date.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBru.label: Criminal Mayhem
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBru.definition: The intentional and unlawful act of causing injury to another person, resulting in serious bodily harm or disfigurement, with the intent to cause such harm.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBru.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Hickory County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBru.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Hickory County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Hickory County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBs0.label: Burford Abstention
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBs0.definition: A legal doctrine known as Burford Abstention allows federal courts to decline jurisdiction over complex state regulatory schemes in order to avoid interfering with state administrative processes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBs0.label: Motion to Substitute Counsel
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBs0.definition: A Motion to Substitute Counsel is a formal request made to a court by a party in a legal proceeding to replace their current attorney with a new one.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBsA.label: Binding Letter of Intent Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBsA.definition: A Binding Letter of Intent Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the parties' agreement to be bound by the terms of a letter of intent, which is a preliminary agreement that sets out the basic terms of a proposed transaction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBsB.label: Entity Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBsB.definition: Entity Management refers to the process of organizing and maintaining legal entities, such as corporations or partnerships, within a business or organization.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBsE.label: New York City Court - Olean
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBsE.definition: A court located in Olean, New York that operates under the jurisdiction of the New York City Court system.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBsF.label: Social Security Contribution
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBsF.definition: A Social Security Contribution refers to the payment made by employees and employers to fund the social security system, which provides benefits for retirement, disability, and survivorship. These contributions are typically deducted from wages and matched by employers, ensuring financial support for eligible beneficiaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBsV.label: Business and Consumer Services Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBsV.definition: The Business Services industry group comprises establishments engaged in providing services not specifically provided for elsewhere in the classification system. Establishments in this sector are primarily engaged in activities such as equipment and machinery repairing, promoting or administering religious activities, grantmaking, advocacy, and providing drycleaning and laundry services, personal care services, death care services, pet care services, photofinishing services, temporary parking services, and dating services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBsV.label: E102 Outside printing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBsV.definition: The concept of E102 Outside printing refers to the expenses incurred for printing services that are outsourced to a third-party vendor, and is a subcategory of the broader concept of E100 Expenses.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBse.label: Georgia Superior Court - Monroe County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBse.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Monroe County is a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Monroe County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBsi.label: Cross-Border Objective
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBsi.definition: Cross-Border Practice, also known as comparative law practice and international practice, involves lawyers providing legal services concerning legal matters that span the laws of two or more jurisdictions. This practice requires a deep understanding of the legal systems, regulations, and cultural considerations of the relevant jurisdictions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBso.label: UTBMS MA00 Preliminary Matters
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBso.definition: UTBMS MA00 Preliminary Matters refers to the initial legal matters that need to be addressed in a merger or acquisition, as classified under the UTBMS Mergers and Acquisitions code set.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBso.label: Work for Hire Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBso.definition: A Work for Hire Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies that any work created by an individual in the course of their employment or under a contract belongs to the employer or the contracting party, rather than the individual who created it.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBso.label: Gay
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBso.definition: Gay refers to a sexual orientation in which an individual is attracted to members of the same sex. It is a term commonly used to describe men who are attracted to other men, but it can also be used more broadly to describe anyone attracted to individuals of the same sex.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBsq.label: Royalty Payment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBsq.definition: A Royalty Payment is a payment made to the owner of a patent, copyright, trademark, or other intellectual property for the right to use, produce, or sell the owner's creation. These payments are typically a percentage of the revenue generated from the use of the intellectual property or a fixed amount per unit sold.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBsq.label: LLC Operating Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBsq.definition: An LLC Operating Agreement is a document governing the internal operations of a Limited Liability Company (LLC). It outlines the financial and managerial rights and duties of its members.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBsr.label: Workflow Automation Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBsr.definition: Workflow Automation Management refers to the use of technology to streamline and optimize legal processes, specifically in the context of improving efficiency and reducing errors.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBsv.label: Indiana Superior Court - Newton County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBsv.definition: The Indiana Superior Court - Newton County is a specific court within the Indiana Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over cases within Newton County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBsv.label: Matter Tax on Fees
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBsv.definition: A Matter Tax on Fees is a type of Tax Detail and Engagement Fee Detail that refers to a tax imposed on the fees charged for legal services provided in a specific matter or case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBsw.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Marion County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBsw.definition: Oregon Circuit Court - Marion County: A specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system located in Marion County, responsible for administering legal proceedings within its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBt0.label: Economic Development Service
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBt0.definition: Economic development refers to the efforts and policies aimed at improving the economic well-being and quality of life in a community, often involving job creation, business growth, and improvements in infrastructure. Laws and regulations in this area can encompass a wide range of topics, including zoning, public funding, tax incentives, environmental assessments, and employment standards.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBt1.label: Witness Statement Recording
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBt1.definition: A Witness Statement Recording is a type of transcript or recording that captures the spoken testimony of a witness in a legal proceeding.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBt3.label: Custodian
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBt3.definition: A person who is authorized to maintain legal custody of a person or property.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBt4.label: Governmental Law Division
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBt4.definition: A Governmental Law Division is a legal entity within a government, responsible for providing legal services to government agencies, officials, and the public. It ensures legal compliance, represents the government in legal matters, and offers legal advice on policy and administrative issues.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBt6.label: Manslaughter
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBt6.definition: The unlawful killing of a human being without malice aforethought, but with either intent to cause harm or reckless disregard for human life.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBt8.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Drew Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBt8.definition: A court located in Drew County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBt9.label: Recruiting Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBt9.definition: Recruiting Management refers to the process of attracting, selecting, and hiring qualified candidates for job positions within an organization. It falls under the broader category of People Management, which involves overseeing and developing the workforce of an organization.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBtD.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Marshall County (10th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Marshall County (10th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBtE.label: Certificate of Credit Counseling
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBtE.definition: A Certificate of Credit Counseling is a document that verifies an individual has completed a credit counseling course and is required for those filing for bankruptcy or restructuring.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBtI.label: Parenting Plan
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBtI.definition: A Parenting Plan is a legal document that outlines the arrangements and responsibilities of parents or guardians regarding the care and upbringing of their child or children. It typically includes details about custody, visitation schedules, decision-making authority, and other matters related to the child's welfare. These plans are often established during divorce or separation proceedings or as part of co-parenting agreements.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBtP.label: "Constructive Knowledge - Role-based" Language
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBtP.definition: A Material Adverse Effect (MAE) is a legal term that refers to a negative change or event that has a significant impact on a party's ability to fulfill their obligations under a contract or agreement.
english_labels: Material Adverse Effect Definition - "Constructive Knowledge - Role-based" Language

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBtP.label: Uncoded languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBtP.definition: Uncoded languages refer to languages that do not have a standardized system of writing or representation, making them difficult to translate or interpret in legal contexts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBtS.label: Minnesota District Court - Beltrami County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBtS.definition: The Minnesota District Court - Beltrami County is a specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Beltrami County, Minnesota.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBtS.label: Consumer Privacy Ombudsman
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBtS.definition: A person appointed to investigate individuals' privacy complaints against maladministration, especially that of public authorities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBtW.label: Ducks
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBtW.definition: Ducks are domesticated waterfowl belonging to the family Anatidae, commonly raised for their meat, eggs, and feathers. They are versatile birds that thrive in various environments, including wetlands and agricultural settings, and are valued for their high-quality meat and egg production.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBtZ.label: Personal Jurisdiction by Consent
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBtZ.definition: The concept of "Personal Jurisdiction by Consent" refers to a court's authority over a party in a legal matter based on that party's voluntary agreement or submission to the court's jurisdiction, rather than any traditional basis for jurisdiction such as physical presence or domicile.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBtf.label: Funeral Practices
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBtf.definition: Funeral Practices are the various rituals, ceremonies, and customs performed to honor and remember a deceased person. These practices vary greatly across different cultures, religions, and legal systems, often reflecting the beliefs and traditions of the community.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBtg.label: Indiana City Court - Delaware County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBtg.definition: Indiana City Court - Delaware County is a specific court located in Delaware County, Indiana that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBtq.label: A106 Communicate - with client
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBtq.definition: To "Communicate (with client)" means to exchange information or ideas with a person or entity for the purpose of providing legal services, as part of the broader category of "Activities".

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBtt.label: Internist Malpractice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBtt.definition: Negligent or wrongful actions or omissions committed by an internist, which result in harm or injury to a patient, and which form the basis of a medical malpractice claim.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBtw.label: Redwood Valley or Little River Band of Pomo Indians of the Redwood Valley Rancheria California
english_labels: Redwood Valley or Little River Band of Pomo Indians of the Redwood Valley Rancheria California

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBu3.label: Natural Condition
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBu3.definition: A public entity is not responsible for harm resulting from natural conditions on unimproved public property.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBu4.label: Firm Of Counsel
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBu4.definition: A "Firm Of Counsel" is a type of lawyer who is affiliated with a law firm and provides legal advice and services to the firm's clients on a regular basis, but is not an employee or partner of the firm.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBu5.label: Qualified Income Offset Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBu5.definition: A Qualified Income Offset Clause is a provision in a contract that allows for the reduction of one party's income by the amount of benefits received by the other party, typically in the context of divorce or separation agreements.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBu6.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Champaign County (6th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Champaign County (6th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBu9.label: Interference with Testamentary Expectancy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBu9.definition: The concept of Interference with Testamentary Expectancy refers to a legal claim that arises when someone intentionally interferes with another person's expected inheritance or gift, causing harm or damages.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBu9.label: Indiana Town Court - Marion County, Lawrence Twp.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBu9.definition: A court located in Marion County, Lawrence Township, Indiana that has limited jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and small claims cases.
english_labels: Indiana Town Court - Marion County, Lawrence Twp.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBuB.label: Texas District Court - Lamar County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBuB.definition: A Texas District Court located in Lamar County, which has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBuC.label: Failure To Discharge a Mandatory Duty
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBuC.definition: The failure to fulfill a required obligation, which may result in legal liability, specifically within the context of government tort law.
english_labels: Failure To Discharge a Mandatory Duty

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBuG.label: Mutual Termination Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBuG.definition: A mutual termination clause is a provision in a contract that allows both parties to agree to end the contract before its natural expiration date.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBuG.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Marion County (4th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Marion County (4th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBuH.label: Citation to Legislation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBuH.definition: A document's citations to bills and other legislation (e.g., bills before a legislature, bills before congress).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBuP.label: Bankruptcy Exemptions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBuP.definition: Bankruptcy Exemptions are legal protections that allow individuals filing for bankruptcy to keep certain assets, such as a primary residence or personal property, from being seized by creditors to satisfy outstanding debts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBuT.label: Payable-on-Death Account
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBuT.definition: A Payable-on-Death (POD) Account is a financial account, such as a bank account or a certificate of deposit, that allows the account holder to designate a specific beneficiary who will receive the funds in the account upon the account holder's death. This designation operates outside of the probate process, making it a straightforward way to transfer assets to a chosen beneficiary without the need for a will or going through the probate court.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBuT.label: Motion to Relate
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBuT.definition: In certain court jurisdictions (e.g., N.D. Cal.), where a newly filed case relates to a previously filed case, a party may a motion to consider whether the case should be related. Example: N.D. Cal. Local Rule 3-12. https://www.docketalarm.com/cases/California_Northern_District_Court/5--20-cv-08570/Klein_et_al_v._Facebook_Inc/68/#q=%22motion+to+relate%22

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBuY.label: Parking Violation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBuY.definition: A parking violation is a type of traffic violation claim that involves the improper or illegal parking of a vehicle, often resulting in a fine or penalty.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBug.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Blair County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBug.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Blair County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within Blair County, Pennsylvania.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Blair County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBuk.label: Limitation of Liability Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBuk.definition: A Limitation of Liability Clause is a provision in a contract that limits the amount of damages that one party can be held liable for in the event of a breach or other legal claim.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBup.label: Ohio Municipal Court - Montgomery County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBup.definition: Ohio Municipal Court - Montgomery County: A specific municipal court located in Montgomery County, Ohio, with jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBus.label: Individual Education Plan
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBus.definition: An Individual Education Plan (IEP) is a legally-binding document developed for public school students who qualify for special education services. It outlines specific learning objectives, accommodations, and services tailored to meet the unique educational needs of the student.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBuz.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Wasco County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBuz.definition: The Oregon Circuit Court - Wasco County is a specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Wasco County, Oregon.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBv0.label: Pain Management Malpractice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBv0.definition: Negligent or improper treatment of pain by a medical professional, resulting in harm or injury to the patient, which may lead to a legal claim for medical malpractice.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBv4.label: Medical - Real Estate Asset
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBv4.definition: Real estate property buildings, offices, and campuses leased to members or organizations within the healthcare community.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBv7.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Owen County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBv7.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Owen County: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that hears civil and criminal cases within the geographical boundaries of Owen County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBv8.label: Improper Lane Change Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBv8.definition: An Improper Lane Change Claim involves an allegation that a driver has changed lanes in a manner that violates traffic regulations, potentially endangering other road users. This claim can lead to civil penalties or administrative actions and often requires detailed examination of the circumstances and evidence surrounding the incident.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBv8.label: Obligation of Contracts Clause Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBv8.definition: An Obligation of Contracts Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a law or government action violates the Obligation of Contracts Clause of the United States Constitution by impairing the obligations of existing contracts, without a legitimate public purpose, thereby infringing on the sanctity and enforceability of contractual rights.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvD.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Barton County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvD.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Barton County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Barton County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvQ.label: Case Management Hearing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvQ.definition: A Case Management Hearing, also known as a Status Conference, is a type of Hearing that is focused on managing the progress of a legal case and ensuring that it is moving forward in an efficient and effective manner.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvU.label: Motion for Joinder
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvU.definition: A Motion for Joinder is a legal request made in trial courts or bankruptcy proceedings to combine two or more cases or parties into a single action.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvX.label: Truck Transportation Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvX.definition: Industries in this group provide over-the-road transportation of cargo using motor vehicles, such as trucks and tractor-trailers. This group includes general freight trucking and specialized freight trucking.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvX.label: Prevailing Market Rate Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvX.definition: A Prevailing Market Rate Clause is a provision in a contract that sets the price or rate for goods or services based on the current market conditions at the time of performance.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBva.label: Disability Healthcare Coverage
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBva.definition: This type of healthcare coverage is geared towards individuals who have a disability that significantly impairs their ability to function normally. Coverage often includes specialized medical services, treatments, and assistive devices. In the U.S., people with certain disabilities are eligible for Medicare or Medicaid.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvc.label: Entered a Location
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvc.definition: "Entered a Location" refers to the act of a person or object crossing a geographic boundary to reside, conduct business, or exist within a jurisdiction. Examples include a person becoming a permanent resident of a state for tax purposes, an immigrant arriving in a destination country, or a product being imported into a country for trade purposes. These events often come with legal and regulatory implications.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvf.label: Legal Separation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvf.definition: Legal Separation: A legal process that allows a married couple to live apart while remaining legally married, often involving court orders regarding property division, child custody, and support.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvh.label: Legal Work Location - Country
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvh.definition: Country where the legal services work is being performed.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvh.label: Government Immunity
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvh.definition: Government Immunity is a legal concept that shields government officials and entities from being held liable for certain actions or omissions in the course of their official duties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvk.label: Wealth Tax Payment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvk.definition: Taxes levied regularly (in most cases annually) on net wealth, i.e. taxes on a wide range of movable and immovable property, net of debt. It is sub-divided into taxes paid by individuals, and taxes paid by corporate enterprises, according to the criteria set out in §31(a) above. If separate figures exist for receipts paid by institutions, the tax payments involved are added to those paid by corporations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvp.label: Gross Revenue
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvp.definition: The aggregate income generated from all forms of engagement before any costs, taxes, or deductions, offering a preliminary look at financial performance.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvs.label: Constitutional Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvs.definition: Constitutional Claims refer to legal actions brought by individuals or groups asserting that their constitutional rights have been violated by the government or other entities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvt.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Franklin County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvt.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Franklin County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that handles minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil cases involving amounts up to $12,000.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Franklin County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvt.label: Deposition Posture
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvt.definition: Deposition Posture refers to the specific role or position taken by a party during a deposition, such as observing, defending, or taking the deposition.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvz.label: Bashkir
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBvz.definition: Bashkir (Language) is a specific written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a member of the Language top-level class.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBw4.label: Sango
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBw4.definition: Sango is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a member of the Language class.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBw4.label: Conspirator
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBw4.definition: A Conspirator is an individual who participates in an agreement with one or more persons to commit an illegal act. The person actively engages in planning or executing the crime with others. Often, a Conspirator is not a Defendant (e.g., unindicted coconspirator).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBw4.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Linn County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBw4.definition: The Oregon Circuit Court - Linn County is a specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Linn County, Oregon.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwA.label: Georgia Superior Court - Fulton County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwA.definition: A court located in Fulton County, Georgia that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwC.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Ogle County (15th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Ogle County (15th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwJ.label: Probate due to Abuse
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwJ.definition: Probate due to Abuse: The legal process of administering the estate of a deceased person when the reason for filing is related to abuse.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwJ.label: Minnesota District Court - Murray County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwJ.definition: Minnesota District Court - Murray County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Murray County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwK.label: Georgia Superior Court - Greene County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwK.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Greene County refers to a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Greene County, Georgia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwK.label: Privilege Log
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwK.definition: A privilege log is a document that lists the documents or information that a party claims are privileged and therefore protected from disclosure during the discovery phase of a legal proceeding.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwK.label: Superseding Intervening Cause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwK.definition: An intervening cause that breaks the chain of causation and relieves the defendant of liability, but only if it is unforeseeable and supersedes the defendant's original act or omission.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwM.label: oasis:collection
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwM.definition: A collection of metadata related to actors in the OASIS standard, including roles, agents, and figures.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwN.label: Visa for Staff of Individuals with Extraordinary Ability or Achievement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwN.definition: The Visa for Staff of Individuals with Extraordinary Ability or Achievement (in the U.S, the O-2 Visa) is designed for individuals who will accompany and assist a visa holder in their field of extraordinary ability or achievement. In the United States, the O-2 visa is typically granted based on the demonstration that the accompanying individual has skills and experience that are essential to the O-1 visa holder's activity or performance. The duration of the O-2 visa is generally tied to that of the principal O-1 visa holder
english_labels: Visa for Staff of Individuals with Extraordinary Ability or Achievement

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwU.label: Guide
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwU.definition: Document describing how to do a particular legal process, often containing links to other documents.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwV.label: Asset-Backed Commercial Paper
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwV.definition: ABCP is a type of short-term debt instrument that is backed by a pool of financial assets, such as trade receivables, auto loans, credit card debt, residential mortgages, or other asset-backed securities (ABS). The maturity of ABCP typically ranges from 1 to 270 days, with an average of around 30 days.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwZ.label: Unpaid Wages Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwZ.definition: An unpaid wages claim is a legal action initiated by an employee against their employer for not paying the employee their earned wages. The claim typically arises when an employer does not comply with applicable laws, which require employers to pay employees for all hours worked and to pay at least the minimum wage rate. The claim can include allegations of employers failing to pay the employee their regular pay, overtime pay, earned commissions, or other forms of compensation. Employees may also bring unpaid wages claims for non-payment of bonuses or other benefits owed to them.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwc.label: No Delegation Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwc.definition: A "No Delegation Clause" is a provision in a contract that prohibits one party from transferring their obligations or responsibilities to another party without the consent of the other party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwe.label: Assumption of Risk
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwe.definition: Assumption of Risk is a legal defense that asserts that the plaintiff voluntarily and knowingly assumed the risks associated with a particular activity or situation, and therefore cannot hold the defendant liable for any resulting harm or injury.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwe.label: Chibcha
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwe.definition: Chibcha (Language) is a structured system of communication used by the Chibcha people, characterized by its own grammar and vocabulary.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwg.label: Engagement Letter
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwg.definition: An agreement, often in the form of a letter, where a legal service provider (e.g., firm, lawyer) and client set forth the terms of a legal engagement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwt.label: Notice of Proposed Use, Sale, or Lease of Property
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBwt.definition: A Notice of Proposed Use, Sale, or Lease of Property is a written communication that informs interested parties of the intention to use, sell, or lease a particular property, and is typically required by law to be provided in advance of any such action.
english_labels: Notice of Proposed Use, Sale, or Lease of Property

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBww.label: Terminated Employment Status
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBww.definition: Terminated Employment Status indicates that an employee's relationship with an organization has formally ended, either due to resignation, layoffs, or dismissal. In this status, the employee is no longer on the payroll and usually loses eligibility for company-provided benefits, with the termination often documented for record-keeping and compliance purposes

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBx2.label: By Document / Artifact
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBx2.definition: Engagement fee model where a client pays a predetermined fee per document.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBx6.label: Right of Inspection
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBx6.definition: The Right of Inspection is the legal entitlement of a shareholder or member of a corporation or partnership to examine and review the company's books, records, and other relevant documents to ensure transparency and accountability.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBx7.label: City Councilperson
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBx7.definition: A City Councilperson is an elected official who serves as a member of a city's legislative body, typically known as the city council. This individual is responsible for proposing, debating, and voting on local ordinances, policies, and budgets that govern the municipality and affect its residents.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxB.label: Distracted Driving Claim
english_labels: Cell Phone Use While Driving Claim

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxF.label: Ex Parte Communication
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxF.definition: Ex Parte Communication refers to a communication between one party and a decision-maker without the presence or knowledge of the other party involved in the matter.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxG.label: International Data Transfer Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxG.definition: An International Data Transfer Clause is a provision in a contract that governs the transfer of personal data across international borders.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxK.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Tillamook County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxK.definition: The Oregon Circuit Court - Tillamook County is a specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Tillamook County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxR.label: Bank Misconduct When Relying on Power of Attorney
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxR.definition: Bank Misconduct When Relying on Power of Attorney: The wrongful or illegal actions taken by a bank when it relies on a power of attorney granted by a customer to conduct transactions on their behalf, often resulting in harm or loss to the customer.
english_labels: Bank Misconduct When Relying on Power of Attorney

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxV.label: North Carolina Supreme Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxV.definition: The North Carolina Supreme Court is the highest court in the state of North Carolina, with the authority to hear appeals from lower state courts and to interpret and apply the state's laws and constitution.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxe.label: Probate Reason of Neglect/Abandonment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxe.definition: Probate Reason of Neglect/Abandonment refers to a legal ground for filing a probate case where the decedent's property was neglected or abandoned by the heirs or beneficiaries, leading to the need for court intervention to distribute the assets.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxg.label: Sustainable Market Segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxg.definition: The sustainable and eco-friendly segment refers to a portion of the market that is characterized by consumers who prioritize environmental sustainability and ethical practices in their purchasing decisions. This segment includes products and services that are designed with a focus on reducing environmental impact, using renewable resources, and promoting social responsibility.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxj.label: Indiana Superior Court - Washington County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxj.definition: Indiana Superior Court - Washington County is a specific court within the Indiana Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Washington County, Indiana.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxj.label: Indigenous and Tribal Religious Laws
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxj.definition: Indigenous and Tribal Religious Laws are the traditional rules, customs, and practices developed and followed by indigenous and tribal communities, often based on spiritual beliefs and ancestral teachings, that govern various aspects of their communal and personal lives.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxo.label: Client Practice Group
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxo.definition: The primary group within the law department that is performing or overseeing the legal work.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxp.label: Rights Agreement Representation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxp.definition: A Rights Agreement Representation is a statement made by a party in a legal matter regarding their ownership or control of certain rights, and the assurance that they have the authority to enter into an agreement related to those rights.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxq.label: Bystander Emotional Distress
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxq.definition: The concept of Bystander Emotional Distress refers to the legal claim that a person who witnesses the harm caused to another person can also suffer emotional distress and can seek compensation for it, under the Infliction of Emotional Distress claim.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxr.label: Partnership Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxr.definition: A Partnership Agreement is a contract between partners in a partnership that specifies their mutual obligations, responsibilities, profit-sharing ratios, and other operational terms.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxs.label: Directory
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxs.definition: A compiled list of people, documents, or artifacts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxs.label: Jurisdiction of Formation Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxs.definition: A Jurisdiction of Formation Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the governing law of the agreement and the jurisdiction where any disputes arising from the contract will be resolved.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxt.label: Georgia Superior Court - Johnson County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxt.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Johnson County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Johnson County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxv.label: Minnesota District Court - Hennepin County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxv.definition: The Minnesota District Court - Hennepin County is a specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Hennepin County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxw.label: Georgia District Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBxw.definition: The Georgia District Court is a court within the Georgia State Courts system that has jurisdiction over a specific geographic area and handles civil and criminal cases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBy3.label: U.S. Marshal
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBy3.definition: An officer of the United States Marshals Service (USMS), which is a federal law enforcement agency that is a bureau within the U.S. Department of Justice.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByA.label: Stipulated Voluntary Dismissal
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByA.definition: A stipulated voluntary dismissal is a legal filing made by parties in a case to dismiss the case by mutual agreement, without prejudice to either party's right to refile the case in the future.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByD.label: Data Quality Principle
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByD.definition: Data Quality is the privacy principle that personal data should be relevant to the purposes for which they are to be used, and, to the extent necessary for those purposes, should be accurate, complete and kept up-to-date.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByG.label: Male Market Segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByG.definition: The male market segment refers to a division of the market that is specifically targeted towards male consumers. This segment encompasses products, services, and marketing strategies that are designed to cater to the needs, preferences, and interests of men, taking into account factors such as lifestyle, life stage, and purchasing behavior.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByI.label: Paternity Test
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByI.definition: A Paternity Test is a DNA test that compares the genetic material of an alleged father to that of a child to determine the likelihood of a biological relationship. This test is often used in legal contexts to establish parental rights, child support, or inheritance claims, but can also be used for personal reasons.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByK.label: Interested
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByK.definition: The attribute "interested" refers to parties who have a stake in the proceedings, such as creditors, shareholders, or other entities that may be affected by the outcome. Interested counsel specifically denotes legal representatives advocating on behalf of these stakeholders to protect their interests during the process.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByL.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Jefferson County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByL.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Jefferson County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Jefferson County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByM.label: Pay Equity Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByM.definition: A legal concept that deals with ensuring equal pay for equal work regardless of gender, race, or other protected characteristics in the workplace.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByO.label: Arkansas District Court - Clark Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByO.definition: The Arkansas District Court - Clark Cty. is a specific court within the Arkansas District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Clark County, Arkansas.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByT.label: Financial Industry Regulatory Authority
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByT.definition: The Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA) is a self-regulatory organization in the United States that oversees broker-dealers and their registered representatives. FINRA is responsible for enforcing rules and regulations in the securities industry to protect investors and maintain market integrity.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByV.label: Appellate Filings - Briefs and Appendices
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByV.definition: A brief or appendix filed by a party in an appellate proceeding.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByW.label: New York Criminal Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByW.definition: The New York Criminal Court is a court within the New York State Courts system that handles criminal cases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByd.label: Indiana Circuit Court - St. Joseph County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByd.definition: The Indiana Circuit Court - St. Joseph County is a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in St. Joseph County, Indiana.
english_labels: Indiana Circuit Court - St. Joseph County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByh.label: fee_item_disc_cred segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByh.definition: "All discounts, credits and Alternate Fee Agreement items applied to the parent fee line item. There will be 0 or more FEE_ITEM_DISC_CRED segments per FEE item. Note that the EXTEND_HEADER option was purposely omitted from this segment. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByl.label: Recurrent Use and Permission Tax Payment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByl.definition: Recurrent Use and Permission Tax Payment refers to taxes levied at regular intervals, usually as fixed amounts, for the use of goods or permission to use goods or perform activities. This category includes vehicle license taxes, as well as taxes on permission to hunt, shoot, fish, sell certain products, own dogs, broadcast license fees, and taxes on performing certain services.
english_labels: Recurrent Use and Permission Tax Payment

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByl.label: Shareholder Letter
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByl.definition: A Shareholder Letter is a formal document, usually penned by a company's top management, directed towards the shareholders of the company. It often accompanies annual or quarterly reports and aims to provide insights into the company's performance, strategies, and future plans.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByq.label: Proprietary Property Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByq.definition: A Proprietary Property Clause is a provision in a contract that grants exclusive ownership rights to a specific property or asset to one party, typically the seller or licensor, and restricts the use or transfer of that property by the other party, typically the buyer or licensee.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByu.label: Slave
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByu.definition: A language spoken by the Athapascan people, including the Slavey dialect, used in legal matters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByw.label: Gender Change
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RByw.definition: A gender change refers to the legal process by which an individual modifies the gender marker on official documentation to align with their gender identity. This process varies by jurisdiction, but typically involves submitting proof of medical or psychological evaluation, undergoing specific medical procedures, or simply making a declaration, followed by the issuance of updated identification documents.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBz2.label: Familial Status
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBz2.definition: Familial status refers to the presence of children under the age of 18 in a family, including pregnant women and individuals in the process of adopting or securing legal custody of a child. This classification is protected under various anti-discrimination laws, such as the Fair Housing Act in the United States, which prohibits discrimination in housing based on familial status (among other bases).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBz3.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Grundy County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBz3.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Grundy County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Grundy County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzB.label: Assignment for the Benefit of Creditors
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzB.definition: Assignment for the Benefit of Creditors (ABC) is a voluntary liquidation process where a debtor transfers all assets to an assignee, who sells the assets and distributes the proceeds to creditors. This non-judicial alternative to bankruptcy aims to maximize asset value and expedite creditor repayment. Some jurisdictions require court proceedings.
english_labels: Assignment for the Benefit of Creditors

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzK.label: Ticket
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzK.definition: A ticket is a legal document used in trial court practice to initiate or respond to a legal action.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzK.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Cedar County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzK.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Cedar County: A specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Cedar County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzL.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Columbia Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzL.definition: A court located in Columbia County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzL.label: L623 Media/ESI Transfer, Receipt, Inventory
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzL.definition: Activities and actions related to the transfer, receipt, tracking an inventory of ESI.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzO.label: A105 Communicate - in firm
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzO.definition: The concept A105 Communicate (in firm) refers to the act of exchanging information or ideas within a law firm or legal organization.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzS.label: LINE_ITEM_TAX_TOTAL
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzS.definition: The LINE_ITEM_TAX_TOTAL concept refers to the total amount of taxes associated with a specific line item in the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzS.label: Juvenile Detention Center
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzS.definition: A Juvenile Detention Center is a secure facility designed to detain minors who are awaiting court hearings or have been adjudicated for juvenile offenses. These centers focus on rehabilitation and education, providing programs tailored to the developmental needs of young offenders.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzT.label: Georgia Superior Court - Brantley County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzT.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Brantley County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzT.label: Outperformance Bonus Certificate
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzT.definition: An Outperformance Bonus Certificate is a financial instrument that allows disproportionate participation in the positive performance of the underlying asset or assets above a certain strike level, combined with protective features. The minimum redemption value is equal to the nominal value, provided a specified barrier has not been breached; if the barrier is breached, the product converts into an outperformance certificate. With greater risk, multiple underlying assets (worst-of) allow for a higher bonus level or lower barrier, offering reduced risk compared to a direct investment in the underlying assets.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzj.label: E113 Subpoena fees
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzj.definition: Subpoena fees are expenses incurred in the process of serving a subpoena.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzn.label: Hausa
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzn.definition: A language spoken in West Africa, primarily in Nigeria and Niger, belonging to the Chadic branch of the Afro-Asiatic language family.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzr.label: Criminal Homicide Offenses
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzr.definition: Criminal Homicide Offenses: The unlawful killing of a human being by another, including murder, manslaughter, and other related claims.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzu.label: Visa for Dependent of Temporary Religious Worker
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzu.definition: This visa (in the U.S., the R-2 visa) is designed for dependents of temporary religious workers (in the U.S., R-1 visa holders), including spouses and unmarried children under the age of 21. In the United States, the R-2 visa allows these dependents to accompany the principal R-1 visa holder for the duration of their authorized stay. While R-2 visa holders are not authorized to work in the U.S., they may attend school
english_labels: Visa for Dependent of Temporary Religious Worker

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzv.label: Transition Services Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzv.definition: A Transition Services Agreement is an agreement between a seller and a buyer where the seller agrees to provide post-closure services (like IT, HR, or accounting) to ensure a smooth transition after a transaction, such as a merger or sale.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzy.label: Dispositive Motion Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzy.definition: Dispositive Motion Practice refers to the legal process of requesting a court to make a final decision on a case before trial, based on the evidence and arguments presented in pretrial motion practice.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzy.label: Motion to Transmit More Complete Trial Record to Appellate Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzy.definition: A Motion to Transmit More Complete Trial Record to Appellate Court is a formal request made by a party in a legal case to send a more complete record of the trial proceedings to the appellate court for review.
english_labels: Motion to Transmit More Complete Trial Record to Appellate Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzz.label: Motion to Reinstate Case
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RBzz.definition: A Motion to Reinstate Case is a formal request made to a court to restore a previously dismissed case to its active docket.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC05.label: Intellectual Property Purchase and Transfer Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC05.definition: An Intellectual Property Purchase and Transfer Agreement details the terms and conditions under which intellectual property rights are sold and transferred from one party to another. It establishes the sale price, rights being transferred, and any ongoing obligations or royalties.
english_labels: Intellectual Property Purchase and Transfer Agreement

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC07.label: Nsanje
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC07.definition: Nsanje is a district located in the southern region of Malawi.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC09.label: Goh-Djiboua
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC09.definition: Goh-Djiboua is a region in Côte d'Ivoire.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0B.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Delaware County Circuit 5
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0B.definition: The Indiana Circuit Court - Delaware County Circuit 5 is a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Delaware County.
english_labels: Indiana Circuit Court - Delaware County Circuit 5

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0C.label: Swiss German; Alemannic; Alsatian
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0C.definition: Swiss German, Alemannic, and Alsatian are dialects of the German language spoken in Switzerland, Germany, and France respectively.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0D.label: Intellectual Property Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0D.definition: An Intellectual Property Agreement is a legal contract between parties that outlines the ownership and use of intangible assets, such as patents, trademarks, and copyrights.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0J.label: Semen Evidence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0J.definition: Semen evidence consists of traces of seminal fluid found at crime scenes or on items. Through forensic analysis, semen can provide DNA and other biological markers, potentially linking a suspect to a specific act or location.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0L.label: Florida Circuit Court - Hamilton County - 3rd Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0L.definition: A court located in Hamilton County, Florida that is part of the larger Florida Circuit Court system.
english_labels: Florida Circuit Court - Hamilton County - 3rd Circuit Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0N.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Jay County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0N.definition: The Indiana Circuit Court - Jay County is a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system, with jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Jay County, Indiana.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0O.label: Insolvent Seller Having Sold Goods
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0O.definition: An Insolvent Seller Having Sold Goods refers to a legal claim arising from a situation where a seller who is unable to pay their debts has sold goods to a buyer. This claim falls under the broader categories of Contract and Quasi-Contract Claims.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0V.label: Resource Supply Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0V.definition: A Resource Supply Agreement is a contract between parties for the provision of specific resources, which can range from raw materials to human resources. The agreement will outline terms, pricing, delivery, and other pertinent conditions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0g.label: Escrow Agent's Negligence and Constructive Fraud
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0g.definition: The concept of "Escrow Agent's Negligence and Constructive Fraud" refers to legal claims against real estate agents and brokers for their failure to exercise reasonable care in handling funds and documents held in escrow, resulting in harm to the parties involved.
english_labels: Escrow Agent's Negligence and Constructive Fraud

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0k.label: date
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0k.definition: "Used to define a date associated with the overall extend_header and associated extend_data elements in this segment. "
