https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0m.label: Human-Centric AI
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0m.definition: Human-Centric AI, also known as human-centered AI, is an approach to designing, deploying, and using AI systems that considers them as integral components of socio-technical environments where humans maintain meaningful agency. This approach prioritizes enhancing human capabilities rather than replacing them and is promoted in policy, research, and engineering to develop AI systems that serve human beings and increase human and environmental well-being by upholding human rights, the rule of law, democratic values, and sustainable development.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0o.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Calhoun Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0o.definition: The Arkansas Circuit Court - Calhoun County is a specific court within the Arkansas Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Calhoun County, Arkansas.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0p.label: Quadriplegia
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0p.definition: Quadriplegia, also known as tetraplegia, is a type of mobility disability characterized by the partial or complete paralysis of all four limbs and the torso. This condition typically results from a spinal cord injury or disease affecting the cervical region of the spine, leading to a loss of motor and sensory function below the level of injury.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0r.label: Motion to Compel Deposition
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0r.definition: A Motion to Compel Deposition is a formal request made to a court to require a witness to attend a deposition and provide testimony or evidence that they have previously refused to provide.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0t.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Sierra County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0t.definition: A court located in Sierra County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases.
english_labels: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Sierra County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0v.label: Georgia District Court - Elbert County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0v.definition: A court located in Elbert County, Georgia that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0w.label: Photograph
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0w.definition: A Photograph is an image captured by a camera that records a visual representation of a subject using light-sensitive materials or digital sensors. Protected under copyright law, photographs grant the photographer exclusive rights to reproduce, distribute, and display the image.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0w.label: Lack of Proportionality
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0w.definition: The Lack of Proportionality is a defense in discovery and evidentiary matters where the requested information or evidence is not reasonably related to the claims or defenses in the legal matter.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0y.label: Joint Venture
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0y.definition: A joint venture is a business arrangement where two or more parties agree to pool their resources to accomplish a specific task, project, or business activity. Each party in a joint venture retains its separate legal status while sharing ownership, control, and profits of the joint enterprise.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0z.label: Grand Jury Clause Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC0z.definition: A Grand Jury Clause claim is a legal assertion that an individual's Fifth Amendment rights have been violated. In the United States Constitution, the Grand Jury Clause of the Fifth Amendment requires that a grand jury indictment or presentment be obtained before a person can be charged with a serious federal crime. A claim related to this clause may arise if an individual believes that their case was not properly or fairly considered by a grand jury, or if the grand jury proceedings were flawed in some significant way.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC10.label: Cabo Delgado
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC10.definition: Cabo Delgado is a region in Mozambique.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC10.label: Wardak
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC10.definition: Wardak is a province in Afghanistan.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC12.label: Texas District Court - Hale County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC12.definition: A Texas District Court located in Hale County is a specific court within the Texas District Court system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC13.label: Karnten
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC13.definition: Karnten is a region in Austria.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC16.label: Textile Mills Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC16.definition: Industries in the Textile Mills subsector group establishments that transform a basic fiber (natural or synthetic) into a product, such as yarn or fabric that is further manufactured into usable items, such as apparel, sheets, towels, and textile bags for individual or industrial consumption. The further manufacturing may be performed in the same establishment and classified in this subsector, or it may be performed at a separate establishment and be classified elsewhere in the Manufacturing sector. The main processes in this subsector include preparation and spinning of fiber, knitting or weaving of fabric, and the finishing of the textile. The NAICS structure follows and captures this process flow. Major industries in this flow, such as preparation of fibers, weaving of fabric, knitting of fabric, and fiber and fabric finishing, are uniquely identified. Texturizing, throwing, twisting, and winding of yarn contain aspects of both fiber preparation and fiber finishing and are classified with preparation of fibers rather than with finishing of fibers. NAICS separates the manufacturing of primary textiles and the manufacturing of textile products (except apparel) produced from purchased primary textiles, such as fabric. The manufacturing of textile products (except apparel) from purchased fabric is classified in Subsector 314, Textile Product Mills, and apparel from purchased fabric is classified in Subsector 315, Apparel Manufacturing. Excluded from this subsector are establishments that weave or knit fabric and make garments. These establishments are included in Subsector 315, Apparel Manufacturing.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC17.label: Ta' Xbiex

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC1B.label: Performing Arts, Spectator Sports, and Related Industries
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC1B.definition: Industries in the Performing Arts, Spectator Sports, and Related Industries subsector group establishments that produce or organize and promote live presentations involving the performances of actors and actresses, singers, dancers, musical groups and artists, athletes, and other entertainers, including independent (i.e., freelance) entertainers and the establishments that manage their careers. The classification recognizes four basic processes: (1) producing (i.e., presenting) events; (2) organizing, managing, and/or promoting events; (3) managing and representing entertainers; and (4) providing the artistic, creative, and technical skills necessary to the production of these live events. Also, this subsector contains four industries for performing arts companies. Each is defined on the basis of the particular skills of the entertainers involved in the presentations. The industry structure for this subsector makes a clear distinction between performing arts companies and performing artists (i.e., independent or freelance). Although not unique to arts and entertainment, freelancing is a particularly important phenomenon in this Performing Arts, Spectator Sports, and Related Industries subsector. Distinguishing this activity from the production activity is a meaningful process differentiation. This approach, however, is difficult to implement in the case of musical groups (i.e., companies) and artists. These establishments tend to be more loosely organized and it can be difficult to distinguish companies from freelancers. For this reason, NAICS includes one industry that covers both musical groups and musical artists. This subsector contains two industries for Industry Group 7113, Promoters of Performing Arts, Sports, and Similar Events, one for those that operate facilities and another for those that do not. This is because there are significant differences in cost structures between those promoters that manage and provide the staff to operate facilities and those that do not. In addition to promoters without facilities, other industries in this subsector include establishments that may operate without permanent facilities. These types of establishments include performing arts companies; musical groups and artists; spectator sports; and independent (i.e., freelance) artists, writers, and performers. Excluded from this subsector are nightclubs. Some nightclubs promote live entertainment on a regular basis and it can be argued that they could be classified in Industry Group 7113, Promoters of Performing Arts, Sports, and Similar Events. However, since most of these establishments function as any other drinking place when they do not promote entertainment and because most of their revenue is derived from sale of food and beverages, they are classified in Subsector 722, Food Services and Drinking Places.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC4K.label: Esperanto
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC4K.definition: Esperanto is a constructed language created in the late 19th century as an international auxiliary language, with the goal of facilitating communication between people of different cultures who speak different native languages.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC4L.label: New York District Court - Suffolk County - 2nd District
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC4L.definition: A court located in Suffolk County, New York that is part of the larger New York District Court system.
english_labels: New York District Court - Suffolk County - 2nd District

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC4O.label: base_amount
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC4O.definition: "The original WIP value of the time entry before adjustments or discounts of any sort are applied. Regardless of charge_type, then base_amount = units * rate prior to any adjustments or discounts. E.g. ""300.0000"" "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC4P.label: Civil Rights Violation Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC4P.definition: A civil rights violation claim is a legal action brought against a government entity for violating an individual's rights protected by law, such as discrimination or denial of voting rights.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC4Q.label: Petty Theft
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC4Q.definition: Petty Theft is a criminal offense that involves the unlawful taking of property or money that is of relatively low value, typically classified as a misdemeanor.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC4j.label: Medical Discharge
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC4j.definition: A Military Medical Discharge refers to the release of a service member from active duty due to a physical or mental condition that impairs their ability to perform their military duties. The condition may be due to an illness, injury, or a mental health issue. Depending on the severity and duration of the condition, the service member might receive benefits and compensation based on their level of disability.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC4l.label: California Superior Court - Riverside Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC4l.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Riverside County, California, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC4m.label: Motion to File Reply
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC4m.definition: A Motion to File Reply is a formal request made to a court or other legal authority, seeking permission to submit a written response to an opposing party's previous filing or argument.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC4p.label: Sinhala; Sinhalese
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC4p.definition: A language spoken in Sri Lanka, belonging to the Indo-Aryan family, and written in the Sinhalese script.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC4t.label: Automatic Renewal Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC4t.definition: An automatic renewal clause is a provision in a contract that allows for the renewal of the agreement without the need for explicit consent or action by the parties involved.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC4u.label: Malay
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC4u.definition: Malay (Language) is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary, used in legal matters, that is specifically identified as the language spoken in Malaysia and parts of Indonesia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC4v.label: Living Apart Pursuant to Separation Decree
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC4v.definition: Living Apart Pursuant to Separation Decree: The legal status of a couple who have obtained a separation decree and are living separately, as ordered by the court.
english_labels: Living Apart Pursuant to Separation Decree

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC50.label: Race
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC50.definition: Any one of the groups that humans are often divided into based on physical traits regarded as common among people of shared ancestry.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC50.label: Ad Dakhiliyah
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC50.definition: Ad Dakhiliyah is a region in Oman.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC51.label: Employer-Sponsored Retirement Account
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC51.definition: An employer-sponsored retirement account is a retirement savings plan offered by an employer to its employees as part of their employee benefits package. Examples include 401(k) plans in the United States. These accounts allow employees to contribute a portion of their salary, often with employer matching contributions, to be invested for retirement, providing tax advantages and financial security in later years

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC51.label: Kien Giang
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC51.definition: Kien Giang is a province in Vietnam.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC52.label: English, Middle
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC52.definition: Middle English is a language that was spoken and written in England between the years 1100 and 1500.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC53.definition: Action filed under the Individuals with Disabilities Educations Act, 20 U.S.C. § 1401 and Title IX of the Education Amendment of 1972, 20 U.S.C. § 1681 et seq.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC58.definition: Swieqi is a locality in Malta.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5C.label: Government National Mortgage Association
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5C.definition: The Government National Mortgage Association (GNMA), or Ginnie Mae, was established in the United States in 1968 to promote home ownership.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5C.definition: Turkana is a region in Kenya.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5C.label: Jonglei
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5C.definition: Jonglei is a region in South Sudan.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5E.label: Tulkarm
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5E.definition: Tulkarm is a city located in the State of Palestine.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5F.label: Ararat
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5F.definition: Ararat is a location in Armenia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5F.label: Curfew Violation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5F.definition: A curfew violation is a specific type of legal offense that occurs when an individual fails to comply with a set curfew time, typically imposed on minors, and can result in legal consequences.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5G.label: AI Measurement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5G.definition: AI Measurement refers to the methods and metrics used to evaluate the performance and effectiveness of artificial intelligence systems. These measurements typically assess the accuracy, precision, recall, and other relevant performance metrics to ensure the AI system meets its intended goals and operates reliably in various conditions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5J.label: Pretrial Order
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5J.definition: A pretrial order is a court order that sets out the rules and procedures for conducting a trial, issued before the trial begins.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5L.label: Nonparty
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5L.definition: A person or entity who is not a party to the legal proceeding.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5R.label: Familial Role
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5R.definition: A Familial Role defines an individual's position or relationship within a family structure based on genetic ties, marriage, or legal definitions. Examples include roles such as parent, child, grandparent, sibling, or spouse, each carrying specific relational dynamics, responsibilities, and societal expectations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5U.label: Guarantor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5U.definition: A person guaranteeing the payment of bonds, the repurchase thereof, or the payment or repurchase of any interest therein. CA Gov. Sec. 5102.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5Y.label: Georgia Superior Court - Columbia County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5Y.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia, located in Columbia County and having authority over civil and criminal cases within its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5Z.label: Continuous Matching Rights Period
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5Z.definition: A Continuous Matching Rights Period is a period of time during which a party has the right to match the terms of a proposed transaction, and this right continues until the transaction is completed or terminated.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5b.label: Article 4 Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5b.definition: An Article IV claim is a legal argument grounded in the provisions of Article IV of the U.S. Constitution, which deals with the states' powers, their interactions with each other, and with the federal government. This claim might emerge in disputes over matters such as extradition between states, the Full Faith and Credit Clause, or the Privileges and Immunities Clause.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5e.label: Sidebar
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5e.definition: A "sidebar" in a legal context refers to a private discussion or conference between the judge and attorneys, usually held outside the presence of the jury or other parties involved in a trial, to address legal issues, objections, or procedural matters related to the case. It allows for the resolution of certain matters without influencing the jury's perception of the proceedings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5o.label: Memorandum
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5o.definition: A memorandum is a written communication used in legal proceedings, typically used to summarize and analyze legal issues and provide recommendations to a court or client.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC5y.label: Illinois Circuit Court - DeWitt County (6th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - DeWitt County (6th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC60.label: U.S. Bankruptcy Court - D. Tennessee
english_labels: United States Bankruptcy Court, D. Tennessee

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC61.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Northumberland County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC61.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court located in Northumberland County, responsible for administering legal proceedings within its jurisdiction.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Northumberland County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC64.label: Analysis of Severance Obligations
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC64.definition: Analysis of Severance Obligations refers to the examination and evaluation of the legal responsibilities and duties of an employer to provide compensation or benefits to an employee upon termination of employment, specifically focusing on the severance package.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC65.label: Gombe
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC65.definition: Gombe is a location in Nigeria.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC65.definition: Mindoro Occidental is a province in the Philippines.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC66.definition: Alebtong is a district in Uganda.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC66.definition: Giresun is a city in Turkey.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC69.label: Omnogovi
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC69.definition: Omnogovi is a province in Mongolia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC69.label: Promise Causing Detrimental Reliance
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC69.definition: A Promise Causing Detrimental Reliance is a legal concept that arises in contract and quasi-contract claims, where a party makes a promise to another party who relies on that promise to their detriment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6B.label: Masvingo
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6B.definition: Masvingo is a city in Zimbabwe.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6E.label: Transcript Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6E.definition: Transcript Management refers to the process of organizing and maintaining records of court proceedings, including the creation, storage, and retrieval of transcripts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6F.label: Public and Indian Housing Office
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6F.definition: The Office of Public and Indian Housing (PIH) is an agency of the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development. Its mission is to ensure safe, decent, and affordable housing, create opportunities for residents' self-sufficiency and economic independence, and assure the fiscal integrity of all program participants.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6G.label: Massachusetts Superior Court - Worcester County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6G.definition: The Massachusetts Superior Court - Worcester County is a court of general jurisdiction in Massachusetts that hears civil and criminal cases within Worcester County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6I.label: Texas District Court - Gregg County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6I.definition: A Texas District Court located in Gregg County, which is a court of general jurisdiction in Texas responsible for hearing civil and criminal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6N.label: Estates, Gifts, and Trusts Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6N.definition: Laws regulating estate or personal planning and administration.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6O.label: Rent Abatement Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6O.definition: A rent abatement clause is a provision in a contract that allows for a reduction or suspension of rent payments in the event of certain circumstances, such as property damage or loss of use.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6P.label: Undifferentiated and Mixed Connective Tissue Disease
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6P.definition: Undifferentiated and mixed connective tissue disease encompasses syndromes with clinical and immunologic features of multiple autoimmune disorders, but which do not meet the criteria for any specific disorder. These conditions may present with clinical manifestations of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), systemic vasculitis, and serologic findings characteristic of rheumatoid arthritis, among others.
english_labels: Undifferentiated and Mixed Connective Tissue Disease

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6S.label: Passport Number
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6S.definition: A passport number is a unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to an individual's passport by the issuing government. This number is used for verification and identification purposes during international travel, border crossings, and various official procedures. It is an essential component of the passport and is often required for legal and administrative purposes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6a.label: Visa for Heads of State, Country Leaders, Ambassadors, and Consuls
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6a.definition: A visa for heads of state, country leaders, ambassadors, and consuls is a specific category of diplomatic visa granted to high-ranking officials for the purpose of conducting official state business in a foreign country. These visas usually afford the holder special privileges and immunities under international law, such as exemption from certain immigration controls and sometimes even legal jurisdiction, to facilitate their diplomatic activities.
english_labels: Visa for Heads of State, Country Leaders, Ambassadors, and Consuls

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6b.label: Educational Rights
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6b.definition: Educational rights refer to the legal entitlements that guarantee individuals access to education, often focusing on equality of opportunity, non-discrimination, and the right to a basic education. These rights are commonly upheld by national laws and international treaties, such as the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, which emphasizes the importance of education for full human development.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6d.label: Asbestos Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6d.definition: Asbestos Court refers to a specific court forum that has jurisdiction over cases related to asbestos-related legal disputes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6i.label: Minnesota District Court - Chisago County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6i.definition: Minnesota District Court - Chisago County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Chisago County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6v.label: Retirement Account
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6v.definition: A Retirement Account is a financial account designed to help individuals save for their retirement, often offering tax advantages. Types of retirement accounts include 401(k)s, Individual Retirement Accounts (IRAs), and pension plans, among others, and they typically come with restrictions on withdrawals to incentivize long-term saving. Relevant to several areas of law (e.g., Bankruptcy Law).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6x.label: Intermittent Explosive Disorder
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC6x.definition: Intermittent Explosive Disorder is characterized by recurrent, impulsive outbursts of aggression or violent behavior that are out of proportion to any external provocation or psychosocial stressors. These outbursts can result in significant damage to property, injury to others, or legal problems and are not attributable to another mental disorder or substance abuse.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC71.label: Zlinsky kraj
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC71.definition: Zlinsky kraj is a region in Czechia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC72.label: Weddings Market Segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC72.definition: The weddings market refers to a division of the market that is specifically targeted towards individuals and couples who are planning their wedding. This segment encompasses products and services that facilitate the planning and execution of weddings, from bridal wear and catering to venue selection and photography.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC75.label: Thimphu
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC75.definition: Thimphu is a city in Bhutan.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC76.label: Federal Labor Relations Authority
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC76.definition: The Federal Labor Relations Authority (FLRA) is an independent agency of the United States government that governs labor relations between the federal government and its employees.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC77.label: Legal Platform Solutions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC77.definition: Legal Platform Solutions: A category of legal technology solutions that provide a platform for various legal use cases, including but not limited to legal marketplace solutions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC79.label: Unlawful Interruption of Utility Service
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC79.definition: The Unlawful Interruption of Utility Service refers to the illegal act of a landlord intentionally cutting off or disrupting essential utility services, such as electricity or water, to a tenant's rental property.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7A.label: Defective Trade Practices Act Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7A.definition: A Defective Trade Practices Act Claim is a legal claim that arises from a product liability issue and is based on a violation of statutory and regulatory laws related to trade practices.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7C.label: Denguele
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7C.definition: Denguele is a region located in Côte d'Ivoire.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7D.label: Bam
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7D.definition: A city located in Burkina Faso.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7D.label: Mayo-Kebbi-Est
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7D.definition: Mayo-Kebbi-Est is a region in Chad.

english_labels: U.S. Bankruptcy Court - N.D. West Virginia
United States Bankruptcy Court, N.D. West Virginia

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7E.label: Georgia District Court - Hall County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7E.definition: Georgia District Court - Hall County: A specific court within the Georgia District Court system located in Hall County, responsible for hearing and deciding legal cases within its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7E.label: Veracruz de Ignacio de la Llave
english_labels: Veracruz de Ignacio de la Llave

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7G.label: Invoice Date
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7G.definition: Invoice Date refers to the specific date on which a fee invoice is issued for legal services rendered, and may include the dates on which the invoice was sent and received.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7G.label: Cost Rate
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7G.definition: Cost rate refers to the monetary expenditure per unit of service or per unit of time spent on a task, offering insights into how costs align with revenue streams. It can be expressed as the rate at which expenses are incurred over a specific period (e.g., hourly, daily, monthly). Cost rate metrics are often used to (1) analyze or project the financial performance of a business or project and to (2) make comparisons, make budgeting decisions, and optimize operations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7J.label: Interference with a Dead Body
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7J.definition: The concept of "Interference with a Dead Body" refers to the intentional or negligent disturbance, removal, or destruction of a deceased person's remains, which can result in civil liability for the responsible party.
english_labels: Tortious Interference with a Dead Body

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7J.label: LINE_ITEM_UNIT_COST
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7J.definition: The concept of LINE_ITEM_UNIT_COST refers to the cost of a single unit of a particular item or service, as defined within the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard for legal electronic data exchange.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7M.label: Florida Circuit Court - Santa Rosa County - 1st Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7M.definition: Florida Circuit Court - Santa Rosa County (1st Circuit Court) is a specific court within the Florida Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Santa Rosa County.
english_labels: Florida Circuit Court - Santa Rosa County - 1st Circuit Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7P.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Pike County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7P.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Pike County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases within Pike County, Pennsylvania.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Pike County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7X.label: California Superior Court - San Bernardino Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7X.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in San Bernardino County, California, with the power to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.
english_labels: California Superior Court - San Bernardino Cty.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7Y.label: Tendering Party Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7Y.definition: A Tendering Party Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the party responsible for submitting a bid or proposal for a project or service.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7b.label: Creditor Meeting and Communication Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7b.definition: A Creditor Meeting and Communication Practice is a specialized area of law within Bankruptcy and Financial Restructuring Practice that deals with the legal procedures and requirements for communication and meetings between creditors and debtors during bankruptcy proceedings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7i.label: Border Control Objective
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7i.definition: Border Control refers to the measures and regulations implemented by a country to monitor and regulate the movement of people, goods, and animals across its borders. It involves immigration enforcement, customs checks, and security protocols to prevent illegal entry, smuggling, and other border-related offenses.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7l.label: Party-List Proportional Representation System - Closed List
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7l.definition: A Closed List Party-List Proportional Representation System is an electoral method where voters cast their ballots for a party, and the party determines the order of candidates on its list. Seats are allocated to each party based on the proportion of votes received, and candidates are selected in the predetermined order.
english_labels: Party-List Proportional Representation System - Closed List

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7p.label: Data Centers and Towers - Real Estate Asset
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7p.definition: Real estate data centers and towers.
english_labels: Data Centers and Towers - Real Estate Asset
Data Centres and Towers - Real Estate Asset

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7q.label: Zenaga
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7q.definition: Zenaga is a structured system of communication that belongs to the language family, and is spoken by the Zenaga people in Mauritania and Western Sahara.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7r.label: Written Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7r.definition: A Written Agreement is a formal contract or agreement that is documented in writing, detailing the terms and conditions agreed upon by the parties involved. This form of agreement provides a tangible record, which can be referred to for enforcement and clarity of the agreed terms.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7r.label: Medical Consent Form
english_labels: A Medical Consent Form is a legal document signed by a patient or their legal guardian granting permission for medical treatment or procedures. The form usually outlines the specifics of the treatment and the associated risks.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7s.label: Zero Rate Interest Payment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC7s.definition: A Zero Rate Interest Payment, also known as a Discounted Payment, is a financial arrangement where the borrower does not make periodic interest payments, but instead pays a lump sum at maturity that includes both the principal and the interest. The interest, in this case, is represented by the difference between the amount received at issuance and the higher amount paid at maturity, effectively being "discounted" from the face value.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC83.label: Wadi Fira
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC83.definition: Wadi Fira is a region in Chad.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC84.label: National Nuclear Security Administration
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC84.definition: The National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA) is a United States federal government agency responsible for enhancing national security through the military application of nuclear science.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC87.label: Chernihivska oblast
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC87.definition: The Peace Corps is a volunteer program run by the United States government. The stated mission of the Peace Corps includes providing technical assistance, helping people outside the United States to understand American culture, and helping Americans to understand the cultures of other countries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC88.label: Narok
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC88.definition: Narok is a location in Kenya.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC88.label: Ilirska Bistrica
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC88.definition: Ilirska Bistrica is a town located in Slovenia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8A.label: Motion to Reject
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8A.definition: A Motion to Reject is a formal request made in a bankruptcy case by a creditor or trustee to deny approval of a proposed action or plan.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8A.label: New York City Court - Oswego
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8A.definition: A court located in Oswego, New York that operates under the jurisdiction of the New York City Court.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8D.label: Failure to Engage in Interactive Process Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8D.definition: A failure to engage in the interactive process claim is a legal action brought by an employee against their employer, alleging that the employer failed to participate in a collaborative, good-faith effort to determine reasonable accommodations for the employee's disability, religious beliefs, or other protected characteristics. Under anti-discrimination laws like the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, employers are required to engage in an interactive process with employees seeking accommodations to identify and implement appropriate adjustments that allow the employee to perform their job effectively.
english_labels: Failure to Engage in Interactive Process Claim

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8D.label: Reputation Evidence Objective
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8D.definition: The reputation evidence objective is the legal principle that allows the use of a person's or entity's reputation as evidence in court to prove character or conduct in specific circumstances. This type of evidence is typically used to establish a pattern of behavior or to refute allegations, and is subject to strict rules to prevent unfair prejudice.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8I.label: TIMEKEEPER_NAME
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8I.definition: A timekeeper name is a component of the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard used for electronic billing in legal matters, which identifies the individual responsible for tracking and recording time spent on a specific task or project.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8J.label: Military Service
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8J.definition: Military Service refers to the act of serving in the armed forces of a country, either voluntarily or through conscription. Military service involves a range of duties, from active combat to support roles, and is governed by a distinct set of laws and regulations separate from civilian law.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8N.label: Motion to Unseal Document
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8N.definition: A Motion to Unseal Document is a formal request made to a court to open or reveal a previously sealed document in a legal proceeding.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8O.label: Proposed Order
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8O.definition: A Proposed Order is a legal document submitted to a court for consideration, outlining the specific relief or action requested by a party in a case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8S.label: Obstetrician Gynecologist Malpractice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8S.definition: Negligent or improper actions or omissions by an obstetrician gynecologist (OB GYN) that result in harm or injury to a patient, leading to a legal claim for damages.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8V.label: Fair Credit Reporting Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8V.definition: A Fair Credit Reporting Claim is a legal action taken by a consumer against a credit reporting agency or creditor for violating the consumer's rights under the Fair Credit Reporting Act.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8Z.label: EMT Negligence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8Z.definition: EMT Negligence refers to the failure of emergency medical technicians to provide the appropriate standard of care, resulting in harm or injury to a patient, and is a specific type of claim under the broader category of Medical Negligence Claims.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8Z.label: Non-Profit and Tax-Exempt Organizations Law

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8b.label: Landlord Negligence

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8c.label: Draft Document Version
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8c.definition: Draft Document Version refers to an initial or intermediate version of a document that is still under review and subject to revisions and edits. This version serves as a preliminary outline or proposal and is not considered final or authoritative.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8m.definition: A Warranty Disclaimer Clause is a statement in a contract that negates or limits the warranty provided by the seller, indicating that the buyer accepts the product or service "as is" and assumes all risks associated with its use.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8q.label: oasis:Figures
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8q.definition: A group of numerical or graphical representations that are part of a larger collection within the OASIS standard.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8u.label: Principal’s/Promoter’s Bad Faith Liability for Real Estate Broker’s Commission
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC8u.definition: The liability of a principal or promoter for a real estate broker's commission due to bad faith, where the principal or promoter acted with dishonesty or deceit in the transaction, resulting in the broker not receiving the commission they were entitled to.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC91.label: Waiting Time Penalty Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC91.definition: A waiting time penalty claim is a legal action initiated by an employee against their employer for not providing timely payment of wages upon termination of employment. The claim typically arises when an employer does not comply with applicable laws, which require employers to pay all wages owed to an employee upon termination, including any accrued vacation pay or other earned compensation. The waiting time penalty is a penalty payment that an employer may be required to pay to the employee for each day that payment is delayed beyond the required timeframe. The penalty amount varies depending on the applicable state law.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC92.label: Kalkara
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC92.definition: Kalkara is a locality in Malta.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC93.label: Waiver of Bond Provision
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC93.definition: A Waiver of Bond Provision is a clause within a Specific Performance agreement that allows the party seeking performance to waive the requirement of posting a bond to secure the performance.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC94.label: Execution in Counterparts Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC94.definition: An Execution in Counterparts Clause is a provision in a contract that allows for the execution of multiple identical copies of the contract, each signed by different parties, as if they were a single document.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC95.label: Indiana Superior Court - Shelby County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC95.definition: Indiana Superior Court - Shelby County is a specific court within the Indiana Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Shelby County, Indiana.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC96.definition: Nakhon Ratchasima is a city in Thailand.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC97.label: Notice of Commencement of Case
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC97.definition: A Notice of Commencement of Case is a written document that officially starts a legal proceeding and notifies interested parties of the initiation of the case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC98.label: Constructive Fraud
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC98.definition: Constructive Fraud is a type of fraud claim that arises when a party's actions or omissions, although not intentionally fraudulent, result in harm or injury to another party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9B.label: Monaghan
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9B.definition: Monaghan is a town in Ireland.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9C.definition: Flacq is a district in Mauritius.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9I.definition: A creole language spoken in the Caribbean islands of Aruba, Bonaire, and Curaçao, characterized by a mixture of Portuguese, Spanish, Dutch, and African languages.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9M.label: Private Placement Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9M.definition: A private placement practice refers to the sale of securities directly to a select group of investors, bypassing the public markets. This method allows companies to raise capital more quickly and with fewer regulatory requirements compared to an initial public offering (IPO).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9O.label: Budget Source
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9O.definition: The entity that is the source of the budget (e.g., from the firm, from the company).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9S.label: Commodity Pool Operator
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9S.definition: A Commodity Pool Operator (CPO) is an individual or firm that manages and operates a commodity pool, a collective investment vehicle that pools together investor funds to trade in commodity futures, options, and other derivatives. CPOs are required to register with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) and comply with specific regulatory requirements to protect investors.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9W.label: 880 Defend Trade Secrets Act of 2016 (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9W.definition: Action filed in support or to dispute a trade secret misappropriation

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9Z.label: Georgia Superior Court - Muscogee County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9Z.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Muscogee County: A specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Muscogee County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9a.label: Immigration Renewal
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9a.definition: "Immigration Renewal" involves applying to extend the validity of an expiring immigration document, such as a visa or permit, allowing an individual to continue their stay or residency in the destination country, subject to submission of required documents and approval from immigration authorities

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9b.label: Interval
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9b.definition: In legal contexts, an Interval refers to a specific duration or period between two points in time, often relevant in determining compliance, applicability, or effects of legal actions or provisions. It plays a critical role in statutes of limitations, compliance deadlines, and contractual obligations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9g.label: Building Material and Garden Equipment and Supplies Dealers Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9g.definition: Industries in the Building Material and Garden Equipment and Supplies Dealers subsector retail new building materials, hardware, paint, and garden and outdoor power equipment and supplies. Establishments in this subsector with fixed point-of-sale locations, including home centers and retail lumber yards, may display merchandise either indoors or outdoors under covered areas. The staff is usually knowledgeable in the use of the specific products being retailed in the construction, repair, and maintenance of the home and associated grounds.
english_labels: Building Material and Garden Equipment Industry
Building Material and Garden Equipment and Supplies Dealers Industry

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9h.label: Skeletal System Cancer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9h.definition: Skeletal system cancer, also known as bone cancer, refers to malignant tumors that originate in the bones, including both primary bone cancers like osteosarcoma and secondary cancers that have metastasized from other body parts. These cancers can cause severe pain, fractures, and impaired mobility, necessitating comprehensive treatment and management.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9h.label: By Goal
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9h.definition: Engagement fee model where a client pays a predetermined fee by a specific goal (e.g., closing, dismissal).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9j.label: Confederated Tribes of the Chehalis Reservation
english_labels: Confederated Tribes of the Chehalis Reservation

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9r.label: Sensory Disability
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9r.definition: Sensory Disability refers to impairments that affect one or more of the senses, such as sight, hearing, touch, taste, or smell. These disabilities can range from mild to severe and can significantly impact an individual's ability to interact with their environment and perform daily activities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9s.label: Georgia Superior Court - Forsyth County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9s.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia, located in Forsyth County and responsible for hearing civil and criminal cases within its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9t.label: Writ of Habeas Corpus
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9t.definition: A Writ of Habeas Corpus is a judicial mandate to a prison official ordering that an inmate be brought to the court so it can be determined whether or not that prisoner has been lawfully imprisoned and whether or not they should be released from custody. It serves as a protection against illegal detention and ensures the right of the accused to appear in court.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9v.label: Wrongful Arrest
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RC9v.definition: The concept of Wrongful Arrest refers to the act of detaining an individual without legal justification or probable cause, resulting in a violation of their civil rights and potential liability for the government entity responsible.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCA0.label: Rabat Malta
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCA0.definition: Rabat Malta refers to a town located in the country of Malta.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCA3.definition: The United States Sentencing Commission is an independent agency of the judicial branch of the federal government of the United States. It is responsible for articulating the sentencing guidelines for the United States federal courts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCA4.label: Kranjska Gora
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCA4.definition: Kranjska Gora is a town located in Slovenia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCA5.label: Connecticut State Courts
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCA5.definition: Connecticut State Courts are the judicial venues in the state of Connecticut responsible for administering justice and resolving legal disputes within their jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCA6.label: Transition Payment Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCA6.definition: A Transition Payment Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the terms and conditions for payment during a transitional period, typically when one party is taking over the responsibilities of another.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCA6.label: Inhambane
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCA6.definition: Inhambane is a city in Mozambique.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCA6.definition: The intentional and illegal act of not paying taxes owed to the government, which is considered a form of criminal fraud and a crime against the government.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCA7.label: Karachayevo-Cherkesskaya Respublika
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCA7.definition: Karachayevo-Cherkesskaya Respublika refers to a political subdivision in the Russian Federation, located in the southern part of the country.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCA7.definition: Leitrim is a county in Ireland.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCA7.definition: Vermont State Courts are the judicial system of the state of Vermont, consisting of the Vermont Supreme Court and Vermont Superior Court, and are a subset of the broader category of U.S. State Courts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCA8.label: Al Bahah
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCA8.definition: A city located in the southwestern region of Saudi Arabia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAC.definition: Belait is a district in Brunei Darussalam.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAC.definition: The Matter Total Due is a specific detail within the broader category of Engagement Fee Details, referring to the total amount owed for legal services provided in a particular matter.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAE.definition: Menges is a location in Slovenia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAI.label: Venture Capital Financing Documents
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAI.definition: Venture Capital Financing Documents are a set of legal documents executed between venture capital firms and the businesses they are investing in. They detail the terms of the investment, the rights and obligations of each party, and often include provisions regarding the governance of the business, amongst other matters. These documents are related to the infusion of capital into a startup or growth-stage company in exchange for equity and other investment instruments, often as part of a series of such transactions, with the aim of accelerating business development and scaling operations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAL.label: Firm Data Science Personnel
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAL.definition: Firm data science personnel are professionals within a law firm or legal organization who specialize in analyzing and interpreting complex data to support decision-making, identify trends, and enhance legal services. They apply statistical methods, machine learning algorithms, and data visualization techniques to derive insights from various legal data sources, such as case law, contracts, and client information.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAM.label: 150 Recovery of Overpayment & Enforcement Judgment (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAM.definition: Action to recover debt owed to the United States, including enforcement of judgments, based on overpayments and restitution agreements involving matters other than Medicare benefits, student loans and veterans’ benefits.
english_labels: 150 Recovery of Overpayment & Enforcement Judgment (PACER NoS)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAO.label: Deceptive Trade Practices
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAO.definition: Deceptive Trade Practices refer to actions taken by a business or individual that misleads consumers or other businesses in order to gain an unfair advantage in the marketplace, and can be a basis for legal claims related to product liability or unfair competition.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAT.label: Creditor Among 20 Largest Unsecured Creditors
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAT.definition: A creditor among the 20 largest unsecured creditors is a person or entity who is owed a debt by a debtor and is one of the top 20 creditors who do not have a security interest in the debtor's property.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAX.label: Usury
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAX.definition: The concept of Usury refers to the illegal act of charging excessive interest rates on loans, which is prohibited by law.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAZ.label: UTBMS J-Codes
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAZ.definition: UTBMS J-Codes (UK) are a set of codes used to classify legal services provided in the United Kingdom, including trial preparation, funding, expert reports, and costs assessment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAd.label: Pre-Flight Inspection
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAd.definition: "Pre-Flight Inspection (PFI)" is a security and immigration procedure that occurs before an individual boards an aircraft destined for a specific country, ensuring compliance with entry requirements and verifying eligibility to travel to the destination

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAk.label: New York Supreme Court - Monroe County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAk.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Monroe County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Monroe County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of civil and criminal cases.
english_labels: New York Supreme Court - Monroe County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAo.label: Investment Advisers Act Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAo.definition: An Investment Advisers Act Claim is a legal action brought under the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, alleging violations of the federal law that regulates investment advisers in the United States. This type of claim typically involves allegations of fraud, misrepresentation, or breach of fiduciary duty by investment advisers in their dealings with clients.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAo.label: Completion Accounts
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAo.definition: Completion Accounts are financial statements prepared as of the closing date of an M&A transaction to determine the final purchase price. They include adjustments for working capital, cash, debt, and other relevant items, ensuring the buyer pays a price reflecting the target's actual financial position at closing.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAo.label: Document Location
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAo.definition: Location of a document (e.g., physical location, virtual location within a system).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAp.label: Tagalog
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAp.definition: Tagalog is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary, and is a member of the language family spoken in the Philippines.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAq.label: Self-Incrimination Privilege
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAq.definition: The Self-Incrimination Privilege is a legal right that allows an individual to refuse to answer questions or provide evidence that may incriminate themselves in a criminal case, as protected by the Fifth Amendment of the United States Constitution.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAr.label: Counterclaim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCAr.definition: A counterclaim is a legal action brought by a defendant against a plaintiff, in response to the plaintiff's claim, seeking relief or damages.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCB0.label: Individual Responsibility Plan
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCB0.definition: An Individual Responsibility Plan (IRP) is a formal agreement between a public benefit recipient and a government agency, outlining specific actions, activities, or conditions the recipient must fulfill to either become eligible for or continue receiving benefits. Commonly used in welfare and workforce development programs, the IRP may include requirements like job searches, vocational training, or educational commitments, with the aim of promoting self-sufficiency.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCB3.label: L260 Class Action Certification and Notice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCB3.definition: The concept of L260 Class Action Certification and Notice refers to the legal process of certifying a class action lawsuit and providing notice to potential class members, which falls under the broader category of L200 Pre-Trial Pleadings and Motions.
english_labels: L260 Class Action Certification and Notice

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCB5.label: Vestfirdir
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCB5.definition: Vestfirdir refers to a region in Iceland.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCB6.label: Piran
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCB6.definition: A coastal town in Slovenia located on the Adriatic Sea.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCB7.label: Single Non-Transferable Vote System
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCB7.definition: The Single Non-Transferable Vote (SNTV) system is an electoral method where each voter casts one vote for one candidate in a multi-member district, and the candidates with the highest number of votes win the seats. This system allows for minority representation by enabling voters to focus their support on a single candidate without the need for vote transfers.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCB7.label: Beyond Scope of Permissive Use
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCB7.definition: Defendant is not liable if defendant proves the permission given was for a limited time, place, or purpose which scope was exceeded.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCB7.definition: Sheema is a district in Uganda.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCB7.definition: Tverskaya oblast' is a region in the Russian Federation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCB8.definition: Karlovacka zupanija is a region in Croatia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCB9.definition: Zilinsky kraj is a region in Slovakia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCB9.definition: Action for rental or lease payments owed on real property and/or to eject a party occupying real property illegally.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBB.label: Tipperary
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBB.definition: Tipperary is a county in Ireland.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBC.label: Halab
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBC.definition: Halab is a city in the Syrian Arab Republic.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBE.label: Georgia Superior Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBE.definition: The Georgia Superior Court is a court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has the power to hear and decide a wide range of civil and criminal cases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBF.label: Grosuplje
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBF.definition: Grosuplje is a town located in Slovenia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBK.label: Obligor Aiding Agent Disloyalty to Principal
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBK.definition: The concept of "Obligor Aiding Agent Disloyalty to Principal" refers to the legal liability of an agent who breaches their duty of loyalty to their principal by assisting an obligor in their efforts to harm the principal's interests.
english_labels: Obligor Aiding Agent Disloyalty to Principal

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBM.label: Motion to Remove
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBM.definition: A Motion to Remove is a legal request made by a defendant in a civil case to transfer the case from state court to federal court.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBO.label: Musical Recording
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBO.definition: A Musical Recording is a captured performance of a musical work, stored in a format that can be played back, such as on a CD, vinyl, or digital file.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBO.label: Sculpture
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBO.definition: A Sculpture is a three-dimensional artistic work created by shaping or combining materials such as stone, metal, wood, or clay, often intended to represent figures, abstract forms, or conceptual ideas. Sculptures are protected under copyright law, granting the artist exclusive rights to reproduce, display, and distribute their work.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBP.label: Estate
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBP.definition: An Estate refers to all the possessions, property, and legal rights owned by an individual, including land, tenements, and personal assets. It also encompasses the total assets and liabilities left by a person at death, which are subject to distribution according to the terms of a will or the laws of intestacy.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBP.label: Errors and Omissions Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBP.definition: A provision in a contract that limits liability for mistakes or omissions made by one or both parties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBP.label: Settlement Authority
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBP.definition: Settlement Authority refers to the legal power or right granted to a person or entity to make decisions and reach agreements in a settlement, which is a legal document outlining the terms of a resolution between parties in a dispute.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBP.label: Legal Process Improvement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBP.definition: Legal Process Improvement: The systematic approach of identifying, analyzing, and improving legal processes to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and increase quality of legal services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBS.label: Baluchi
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBS.definition: Baluchi is a structured system of communication, both written and spoken, that belongs to the Language top-level class and is used in legal matters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBW.label: Sentencing Proceeding
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBW.definition: A Sentencing Proceeding is a legal process within Criminal Proceedings where a judge determines the appropriate punishment for a convicted defendant based on the severity of the crime and other relevant factors.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBW.label: Document's Intended Audience
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBW.definition: The audience that the author(s) intend to see the document, including potential items as Actors (e.g., Client Name, Provider Organization Name), Forums (e.g., Court), Governmental Body (e.g., Food and Drug Administration, Federal Trade Commission), or Public.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBY.label: Invertebrate Animal
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBY.definition: An Invertebrate Animal is a member of the animal kingdom that lacks a backbone or spinal column. Invertebrates encompass a vast array of species including insects, mollusks, crustaceans, arachnids, and echinoderms, and they constitute the majority of animal diversity on Earth.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBe.label: DUPE Motion to Consolidate Case
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBe.definition: A "DUPE Motion to Consolidate Case" is a deprecated concept in legal knowledge management that refers to a motion filed by a party in a lawsuit to consolidate their case with another case that involves similar issues and parties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBf.label: Fee Credit Category
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBf.definition: A Fee Credit Category is a type of discount or credit that can be applied to legal services fees.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBk.label: Minority Shareholder Freeze-Out
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBk.definition: The Minority Shareholder Freeze-Out is a legal claim related to corporate and partnership liability, where majority shareholders use their power to force out minority shareholders from the company against their will.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBm.label: Failure to Disclose Evidence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBm.definition: Failure to disclose evidence, also known as Brady violation, occurs when prosecutors do not provide exculpatory evidence to the defense in a criminal case. This is a serious ethical and legal breach that can result in convictions being overturned or sanctions against the prosecution.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBt.label: Entity Formation and Governance Document
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBt.definition: A Corporate Governance Document is a formal text that outlines the framework for how a legal entity is organized and operated, focusing on the relationships among various stakeholders including the board of directors, management, and shareholders. These documents serve as the foundation for corporate policy, structure, and decision-making, often encompassing bylaws, articles of incorporation, and codes of conduct.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBv.label: Motion to Exclude Report
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCBv.definition: A Motion to Exclude Report is a legal request to prevent a specific report or evidence from being presented in court proceedings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC0.label: Registration for Skilled Workers and Specialty Occupations
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC0.definition: In the United States, the H-1B registration refers to the online registration process implemented by U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) for the H-1B visa lottery. Prior to submitting a complete H-1B petition, employers seeking to hire foreign workers in specialty occupations must first register electronically during the designated registration period. The registration process involves providing basic information about the employer and the intended H-1B beneficiary (employee). If selected in the lottery, the employer can then proceed to file the full H-1B petition. The registration system aims to streamline the H-1B application process and make it more efficient for both employers and USCIS
english_labels: Registration for Skilled Workers and Specialty Occupations

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC0.label: Kapisa

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC1.label: Environmental, Social, and Governance Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC1.definition: Environmental, Social, and Governance Law (ESG Law) encompasses a set of legal standards and regulations that guide organizations in integrating environmental, social, and governance considerations into their operations and decision-making processes. ESG laws aim to promote sustainable practices, ethical governance, and social responsibility to achieve long-term positive impacts on society and the environment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC1.label: Clerk of Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC1.definition: A court administrator or nonjudicial officer who is the official custodian of records for a court (e.g., clerk of the Supreme Court).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC2.label: Gaming Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC2.definition: Law, rules, and regulations that apply to the gaming or gambling industry.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC2.label: Regulatory Processing Service
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC2.definition: Regulatory processing service refers to legal services relating to administrative actions by governmental or regulatory bodies to review, assess, and process applications for various services or benefits (e.g., public benefits, intellectual property registration). This service involves steps like form submission, documentation verification, and legal review to determine an applicant's eligibility or the validity of a request, culminating in either approval, denial, or request for additional information

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC2.label: Plateau
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC2.definition: A plateau is a flat-topped area of land elevated above the surrounding terrain, typically with one or more steep sides.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC4.label: Bizerte
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC4.definition: A city located in the northern region of Tunisia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC4.label: Ulaanbaatar
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC4.definition: Ulaanbaatar is the capital city of Mongolia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC5.label: Alifu Alifu
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC5.definition: Alifu Alifu is a subdivision of the Maldives, typically referring to a group of islands or atolls within the country.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC5.label: Rumphi
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC5.definition: Rumphi is a district located in Malawi.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC5.label: Pain and Suffering
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC5.definition: Pain and Suffering refers to the physical and emotional distress experienced by a person as a result of an injury or harm caused by another party, for which compensation may be sought in a legal proceeding.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC6.label: Marriage Market Segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC6.definition: The marriage market refers to a division of the market that is specifically targeted towards individuals and couples who are married or planning to get married. This segment encompasses products and services that support the various aspects of married life, from wedding planning to financial and relationship counseling.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC6.label: Bus Lane Violation Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC6.definition: A Bus Lane Violation Claim involves allegations that a driver has unlawfully used a bus lane designated solely for buses, potentially impeding public transport efficiency and violating traffic regulations. These claims aim to uphold the integrity of public transit lanes and typically result in fines or other penalties to enforce compliance.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC7.label: Government Contract Labor Standards Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC7.definition: A Government Contract Labor Standards Claim (in the U.S., a Service Contract Act claim) is a legal assertion that an employer has failed to pay prevailing wages and benefits to employees working on federal service contracts. In the U.S., those are required by the McNamara-O'Hara Service Contract Act. Such claims typically seek compensation for underpaid wages and benefits, as well as enforcement of labor standards.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC9.label: Office of the United States Trade Representative
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCC9.definition: The Office of the United States Trade Representative (USTR) is the United States government agency responsible for developing and recommending United States trade policy to the President of the United States, conducting trade negotiations at bilateral and multilateral levels, and coordinating trade policy within the government through the interagency Trade Policy Staff Committee (TPSC) and Trade Policy Review Group (TPRG).
english_labels: Office of the United States Trade Representative

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RCCA.label: Kumi
