https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMDF.definition: A legal presumption that a person is deceased when they have been absent for a certain period of time without any evidence of being alive, often used in trust and estate claims.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMDZ.label: Engagement Fee Detail
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMDZ.definition: Details the fees and expenses for providing legal services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMDp.label: Negligent Interference with Prospective Economic Advantage
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMDp.definition: The concept of Negligent Interference with Prospective Economic Advantage refers to a situation where a party's careless actions cause harm to another party's potential economic opportunities.
english_labels: Negligent Interference with Prospective Economic Advantage

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMFG.label: "'Inconsistent' with fiduciary duties" Language
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMFG.definition: Language used in a legal document that describes actions or events that would violate a party's fiduciary duties, specifically in relation to a no-shop covenant, an intervening event, or a superior offer.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMFT.label: Austronesian languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMFT.definition: Austronesian languages are a group of languages spoken in Southeast Asia and the Pacific Islands, including languages such as Malay, Tagalog, and Hawaiian.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMIO.label: Provençal, Old ;Occitan, Old
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMIO.definition: Old Provençal and Occitan languages, up to the year 1500, used in legal documents, artifacts, evidence, testimony, proceedings, or any other legal aspect.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMIo.label: Legal Services Provider - Organization
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMIo.definition: A Legal Services Provider - Organization is an entity that offers professional legal assistance, advice, or representation to clients. This category encompasses traditional law firms, alternative legal service providers (ALSPs), legal aid, and other organizations or professionals authorized to deliver legal services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMJZ.label: Buginese
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMJZ.definition: Buginese is a structured system of communication, both written and spoken, that belongs to the Language top-level class and is used in legal matters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMJl.label: State-run Pension Account
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMJl.definition: A state-run pension account is a retirement savings program managed by the government, funded through taxation or mandatory contributions. These accounts typically provide defined benefits upon retirement, ensuring a basic income for retirees.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMNE.label: Florida Circuit Court - Escambia County - 1st Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMNE.definition: Florida Circuit Court - Escambia County (1st Circuit Court) is a specific court within the Florida Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Escambia County.
english_labels: Florida Circuit Court - Escambia County - 1st Circuit Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMP8.label: Transferred Matter
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMP8.definition: A transferred matter refers to a legal case or issue that has been moved from one law firm or jurisdiction to another. This transfer may occur due to various reasons, such as a change in legal representation, conflicts of interest, or the need for specialized expertise.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMRP.label: Rental Payment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMRP.definition: Rental Payment, also known as Rental Income, refers to the income received by a property owner from tenants in exchange for the use of the property. This income is typically derived from residential, commercial, or industrial real estate and is received on a regular basis, such as monthly or annually.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMRc.label: Valuation Services Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMRc.definition: A Valuation Services Agreement is a contract between a company or individual and a service provider who will assess the value of assets, businesses, or securities. The agreement details the scope of the valuation, methodologies to be used, and compensation terms.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMSn.label: Right of First Offer Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMSn.definition: A Right of First Offer Clause is a provision in a contract that gives a party the right to be the first to purchase a property or asset before it is offered to others.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMU5.label: Abkhazian
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMU5.definition: Abkhazian (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Abkhazian language, which is used in legal matters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMXK.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Delaware County Circuit 2
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMXK.definition: The Indiana Circuit Court - Delaware County Circuit 2 is a court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that hears civil and criminal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.
english_labels: Indiana Circuit Court - Delaware County Circuit 2

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMYK.label: New Jersey County Court - Probate Division
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMYK.definition: The New Jersey County Court - Probate Division is a specialized court within the New Jersey County Court system that handles matters related to the distribution of a deceased person's assets and property.
english_labels: New Jersey County Court - Probate Division

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMYM.label: Trade Secret Assets
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMYM.definition: Trade Secret Assets are a type of Intellectual Property Asset that refers to confidential information or knowledge that provides a competitive advantage to a person, business, or economic entity and is kept secret from the public.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMYc.label: Cost Center
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMYc.definition: A Cost Center is a department or unit within an organization that incurs expenses but does not directly generate revenue. It is used for budgeting and accounting purposes to track and analyze costs, helping management make informed decisions about resource allocation and operational efficiency

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMYu.label: Motion to Disallow Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMYu.definition: A Motion to Disallow Claims is a legal request made in a bankruptcy case to prevent certain claims from being considered valid or enforceable.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMZ6.label: Criminal Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMZ6.definition: Law concerned with the punishment of individuals who commit crimes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMaQ.label: Deceptive Advertising
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMaQ.definition: Deceptive Advertising refers to the act of promoting a product or service through false or misleading statements or representations, with the intention of deceiving or misleading consumers.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMbl.label: Government Coalition Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMbl.definition: Coalition Management refers to the strategies and processes involved in forming, maintaining, and managing alliances between different political parties or groups within a governmental framework. Effective coalition management is crucial for ensuring stable governance and achieving common policy objectives.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMcq.label: Deal Announcement, Pendency, or Consummation Language
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMcq.definition: Deal Announcement, Pendency, or Consummation Language refers to the specific language used in legal agreements to describe the announcement, pending status, or completion of a business transaction, and any related exceptions or carveouts regarding material adverse effects.
english_labels: Deal Announcement, Pendency, or Consummation Language

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMdf.label: Georgia District Court - Grady County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMdf.definition: A court located in Grady County, Georgia that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMf0.label: Invoice Currency
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMf0.definition: Invoice Currency refers to the specific currency in which a fee invoice is issued for legal services rendered.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMjD.label: Public Domain
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMjD.definition: Public Domain refers to creative works and information that are not protected by intellectual property laws and are therefore freely available for anyone to use, copy, distribute, or modify without permission. This status typically applies to works whose copyrights have expired, works explicitly released into the public domain by their creators, or works that were never eligible for copyright protection.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMjV.label: Laches
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMjV.definition: Laches is a legal defense that argues that a plaintiff has unreasonably delayed in bringing a claim, causing prejudice to the defendant.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMmq.label: Dangerous Domesticated Animals
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMmq.definition: Dangerous Domesticated Animals: Domesticated animals that have a propensity to cause harm or injury to humans or other animals, and are subject to specific legal regulations and liabilities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMo0.label: Concurrent Interest
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMo0.definition: Concurrent Interest refers to the situation where two or more parties simultaneously hold ownership interests in the same piece of property. This type of ownership includes various forms such as joint tenancy, tenancy in common, and tenancy by the entirety, each with distinct legal implications regarding the rights of the owners.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMp1.label: Liable
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMp1.definition: In a civil legal context, "liable" is a determination made by a court that a party is legally responsible or accountable for a particular harm, injury, or legal obligation. It often leads to the imposition of remedies or damages to compensate the injured party in a civil lawsuit.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMsj.label: Liability to Property Trespassers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMsj.definition: Liability to Property Trespassers refers to the legal responsibility of a property owner for any harm caused to individuals who enter their property without permission, and the resulting legal claims that may arise in relation to such harm.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMub.label: Amortization Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMub.definition: An amortization clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the schedule and method for paying off a debt over time.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMui.label: Federal Rules of Bankruptcy Procedure
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMui.definition: Procedural rules governing U.S. Bankruptcy cases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMvm.label: Hawaiian
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMvm.definition: Hawaiian (Language) is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Hawaiian Islands.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMwH.label: Illinois Circuit Court - White County (2nd Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - White County (2nd Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMxv.label: Checklist
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RMxv.definition: A checklist is a structured document containing a list of tasks, criteria, or steps that need to be completed, verified, or achieved. In the legal context, it's often used as an organizational tool to ensure compliance with laws, regulations, or protocols.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RN2D.label: Business and Administrative Services Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RN2D.definition: The Business and Administrative Services group comprises establishments performing routine support activities for the day-to-day operations of other organizations. These essential activities are often undertaken in-house by establishments in many sectors of the economy. Activities performed include office administration, hiring and placing of personnel, document preparation and similar clerical services, solicitation, collection, security and surveillance services, cleaning, and waste disposal services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RN3T.label: Mental Disorders
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RN3T.definition: Mental Disability, often referred to as a mental disorder or psychiatric disability, encompasses a wide range of conditions that affect an individual's thinking, feeling, behavior, or mood. These conditions can hinder daily functioning and interpersonal relations, with causes, symptoms, and treatments varying widely.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RN4G.label: Administration of Human Resource Programs Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RN4G.definition: The Administration of Human Resource Programs subsector groups government establishments primarily engaged in the administration of human resource programs.
english_labels: Administration of Human Resource Programs Industry

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RN5x.label: Privacy Policy - Internally Facing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RN5x.definition: An internally facing privacy policy is a document intended for an organization's employees, contractors, and other stakeholders, outlining the company's practices and procedures related to the collection, use, storage, and protection of personal information within the organization. This policy guides employees in maintaining compliance with applicable data protection laws and regulations, and helps to ensure that internal handling of personal data respects individuals' privacy rights and the organization's data security obligations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RN9Z.label: matter_disc_cred_total
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RN9Z.definition: "matter_disc_credit_total = matter_disc_credit_fees + matter_disc_credit_exp. Represents the total of all discounts or credits applied at the matter/invoice level, exclusive of reductions that are the result of fees shared with another client of the law firm. Excludes discounts or credits applied to fee or expense line items. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNCu.label: matter_name
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNCu.definition: "The descriptive name of the matter, e.g. ""Jones v. Davidson"", ""Jamison Contract Proposal"". "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNDT.label: Florida Circuit Court - St. Johns County - 7th Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNDT.definition: A court located in St. Johns County, Florida that is part of the larger Florida Circuit Court system.
english_labels: Florida Circuit Court - St. Johns County - 7th Circuit Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNFe.label: Contract Management Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNFe.definition: Contract Management Services refers to the provision of legal services related to the management and administration of contracts, including drafting, negotiation, and enforcement, as well as the development and implementation of strategies for effective contract management.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNG9.label: Defamation by Implication
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNG9.definition: The act of making a false statement that implies a negative meaning about someone, which harms their reputation or standing in the community, and is considered a form of defamation under the law.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNGU.label: Minnesota District Court - Lake County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNGU.definition: Minnesota District Court - Lake County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Lake County, Minnesota.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNHq.label: New York Supreme Court - Tompkins County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNHq.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Tompkins County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Tompkins County, New York, with authority to hear and decide legal disputes within its geographical jurisdiction.
english_labels: New York Supreme Court - Tompkins County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNI5.label: In Pari Delicto
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNI5.definition: A defense in civil litigation that asserts that both parties are equally at fault and therefore neither can recover damages from the other.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNIC.label: Legal Proposition
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNIC.definition: A legal proposition is a statement that outlines a principle, rule, or application of law that arguably applies to a particular legal matter, usually in writing. Legal propositions are foundational components of legal arguments, supported by statutes, case law, or other legal authorities to persuade a stakeholder (e.g., decisionmaker, opposing counsel, a counterparty) to reach a particular conclusion.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNIF.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Douglas County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNIF.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Douglas County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Douglas County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNJR.label: Database
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNJR.definition: A Database is a structured collection of data that is stored and organized in a manner that allows for efficient retrieval, modification, and management of information. Databases are commonly used in various applications ranging from simple data logging systems to complex relational databases for large organizations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNKR.label: Kashia Band of Pomo Indians of the Stewarts Point Rancheria
english_labels: Kashia Band of Pomo Indians of the Stewarts Point Rancheria

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNLK.label: Date Filed
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNLK.definition: The "Date Filed" concept refers to the specific date on which a document or artifact was officially submitted or recorded, and is a component of the larger category of "Document Components".

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNLV.label: Florida Circuit Court - Hernando County - 5th Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNLV.definition: A court located in Hernando County, Florida that is part of the larger Florida Circuit Court system, which handles civil and criminal cases within its jurisdiction.
english_labels: Florida Circuit Court - Hernando County - 5th Circuit Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNQ-.label: P800 Maintenance and Renewal
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNQ-.definition: This phase includes all tasks related to subsequent maintenance and renewal requirements under the terms of the transaction or project such as monitoring of lease agreements, routine waivers and coordination of UCC requirements.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNSW.label: Discount Amount - Expense
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNSW.definition: Discount Amount - Expense refers to the reduction in cost incurred by a client for expenses related to legal services provided, as opposed to fees charged for the services themselves.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNSw.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Harding County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNSw.definition: A court located in Harding County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases.
english_labels: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Harding County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNTE.label: Public Benefit Coverage Objective
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNTE.definition: Public Benefit Coverage Objective refers to the goal of a legal service provider in determining client eligibility for public benefits. This can encompass various types of assistance including cash or food benefits, as well as specific healthcare services (e.g., birth control, dental care, prescriptions, optical services).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNTY.label: Visa for Temporary Agricultural Workers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNTY.definition: A Temporary Agricultural Workers Visa is a type of visa designed to allow foreign nationals to work temporarily in the agricultural sector of a host country. These visas are typically issued to address seasonal labor needs, such as planting, harvesting, or other farm-related activities that require a temporary influx of workers.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNUB.label: Extraordinary Ability Non-Immigrant Visa Types
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNUB.definition: An O visa is issued to foreign nationals with extraordinary ability in the sciences, arts, education, business, or athletics, allowing them to enter the U.S. to continue work in their field. This visa category includes O-1 for individuals with extraordinary ability, O-2 for essential support personnel, and O-3 for their immediate family members.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNUG.label: WC120 Analysis/Strategy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNUG.definition: Thinking, Strategizing, and Planning for a case, including preparing for/attending initial strategy conference with adjuster/employer/ nurse case manager, discussions/writing /meetings on case strategy, preparation of litigation plan & updates, communication on case strategy/trial strategy with adjuster/ employer/nurse case manager

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNUW.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Lycoming County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNUW.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Lycoming County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that handles minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil cases involving amounts up to $12,000.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Lycoming County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNUi.label: Redemption Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNUi.definition: A redemption claim is a legal action in which a party seeks to regain ownership or rights to property that has been foreclosed upon or sold due to nonpayment of a debt or other financial obligations. In some cases, property owners or debtors have the opportunity to "redeem" their property by paying off the outstanding debt, including associated costs and fees, within a specified period defined by law. Redemption claims can be part of the foreclosure process, allowing individuals or entities to reclaim their property under certain conditions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNVl.label: Proposed Findings of Fact
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNVl.definition: Proposed Findings of Fact refer to a written document submitted to the court by a party in a legal case, outlining the facts that they believe have been proven during the trial or hearing.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNVm.label: Subscription Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNVm.definition: Subscription Agreement is a contract between a company and an investor, stipulating the terms under which the investor can purchase shares or other securities from the company. It includes the purchase price, the number of shares, and representations and warranties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNVu.label: Blood Evidence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNVu.definition: Blood evidence includes any traces of blood found at a crime scene, whether in liquid form, stains, or spatter patterns. Forensic experts analyze this evidence for DNA, blood type, and other factors to identify individuals or recreate events related to a crime.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNYD.label: Oral Argument
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNYD.definition: Oral Argument refers to a formal presentation made by attorneys to a judge or appellate court, where they argue the legal issues in a case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNZH.label: Missouri Circuit Court - St. Louis County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNZH.definition: A Missouri Circuit Court - St. Louis County is a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within St. Louis County.
english_labels: Missouri Circuit Court - St. Louis County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNZJ.label: WC110 Fact Investigation/Development
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNZJ.definition: All actions to investigate, understand the facts of matter, including interviewing of client personnel/potential witnesses/Conference with employer, review of file documents, investigation/surveillance/background search and security and claims materials, review of employer/personnel/wage records, legal research for initial case assessment purposes, development of factual and legal issues, identify potential experts, review of medical records regarding work status, treatment plan and maximum medical improvement, obtain and review medical/legal claims records for prior injuries/diseases/disability/W.C. Claims

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNZh.label: Failure to Warn
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNZh.definition: The failure of a manufacturer or seller to provide adequate warning or instruction about the potential dangers of a product, which can result in liability for any resulting harm or injury.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNcZ.label: Florida Circuit Court - Palm Beach County - 15th Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNcZ.definition: The Florida Circuit Court - Palm Beach County (15th Circuit Court) is a specific court within the Florida Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Palm Beach County.
english_labels: Florida Circuit Court - Palm Beach County - 15th Circuit Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNdg.label: Statement of Intent
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNdg.definition: A Statement of Intent is a written document that outlines the intentions of a party involved in a bankruptcy or restructuring process.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNgF.label: TR599 Other International Trademark Application Preparation and Filing
english_labels: TR599 Other International Trademark Application Preparation and Filing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNi4.label: Right of Reversion Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNi4.definition: A right of reversion clause is a provision in a contract that allows the original owner to regain ownership of the property or asset if certain conditions are met.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNj7.label: Workplace-run Pension Account
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNj7.definition: A workplace-run pension account is a retirement savings plan provided and managed by an employer, often involving contributions from both the employer and the employee. These plans can include defined benefit plans, which promise a specified monthly benefit at retirement, and defined contribution plans, which depend on the amount contributed and the performance of the investments.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNjg.label: Motion to Confirm Arbitration Award
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNjg.definition: A Motion to Confirm Arbitration Award is a formal request made to a trial court to recognize and enforce an arbitration decision that has been made by an arbitrator or arbitration panel.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNkV.label: Sikh Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNkV.definition: Sikh Law pertains to the customs, traditions, and guidelines derived from the teachings of the Guru Granth Sahib and the ten Sikh Gurus, though it is not a formalized legal system like some other religious laws.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNkh.label: L620 Collection (NOS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNkh.definition: "NOS" = Not Otherwise Specified (catch-all, includes the subcategories) Primarily charges on a per custodian or a flat/fixed fee basis.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNla.label: Case Assessment, Development, Administration
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNla.definition: The concept of Case Assessment, Development, Administration refers to the process of evaluating and managing a legal case, including analyzing strategies, investigating and developing facts, coordinating with co-parties, and managing documents and files.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNoW.label: Engagement Fee Model
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNoW.definition: The model (e.g., hourly, fixed fee, contingency fee) by which legal services are obtained.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNok.label: Energy Law Regulatory Objectives
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNok.definition: Energy Law Regulatory Objectives are the legal and policy goals that guide the regulation, management, and development of energy resources and systems. These objectives aim to ensure energy security, sustainability, economic efficiency, and environmental protection.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNrc.label: country
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNrc.definition: "The country of parent. Use ISO 3166 country code set forth by International Standards Organization (www.iso.org.) "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNs1.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Elk County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNs1.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Elk County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that handles minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil cases involving amounts up to $12,000.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Elk County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNt4.label: Hotels and Public Houses
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNt4.definition: Hotels and Public Houses are a type of real estate asset within the hospitality industry, which provide lodging and/or food and beverage services to the public.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNtr.label: Domestic Violence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNtr.definition: Domestic Violence refers to physical, emotional, or sexual abuse that occurs within a domestic relationship, such as between spouses or partners, and is considered a form of criminal assault.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNw3.label: Relationship-Based Market Segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNw3.definition: The relationship-based market segment refers to a division of the market that is specifically targeted towards consumers who are interested in products and services related to romantic relationships, lifestyle choices, and significant life events. This segment encompasses a wide range of offerings, from dating services to wedding planning, all designed to support and enhance various aspects of personal relationships

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNxm.label: Standard Moroccan Tamazight
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNxm.definition: Standard Moroccan Tamazight is a written or spoken structured system of communication that is a member of the Berber language family and is the official language of Morocco alongside Arabic.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNxs.label: Pampanga; Kapampangan
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RNxs.definition: A language spoken in the Philippines, specifically in the province of Pampanga, characterized by its unique grammar and vocabulary.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RO1j.label: U.S. Federal Courts
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RO1j.definition: U.S. Federal Courts are a subset of the U.S. Courts and include the U.S. Courts of Appeal, U.S. Federal Courts - Specialty, U.S. Bankruptcy Courts, U.S. Bankruptcy Appellate Panels, U.S. District Courts, and the U.S. Supreme Court.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RO2r.label: Motion to Dismiss Adversary Proceeding
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RO2r.definition: A Motion to Dismiss Adversary Proceeding is a formal request made by a party in a bankruptcy case to terminate a separate legal action brought against them within the bankruptcy proceedings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RO4t.label: Stomach Cancer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RO4t.definition: Stomach cancer, also known as gastric cancer, is a type of cancer that develops from the lining of the stomach. It can spread to other parts of the body if not treated and typically requires treatments such as surgery, chemotherapy, radiation therapy, and targeted therapy.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RO6K.label: EBITDA Bonus Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RO6K.definition: A provision in a contract that entitles a party to receive a bonus based on the calculation of earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization (EBITDA).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RO73.label: Successor Corporation Liable for Predecessor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RO73.definition: When a new company takes over the assets and liabilities of a previous company, the new company can be held responsible for any legal claims against the previous company.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RO8W.label: Nevada District Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RO8W.definition: The Nevada District Court is a court of general jurisdiction in the state of Nevada, responsible for hearing civil and criminal cases within its jurisdictional boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROCG.label: Oregon Workers' Compensation Division
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROCG.definition: The Oregon Workers' Compensation Division is a state agency responsible for administering the workers' compensation system in Oregon.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROCL.label: X124 Publications/Books/Treatises
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROCL.definition: Costs for any publications, books or treatises Excludes LEXIS, Westlaw or similar online legal research service (X111)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RODI.label: Plant Patent Registration Document
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RODI.definition: A plant patent registration document is a legal certificate issued by a patent office that grants the holder exclusive rights to a new and distinct variety of a plant for a certain period. It includes detailed information about the plant's unique characteristics, such as its appearance, genetic makeup, and cultivation methods.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RODs.label: JJ10 Applications relating to originating process or Statement of Case or for default or summary Judgment (UK J-CODE)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RODs.definition: Includes applications as to service or jurisdiction, to strike out or amend all or part of a claim or Statement of Case, or for the variation of parties.
english_labels: JJ10 Applications relating to originating process or Statement of Case or for default or summary Judgment (UK J-CODE)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROFT.label: TR440 Quasi-Judicial Administrative Proceedings - Domestic
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROFT.definition: All action associated with completing a quasi-judicial proceeding before an administrative tribunal associated with the Trademark Office of the home country of the applicant in connection with an application filed under TR300, including Appeals, Oppositions, and other ex-parte and inter-parties proceedings. Includes collecting evidence, preparing and filing motions, briefs, responses, replies, surreplies, and other documents, attending conferences, depositions, hearings, and other proceedings. Does not include requests for supervisory action ("Petitions" in the U.S.) under TR430. Note that governmental fees and external expenses (or "disbursements" in the U.S.) are included under E100.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROGL.label: Stipulation to Abandon
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROGL.definition: A Stipulation to Abandon is a legal agreement between parties in which they voluntarily give up or relinquish their rights or interests in a property or legal claim.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROKa.label: Event Postponed / Rescheduled
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROKa.definition: Event Postponed / Rescheduled: A change in the scheduled date or time of an event.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RORC.label: Corporate Vice President
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RORC.definition: A Corporate Vice President is an executive officer responsible for leading specific departments or functions within a company and supporting the President or CEO in executing strategic initiatives. The Vice President may oversee operations, sales, finance, or other divisions, often holding a key leadership role within the organization's hierarchy.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROT1.label: Derivatives Investment Assets
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROT1.definition: Derivatives Investment Assets are financial instruments whose value is derived from an underlying asset, index, or security. Examples include options, futures, and swaps, and these derivatives are often used for hedging risk or for speculative purposes, offering the potential for high returns but also carrying high risk.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROT5.label: Firm Innovation Personnel
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROT5.definition: Firm innovation personnel are individuals within a law firm or legal organization who are responsible for driving innovation and implementing new technologies or processes. They focus on improving efficiency, enhancing service delivery, and creating new business models to keep the firm competitive in an evolving legal landscape.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROTd.label: Cloverdale Rancheria of Pomo Indians of California
english_labels: Cloverdale Rancheria of Pomo Indians of California

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROUp.label: Automatic Stay
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROUp.definition: An Automatic Stay is a legal concept that arises in the context of bankruptcy and restructuring events, which prohibits creditors from taking certain actions against the debtor or the debtor's property.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROVo.label: Social Health Insurance (SHI)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROVo.definition: Social Health Insurance is a healthcare system funded by contributions from employers and employees, rather than general taxation. This model is commonly found in European countries like Germany, and it generally offers a wide range of healthcare services to contributors.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROW7.label: Cross-Defendant
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROW7.definition: A person against who a cross-claim is brought.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROWi.label: Civil Assault
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROWi.definition: Civil Assault: A legal claim for damages resulting from intentional conduct that causes a person to fear an imminent harmful or offensive contact.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROWs.label: Mining and Natural Resources Extraction Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROWs.definition: The Mining and Natural Resources Extraction industry group comprises establishments that extract naturally occurring mineral solids, such as coal and ores; liquid minerals, such as crude petroleum; and gases, such as natural gas. The term mining is used in the broad sense to include quarrying, well operations, beneficiating (e.g., crushing, screening, washing, and flotation), and other preparation customarily performed at the mine site, or as a part of mining activity.
english_labels: Mining and Natural Resources Extraction Industry

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROXo.label: New York Supreme Court - Rensselaer County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROXo.definition: New York Supreme Court - Rensselaer County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of New York that hears civil and criminal cases within Rensselaer County.
english_labels: New York Supreme Court - Rensselaer County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROYG.label: 462 Naturalization Application (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROYG.definition: Action seeking review of denial of an application for naturalization [8 U.S.C. § 1447(b)] or alleging failure to make a determination regarding an application for naturalization [8 U.S.C. § 1421(c)].

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROYa.label: Financial Indicators
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROYa.definition: Financial Indicators are quantitative measures that provide insights into the financial performance of a business or investment. Examples include balance, which can help in evaluating an entity's financial health and growth potential.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROZm.label: Reasonableness
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROZm.definition: The concept of Reasonableness refers to the standard of review used by appellate courts to determine whether a lower court's decision was based on a rational and justifiable interpretation of the law and the facts presented in the case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROaM.label: B130 Asset Disposition
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROaM.definition: Sales, abandonment and transaction work related to asset disposition

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROak.label: Florida County Court - Baker County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROak.definition: Florida County Court - Baker County is a specific court within the Florida County Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Baker County, Florida.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROb7.label: Business of Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROb7.definition: Business of Law refers to the management and administration of legal services, including tasks such as client portal management, procurement management, and pricing management, among others.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RObD.label: Pre-Judgment Interest
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RObD.definition: Pre-Judgment Interest refers to the interest that accrues on a monetary award from the time the cause of action arose until the judgment is entered, and is intended to compensate the plaintiff for the loss of use of the money during that period.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RObT.label: Use and Permission Tax Payment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RObT.definition: Use and Permission Tax Payment includes taxes levied for the use of goods or permission to use goods or perform activities. These taxes are distinct from those assessed on the value of the goods themselves and are usually fixed amounts. This category also covers pollution taxes not based on the value of specific goods. Distinguishing between compulsory user charges and license fees considered as taxes and those regarded as non-tax revenues can be challenging.
english_labels: Taxes on use of goods, or on permission to use goods or perform activities

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROdG.label: Stipulated Voluntary Dismissal with Prejudice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROdG.definition: A Stipulated Voluntary Dismissal with Prejudice is a legal agreement between parties in a lawsuit where the plaintiff agrees to dismiss the case permanently and cannot bring the same claim again in the future.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROdg.label: Document Production Event
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROdg.definition: A Document Production Event is a specific type of event within the legal field that involves the creation and collection of documents for a case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROgO.label: L634 Exception handling
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROgO.definition: Activities and actions related to exception of both electronic and paper documents requiring special handling. Includes decryption.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROgu.label: Written Consent in Lieu of Meeting Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROgu.definition: A Written Consent in Lieu of Meeting Clause is a provision in a contract that allows the parties to give their consent to a decision without holding a formal meeting, as long as the consent is given in writing.
english_labels: Written Consent in Lieu of Meeting Clause

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROhQ.label: oasis:role
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROhQ.definition: A role within the OASIS organization, with subtypes of Editor and Author.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROjP.label: Missouri Supreme Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROjP.definition: The Missouri Supreme Court is the highest court in the state of Missouri and serves as the final court of appeals for cases within the state court system.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROjl.label: Garnishee
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROjl.definition: A person who owes a debt to a judgment debtor, or a person other than the judgment debtor who has property in his possession or custody in which a judgment debtor has an interest. NY CPLR § 105.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROkZ.label: Motions Regarding Litigation Scope
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROkZ.definition: A Motion Regarding Litigation Scope is a formal request made to a trial court to determine the boundaries and extent of a legal case, including which issues will be addressed and which parties will be involved.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROn8.label: E100 Expenses
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROn8.definition: E100 Expenses refer to the costs incurred during litigation that are categorized under the UTBMS Litigation code set, including but not limited to copying, postage, delivery services, expert fees, and travel expenses.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROns.label: Petition for Rehearing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROns.definition: A Petition for Rehearing is a formal request made to an appellate court to reconsider its decision in a case, typically filed after an unfavorable ruling, and is a type of Appellate Filing.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROny.label: Deceptive Use of Credit-Bureau Name
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROny.definition: The deceptive use of a credit-bureau name refers to the illegal practice of falsely representing oneself as a credit bureau or using a name similar to a credit bureau in order to deceive consumers, which falls under the broader categories of consumer credit and unfair debt collection claims.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROon.label: Synthetic Data
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROon.definition: Synthetic data is data that is artificially generated by a computational process rather than being collected through sensory means or manually created by humans. It is typically produced by a model trained to replicate the characteristics and structure of its original training data, aiming to maintain a similar distribution.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROpQ.label: Texas Court of Appeals - 9th
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROpQ.definition: The Texas Court of Appeals - 9th is a specific intermediate appellate court in Texas that hears appeals from lower courts within its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROqk.label: Breach of Confidentiality Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROqk.definition: The Breach of Confidentiality Clause is a provision in a contract that prohibits the disclosure of confidential information to third parties without authorization, and establishes remedies for any unauthorized disclosure.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROrs.label: JL30 Judgment and post-trial activity (UK J-CODE)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROrs.definition: Considering draft judgments, preparing and considering any written responses to the court, submissions or skeleton arguments in relation to judgment or consequential orders, preparation for and attendance at hearings when reserved judgments handed down or consequential orders considered, all dealings relating to form of judgment or order. Includes all meetings and communications relating thereto.
english_labels: JL30 Judgment and post-trial activity (UK J-CODE)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROsV.label: Required-Report Privilege
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROsV.definition: A privilege that protects from disclosure any reports that are required by law or regulation to be prepared and submitted to a government agency or other authority.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROtF.label: Attorney-Client Corporate Privilege
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROtF.definition: The Attorney-Client Corporate Privilege is a legal concept that protects confidential communications between a corporation and its attorneys from being disclosed in court proceedings, as long as the communications were made for the purpose of seeking legal advice.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROuL.label: Minnesota District Court - Mower County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROuL.definition: Minnesota District Court - Mower County refers to a specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Mower County, Minnesota.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROyh.label: Indiana Superior Court - Huntington County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROyh.definition: A court located in Huntington County, Indiana that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROzt.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Bucks County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ROzt.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Bucks County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within Bucks County, Pennsylvania.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Bucks County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RP1-.label: X115 Out-of-Town Travel
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RP1-.definition: Any airfare, ground transportation (taxi, subway, train), rental car, mileage, parking, and hotel associated with out-of-town travel. Excludes include billable travel time (A112). If client requires a more granular breakdown, law firm or legal vendor should submit separate itemized expense line items.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RP1h.label: Furniture and Home Furnishings Retailers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RP1h.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing new furniture and home furnishings. Establishments in this industry group with fixed point-of-sale locations may operate from showrooms and have substantial areas for the presentation of their products. Establishments in this industry group may provide incidental services, including interior decorating, product assembly, installation, or repair services.
english_labels: Furniture and Home Furnishings Store Industry

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RP1p.label: Tax on Tax
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RP1p.definition: Tax on Tax refers to a tax levied on another tax, resulting in an increased tax liability for the taxpayer.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPBE.label: Higher Education Degree
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPBE.definition: A Post-secondary Degree Level refers to the education attained after completing high school or its equivalent. This encompasses a range of academic qualifications including associate's degrees, bachelor's degrees, master's degrees, doctoral degrees (e.g., PhD), and professional degrees (e.g., MD, JD), which are awarded by colleges, universities, and professional schools after successful completion of specific courses or programs of study.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPBM.label: Partner Breaching Duty to Co-Partner
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPBM.definition: When a partner fails to fulfill their legal obligation to another partner in a business entity, resulting in harm or damages, it is considered a breach of duty to co-partner.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPCo.label: PA730 Assignments and Security Interests
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPCo.definition: All actions associated with negotiating and preparing assignment (i.e. previously registered or filed application) or security interest, including review of file history, checking status and meeting with client. Work of outside vendors in conducting searches or otherwise assisting investigation should be an expense under E100.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPCs.label: Contempt Appeal
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPCs.definition: An appeal made to challenge a decision of contempt of court, which can only be made by a party who has standing and has followed the proper procedural rules.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPDg.label: Pets Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPDg.definition: A Pets Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the rights and responsibilities of pet ownership within the context of the agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPF6.label: Event Risk
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPF6.definition: The risk that a specific event will impact the market or a particular industry.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPGD.label: Georgia District Court - Emanuel County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPGD.definition: Georgia District Court - Emanuel County refers to a specific court within the Georgia District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Emanuel County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPJj.label: Specialty Court Rules
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPJj.definition: Procedural rules governing specialty courts (e.g., bankruptcy courts, immigration courts)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPMr.label: Motion to Vacate Default Judgment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPMr.definition: A Motion to Vacate Default Judgment is a legal request to set aside a court decision made against a party who failed to appear or respond to a lawsuit, based on the grounds of excusable neglect or mistake.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPO0.label: Regulatory Eligibility Determination Service
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPO0.definition: Regulatory Eligibility Determination Legal Service refers to the specialized legal assistance provided by lawyers or legal experts to assess an individual's or entity's eligibility for a specific regulated activity or benefit before formally filing an application. This pre-assessment typically includes a review of relevant laws and regulations, analysis of documentation, and consultation to ensure that the applicant meets the necessary criteria to maximize the chances of approval.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPOT.label: Consul
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPOT.definition: A consul is a government official who represents their country in a foreign city, often with the aim of assisting and protecting the citizens and interests of their home country. Unlike ambassadors, consuls do not engage in diplomatic negotiations but focus on administrative and practical matters such as issuing visas, aiding in trade relations, and assisting nationals in distress.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPRR.label: Religious Market Segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPRR.definition: The religious market segment refers to a division of the market that is specifically targeted towards consumers based on their religious beliefs and practices. This segment encompasses products, services, and marketing strategies that are designed to cater to the needs, preferences, and interests of individuals who follow specific religious faiths, taking into account factors such as religious observances, dietary restrictions, and spiritual needs.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPRa.label: Limited Partnership Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPRa.definition: A Limited Partnership Agreement is a legal contract that outlines the terms, conditions, and structure of a limited partnership (LP). It specifies the roles, responsibilities, rights, and obligations of the general and limited partners, as well as details regarding profit distribution, capital contributions, and the management of the partnership.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPSB.label: Traffic Accident Indicator
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPSB.definition: Y/N - True if an incident involved a traffic accident; false otherwise.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPSm.label: Discovery Cost-shifting
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPSm.definition: The concept of Discovery Cost-shifting refers to the allocation of expenses related to the process of obtaining evidence in a legal case, where the burden of paying for the discovery is shifted from one party to another.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPT3.label: X127 Deposition Transcripts
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPT3.definition: Any court reporter and transcript fees associated with the taking of a deposition. Excludes videotape deposition costs (X308).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPVH.label: National Government Representative
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPVH.definition: A National Government Representative is an elected or appointed official who serves at the highest level of a country's government, typically in the executive or legislative branch. This individual is responsible for making, debating, or executing national laws and policies, representing constituents or the nation as a whole, and participating in governance at the federal level.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPX8.label: Elem Indian Colony of the Sulphur Bank Rancheria
english_labels: Elem Indian Colony of the Sulphur Bank Rancheria

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPYD.label: Base Amount - Expense
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPYD.definition: Base Amount - Expense refers to the fixed fee charged by a lawyer for expenses incurred during the provision of legal services, such as travel expenses or filing fees.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPZh.label: Peculiar Risk of Harm
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPZh.definition: Peculiar Risk of Harm refers to the legal principle that if a party hires an independent contractor to perform work that is likely to create a special risk of bodily harm to others, and fails to take necessary precautions, they may be held liable for any resulting harm caused to employees of the contractor.
english_labels: Ordinarily, one who hires an independent contractor to do work is not liable for the acts or omissions of the independent contractor or its employees. However, if the hirer should recognize that the work is likely to create, during its progress, a peculiar/special risk of bodily harm to others unless special precautions are taken, then the hirer is liable for bodily harm caused to employees for the failure of the independent contractor to exercise reasonable care to take such precautions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPaO.label: Hiri Motu
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPaO.definition: A language spoken in Papua New Guinea, characterized by a simplified grammar and vocabulary, and used in legal matters within that region.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPb0.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Taos County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPb0.definition: The New Mexico Magistrate Court - Taos County is a specific court within the New Mexico Magistrate Court system that has jurisdiction over certain types of cases in Taos County.
english_labels: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Taos County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPbY.label: Iron Ore Mining
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPbY.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) developing mine sites, mining, and/or beneficiating (i.e., preparing) iron ores and manganiferous ores valued chiefly for their iron content and/or (2) producing sinter iron ore (except iron ore produced in iron and steel mills) and other iron ore agglomerates.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPh8.label: Freedom of Religion
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPh8.definition: A freedom of religion claim is a legal action initiated by an individual or group alleging that their right to freedom of religion has been violated by the government or a government actor. The First Amendment of the U.S. Constitution guarantees that the government shall not establish an official religion (the Establishment Clause) or prohibit the free exercise of religion (the Free Exercise Clause). A freedom of religion claim may arise in various contexts, such as when a government body enacts a law or regulation that unduly restricts religious practices, when a government actor favors one religion over another, or when an individual or group is discriminated against or denied benefits based on their religious beliefs or practices.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPk5.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Beaver County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPk5.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Beaver County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in the state of Pennsylvania.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Beaver County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPki.label: Senior Citizen
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPki.definition: A senior citizen, also referred to as an elderly person, is an individual who has reached an age where they are generally considered to be in the later stage of life, often defined as 65 years old or older in many societies. This age group may be eligible for certain benefits like retirement pensions, healthcare coverage, and various social services designed to support their well-being.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPm8.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Lake County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPm8.definition: Oregon Circuit Court - Lake County: A specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Lake County, Oregon.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPmx.label: Wielding a Weapon
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPmx.definition: Wielding a Weapon refers to the act of carrying, brandishing, or using a weapon in a manner that can cause harm or instill fear in others. This cause of action is typically associated with criminal charges or civil liability resulting from the threat or actual use of a weapon.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPqw.label: Malware Infection
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPqw.definition: Malware infection refers to a computer system being compromised by malicious software designed to damage, disrupt, or gain unauthorized access. This can include viruses, worms, trojans, and spyware.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPs4.label: Jury Selection / Voire Dire
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPs4.definition: The concept of Jury Selection/Voire Dire refers to the process of questioning potential jurors to determine their suitability for serving on a jury.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPs7.label: Motion to Dismiss for Failure to Prosecute
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPs7.definition: A Motion to Dismiss for Failure to Prosecute is a request made to a court to dismiss a case due to the plaintiff's failure to take action or move the case forward.
english_labels: Motion to Dismiss for Failure to Prosecute

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPsT.label: P240 Real and Personal Property
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPsT.definition: This task includes all fact investigation/due diligence from a real and personal property perspective.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPwA.label: Counselor-Pupil Privilege
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPwA.definition: A legal privilege that protects confidential communications between a counselor and their pupil from being disclosed without the consent of the pupil.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPxL.label: Family Law Events
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPxL.definition: Family Law Events are specific types of Transaction Events that pertain to legal actions related to marriage and domestic partnerships, including events such as dissolution and creation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPyF.label: Florida County Court - Orange County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPyF.definition: A court located in Orange County, Florida that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPzu.label: Letter Communication
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RPzu.definition: A communication that occurs via physical letter.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQ0T.label: Redeemable Asset
english_labels: A Redeemable Asset is a financial instrument that can be bought back or redeemed by the issuer or the holder under predefined conditions. This option provides flexibility and liquidity to the asset, allowing for its retirement before the maturity date or upon reaching specific terms.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQ1A.label: Otolaryngology Malpractice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQ1A.definition: Negligent or wrongful conduct by a medical professional in the field of otolaryngology, resulting in harm or injury to a patient.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQ1H.label: PA720 Portfolio Analysis and Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQ1H.definition: All action associated with reviewing, analyzing, documenting, and managing a portfolio of patents. Includes patent "due diligence" during transactional analysis.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQ69.label: By Fixed Fee
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQ69.definition: Engagement model where a client pays a predetermined fee — sometimes by milestone (e.g., by document, by stage) or by a bundle of matters (e.g., by portfolio).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQ6i.label: Indiana Superior Court - Morgan County, Superior Court3
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQ6i.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Morgan County, Indiana, with authority over civil and criminal cases.
english_labels: Indiana Superior Court - Morgan County, Superior Court3

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQAq.label: Mayan languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQAq.definition: Mayan languages are a group of indigenous languages spoken in Central America, characterized by complex grammatical structures and a rich cultural heritage.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQCE.label: Transporting Stolen Property
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQCE.definition: The act of moving or carrying property that has been unlawfully taken from its rightful owner, with the knowledge that it has been stolen.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQCL.label: Motion to Dismiss Single Debtor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQCL.definition: A Motion to Dismiss Single Debtor is a legal request made by a party in a bankruptcy case to dismiss the case for a single debtor.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQCq.label: Child
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQCq.definition: A Child is an individual who is the offspring of one or more parents, either biologically or through legal processes like adoption. In legal contexts, a child is often considered a minor and is under the guardianship of their parent(s) or legal guardian(s) until reaching the age of majority.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQCy.label: Political Vote Privilege
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQCy.definition: The Political Vote Privilege is a legal right or immunity granted to individuals that allows them to cast their vote in political elections without fear of retaliation or discrimination.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQGz.label: Forfeiture Proceeding
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQGz.definition: A forfeiture proceeding is a legal process in which the government seeks to take possession of property that is believed to have been used in or obtained through criminal activity.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQHO.label: Breach of Implied-in-Law Contract
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQHO.definition: The Breach of Implied-in-Law Contract refers to a situation where a party fails to fulfill an obligation that is not explicitly stated in a contract, but is implied by law.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQIm.label: Statements Not Offered for the Truth of the Matter Asserted
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQIm.definition: Statements Not Offered for the Truth of the Matter Asserted are out-of-court statements that are admitted into evidence for a purpose other than proving the truth of the content of the statement itself. These statements are not considered hearsay because they are not relied upon for their truthfulness, but rather for another legally relevant purpose.
english_labels: Statements Not Offered for the Truth of the Matter Asserted

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQK2.label: Deal Language
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQK2.definition: Material Adverse Effect (MAE) Language refers to a legal provision in mergers and acquisitions contracts that outlines specific circumstances or events that would have a significant negative impact on the value or operations of the target company, and may allow the acquiring party to terminate the agreement or renegotiate the terms.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQK2.label: Merger
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQK2.definition: The concept of "Merger" refers to a type of M&A deal structure where two or more companies combine into a single entity, with one surviving entity and the others being absorbed.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQKn.label: Dividend Payment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQKn.definition: A Dividend Payment is a distribution of a portion of a company's earnings to its shareholders, typically in the form of cash or additional shares. Dividends are usually paid out regularly (e.g., quarterly) and are intended to provide a return on investment to shareholders.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQLB.label: Public Space Committee
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQLB.definition: A Public Space Committee is an organized group of individuals, often within local government or a relevant agency, that oversees, plans, and makes recommendations for the development, maintenance, and use of public spaces within a community. This committee typically collaborates with urban planners, landscape architects, and community stakeholders to create spaces that serve public needs and enhance community welfare.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQR6.label: Document Collections by Areas of Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQR6.definition: Document Collections by Areas of Law are a type of Transactional Document that group together various legal documents related to specific areas of law, such as Real Estate, Mergers & Acquisitions, and Trusts and Estate Planning.
english_labels: Document Collections by Areas of Law

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQRT.label: L679 Quality assurance and control
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQRT.definition: Activities and actions related to ensuring that the process and practices used to perform analysis meet an acceptable level of defensibility.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQRj.label: Cross-Appellant
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQRj.definition: A litigant who makes a cross-appeal.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQS7.label: Kansas District Court - Allen County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQS7.definition: Kansas District Court - Allen County refers to a specific court within the Kansas District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Allen County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQTQ.label: Lozi
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQTQ.definition: A Bantu language spoken in Zambia and Angola, characterized by its tonal system and use of prefixes and suffixes to indicate tense, mood, and aspect.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQWQ.label: Benign Brain Tumor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQWQ.definition: A benign brain tumor is a non-cancerous growth in the brain that typically does not invade surrounding tissues or spread to other parts of the body. Despite being non-malignant, benign brain tumors can still cause significant health issues due to their location and pressure on surrounding brain structures, leading to symptoms such as headaches, seizures, and neurological deficits.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQXl.label: X205 Official Fees, Patent and Trademark Opposition Fees, Excluding Prosecution (Application or Post-Issuance) Fees
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQXl.definition: Any fees associated with the opposition of a patent or trademark. Excludes prosecution application (X203) or post-issuance maintenance (X204) fees.
english_labels: X205 Official Fees, Patent and Trademark Opposition Fees, Excluding Prosecution (Application or Post-Issuance) Fees

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQZl.label: L612 Legal hold
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQZl.definition: Activities and actions related to a) developing / drafting of appropriate legal hold for nature of litigation and distributing to identified custodians and data stewards, b) tracking and monitoring of responses received from custodians and including addressing any questions, and c) the release of a custodian or data steward from legal hold due to conclusion of litigation via settlement, conclusion of appeal or otherwise.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQa0.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Delaware County Circuit 4
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQa0.definition: The Indiana Circuit Court - Delaware County Circuit 4 is a court of general jurisdiction in Delaware County, Indiana, responsible for hearing civil and criminal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.
english_labels: Indiana Circuit Court - Delaware County Circuit 4

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQa2.label: tax_total_detail_expense
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQa2.definition: "Total taxable amount of expenses attributable to this tx_id, including amounts associated with MATTER_DISC_CRED where disc_cred_category = ""Exp"". Using the Math Statement on the next tab in this workbook: The total for pre-split expense items for this tx_id + The total for post-split expense items for this tx_id tax_total_detail_exp If tx_id is a Tiered Tax, the value in this field should be 0. Certain taxes are calculated not only on line items, but also include another tax for these line items -- a ""tax on tax"" situation. For example, in Canada both Quebec and Prince Edward Island have specific taxes calculated on the sum of the line items plus the federal tax paid on those line items. In situations like this, the tax_total_detail_expense figure stated should include the other tax attributable to the line items so that the math statement for total_tax_on_expense is correct. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQbV.label: Price-Based Market Segments
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQbV.definition: Price-based segments refer to divisions of the market that are categorized based on the pricing and affordability of products and services. These segments include luxury, budget, and mass market, each targeting consumers with different levels of purchasing power and preferences for price versus quality.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQcR.label: US Chapter 12 Bankruptcy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQcR.definition: This form of bankruptcy is designed for 'family farmers' and 'family fisherman' that are under financial distress. Under chapter 12, the person in debt comes up with a plan to pay back creditors over three to five years.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQfW.label: Relative Caregiver
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQfW.definition: A caregiver who is a member of the child's family.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQfr.label: Nahuatl languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQfr.definition: The Nahuatl languages are a group of written or spoken structured systems of communication that belong to the Language top-level class and are used in legal matters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQg5.label: Georgia Superior Court - Taliaferro County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQg5.definition: The Georgia Superior Court - Taliaferro County is a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Taliaferro County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQgp.label: Matching Rights Language
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQgp.definition: Matching Rights Language refers to the specific contractual language used in a Change of Recommendation Covenant that grants parties the right to maintain their ownership percentage in a company during a merger or acquisition by allowing them to purchase additional shares of the new entity.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQhg.label: U.S. Senate
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQhg.definition: The U.S. Senate is the upper chamber of Congress, responsible for confirming presidential appointments, ratifying treaties, and conducting impeachment trials. Composed of 100 members, with two Senators representing each state, the Senate exercises legislative, executive, and judicial powers as part of the federal government.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQiF.label: Prison
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQiF.definition: A Prison is a secure facility used to confine individuals who have been convicted of serious crimes and are serving sentences of incarceration. It is designed to ensure public safety, rehabilitate offenders, and deter future criminal behavior, typically operated by government authorities or private entities under government contract.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQiz.label: Real Estate Special Exception
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQiz.definition: A Real Estate Special Exception is a provision in zoning law that allows a property to be used in a way that deviates from the general zoning regulations of that area, usually granted after review and approval by a local governing body. This exception is subject to specific conditions and limitations aimed at minimizing adverse effects on surrounding properties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQpg.label: California Superior Court - Alameda Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQpg.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Alameda County, California, with the power to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQqB.label: Certificate (Litigation)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQqB.definition: A certificate is a written document that serves as proof of a particular fact or achievement, often issued by a court or other authority.
