https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQtF.label: Commonwealth of Independent States
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQtF.definition: CIS (Commonwealth of Independent States): A regional intergovernmental organization of post-Soviet countries in Eurasia aimed at fostering cooperation in political, economic, and military affairs.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQw3.label: Delusional Disorder
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQw3.definition: Delusional Disorder is a mental health condition characterized by the presence of one or more persistent delusions that are not attributable to other mental health disorders or medical conditions. Individuals with delusional disorder experience significant distress or impairment due to the belief in false, fixed, and unshakable convictions despite evidence to the contrary.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQx0.label: Intervening Event - Knowledge by Target Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQx0.definition: An intervening event in a legal matter that involves the knowledge possessed by the target management.
english_labels: Intervening Event - Knowledge by Target Management

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQx4.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQx4.definition: An Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) document is a formal written plan that outlines the terms, conditions, and procedures for establishing and operating an Employee Stock Ownership Plan. This document details the rules governing employee eligibility, stock allocation, vesting schedules, and the plan’s administration to ensure compliance with legal requirements.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQxw.label: Provider Non-Timekeeper Level
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQxw.definition: A Provider Non-Timekeeper Level is a category of personnel within a law firm who do not bill clients for their time, such as knowledge managers, pricing personnel, discovery personnel, accounting personnel, assistants/secretaries, administrators, and marketing personnel.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQy4.label: Indiana Superior Court - Carroll County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQy4.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that has the authority to hear and decide civil and criminal cases within Carroll County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQyz.label: Ga
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQyz.definition: A specific language, such as English or Spanish, used in legal matters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQzQ.label: Enterprise Search Implementation Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQzQ.definition: Enterprise Search Implementation Services refers to the provision of consulting and management services for the implementation of search solutions within an organization.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RQzs.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Kendall County (23rd Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Kendall County (23rd Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RR2Q.label: Historical Landmark
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RR2Q.definition: A Historical Landmark in the context of a Real Estate Asset Type refers to a building, site, structure, or object recognized for its historical, cultural, or architectural significance. The legal processes surrounding its designation usually involve rigorous evaluation, public hearings, and often require the formal approval from a historic preservation commission or similar authority.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RR6R.label: Florida Circuit Court - Lake County - 5th Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RR6R.definition: A court located in Lake County, Florida that is part of the larger Florida Circuit Court system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings within the state.
english_labels: Florida Circuit Court - Lake County - 5th Circuit Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RR7o.label: Negligence and Malpractice Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RR7o.definition: Failure to exercise the care that a reasonably prudent person or professional, in the case of professional negligence, would exercise in like circumstances and the harm caused by those actions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RR9Q.label: 05_1 Prisoner Petitions: Habeas Corpus (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RR9Q.definition: A petition filed by a person who is in custody, challenging the legality of their detention, specifically categorized under the PACER Nature of Suit (NoS) Codes as Habeas Corpus.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RR9Z.label: PA410 Information Disclosure Statement - Domestic
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RR9Z.definition: All action associated with bringing prior art, or other information, to the attention of an Examiner in the home country of the applicant in connection with an application that was previously filed under PA300. Note that Information Disclosure Statements that are filed with the application are included under PA300.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRAm.label: "Necessity" Receiver
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRAm.definition: A "Necessity" Receiver is a type of receiver appointed by a court to take control of a company or property when it is necessary to prevent harm or damage to the property or its stakeholders.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRC3.label: Misrepresentation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRC3.definition: A misrepresentation is a false statement made by one party to another, which induces the other party to enter into a contract or take some other action, and which causes harm or damages to the other party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RREW.label: WC450 Hearing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RREW.definition: Appearance at hearing, Travel to /from hearing, Post-hearing communication/report regarding hearing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRF8.label: Sophisticated User of Product
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRF8.definition: A sophisticated user of a product is a defense in product liability cases that asserts that the user had knowledge and experience with the product and therefore assumed the risk of any potential harm.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRFc.label: Release Agreement Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRFc.definition: A Release Agreement Clause is a provision in a legal contract that outlines the terms and conditions for releasing one party from liability or obligation to another party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRG4.label: Georgia Superior Court - Lowndes County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRG4.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia, located in Lowndes County and having authority over civil and criminal cases within its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRLe.label: Red Light Ticket
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRLe.definition: A Red Light Ticket is issued to a driver who fails to stop at a red traffic light, indicating a violation of traffic control signals. This citation is enforceable by law and typically requires the offender to pay a fine or contest the ticket in court.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRM6.label: Queen
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRM6.definition: A Queen is a female monarch who holds the highest royal title and serves as the sovereign ruler of a kingdom or realm. This position, typically hereditary or acquired through marriage to a king, involves ceremonial duties and may include varying degrees of political authority, depending on the constitutional structure of the country.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RROI.label: Tool Mark Evidence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RROI.definition: Tool mark evidence refers to the impressions or patterns left by a tool on an object or surface. Forensic experts analyze these marks to identify the specific type and characteristics of the tool, potentially linking it to a crime or suspect.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRPL.label: Schedules and Statements Extension Motion
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRPL.definition: A Schedules and Statements Extension Motion is a request made in a bankruptcy case to extend the deadline for filing schedules and statements.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRR1.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Perry County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRR1.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Perry County: A specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Perry County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRR2.label: Online Dispute Resolution Forum
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRR2.definition: An Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) Forum is a type of Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) Forum that operates through digital means, either with or without human facilitation, to resolve disputes between parties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRTf.label: Multi-Jurisdictional Survey
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRTf.definition: A multi-jurisdictional survey (e.g., 50-state survey, 50-country survey) involves a systematic examination of laws, regulations, or practices across multiple specific jurisdictions within a larger entity, such as states within a country. It is often used to identify variations in legal standards or requirements and assess their impact on compliance or policy development.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRTs.label: Proportional Electoral System
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRTs.definition: A proportional electoral system is a voting method designed to allocate seats in a legislative body in proportion to the number of votes each party or candidate receives. This system aims to create a representative body that mirrors the overall distribution of public support, promoting fairer and more inclusive representation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRUX.label: Tokelau
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRUX.definition: A language spoken in Tokelau, a territory of New Zealand, which is a member of the Polynesian language family.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRWB.label: Excess Cash Flow Recapture Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRWB.definition: A provision in a contract that allows a party to recapture excess cash flow generated by the contract and apply it towards outstanding debt or other obligations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRZH.label: L650 Review (NOS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRZH.definition: "NOS" = Not Otherwise Specified (catch-all, includes the subcategories) Primarily charges on a hourly, per GB, per document or per page charges.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRZQ.label: Candidate
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRZQ.definition: A Candidate is an individual who is seeking selection, nomination, or election for a specific position, office, or role. This person typically undergoes a formal process of evaluation, campaigning, or competition to be chosen for the desired position, whether in a political, professional, or organizational context.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRa8.label: Evading Arrest
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRa8.definition: The concept of Evading Arrest refers to the act of intentionally avoiding or running away from a law enforcement officer who is attempting to make an arrest, and is classified as a type of criminal misdemeanor offense.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRbb.label: Right to Foreclose
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRbb.definition: The Right to Foreclose is the legal authority granted to a lender to initiate proceedings to take possession of a property used as collateral when a borrower defaults on a loan. This right allows the lender to sell the property in order to recoup the outstanding loan amount, interest, and any associated costs, subject to specific regulations and procedures outlined in the mortgage agreement and applicable law

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRd8.label: expense_item_disc_cred segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRd8.definition: "All discounts, credits and Alternate Fee Agreement items applied to the parent expense line item. There will be 0 or more EXPENSE_ITEM_DISC_CRED segments per EXPENSE item. This segment excludes discounts taken at the MATTER_DISC_CRED level. Note that the EXTEND_HEADER option was purposely omitted from this segment. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRdS.label: PA650 Post-Issuance Remedial Action
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRdS.definition: All actions associated with completing a continuing patent application (claiming priority to an earlier-filed, parent application in the same country, without adding any new disclosure) that are to be filed outside of the ("domestic") home country or region of the applicant, including review of parent application, drafting and execution of any formal documents (such as transmittals and information disclosure statements), filing of application, and reporting to the client. Includes Divisional and Reissue Applications, and Reexamination Requests.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RReG.label: California Superior Court - Santa Clara Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RReG.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Santa Clara County, California, with the power to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.
english_labels: California Superior Court - Santa Clara Cty.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RReI.label: L671 Conversion of ESI to production format
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RReI.definition: Activities and actions related to the TIFFing, bates stamping, endorsing, preparation of load files and deliverables to be provided as part of the data and/or document production(s). Also includes any technical time not included in the base production charges.
english_labels: L671 Conversion of ESI to production format

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRfu.label: Environmental and Natural Resource Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRfu.definition: Law addressing environmental pollution and natural resource management.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRhA.label: New York Magistrate Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRhA.definition: New York Magistrate Court is a lower court in the New York State Court system that handles minor criminal and civil cases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRjG.label: Irish
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRjG.definition: Irish (Language) refers to the Goidelic language spoken in Ireland, which is one of the official languages of the country alongside English.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRjy.label: Minnesota District Court - Jackson County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRjy.definition: Minnesota District Court - Jackson County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system located in Jackson County, Minnesota.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRkM.label: Cardiologist Negligence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRkM.definition: Cardiologist Negligence refers to a legal claim of medical malpractice against a cardiologist, alleging that the cardiologist failed to provide the appropriate standard of care resulting in harm or injury to the patient.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRkX.label: Application to Compromise Controversy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRkX.definition: An Application to Compromise Controversy is a legal request made in the context of bankruptcy proceedings to settle a dispute or claim with creditors through a negotiated agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRp1.label: Motion to Deposit Funds into Court Registry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRp1.definition: A Motion to Deposit Funds into Court Registry is a request made in a bankruptcy case to transfer funds from a debtor to the court's registry for safekeeping and distribution to creditors.
english_labels: Motion to Deposit Funds into Court Registry

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRqk.label: Motions to Recover Fees, Interest, and Costs
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRqk.definition: A Motion to Recover Fees, Interest, and Costs is a request made to the court by a party seeking reimbursement for expenses incurred during litigation, including attorney fees, costs, and interest on a judgment.
english_labels: Motions to Recover Fees, Interest, and Costs

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRt4.label: Motion for Bench Trial
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRt4.definition: A Motion for Bench Trial is a request made by a party in a trial court to have the judge, rather than a jury, decide the outcome of the case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRtr.label: Nursing and Residential Care Facilities Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRtr.definition: Industries in this group provide residential care combined with either nursing, supervisory, or other types of care as required by the residents. In this subsector, the facilities are a significant part of the production process and the care provided is a mix of health and social services with the health services being largely some level of nursing services.
english_labels: Nursing and Residential Care Facilities Industry

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRxI.label: JJ30 Applications for disclosure or Further Information (UK J-CODE)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRxI.definition: Work performed related to applications for disclosure or Further Information
english_labels: JJ30 Applications for disclosure or Further Information (UK J-CODE)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRym.label: Sorghum
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRym.definition: Sorghum is a cereal crop belonging to the species Sorghum bicolor, known for its drought tolerance and versatility as a food, fodder, and biofuel crop. It is widely cultivated in arid regions and provides essential nutrients such as carbohydrates, proteins, and vitamins.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRym.label: Judicial Error
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RRym.definition: Judicial error refers to mistakes or oversights made by a judge during a legal proceeding that can affect the outcome of the case. Such errors might include incorrect interpretations of the law, admitting inadmissible evidence, or procedural mistakes. If significant enough, a judicial error can serve as grounds for an appeal or the overturning of a verdict or judgment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RS08.label: taxing_jurisdiction_country
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RS08.definition: "The country of the taxing jurisdiction. Use ISO 3166 country code set forth by International Standards Organization (www.iso.org.) "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RS0M.label: Preferential Transfer Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RS0M.definition: A Preferential Transfer Claim is a legal claim made by a creditor seeking to recover payments made by a debtor to a preferred creditor before filing for bankruptcy, in order to ensure equal distribution of assets among all creditors.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RS0a.label: B420 Restructurings
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RS0a.definition: Analysis, consultation and drafting in connection with the restructuring of agreements, including financing agreements, where no bankruptcy case has been filed

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RS1d.label: Protection and Advocacy Attorney
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RS1d.definition: A Protection & Advocacy (P&A) Attorney is a type of lawyer who specializes in representing individuals with disabilities in legal matters related to their rights and access to services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RS48.label: PA100 Assessment, Development, and Administration
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RS48.definition: All actions to investigate and understand the facts of a matter that are not included under another patent task code below. Covers interviews of client personnel and potential witnesses, review of documents to learn the facts of a potential case, work with an investigator, and all related communications and correspondence.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RS4M.label: Governmental Branch
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RS4M.definition: The branches of government typically refer to the three main divisions of a democratic system: the legislative, which makes laws; the executive, which enforces and administers laws; and the judicial, which interprets laws. These branches are designed to balance power and ensure that no single entity has unchecked authority.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RS51.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Columbia County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RS51.definition: Oregon Circuit Court - Columbia County: A specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Columbia County, Oregon.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RS5w.label: USCIS Administrative Appeals Office
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RS5w.definition: The USCIS Administrative Appeals Office is a specific administrative venue within the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services where individuals can appeal certain immigration-related decisions made by USCIS.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RS6P.label: Limitations on Antitrust Efforts Standards
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RS6P.definition: Limitations on Antitrust Efforts Standards refer to specific provisions or rules that restrict the extent to which antitrust efforts can be pursued in a legal matter, such as dollar-based, materiality-based, or MAE-based standards, among others.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RS8e.label: Product Disparagement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RS8e.definition: The act of making false or misleading statements about a product or service with the intention of harming its reputation or sales, which falls under the broader category of defamation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RS9m.label: Double Jeopardy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RS9m.definition: The concept of Double Jeopardy refers to the legal principle that prohibits an individual from being prosecuted or punished twice for the same offense after a final judgment has been made.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSAI.label: Mandatory Sentence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSAI.definition: A Mandatory Sentence is a predetermined punishment specified by law for a particular criminal offense, leaving the judge with no discretion to individualize the sentence. This type of sentence requires the court to impose a specific penalty upon conviction, regardless of mitigating factors or the judge's personal assessment of the case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSCP.label: AI Discrimination
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSCP.definition: AI Discrimination refers to the differential treatment of individuals based on factors such as ethnicity, culture, or religion. This discrimination can arise from institutional and individual biases embedded in AI processes, cultural and social biases within the data, technical limitations of hardware or software, or the context of an AI system's application that results in unequal treatment of groups.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSCi.label: Claim for Falling on Water
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSCi.definition: A claim for falling on water is a legal action brought by a plaintiff who has suffered injury due to slipping and falling on a wet surface, and is based on the legal theory of negligence.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSDH.label: Actions Required Under Transaction Agreement Language
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSDH.definition: Actions Required Under Transaction Agreement Language refers to the specific obligations and duties that must be fulfilled by parties involved in a legal transaction as outlined in the agreement, and which are exempted from the Material Adverse Effect (MAE) definition.
english_labels: Actions Required Under Transaction Agreement Language

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSEc.label: Secondary Legal Authorities
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSEc.definition: Documents and other materials that discuss, explain, analyze, and critique the law.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSHY.label: 360 Other Personal Injury (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSHY.definition: Action primarily based on personal injury or death caused by negligence or intentional misconduct, including suits brought against the United States under the Federal Tort Claims Act, and which cannot be classified under any other nature of suit.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSJb.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Gilliam County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSJb.definition: The Oregon Circuit Court - Gilliam County is a specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Gilliam County, Oregon.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSKL.label: WC150 Budgeting
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSKL.definition: Preparation of budget, correspondence regarding budget

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSKh.label: Subpoena Fees Expense
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSKh.definition: The Subpoena Fees Expense refers to the costs incurred by a party in a legal matter for issuing and serving a subpoena to a witness or a third party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSLf.label: Provider Practice Group
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSLf.definition: Name of the provider (e.g., law firm, ALSP) practice group.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSMJ.label: Plea Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSMJ.definition: A plea agreement is a legal document that outlines an agreement between a defendant and prosecutor, in which the defendant agrees to plead guilty or no contest to a charge in exchange for a reduced sentence or other concessions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSPy.label: X132 Medical Record Service Provider Fees
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSPy.definition: Any third party medical record service provider fees billed as an expense as opposed to a service, when this task is outsourced to a third party and paid by the law firm or legal vendor
english_labels: X132 Medical Record Service Provider Fees

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSQj.label: Parental Alienation Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSQj.definition: The intentional or unintentional behavior of one parent that causes a child to reject or fear the other parent, leading to a claim in a custody or visitation dispute.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSQv.label: Summary of Ballots
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSQv.definition: A summary of ballots is a document that provides a condensed version of the votes cast by creditors or shareholders in a bankruptcy or restructuring proceeding.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSRx.label: Judicial and Procedural Tort Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSRx.definition: Judicial and Procedural Tort Claims refer to legal claims made against individuals or entities for their wrongful actions or omissions during legal proceedings, such as perjury, abuse of process, or spoliation of evidence.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSW1.label: Treating Physician
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSW1.definition: Physician who has treated a patient.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSYB.label: Area of Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSYB.definition: The practice area into which a legal matter or legal area of study falls (e.g., Criminal Law, Real Property Law, Mergers and Acquisitions Law, Personal and Family Law, Tax and Revenue Law).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSYi.label: Indiana Town Court - Marion County, Washington Twp.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSYi.definition: A local court in Marion County, Washington Township, Indiana that handles minor criminal and traffic offenses, as well as small claims and civil cases within its jurisdiction.
english_labels: Indiana Town Court - Marion County, Washington Twp.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSa8.label: Birth Certificate
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSa8.definition: A Birth Certificate is an official document issued by a government authority that records the details of a person's birth. It typically includes information such as the individual's full name, date and place of birth, parentage, and, in some cases, other relevant details like the attending physician. Birth certificates serve as legal proof of identity and are often required for various official purposes, including obtaining identification documents and accessing government services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSaW.label: Motion to Obtain Credit
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSaW.definition: A Motion to Obtain Credit is a request made in a bankruptcy case by a debtor seeking permission to obtain credit or incur debt.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSfJ.label: Sexual Orientation Discrimination
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSfJ.definition: Discrimination based on an individual's sexual orientation, which involves treating someone unfavorably because of their sexual orientation, whether real or perceived.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSfW.label: Contributory Benefit
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSfW.definition: A type of social security benefit funded by contributions from employees, employers, or both, typically through payroll taxes. Eligibility for contributory benefits is usually based on the individual's contribution history and may include benefits such as retirement pensions, disability insurance, and unemployment insurance.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSfk.label: P250 Employee/Labor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSfk.definition: This task includes all fact investigation/due diligence from an employee benefits and labor perspective.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSgM.label: Family Practitioner Malpractice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSgM.definition: Negligent or wrongful actions or omissions committed by a family practitioner in the course of providing medical care to a patient, resulting in harm or injury to the patient or a failure to diagnose or treat a medical condition.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSgs.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Grundy County (13th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Grundy County (13th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSiP.label: New York Court of Appeals
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSiP.definition: The New York Court of Appeals is the highest court in the New York State court system, responsible for hearing appeals from lower courts and making final decisions on legal disputes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSjx.label: ACCOUNT_TYPE
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSjx.definition: A type of account used in the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard for electronic legal invoicing.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSk5.label: Coastal Real Estate Asset
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSk5.definition: A Coastal Real Estate Asset refers to property located along the coastlines of oceans or seas. These assets typically offer scenic views, access to water-based activities, and come with unique environmental and regulatory considerations related to coastal management and conservation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSlv.label: P400 Initial Document Preparation/Filing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSlv.definition: This phase includes all tasks undertaken to prepare transaction documents and opinions prior to their being sent to non-client third parties. Also includes all tasks undertaken to file documents (including regulatory filings). All related communications with the client and review of client generated transaction documentation should be coded here.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSoA.label: Evergreen Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSoA.definition: An evergreen clause is a provision in a contract that automatically renews the agreement at the end of its term unless one of the parties gives notice to terminate.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSq6.label: Household Income
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSq6.definition: Household income is the combined total income of all people living in a single household, regardless of their relationship to each other. This metric is often used for demographic, tax, and social services analysis to assess the economic status of a household.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSrW.label: Motion Setting Property Value
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSrW.definition: A motion setting property value is a type of motion filed in a bankruptcy case that seeks to determine the value of a particular property.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSru.label: Guardianship of Minor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSru.definition: The legal concept of Guardianship of Minor refers to the legal authority and responsibility given to a person or entity to care for and make decisions on behalf of a minor child who is not able to care for themselves.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSs6.label: PA110 Fact Investigation and Development
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSs6.definition: All actions to investigate and understand the facts of a matter that are not included under another patent task code below. Covers interviews of client personnel and potential witnesses, review of documents to learn the facts of a potential case, work with an investigator, and all related communications and correspondence.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSv0.label: Payee Name - Fee or Expense
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSv0.definition: Payee Name - Fee or Expense refers to the specific details of the payment recipient and the type of payment, whether it is a fee or an expense, within the context of an engagement for legal services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSwO.label: Government Benefits
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSwO.definition: Government Benefits are financial assistance programs provided by the government to individuals in need, designed to support basic living expenses, healthcare, and other essential needs. These benefits include payments such as Social Security, unemployment benefits, and welfare payments, which help to ensure a safety net for the vulnerable and unemployed.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSxE.label: Expert Interview Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSxE.definition: Expert Interview Practice refers to the process of conducting interviews with individuals who possess specialized knowledge or expertise relevant to a legal matter, as part of the fact investigation and development phase of a case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSxq.label: Sundanese
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSxq.definition: Sundanese (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Sundanese people of West Java, Indonesia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSyB.label: Motion to Stay Preliminary Injunction
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSyB.definition: A Motion to Stay Preliminary Injunction is a request made to a court to temporarily suspend or delay the enforcement of a preliminary injunction until a final decision is made on the case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSyZ.label: Negotiable Instrument Forged or Stolen Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSyZ.definition: A Negotiable Instrument Forged or Stolen Claim is a legal claim related to a written promise to pay a specific amount of money that has been fraudulently created or taken without authorization, and is related to banking, commercial paper, and creditor claims.
english_labels: Negotiable Instrument Forged or Stolen Claim

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSyq.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Jackson County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSyq.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Jackson County: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that hears civil and criminal cases within Jackson County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSzC.label: Yao
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RSzC.definition: Yao (Language) is a specific written or spoken structured system of communication that is a member of the Language class, and is used in legal matters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RT2d.label: Treaty Trader Visa
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RT2d.definition: The Treaty Trader Visa is a visa category designed for nationals of countries with which the United States maintains a treaty of commerce and navigation. The visa allows individuals or companies to enter and conduct substantial trade activities, such as the exchange of goods, services, or technology, between the host and treaty countries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RT6d.label: Statement of Operations
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RT6d.definition: A Statement of Operations is a financial document that provides information on a company's revenues, expenses, and profits or losses during a specific period of time, and is typically used in bankruptcy and restructuring proceedings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RT7x.label: Daubert Motion Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RT7x.definition: Daubert Motion Practice refers to the process of challenging the admissibility of expert testimony in court, based on the standards set forth in the Daubert case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RT9I.label: Galibi Carib
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RT9I.definition: Galibi Carib is a language that belongs to the Cariban language family and is spoken by the Galibi people in parts of South America.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTAn.label: License Grant Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTAn.definition: A License Grant Clause is a provision in a contract that gives permission to use a specific intellectual property right, such as a patent or trademark, for a certain purpose or period of time.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTC1.label: L120 Analysis/Strategy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTC1.definition: The concept of L120 Analysis/Strategy refers to the process of evaluating and developing a plan of action for a legal case, including identifying key issues and potential outcomes, and determining the best course of action to achieve the desired result.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTCe.label: Intervenor-Plaintiff
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTCe.definition: A person who intervenes or seeks to intervene as a plaintiff in a civil action.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTHm.label: Cost Metrics
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTHm.definition: Metrics that specifically focus on the expenses and costs incurred in the process of delivering services or goods, used for budgeting, financial planning, and pricing strategies.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTI2.label: Adequate Protection Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTI2.definition: Adequate Protection Practice refers to the legal practice of ensuring that a creditor's interest in collateral is protected during bankruptcy proceedings, typically through the use of cash or other forms of relief from stay.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTIk.label: Georgia Superior Court - Stephens County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTIk.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Stephens County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Stephens County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTJN.label: Pancreas Transplantation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTJN.definition: Pancreas transplantation is a surgical procedure that involves replacing a diseased or non-functional pancreas with a healthy donor pancreas. This transplant is often performed for patients with severe type 1 diabetes who have difficult-to-manage blood sugar levels and complications from the disease.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTK9.label: King
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTK9.definition: A King is a male monarch who holds the highest royal title and serves as the sovereign ruler of a kingdom or realm. This hereditary or elected position typically involves both ceremonial duties and varying degrees of political power, depending on the constitutional structure of the country.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTM0.label: Victim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTM0.definition: A victim is an individual who suffers harm, injury, loss, or hardship due to an unlawful act, omission, or negligence of another party. This harm can manifest physically, emotionally, financially, or in any other form detrimental to the individual's well-being or rights.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTNL.label: Judicial Concurrence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTNL.definition: Judicial concurrence refers to the agreement of one or more judges with the majority opinion in a court case, but for different reasons or with additional commentary.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTNQ.label: Motion to File Amended Complaint
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTNQ.definition: A Motion to File Amended Complaint is a formal request made to the court to allow a party to modify or add to their original complaint in a legal case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTPF.label: Knowledge Type
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTPF.definition: Knowledge Type is a subclass of Document/Artifact and includes various types of documents such as FAQs, training materials, reports, exemplar documents, templates, forms, guides, directories, playbooks, articles, presentations, and expert opinions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTQ0.label: Easement After Property Divided
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTQ0.definition: A legal right to use someone else's property for a specific purpose, which arises after the property has been divided among different owners.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTQA.label: 820 Copyright (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTQA.definition: Action filed in support or to dispute a copyright claim.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTRi.label: Welfare Payments
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTRi.definition: Welfare Payments are financial assistance provided by the government to individuals and families in need, aiming to ensure a minimum standard of living. These payments are designed to support basic necessities such as food, housing, and healthcare for low-income and vulnerable populations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTSI.label: Vestibular Disorder
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTSI.definition: Disturbance of labyrinthine-vestibular function involves a condition characterized by frequent episodes of balance disturbances, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), and progressive hearing loss. Diagnosis typically requires evidence of impaired vestibular function through tests such as caloric or other vestibular assessments, as well as documented hearing loss established by audiometry.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTSi.label: Paralegal
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTSi.definition: A paralegal is a level of provider in legal services who is responsible for timekeeping and other administrative tasks, but is not a licensed attorney.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTVk.label: Including Without Limitation Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTVk.definition: An "Including Without Limitation Clause" is a provision in a contract that clarifies that the listed items are not an exhaustive list and that other items may also be included.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTWQ.label: Motion to Extend Time to Comply with Order
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTWQ.definition: A Motion to Extend Time to Comply with Order is a request made to a court to allow additional time to fulfill a previously issued order.
english_labels: Motion to Extend Time to Comply with Order

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTWp.label: Interference with Prospective Economic Advantage
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTWp.definition: The concept of Interference with Prospective Economic Advantage refers to the intentional or negligent actions of one party that prevent another party from realizing potential economic benefits or advantages that were reasonably expected to occur in the future.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTWv.label: Federal Tort Claims Act Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTWv.definition: A Federal Tort Claims Act Claim is a legal claim made against the United States government for damages caused by the negligent or wrongful acts of federal employees acting within the scope of their employment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTYN.label: Engagement Start Date
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTYN.definition: The date at which a provider (e.g., law firm, ALSP) is engaged by a Buyer (e.g., corporation, client)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTYc.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Washington County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTYc.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Washington County: A specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Washington County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTYe.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Gasconade County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTYe.definition: A Missouri Circuit Court located in Gasconade County, which is responsible for hearing and deciding civil and criminal cases within its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTZQ.label: Motion for Interest on a Judgment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTZQ.definition: A Motion for Interest on a Judgment is a request made to the court to add interest to a previously awarded judgment, typically to compensate for the delay in payment.
english_labels: Motion for Interest on a Judgment

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTdz.label: Latvian
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTdz.definition: A language spoken in Latvia and used in legal matters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTfF.label: Motion for Findings of Fact
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTfF.definition: A Motion for Findings of Fact is a formal request made by a party in a trial court asking the judge to make specific factual determinations based on the evidence presented at trial.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTfH.label: Latin
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTfH.definition: A language that was spoken in ancient Rome and is still used in legal contexts today.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTfu.label: X114 Local Travel
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTfu.definition: Any ground transportation (taxi, subway), mileage and parking associated with local travel. Excludes billable travel time (A115). If client requires a more granular breakdown, law firm or legal vendor should submit separate itemized expense line items.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTh6.label: EMS Negligence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTh6.definition: Negligence by emergency medical services providers, including paramedics and ambulance personnel, in the treatment or transport of patients.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RThF.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Callaway County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RThF.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Callaway County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Callaway County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTid.label: Treason
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTid.definition: The act of betraying one's country by levying war against it or by giving aid or comfort to its enemies.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTkZ.label: Tangerines
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTkZ.definition: Tangerines are small citrus fruits belonging to the Citrus reticulata species, known for their bright orange color, sweet flavor, and easy-to-peel skin. They are consumed fresh, juiced, or used in culinary dishes, valued for their high vitamin C content and aromatic zest.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTpY.label: LAW_FIRM_STATEorREGION
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTpY.definition: A geographic location where a law firm is located, as defined by the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTrO.label: Sales Commission Due from Principal
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTrO.definition: Sales Commission Due from Principal refers to the legal claim made by an agent or salesperson against their principal for payment of a commission owed for the sale of goods or services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTru.label: Outside Printing Expense
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTru.definition: Expenses related to printing materials or services that are outsourced to a third-party vendor, rather than being produced in-house.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTsx.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Livingston County (11th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Livingston County (11th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTtF.label: By Contingency Fee
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTtF.definition: Engagement fee model where if a matter is successful, the provider is paid a percentage of a client’s recovery.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTtZ.label: Analysis of Pre-Petition Mortgage
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTtZ.definition: An Analysis of Pre-Petition Mortgage involves the examination and evaluation of mortgage agreements and related financial transactions that occurred before the filing of a bankruptcy petition. This analysis helps determine the validity, priority, and enforceability of claims against the debtor's property within the bankruptcy proceedings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTvh.label: European Call Option Style
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTvh.definition: A European Call Option Style is a type of option contract that can only be exercised for a short, specified period just prior to its expiration, usually on a single day. This restriction contrasts with American-style options, which can be exercised at any time before expiration.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTvm.label: Condition Precedent Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTvm.definition: A condition precedent clause is a provision in a contract that specifies an event or action that must occur before the parties are obligated to perform their respective duties under the contract.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTxf.label: tax_tier_max
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTxf.definition: "The maximum amount of this tax tier expressed in INVOICE.inv_currency. Use the value ""TOP"" to indicate that the top tier extends to infinity. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTyO.label: Governor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTyO.definition: A Governor is the chief executive officer of a state, commonwealth, or territory within a federal system of government. This official is typically elected by the populace and is responsible for implementing state laws, managing the state government, and serving as the state's top representative in dealings with other states and the federal government.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTyo.label: Number of Employees
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTyo.definition: Number of Employees refers to the total count of individuals employed by a business or organization, either on a full-time or part-time basis. This metric is often used for various purposes including business valuation, eligibility for certain benefits or programs, and as an indicator of company size and capacity.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTzC.label: Breach of Nonsolicitation Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RTzC.definition: A breach of nonsolicitation agreement occurs when a party violates the terms of a contract that prohibits them from soliciting or attempting to solicit the employees, clients, or customers of another party, typically their former employer or business partner. Nonsolicitation agreements are often included in employment contracts, partnership agreements, or business sale agreements to protect a company's relationships with its workforce and clientele.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RU1d.label: Contested Divorce
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RU1d.definition: A Contested Divorce is a type of divorce in which the spouses are unable to reach an agreement on key issues such as division of property, child custody, spousal support, or other matters related to the dissolution of their marriage. In a contested divorce, these issues are typically resolved through litigation, with a court making decisions on behalf of the spouses. It often involves a more lengthy and adversarial legal process compared to an uncontested divorce, where the parties agree on the terms of the divorce.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RU20.label: Contact Name Suffix - III (Third)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RU20.definition: The suffix "III" stands for "Third" and is used after a person's full name to distinguish them as the third generation to bear that name in their family. Typically, it follows a grandfather, father, and son who all share the same name, and it helps in differentiating among them in formal, legal, or financial documents.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUAD.label: Management Information Circular
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUAD.definition: A Management Information Circular is a document prepared by a company's management to provide shareholders with material information needed to make informed voting decisions at a shareholders' meeting. It often includes proposals, background information, and recommendations from the board of directors.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUBV.label: Multifamily Real Estate Asset
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUBV.definition: Real estate properties that include more than one unit for residential inhabitants including residential buildings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUCs.label: Lung Transplantation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUCs.definition: Lung transplantation is a surgical procedure in which one or both diseased lungs are replaced with healthy lungs from a donor. This treatment is typically considered for patients with end-stage lung disease, such as chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) or pulmonary fibrosis, who have not responded to other therapies.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUDV.label: Equity Committee
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUDV.definition: An Equity Committee represents the interests of equity holders (shareholders) in a bankruptcy or restructuring process. This committee ensures that the rights and priorities of shareholders are considered in negotiations, particularly in scenarios where their investments are at risk of being diluted or wiped out.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUE4.label: Transportation and Logistics Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUE4.definition: The Transportation and Logistics industry group includes industries providing transportation of passengers and cargo, warehousing and storage for goods, scenic and sightseeing transportation, and support activities related to modes of transportation. Establishments in these industries use transportation equipment or transportation related facilities as a productive asset. The type of equipment depends on the mode of transportation. The modes of transportation are air, rail, water, road, and pipeline.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUGj.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Lehigh County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUGj.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Lehigh County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within Lehigh County.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Lehigh County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUH9.label: Citations to Another Document
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUH9.definition: A document's citations to other documents (e.g., legal authorities, exhibits, other documents).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUHH.label: Criminal Court Proceeding
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUHH.definition: A criminal lawsuit; all or some part of a cause heard and determined by a criminal court. Any legal step or action taken at the direction of, or by the authority of a court.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUIq.label: Prostate Cancer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUIq.definition: Prostate cancer is a type of cancer that develops in the prostate gland, a small gland in men that produces seminal fluid. It can range from slow-growing tumors that may need minimal treatment to aggressive cancers that require surgery, radiation, and hormone therapy.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUKE.label: Probate Filing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUKE.definition: A probate filing is a legal document submitted to a court to initiate the process of settling a deceased person's estate.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUKo.label: BILLING_END_DATE
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUKo.definition: The term BILLING_END_DATE refers to the date on which a billing period ends, as defined in the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard for legal electronic data exchange.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUM0.label: Dispositive Motions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUM0.definition: Dispositive Motions are requests made by a party in a trial court seeking a final resolution of a case or a particular issue, such as a motion for summary judgment or a motion to dismiss.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUMW.label: A116 Training
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUMW.definition: Training services provided by the law firm or legal vendor and billed as an hourly service. Typically technical or project training associated with eDiscovery.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUNL.label: Colleges, Universities, and Professional Schools Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUNL.definition: Colleges, universities, and professional schools furnishing academic courses and granting academic degrees. The requirement for admission is at least a high school diploma or equivalent general academic training.
english_labels: Colleges, Universities, and Professional Schools Industry

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUON.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Morgan County (7th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Morgan County (7th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUSb.label: No Assignment Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUSb.definition: A No Assignment Clause is a provision in a contract that prohibits one party from transferring their rights or obligations under the contract to a third party without the consent of the other party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUSp.label: X203 Patent and Trademark Prosecution Application Official Fees, Excluding Prosecution Post-Issuance and Opposition Fees
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUSp.definition: Any Patent and Trademark Prosecution official fees paid to governmental and quasi-governmental entities in order to obtain a patent or trademark, including those paid to Patent and Trademark Offices, the World Intellectual Property, Notaries, consulates, and embassies. Excludes post-issuance prosecution (X204) or opposition (X205) fees.
english_labels: X203 Patent and Trademark Prosecution Application Official Fees, Excluding Prosecution Post-Issuance and Opposition Fees

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUTs.label: ADR Court-Annexed Arbitration Forum
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUTs.definition: An ADR Court-Annexed Arbitration Forum is a type of Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) Forum that is attached to a court and provides a process for resolving disputes outside of the traditional court system.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUVt.label: M.Eng. (Master of Engineering)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUVt.definition: An M.Eng. (Master of Engineering) is a postgraduate degree focused on engineering studies, emphasizing technical and applied knowledge. It signifies advanced expertise in engineering principles and practices.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUWO.label: Medicare Fraud
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUWO.definition: The intentional deception or misrepresentation of information related to Medicare services or claims, with the aim of obtaining unauthorized benefits or payments.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUWo.label: Florida Circuit Court - Dixie County - 3rd Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUWo.definition: A court located in Dixie County, Florida that is part of the larger Florida Circuit Court system.
english_labels: Florida Circuit Court - Dixie County - 3rd Circuit Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUa6.label: Design Patent Registration Document
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUa6.definition: A design patent registration document is a legal certificate issued by a patent office that grants the holder exclusive rights to a unique visual design of a functional item for a certain period. It includes details about the design's appearance, such as shape, pattern, or ornamentation, and protects against unauthorized copying or imitation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUcP.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Fulton County (9th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Fulton County (9th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUcl.label: New York Court of General Sessions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUcl.definition: The New York Court of General Sessions is a court within the New York State Courts system that has jurisdiction over criminal cases and some civil cases.
english_labels: New York Court of General Sessions

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUe8.label: Regulatory Filing Event
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUe8.definition: A Regulatory Filing Event refers to a specific action or submission made to comply with regulations or requirements set forth by a governing authority. In the context of immigration, it could involve submitting applications, documents, or forms that adhere to the regulations and procedures established by immigration authorities for various immigration-related matters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUgW.label: Matter ID
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUgW.definition: Matter ID refers to a unique identifier assigned to a specific legal matter within an engagement for providing legal services. That matter identifier (e.g., IRIs, UUIDs, GUIDs) can be created and stored within the systems of various stakeholders (e.g., vendors, sellers, buyers, courts, regulators).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUhR.label: client segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUhR.definition: "Information on the Client(s) for whom bills are submitted by the Firm. There will be 1 or more CLIENT segments per FIRM segment. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUmO.label: Indiana Circuit Court - LaGrange County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUmO.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that hears civil and criminal cases within LaGrange County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUob.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Osage County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUob.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Osage County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Osage County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUpb.label: Expert Opinion
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUpb.definition: A document reflecting a belief or judgment, as provided by an expert on the subject.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUrI.label: Muslim Religion
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUrI.definition: The Muslim Religion, or Islam, is a monotheistic faith based on the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad as recorded in the Quran. In legal contexts, it often relates to the protection of religious freedoms, the accommodation of Islamic practices such as prayer and fasting, and the recognition of Islamic laws and principles in certain legal systems.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUuD.label: New York Supreme Court - Rockland County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUuD.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Rockland County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Rockland County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal disputes within its geographic jurisdiction.
english_labels: New York Supreme Court - Rockland County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUvM.label: PA330 Design Application Preparation - Domestic
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUvM.definition: All actions associated with completing a design patent (but not utility or utility model) application or design registration application that are to be filed in the ("domestic") home country or region of the applicant, including review of invention disclosure materials and prior art, interviews with the inventors, drafting and revision of application, preparation and execution of formal documents (such as assignments, declarations, information disclosure statements, and transmittals) filing of application, and reporting to the client. Note that government fees and external drafting expenses (or "disbursements" in the U.S.) are included under E100.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUwb.label: Motion for Appointment of Counsel
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUwb.definition: A Motion for Appointment of Counsel is a formal request made to the court by a defendant or a party in a legal proceeding, asking the court to appoint an attorney to represent them in the case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUx3.label: Cucumbers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUx3.definition: Cucumbers are elongated, green fruit vegetables from the Cucumis sativus species, known for their crisp texture and refreshing taste. They are commonly consumed raw in salads, pickled, or used as a garnish, and are valued for their hydrating properties and low calorie content.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUyA.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Washington County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUyA.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Washington County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that handles minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil cases involving amounts up to $12,000.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Washington County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUz5.label: Local
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUz5.definition: Actor attribute designating locality (e.g., local counsel, local expert, local business contact).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUze.label: X103 Copy Service (External)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RUze.definition: Any black & white or color copy, binding and reassembly charges when that service is performed by an external party and paid by the law firm or legal vendor

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RV0F.label: Motion to Reopen Chapter 11 Case
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RV0F.definition: A Motion to Reopen Chapter 11 Case is a request made to the court to reopen a previously closed bankruptcy case under Chapter 11 of the Bankruptcy Code.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RV0d.label: Indiana Circuit Court - White County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RV0d.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - White County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Indiana that has the authority to hear and decide civil and criminal cases within White County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RV1s.label: Environmental Review Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RV1s.definition: An Environmental Review Claim is a legal action asserting that a project or action has not adequately complied with environmental impact assessment requirements mandated by law. Such claims typically allege insufficient analysis of potential environmental effects, failure to consider alternatives, or inadequate mitigation measures for identified impacts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RV2Z.label: Claim for Falling on Commercial Sidewalk
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RV2Z.definition: A claim for falling on a commercial sidewalk is a legal action brought by an individual who has suffered injuries due to a slip-and-fall accident caused by the negligence of a commercial property owner.
english_labels: Claim for Falling on Commercial Sidewalk

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RV45.label: Misdemeanor Manslaughter
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RV45.definition: Misdemeanor Manslaughter is a type of negligent manslaughter that occurs when a person commits a misdemeanor offense that results in the death of another person.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RV4L.label: Middle Eastern / North African
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RV4L.definition: Middle Eastern / North African (MENA) is an ethnicity that refers to individuals who originate from or have ancestry in the regions of the Middle East and North Africa, which encompass countries such as Egypt, Iran, Iraq, Israel, Lebanon, Morocco, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey, among others. This diverse group of people shares historical, cultural, linguistic, and religious ties, while also exhibiting distinct differences across the various nations and communities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RV6D.label: Crow Creek Sioux Tribe of the Crow Creek Reservation, South Dakota
english_labels: Crow Creek Sioux Tribe of the Crow Creek Reservation, South Dakota

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RV8A.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Clarion County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RV8A.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Clarion County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in the state of Pennsylvania.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Clarion County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RV8T.label: X110 Conference Call/Video Call/Webinar Charges
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RV8T.definition: Multi party communication whether by telephone, video or external

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RV8m.label: Winner-Take-All - Multi-Winner System
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RV8m.definition: A winner-take-all multi-winner system is an electoral method where multiple candidates are elected from a single district, and the candidates with the highest number of votes win the available seats. This system can lead to one party or group dominating the representation, often marginalizing minority party voters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVAC.label: Probate Reason of Substance Abuse
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVAC.definition: Probate Reason of Substance Abuse refers to the legal grounds for filing a subsequent probate case due to the decedent's substance abuse issues.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVD4.label: PA710 Opinion Preparation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVD4.definition: All action associated with the completing formal legal opinions on the validity, enforceability, infringement, and/or non-infringement of a patent claim. Includes opinions on infringement of a client's patent by a non-client infringer.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVG1.label: European Union
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVG1.definition: The European Union (EU) Government is a permanent or semi-permanent administrative entity of the European Union that oversees and administers specific governmental functions within the EU.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVHa.label: Customer Lifetime Value
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVHa.definition: Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) is a metric that represents the total net profit a company expects to earn from a customer throughout their entire relationship. It is calculated by multiplying the average value of a customer transaction by the number of repeat transactions and the average retention time in a specific period.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVIY.label: Inuktitut
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVIY.definition: A language spoken by the Inuit people in Canada and parts of Greenland, characterized by a complex system of inflection and agglutination.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVIi.label: Sign On Bonus Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVIi.definition: A sign-on bonus clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the terms and conditions of a bonus payment made to an employee upon joining a company.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVKj.label: Anti-Bribery Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVKj.definition: An Anti-Bribery Clause is a provision in a contract that prohibits the offering, giving, receiving, or soliciting of any form of bribe or kickback in connection with the performance of the contract.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVLg.label: M&A Practice Components
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVLg.definition: M&A Practice Components refers to the specific tasks and activities involved in the process of mergers and acquisitions, including due diligence, drafting and negotiating agreements, regulatory compliance, financing, and post-closing matters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVLn.label: X402 Transaction Fee
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVLn.definition: Delivery of information on a transaction basis as opposed to a per user license fee or a subscription fee. Indicate # of transactions as units; if pricing varies by transaction, split into multiple expense lines by rate.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVOc.label: Minnesota District Court - Pipestone County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVOc.definition: Minnesota District Court - Pipestone County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Pipestone County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVPw.label: Legal System Types
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVPw.definition: Legal System Types refer to the various frameworks of laws, rules, and institutions that govern the legal processes and procedures within a jurisdiction. These systems encompass distinct traditions, principles, and methodologies that have evolved over time, influenced by cultural, religious, and historical factors.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVRr.label: Permanent Resident
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVRr.definition: A Permanent Resident is an individual who has been granted the right to live indefinitely within a country, typically after meeting certain eligibility criteria. In the United States, for example, this status is commonly referred to as having a "Green Card," and it grants the holder various rights and responsibilities, including the ability to work and reside in the country long-term, but does not confer citizenship.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVYB.label: Immigration Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVYB.definition: National statutes, and regulations governing immigration into and deportation from a country including issues of naturalization and citizenship.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVYE.label: Marathi
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVYE.definition: Marathi is a structured system of communication, consisting of grammar and vocabulary, used in legal matters, which is a subcategory of the Language class.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVYs.label: Privacy Agreements
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVYs.definition: A Privacy Related Agreement refers to a contract or clause that stipulates how personal data will be processed, protected, and maintained. It underscores the obligations of parties in relation to data privacy and compliance with privacy laws and regulations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVZJ.label: Fact Investigation and Development
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVZJ.definition: Fact Investigation and Development refers to the process of gathering and analyzing evidence and information related to a legal matter, including interviewing witnesses and experts, analyzing technical data, and assessing the validity of claims.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVaH.label: Copyright Assets
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVaH.definition: Copyright assets are a type of intellectual property asset that refers to the exclusive legal right to use and distribute original works of authorship, such as books, music, and software.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVb2.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Monroe County Circuit 1
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVb2.definition: The Indiana Circuit Court - Monroe County Circuit 1 is a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over cases in Monroe County.
english_labels: Indiana Circuit Court - Monroe County Circuit 1

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVbr.label: Leading Objection
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVbr.definition: An objection to a leading question is raised when a party in a legal proceeding believes that a question posed by the opposing counsel improperly suggests an answer to the witness. Leading questions are generally not allowed during direct examination but may be permitted during cross-examination.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVcK.label: Military Active Duty
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVcK.definition: "Military Active Duty" refers to a period during which individuals in the armed forces are in full-time service, actively engaged in their duties, and can be deployed at any time. This status contrasts with reserve or part-time duties and involves more direct involvement in military operations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVcQ.label: Affirmative Covenant
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVcQ.definition: An affirmative covenant is a legally binding promise made by one party to another to take specific actions or refrain from certain activities, as outlined in a contract or agreement, in order to fulfill a particular obligation or achieve a specific goal.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVd3.label: Indemnification from Person Ordering Tort
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVd3.definition: Indemnification from Person Ordering Tort: A legal concept that refers to the compensation or protection provided to a party who is held liable for a tortious act, but is entitled to be reimbursed by the person who ordered or directed the act.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVd5.label: General Discharge Under Honorable Conditions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVd5.definition: Often referred to simply as a General Discharge, this type indicates satisfactory service but the individual fell short of meeting all expectations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVep.label: Analysis of Cash Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVep.definition: Analysis of Cash Management: A process of examining and evaluating the flow and use of cash within an organization, including the identification of areas for improvement and the development of strategies to optimize cash management.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVig.label: Georgia District Court - Worth County
