https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVig.definition: Georgia District Court - Worth County: A specific court within the Georgia District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Worth County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVjX.label: Law Codified by Statute
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVjX.definition: Law Codified by Statute refers to legal rules and regulations that have been enacted by a legislative body and are binding and enforceable.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVmj.label: Failure to Exhaust Administrative Remedy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVmj.definition: The Failure to Exhaust Administrative Remedy is a legal defense in civil litigation where the plaintiff has not completed all required administrative procedures before filing a lawsuit.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVn3.label: Insurance Carrier Supplying Defense of Suit
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVn3.definition: An Insurance Carrier Supplying Defense of Suit is an insurance claim concept that refers to the situation where an insurance company provides legal defense to its policyholder in a lawsuit.
english_labels: Insurance Carrier Supplying Defence of Suit
Insurance Carrier Supplying Defense of Suit

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVor.label: War Clause Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVor.definition: A War Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a particular action or law exceeds the constitutional authority granted to the government in times of war. This claim is based on the interpretation that the War Clause, which grants Congress the power to declare war, also imposes limitations on the government's actions during war, such as the exercise of certain powers or the infringement of individual rights.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVoy.label: Debt Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVoy.definition: A Debt Agreement is a legally binding contract between a debtor and creditor(s) that outlines the terms and conditions for repayment of a debt, including any interest or fees.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVqw.label: Successor in Interest Petition
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVqw.definition: The I-140 Successor in Interest Petition is a process in the United States through which a new employer or entity assumes the sponsorship of an employment-based immigrant visa (green card) petition that was previously filed by a predecessor employer. This is relevant when the original petitioner goes out of business or undergoes a merger, acquisition, or other organizational change. The new employer or entity can file a Successor in Interest Petition to continue the green card process for the beneficiary (foreign worker) without starting the process anew, provided certain conditions are met.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVrG.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Clinton County (4th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Clinton County (4th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVs5.label: B410 General Bankruptcy Advice/Opinions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVs5.definition: Analysis, advice and/or opinions regarding potential bankruptcy related issues, where no bankruptcy case has been filed

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVu4.label: Population Density Market Segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVu4.definition: The population density market segment classifies consumers or businesses based on the density of people in their geographic area, such as urban, rural, or suburban regions. This segmentation helps businesses understand and address the varying needs, preferences, and purchasing behaviors of customers living in areas with different levels of population concentration.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVu6.label: B140 Relief from Stay/Adequate Protection Proceedings
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVu6.definition: Matters relating to termination or continuation of automatic stay under 362 and motions for adequate protection
english_labels: B140 Relief from Stay/Adequate Protection Proceedings

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVuA.label: Visa for Free Trade Agreement Professionals
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVuA.definition: A Free Trade Agreement (FTA) Professionals Visa is a type of visa that allows citizens of countries that have signed a free trade agreement with a particular country to work in that country under specific conditions. These visas often facilitate the movement of professionals such as businesspeople, traders, and certain skilled workers, aiming to promote economic cooperation and trade between the countries.
english_labels: Visa for Free Trade Agreement Professionals

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVuD.label: Product Misuse or Use Beyond Scope of Product
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVuD.definition: The concept of "Product Misuse or Use Beyond Scope of Product" refers to a defense in product liability cases where the defendant argues that the plaintiff's injury was caused by using the product in a way that was not intended or foreseeable by the manufacturer.
english_labels: Product Misuse or Use Beyond Scope of Product

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVub.label: Vaccine Negligence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVub.definition: Failure to provide proper care or attention in administering vaccines, resulting in harm or injury to the patient, and the legal claims that arise from such negligence.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVv0.label: Status - Denied
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVv0.definition: Status of "Denied" indicates that an application, request, or action has been reviewed and declined by the relevant authority, signaling that the individual's request or application did not meet the necessary criteria or legal requirements, resulting in a denial of the intended action, status change, or benefit.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVvp.label: Request for Budget
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVvp.definition: Document where a Buyer asks a Legal Services Provider for a budget.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVwR.label: Bankruptcy Chapter 12 Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVwR.definition: A Bankruptcy Chapter 12 Claim is a type of claim made in a bankruptcy case filed under Chapter 12 of the Bankruptcy Code, which provides relief to family farmers or fishermen.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVx9.label: Service of Document
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVx9.definition: The concept of "Service of Document" refers to the act of delivering legal documents to the parties involved in a litigation event.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVy4.label: B185 Assumption/Rejection of Leases and Contracts
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVy4.definition: Analysis of leases and executory contracts and preparation of motions specifically to assume or reject
english_labels: B185 Assumption/Rejection of Leases and Contracts

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVzV.label: Tax Form
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RVzV.definition: A Tax Form is a standardized document used to report financial information to taxation authorities. It is the primary means for individuals and organizations to file tax returns, claim deductions, and comply with tax laws.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RW06.label: Indemnification Provisions Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RW06.definition: A provision in a contract that requires one party to compensate the other for any losses or damages incurred as a result of the contract, typically related to legal claims or liabilities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RW4e.label: By Time with Blended Rate
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RW4e.definition: Engagement fee model where a client pays for the legal service provider's number of expended hours, but rather than paying for a person's individualized rate (e.g., partner's higher rate, associate's lower rate), the provider pays an average billable rate — regardless of which lawyer performs the work.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RW4m.label: disc_cred
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RW4m.definition: "The disc_credit field is used to track discounts and credits that the law firm may need to submit on the expense item. EIA - Expense Item Adjustment - A flat adjustment (reduction or credit) applied to the fee item EID - Expense Item Discount - client receives a percentage discount that is assessed at the expense item level EIDHR - Expense Item Discounted Hourly Rate - the discounted hourly rate or unit rate applied to the expense item EIFF - Expense Item is billed at a Flat Fee Other - Any other type of discount of credit applied to the line item "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RW5m.label: Undue Influence Over Testator or Settlor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RW5m.definition: The concept of "Undue Influence Over Testator or Settlor" refers to the situation where someone exerts pressure or control over a person creating a trust or will, causing them to make decisions that they would not have made otherwise.
english_labels: Undue Influence Over Testator or Settlor

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RW6L.label: Robust AI
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RW6L.definition: Robust AI refers to artificial intelligence systems that are both technically and socially resilient, designed to prevent unintentional harm. Technically robust AI systems are built to handle diverse conditions and adversarial attacks, while socially robust AI systems are designed to function ethically within societal contexts, ensuring safety, reliability, and fairness.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RW6n.label: Health Insurance Benefits
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RW6n.definition: Health insurance benefits refer to any medical coverage provided to employees as part of their compensation package, which pays for medical and surgical expenses incurred by the insured, often including preventive care and prescription medication.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RW7P.label: Budgeting Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RW7P.definition: Budgeting Management refers to the process of planning and controlling the financial resources of a business or organization within the legal industry.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RW86.label: Intervening Event - Known at Signing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RW86.definition: An Intervening Event - Known at Signing is a specific type of event that occurs after the signing of a legal agreement and has been anticipated by the parties involved.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RW94.label: Collaboration Platform Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RW94.definition: Collaboration Platform Management refers to the management of a system or software that enables individuals or groups to work together on a project or task, including the coordination of communication, data sharing, and workflow.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RW9F.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Gallatin County (2nd Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Gallatin County (2nd Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWBJ.label: Cornish
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWBJ.definition: Cornish (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a member of the Language top-level class.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWCG.label: Motion to Stay Proceedings Pending Appeal
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWCG.definition: A Motion to Stay Proceedings Pending Appeal is a request made to a court to pause legal proceedings until an appeal is resolved.
english_labels: Motion to Stay Proceedings Pending Appeal

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWEp.label: Arkansas District Court - Garland Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWEp.definition: A court located in Garland County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWGa.label: PA560 Validation Patent Application Preparation - International
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWGa.definition: All actions associated with the preparation and filing of applications for validation of an issued regional patent outside of the ('domestic') home country of the applicant. Note that PCT National Phase Entry is a continuing application process included under PA350 or PA550.
english_labels: PA560 Validation Patent Application Preparation - International

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWI3.label: Federal Rules of Appellate Procedure
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWI3.definition: U.S. federal courts' body of procedural rules governing appeals.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWIH.label: Three-fifths Clause Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWIH.definition: A Three-fifths Clause claim is a legal assertion tied to Article I, Section 2, Clause 3 of the U.S. Constitution, historically known as the Three-fifths Clause. This clause counted enslaved individuals as three-fifths of a person for purposes of representation and taxation, but it was effectively rendered obsolete by the Thirteenth Amendment, which abolished slavery.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWKI.label: Key Employee Incentive Program Motion
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWKI.definition: A Key Employee Incentive Program Motion (KEIP) is a request made in a bankruptcy case to provide incentives to key employees to remain with the company during the bankruptcy process.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWLK.label: Threatened Battery Assault
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWLK.definition: The concept of Threatened Battery Assault refers to a criminal assault where the perpetrator intentionally causes the victim to fear immediate bodily harm or offensive contact, without actually making physical contact.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWMC.label: Indiana Superior Court - Porter County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWMC.definition: Indiana Superior Court - Porter County refers to a specific court within the Indiana Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Porter County, Indiana.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWN8.label: Ohio Court of Common Pleas
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWN8.definition: The Ohio Court of Common Pleas is a specific court within the Ohio State Courts system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases at the county level.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWNA.label: Common Carrier Liability
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWNA.definition: Common Carrier Liability refers to the legal responsibility of transportation companies, such as railroads, trucking companies, and cruise ships, to ensure the safety of their passengers and cargo while in transit.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWNH.label: Tax Payment Event
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWNH.definition: A tax payment event refers to the specific occasion when an individual or entity remits payment to a tax authority to settle or reduce a tax liability.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWNZ.label: Docketing Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWNZ.definition: Docketing Management refers to the process of managing and tracking legal cases and their associated deadlines and events. It falls under the broader category of Litigation Management, which encompasses all aspects of managing a legal case from start to finish.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWO6.label: Private-run Pension Account
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWO6.definition: A private-run pension account is a retirement savings account managed by a private financial institution, such as a bank or investment firm. These accounts are typically funded by individual contributions and can offer various investment options.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWQ1.label: Undetermined
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWQ1.definition: A language that has not been identified or determined in the context of legal matters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWQD.label: Georgia Superior Court - Banks County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWQD.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Banks County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Banks County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWQJ.label: Query
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWQJ.definition: An FOLIO Query - A document fragment that can be used as a query against a database

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWQW.label: Arbitration Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWQW.definition: An arbitration clause is a provision in a contract that requires any disputes arising from the contract to be resolved through arbitration rather than through the court system.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWS7.label: Equitable Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWS7.definition: A claim that seeks fairness and justice, rather than a legal remedy, and is based on principles of equity and conscience.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWTt.label: X403 Hardware Costs
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWTt.definition: Any hardware purchased, including cell phones/PDAs/Blackberries; desktops/laptops/tablets; DVD/CD Drives; external hard drives; servers; USB drives or future technology hardware device. Excludes material costs for electronic media devices used to move a data collection in eDiscovery (X307).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWW9.label: Indiana Superior Court - Putnam County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWW9.definition: A court located in Putnam County, Indiana that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWY8.label: Drafting Drafting Notes
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWY8.definition: Drafting Notes are annotations made by writers and editors during the document drafting process. These notes often include comments, suggestions, and explanations to aid in the development and refinement of the document.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWYR.label: Chronic Soft Tissue Surgical Intervention
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWYR.definition: A soft tissue injury or abnormality under continuing surgical management involves damage or dysfunction affecting non-bone structures such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, or skin that requires ongoing surgical intervention. This management is aimed at repairing or reconstructing the damaged soft tissues and addressing any related complications or functional impairments.
english_labels: Soft Tissue Injury or Abnormality Under Continuing Surgical Management

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWYc.label: Double Trigger Acceleration Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWYc.definition: A Double Trigger Acceleration Clause is a provision in a contract that allows for the acceleration of vesting or payment of compensation upon the occurrence of two specified events, such as a change in control of a company and termination of employment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWaL.label: PA540 Plant Patent Preparation - International
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWaL.definition: All actions associated with completing plant patent applications that are to be filed outside the ('domestic') home country or region of the applicant, including translations, review of any invention disclosure materials or parent applications, drafting of application including pre-filing revision of parent applications, preparation and execution of formal documents (such as assignments, declarations, information disclosure statements, transmittals, and biological deposits) filing of application, and reporting to the client Note that government fees and other external expenses are included under E100.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWb1.label: Avoidance Action Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWb1.definition: Avoidance Action Practice refers to the legal work performed by a Legal Services Provider in the Bankruptcy and Financial Restructuring Practice area, which involves pursuing actions to recover assets or payments made by a debtor prior to filing for bankruptcy.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWbP.label: Motion to Postpone Settlement Conference
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWbP.definition: A Motion to Postpone Settlement Conference is a request made by one party in a legal case to delay the scheduled settlement conference to a later date.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWcN.label: Florida Circuit Court - Collier County - 20th Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWcN.definition: A court located in Collier County, Florida that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical area.
english_labels: Florida Circuit Court - Collier County - 20th Circuit Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWfJ.label: Disclosure Letter Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWfJ.definition: A Disclosure Letter Clause is a specific type of contractual clause that requires one party to provide the other party with a letter disclosing certain information related to the contract.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWfa.label: Medical Expert
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWfa.definition: A person who holds a health care professional degree from a university or college, who has engaged in the practice of that profession, and who has knowledge or skill about the subject upon which he is called to testify or provide an opinion. See Fla. Stat. § 766.202(5); Fort Walton Beach Medical Center, Inc. v. Dingler, 697 So.2d 575 (Fla. App. 1997).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWgC.label: Church Slavic; Old Slavonic; Church Slavonic; Old Bulgarian; Old Church Slavonic
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWgC.definition: A language used in the liturgy and religious texts of the Eastern Orthodox Church, based on Old Bulgarian and Old Macedonian.
english_labels: Church Slavic; Old Slavonic; Church Slavonic; Old Bulgarian; Old Church Slavonic

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWhD.label: Stakeholder
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWhD.definition: In project management, a person who has an interest in the project's outcome.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWiR.label: matter_perc_shar_exp
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWiR.definition: "MATTER_DISC_CRED.disc_cred_percent where MATTER_DISC_CRED.disc_credit_type equals ""Percent"" and MATTER_DISC_CRED.disc_credit_category equals ""Exp"" and MATTER_DISC_CRED.disc_cred equals ""MISF"" "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWlW.label: Motion to Amend Schedules
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWlW.definition: A Motion to Amend Schedules is a formal request made in bankruptcy proceedings by a debtor seeking to modify previously filed schedules of assets, liabilities, income, expenses, or other financial statements. This motion is typically necessary when new information becomes available or errors are discovered in the original filings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWrc.label: Konkani
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWrc.definition: Konkani is a written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a specific language within the context of legal matters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWrt.label: XLS
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWrt.definition: A Microsoft Excel spreadsheet file from Microsoft Office 2003 or earlier.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWsi.label: Intestinal Failure
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWsi.definition: Intestinal failure is a condition where the intestines are unable to absorb sufficient nutrients and fluids to maintain health, often due to severe functional or structural abnormalities. This condition can result from diseases or surgical interventions that significantly impair the digestive tract's ability to process and absorb essential nutrients, requiring interventions such as total parenteral nutrition (TPN) or enteral nutrition support.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWtK.label: Waiver and Release Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWtK.definition: A waiver and release clause is a provision in a contract that releases a party from liability for certain actions or events, and waives the right to pursue legal action related to those actions or events.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWuB.label: Cancers of the Female Genital Tract
english_labels: Cancers of the Female Genital Tract

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWuv.label: Proper Cause Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWuv.definition: A Proper Cause Clause is a specific type of clause found within a contractual agreement that outlines the acceptable reasons for terminating the contract.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWvg.label: oasis:Roles
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWvg.definition: A group or set of responsibilities or functions assigned to a person or entity within the context of the OASIS Collection.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWwZ.label: E114 Witness fees
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWwZ.definition: A witness fee is a type of expense incurred in legal proceedings, specifically referring to the compensation paid to a person who testifies as a witness.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWwp.label: Motion to Determine Final Cure and Mortgage Payment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWwp.definition: A Motion to Determine Final Cure and Mortgage Payment is a legal request made in a bankruptcy case to determine the final amount needed to pay off a mortgage and bring it current.
english_labels: Motion to Determine Final Cure and Mortgage Payment

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWyi.label: Quasi-Contract Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWyi.definition: A quasi-contract claim is a legal claim that arises when one party receives a benefit from another party, even though there was no actual contract between them, and the law implies a promise to pay for that benefit.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWyy.label: Quarterly Report
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWyy.definition: A Quarterly Report is a financial report issued by a company every three months to provide an update on its earnings, expenses, and net income. It is required by securities regulators and is aimed at investors and analysts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWzW.label: Georgia Superior Court - Bartow County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RWzW.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Bartow County, Georgia, with authority over civil and criminal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RX1C.label: M&A G Shareholder / Board Matters Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RX1C.definition: A legal practice area that deals with matters related to shareholders and the board of directors in the context of mergers and acquisitions.
english_labels: M&A G Shareholder / Board Matters Practice

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RX4I.label: Overtime Violation Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RX4I.definition: An overtime violation claim is a legal action initiated by an employee against their employer for not properly compensating them for overtime work. The claim typically arises when an employer does not comply with applicable federal, state, or local overtime laws, which require employers to pay eligible employees at a higher rate for any hours worked beyond a certain number per week or per day. The claim can include allegations of employers failing to pay the required overtime rate, miscalculating the employee's overtime pay, or not properly tracking the employee's overtime hours.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RX4Q.label: Estimated, Budgeted, and Actual Engagement Variables
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RX4Q.definition: Quantitative amounts used to create and monitor budgets
english_labels: Estimated, Budgeted, and Actual Engagement Variables

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RX6z.label: C400 Third Party Communication
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RX6z.definition: This phase includes all discussions with third parties not otherwise covered above, such as communications with regulators or parties to contracts with the client.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RX7L.label: New Jersey Prerogative Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RX7L.definition: A New Jersey Prerogative Court is a specialized court within the New Jersey State Courts system that has jurisdiction over appeals of administrative agency decisions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RX8z.label: Buying Stolen Property
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RX8z.definition: The act of purchasing property that has been unlawfully taken, with knowledge of its illegal origin.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXAC.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Lea County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXAC.definition: A court located in Lea County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases.
english_labels: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Lea County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXAO.label: Due Diligence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXAO.definition: Due Diligence is the process of conducting a thorough investigation and analysis of a company or business before a merger or acquisition takes place.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXCe.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Hendricks County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXCe.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that hears civil and criminal cases within Hendricks County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXDx.label: Venue Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXDx.definition: A Venue Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the location or jurisdiction where any legal disputes arising from the contract will be resolved.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXEK.label: Mediation Event
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXEK.definition: A Mediation Event is a specific type of Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) Event that involves a neutral third party facilitating communication and negotiation between parties in conflict, with the goal of reaching a mutually acceptable resolution.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXGV.label: Kalmyk; Oirat
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXGV.definition: A language spoken by the Kalmyk people, a Mongolic ethnic group, and the Oirat people, a group of Mongolian and Turkic peoples.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXGz.label: Waiver of Service of Summons
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXGz.definition: A waiver of service of summons is a legal document that allows a defendant to waive their right to be formally served with a summons and complaint, thereby expediting the legal process.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXHQ.label: L619 Quality assurance and control
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXHQ.definition: Activities and actions related to ensuring that the process and practices used to perform analysis meet an acceptable level of defensibility.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXJQ.label: A127 Project Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXJQ.definition: Discovery or eDiscovery project management services, including budgeting and case assessment of the project and quality assurance and control. Excludes legal project management of a matter.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXLA.label: Litigation Finance Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXLA.definition: Litigation finance management refers to the process of managing the financial aspects of a legal case, including funding, budgeting, and accounting, in order to maximize the potential return on investment for the parties involved.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXMz.label: inv_due_date
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXMz.definition: "The law firm assigned date by which the invoice is due to be paid by the client. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXND.label: Part-Time Employee
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXND.definition: A Part-Time Employee is an individual who works fewer hours per week than what is considered full-time by their employer or by labor laws. While part-time employees may have more flexible schedules, they often have limited or no access to benefits like health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXO2.label: Arbitration Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXO2.definition: Arbitration, a form of alternative dispute resolution (ADR), is a way to resolve disputes outside the courts. The dispute will be decided by one or more persons (the "arbitrators", "arbiters" or "arbitral tribunal"), which renders the "arbitration award".

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXOd.label: Dissolution for Oppression
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXOd.definition: The concept of "Dissolution for Oppression" refers to a legal claim made by shareholders or partners against a corporation or partnership alleging that the majority shareholders or partners have acted oppressively towards the minority, resulting in the dissolution of the entity.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXQT.label: Motion for New Trial - Improper Jury Deliberations
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXQT.definition: A Motion for New Trial - Improper Jury Deliberations is a legal request made by a party to a case asking the court to set aside the verdict and order a new trial due to improper conduct during jury deliberations.
english_labels: Motion for New Trial - Improper Jury Deliberations

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXQn.label: Approval Signatures Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXQn.definition: An Approval Signatures Clause is a provision in a contract that requires the parties to sign and approve the agreement in order for it to be legally binding.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXSQ.label: Bankruptcy and Restructuring Objectives
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXSQ.definition: Bankruptcy and Restructuring Objectives refer to the specific aims, goals, plans, and intentions that are constructed by a party in a legal matter related to bankruptcy and restructuring, including the protection of property from damage, rebuttal of presumption of undue hardship, and avoidance action claims.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXST.label: Child Dependency Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXST.definition: Child Dependency Court refers to a specialized court that deals with cases involving children who have been removed from their homes due to abuse or neglect, and determines their custody and care arrangements.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXTV.label: Romany
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXTV.definition: Romany (Language) is a structured system of communication used by the Romani people, consisting of grammar and vocabulary specific to their culture and traditions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXUB.label: Originating Country
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXUB.definition: Destination Country, in the context of immigration, refers to the country to which an individual is moving or has moved, with the intention of residing there either temporarily or permanently. The destination country's immigration laws and policies determine eligibility for entry, length of stay, and other rights or obligations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXUZ.label: Georgia Superior Court - Grady County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXUZ.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Grady County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXUk.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Monroe County Circuit 8
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXUk.definition: The Indiana Circuit Court - Monroe County Circuit 8 is a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Monroe County.
english_labels: Indiana Circuit Court - Monroe County Circuit 8

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXWE.label: oasis:Times
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXWE.definition: A collection of documents or resources related to time, as defined by the OASIS organization.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXWF.label: L670 Production (NOS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXWF.definition: "NOS" = Not Otherwise Specified (catch-all, includes the subcategories). Primarily charges on a per GB, per custodian. or a flat/fixed fee basis.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXXp.label: Capitalized Terms Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXXp.definition: A Capitalized Terms Clause is a specific clause within a contract that identifies and defines capitalized terms used throughout the contract.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXYs.label: Knowledge Management Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXYs.definition: Knowledge Management Services refers to professional services that involve the strategic management of an organization's knowledge resources, including the creation, sharing, and utilization of knowledge assets, and are provided by consultants or managers.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXbt.label: Motion to Certify Appealability
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXbt.definition: A Motion to Certify Appealability is a formal request made to an appellate court to determine whether an appeal can be pursued, typically in cases where the lower court has denied the appeal.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXeH.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Potter County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXeH.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Potter County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings at the county level in Pennsylvania.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Potter County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXfD.label: Exhaustion of Remedies
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXfD.definition: Exhaustion of remedies refers to the legal principle that a litigant must have pursued and used up all available administrative or legal remedies before seeking judicial review. This requirement ensures that the appropriate administrative or lower court authority has had the opportunity to correct its own errors before higher-level intervention is sought

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXfX.label: New York City Court - Mt. Vernon
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXfX.definition: A court located in Mt. Vernon, New York that operates under the jurisdiction of the New York City Court.
english_labels: New York City Court - Mt. Vernon

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXgl.label: Workers Compensation Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXgl.definition: Law addressing wage replacement and medical benefits to employees injured in the course of employment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXhR.label: Homeowners Association Forclosure
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXhR.definition: Homeowners Association Foreclosure is the legal process by which a Homeowners Association (HOA) takes possession of a property within its jurisdiction due to the homeowner's failure to pay association fees or fines. The property is subsequently sold to satisfy the outstanding debt, and the process is governed by state laws and the HOA's governing documents.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXiz.label: Turnkey Project Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXiz.definition: A turnkey project clause is a provision in a contract that requires the contractor to complete the project and deliver it to the client in a fully operational state, with all necessary components and systems in place.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXjD.label: Definition of Net Profits Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXjD.definition: A Net Profits Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies how profits will be calculated and distributed among parties involved, after deducting expenses and taxes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXm7.label: extend_data segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXm7.definition: "The EXTEND_DATA segment is the child of EXTEND_HEADER segment. There will be 1 or more EXTEND_DATA segments per EXTEND_HEADER. It is not intended that the EXTEND_DATA include a file_item_nbr. Note that the data definition in this segment is for readability and not formatting. The EXTEND_DATA elements, ext_name and ext_value appear on the same line, the former as the XML field tag and the latter as the field value, in the EXTEND_HEADER segment. Each EXTEND_DATA segment may contain multiple rows of data that extend the applicable segment. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXnl.label: Management Committee
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXnl.definition: A Management Committee typically oversees the daily operations of an organization, managing broader aspects than those typically handled by an executive committee. This committee is often composed of senior managers across different departments and is responsible for implementing the strategic decisions made by the board or executive committee.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXnz.label: New York District Court - Nassau County - 3rd District
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXnz.definition: New York District Court - Nassau County (3d Dist.) is a specific court within the New York District Court system, located in Nassau County and designated as the third district.
english_labels: New York District Court - Nassau County - 3rd District

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXp0.label: Responses to Interrogatories
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXp0.definition: Responses to Interrogatories are written answers to a set of questions posed by one party to another during the discovery phase of a legal proceeding.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXp8.label: New York Supreme Court - Kings County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXp8.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Kings County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Brooklyn, New York, with authority to hear both civil and criminal cases.
english_labels: New York Supreme Court - Kings County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXqU.label: Florida County Court - Pasco County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXqU.definition: A court located in Pasco County, Florida that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXsX.label: Relative Sponsorship Request
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXsX.definition: The Relative Sponsorship Request (in the U.S., I-130 Petition), is the initial step in the process of sponsoring a family member for a family-based immigrant visa (in the U.S., a Green Card). In the United States, the petitioner, typically a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident, files Form I-130 with U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) to establish the qualifying relationship with the intending immigrant relative. Once the I-130 petition is approved, the sponsored relative can proceed with the green card application process, which often involves waiting for a visa number to become available in the appropriate family preference category.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXtq.label: Customs Recordal Process
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXtq.definition: Customs recordal is a legal mechanism that allows intellectual property rights holders to register their trademarks or other IP rights with customs authorities. This registration enables customs officials to monitor and detain shipments that may contain counterfeit or infringing goods.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXul.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Saline County (1st Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Saline County (1st Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXvy.label: Groundwater Rights
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXvy.definition: Groundwater rights concern the use of water that exists beneath the surface of the land, often in underground reservoirs or aquifers. Regulations and allocations vary by region and can depend on factors like recharge rates and overall availability.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXwl.label: Client Identification Detail
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXwl.definition: Client Identification Detail refers to specific information about a client, such as their organizational unit, business manager, internal counsel, ID, practice group, administrator, tax ID, and name, which is used for invoicing and identifying the legal services buyer.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXx1.label: Pleadings
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXx1.definition: Pleadings are formal written documents submitted to a court that outline the claims and defenses of parties involved in a legal dispute.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXyp.label: Pattern or Practice Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RXyp.definition: A "Pattern or Practice Claim" refers to a legal claim alleging that a defendant has engaged in a systematic and repeated pattern of discriminatory or unlawful behavior, rather than isolated incidents. This concept is often used in civil rights and employment law cases. In the U.S., these claims are brought under laws like Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, where the claimant must demonstrate that the defendant's actions were not random or isolated but were part of a consistent and regular practice of discrimination or illegal conduct.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RY1T.label: B250 Real Estate
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RY1T.definition: Review and analysis of real estate-related matters, including purchase agreements and lease provisions (e.g., common area maintenance clauses).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RY4T.label: X125 ATE Premiums/Insurance
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RY4T.definition: The cost of ATE (After the Event) Insurance to indemnify legal costs in the event the litigation or arbitration is unsuccessful

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RY5t.label: PA260 Infringement Investigation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RY5t.definition: All actions associated with determining which of a client's patent claims may cover a non-client's products or processes, including collecting patent and/or product information, obtaining any product samples, comparing the products to the client's patent claims, and reporting the results to the client. Work of outside vendors, such as private investigators, in assisting the investigation should be an expense under E100. Any formal infringement opinion should be prepared separately under PA710, including any formal documentation that is to be used in order to support a complaint for patent infringement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RY5u.label: Alternative Dispute Resolution Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RY5u.definition: Alternative Dispute Resolution Management refers to the process of resolving legal disputes outside of the traditional court system, such as through mediation or arbitration, and involves managing the various stages of the ADR process.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RY7O.label: Security Safeguards Principle
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RY7O.definition: Security safeguards is the privacy principle that data should be protected by reasonable security safeguards against such risks as loss or unauthorized access, destruction, use, modification or disclosure of data.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYBY.label: New York Supreme Court - Onondaga County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYBY.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Onondaga County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Onondaga County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal disputes within its geographical jurisdiction.
english_labels: New York Supreme Court - Onondaga County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYJo.label: X301 Discovery/eDiscovery Collection-Third Party
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYJo.definition: Any costs associated with the retrieval of collection materials from a third party when billed as an expense instead of a service

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYJs.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Benton County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYJs.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Benton County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Benton County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYKG.label: Campo Band of Diegueno Mission Indians
english_labels: Campo Band of Diegueno Mission Indians

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYNZ.label: License Back Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYNZ.definition: A License Back Clause is a clause in a contract that grants the licensor the right to use any modifications or improvements made by the licensee to the licensed technology or intellectual property.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYOW.label: Indiana Superior Court - Pulaski County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYOW.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that has the power to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases, located specifically in Pulaski County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYPD.label: Lien Waiver Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYPD.definition: A lien waiver clause is a provision in a contract that requires one party to waive their right to place a lien on the property of another party in exchange for payment or other consideration.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYQS.label: Tribal Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYQS.definition: A Tribal Court is a specialized court established by Indigenous communities to handle legal matters within their jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYQt.label: Operating / Promoting / Assisting Gambling
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYQt.definition: To unlawfully operate, promote, or assist in the operation of a game of chance, lottery, or other gambling activity

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYR2.label: National Origin Discrimination
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYR2.definition: Discrimination based on a person's country of origin or ancestry, which is prohibited by law in various jurisdictions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYRL.label: AAA Optional Appellate Arbitration Rules
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYRL.definition: The AAA Optional Appellate Arbitration Rules are a set of rules created by the American Arbitration Association that parties can choose to use in their arbitration agreement to provide for an optional appeal process.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYS2.label: Toxic Tort Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYS2.definition: A toxic tort claim arises when an individual alleges harm due to exposure to a toxic substance. This claim seeks compensation for injuries caused by chemicals, pollutants, or other hazardous materials.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYSa.label: Seat Belt Violation Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYSa.definition: A Seat Belt Violation Claim involves allegations that a driver or passenger has failed to wear a seat belt as required by law, posing a risk to their safety and violating traffic safety regulations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYSc.label: Removal of Personal Property Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYSc.definition: A Removal of Personal Property Clause is a provision in a contract that allows one party to take possession of another party's personal property in certain circumstances.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYVE.label: Resource Management Risk
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYVE.definition: The threats and opportunities associated with the availability and level of resources of an organization to deliver on its mandate, as well as the organization's management of these resources. This risk can arise from an organization's inefficient or ineffective allocation and utilization of its available resources, such as personnel, capital, or physical assets. This can result from poor planning, misaligned priorities, or inadequate controls, potentially leading to operational inefficiencies, increased costs, or unmet objectives, ultimately impacting the organization's overall performance and sustainability

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYWT.label: ext_value
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYWT.definition: "Used to provide the value of the variable. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYWW.label: rate
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYWW.definition: "The timekeeper rate for this line item. E.g. ""120.0000"", or the fixed rate for the item. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYWw.label: DEPRECATED Debtor’s Fraudulent Conveyance
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYWw.definition: Deprecated in favor of Fraudulent Transfer

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYXl.label: Personal Jurisdiction by National Personal Jurisdiction
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYXl.definition: The concept of "Personal Jurisdiction by National Personal Jurisdiction" refers to the authority of a court to hear a case based on a defendant's presence or activities within the country's borders, as opposed to other bases for personal jurisdiction such as consent or minimum contacts.
english_labels: Personal Jurisdiction by National Personal Jurisdiction

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYXu.label: Negligent Security on Property
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYXu.definition: Negligent Security on Property refers to a legal claim that arises when a property owner fails to provide adequate security measures, resulting in harm or injury to a person on the property.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYbj.label: Avoidant Personality Disorder
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYbj.definition: Avoidant Personality Disorder is characterized by a pervasive pattern of social inhibition, feelings of inadequacy, and hypersensitivity to negative evaluation. Individuals with this disorder typically avoid occupational activities involving significant interpersonal contact due to fears of criticism, disapproval, or rejection.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYcl.label: Motion to Adjourn Settlement Conference
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYcl.definition: A Motion to Adjourn Settlement Conference is a request made by one party to postpone or reschedule a meeting between parties aimed at resolving a legal dispute.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYd9.label: Call Right Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYd9.definition: A Call Right Clause is a provision in a contract that grants one party the right to purchase an asset or security at a specified price within a certain time frame.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYdD.label: Agriculture Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYdD.definition: Agriculture Law refers to the collection of laws and regulations that govern activities related to farming and agribusiness. It covers a broad range of matters such as land use, environmental protection, labor laws, food production and safety, animal welfare, and international trade of agricultural products.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYeh.label: Pocket Picking Theft
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYeh.definition: The theft of articles from another person’s physical possession by stealth where the victim usually does not become immediately aware of the theft.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYfC.label: Townhouse
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYfC.definition: A Townhouse is a multi-story residential building that shares one or more walls with adjacent units, featuring individual entrances and often private outdoor spaces such as a patio or garden. Townhouses are typically part of a planned community or row, offering a blend of urban living and private homeownership.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYhd.label: JK00 Trial preparation (UK J-CODE)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYhd.definition: Work for the preparation of the trial not included in the other phases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYiN.label: B150 Meetings of and Communications with Creditors
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYiN.definition: Preparing for and attending the conference of creditors, the 341(a) meeting and other creditors' committee meetings
english_labels: B150 Meetings of and Communications with Creditors

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYiy.label: Trial Preparation Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYiy.definition: Trial Preparation Management refers to the process of organizing and managing the various tasks and activities involved in preparing for a trial, including gathering evidence, interviewing witnesses, and developing legal strategies.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYjA.label: Squaxin Island Tribe of the Squaxin Island Reservation, Washington
english_labels: Squaxin Island Tribe of the Squaxin Island Reservation, Washington

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYlO.label: Upon Death Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYlO.definition: An "Upon Death Clause" is a provision in a contract that specifies what will happen to the contract or its subject matter upon the death of one of the parties involved.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYnK.label: Invoice ID
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYnK.definition: A unique identifier assigned to a specific invoice for legal services rendered, used for tracking and payment purposes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYnn.label: Recklessness
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYnn.definition: Recklessness is a legal concept that refers to a state of mind in which a person knowingly takes an unjustifiable risk that results in harm to another person or property.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYoI.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Rio Arriba County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYoI.definition: A court located in Rio Arriba County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases.
english_labels: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Rio Arriba County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYop.label: Subtenant Liable to Landlord for Rent
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYop.definition: A subtenant who occupies a rental property is responsible for paying rent to the landlord, even if the subtenant has an agreement with the primary tenant to pay rent to them instead.
english_labels: Subtenant Liable to Landlord for Rent

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYpF.label: Cachil Dehe Band of Wintun Indians of the Colusa Rancheria
english_labels: Cachil Dehe Band of Wintun Indians of the Colusa Rancheria

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYqn.label: Advertisement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYqn.definition: An Advertisement, as a type of copyright asset, is a creative work designed to promote products, services, or ideas, protected under copyright law. This includes various forms of media such as print, digital, audio, and visual content, ensuring exclusive rights to the creator or owner against unauthorized use.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYtU.label: Maine Supreme Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYtU.definition: The Maine Supreme Court is the highest court in the state of Maine and serves as the final court of appeal for legal cases within the state's judicial system.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYtz.label: Failure to Disperse
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYtz.definition: The Failure to Disperse is a type of crime against the public that involves the refusal or failure to leave a public area when ordered to do so by law enforcement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYvO.label: Social Worker Privilege
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYvO.definition: A legal protection that allows social workers to keep confidential any information obtained during their professional interactions with clients, unless there is a legal obligation to disclose such information.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYyE.label: Royalty Payment Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYyE.definition: A royalty payment clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the terms and conditions for payment of royalties, which are payments made to the owner of a property or asset for its use or exploitation by another party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYyg.label: United Keetoowah Band of Cherokee Indians in Oklahoma
english_labels: United Keetoowah Band of Cherokee Indians in Oklahoma

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYzJ.label: Unlawful Warrant Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYzJ.definition: An unlawful warrant claim is a legal assertion that a search or arrest warrant was issued without proper justification or did not meet the required legal standards, thereby violating an individual's constitutional rights.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RYzM.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Shelby County (4th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Shelby County (4th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZ0c.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Christian County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZ0c.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Christian County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Christian County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZ1d.label: Contract & Quasi-Contract Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZ1d.definition: Contract & Quasi-Contract Claims refer to legal claims arising from the breach of a contract or an agreement that is not legally binding, but where one party has received a benefit that would be unjust to retain without compensation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZ2y.label: Service Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZ2y.definition: A Service Agreement is a written document that outlines the terms and conditions of a service provided by one party to another.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZ4b.label: Cats
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZ4b.definition: Cats are domesticated mammals belonging to the species Felis catus, known for their agility, independence, and hunting skills. They serve primarily as companions and pest controllers, and come in a wide variety of breeds with distinct physical and behavioral traits.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZ6h.label: Age-Based Market Segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZ6h.definition: Age-based market segments refer to divisions of the market that are categorized based on the age of consumers. These segments allow businesses to tailor their products, services, and marketing strategies to specific age groups, taking into account their unique preferences, lifestyles, and purchasing behaviors.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZ73.label: Paint and Wallpaper Retailers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZ73.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing paint, wallpaper, and related supplies.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZ82.label: A103 Draft/revise
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZ82.definition: The concept of "A103 Draft/revise" refers to the specific activity of creating or modifying a preliminary or final written document, such as a contract or agreement, as part of a larger set of legal activities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZ8w.label: Indian Child Welfare Act Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZ8w.definition: A claim made under the Indian Child Welfare Act (ICWA), which provides specific protections for Native American children in custody and visitation cases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZ96.label: Vision Insurance Benefits
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZ96.definition: Vision insurance benefits are a form of insurance provided to employees that covers expenses related to eye health, including eye exams, prescription eyewear, and sometimes corrective surgeries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZAA.label: Ownership Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZAA.definition: An Ownership Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies who has the legal right to own and control a particular work product or information.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZBG.label: Secured Creditor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZBG.definition: A secured creditor is any creditor or lender associated with an investment in or issuance of a credit product backed by collateral. Secured creditors have a first-order claim on the payouts of a distressed credit investment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZCE.label: DEPRECATED: M&A Buyer (in favor of Acquiror)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZCE.definition: A M&A Buyer is a person or entity that acquires another company or business through a merger or acquisition, and can be classified as a Strategic Buyer, Financial Sponsor, or Management.
english_labels: DEPRECATED: M&A Buyer (in favor of Acquiror)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZCJ.label: Critical Care Malpractice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZCJ.definition: Negligence or wrongdoing by a medical professional or facility in the treatment of a critically ill patient, resulting in harm or injury.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZDs.label: Entry of Default Judgment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZDs.definition: The Entry of Default Judgment is a legal concept that refers to a court's decision to enter a judgment against a party who has failed to appear or respond to a lawsuit.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZEC.label: L660 Analysis (NOS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZEC.definition: "NOS" = Not Otherwise Specified (catch-all, includes the subcategories). Activities and actions required by litigation teams to be able to make informed decisions about strategy and scope through reliable methods based on verified data. Primarily hourly charges.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZEq.label: Forcible Entry and Detainer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZEq.definition: The concept of Forcible Entry and Detainer refers to the illegal act of entering and taking possession of someone else's property without their consent, and the legal actions that can be taken to remove the trespasser and regain possession of the property.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZFe.label: Restraint of Assets
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZFe.definition: A restraint of assets is a legal concept within matrimonial emergency applications that involves preventing one party from disposing of or transferring their assets in order to preserve them for equitable distribution in a divorce settlement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZFm.label: E101 Copying
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZFm.definition: The act of making a reproduction of a document or other material, typically for the purpose of retaining a record or for distribution to others, which is categorized as an expense.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZGf.label: Financing Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZGf.definition: Agreements to finance a business or other entity.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZJZ.label: Head of State or Government
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZJZ.definition: The Head of State or Government is the highest-ranking official in a country, responsible for either ceremonial duties, executive powers, or both, depending on the form of government. In some countries, the roles of Head of State and Head of Government are separate, with the former often being a monarch or president and the latter usually being a prime minister or chancellor.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZK6.label: TR770 Quasi-Judicial Administrative Proceedings - Domain Names
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZK6.definition: All action associated with completing a quasi-judicial proceeding before an administrative tribunal associated with domain name enforcement actions, including Uniform Domain Name Dispute Resolution (UDRP) actions administered under ICANN and WIPO. Note that governmental fees and external expenses (or "disbursements") are included under E100. This code set is for quasijudicial proceedings only, and any subsequent work completed in a contested matter (i.e. filing complaint or appeal to a national court of jurisdiction) would be expensed under general litigation codes.
english_labels: TR770 Quasi-Judicial Administrative Proceedings - Domain Names

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZL_.label: WC380 Alternative Fee Arrangements
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZL_.definition: This code includes all non-hourly or other alternative fee arrangements for tasks and activities in this phase.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZPc.label: Cargo Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZPc.definition: A cargo claim is a legal action related to the loss or damage of goods during maritime transportation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZPq.label: Advance Parole Application
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZPq.definition: The Advance Parole application, commonly submitted on Form I-131 in the United States, allows certain individuals with pending applications for adjustment of status (green card) to travel outside the country and return without abandoning their application. This is particularly important for individuals who have applied for a green card and want to travel before their green card is approved to avoid potential issues with re-entry. Advance Parole is also used by individuals with certain immigration statuses (like DACA recipients) to seek permission to travel internationally while maintaining their legal status

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZQe.label: Invoice Payment Terms
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZQe.definition: Invoice Payment Terms refer to the specific conditions and requirements for payment of a legal fee invoice.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZSI.label: Modification of Agreement Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZSI.definition: A Modification of Agreement Clause is a provision in a contract that allows the parties to change or amend the terms of the agreement after it has been executed.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZUS.label: Term Sheet
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZUS.definition: A Term Sheet is a document that outlines the basic terms and conditions under which an investment or significant transaction will be made. It serves as a blueprint for subsequent, more detailed legal agreements. Term Sheets can be binding or non-binding and may include other, significant legal provisions such as non-complete language, no-shop clauses, liquidated damages, etc.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZV8.label: Burt Lake Band of Ottawa and Chippewa Indians
english_labels: Burt Lake Band of Ottawa and Chippewa Indians

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZVX.label: Liability Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZVX.definition: A Liability Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the responsibility of one party to compensate the other party for any losses or damages incurred as a result of a breach of the contract.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZXG.label: Right to Sublet Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZXG.definition: The Right to Sublet Clause is a provision in a contract that grants the tenant the legal right to sublet the property to another person for a specified period of time.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZXp.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Newton County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZXp.definition: The Indiana Circuit Court - Newton County is a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Newton County, Indiana.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZYX.label: Real Estate Commission
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZYX.definition: A real estate commission is a fee paid to real estate agents or brokers for their services in facilitating the sale or purchase of property. It is typically a percentage of the final sale price and compensates the agent for their efforts in marketing, negotiating, and closing the real estate transaction

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZZl.label: Headings Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZZl.definition: A headings clause is a specific type of contractual clause that provides a title or label for each section of a legal document.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZbe.label: Motion for New Trial - Improper Jury Instructions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZbe.definition: A Motion for New Trial - Improper Jury Instructions is a legal request made by a party to a case asking the court to set aside the verdict and order a new trial due to errors or mistakes made by the judge in instructing the jury during the trial.
english_labels: Motion for New Trial - Improper Jury Instructions

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZeq.label: WC350 Discovery Motions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZeq.definition: Preparing/responding to/arguing motions that arise from discovery, Review order ruling on motion, Preparing summary of tribunal order

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZg6.label: Circle Up Automation Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZg6.definition: Circle Up Automation Management is a concept related to the Legal Point Solutions ontology, which likely refers to the use of automated tools and processes to manage legal tasks and workflows.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZgF.label: Assignment by Lessor Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZgF.definition: An Assignment by Lessor Clause is a provision in a contract that allows the lessor to transfer their rights and obligations to a third party, typically the lessee, without the need for the lessee's consent.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZh6.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Butler County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZh6.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Butler County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in the state of Pennsylvania.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Butler County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZhK.label: New York City Court - Utica
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZhK.definition: A court located in Utica, New York that is part of the New York City Court system.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZhM.label: Rent Implied by Tenant's Occupation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZhM.definition: A legal concept where a tenant is obligated to pay rent to the landlord, even if there is no written agreement, because the tenant is occupying the landlord's property.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZhw.label: Savings Account
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZhw.definition: A savings account is a deposit account held at a financial institution that provides a modest interest rate. It is primarily used for the safekeeping of money and often has limitations on the number and types of withdrawals that can be made.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZis.label: L100 Case Assessment, Development and Administration
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZis.definition: L100 Case Assessment, Development and Administration refers to the process of evaluating and managing a legal case, including conducting factual investigations, analyzing legal strategies, managing documents and files, and engaging experts or consultants.
english_labels: L100 Case Assessment, Development and Administration

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZm4.label: Child Custody Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZm4.definition: A Child Custody Claim is a legal action brought by a parent seeking to obtain custody of their child, which falls under the broader category of Custody and Visitation Claims.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZoj.label: Georgia Superior Court - Lincoln County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZoj.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Lincoln County is a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases in Lincoln County, Georgia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZpX.label: Idea Misappropriation - Contract Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZpX.definition: The wrongful taking or use of another's idea or concept, specifically in the context of a breach of contract claim.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZq4.label: X123 Publication Costs
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZq4.definition: Any fees associated with publishing an official notice on the matter as required by statute. Excludes electronic or bound resource material purchased for use as a reference (X124) or legal research service costs (X111).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZqH.label: Writ of Garnishment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZqH.definition: A Writ of Garnishment is a legal mechanism whereby a court orders a third party to withhold funds they owe to the debtor and to direct the payment to the creditor instead. It's commonly used to collect on a judgment by seizing wages, bank account funds, or other assets that are in the hands of someone other than the debtor.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZri.label: Capital Gains
english_labels: Capital Gains refer to the profit realized from the sale or exchange of an asset that has increased in value. This gain is the difference between the purchase price (or basis) of the asset and its selling price, and it is typically subject to taxation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZsG.label: Motion Picture and Video Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZsG.definition: The Motion Picture and Video Industry is a branch of the Recording Industry that involves the production and distribution of films and videos for entertainment or educational purposes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZsT.label: Clinic Malpractice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZsT.definition: Clinic Malpractice refers to a type of medical malpractice claim that arises from negligent actions or omissions by healthcare providers in a clinic setting.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZsf.label: Motion to Compel Supplementation of Excerpts of Record
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZsf.definition: A Motion to Compel Supplementation of Excerpts of Record is a legal request to require additional information to be added to a previously submitted record or evidence.
english_labels: Motion to Compel Supplementation of Excerpts of Record

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZt6.label: Visa for Artist or Entertainer in a Reciprocal Exchange Program
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZt6.definition: This visa (in the U.S., the P-2 visa) is designed for artists or entertainers who will perform as part of a reciprocal exchange program between an organization in the destination country (e.g., U.S.) and an organization in another country. In the United States, the P-2 visa allows for a temporary stay tied to the duration of the specific performance or event, generally for a period of up to one year, with options for extension
english_labels: Visa for Artist or Entertainer in a Reciprocal Exchange Program

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZzN.label: Georgia Superior Court - Evans County
