https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZzN.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Evans County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Evans County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R_MG.label: Motor Vehicle Electrical and Electronic Equipment Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R_MG.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing and/or rebuilding electrical and electronic equipment for motor vehicles and internal combustion engines. The products made can be used for all types of transportation equipment (i.e., aircraft, automobiles, trucks, trains, ships) or stationary internal combustion engine applications.
english_labels: Motor Vehicle Electrical and Electronic Equipment Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R_OV.label: A112 Billable Travel Time
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R_OV.definition: Travel time billed by the timekeeper when other billable services are not performed for the client. Includes time spent waiting for a calendar/court call or other scheduled out-of-office event associated with the matter when other billable services are not performed for the client.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R_UX.label: X101 Copies/Blowbacks/Printing-Black & White (Internal)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R_UX.definition: Any black & white copies, blowbacks, digital prints from images, printing or reprinting costs billed on a per page basis when that printing is performed in-house and not by an external vendor

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R__b.label: Support Activities for Coal Mining
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R__b.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing support activities for coal mining (except geophysical surveying and mapping, site preparation, construction, and transportation activities) on a contract or fee basis. Exploration for coal is included in this industry. Exploration services include traditional prospecting methods, such as taking core samples and making geological observations at prospective sites.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R_h5.label: Telephone Apparatus Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/R_h5.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing wire telephone and data communications equipment. These products may be stand-alone or board-level components of a larger system. Examples of products made by these establishments are central office switching equipment, cordless and wire telephones (except cellular), PBX equipment, telephone answering machines, LAN modems, multi-user modems, and other data communications equipment, such as bridges, routers, and gateways.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ra12.label: Negligent Exposure of Another to Disease or Toxic Substances
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ra12.definition: Negligent Exposure of Another to Disease or Toxic Substances: The failure to exercise reasonable care in preventing the exposure of another person to a disease or toxic substance, resulting in harm or injury to that person.
english_labels: Negligent Exposure of Another to Disease or Toxic Substances

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ra1Y.label: inv_start_date
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ra1Y.definition: "The starting date for the billing period. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ra1Z.label: Month to Month Tenancy Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ra1Z.definition: A month-to-month tenancy clause is a provision in a contract that allows a tenant to occupy a property on a monthly basis without a fixed term commitment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ra1p.label: Creditor Matrix
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ra1p.definition: A Creditor Matrix or Creditor List is a document that lists the names and addresses of all creditors in a bankruptcy or restructuring case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ra2V.label: Mixed-Member Majoritarian Representation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ra2V.definition: Mixed-Member Majoritarian Representation (MMM), also known as Parallel Voting, is an electoral system combining first-past-the-post and proportional representation elements, but the two components operate independently. Voters typically have two votes: one for a candidate in a single-member district and another for a party list, with seats filled separately by each method without adjusting for proportionality.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ra3R.label: Utilities Motion
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ra3R.definition: A Utilities Motion (Bankruptcy) is a request made by a utility company in a bankruptcy case to receive payment for providing essential services such as electricity, gas, or water to the debtor.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ra6E.label: Author
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ra6E.definition: An Author is a specific type of Role in Document or oasis:role that refers to the individual or entity responsible for creating or originating a written work.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ra6t.label: Sexual Orientation and Gender Identity Rights
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ra6t.definition: Sexual Orientation and Gender Identity Rights refer to the legal and ethical protections aimed at ensuring individuals are not discriminated against based on their sexual orientation or gender identity. These rights may include freedom from persecution, equal employment opportunities, and access to healthcare and social services, and are increasingly recognized in international human rights law and national legislation.
english_labels: Sexual Orientation and Gender Identity Rights

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ra8N.label: Drug Crimes
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ra8N.definition: The violation of laws prohibiting the production, distribution, and/or use of certain controlled substances and the equipment or devices utilized in their preparation and/or use.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RaBY.label: Writ of Execution
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RaBY.definition: A Writ of Execution is a court order granted to enforce a judgment of possession or to collect on a judgment of monetary damages by allowing the seizure or transfer of the debtor's property by authorities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RaBm.label: Primary Care Negligence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RaBm.definition: Negligence by a primary care physician in providing medical treatment or advice to a patient, resulting in harm or injury to the patient.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RaCN.label: Impairment of Kidney Function
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RaCN.definition: Impairment of kidney function refers to a reduction in the kidneys' ability to filter waste products and excess fluids from the blood. This condition can vary in severity and may lead to chronic kidney disease, necessitating medical management or interventions to prevent further deterioration.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RaE0.label: Trial Court Forum
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RaE0.definition: A Trial Court Forum is a level of court forum where legal proceedings are conducted and judgments are made, typically involving the presentation of evidence and witnesses.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RaGE.label: Sac River Band of the Chickamauga - Cherokee
english_labels: Sac River Band of the Chickamauga - Cherokee

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RaK9.label: Back Pay
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RaK9.definition: Back Pay refers to the wages, benefits, or other forms of compensation owed to an employee for past work performed but not yet paid. This could arise due to miscalculation, wage disputes, legal settlements, or retroactive pay increases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RaQI.label: Donation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RaQI.definition: A Donation is a voluntary gift of money, goods, services, or property given to an individual, organization, or cause without expectation of reciprocation or direct personal benefit. This act of giving is typically motivated by altruism, support for a specific mission or goal, or a desire to contribute to societal well-being.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RaSU.label: National Upper House Legislator
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RaSU.definition: A National Upper House Legislator is a member of the higher chamber in a bicameral national legislature, typically responsible for providing a check on the lower house and representing broader state or regional interests. This official participates in crafting, debating, and voting on national legislation, often with special powers such as confirming executive appointments or ratifying treaties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RaTF.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - York County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RaTF.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - York County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering civil and criminal proceedings at the county level in Pennsylvania.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - York County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RaV7.label: Motion to Settle
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RaV7.definition: A Motion to Settle is a legal request made by one party to a lawsuit to resolve the case through a mutually agreed upon settlement, rather than proceeding to trial.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RaWO.label: Advertising Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RaWO.definition: Advertising Law regulates the practices and methods of promoting products, services, and brands to ensure that advertisements are truthful, non-deceptive, and fair. It encompasses regulations on commercial speech, consumer protection, and compliance with industry standards.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RaYh.label: Retention Bonus Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RaYh.definition: A retention bonus clause is a provision in a contract that offers an incentive payment to an employee to encourage them to remain with the company for a specified period of time.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Raa0.label: Bankruptcy Schedule - Income
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Raa0.definition: Bankruptcy Schedule - Income, also known as Schedule I, requires the debtor to disclose all sources of income, including wages, salaries, business income, rental income, and other earnings. This schedule provides a detailed account of the debtor's financial resources, helping the court and creditors assess the debtor's ability to repay debts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Raa2.label: Notice and Opportunity to Cure Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Raa2.definition: A Notice and Opportunity to Cure Clause is a provision in a contract that requires one party to notify the other party of a breach or default and provide them with a chance to remedy the situation before taking legal action.
english_labels: Notice and Opportunity to Cure Clause

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Raa9.label: A118 Collection-Forensic
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Raa9.definition: For discovery and eDiscovery, the forensic acquisition and analysis of data that includes active files, deleted files and file fragments using specialized software or hardware

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RaaV.label: Massachusetts Trial Court - Land Court Department
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RaaV.definition: The Massachusetts Trial Court - Land Court Department is a specialized division within the Massachusetts Trial Court that handles cases related to real property disputes.
english_labels: Massachusetts Trial Court - Land Court Department

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rad9.label: Semitic languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rad9.definition: Semitic languages are a group of languages that originated in the Middle East and are characterized by a common set of grammatical features and vocabulary.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RadA.label: Client Relationship Role
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RadA.definition: A lawyer's client relationship role refers to the various capacities in which an attorney interacts with and manages clients on behalf of a law firm. Examples include a billing partner (who oversees billing and invoicing matters), a responsible attorney (who is in charge of managing a specific legal matter), and a relationship attorney (who is in charge of an overall client relationship).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Radd.label: Motion to Quash Service
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Radd.definition: A Motion to Quash Service is a legal request to invalidate or nullify a summons or other legal notice that was improperly served to a party in a lawsuit.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Radg.label: UTBMS MF30 Employment, Labor and Employee Benefits
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Radg.definition: A category within the UTBMS coding system used to classify legal services related to employment, labor, and employee benefits, which falls under the broader category of Mergers and Acquisitions.
english_labels: UTBMS MF30 Employment, Labor and Employee Benefits

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Radj.label: Third-Party Summons
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Radj.definition: A third-party summons is a legal document that requires a person who is not a party to a lawsuit to appear in court or provide evidence related to the case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rado.label: Free Cash Flow Conversion Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rado.definition: A Free Cash Flow Conversion Clause is a provision in a contract that allows for the conversion of a company's free cash flow into equity or debt securities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rafw.label: Court Forum
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rafw.definition: A Court Forum is a type of Dispute Forum that is administered by an organization or government entity and has specific levels and jurisdiction types for resolving legal disputes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RagN.label: Construction Flooding Negligence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RagN.definition: The concept of Construction Flooding Negligence refers to a legal claim of negligence against a party involved in construction activities, where the negligence resulted in flooding or water damage to property.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RahB.label: Employer Breach of Employee Manual
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RahB.definition: The concept of "Employer Breach of Employee Manual" refers to a legal claim made by an employee against their employer for failing to comply with the terms outlined in the company's employee manual.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RahH.label: Indiana City Court - Hamilton County, Noblesville City
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RahH.definition: Indiana City Court - Hamilton County, Noblesville City is a specific court located in Hamilton County that operates under the jurisdiction of the Indiana City Court, handling cases related to city ordinances and traffic violations.
english_labels: Indiana City Court - Hamilton County, Noblesville City

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Raio.label: Audio and Video Equipment Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Raio.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing electronic audio and video equipment for home entertainment, motor vehicles, and public address and musical instrument amplification. Examples of products made by these establishments are digital video recorders, televisions, stereo equipment, speaker systems, household-type video cameras, jukeboxes, and amplifiers for musical instruments and public address systems.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RajW.label: Initial Public Offering Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RajW.definition: An Initial Public Offering (IPO) is the process of offering shares of a private company to the public for the first time in order to raise capital, and is a type of Equity Financing.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Raka.label: Health Care Fraud
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Raka.definition: Health Care Fraud refers to the intentional deception or misrepresentation of information related to health care services or products, with the aim of obtaining unauthorized benefits or payments from a health care program or insurer.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rala.label: Architect Malpractice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rala.definition: Architect Malpractice refers to a type of malpractice claim that arises from the negligent or wrongful actions of an architect in the design or construction of a building or structure.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ram7.label: Disclaimer Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ram7.definition: A disclaimer clause is a contractual provision that limits or excludes liability or responsibility for certain risks, damages, or warranties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ranh.label: Naturalization Clause Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ranh.definition: A Naturalization Clause claim is a legal assertion related to Article I, Section 8, Clause 4 of the United States Constitution, which grants Congress the power "To establish a uniform Rule of Naturalization." This clause provides the federal government with the authority to set the rules for becoming a U.S. citizen. A claim involving the Naturalization Clause may arise in situations where there is a dispute over the application or interpretation of federal immigration and naturalization laws.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RaoU.label: Definition of Change of Control Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RaoU.definition: A Change of Control Clause is a provision in a contract that allows one party to terminate or modify the agreement if the other party undergoes a change in ownership or control.
english_labels: Definition of Change of Control Clause

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Raoj.label: B190 Other Contested Matters (excluding assumption/rejection motions)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Raoj.definition: Analysis and preparation of all other motions, opposition to motions and reply memoranda in support of motions
english_labels: B190 Other Contested Matters (excluding assumption/rejection motions)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RapV.label: TR760 Domain Names - ccTLDs Domain Name Filing - Country Code
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RapV.definition: All actions associated with completing a domain name application (including renewal) that is to be filed as a country code top-level domain (ccTLD), e.g., .jp, .uk, .tv. The domain name applications should be filed through the current domain name provider unless otherwise instructed.
english_labels: TR760 Domain Names - ccTLDs Domain Name Filing - Country Code

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Raqj.label: WC330 Depositions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Raqj.definition: Preparing deposition notices and subpoenas, Communicating with witnesses and/or opposing counsel, Discussing deposition strategy with adjuster/employer and/or witness, Preparing witnesses, Reviewing medical records/documents/claims file for deposition preparation, Preparing direct/cross examination questions for depositions, Attending depositions, Travel to and from depositions, Prepare deposition summaries/reports to client

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Raug.label: Florida Circuit Court - Nassau County - 4th Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Raug.definition: A court located in Nassau County, Florida that is part of the larger Florida Circuit Court system, which handles civil and criminal cases within its jurisdiction.
english_labels: Florida Circuit Court - Nassau County - 4th Circuit Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ravb.label: Kansas District Court - Coffey County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ravb.definition: Kansas District Court - Coffey County refers to a specific court within the Kansas District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Coffey County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ravf.label: Indiana Town Court - Hendricks County, Brownsburg Town
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ravf.definition: A court located in Brownsburg Town, Hendricks County, Indiana that has jurisdiction over local ordinance violations and minor criminal offenses.
english_labels: Indiana Town Court - Hendricks County, Brownsburg Town

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Raw0.label: Data Breach
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Raw0.definition: A "Data Breach" refers to an incident in which unauthorized individuals gain access to confidential data, often resulting in the exposure or theft of sensitive information. Such breaches can compromise personal, financial, or business-related data, posing risks to individuals, organizations, and stakeholders.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RawJ.label: Abuse of Process
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RawJ.definition: The concept of "Abuse of Process" refers to the misuse of legal procedures or the justice system for an ulterior motive, such as to harass or intimidate someone, rather than for the legitimate pursuit of justice.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Raye.label: Polar Market Segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Raye.definition: The Polar Market Segment targets consumers or businesses situated in regions experiencing extremely cold temperatures, such as polar and subpolar zones. Products and services in this segment are designed to address the challenges of living in frigid climates, including insulation, heating solutions, and specialized clothing.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rb1a.label: X202 Patent and Trademark Searching and Monitoring
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rb1a.definition: Any searching and monitoring costs, including any monitoring or watch service for a trademark, brand or domain name. Excludes on-line legal research (X111) or discovery/eDiscovery culling and filtering (X302).
english_labels: X202 Patent and Trademark Searching and Monitoring

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rb33.label: Unit per Task
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rb33.definition: A "Unit per Task" is a type of unit used to measure the cost of a specific task or activity within a legal engagement, such as drafting a contract or attending a hearing.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rb5D.label: Agent Breaching Fiduciary Duty to Principal
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rb5D.definition: An agent breaching their legal obligation to act in the best interest of their principal, often an employee breaching their duty to their employer.
english_labels: Agent Breaching Fiduciary Duty to Principal

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rb6m.label: Investors' Rights Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rb6m.definition: An Investors' Rights Agreement (IRA) is a legal document that delineates the rights, privileges, and protections afforded to investors, particularly those investing in private companies. It often includes provisions concerning information rights, anti-dilution protections, and registration rights, among others, aimed at protecting the investors' interests and ensuring they have access to critical information.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rb7g.label: Joint Insurance Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rb7g.definition: A Joint Insurance Agreement allows two or more parties to be jointly insured under one policy. This ensures that all parties have coverage and defines how liabilities or benefits are distributed among them.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rb83.label: Association
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rb83.definition: An association refers to an organized group of individuals or entities that join together for a common purpose or goal. These groups can take various forms, and they often have specific missions, objectives, and membership requirements. Associations are commonly established to promote shared interests, advocacy, networking, and collaboration among their members.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rb8q.label: Florida Circuit Court - Jackson County - 14th Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rb8q.definition: The Florida Circuit Court - Jackson County (14th Circuit Court) is a specific court within the Florida Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Jackson County.
english_labels: Florida Circuit Court - Jackson County - 14th Circuit Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rb98.label: L652 Objective and Subjective coding
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rb98.definition: Activities and actions related to unitizing and the objective and subjective coding of basic bibliographic information related to both electronic and paper-based data and documents, including auto-coding.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rb99.label: Georgia Superior Court - Brooks County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rb99.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Brooks County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Brooks County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rb9G.label: Lack of Case or Controversy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rb9G.definition: The term "case or controversy" refers to the requirement that courts may only hear matters involving actual, ongoing disputes between parties with a concrete interest in the outcome. This requirement ensures that the judiciary only resolves real conflicts and does not give advisory opinions or engage in issues that are moot, not ripe, or non-justiciable. In the United States, this falls under Article III of the Constitution.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rb9y.label: Trademark Registration Process
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rb9y.definition: The Trademark Registration Process involves filing an application with a governmental authority, such as the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO), that includes the name, logo, or other mark to be registered, along with the goods or services it will represent. The application undergoes examination for distinctiveness and potential conflicts with existing trademarks; if approved, a Trademark Registration Document is issued, granting the owner exclusive rights to use the mark in commerce for the specified goods or services

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbAy.label: Motions in Appellate Courts
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbAy.definition: Motions in Appellate Courts are requests made by parties in a higher court seeking a specific action or decision, such as a motion to expedite a case or a motion for summary disposition.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbBE.label: PA220 Patentability Investigation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbBE.definition: All actions associated with determining the approximate scope of patent protection that may be available for a client's invention, including definition of the scope and field of the search, searching, analysis of search results, and reporting to client. Also known as a "novelty" or "prior art" search, the field of a patentability search is often similar to that of a state-of-the-art search. However, patentability searches are typically conducted after any market research or conceptual engineering has been completed so that the scope of the investigation is described by at least an informal structural or functional description of an invention. Often a patentability search will also locate expired and/or lapsed patents disclosing technology that may be freely copied in order to improve the invention. Thus, a patentability search may include various aspects of a state-of-the-art search. Work of outside vendors in conducting searches or otherwise assisting the investigation should be an expense under E100.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbFV.label: New York City Court - Cohoes
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbFV.definition: A court located in Cohoes, New York City, which has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbGC.label: Deposition Exhibit
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbGC.definition: A deposition exhibit is a physical or digital item presented as evidence during a deposition, which is a pre-trial legal proceeding where witnesses are questioned under oath.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbGp.label: increase_decrease
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbGp.definition: "Identifies whether the disc_cred results in increasing the cost of the expense item (and is therefore a charge applied to the expense item) or decreasing the cost of the expense item (and is therefore a reduction applied to the expense item). "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbK2.label: Washington Superior Court - Asotin County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbK2.definition: Washington Superior Court - Asotin County refers to a specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Asotin County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbNd.label: Orthodontics Malpractice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbNd.definition: Orthodontics Malpractice refers to a type of medical malpractice claim that arises from negligent or improper orthodontic treatment by a healthcare professional.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbNl.label: B110 Case Administration
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbNl.definition: Coordination and compliance matters, including preparation of statement of financial affairs; schedules; list of contracts; United States Trustee interim statements and operating reports; contacts with the United States Trustee; general creditor inquiries

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbP2.label: tksum segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbP2.definition: A "tksum segment" is a component of the LEDES XML E-Billing Ver. 2.2 standard that includes information such as the timekeeper's first and last name, ID, and billing rate.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbTT.label: Bankruptcy Schedule - Expenses for Separate Household
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbTT.definition: Bankruptcy Schedule - Expenses for Separate Household requires the debtor to list the monthly living expenses for a household that is separate from the primary residence, such as an estranged spouse's household or a dependent's separate living arrangement. This schedule details the financial obligations associated with maintaining the separate household, aiding the court and creditors in understanding the full scope of the debtor's financial commitments.
english_labels: Bankruptcy Schedule - Expenses for Separate Household
Expenses for Separate Household of Debtor 2 (individuals)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbXf.label: Skull Valley Band of Goshute Indians of Utah
english_labels: Skull Valley Band of Goshute Indians of Utah

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbYF.label: 02 Real Property (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbYF.definition: 02 Real Property (PACER NoS) refers to a category of legal cases related to disputes over ownership, use, or transfer of land and buildings, as classified by the PACER Nature of Suit (NoS) Codes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbZd.label: Liability to Property Invitees
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbZd.definition: Liability to Property Invitees refers to the legal responsibility of a property owner or occupier to ensure the safety of individuals who are invited onto their property for business purposes, such as customers or clients.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rbcg.label: Motion to Amend Answer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rbcg.definition: A Motion to Amend Answer is a formal request made to the court by a party in a legal case to modify or change their previously filed answer to the complaint or petition.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbdY.label: Florida County Court - Franklin County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbdY.definition: Florida County Court - Franklin County is a specific court within the Florida County Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Franklin County, Florida.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rbei.label: Maritime Negligence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rbei.definition: Maritime Negligence refers to a legal claim for damages resulting from a failure to exercise reasonable care in maritime activities, such as shipping, navigation, or boating.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rbej.label: Lule Sami
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rbej.definition: Lule Sami is a language within the Language top-level class, spoken by the Lule Sami people in Norway, Sweden, and Finland.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbhV.label: Minnesota District Court - Carlton County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbhV.definition: Minnesota District Court - Carlton County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system located in Carlton County, responsible for administering legal proceedings within its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rbhw.label: Debtor in Possession Financing Motion
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rbhw.definition: A Debtor in Possession (DIP) Financing Motion is a request made by a bankrupt entity to obtain financing while still in possession of its assets, allowing it to continue operating during the bankruptcy process.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbiO.label: Contact DBA Name
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbiO.definition: Contact DBA Name refers to the "Doing Business As" name associated with an individual, business, or organization. Unlike the legal name, the DBA name is the alias under which the person or entity operates and may be used in commercial and legal documents to identify the entity.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbiQ.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Randolph County (20th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Randolph County (20th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbjI.label: Motion to Stay Proceedings Pending Reexamination
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbjI.definition: A Motion to Stay Proceedings Pending Reexamination is a legal request to pause a court case while a reexamination of a patent or trademark is conducted.
english_labels: Motion to Stay Proceedings Pending Reexamination

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rbjf.label: Right to Audit Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rbjf.definition: A right to audit clause is a provision in a contract that allows one party to inspect and review the financial records of the other party to ensure compliance with the terms of the agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rbkh.label: Breach of Contract Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rbkh.definition: A breach of contract claim is a legal action taken by one party against another for failing to fulfill their obligations as outlined in a contractual agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rbmg.label: Necessity of Trespass
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rbmg.definition: The Necessity of Trespass is a legal defense in civil litigation that allows a defendant to justify their trespass onto another's property as necessary to prevent a greater harm.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RboB.label: Governmental Policy
english_labels: A Governmental Policy is a deliberate plan of action or inaction chosen by a government to address societal issues, guide decision-making, and achieve specific goals. These policies are formulated through legislative, executive, or administrative processes and cover various sectors, including economic, social, environmental, and foreign affairs.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbtV.label: New Jersey Superior Court - Hudson County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbtV.definition: The New Jersey Superior Court - Hudson County is a court of general jurisdiction within the New Jersey state court system, located in Hudson County, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal disputes.
english_labels: New Jersey Superior Court - Hudson County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rbur.label: New York Supreme Court - Herkimer County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rbur.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Herkimer County is a court of general jurisdiction in the state of New York that hears civil and criminal cases within Herkimer County.
english_labels: New York Supreme Court - Herkimer County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rbv1.label: Equity Mutual Fund
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rbv1.definition: An Equity Mutual Fund is an investment fund that pools capital from multiple investors to buy a diversified portfolio of stocks or equities. The primary objective is to generate high returns through capital appreciation, dividends, or a combination of both, although these funds carry higher volatility and risk compared to debt mutual funds

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbvE.label: Tangible Assets
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RbvE.definition: Tangible assets are assets that have a physical existence (we can touch, feel, and see them) except for real estate.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rbxi.label: Mississippi Office of the Attorney General
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rbxi.definition: The Mississippi Office of the Attorney General is a government entity responsible for representing the state in legal matters and providing legal advice to state agencies and officials.
english_labels: Mississippi Office of the Attorney General

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rbza.label: Notice of Judgment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rbza.definition: A Notice of Judgment is a written notification that officially communicates the decision and outcome of a legal case to the parties involved.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rc1X.label: Matter Percentage Shared Expenses
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rc1X.definition: A Matter Percentage Shared Expenses is a type of Engagement Fee Detail that refers to the portion of expenses related to a legal matter that will be shared between the client and the law firm based on a predetermined percentage.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rc2q.label: lf_remit_address
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rc2q.definition: "Address Structure (See ADDRESS_INFO Segment below). If not provided, then is assumed to be the same as lf_address. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rc3S.label: Top Secret
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rc3S.definition: Top Secret is the highest level of classified information, requiring the strictest control and protection due to its potential to cause exceptionally grave damage to national security if disclosed. Access to top secret information is highly restricted and granted only to individuals with the appropriate security clearance and a demonstrated need to know.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rc3f.label: Annual Recurring Revenue
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rc3f.definition: Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) is a metric commonly used by subscription-based businesses to measure the total amount of predictable revenue generated from subscriptions over a one-year period. Unlike Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR), ARR provides a longer-term view of revenue stability and is often used for strategic planning and valuation purposes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rc52.label: Use Beyond Scope of Permission
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rc52.definition: Use Beyond Scope of Permission refers to a defense strategy in civil litigation where the defendant argues that their actions were not in violation of the law because they were within the scope of their authorized permission.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcAw.label: Bearer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcAw.definition: A Bearer in legal contexts refers to an individual or entity responsible for physically transporting or delivering documents, goods, or service of process. This role requires the bearer to ensure the safe and accurate transfer of the item in question, often with a duty to provide confirmation upon successful delivery

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcBU.label: Approval from Prior Employer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcBU.definition: Approval from a Prior Employer refers to an applicant's receipt of immigration petition approvals from a former employer, applicable to various applications. This approval indicates that the former employer had successfully sponsored the applicant for a specific visa or immigration status.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcBg.label: matter_funds_applied
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcBg.definition: "Sum of all MATTER_DISC_CRED.disc_cred_amount where disc_cred equals ""MIFA"" "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcC0.label: Motion to Confirm Termination or Absence of Stay
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcC0.definition: A Motion to Confirm Termination or Absence of Stay is a legal request made in bankruptcy proceedings to confirm that a stay has been terminated or does not exist.
english_labels: Motion to Confirm Termination or Absence of Stay
Motion to Determine No Stay in Place

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcCh.label: Document Automation Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcCh.definition: Document Automation Management refers to the process of automating the creation, management, and storage of legal documents, specifically within the context of contract and document management.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcFM.label: Administration of Housing Programs, Urban Planning, and Community Development Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcFM.definition: The Administration of Housing Programs, Urban Planning, and Community Development subsector groups government establishments primarily engaged in the administration of housing, urban planning, and community development.
english_labels: Administration of Housing Programs, Urban Planning, and Community Development Industry

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcHd.label: Negligent Exercise of Retained Control
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcHd.definition: On a multi-employer work site, a person or entity may be civilly liable if it negligently exercised control so as to have "affirmatively contributed in any way" to the injury.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcLu.label: Travel Document Issuing Country
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcLu.definition: The Travel Document Issuing Country refers to the country that has issued the travel document or other identification suitable for international travel. This country is usually responsible for the traveler's consular needs and is the authority to which foreign governments will refer for identification and verification purposes

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcMZ.label: Implied Indemnification
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcMZ.definition: A legal concept where one party is obligated to compensate another party for damages or losses, even if there is no explicit agreement to do so, due to actions or statements that created a reasonable expectation of indemnification.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcNT.label: Nonacquiescence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcNT.definition: Nonacquiescence refers to the practice where a government agency chooses not to follow or implement a court ruling that directly affects the agency's actions or policies. This may happen when the agency disagrees with the decision or believes that it only applies to the specific case and not to its general procedures or regulations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcP9.label: Contract Duration Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcP9.definition: A Contract Duration Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the length of time that the contract will remain in effect.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcPC.label: Obviousness
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcPC.definition: Obviousness in legal terms refers to the lack of novelty and inventiveness in an invention, making it ineligible for a patent. An invention is considered obvious if a person with ordinary skill in the field would find the invention predictable based on prior art.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcPm.label: Real Estate Investor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcPm.definition: Entities or individuals that invest in real property, either directly or through a real estate investment trust (REIT).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcR2.label: Seating Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcR2.definition: A seating claim is a legal action initiated by an employee against their employer for not providing reasonable seating to employees who perform tasks that can be done while seated. The claim typically arises when an employer does not comply with applicable laws, which require employers to provide seating to employees when the nature of their work reasonably permits the use of seats. Employers can face liability for failing to provide seating when required, which can result in physical discomfort or injury to employees who are required to stand for long periods of time.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcR3.label: Closing Arguments / Summation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcR3.definition: Closing Arguments/Summation is a trial event where each party presents their final arguments to the jury or judge before a verdict is reached.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcR4.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Sangamon County (7th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Sangamon County (7th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcRp.label: No Default Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcRp.definition: A "No Default Clause" is a provision in a contract that specifies that neither party can be considered in default unless a specific event or condition occurs, as defined in the contract.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcS1.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Little River Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcS1.definition: A court located in Little River County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical area.
english_labels: Arkansas Circuit Court - Little River Cty.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcTA.label: Lawyer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcTA.definition: A lawyer is a legal professional who provides legal advice and representation to clients in various legal matters, including litigation, transactions, and regulatory compliance.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcUQ.label: Appointment of Successor Trustee Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcUQ.definition: An Appointment of Successor Trustee Clause is a provision in a contract that designates a person or entity to take over as trustee in the event that the original trustee is unable or unwilling to continue serving.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcUv.label: Social Rights
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcUv.definition: Social rights are the rights that focus on ensuring individuals have access to essential social services and protections, such as healthcare, education, and housing. Often considered a subset of economic rights, social rights aim to provide a safety net and foster social cohesion, and they may be protected by international treaties as well as national laws.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcVa.label: Tax and Revenue Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcVa.definition: Law which deals with the constitutional, common-law, statutory, tax treaty, and regulatory rules that constitute the law applicable to taxation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rccm.label: Renewable Energy Law Objectives
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rccm.definition: Renewable Energy Law Objectives refer to the legal and regulatory goals aimed at promoting the development, deployment, and integration of renewable energy sources into the energy mix. These objectives address environmental, economic, social, and technological aspects to ensure a transition to sustainable energy systems.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rccx.label: L632 Scanning - Hard Copy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rccx.definition: Includes OCR, production of metadata, and other services involved around scanning

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RceM.label: Nephrotic Syndrome
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RceM.definition: Nephrotic Syndrome is a kidney disorder characterized by excessive protein loss in the urine, low blood protein levels, high cholesterol, and swelling (edema). This condition results from damage to the kidney's filtering units (glomeruli) and can lead to complications requiring medical management.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RceZ.label: Misfeasance in Public Office
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RceZ.definition: Misfeasance in public office is a legal cause of action in some jurisdictions (e.g., United Kingdom), where a public officer abuses their position by acting unlawfully with malice or reckless disregard for the harm caused. This tort requires proof of deliberate wrongful conduct by the officer, resulting in damage to the claimant.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rced.label: Affiliate Non-Debtor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rced.definition: An affiliate non-debtor is a company or entity related to a debtor through common ownership, control, or significant financial interest, but which itself is not undergoing bankruptcy proceedings. Such entities may be involved in the bankruptcy case due to financial ties, guarantees, or shared obligations with the debtor.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rcfg.label: Recreational Immunity
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rcfg.definition: Recreational immunity exists as a defense for owners and/or occupiers of land as long as the plaintiff's recreational use was uninvited, used without fee, and there was no unreasonable risks that the owner/occupier should have known or knew existed.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rcg2.label: New York City Court - New Rochelle
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rcg2.definition: A court located in New Rochelle that operates under the jurisdiction of the New York City Court.
english_labels: New York City Court - New Rochelle

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rchk.label: TR699 Other Trademark Prosecution - International
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rchk.definition: Use only for trademark prosecution activities in connection with applications that are ("international") filed outside the home country or region of the applicant, and that can not be included under a previous code, or as instructed by the client.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rchn.label: Trial Events
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rchn.definition: Trial Events refer to the specific events that occur during a trial, such as opening statements, witness testimony, and the receipt of a verdict.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcjE.label: Spousal Support Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcjE.definition: A Spousal Support Claim is a legal request made by one spouse to receive financial assistance from the other spouse following a divorce or separation. This claim is typically based on factors such as income disparity, the length of the marriage, and each spouse's financial needs and contributions during the marriage. Spousal support, also known as alimony, is designed to provide financial support to the lower-earning spouse to help them maintain their standard of living or become financially independent.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rck2.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Pike Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rck2.definition: A court located in Pike County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rco6.label: WC410 Fact Witnesses
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rco6.definition: Preparing for examination of witness, Interview/meeting with witness, Preparing for cross-examination of witness, Review & analysis of deposition/trial transcripts

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rcqr.label: Respiratory Disorder
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rcqr.definition: Respiratory disorders are a group of conditions that affect the respiratory system, including the lungs and airways, leading to symptoms such as difficulty breathing, chronic cough, and reduced oxygen intake. These disorders can range from acute conditions like asthma attacks to chronic diseases like cystic fibrosis, requiring varied treatments and management strategies to improve respiratory function and quality of life.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rcsm.label: Testator
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rcsm.definition: A Testator is an individual who creates and executes a valid will, specifying how their estate should be distributed after their death. This person must have the legal capacity to make a will and clearly express their intentions regarding the disposition of their property and assets.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rcut.label: Delaware Justice of the Peace Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rcut.definition: The Delaware Justice of the Peace Court is a court within the Delaware State Courts system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases involving minor offenses and disputes.
english_labels: Delaware Justice of the Peace Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcwQ.label: Personally Identifiable Information
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcwQ.definition: Personally Identifiable Information (PII) is any data that can be used to identify, contact, or locate a specific individual. This includes names, addresses, phone numbers, email addresses, social security numbers, and other identifiers that can be linked to a particular person.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcwS.label: X401 Subscription Fee
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcwS.definition: Delivery of information via a subscription fee as opposed to a per user license fee or on a transaction basis. Indicate # of subscriptions as units; if different rates depending on type of subscription, split into multiple expense lines by rate.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rcwn.label: Trademark Dilution
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rcwn.definition: Trademark Dilution is a legal claim that arises when a party uses a similar or identical trademark to another party's famous mark, causing a likelihood of dilution of the distinctive quality of the famous mark.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcyQ.label: Impounding Property to Pay Debt
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RcyQ.definition: The concept of "Impounding Property to Pay Debt" refers to the legal process of seizing and holding property as collateral to satisfy a debt owed by the property owner, typically in cases of equitable claims.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RczO.label: Bank Leaving Funds Transfer Incomplete
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RczO.definition: When a bank fails to complete a funds transfer initiated by a customer before the customer closes their account or withdraws their authorization, resulting in the funds not being transferred, and potentially causing financial harm to the customer.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rd2J.label: Promissory Fraud
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rd2J.definition: The concept of Promissory Fraud refers to a type of fraudulent misrepresentation where a party makes a promise with no intention of keeping it, in order to induce another party to enter into a contract or take some other action to their detriment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rd3Z.label: Economic Community of West African States
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rd3Z.definition: ECOWAS (Economic Community of West African States): A regional group of fifteen West African countries, founded to promote economic integration across the region.
english_labels: Economic Community of West African States

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rd5U.label: Sanctions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rd5U.definition: A penalty or punishment imposed by a court or other authority for a violation of a law or rule, typically involving a fine or other restriction on one's rights or freedoms.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rd5c.label: Certified Rent Roll Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rd5c.definition: A Certified Rent Roll Clause is a provision in a contract that requires the landlord to provide a verified list of current tenants and their corresponding rental rates.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rd5f.label: Emergency Medical Treatment and Active Labor Act Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rd5f.definition: An EMTALA Claim arises when a healthcare provider fails to comply with the obligations under the Emergency Medical Treatment and Active Labor Act, which requires hospitals to provide emergency medical treatment to all individuals regardless of their ability to pay. This claim involves allegations that the hospital did not provide appropriate medical screening, necessary stabilizing treatment, or an appropriate transfer of an unstable patient.
english_labels: Emergency Medical Treatment and Active Labor Act Claim

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rd6d.label: Motion to Obtain Oral Argument
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rd6d.definition: A Motion to Obtain Oral Argument is a formal request made to a court by a party in a legal case, asking for the opportunity to present their arguments orally before the court.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rd6i.label: Health Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rd6i.definition: Law, rules, regulations and other jurisprudence among providers, payers and vendors to the health care industry and its patients; and (2) delivery of health care services; all with an emphasis on operations, regulatory and transactional legal issues.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rd6r.label: Arkansas District Court - Polk Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rd6r.definition: A court located in Polk County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its designated geographic area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rd7S.label: tax_invoice_cl_id
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rd7S.definition: The tax id number for the INVOICE.tax_invoice_cl_name.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rd7m.label: P210 Corporate Review
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rd7m.definition: This task includes all fact investigation/due diligence from a corporate perspective, such as structural reviews, material contract reviews, SEC filing reviews, financing document reviews, and industry information reviews.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rd7u.label: Privacy Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rd7u.definition: A Privacy Claim is a civil claim that seeks to protect an individual's right to privacy, including claims related to the unauthorized disclosure of personal information, invasion of privacy, and violations of confidentiality by healthcare providers.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdCJ.label: Order of Precedence Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdCJ.definition: An Order of Precedence Clause is a provision in a contract that establishes the hierarchy of conflicting terms and conditions within the agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdCa.label: Key Employee Retention Program Motion
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdCa.definition: A Key Employee Retention Program Motion (KERP) is a request made in a bankruptcy case to retain certain employees who are considered essential to the company's success during the bankruptcy process.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdDs.label: St. Croix Chippewa Indians of Wisconsin
english_labels: St. Croix Chippewa Indians of Wisconsin

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdGr.label: "Consolidated Fixed Charges Coverage Ratio" - Bond Indenture
english_labels: "Consolidated Fixed Charges Coverage Ratio" - Bond Indenture

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdHB.label: California Superior Court - Contra Costa Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdHB.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Contra Costa County, California, with the power to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.
english_labels: California Superior Court - Contra Costa Cty.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdHZ.label: First-Past-the-Post Electoral System
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdHZ.definition: A First-Past-the-Post (FPTP) electoral system is a voting method where the candidate with the most votes in a single-member district wins the election. This system does not require the winner to achieve a majority of the votes, only a plurality.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdIp.label: Galician
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdIp.definition: Galician is a written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a specific language within the context of legal matters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdJD.label: New York Supreme Court - Hamilton County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdJD.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Hamilton County is a specific court within the New York Supreme Court system, located in Hamilton County.
english_labels: New York Supreme Court - Hamilton County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdJQ.label: Idea Misappropriation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdJQ.definition: The unauthorized use or theft of someone else's original idea, without their permission or compensation, which can be claimed as a violation of intellectual property rights.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdJX.label: Approval Representation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdJX.definition: A representation made by a party in a legal matter that confirms the approval of a particular action or decision, and is supported by legal or other professional frameworks.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdKe.label: Statutory Deductions Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdKe.definition: A Statutory Deductions Clause is a provision in a contract that requires the employer to deduct certain amounts from an employee's pay, such as taxes and social security contributions, as required by law.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdLK.label: Vehicle Emissions Violation Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdLK.definition: A Vehicle Emissions Violation Claim involves allegations that a vehicle has exceeded the permissible emission levels set by environmental regulations, contributing to air pollution and violating environmental protection laws.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdLt.label: Attractive Nuisance
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdLt.definition: A legal concept that refers to a hazardous condition or object on a property that is likely to attract children and may cause them harm, for which the property owner may be held liable.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdN2.label: 151 Medicare (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdN2.definition: Action relating to Medicare payments, including actions for payments of benefits, to recover overpayments, and for judicial review of administrative decisions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdN6.label: Strict Liability
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdN6.definition: Strict liability refers to a legal doctrine where a party is held responsible for their actions or the consequences of those actions, regardless of intent or negligence. This means that the person or entity is liable for damages even if they didn't intend to cause harm or weren't negligent in their actions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdOK.label: Status - Process Outcome
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdOK.definition: Status Process Outcome reflects the result or disposition of a particular process or action — at a particular point in time — often indicating the decision or outcome of an application, request, or submission within a legal or regulatory context. This status conveys the relevant authority's determination, such as "approved," "denied," "received," "responded," or "withdrawn."

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdSA.label: International Terrorism
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdSA.definition: The use of violence and intimidation in pursuit of political aims that occurs across national borders.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdSS.label: Objection to Transfer of Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdSS.definition: An objection made by a party in a legal proceeding to prevent the transfer of a claim from one party to another.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdSk.label: Lessons Learned
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdSk.definition: Lessons Learned refers to the process of reflecting on past experiences and identifying what worked well and what did not, in order to improve future performance, within the context of project management objectives.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdTD.label: Fund Participation Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdTD.definition: A Fund Participation Agreement is a contract where parties agree to share in the gains or losses of a specific fund or investment. Often used in insurance, it's a way for insurers to spread risk among multiple participants.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdTy.label: Liquidity Covenant Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdTy.definition: A Liquidity Covenant Clause is a provision in a contract that requires a party to maintain a certain level of liquidity or cash reserves to ensure their ability to meet financial obligations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdU6.label: Minutes
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdU6.definition: Minutes are a written record of the proceedings or events that occurred, typically including the names of those present and decisions made.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdUx.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Wheeler County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdUx.definition: Oregon Circuit Court - Wheeler County refers to a specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Wheeler County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdWb.label: Third-Party Complaint
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdWb.definition: A third-party complaint is a legal document filed by a defendant against a non-party who may be liable for some or all of the plaintiff's claims.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdYq.label: New York Supreme Court - Cattaraugus County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdYq.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Cattaraugus County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Cattaraugus County, New York, with authority to hear and decide legal disputes within its geographic jurisdiction.
english_labels: New York Supreme Court - Cattaraugus County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdZJ.label: Political Rights Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdZJ.definition: Political rights include natural justice (procedural fairness) in law, such as the rights of the accused, including the right to a fair trial; due process; the right to seek redress or a legal remedy; and rights of participation in civil society and politics such as freedom of association, the right to assemble, the right to petition, the right of self-defense, and the right to vote.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rda1.label: Tortious Breach of Implied Covenant of Good Faith and Fair Dealing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rda1.definition: The Tortious Breach of Implied Covenant of Good Faith and Fair Dealing refers to a legal claim that arises when one party to a contract violates the implied duty of good faith and fair dealing, resulting in harm or damages to the other party.
english_labels: Tortious Breach of Implied Covenant of Good Faith and Fair Dealing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rdeq.label: Minimum Wage Violation Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rdeq.definition: A minimum wage violation claim is a legal action initiated by an employee against their employer for not paying the required minimum wage for the work performed. The minimum wage is the lowest hourly rate that employers are legally required to pay to their employees, and the claim typically arises when an employer pays less than the applicable minimum wage rate set by federal, state, or local law, or fails to properly calculate the employee's regular rate of pay when determining minimum wage.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdfK.label: Transaction Events
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdfK.definition: Events occurring during the course of a transaction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdrI.label: Tok Pisin
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdrI.definition: A creole language based on English and Melanesian languages, spoken in Papua New Guinea and used in legal matters in that country.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RduV.label: Minnesota District Court - Becker County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RduV.definition: Minnesota District Court - Becker County is a specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Becker County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rdvl.label: Washington Superior Court - Skamania County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rdvl.definition: Washington Superior Court - Skamania County refers to a specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Skamania County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rdww.label: Florida Circuit Court - Manatee County - 12th Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rdww.definition: A court located in Manatee County, Florida that is part of the larger Florida Circuit Court system.
english_labels: Florida Circuit Court - Manatee County - 12th Circuit Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdxE.label: Citation to Non-Legal-Authority Document
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdxE.definition: A citation to a document (e.g., opposing counsel's brief, appendix) that is not a legal authority (e.g., caselaw, statute, regulation)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdyV.label: Texas Court of Appeals - 14th
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdyV.definition: The Texas Court of Appeals - 14th is a specific intermediate appellate court in Texas that hears appeals from lower courts within its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdzW.label: Subordination of Lease Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RdzW.definition: A subordination of lease clause is a provision in a lease agreement that places the tenant's rights and interests below those of a third-party lender or landlord in the event of default or foreclosure.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Re0I.label: 865 RSI (405(g)) (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Re0I.definition: Action filed with regard to social security benefits provided for Retirement, Survivor Insurance under 42 U.S.C. § 405

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Re2W.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Henry County (14th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Henry County (14th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Re2p.label: Confederated Tribes and Bands of the Yakama Nation
english_labels: Confederated Tribes and Bands of the Yakama Nation

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Re30.label: L693 Review Planning & Training
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Re30.definition: Activities and actions related to the development and providing of initial and ongoing training prior to initial document review or periodically throughout the document review. Includes development of review protocol.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Re4E.label: Kansas District Court - Miami County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Re4E.definition: Kansas District Court - Miami County: A specific court within the Kansas District Court system located in Miami County, responsible for administering legal proceedings within its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Re4q.label: Minnesota District Court - Todd County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Re4q.definition: Minnesota District Court - Todd County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Todd County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Re6T.label: Embezzlement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Re6T.definition: The unlawful misappropriation by an offender to his/her own use or purpose of money, property, or some other thing of value entrusted to his/her care, custody, or control.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Re6i.label: Genetic Information
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Re6i.definition: Genetic information refers to data about an individual's genetic traits, which are inherited from their parents through DNA. This information can include details about an individual's genes, family medical history, and the presence or absence of specific genetic markers that may be associated with certain diseases or conditions. Genetic information is protected under various laws, such as the Genetic Information Nondiscrimination Act (GINA) in the United States, which prohibits discrimination in employment and health insurance based on genetic information.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Re6i.label: Council of the European Union
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Re6i.definition: The Council of the European Union, often referred to as the Council of Ministers, is a principal decision-making body of the European Union, where ministers from each member state convene to adopt legislation and coordinate policies. It represents the governments of the member states and, together with the European Parliament, exercises legislative and budgetary functions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReA0.label: Spouse
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReA0.definition: A Spouse is a legally recognized partner in a marriage, civil union, or domestic partnership. This status confers various legal rights and responsibilities related to inheritance, taxation, healthcare decision-making, and immigration.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReBU.label: Arizona Superior Court - Cochise Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReBU.definition: Arizona Superior Court - Cochise Cty. is a specific court within the Arizona Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Cochise County, Arizona.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReEH.label: PA120 Analysis/Strategy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReEH.definition: The thinking, strategizing, and planning for a case that is not included under other patent task codes below. Includes discussions, writing, and meetings on case strategy. Also includes initial legal research for case assessment purposes and legal research for developing a basic case strategy. Most legal research and/or other activity will be under the primary task for which the research is conducted, such as research for a response to an office action under PA430.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReKY.label: Trial Transcript
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReKY.definition: A trial transcript is a written or recorded account of the proceedings and testimony given during a trial.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReL7.label: Texas District Court - Walker County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReL7.definition: Texas District Court - Walker County: A court of law in the state of Texas that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Walker County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReM2.label: Long-Term Financial Obligations
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReM2.definition: Long-Term Financial Obligations, also known as Long-term Liabilities, are debts or obligations that are due more than one year from the present date. These can include long-term loans, bonds payable, lease obligations, and pension liabilities, and they are recorded on a company's balance sheet under non-current liabilities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReMJ.label: Croatian
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReMJ.definition: Croatian (Language) refers to the written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Croatian language, which is used in legal matters such as documents, artifacts, evidence, testimony, proceedings, or any other legal aspect.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReNQ.label: Estimated Resolution Date
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReNQ.definition: The Estimated Resolution Date is a specific goal within Project Management Objectives that refers to the anticipated date by which a legal matter or project is expected to be resolved.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReNk.label: Passive Investor Disclosure
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReNk.definition: A Passive Investor Disclosure is a document filed by investors who hold a significant stake in a company but do not seek to influence or control its management or operations. This disclosure is typically required by regulatory authorities to distinguish passive investors from active ones and to provide transparency about the ownership structure of publicly traded companies.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReOL.label: Salishan languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReOL.definition: Salishan languages are a group of languages spoken by indigenous peoples in the Pacific Northwest region of North America.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReSP.label: Base Amount - Fee
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReSP.definition: A Base Amount - Fee is a specific type of fee or expense that is charged for legal services, typically representing a fixed or minimum amount that must be paid by the client.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReVI.label: Certificate of Incorporation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReVI.definition: A Certificate of Incorporation is a legal document filed with a state's Secretary of State or similar government agency to officially establish a corporation. It sets forth the corporation's name, purpose, capital structure, and other essential details, and serves as a charter that grants the corporation legal existence.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReVp.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Cape Girardeau County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReVp.definition: A Missouri Circuit Court located in Cape Girardeau County, which is a court of general jurisdiction in Missouri responsible for hearing civil and criminal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.
english_labels: Missouri Circuit Court - Cape Girardeau County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReYh.label: Broker-Dealer Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReYh.definition: Law surrounding individuals engaged in effecting transactions in securities for others or for their own account.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReYr.label: Dram Shop Liability
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ReYr.definition: The legal concept of Dram Shop Liability refers to the responsibility of a business or individual who serves or provides alcohol to someone who then causes harm or injury to another person as a result of their intoxication.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rea9.label: Family Treatment
