https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rj77.label: Kansas District Court - Neosho County, Erie
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rj77.definition: A court located in Neosho County, Erie, Kansas that has jurisdiction over cases within its geographical area.
english_labels: Kansas District Court - Neosho County, Erie

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rj8C.label: Athlete Visa
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rj8C.definition: The Athlete Visa (in the U.S., P-1A visa) is a non-immigrant visa specifically designed for internationally recognized athletes who wish to enter the destination country (e.g., U.S.) to participate in individual or team events. In the United States, this visa allows the athlete to stay for the duration of the competition, event, or performance, with a maximum initial period of up to 5 years for individual athletes and 1 year for athletic teams, with the possibility of extension.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rj8Y.label: Interruption of Services Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rj8Y.definition: An Interruption of Services Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the rights and obligations of parties in the event that services are interrupted or unavailable due to unforeseen circumstances.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rj97.label: Grapefruits
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rj97.definition: Grapefruits are large citrus fruits from the Citrus × paradisi species, known for their tart to semi-sweet flavor and distinctive segmented flesh. They are consumed fresh, juiced, or used in culinary applications, valued for their high vitamin C content, dietary fiber, and potential health benefits, including antioxidant properties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjAR.label: New York Court on the Judiciary
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjAR.definition: The New York Court on the Judiciary is a specialized court within the New York State Courts system that is responsible for investigating and disciplining judges who have engaged in misconduct.
english_labels: New York Court on the Judiciary

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjAf.label: Washington Superior Court - Columbia County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjAf.definition: Washington Superior Court - Columbia County refers to a specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Columbia County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjDh.label: Arugula
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjDh.definition: Arugula, also known as rocket, is a leafy green vegetable from the Eruca vesicaria species, known for its peppery flavor and tender texture. It is commonly used in salads, sandwiches, and as a garnish, valued for its nutritional benefits, including high levels of vitamins A, C, and K, as well as calcium and antioxidants.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjFY.label: Collateral Appeal
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjFY.definition: A collateral appeal, also known as a collateral attack, is a legal challenge to a criminal conviction that occurs outside the direct appeal process. Instead of challenging the validity of the conviction based on the record of the original trial (as in a direct appeal), a collateral appeal addresses issues such as newly discovered evidence, ineffective assistance of counsel, or constitutional violations that weren't raised during the trial or on direct appeal. This form of relief is often sought after all direct appeals have been exhausted.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjGC.label: Fixation in a Tangible Medium
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjGC.definition: Fixation in a Tangible Medium, a cornerstone of copyright law, requires that a work must be fixed in a medium of expression from which it can be perceived, reproduced, or otherwise communicated. This concept ensures that copyright protects not the idea itself but its expression in a form that can be physically or digitally captured and reproduced.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjId.label: Stale Rent
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjId.definition: Rent that remains unpaid or uncollected for a prolonged period of time, which may be used as a defense in a civil litigation case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjK5.label: Motion to Waive Filing of Excerpts of Record
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjK5.definition: A Motion to Waive Filing of Excerpts of Record is a request made to the court to excuse a party from submitting certain portions of the record in a legal case.
english_labels: Motion to Waive Filing of Excerpts of Record

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjKL.label: Real Estate, Rental and Leasing Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjKL.definition: The industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in renting, leasing, or otherwise allowing the use of tangible or intangible assets, and establishments providing related services. The major portion of this sector comprises establishments that rent, lease, or otherwise allow the use of their own assets by others. The assets may be tangible, as is the case of real estate and equipment, or intangible, as is the case with patents and trademarks. This industry group also includes establishments primarily engaged in managing real estate for others, selling, renting and/or buying real estate for others, and appraising real estate.
english_labels: Real Estate, Rental and Leasing Industry

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjLJ.label: X105 Word Processing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjLJ.definition: Any in-house word processing fees. Excludes word processing associated with a Translation (X139).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjLr.label: Merger of Idea and Expression
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjLr.definition: The Merger of Idea and Expression doctrine in copyright law applies when an idea and its expression are so intertwined that the idea cannot be expressed in any other way, making the expression non-protectable. This principle recognizes that when only one or very few ways exist to express an idea, protecting such expression would effectively grant a monopoly over the idea itself.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjM8.label: Buyer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjM8.definition: A buyer or purchaser generally means a person, company or entity contracting with a seller for services or merchandise to be provided or delivered for a named individual. In a strict legal sense, a buyer may also include someone who acquires title to something by deed, devise, execution, prescription, possession, occupancy, or escheat.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjNG.label: Virgin Islands Municipal Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjNG.definition: The Virgin Islands Municipal Court is a court of limited jurisdiction within the Virgin Islands Territory Courts, responsible for hearing cases related to local ordinance violations and misdemeanors.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjQP.label: US Chapter 7 Bankruptcy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjQP.definition: Chapter 7 bankruptcy, sometimes referred to as liquidation bankruptcy, is the most common type of bankruptcy in the U.S., and the most basic form of bankruptcy. Chapter 7 provides liquidation of an individual's property and then distributes it to creditors.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjRp.label: Letter of Intent
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjRp.definition: A Letter of Intent is a formal document that outlines the preliminary terms and conditions of an agreement between two or more parties. While generally not legally binding, it serves as a roadmap for future negotiations or agreements.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjRt.label: Connecticut Circuit Court - Appellate Division
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjRt.definition: The Connecticut Circuit Court - Appellate Division is a court within the Connecticut State Courts system that hears appeals from lower courts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjSY.label: Covenant Compliance
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjSY.definition: The concept of Covenant Compliance refers to the fulfillment of specific obligations or promises made by a party in a legal matter, as outlined in a contract or agreement, in order to meet the conditions necessary for the closing of the transaction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjT7.label: Options - Assets
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjT7.definition: Options are financial instruments that are derivatives based on the value of underlying securities such as stocks. An options contract offers the buyer the opportunity to buy or sell-depending on the type of contract they hold-the underlying asset. Unlike futures, the holder is not required to buy or sell the asset if they choose not to.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjTe.label: Arraignment Cancellation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjTe.definition: Arraignment Cancellation refers to the act of revoking or annulling an arraignment, which is a formal reading of criminal charges in court, before a trial takes place.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjUN.label: Brain Stem Death
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjUN.definition: Brain stem death is a medical condition where an individual has irreversibly lost all brain stem functions, which are responsible for consciousness and vital bodily functions, while other parts of the brain may still have activity. It is often considered a criterion for legal death in many jurisdictions, as the loss of brain stem function is critical for maintaining life.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjVg.label: Credit Rating
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjVg.definition: A Credit Rating is an evaluation of the creditworthiness of a borrower or debt instrument, assigned by a credit rating agency, reflecting the likelihood of timely repayment of principal and interest. Credit ratings range from high grades, indicating low risk, to low grades, indicating higher risk of default.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjVp.label: Landlord Indemnification Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjVp.definition: A Landlord Indemnification Clause is a specific type of contractual clause that requires the tenant to compensate the landlord for any losses or damages incurred as a result of the tenant's actions or negligence.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjVw.label: PA740 Licensing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjVw.definition: All actions associated with negotiating and preparing license.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjZY.label: Adoption, Surrogacy, and Paternity Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjZY.definition: Laws relating to adoption, surrogacy and paternity.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjeD.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Cole County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjeD.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Cole County: A court of law in the state of Missouri that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Cole County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rjev.label: Data Visualization Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rjev.definition: Data Visualization Management refers to the management of data in a way that allows for the creation and interpretation of visual representations of that data.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rjh7.label: Washington Shorelines Hearing Board
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rjh7.definition: The Washington Shorelines Hearing Board is a specialized court within the Washington State Courts system that hears cases related to the use and development of shorelines in the state.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rjhe.label: Certificate of Limited Partnership
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rjhe.definition: A Certificate of Limited Partnership is a legal document filed with a state's Secretary of State or similar government agency to officially register a limited partnership (LP). It typically includes information such as the partnership's name, purpose, registered agent, and the names of its general and limited partners.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rji2.label: Chinook jargon
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rji2.definition: A pidgin language used in the Pacific Northwest region of North America, combining elements of Indigenous languages and English, historically used as a lingua franca for trade and communication between Indigenous peoples and European settlers.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rjk1.label: Information and Participation Rights
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rjk1.definition: Information and Participation Rights refer to the entitlements that allow individuals to access information held by public bodies and to participate in decision-making processes that affect their lives. These rights are often enshrined in international environmental agreements like the Aarhus Convention, as well as national laws, and aim to enhance transparency, accountability, and public involvement in governance.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjkN.label: Phenylketonuria (PKU)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjkN.definition: Phenylketonuria (PKU) is a genetic disorder characterized by the inability to metabolize phenylalanine, an amino acid, due to a deficiency in the enzyme phenylalanine hydroxylase (PAH). This leads to an accumulation of phenylalanine in the blood and brain, which can result in severe neurological and developmental issues.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjkY.label: matter_net_fees
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjkY.definition: "Using the Math Statement on the next tab: The total for pre-split non-taxable fee items on the bill + The total for pre-split Tax1 fee items on the bill + ... repeated for each pre-split tax fee items on the bill + The total for post-split non-taxable fee items on the bill + The total for post-split Tax1 fee items on the bill + ... repeated for each post-split tax fee items on the bill tax_total_detail_fees "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rjlq.label: National Market Segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rjlq.definition: The national segment refers to a portion of the market that is focused on consumers and businesses within the entire geographical boundaries of a specific country. This segment encompasses products, services, and marketing strategies that are tailored to meet the needs and preferences of the national population, regardless of regional differences.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rjmp.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Klamath County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rjmp.definition: Oregon Circuit Court - Klamath County: A specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system located in Klamath County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rjow.label: Ordinance Violation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rjow.definition: A violation of a local law or regulation, typically related to traffic, that is punishable by a fine or other penalty.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjpS.label: Audit Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjpS.definition: Audit practice refers to the systematic process of evaluating and examining an organization's records, processes, operations, and performance — ensuring compliance with laws, standards, and regulations. Audits can relate to many areas of law (e.g., Tax, Employment, Regulatory).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rjss.label: Project Plan
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rjss.definition: States a project's timging of deliverables, resource allocation, and activities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjyS.label: Veteran's Healthcare Coverage
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RjyS.definition: This is a type of healthcare program specifically designed for military veterans. In the U.S., the Veterans Health Administration (VHA) provides medical care to eligible veterans, which can include hospital care, outpatient services, and prescriptions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rjz4.label: Action for Commission on Exclusive Agency Listing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rjz4.definition: A legal claim made by a real estate agent or broker against another agent or broker for the commission earned on an exclusive agency listing.
english_labels: Action for Commission on Exclusive Agency Listing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rjzo.label: Wakashan languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rjzo.definition: Wakashan languages are a group of indigenous languages spoken in the Pacific Northwest region of North America, including languages such as Nuu-chah-nulth, Makah, and Kwak'wala.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rk1N.label: Deepfake Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rk1N.definition: A Deepfake Claim refers to a legal assertion involving the use of deepfake technology, which employs artificial intelligence to create or alter video and audio recordings to make them appear real. These claims often arise in the context of defamation, privacy violations, or copyright infringement, as deepfakes can be used to spread false information or unauthorized content.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rk5g.label: X116 Meals
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rk5g.definition: Any meals, whether local or associated with travel, payable by the client

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rk7I.label: JB00 Budgeting incl. costs estimates (UK J-CODE)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rk7I.definition: All work throughout the life of the case relating to budgeting and costs management, excluding the ‘costs assessment’ and ‘funding’ related work and preparation for and attendance at any costs management hearing, all of which have discrete phases.
english_labels: JB00 Budgeting incl. costs estimates (UK J-CODE)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkAx.label: Name Change Amendment Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkAx.definition: A Name Change Amendment Clause is a provision in a contract that allows for the modification of a party's name without invalidating the entire agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkBY.label: Motion to Limit Prior Art
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkBY.definition: A Motion to Limit Prior Art is a request made during a trial to restrict the evidence that can be presented by the opposing party to only certain prior art, in order to narrow the issues at trial.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkCa.label: "Material Adverse Effect" Definition - Exceptions - Announcement of Transaction
english_labels: "Material Adverse Effect" Definition - Exceptions - Announcement of Transaction

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkDY.label: Texas District Court - Angelina County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkDY.definition: A court located in Angelina County, Texas that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkDm.label: Shareholder
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkDm.definition: A shareholder, also referred to as a stockholder, is any person, company, or institution that owns at least one share of a company's stock (equity).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkF_.label: PA430 Official Communication - Domestic
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkF_.definition: All action associated with processing an Official Communication from a Patent Office (known as an "Office Action" in the U.S. when directed toward the merits of the application) in the home country of an application for an application filed under PA300, including initial review and any calendaring ("docketing" in the U.S.) of any response deadline, report to client with any proposed response, review of applicant's instructions and inventor's comments, preparation of amendments and/or responsive arguments, examiner interviews, and report of actions to the client. Includes activities associated with Official Communications not affecting the merits of the application, such as filing receipts, restriction/election requirements, and annuity/maintenance fee payments. Also includes "Petitions" and other requests for supervisory action that are not decided by a quasi-judicial appellate tribunal within the Patent Office, such as petitions to reinstate an abandoned application in the U.S.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkFj.label: Fishing Rights
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkFj.definition: These rights provide the holder with the privilege to catch fish in specific bodies of water. This can be governed by licenses, permits, or treaties, especially in areas with shared water resources.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkFq.label: Unfair Collection Practices
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkFq.definition: The concept of "Unfair Collection Practices" refers to any actions taken by debt collectors that are deemed to be abusive, deceptive, or unfair towards consumers, and can result in legal claims against the collectors.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkFw.label: Schizotypal Personality Disorder
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkFw.definition: Schizotypal Personality Disorder is characterized by a pervasive pattern of eccentric behavior, cognitive distortions, and discomfort with close relationships. Individuals with this disorder may exhibit odd beliefs, unusual perceptual experiences, and suspiciousness or paranoia, alongside a marked preference for social isolation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkI4.label: Arkansas District Court - White Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkI4.definition: A court located in White County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkIe.label: Manager
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkIe.definition: A Manager is an individual in an organization who has the responsibility of overseeing a team or a set of processes, making decisions, and ensuring that tasks and goals are successfully completed. Managers often have authority to make personnel decisions, allocate resources, and are accountable for the performance and outcomes of their team or department.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkJq.label: Motion for Discovery Sanctions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkJq.definition: A Motion for Discovery Sanctions is a legal request made by one party to the court asking for penalties or punishment against the opposing party for failing to comply with the rules of discovery during the pre-trial phase of a lawsuit.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkNV.label: Florida County Court - Martin County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkNV.definition: A court located in Martin County, Florida that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkSz.label: Job Interview
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkSz.definition: A job interview is a formalized conversation between a job applicant and a representative of an employing organization, aimed at assessing the applicant's suitability for a specific position. The process provides an opportunity for both the employer and the candidate to evaluate fit and compatibility.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkTW.label: Firm Marketing Personnel
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkTW.definition: Firm Marketing Personnel refers to individuals within a legal organization who are responsible for promoting the firm's services and brand, and who are not involved in the direct provision of legal services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkW2.label: Claims by Real Estate Agents and Brokers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkW2.definition: Claims by Real Estate Agents and Brokers refer to legal actions taken by these professionals in order to receive compensation for their services, such as commissions on exclusive listings or breach of implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing, in relation to property and premises liability claims.
english_labels: Claims by Real Estate Agents and Brokers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkWh.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Butler County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkWh.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Butler County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Butler County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkWx.label: X404 Hosting Fees- Internal
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkWx.definition: Any charges for hosting of electronic material typically associated with an application, database or data warehouse. May be on-site or off-site, but managed by the law firm or legal vendor. Excludes Data Storage Fees (X405).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkY3.label: Indemnification of Trustee Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkY3.definition: A provision in a contract that requires one party to compensate and protect a trustee from any losses or damages incurred while carrying out their duties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkYM.label: Motion for Examination
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkYM.definition: A Motion for Examination is a request made in a bankruptcy case for the debtor or other relevant parties to be examined under oath regarding their financial affairs.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkZE.label: Causation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkZE.definition: The concept of Causation refers to the relationship between an action or event and the resulting injury or harm, and is an essential element of a legal claim.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkZY.label: Fail-to-Pay-Timely Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkZY.definition: A fail-to-pay-timely claim is a legal action initiated by an employee against their employer for not providing timely payment of wages or other compensation. The claim typically arises when an employer does not comply with applicable laws, which require employers to pay employees their earned wages at regular intervals, such as weekly or bi-weekly. The claim can also include allegations of employers not paying earned commissions, bonuses, or other forms of compensation in a timely manner.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkbI.label: Police Misconduct
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkbI.definition: Police misconduct refers to wrongful or inappropriate actions committed by law enforcement officers while performing their duties. This misconduct can encompass a range of behaviors, including excessive use of force, racial profiling, false arrest, bribery, or other violations of laws, policies, or ethical standards. Cases of police misconduct may result in legal action against the officers involved, civil lawsuits, or disciplinary measures within the police department.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rkbs.label: Acts of God Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rkbs.definition: A provision in a contract that excuses a party's performance if an unforeseeable event beyond their control, such as a natural disaster, occurs.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkcD.label: Claim for Falling on Government Sidewalk
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkcD.definition: A claim for falling on a government sidewalk is a legal action brought by an individual who has suffered injuries due to a slip-and-fall incident caused by the negligence of a government entity responsible for maintaining the sidewalk.
english_labels: Claim for Falling on Government Sidewalk

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rkdu.label: Nottawaseppi Huron Band of the Potawatomi, Michigan
english_labels: Nottawaseppi Huron Band of the Potawatomi, Michigan

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkhU.label: L655 Privilege review
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkhU.definition: Activities and actions related to performing final privilege review and determination of documents, as well as all privilege log related work.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkhY.label: Drone
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkhY.definition: A Drone, or Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV), is an aircraft that operates without a human pilot on board, controlled either autonomously by onboard computers or by a remote control. Drones are utilized in various fields including military operations, commercial delivery services, aerial photography, and recreational activities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rkjs.label: Indiana Superior Court - Rush County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rkjs.definition: A court located in Rush County, Indiana that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rkjw.label: Arrest Warrant
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rkjw.definition: An arrest warrant is a legal document issued by a court authorizing law enforcement to arrest and detain an individual suspected of committing a crime.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rkkl.label: Soninke
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rkkl.definition: A language spoken primarily in West Africa, specifically in the countries of Mali, Senegal, and Mauritania, among others.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rkku.label: Succession Rights Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rkku.definition: A succession rights claim pertains to a legal action filed by a family member or household member seeking the right to continue residing in a rent-controlled or rent-stabilized apartment after the original tenant has vacated or passed away. In some jurisdictions, rent control or rent stabilization laws allow certain family members or individuals who have lived with the tenant for an extended period to succeed to the tenancy and maintain the regulated rent. Succession rights claims typically involve legal proceedings to determine eligibility and establish the successor's right to remain in the rental unit.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rkmw.label: Futures - Assets
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rkmw.definition: Futures are financial contracts obligating the buyer to purchase an asset or the seller to sell an asset and have a predetermined future date and price. A futures contract allows an investor to speculate on the direction of a security, commodity, or a financial instrument.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkoL.label: Traffic Ticket
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkoL.definition: A "Traffic Ticket" is a formal notice issued by a law enforcement officer to a motorist or other road user, indicating that the individual has violated traffic regulations. It typically requires the payment of a fine or an appearance in court to address the infraction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rkot.label: Canola
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rkot.definition: Canola is a type of oilseed crop derived from varieties of rapeseed (Brassica napus and Brassica rapa) that have been selectively bred to be low in erucic acid and glucosinolates. It is primarily grown for its oil, which is valued for its low saturated fat content and versatility in cooking and food production, as well as its use in biodiesel and industrial applications.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rkpu.label: WC160 Settlement/Resolution
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rkpu.definition: Activities directed specifically to settlement, planning/participation in settlement discussions, conferences/communications with attorney, adjuster and employer, preparing settlement analysis, mediation, preparing opening statement for mediation, traveling to/from mediation, attend mediation, any and all communication regarding settlement/mediation/other non-binding procedures, preparing /drafting compromise & release agreement and order, preparing/drafting/attending motion to enforce settlement agreements, prepare settlement stipulation, preparing medicare allocation/application to CMS for pre or post settlement approval

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rkqa.label: 320 Assault, Libel & Slander (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rkqa.definition: Action alleging intentional acts of assault, libel, trade libel or slander by a private party. (Excludes a government employee)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rkqn.label: Jewish Law System
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rkqn.definition: Jewish Law, also known as Halakha, is a legal system based on Jewish religious texts, including the Torah and Talmud. This system governs both religious and daily life aspects of observant Jews, integrating legal, ethical, and moral guidelines.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rkr4.label: PA240 Validity Investigation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rkr4.definition: All actions associated with determining whether a patent claim is invalid including definition of the scope and field of search, searching, analysis of search results, and reporting the search results to the client. A validity search attempts to locate "prior art" documents and/or other information that were not considered during the examination of the corresponding patent application but appear to disclose the features recited in a patent claim. The field of the search can vary widely depending upon the technology under consideration. Work of outside vendors in conducting searches or otherwise assisting the investigation should be an expense under E100. Any formal invalidity opinion should be prepared separately under PA710.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rkso.label: Document Comparison Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rkso.definition: Document Comparison Management refers to the process of managing and analyzing differences between two or more versions of a document, within the context of document management.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RktL.label: Parent-Child Liability
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RktL.definition: The legal concept of Parent-Child Liability refers to the responsibility of a parent for the actions or debts of their child, within the context of Family Liability.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rktz.label: Huntington's Disease
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rktz.definition: Huntington's disease is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by the gradual onset of motor dysfunction, cognitive decline, and psychiatric symptoms due to the degeneration of neurons in the basal ganglia. It is caused by a genetic mutation in the HTT gene, leading to a typical onset in middle adulthood and requiring ongoing medical and supportive care.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkuD.label: Tax Invoice Client ID
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkuD.definition: A Tax Invoice Client ID is a specific detail included in a fee invoice for legal services provided to a client, which identifies the client for tax purposes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkvR.label: Neurodegenerative Disorders of the Central Nervous System
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkvR.definition: Neurodegenerative disorders of the central nervous system involve the progressive degeneration or death of nerve cells (neurons) in the brain and spinal cord. These disorders are characterized by gradual loss of cognitive, motor, or autonomic functions due to the progressive nature of neuronal damage.
english_labels: Neurodegenerative Disorders of the Central Nervous System

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkxV.label: TR220 Registerability Investigation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkxV.definition: All actions associated with determining the initial availability and registerability of a particular trademark, including the definition of the scope of protection, searching, analyzing search results, and reporting results to the client. Also known as a "knock out" search, or 'preliminary' search, it is the most general type of trademark search which usually encompasses a review of trademark registry records, such as pending trademark applications, active trademark registrations, and abandoned trademark applications and registrations. Preliminary searches are conducted to determine if a full clearance investigation is warranted under TR230. Work of outside vendors in conducting searches or otherwise assisting the investigation should be an expense under E100. Any formal opinion should be prepared under TR710.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkyE.label: Arkansas District Court - Franklin Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RkyE.definition: Arkansas District Court - Franklin Cty. is a specific court within the Arkansas District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Franklin County, Arkansas.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rkze.label: Monitor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rkze.definition: Under Canadian Companies' Creditors Arrangement Act (CCAA), a Monitor is an independent third party who is appointed by the Court to monitor the company's ongoing operations and assist with the filing and voting on the Plan of Arrangement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rl2e.label: A114 Communicate (experts)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rl2e.definition: Any communication by letter, fax, email, telephone, meetings and conferences with experts associated with the legal matter

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rl3n.label: Stipulation to Approve Document
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rl3n.definition: A Stipulation to Approve Document is a legal agreement between parties that acknowledges the acceptance and approval of a written or recorded representation of thought or expression.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rl6P.label: "'Reasonably likely/expected violation' of fiduciary duties" Language
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rl6P.definition: A "reasonably likely/expected violation" of fiduciary duties refers to a breach of the legal obligation to act in the best interest of another party, which is anticipated or probable based on the circumstances and facts at hand, and may arise in the context of a no-shop covenant, an intervening event, or a superior offer.
english_labels: "'Reasonably likely/expected violation' of fiduciary duties" Language

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rl6f.label: Food Poisoning Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rl6f.definition: A food poisoning claim is a legal action seeking compensation for harm caused by consuming contaminated food, falling under the broader categories of personal injury claims and food liability claims.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rl85.label: Non-Solicitation of Employees Covenant
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rl85.definition: A "Non-Solicitation of Employees Covenant" is a contractual provision where one party agrees not to approach, recruit, or hire the other party's employees for a specified duration. This type of covenant is often used in employment contracts, business sale agreements, and partnership agreements to prevent the departure of key personnel and to protect an organization's human resources from being poached by competitors or other entities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rl8M.label: Adult Dependent Abuse
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rl8M.definition: The mistreatment or harm inflicted upon an adult who is dependent on another person for care or support, such as an elderly or disabled individual, by a caregiver or family member.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlBJ.label: Fraud Permitting Reformation or Rescission
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlBJ.definition: Fraud Permitting Reformation or Rescission: A legal claim that allows for the modification or cancellation of a contract due to fraudulent behavior by one of the parties involved.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlCS.label: O-1B Visa
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlCS.definition: An O-1B visa is issued to individuals with extraordinary ability in the arts or those who have demonstrated extraordinary achievement in the motion picture or television industry, evidenced by sustained national or international acclaim. This visa allows them to enter the U.S. to work in their field of artistic or entertainment expertise.
english_labels: Exceptional Talent Visa In Arts Or Entertainment

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlDw.label: Attorney Fees
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlDw.definition: Attorney Fees refer to the compensation paid to a lawyer for their legal services, which can be shifted to the losing party in a lawsuit or calculated based on the benefit or value provided to the client.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlGj.label: Information Statement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlGj.definition: An Information Statement is a document that provides material information about corporate matters that require shareholder action but do not necessitate a shareholder meeting. It is often distributed prior to corporate actions like spin-offs or large asset sales.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlGo.label: Grant of Rights Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlGo.definition: A Grant of Rights Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the rights being granted by one party to another.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlGr.label: PA310 Provisional Application Preparation - Domestic
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlGr.definition: All actions associated with completing a provisional patent application that is to be filed in the ("domestic") home country or region of the applicant, including review of invention disclosure materials and prior art, interviews with the inventors, drafting and revision of application, preparation and execution of formal documentation (such as assignments, transmittals, and biological deposits), filing of application, and reporting to the client. Note that government fees and external expenses (or "disbursements" in the U.S.) are included under E100.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlJ0.label: Covered Business Method Review
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlJ0.definition: A Covered Business Method Review (CBM) is a type of administrative dispute proceeding practice conducted by the U.S. Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlJr.label: Yupik languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlJr.definition: Yupik languages are a group of indigenous languages spoken in Alaska and Siberia, characterized by complex inflectional systems and polysynthetic word formation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlKG.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Chester County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlKG.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Chester County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within Chester County, Pennsylvania.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Chester County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlNF.label: Objectives
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlNF.definition: Specific aims, goals, arguments, plans, intentions, designs, purposes, schemes, etc. that are constructed by a party in a legal matter, and the legal or other professional frameworks that support their execution.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlNd.label: oasis:agent collection
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlNd.definition: A collection of agents within the OASIS standard framework.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlOH.label: Asset Disposition Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlOH.definition: Asset Disposition Practice refers to the legal practice area that deals with the management and disposal of assets in the context of bankruptcy and financial restructuring, including the sale and abandonment of assets.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlOK.label: Bankruptcy Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlOK.definition: A Bankruptcy Agreement is a legal document that outlines the terms and conditions of an agreement between a debtor and creditor in a bankruptcy or restructuring proceeding.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlPU.label: TR240 Opposition Investigation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlPU.definition: All actions associated with investigating a claim or potential claim of trademark opposition, trademark infringement or trademark dilution before a trademark office tribunal, including definition of the scope of the investigation, searching, analyzing the search results, and reporting the search results to the client. Work of outside vendors in conducting searches or otherwise assisting the investigation should be an expense under E100. This code set is for determining the facts and recommendations of an opposition matter. Any formal opinion should be prepared under TR710. Any subsequent work completed in a contested matter would be completed under TR440 or TR640 respectively.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlRM.label: Surgery Malpractice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlRM.definition: Surgery Malpractice refers to a type of medical malpractice claim that arises from a surgical procedure that was performed negligently or incompetently, resulting in harm to the patient.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlTX.label: California Superior Court - Fresno Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlTX.definition: California Superior Court - Fresno Cty. is a specific court located in Fresno County, California that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographic area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlU4.label: Termination With Cause Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlU4.definition: A Termination With Cause Clause is a provision in a contract that allows one party to end the agreement if the other party breaches a specific condition or obligation outlined in the contract.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlV3.label: Response to Cross-Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlV3.definition: A response made by a party to a cross-claim filed against them, which is a type of legal document that is filed in response to a claim made by another party in a lawsuit.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlVw.label: Escape from Correctional Facility
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlVw.definition: The act of leaving a correctional facility without authorization, which is considered a crime against the government.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlY5.label: Disfigurement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlY5.definition: Disfigurement refers to a physical impairment or alteration of a person's appearance resulting from an injury or accident, which may lead to emotional distress and loss of self-esteem.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlZP.label: Antitrust - Horizontal Price Fixing Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlZP.definition: A claim made in a legal matter alleging that competitors in the same industry colluded to set prices at a certain level, in violation of antitrust laws.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlZd.label: Authorship
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlZd.definition: Authorship, particularly human authorship in copyright law, designates the creation of a work by a human being, attributing legal rights and responsibilities to the creator. This principle recognizes the human creator as the source of intellectual creativity and grants them exclusive rights over their work.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlZd.label: X306 Discovery/eDiscovery Evidence/Exhibit Creation and Preparation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlZd.definition: Any services associated with the creation, export or delivery of trial evidence or exhibits including: creation of video clips and other demonstrative evidence from the collection when billed as an expense instead of a service.
english_labels: X306 Discovery/eDiscovery Evidence/Exhibit Creation and Preparation

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rlbq.label: Hindu Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rlbq.definition: Hindu Law is a traditional legal system governing personal matters of Hindus, primarily based on ancient scriptures like the Dharmashastra and customs followed over time.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rlek.label: Nonsolicitation Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rlek.definition: A Nonsolicitation Agreement is a legal contract between parties that prohibits one party from soliciting or hiring employees or customers of the other party for a specified period of time.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rlen.label: matter_total_detail_exp
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rlen.definition: "Sum of all EXPENSE.total_amounts billed to this matter/invoice. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rlff.label: 870 Taxes (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rlff.definition: Action filed under the Internal Revenue Code (General)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlgF.label: Municipal Liability
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RlgF.definition: Municipal Liability refers to the legal responsibility of a city or other local government entity for the actions or omissions of its employees or agents, which may result in harm or damages to individuals or property.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rlic.label: Realization
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rlic.definition: Measures the percentage of billed or invoiced work that is actually turned into revenue. It is calculated by dividing the actual revenue received by the potential revenue based on billable hours, helping firms assess the effectiveness of their billing and collection practices, as well as client payment behavior.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RljZ.label: Country of Citizenship
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RljZ.definition: Country of Citizenship refers to the nation with which an individual holds legal membership, often acquired by birth, descent, or naturalization. This information is important for legal, immigration, and governmental matters, and is usually indicated on passports and other official identification documents.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rlkd.label: Motion in Limine
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rlkd.definition: A Motion in Limine is a pretrial motion requesting the court to exclude certain evidence or testimony that may be prejudicial or irrelevant to the case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RllR.label: Supplemental Brief
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RllR.definition: A supplemental brief is a written document submitted to an appellate court that provides additional information or arguments in support of a previously filed appellate brief.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rlmy.label: Infringement Analysis Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rlmy.definition: The Infringement Analysis Practice is a legal process that involves investigating and analyzing facts related to potential infringement of intellectual property rights.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rlt4.label: Vicarious Copyright Infringement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rlt4.definition: Vicarious Copyright Infringement refers to a situation where a person is held liable for copyright infringement committed by another person, even if they did not directly commit the infringement themselves.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rlt5.label: Kenaf
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rlt5.definition: Kenaf is a fast-growing annual plant cultivated for its fiber, which is used in the production of paper, textiles, and biodegradable composites. Known for its high biomass yield and environmental benefits, kenaf serves as a sustainable alternative to traditional raw materials in various industries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rlwi.label: Maori
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rlwi.definition: Maori (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the indigenous people of New Zealand, and is used in legal matters related to this culture.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rm51.label: Sex Offender Registration
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rm51.definition: Sex offender registration is a system in which individuals convicted of certain sexual offenses are required to register their personal details, including current address and nature of their offense, with a designated government authority. This registration is typically made available to the public, either in part or in full, with the intent of informing communities about the presence of individuals who might pose a risk, and to aid law enforcement in monitoring and managing these individuals.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rm55.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Carter County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rm55.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Carter County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Carter County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rm6A.label: X120 Title Insurance Costs
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rm6A.definition: Any Title Service, examination and abstract costs

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rm7f.label: Chechen
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rm7f.definition: A language spoken by the Chechen people, primarily in the Chechen Republic of the Russian Federation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rm86.label: Terms of Service
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rm86.definition: Terms of Service are rules and regulations that users must agree to in order to use a service or product, typically provided online. They set forth the legal and operational boundaries of the user's relationship with the service provider.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmC8.label: X307 Electronic Media Cost
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmC8.definition: Material cost only, whether CD, DVD, hard drive or other device used to move a data collection. Excludes hardware not used to move a data collection (X403).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmCC.label: Right
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmCC.definition: A right is a moral, social, or legal entitlement to perform or refrain from certain actions, or to be in a certain state, often protected and enforceable by law.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmCE.label: Entity Disclosure Document
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmCE.definition: A Entity Disclosure Document is a formal document in which an entity discloses specific information, often financial or operational, to regulators, investors, or the public. These documents are generated to comply with regulatory requirements and to provide transparency in corporate activities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmDP.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Hancock County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmDP.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Hancock County: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that hears civil and criminal cases within the geographical boundaries of Hancock County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmEM.label: Florida Circuit Court - Hendry County - 20th Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmEM.definition: A court located in Hendry County, Florida that is part of the 20th Circuit Court system.
english_labels: Florida Circuit Court - Hendry County - 20th Circuit Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmGW.label: Independent Contractor Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmGW.definition: An Independent Contractor Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the relationship between a company and an individual who is not an employee, but rather an independent contractor hired to perform specific services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmGr.label: Oregon Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmGr.definition: The Oregon Circuit Court is a court of general jurisdiction in the state of Oregon that hears civil and criminal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmIm.label: Critical Claims Motion
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmIm.definition: A Critical Claims Motion is a legal request made in a bankruptcy case that seeks to prioritize certain claims over others, often due to their importance or urgency.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmKG.label: Railroad Rolling Stock Manufacturing Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmKG.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) manufacturing and/or rebuilding locomotives, locomotive frames and parts; (2) manufacturing railroad, street, and rapid transit cars and car equipment for operation on rails for freight and passenger service; and (3) manufacturing rail layers, ballast distributors, rail tamping equipment and other railway track maintenance equipment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmL6.label: Georgia District Court - Bibb County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmL6.definition: A court located in Bibb County, Georgia that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmLd.label: L690 Project Management (NOS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmLd.definition: "NOS" = Not Otherwise Specified (catch-all, includes the subcategories). Activities or actions to associated with supervising or managing specific activities or actions throughout the EDRM continuum such as conducting meetings and team calls, developing work plans, budgets, forecasts, reports and other meaningful activities or for general project management not associated with a particular "L" code. Primarily charges on a hourly or a flat/fixed fee basis.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmNn.label: Petition for Visa for Specialized Knowledge Worker
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmNn.definition: Petition for Visa for Specialized Knowledge Worker (in the U.S., L-1B petition) refers to the process of applying for a visa for intracompany transferees with specialized knowledge who are being transferred from a foreign office to a U.S. office within the same company. In the United States, employers must file a Form I-129 petition with U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS), providing evidence of the employee's specialized knowledge and meeting other eligibility criteria for the L-1B visa. If approved, the employee can work in the U.S. for the sponsoring employer for a specified period
english_labels: Petition for Visa for Specialized Knowledge Worker

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmO3.label: NATO-2 Visa
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmO3.definition: A NATO-2 visa is issued to representatives of NATO, including civilian employees, who are stationed in the U.S. for official duties, along with their immediate family members. This visa category also includes dependents and staff members accompanying the representatives.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmPb.label: Car Allowance Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmPb.definition: A car allowance clause is a provision in a contract that provides for a specific amount of money to be paid to an employee for the use of their personal vehicle for work-related purposes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmQm.label: Georgia Superior Court - Peach County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmQm.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Peach County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Peach County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmR7.label: TR510 Application Preparation and Filing - International
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmR7.definition: All actions associated with completing a trademark, service mark or design mark application (including renewal applications) that is to be filed in a jurisdiction outside the home country or region of the applicant, including obtaining the power of attorney, translations if necessary, obtaining supporting information and documentation from the client, discussing priority filings with the client, drafting and revision of the application, preparation and filing of the application, and reporting the results to the client. This section includes all international national applications, regional applications (such as a CTM or Benelux application), and marks filed under WIPO (Madrid Agreement and Madrid Protocol). Note that government fees and external expenses (or "disbursements" in the U.S.) are included under E100.
english_labels: TR510 Application Preparation and Filing - International

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmVA.label: Standardized Contractual Terms
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmVA.definition: Standardized Contractual Terms refer to contract specifications that are uniform and predefined, including the underlying instruments, exercise price, expiration date, and contract size. These standardized options facilitate trading on specialized option exchanges, providing greater liquidity, transparency, and regulatory oversight.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmVq.label: Legal Services Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmVq.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in offering legal services, such as those offered by offices of lawyers, offices of notaries, and title abstract and settlement offices, and paralegal services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmWz.label: Phoenician
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmWz.definition: Phoenician (Language) is a historical written and spoken structured system of communication used by the ancient Phoenician civilization.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmXv.label: Coronary Artery Disease
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmXv.definition: Ischemic heart disease (IHD), also known as coronary artery disease (CAD), is a condition characterized by reduced blood flow to the heart muscle due to the narrowing or blockage of coronary arteries. It manifests through symptoms such as angina pectoris (chest pain), myocardial infarction (heart attack), and may require interventions like coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) or percutaneous coronary interventions (PCI).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmZK.label: A128 Collection Closing Activities
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmZK.definition: Closing activities related to a Discovery or eDiscovery collection.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmZv.label: Walker River Paiute Tribe of the Walker River Reservation, Nevada
english_labels: Walker River Paiute Tribe of the Walker River Reservation, Nevada

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rmaf.label: National Legislator
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rmaf.definition: A National Legislator is an elected or appointed official who serves as a member of a country's national law-making body. This individual is responsible for proposing, debating, and voting on national laws and policies, representing constituents or regions at the federal level, and providing oversight of the executive branch.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmbI.label: Peremptory Challenge of Judge
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmbI.definition: A peremptory challenge of judge is a request made by a party in a legal case to remove a judge from the case without providing a reason or cause for the removal.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rmbe.label: X117 Court and Governmental Agency Fees
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rmbe.definition: Any court or governmental agency fees, including UCC, land record filings and property tax. Excludes late fees (X122), publication costs (X123) and patent and trademark filing fees (X203, X204 and X205).
english_labels: X117 Court and Governmental Agency Fees

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rmbq.label: DEPRECATED Offsite Employment - in favor of `Remote Employment`
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rmbq.definition: Offsite Employment refers to a work arrangement where an employee performs job duties at a location other than the employer's primary facilities, such as at a client's office or a separate project site. While offsite employees may have some degree of autonomy, they likely still fall under the employer's oversight and policies.
english_labels: DEPRECATED Offsite Employment - in favor of `Remote Employment`

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmdT.label: Limes
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmdT.definition: Limes are small, green citrus fruits from the Citrus aurantiifolia and Citrus latifolia species, known for their tart, acidic juice and aromatic zest. They are widely used in culinary applications, beverages, and as a garnish, valued for their distinctive flavor and high vitamin C content.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmfS.label: Public Company
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmfS.definition: Company whose stock is publicly available on a public stock exchange, as recognized by the relevant jurisdictions' authority — as well as a private company that are required by relevant legal authorities to make public disclosures (e.g., operations, finance).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmhQ.label: Synthetic Lease
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmhQ.definition: A Synthetic Lease is a financial arrangement that allows a company to lease an asset while maintaining the benefits of ownership for tax purposes, such as depreciation, without having the asset appear on the balance sheet as a liability. This structure is typically used for real estate or large equipment to improve financial ratios by keeping debt off the balance sheet.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rmhy.label: Freddie Mac
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rmhy.definition: Freddie Mac, officially known as the Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (FHLMC), is a government-sponsored enterprise (GSE) in the United States that buys mortgages from lenders and securitizes them into mortgage-backed securities. Established to increase the availability of mortgage funds, Freddie Mac plays a crucial role in the secondary mortgage market by providing liquidity, stability, and affordability.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmiM.label: Lending Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmiM.definition: A transaction whereby property is lent or given to another on condition of return or, where the loan is of money, repayment. In a loan of money, the money lent becomes the property of the borrower during the period of the loan against an undertaking to return a sum of an equivalent amount either on demand or on a specified date or in accordance with an agreed schedule of repayments.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmiY.label: Export Control Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmiY.definition: An Export Control Claim arises when an individual or entity is accused of violating regulations that govern the export, re-export, and transfer of controlled goods, technology, and services. This claim involves allegations of unauthorized exports, failure to obtain necessary licenses, or exporting to prohibited destinations or entities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rmlz.label: 850 Securities/Commodities/Exchange (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rmlz.definition: Action filed under Small Business Investment Act 15:681, Securities Exchange Act 15:78, Securities Act 15:77, Investment Advisers Act 15:80B(1-21)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmmL.label: DEPRECATED: Entry of Default
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmmL.definition: Deprecated as duplicative of `Entry of Default Judgment` https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RZDsWeBRdamDfrXlti4iv9

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rmo6.label: Severance Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rmo6.definition: A severance clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the terms and conditions under which the agreement may be terminated by one or both parties, typically addressing issues such as notice requirements, compensation, and benefits.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rmqy.label: Offering Document
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rmqy.definition: An Offering Document is a comprehensive legal document provided by a company or financial entity to potential investors, detailing the terms, conditions, and risks of the investment offering. This document, often used in private placements and public offerings, includes key information such as the company's business model, financial statements, management background, and details of the security being offered.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rmsk.label: Bankruptcy Schedule - Creditors with Unsecured Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rmsk.definition: Bankruptcy Schedule - Creditors with Unsecured Claims, also known as Schedule E/F, requires the debtor to list all creditors who hold unsecured claims against them. This schedule distinguishes between priority unsecured claims, which have a higher repayment priority under bankruptcy law, and non-priority unsecured claims, detailing the creditor's name, claim amount, and the nature of the claim.
english_labels: Bankruptcy Schedule - Creditors with Unsecured Claims

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmuN.label: Antitrust - Horizontal Market Allocation Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmuN.definition: Antitrust - Horizontal Market Allocation Claims refer to legal claims that allege agreements between competitors to divide markets or customers, which violate antitrust laws.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rmv3.label: No-Shop Covenant - Fiduciary Exception
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rmv3.definition: A No-Shop Covenant - Fiduciary Exception is a legal agreement that allows a target company's board of directors to consider alternative acquisition offers during a specified period, despite a prior agreement with an initial bidder, if the board determines that it is in the best interest of the company and its shareholders.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmwG.label: Minnesota District Court - Aitkin County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmwG.definition: Minnesota District Court - Aitkin County is a specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Aitkin County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rmwr.label: Condition Subsequent Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rmwr.definition: A condition subsequent clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the circumstances under which the contract may be terminated or modified by one or both parties after it has been executed.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmxU.label: Caselaw Research Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RmxU.definition: Caselaw Research Management refers to the process of organizing and analyzing legal cases for research purposes. It falls under the broader category of Legal Research.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rn0H.label: Executor and Administrator
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rn0H.definition: A person designated to serve as the legal representative of an estate.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rn2r.label: Texas District Court - Howard County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rn2r.definition: A Texas District Court located in Howard County, which has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rn7R.label: Deliberative Process Privilege
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rn7R.definition: The Deliberative Process Privilege is a legal protection that allows government agencies to withhold documents and communications that are part of the decision-making process, in order to encourage open and honest discussion and debate among officials.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rn9n.label: General Jurisdiction
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rn9n.definition: General Jurisdiction refers to a court's authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases, including those that are not related to a specific geographic location or personal connection to the court.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnA4.label: Individual Debtor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnA4.definition: An individual who owes money or other obligations to another party and is personally responsible for repayment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnCt.label: Medical Equipment and Supplies Manufacturing Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnCt.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing medical equipment and supplies. Examples of products made by these establishments are surgical and medical instruments, surgical appliances and supplies, dental equipment and supplies, orthodontic goods, ophthalmic goods, dentures, and orthodontic appliances.
english_labels: Medical Equipment and Supplies Manufacturing Industry

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnDe.label: Visa
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnDe.definition: A visa is an official document or endorsement that grants the holder permission to enter, stay, or leave a specific country for a specified period. It is usually stamped or affixed to the traveler's passport and may come with various conditions such as the purpose of the visit, duration of stay, and whether multiple entries are allowed

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnFp.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Schuylkill County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnFp.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Schuylkill County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in Schuylkill County, Pennsylvania.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Schuylkill County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnKW.label: Factual Statement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnKW.definition: A document's statement of fact (e.g., brief's recitation of facts, judicial findings of fact).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnNa.label: X130 Medical Records Costs
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnNa.definition: Costs for obtaining copies of medical records

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnOW.label: Stillaguamish Tribe of Indians of Washington
english_labels: Stillaguamish Tribe of Indians of Washington

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnSH.label: Administrative Proceeding Venues
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnSH.definition: Administrative Proceeding Venues are specific government entities or organizations that oversee and manage legal proceedings related to disputes, such as the U.S. Merit Systems Protection Board or the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnTN.label: Clean Air Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnTN.definition: A Clean Air Claim is a legal action brought under environmental law seeking to enforce or protect the right to clean air.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnVv.label: No Waiver Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnVv.definition: A No Waiver Clause is a provision in a contract that states that the failure to enforce a right or remedy does not constitute a waiver of that right or remedy.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnXg.label: Tendered Contract
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnXg.definition: A tendered contract is a legal defense in civil litigation where the defendant argues that they offered to perform a contract but the plaintiff refused to accept, thereby releasing the defendant from any further obligation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnY9.label: Multiple Myeloma
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnY9.definition: Multiple myeloma is a malignant disease of plasma cells that primarily affects the bone marrow and is characterized by the presence of abnormal plasma cells, leading to bone destruction, hypercalcemia, anemia, and renal impairment. Diagnosis is based on the presence of monoclonal protein in the blood or urine, clonal plasma cells in the bone marrow, and related organ or tissue impairment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnZ7.label: Hospitality - Real Estate Asset
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnZ7.definition: Real estate used in the hospitality industry including hotels, travel centers, water parks, amusement facilities, golf courses, etc.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rn_3.label: A123 Search Creation and Execution
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rn_3.definition: For discovery and eDiscovery, creation and execution of electronic document searches irrespective of source of document collection. Excludes legal research (A102).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnbR.label: X104 Special Handling Copying/Scanning/Imaging (Internal)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnbR.definition: Any special oversized copying, binding, scanning, imaging and photograph reproduction handled in-house which requires manual handling

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rnbu.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Cass County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rnbu.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Cass County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Cass County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RncN.label: Sporting Goods, Hobby, Musical Instrument, Book, and Miscellaneous Retailers Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RncN.definition: Industries in the Sporting Goods, Hobby, Musical Instrument, Book, and Miscellaneous Retailers subsector retail new sporting goods; new toys, games, and hobby supplies; new sewing supplies and needlework accessories; new musical instruments; new books, newspapers, magazines, and other periodicals; and other specialized lines of merchandise, such as cut flowers and floral arrangements, new office supplies and stationery, new gifts, novelty merchandise, and souvenirs, used merchandise, pets and pet supplies, art, new or used manufactured (mobile) homes, and tobacco, electronic cigarettes, and other smoking supplies.
english_labels: Sporting Goods, Hobby, Musical Instrument, Book, and Miscellaneous Retailers Industry

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rnfz.label: Revenue Metrics
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rnfz.definition: Metrics that provide a quantitative measure of the total income generated through various forms of engagement, offering valuable insights into financial health and growth opportunities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnhX.label: TR260 Enforcement Investigation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnhX.definition: All actions associated with investigating a claim or potential claim of trademark infringement, dilution or unfair competition before a court of jurisdiction, including definition of the scope of the investigation, searching, analyzing the search results, and reporting the search results to the client. Work of outside vendors in conducting searches or otherwise assisting the investigation should be an expense under E100. This code set is for determining the facts and recommendations of an enforcement matter. Any subsequent work completed in a contested matter would be expensed under general litigation codes. Any formal opinion should be prepared under TR710.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnhX.label: 05_2 Prisoner Petitions: Other (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RnhX.definition: 05_2 Prisoner Petitions: Other (PACER NoS) refers to a specific category of legal cases filed by prisoners that do not fall under other PACER Nature of Suit Codes, such as mandamus, civil rights, or prison conditions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rnhi.label: Clear and Convincing Evidence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rnhi.definition: Clear and Convincing Evidence is a standard of proof that requires evidence to be highly and substantially more probable to be true than not, and leaves no serious or substantial doubt in the mind of the factfinder.
