This right is often protected by international instruments like the International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights and national labor laws, which may set minimum wage standards and regulate working conditions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rsgo.label: Creoles and pidgins, English based
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rsgo.definition: A type of language that is based on English but has developed from a mixture of different languages and is used as a means of communication between people who do not share a common language.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RsjS.label: Invoice Total Net Due
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RsjS.definition: The "Invoice Total Net Due" is a specific type of fee invoice detail that represents the total amount owed by the client after all deductions and adjustments have been made.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RskH.label: Confusing Language in Written Contract
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RskH.definition: The concept of "Confusing Language in Written Contract" refers to the use of unclear or ambiguous terms in a written agreement, which may lead to disputes or misunderstandings between the parties involved.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rslx.label: Public Defender
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rslx.definition: A public defender is a lawyer appointed by the court to represent individuals who cannot afford to hire their own legal counsel.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RsmQ.label: Drafting Tools and Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RsmQ.definition: Drafting Tools and Management refers to the process of creating and organizing legal documents using various tools and techniques, and falls under the broader category of Document Management.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rsnk.label: Transfer Agent Services Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rsnk.definition: A Transfer Agent Services Agreement is a contract between a company and a transfer agent who manages the record-keeping of investor information, processes security transactions, and distributes dividends. The agreement outlines the services provided and compensation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RsqA.label: X141 Special Purpose Moving and Storage Fees
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RsqA.definition: Any costs for moving and storage of physical objects; typically associated with a trial. Excludes internal data storage fees (X405).
english_labels: X141 Special Purpose Moving and Storage Fees

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rss8.label: Insanity Defense
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rss8.definition: The insanity defense is a legal strategy in which a defendant claims that they were not criminally responsible for their actions at the time of the alleged crime due to a severe mental disorder or illness. If successful, this defense can result in the defendant being found not guilty by reason of insanity or being committed to a psychiatric institution rather than being subject to criminal penalties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RssA.label: Lack of Authentication Objection
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RssA.definition: A Lack of Authentication Objection is raised when a party attempts to introduce evidence without providing sufficient proof that the evidence is genuine and authentic. This objection asserts that the party offering the evidence has not met the necessary burden to establish that the evidence is what it purports to be.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RstH.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Juniata County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RstH.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Juniata County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in the state of Pennsylvania.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Juniata County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rswi.label: 380 Other Personal Property Damage (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rswi.definition: Action primarily based on damage to personal property caused by harmful conduct such as negligence, misrepresentation, interference with business relationships or unfair trade practices.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rsz1.label: Cherokee
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rsz1.definition: A Native American language spoken primarily in the southeastern United States, particularly in the Cherokee Nation and among members of the Cherokee diaspora.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rsz9.label: Application to Designate Responsible Individual
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rsz9.definition: An Application to Designate Responsible Individual is a legal document filed in the context of bankruptcy proceedings, which allows for the appointment of an individual to oversee the administration of the debtor's estate.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RszU.label: Payment Advices
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RszU.definition: Payment Advices (Employment Pay Stubs) are written or electronic documents provided by an employer to an employee that show the details of their pay, including deductions and taxes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rt0J.label: Treaty Investor Visa
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rt0J.definition: The Treaty Investor Visa is a type of visa offered by various countries to foreign nationals who intend to invest a significant amount of capital in the host country's economy. The visa is usually part of bilateral treaties between the host country and the investor's home country, aimed at encouraging economic cooperation and foreign investment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rt1I.label: Motion to Enforce Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rt1I.definition: A Motion to Enforce Agreement is a legal request made by one party to a court to compel the other party to comply with the terms of a previously agreed upon settlement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rt2A.label: Subsidiary
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rt2A.definition: A Subsidiary is a company that is owned or controlled by another company, known as the parent company or holding company. The parent company holds a controlling interest in the subsidiary, typically through ownership of more than 50% of its voting stock, allowing it to influence the subsidiary's management and operations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rt4K.label: Designation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rt4K.definition: A designation refers to a specific identification or name given to a legal document or filing, and is a subcategory of Appellate Filings - Correspondence and Forms.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rt4T.label: Comparative Negligence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rt4T.definition: A legal theory that allows for the apportionment of damages between parties based on their respective degrees of fault or negligence in causing harm or injury.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rt5D.label: Motion to Reject Lease or Executory Contract
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rt5D.definition: A Motion to Reject Lease or Executory Contract is a request made in a bankruptcy case to terminate a lease or contract that is burdensome to the debtor's estate.
english_labels: Motion to Reject Lease or Executory Contract

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rt5F.label: Office of Compliance
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rt5F.definition: The Office of Compliance (OOC) is a specific administrative proceeding venue responsible for ensuring compliance with workplace laws and regulations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rt6K.label: Failure to State a Cause of Action
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rt6K.definition: The failure to state a cause of action is a defense in civil litigation where the plaintiff's complaint does not contain sufficient facts to support a legal claim.
english_labels: Failure to State a Cause of Action

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rt7T.label: Beneficiary
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rt7T.definition: A beneficiary is an individual or entity designated to receive benefits, assets, or proceeds from a legal matter, including those of an estate, trust, insurance policy, or other financial or legal instruments. The term is commonly used in legal and financial contexts to specify who will benefit from a particular financial arrangement or legal structure.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rt7y.label: Nutrition Market Segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rt7y.definition: The nutrition market segment refers to a division of the market that is specifically targeted towards consumers who are interested in dietary and nutritional health. This segment encompasses products, services, and marketing strategies that are designed to cater to the needs, preferences, and interests of individuals who seek to maintain or improve their health through balanced and healthy eating habits, dietary supplements, and nutrition-focused products.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rt9c.label: Patent Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rt9c.definition: The management of patents, including their acquisition, maintenance, and enforcement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtCu.label: Marwari
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtCu.definition: Marwari is a language spoken in the Indian state of Rajasthan and surrounding areas.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtGO.label: International Market Segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtGO.definition: The international segment refers to a market that spans across multiple countries or regions. It targets a global audience and is characterized by marketing strategies and product offerings that cater to diverse international preferences and regulations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtGb.label: Shoalwater Bay Indian Tribe of the Shoalwater Bay Indian Reservation
english_labels: Shoalwater Bay Indian Tribe of the Shoalwater Bay Indian Reservation

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtGn.label: Sault Ste. Marie Tribe of Chippewa Indians
english_labels: Sault Ste. Marie Tribe of Chippewa Indians

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtHk.label: Vital Status
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtHk.definition: Vital Status refers to the current state of being either alive or deceased for an individual person.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtJU.label: Proceeding Reactivated
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtJU.definition: The concept of "Case Reactivated" refers to a legal matter that was previously closed or pending, but has now been reopened or resumed.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtKp.label: Analysis of KEIPs and KERPs
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtKp.definition: Analysis of KEIPs and KERPs refers to the examination and evaluation of key employee incentive plans and key employee retention plans in order to determine their effectiveness and impact on employee retention within an organization.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtLC.label: Peripheral Neuropathy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtLC.definition: Peripheral neuropathy refers to a range of disorders caused by damage to the peripheral nerves, which are the nerves outside the brain and spinal cord. This condition often results in symptoms such as pain, numbness, tingling, and weakness, typically affecting the extremities like the hands and feet.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtNd.label: Immigrant Petition for Alien Worker
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtNd.definition: The Immigrant Petition for Alien Worker (in the U.S., I-140 Petition), is a form filed with to initiate the employment-based Permanent Resident (in the U.S., green card) process for a foreign worker. In the United States, this petition is typically filed by the employer to demonstrate that there is a valid job offer and that the foreign worker meets the qualifications for the specific employment-based preference category. For PERM-based I-140 petitions, the employer must first obtain a Labor Certification (PERM) from the U.S. Department of Labor to demonstrate that there are no qualified U.S. workers available for the job position. Once the I-140 is approved, the foreign worker can move forward with the final steps of the green card process, including waiting for a visa number to become available in the relevant preference category

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtOq.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Huntingdon County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtOq.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Huntingdon County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in Huntingdon County, Pennsylvania.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Huntingdon County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtQP.label: Dzongkha
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtQP.definition: Dzongkha is a written or spoken structured system of communication that is the official language of Bhutan.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtQg.label: Appraiser
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtQg.definition: An expert who conducts an appraisal.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtSJ.label: Bankruptcy Applications
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtSJ.definition: Bankruptcy Applications are written requests submitted to a court by individuals or entities seeking relief from their debts and financial obligations under the Bankruptcy and Restructuring Document.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtSe.label: Current Legal Efficacy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtSe.definition: Property of a Legal Authority, annotating whether that authority (e.g., caselaw, statute, rule, regulation) is currently effective, or whether it is obsolete (e.g., overruled judicial opinion, superseded statute).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtSn.label: Mammals
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtSn.definition: Mammals are a class of vertebrate animals characterized by the presence of mammary glands which produce milk for feeding their young, hair or fur, and a neocortex region in the brain. Mammals are warm-blooded and include a wide range of species from terrestrial to aquatic environments, such as humans, elephants, and whales.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtUC.label: MAE-Based Antitrust Standard
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtUC.definition: A MAE-Based Antitrust Standard is a legal concept that sets limitations on antitrust efforts based on the occurrence of a material adverse effect, which is a significant negative change in the financial condition or business operations of a company.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtVE.label: Bonded Labor Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtVE.definition: A bonded labor claim alleges that an individual is forced to work under a debt or other obligation that they cannot repay and that limits their freedom. This practice is a form of modern-day slavery and is illegal under international law and in many national jurisdictions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtYo.label: Sjögren’s Syndrome
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtYo.definition: Sjögren's syndrome is an immune-mediated disorder of the exocrine glands. Involvement of the lacrimal and salivary glands is the hallmark feature, resulting in symptoms of dry eyes and dry mouth, and possible complications, such as corneal damage, blepharitis (eyelid inflammation), dysphagia (difficulty in swallowing), dental caries, and the inability to speak for extended periods of time. Involvement of the exocrine glands of the upper airways may result in persistent dry cough.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtZO.label: CLIENT_ADDRESS_1
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtZO.definition: The concept CLIENT_ADDRESS_1 refers to the first line of the address of a client in the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard for legal electronic data exchange.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtZa.label: Court Fees Expense
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtZa.definition: Court Fees Expense refers to the costs incurred by a party in a legal matter for filing documents, motions, or other court-related activities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtZl.label: 152 Recovery of Defaulted Student Loans (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtZl.definition: Action to recover debt owed to the United States from defaulted student loan.
english_labels: 152 Recovery of Defaulted Student Loans (PACER NoS)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtcZ.label: Pedi; Sepedi; Northern Sotho
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtcZ.definition: African language spoken in South Africa, belonging to the Bantu language family and specifically to the Sotho-Tswana group.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtdK.label: Chappaquiddick Tribe of the Wampanoag Indian Nation
english_labels: Chappaquiddick Tribe of the Wampanoag Indian Nation

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rte2.label: Pretrial Release
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rte2.definition: Pretrial Release refers to the legal process of releasing a defendant from custody before their trial, subject to certain conditions such as bail or supervision, as a means of ensuring their appearance in court.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rthk.label: Reserved Power Clause Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rthk.definition: A Reserved Power Clause claim is a legal assertion related to the Tenth Amendment of the United States Constitution, which reserves to the states or the people any powers not specifically delegated to the federal government or prohibited to the states by the Constitution. This clause forms the basis of federalism, the division of power between the federal government and the states. A claim involving this clause typically arises when there is a dispute over whether a power exercised by the federal government infringes on powers reserved to the states or the people.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rtk1.label: Revenue Share Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rtk1.definition: A Revenue Share Agreement is a contractual arrangement where the parties agree to share a portion of the generated revenue from a specific project, product, or business venture. This type of agreement is often used in collaborative business models, joint ventures, or licensing deals to align the interests of the parties and distribute earnings based on their respective contributions or agreed-upon terms.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rtlb.label: County Governmental Representative
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rtlb.definition: A County Governmental Representative is an elected or appointed official who serves in a governmental body overseeing an area larger than a municipality but smaller than a state or province. This individual is responsible for policy-making, budget allocation, and administration of services for a specific region, such as a county, district, or prefecture.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtmR.label: Breach of Fiduciary Duty
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RtmR.definition: Breach of Fiduciary Duty refers to a situation where a person in a position of trust and confidence, such as a trustee, agent, or business partner, fails to act in the best interests of the other party and instead acts in their own self-interest, resulting in harm or loss to the other party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rtoq.label: Parathyroid Gland Disorders
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rtoq.definition: Parathyroid gland disorders affect the regulation of calcium levels in the body, influencing bone health, blood calcium levels, and nerve and muscle function. These disorders can lead to osteoporosis, fractures, hypercalcemia, kidney failure, and hypocalcemia with associated symptoms such as tetany and muscle spasms.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rtow.label: Material Adverse Effect Definition - "Relating to" Language
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rtow.definition: A Material Adverse Effect (MAE) Definition - "Relating to" Language refers to a clause in a contract that outlines the specific circumstances under which a party can terminate the agreement if there is a significant negative change in the other party's financial or business condition that affects the overall value of the contract.
english_labels: Material Adverse Effect Definition - "Relating to" Language

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rtpi.label: Term Extension Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rtpi.definition: A Term Extension Clause is a provision in a contract that allows for the extension of the agreement beyond its original expiration date.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rtqo.label: Mental Health Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rtqo.definition: Mental Health Services refer to the treatment and care provided to individuals with mental health conditions as a condition of their criminal disposition.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rtrx.label: Discovery Documents
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rtrx.definition: Discovery Documents are written or recorded evidence presented during a legal case, including responses to requests for admission, production, and interrogatories, witness statements, privilege logs, FOIA requests, subpoenas, requests for physical or mental examination, and deposition exhibits.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rtvg.label: X136 Appraiser/Appraisal Fees
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rtvg.definition: Any Appraiser's fees, appraisal costs or cost of an appraiser's report

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rtyq.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Adams County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rtyq.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Adams County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Adams County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ru0P.label: Motion to Withdraw Document
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ru0P.definition: A Motion to Withdraw Document is a formal request made to a court or other legal authority to remove a written or recorded representation of thought or expression from consideration in a legal proceeding.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ru41.label: Peppers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ru41.definition: Peppers are fruit vegetables from the Capsicum genus, known for their diverse flavors ranging from sweet to spicy. They are used in a wide array of culinary applications, valued for their vibrant colors, unique flavors, and nutritional benefits, including vitamins A and C and antioxidants.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ru4J.label: L629 Quality assurance and control
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ru4J.definition: Activities and actions related to ensuring that the process and practices used to perform analysis meet an acceptable level of defensibility.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ru4x.label: General Partnership
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ru4x.definition: A general partnership, the basic form of partnership under common law, is in most countries an association of persons or an unincorporated company with the following major features: must be created by agreement, proof of existence and estoppel; formed by two or more persons; the owners are jointly and severally liable for any legal actions and debts the company may face, unless otherwise provided by law or in the agreement. It is a partnership in which partners share equally in both responsibility and liability.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ru8I.label: Risk Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ru8I.definition: The concept of Risk Management refers to the process of identifying, assessing, and prioritizing potential risks that may affect a business or organization, and implementing strategies to mitigate or avoid those risks.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuBd.label: Minnesota District Court - Blue Earth County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuBd.definition: Minnesota District Court - Blue Earth County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system located in Blue Earth County.
english_labels: Minnesota District Court - Blue Earth County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuDA.label: Injury
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuDA.definition: An injury refers to damage or harm caused to the structure or function of the body, either due to external forces or internal causes. Injuries can be physical or emotional and can result from accidents, falls, hits, weapons, and other causes, leading to pain, discomfort, or disability.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuFY.label: Motion to Avoid Lien
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuFY.definition: A Motion to Avoid Lien is a legal request made in a bankruptcy case to remove a creditor's lien on a debtor's property, allowing the debtor to keep the property free and clear of the creditor's claim.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuFa.label: Cerebral Palsy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuFa.definition: Cerebral Palsy (CP) is a group of neurological disorders that affect movement, muscle tone, and posture, caused by damage to the developing brain either during pregnancy, childbirth, or shortly after birth. This condition leads to varying degrees of motor impairment and may also impact speech, vision, and cognitive abilities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuGC.label: X122 Late Fees
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuGC.definition: Any late fee imposed by a governmental or quasi-governmental agency in any type of matter in order to have a document entered into record past the initial deadline. For IP matters, includes including Petition for Extension of Time and Information Disclosure Statement fees in the US. Excludes any late fee or finance charge on overdue legal bills.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuGr.label: Intestate Status
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuGr.definition: The state of having died without a valid will or testamentary disposition of property, resulting in the distribution of the deceased's assets according to the laws of intestacy.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuIG.label: Demand Futility
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuIG.definition: Demand futility is a legal concept within corporate and partnership liability claims that allows shareholders to bring a lawsuit on behalf of the company without first making a demand on the board of directors if doing so would be futile.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuJb.label: Animal Authorship
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuJb.definition: Animal Authorship in copyright law addresses the concept of works created by animals, questioning whether such creations can qualify for copyright protection. It challenges traditional notions of authorship by considering the legal status and intellectual property rights of works produced by non-human beings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuJh.label: 371 Truth in Lending (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuJh.definition: Action alleging violation of the federal Truth in Lending Act arising from consumer loan transactions involving personal property including automobile loans and revolving credit accounts. Actions relating to fraud or misrepresentation in the transfer of real property should be classified under nature of suit 290, “All Other Real Property,” or, if foreclosure is involved, under nature of suit 220, “Foreclosure.”

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuJm.label: LAW_FIRM_MATTER_ID
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuJm.definition: A LAW_FIRM_MATTER_ID is a unique identifier assigned by a law firm to a specific matter, and is defined within the context of the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard for electronic billing.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuKm.label: Economic Experts
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuKm.definition: An expert in a monetary areas, including accounting, appraisal, damages, securities, and other areas of finance.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuL0.label: cl_tax_id
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuL0.definition: The client's tax id number to which law firm taxes are charged.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuNR.label: Subornation of Perjury
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuNR.definition: The act of persuading someone to commit perjury, which is giving false testimony under oath, with the intention of obstructing justice or misleading the court.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuOr.label: Claim Construction Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuOr.definition: Claim Construction Practice refers to the process of analyzing and interpreting the language used in patent claims to determine the scope of the invention, and is a subset of Fact Investigation and Development.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuQr.label: Non-Main Proceeding (Foreign Insolvency)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuQr.definition: A non-main proceeding in foreign insolvency is an ancillary insolvency case initiated in a jurisdiction other than where the debtor's center of main interests (COMI) is located. This proceeding handles local assets and operations, complementing the main proceeding by addressing regional concerns and facilitating cooperation in cross-border insolvency cases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuRx.label: X300 Discovery/eDiscovery Collection-Forensic
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuRx.definition: Any costs associated with the retrieval of collection materials for forensic purposes when billed as an expense instead of a service

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuTi.label: Noncompete Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuTi.definition: A Noncompete Agreement is a legal contract between an employer and an employee that restricts the employee from working for a competitor or starting a competing business for a certain period of time after leaving the employer.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuUe.label: Duration of the Contract Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuUe.definition: The Duration of the Contract Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the length of time that the agreement will remain in effect.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuVk.label: Sheriff
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuVk.definition: Official of a political subdivision who is charged with judicial duties, such as executing a court's processes and orders.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuWy.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Worth County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuWy.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Worth County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Worth County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuXA.label: Case Assessment, Development, Administration Documents
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuXA.definition: Documents related to the evaluation, creation, and management of legal cases, including but not limited to pleadings, motions, and discovery requests.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuXn.label: Lung Cancer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuXn.definition: Lung cancer is a type of cancer that begins in the lungs, often in the cells lining the air passages. It can be classified into different types, primarily non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and small cell lung cancer (SCLC), each requiring specific treatments such as surgery, chemotherapy, radiation therapy, and targeted therapy.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuYM.label: Target Stockholder Proceedings Language
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuYM.definition: Language used in legal proceedings related to disputes between target companies and their stockholders regarding Material Adverse Effect (MAE) definitions and carveouts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuYa.label: Commercially Reasonable Efforts Standard
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuYa.definition: The Commercially Reasonable Efforts Standard is a legal concept that refers to the level of effort that a party must exert in order to fulfill their obligations under a contract or agreement. This standard requires the party to act in a manner that is reasonable and consistent with industry practices and standards.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuZh.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Lasalle County (13th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Lasalle County (13th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuaU.label: Application for Trademark Registration
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuaU.definition: An Application for Trademark Registration is a formal request filed with a trademark office to secure legal protection for a specific logo, name, or symbol used in commerce. The application usually includes the name of the applicant, a representation of the trademark, the goods or services it will be used on, and a specimen showing the trademark as used in commerce.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rub2.label: Vegetable Crops
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rub2.definition: Vegetable Crops are cultivated plants grown primarily for their edible parts, such as leaves, roots, stems, and fruits. They are a vital component of human diets, providing essential vitamins, minerals, and fiber, and are cultivated in a variety of environments worldwide.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RudV.label: Supporting
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RudV.definition: Actor who is supporting the Lead.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RueR.label: French, Middle
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RueR.definition: Middle French is a language that was spoken in France between the 14th and 17th centuries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RufY.label: Prepayment Penalty Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RufY.definition: A prepayment penalty clause is a provision in a contract that requires a borrower to pay a fee or penalty if they pay off a loan before the end of its term.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ruid.label: Claim for Falling on Grease
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ruid.definition: A claim for falling on grease is a legal assertion made by a plaintiff who has suffered injury due to slipping on a surface contaminated with grease, and is a subcategory of the broader concept of slip-and-fall negligence.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ruih.label: Joint and Several Obligations Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ruih.definition: A joint and several obligations clause is a provision in a contract where two or more parties are jointly and individually responsible for fulfilling the obligations outlined in the agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ruiy.label: Voter
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ruiy.definition: A voter, also known as an Elector, is an individual who is eligible to vote in an election. This term can also refer to a member of an electoral college, who has the formal responsibility to cast votes for the selection of certain public officials, such as the President of the United States.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rul3.label: "'Reasonably likely/expected to be inconsistent' with fiduciary duties" Language
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rul3.definition: "'Reasonably likely/expected to be inconsistent' with fiduciary duties" Language refers to a specific phrase used in legal documents that indicates actions or decisions that may go against the responsibilities and obligations of a fiduciary, such as a trustee or agent, and may result in legal consequences.
english_labels: "'Reasonably likely/expected to be inconsistent' with fiduciary duties" Language
'Reasonably likely/expected to be inconsistent' with fiduciary duties

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ruli.label: Abstention Doctrines
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ruli.definition: Abstention Doctrines refer to legal theories that allow federal courts to abstain from exercising jurisdiction over a case in deference to state court proceedings, including Pullman Abstention, Brillhart-Wilton Abstention, Younger Abstention, Burford Abstention, and Colorado River Abstention.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RumD.label: Attachment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RumD.definition: Attachment refers to a legal remedy that allows a creditor to seize a debtor's property before a judgment is made, in order to secure payment of a debt.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuoT.label: JK10 Preparation of trial bundles (UK J-CODE)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuoT.definition: Time spent identifying documents for inclusion in the trial bundles, working with the other parties to agree the trial bundles, preparing and updating the trial bundles.
english_labels: JK10 Preparation of trial bundles (UK J-CODE)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuoU.label: Monetary Outflow
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuoU.definition: Legal Services Buyer pays external Actor. Money flowing out of the Legal Services Buyer. E.g., Legal Services Buyer pays Legal Services Provider. In Accounts Payable systems (e.g., Oracle), this is labeled "Cost Center."

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rur2.label: Eviction of Tenant for Illegal Occupancy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rur2.definition: The eviction of a tenant for occupying a property illegally, which involves the removal of the tenant from the property due to a violation of the terms of the lease or rental agreement.
english_labels: Eviction of Tenant for Illegal Occupancy

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RusV.label: Banking Law Documents
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RusV.definition: "Banking Law Documents" refer to the collection of legal texts, forms, contracts, and regulatory materials that govern the operations, transactions, and compliance of financial institutions. These documents encompass a wide range of topics, including but not limited to, customer interactions, financial transactions, regulatory compliance, and risk management.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rut-.label: Nuclear Electric Power Generation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rut-.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in operating nuclear electric power generation facilities. These facilities use nuclear power to produce electric energy. The electric energy produced in these establishments is provided to electric power transmission systems or to electric power distribution systems.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RutX.label: Pricing Grid Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RutX.definition: A Pricing Grid Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the pricing structure for goods or services, typically presented in a grid format.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ruuy.label: No Compensation Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ruuy.definition: A No Compensation Clause is a provision in a contract that prohibits one party from receiving any form of payment or reimbursement for their services or actions related to the contract.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuwR.label: X119 Foreclosure Costs
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuwR.definition: Any other costs specifically associated with a foreclosure action not already provided for within the expense codes

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ruxp.label: Motion to Set Hearing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ruxp.definition: A Motion to Set Hearing is a formal request made to a court or tribunal to schedule a hearing for a specific matter, often used to expedite the legal process.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuyZ.label: Georgia District Court - Colquitt County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RuyZ.definition: A court located in Colquitt County, Georgia that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ruze.label: Motion for New Trial - Evidentiary Error
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ruze.definition: A Motion for New Trial - Evidentiary Error is a legal request made by a party to a case asking the court to grant a new trial due to a mistake made during the presentation of evidence that affected the outcome of the trial.
english_labels: Motion for New Trial - Evidentiary Error

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rv1W.label: Motion to Continue
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rv1W.definition: A Motion to Continue is a request made to a court to postpone a scheduled hearing or trial to a later date.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rv27.label: Pahlavi
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rv27.definition: A language that was used in ancient Persia and is now extinct, characterized by its use of an Aramaic script and its influence on modern Persian.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rv2B.label: Risk Benefit Test
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rv2B.definition: A Risk Benefit Test is a defense used in product liability cases where the defendant argues that the benefits of the product outweigh the risks associated with it.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rv2q.label: Internal Medicine Malpractice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rv2q.definition: Negligent or wrongful actions or omissions committed by a healthcare provider who specializes in the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of adult diseases, and who has breached the standard of care expected in the field of internal medicine.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rv3E.label: Transportation Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rv3E.definition: A Transportation Agreement is a legally binding contract between two or more parties that outlines the terms and conditions for the transportation of goods or people from one place to another.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rv3s.label: Pro Se Party
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rv3s.definition: A Pro Se Party is an individual who represents themselves in a legal matter without the assistance of an attorney. Another name for pro se is "unrepresented party."

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rv4A.label: Brief Drafting Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rv4A.definition: Brief Drafting Management refers to the process of managing and organizing the creation of legal documents that are concise and to the point. It is a subcategory of Litigation Management, which involves the overall management of legal cases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rv6S.label: ADR Private Judging Forum
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rv6S.definition: A private forum for alternative dispute resolution (ADR) where a neutral third party acts as a judge to resolve disputes outside of the court system.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvAP.label: Analysis of Environmental Considerations
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvAP.definition: Analysis of Environmental Considerations refers to the process of evaluating and assessing the potential environmental impacts and consequences of a legal obligation or action.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvBP.label: Geez
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvBP.definition: A language originating in Ethiopia and Eritrea, characterized by a script that dates back to the 5th century and is still used in religious contexts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvBg.label: Upper Sorbian
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvBg.definition: Upper Sorbian is a Slavic language spoken in eastern Germany, primarily in the region of Lusatia, and is a subcategory of the Language top-level class.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvCy.label: Recitals Incorporated Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvCy.definition: A Recitals Incorporated Clause is a type of contractual clause that includes a section outlining the background and context of the agreement being made.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvFO.label: Consumer Protection Act Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvFO.definition: Claims made under the Consumer Protection Act, which provide legal recourse for consumers who have been harmed by defective products or unfair business practices.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvG8.label: Georgia District Court - Catoosa County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvG8.definition: A court located in Catoosa County, Georgia that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvHK.label: Withdrawal of Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvHK.definition: Withdrawal of Claim refers to the act of retracting a previously filed claim in a bankruptcy or restructuring document.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvHO.label: Fanti
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvHO.definition: Fanti is a language that belongs to the Language top-level class and is spoken in Ghana.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvIT.label: Employment Training
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvIT.definition: "Employment Training" refers to the process of acquiring or enhancing the skills, knowledge, and competencies necessary for a specific job or career. It often involves formal or informal education, on-the-job training, workshops, or courses designed to prepare individuals for employment or improve their performance in a current job.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvIX.label: Tax ID - Firm
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvIX.definition: A Tax ID - Firm is a specific identifier assigned to a legal services provider organization for tax purposes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvJs.label: Petition for Skilled Workers - Master's Cap
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvJs.definition: In the United States, the "Petition for Skilled Workers - Master's Cap" involves employers filing Form I-129 for H-1B visas on behalf of prospective employees with a master's degree or higher, subject to the annual H-1B master's cap, and potentially requiring a lottery for selection
english_labels: Petition for Skilled Workers - Master's Cap

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvKP.label: Funeral
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvKP.definition: A funeral is a ceremony or service held in honor of a deceased person, often involving rituals, customs, or religious practices. The event can include various elements such as eulogies, the burial or cremation of the body, and gatherings for mourning and remembrance.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvKW.label: Description of Asset Recovery
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvKW.definition: For a given dispute, a description of the assets that are potentially recoverable.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvMb.label: Notice of Action
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvMb.definition: A Notice of Action (in the U.S., Form I-797), is a document issued by the government agency (e.g., United States Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS)) to communicate specific actions taken on an immigration application or petition. It serves as an official receipt or approval notice for various immigration-related applications, including visa petitions, adjustment of status, and naturalization.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvOC.label: Single Transferable Vote System
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvOC.definition: The Single Transferable Vote (STV) system is a proportional voting method where voters rank candidates in order of preference. Votes are initially allocated to each voter's first preference, and if a candidate reaches a specified quota, they are elected; any surplus votes are transferred to remaining candidates based on the voters' next preferences, and this process continues until all seats are filled.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvOk.label: Uncontentious
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvOk.definition: Uncontentious negotiation refers to a negotiation process where parties have aligned interests and work cooperatively to reach an agreement without conflict or adversarial tactics. This approach emphasizes mutual understanding, amicable discussions, and efficient resolution of terms, often resulting in agreements that are satisfactory to all parties involved.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvSl.label: Missouri Circuit Court - City of St. Louis
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvSl.definition: A Missouri Circuit Court located in the City of St. Louis, which is a court of general jurisdiction in Missouri responsible for hearing civil and criminal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.
english_labels: Missouri Circuit Court - City of St. Louis

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvUa.label: Connecticut Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvUa.definition: The Connecticut Circuit Court is a lower court within the Connecticut State Courts system that has jurisdiction over certain civil and criminal cases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvUd.label: Wellness Market Segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvUd.definition: The wellness market segment refers to a division of the market that is specifically targeted towards consumers who are interested in maintaining or enhancing their overall well-being. This segment encompasses products, services, and marketing strategies that are designed to cater to the needs, preferences, and interests of individuals who seek holistic health solutions, including physical, mental, emotional, and spiritual wellness.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvXe.label: B170 Fee/Employment Objections
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvXe.definition: Review of and objections to the employment and fee applications of others

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvYm.label: New York Supreme Court - Saratoga County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvYm.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Saratoga County is a court of general jurisdiction in the state of New York that has the power to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.
english_labels: New York Supreme Court - Saratoga County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvYu.label: "Constructive Knowledge - Express Investigation" Language
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvYu.definition: A negative change or event that has a significant impact on a company's financial condition or operations, and which a reasonable person would not have known about without conducting an express investigation.
english_labels: Material Adverse Effect Definition - "Constructive Knowledge - Express Investigation" Language

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvYz.label: Improper Impeachment Objection
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvYz.definition: An Improper Impeachment Objection is raised when a party in a legal proceeding believes that the opposing counsel is attempting to discredit a witness in a manner that is not allowed by the rules of evidence. This objection aims to protect the integrity of the witness's testimony and ensure that any challenge to their credibility is conducted appropriately.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvZD.label: Florida County Court - Hendry County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvZD.definition: A court located in Hendry County, Florida that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within the county.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvZL.label: Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvZL.definition: Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) is a mental health condition triggered by experiencing or witnessing a traumatic event, such as a natural disaster, serious accident, terrorist act, war/combat, rape, or other violent personal assault. Individuals with PTSD may experience intense, disturbing thoughts and feelings related to their experience long after the traumatic event has ended.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvaA.label: Slavic languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvaA.definition: Slavic languages are a group of related languages spoken in Eastern Europe, characterized by their use of the Cyrillic alphabet and shared grammatical features.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rvar.label: Late Payment Penalty Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rvar.definition: A Late Payment Penalty Clause is a provision in a contract that imposes a financial penalty on a party who fails to make a payment by the agreed-upon due date.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rvby.label: Metallic Mineral Rights
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rvby.definition: These rights concern the ownership and extraction of metallic minerals, like gold, silver, copper, and iron, from a particular area of land. These rights can be leased, sold, or transferred, allowing either the owner or the lessee to profit from the extraction of these minerals.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvdW.label: Exceptions Clause Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvdW.definition: An Exceptions Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a law or action violates the Exceptions Clause of the United States Constitution by exceeding the constitutional limitations on the President's veto power, as the Clause outlines specific circumstances where a veto can be overridden by a two-thirds majority vote in both houses of Congress. The claim challenges the validity of the law or action based on an alleged violation of the constitutional procedures outlined in the Exceptions Clause

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvfW.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Douglas County (6th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Douglas County (6th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvgS.label: Verdict
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvgS.definition: A verdict is a decision made by a trial court that determines the guilt or innocence of a defendant.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rvh4.label: AAA Construction Industry Arbitration Rules and Mediation Procedures
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rvh4.definition: The AAA Construction Industry Arbitration Rules and Mediation Procedures are a set of guidelines and procedures established by the American Arbitration Association for resolving disputes in the construction industry through arbitration and mediation.
english_labels: AAA Construction Industry Arbitration Rules and Mediation Procedures

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvnR.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Nodaway County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvnR.definition: A Missouri Circuit Court in Nodaway County is a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Nodaway County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvpV.label: Business Formation Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvpV.definition: Business formation practice refers to the legal service in which lawyers assist individuals in establishing a new business, covering aspects like selecting the appropriate business structure, filing necessary paperwork, and ensuring compliance with local, state, and federal regulations. Lawyers in this field guide clients through legal complexities to mitigate risk and create a sound legal foundation for the business

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvpY.label: Azerbaijani
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvpY.definition: Azerbaijani (Language) refers to the written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Azerbaijani language, which is a member of the Turkic language family.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvpY.label: German, Middle High
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvpY.definition: Middle High German is a structured system of communication used between 1050 and 1500, and is considered a language in the context of legal matters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rvqa.label: M&A F4 Environmental Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rvqa.definition: M&A F4 Environmental Practice refers to the legal work performed by a Legal Services Provider in the course of a merger or acquisition transaction that involves regulatory and specialty matters related to environmental issues.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rvr8.label: Motion to Extend Time to File Appendix
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rvr8.definition: A Motion to Extend Time to File Appendix is a request made to a court to allow additional time beyond the original deadline for a party to submit a document containing the record of a case on appeal.
english_labels: Motion to Extend Time to File Appendix

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvtA.label: Bankruptcy Schedule - Codebtors
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvtA.definition: Bankruptcy Schedule - Codebtors, also known as Schedule H, requires the debtor to list all individuals or entities who are also liable on any of the debtor's debts. This schedule includes the names and addresses of codebtors, along with the corresponding debts for which they share liability, providing transparency about shared financial obligations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvtK.label: Return on Investment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvtK.definition: Return on Investment (ROI) is a financial metric used to evaluate the profitability of an investment or to compare the profitability of multiple investments. It is calculated by dividing the net profit from the investment by the initial cost, usually multiplied by 100 to express it as a percentage. ROI is commonly used to evaluate investment effectiveness.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rvth.label: Papuan languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rvth.definition: A group of languages spoken in Papua New Guinea and surrounding areas, characterized by their unique grammar and vocabulary.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rvv1.label: Term of Agreement and Termination Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rvv1.definition: A Term of Agreement and Termination Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the conditions under which the agreement can be ended by either party.
english_labels: Term of Agreement and Termination Clause

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rvvv.label: Laryngitis
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rvvv.definition: Laryngitis is an inflammation of the larynx (voice box), often causing hoarseness or loss of voice, and may be accompanied by throat pain and coughing. This condition can be acute, typically resulting from viral infections or vocal strain, or chronic, caused by persistent irritation from factors such as smoking, GERD, or prolonged vocal overuse.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rvwi.label: Remote Deposition Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rvwi.definition: Remote Deposition Management refers to the process of managing and conducting depositions remotely, typically through video conferencing technology. This concept falls under the broader category of Litigation Management.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvxW.label: Indian Commerce Clause Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RvxW.definition: An Indian Commerce Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a state law or regulation infringes upon the exclusive authority of the federal government to regulate commerce with Native American tribes. This claim is based on the interpretation that the Indian Commerce Clause grants Congress the power to regulate trade and commerce involving tribal nations, thereby limiting state interference in this sphere.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rvyy.label: Contact Phone
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rvyy.definition: A contact phone is a type of contact information used to communicate with a person or entity involved in a legal matter.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rw-s.label: A120 Processing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rw-s.definition: For discovery and eDiscovery, services associated with the processing of documents, images, files, etc. in a document collection. Includes OCR, importing/ingestion/overlay, exporting, file conversion and/or extraction when billed as a service. Excludes scanning (A117).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rw0v.label: Stipulation to Compromise Controversy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rw0v.definition: A Stipulation to Compromise Controversy is a legal agreement between parties to settle a dispute by making concessions and coming to a mutual agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rw11.label: P220 Tax
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rw11.definition: This task includes all steps involved in conducting fact investigation/due diligence from a tax perspective.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rw51.label: Espionage
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rw51.definition: The act of spying or gathering confidential information for a foreign government or entity, considered a crime against the government.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rw5O.label: Impact Investor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rw5O.definition: Investors who aim to generate a measurable, beneficial social or environmental impact alongside a financial return.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rw7D.label: Motion for Exemption from Credit Counseling
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rw7D.definition: A Motion for Exemption from Credit Counseling is a request made in a bankruptcy case to be excused from the requirement of completing credit counseling before filing for bankruptcy.
english_labels: Motion for Exemption from Credit Counseling

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rw8T.label: Radishes
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rw8T.definition: Radishes are edible root vegetables belonging to the Raphanus sativus species, characterized by their crisp texture and pungent flavor. They are typically small, round or elongated in shape, with colors ranging from white to red to black, and are consumed raw in salads, as garnishes, or cooked in various culinary applications.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rw8q.label: M.B.A. (Master of Business Administration)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rw8q.definition: The suffix "M.B.A." stands for "Master of Business Administration" and is used after a person's name to indicate that they have earned an advanced degree in business management. This designation signifies the individual's expertise in various aspects of business, such as finance, marketing, and operations, and is commonly used in professional, academic, and formal settings

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rw9V.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Vermilion County (5th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Vermilion County (5th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwAh.label: Pushto; Pashto
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwAh.definition: A language spoken primarily in Afghanistan and Pakistan, belonging to the Indo-European family and written in Arabic script.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwBK.label: Past Medical Expenses
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwBK.definition: Expenses incurred for medical treatment or services that have already been provided to an individual.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwBv.label: Job Application
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwBv.definition: A "Job Application" is a formal document or form that individuals submit to potential employers when expressing interest in a specific job or position. It typically includes personal information, work history, education, qualifications, and may require applicants to answer specific questions related to the job. Job applications serve as the initial step in the hiring process, allowing employers to assess candidates' suitability for a particular role.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwD7.label: JJ00 Interim Applications and Hearings (UK J-CODE)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwD7.definition: Work covering all proposed and actual interim applications and hearings. Includes taking instructions, making inquiries, research, preparing and filing applications, supporting evidence and skeleton arguments including reviewing those of other parties whether or not a responsive document is served, preparing for and attending hearings and all meetings and communications for the purpose of such applications or hearings.
english_labels: JJ00 Interim Applications and Hearings (UK J-CODE)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwDa.label: Income Tax Payment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwDa.definition: An Income Tax Payment Event refers to the specific instance when an individual or entity makes a payment to satisfy their income tax obligations. This includes periodic payments such as quarterly estimated tax payments or annual tax settlements, made to the relevant tax authorities.
english_labels: Taxes on income, profits and capital gains

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwEJ.label: Beyond the Scope Objection
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwEJ.definition: A Beyond the Scope Objection is raised when questions during cross-examination or redirect examination address matters not covered in the previous direct examination, exceeding the permissible scope as defined by rules of evidence (e.g., Federal Rule of Evidence 611(b)). While cross-examination is generally limited to the subject matter of the direct examination and matters relating to credibility, decision-makers often permit wide-ranging examinations as long as the questions are relevant, with the option to call the witness as an adverse witness for further questioning.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwIL.label: Male
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwIL.definition: A male is a person who identifies as or is biologically characterized as male, and is a member of the gender class of self-identified gender.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwJI.label: Insurance Claim Wrongfully Delayed or Denied
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwJI.definition: An Insurance Claim Wrongfully Delayed or Denied refers to a situation where an insurance company unjustly postpones or denies payment to a policyholder for a claim that is covered under the policy.
english_labels: Insurance Claim Wrongfully Delayed or Denied

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwKs.label: Disability / Loss of a Normal Life
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwKs.definition: The concept of Disability/Loss of a Normal Life refers to the physical or mental impairment that results in a diminished ability to enjoy life's activities and experiences, and the resulting non-economic damages that may be awarded in a legal matter.
english_labels: Disability / Loss of a Normal Life

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwOM.label: Local Governmental Body
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwOM.definition: A local governmental body, such as a city or municipality, is responsible for governance at the community or city level, addressing issues and services that directly affect residents within a specific locality. These bodies typically have authority over matters like zoning, local law enforcement, public works, sanitation, and local ordinances. Their structure can include a mayor or city manager, a city council or board, and various departments or agencies dedicated to specific community services. The specific powers and responsibilities of local governments can vary widely based on regional laws and traditions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwQe.label: Florida Circuit Court - Baker County - 8th Circuit Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwQe.definition: A court located in Baker County, Florida that is part of the 8th Circuit Court system.
english_labels: Florida Circuit Court - Baker County - 8th Circuit Court

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwRi.label: 791 Employee Retirement Income Security Act (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwRi.definition: Action filed under the Employee Retirement Income Security Act, 29 U.S.C. § 1132 by individuals and labor organizations.
english_labels: 791 Employee Retirement Income Security Act (PACER NoS)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwTy.label: Statement of Work
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwTy.definition: A Statement of Work is a document accompanying a contract that provides detailed descriptions of specific tasks, deliverables, timelines, and resources associated with a project or service contract. It serves as a guideline for the work to be performed.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwU3.label: Local Market Segment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwU3.definition: The local segment refers to a portion of the market that is focused on consumers and businesses within a specific, limited geographical area, such as a city, town, or neighborhood. This segment encompasses products, services, and marketing strategies that are tailored to meet the needs and preferences of the local population, often considering hyper-local culture, traditions, and consumer behavior.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwXx.label: L510 Appellate Motions and Submissions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwXx.definition: A legal document filed with an appellate court requesting a ruling or decision on a specific issue or matter, falling under the broader category of appeals.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwY9.label: Landlord's Failure to Protect Tenant from Crime
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwY9.definition: The failure of a landlord to provide adequate protection to a tenant from criminal activity, resulting in harm or injury to the tenant.
english_labels: Landlord's Failure to Protect Tenant from Crime

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwYk.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Armstrong County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwYk.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Armstrong County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Armstrong County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwa1.label: Notice of Motion
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwa1.definition: A Notice of Motion is a formal written request submitted to a court or tribunal by a party in a legal proceeding, seeking a specific order or direction from the court.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwad.label: Employment Harassment Claims
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwad.definition: Employment Harassment Claims: Legal claims made by an employee against an employer for harassment in the workplace, including sexual harassment, harassment based on protected characteristics, and harassment related to the work environment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwb6.label: oasis:figure collection
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwb6.definition: A collection of figures within the OASIS standard framework.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwdh.label: Nominal Damages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwdh.definition: Nominal Damages are a small amount of money awarded to a plaintiff in a lawsuit to recognize a legal wrong, without compensating for any actual loss or injury.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwgJ.label: Import-Export Clause Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwgJ.definition: An Import-Export Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a law or government action violates the Import-Export Clause of the United States Constitution, which prohibits states from imposing taxes or regulations that discriminate against imports or exports, thus protecting the free flow of goods across state and national borders.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwiY.label: Quasi-Public Governmental Body
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwiY.definition: A Quasi-Public Governmental Body is an organization that has governmental functions but operates with some degree of independence from direct government control. These bodies often provide public services and may have regulatory authority, yet they typically function more like private enterprises.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwip.label: Commerce Clause Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwip.definition: A Commerce Clause claim is a legal argument centered on the interpretation of the Commerce Clause in the United States Constitution, which grants Congress the power to regulate interstate commerce. These claims often involve disputes over the scope of federal authority to regulate economic activities or address issues that may impact multiple states, and can have implications for the balance of power between the federal government and state governments.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwjU.label: Antitrust Efforts Provisions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwjU.definition: Antitrust Efforts Provisions refer to the specific provisions in a legal agreement that outline the standards and limitations for the parties' efforts to comply with antitrust laws and regulations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwla.label: Infraction
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwla.definition: An infraction is a violation of a rule or law that is typically considered less serious than a misdemeanor or felony. Infractions are generally punishable by fines, citations, or other minor penalties, rather than imprisonment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwon.label: Georgia Superior Court - Bulloch County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwon.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia, located in Bulloch County and responsible for hearing civil and criminal cases within its jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwp7.label: Judicial Privilege
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwp7.definition: The concept of Judicial Privilege refers to the legal immunity granted to judges and other court officials from being compelled to testify in court about their official duties or decision-making processes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwpg.label: Sotho, Southern
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwpg.definition: African language spoken primarily in Lesotho and South Africa, belonging to the Bantu language family.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwph.label: Translation Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwph.definition: Translation Management refers to the process of managing the translation of legal documents and materials from one language to another within the context of Legal Point Solutions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwqd.label: Statutory Lien
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwqd.definition: A statutory lien is a legal claim or encumbrance on property that arises by operation of law, typically created by a statute, and provides security for the payment of a debt or obligation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwrb.label: Minnesota District Court - Crow Wing County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwrb.definition: Minnesota District Court - Crow Wing County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Crow Wing County.
english_labels: Minnesota District Court - Crow Wing County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwrv.label: Default Judgment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwrv.definition: A default judgment is a legal decision made by a court when one party fails to appear or respond to a lawsuit.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwvY.label: Outsourcing Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwvY.definition: An Outsourcing Agreement is a legal contract between two parties where one party hires another to perform a specific task or service on their behalf, typically involving the transfer of certain responsibilities or functions outside of the organization.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwx5.label: TR199 Other Assessment, Development, or Administration
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwx5.definition: Use only for assessment, development, administration and other activities that can not be included under a previous code, or as instructed by the client.
english_labels: TR199 Other Assessment, Development, or Administration

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwxL.label: Location-Based Event
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwxL.definition: A Location-Based Event refers to an occurrence tied to a specific geographic location, often marking a change in status or condition for a person or object. Examples include events like a person beginning or ending residency in a particular place, or an item entering or leaving a specified location, which may have legal, social, or logistical implications.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwxM.label: TR730 Assignments and Security Interests
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwxM.definition: All actions associated with negotiating and preparing assignment (i.e. previously registered or filed application) or security interest, including review of file history, checking status and meeting with client. Work of outside vendors in conducting searches or otherwise assisting investigation should be an expense under E100.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwxt.label: Cybersecurity Risk
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwxt.definition: The potential of loss or damage from a cyber event such as a data breach, cyber attack, or system failure.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwzW.label: Approved During Tail Period
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RwzW.definition: A legal term referring to the approval of an acquisition proposal during the final period of the transaction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwzr.label: Fee Discount or Credit Percent
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rwzr.definition: A Fee Discount or Credit Percent is a type of discount or credit applied to legal services fees, which reduces the overall cost by a certain percentage.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rx0v.label: Massachusetts Superior Court - Dukes County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rx0v.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Massachusetts that has authority over civil and criminal cases in Dukes County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rx1v.label: Appellate Court Forum
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rx1v.definition: An Appellate Court Forum is a level of court forum that hears appeals from lower courts and has the authority to review and modify decisions made by those courts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rx3S.label: Human Resources Form
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rx3S.definition: A Human Resources Form is a standardized document used within an organization to capture specific information related to personnel management. Forms may be used for various HR functions, such as hiring, performance evaluations, or benefits enrollment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rx69.label: Status
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rx69.definition: The state or condition of a proceeding, legal element, or legal matter (e.g., open, closed, canceled, expired).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rx6F.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Clinton County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rx6F.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Clinton County refers to a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Clinton County, Indiana.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rx73.label: Change in Control Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rx73.definition: A Change in Control Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the conditions under which a change in ownership or control of a company would trigger certain rights or obligations for the parties involved.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rx7C.label: Occupancy
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rx7C.definition: Occupancy refers to the act of residing in or using a property or space.
