This includes the possession and control of the property, typically under a lease or ownership agreement, and entails responsibilities such as maintenance and adherence to property regulations. Occupancy refers to the physical act of living in or using a property, which can be temporary or intermittent, in contrast to "residence," which refers to a person's fixed, permanent, and principal home, often with legal implications and the intention to remain for an extended period.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rx7f.label: New York City Court - North Tonawanda
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rx7f.definition: A court located in North Tonawanda, New York, which is a part of the larger New York City Court system.
english_labels: New York City Court - North Tonawanda

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rx7j.label: NAFTA Market Region
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rx7j.definition: The NAFTA Market Region encompasses the countries that were part of the North American Free Trade Agreement—Canada, the United States, and Mexico—characterized by integrated supply chains, significant trade flows, and economic collaboration. This region is known for its extensive cross-border trade and investment, driven by the harmonization of regulations and the reduction of trade barriers.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rx8F.label: INVOICE_DESCRIPTION
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rx8F.definition: A description of the goods or services provided on an invoice, as defined within the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rx8y.label: D.C. Office of Bar Counsel
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rx8y.definition: The D.C. Office of Bar Counsel is an entity within the District of Columbia Courts that is responsible for administering proceedings related to attorney discipline and ethics.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxCc.label: Motion for Intra-District Transfer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxCc.definition: A Motion for Intra-District Transfer is a request made in a bankruptcy case to transfer the case from one district to another within the same state.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxCg.label: 245 Tort Product Liability (PACER NoS)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxCg.definition: Action alleging harm by an unsafe product based on negligence, breach of warranty, misrepresentation, and strict tort liability.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxEO.label: Remote Employment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxEO.definition: Remote Employment refers to a work arrangement where the employee performs job tasks from a location outside the employer's physical facilities, often from home or another suitable environment. This setup provides greater flexibility but may require specific technologies and self-discipline to maintain productivity and communication with the team.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxFJ.label: Involuntary Bankruptcy Petition
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxFJ.definition: An Involuntary Bankruptcy Petition is a legal request filed by creditors against a debtor who has not paid their debts, seeking to force the debtor into bankruptcy.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxH7.label: Neutral Fact Witness Interview
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxH7.definition: A Neutral Fact Witness Interview is an interview conducted by an unbiased party with a person who has knowledge of a situation, without taking any side or expressing any opinion.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxIA.label: DEPRECATED: Litigation Deliverables
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxIA.definition: Deprecated: Litigation Deliverables refers to the specific documents or items that are produced or provided as part of a litigation engagement, which are no longer in use or recommended.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxIL.label: Rules of Criminal Procedure
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxIL.definition: A court's body of procedural rules governing criminal actions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxJh.label: Termination Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxJh.definition: A Termination Agreement is a legal document that formally concludes a previously established contract before the original terms of the contract are fulfilled. It outlines the conditions, responsibilities, and any obligations or entitlements of the parties involved in ending the agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxKL.label: Provider Last Name
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxKL.definition: The concept of "Provider Last Name" refers to the surname or family name of an individual who provides legal services as a person, within the broader category of Legal Services Provider.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxKO.label: Nondischargeable Debt
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxKO.definition: Debt that cannot be eliminated through bankruptcy proceedings, typically including taxes, student loans, and debts incurred through fraud or willful misconduct.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxKm.label: Bankruptcy Means Test
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxKm.definition: The Bankruptcy Means Test is a document used in bankruptcy and restructuring proceedings to determine whether an individual or business is eligible for bankruptcy relief based on their income and expenses.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxLV.label: Minnesota District Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxLV.definition: The Minnesota District Court is a trial court in the state of Minnesota that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxMG.label: Parking - Real Estate Asset
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxMG.definition: Parking, in the context of real estate assets, refers to designated areas or structures designed for the temporary storage of vehicles. This type of real estate asset can include surface lots, multi-story garages, or underground facilities, often generating revenue through hourly, daily, or monthly fees.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxMO.label: Texas District Court - Harris County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxMO.definition: A Texas District Court - Harris County is a specific court within the Texas District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Harris County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxNw.label: Corporate Campaigns Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxNw.definition: Corporate Campaigns Practice involves the development and execution of strategy and strategic communication efforts aimed at influencing corporate policies and practices. This practice includes managing campaigns that address issues such as employee rights, environmental sustainability, and corporate social responsibility to achieve specific advocacy goals.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxO4.label: Reinstatement Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxO4.definition: A reinstatement claim is a legal action initiated by a party, often a borrower or homeowner, to reinstate a contract or agreement that has been terminated or suspended due to noncompliance with its terms. This can apply to various contracts, including mortgage agreements, insurance policies, or service contracts. The claim typically seeks to rectify the breach or default by fulfilling the outstanding obligations, such as making overdue payments or meeting specified conditions, with the goal of resuming the original contractual relationship.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxPx.label: Private Equity, Hedge Funds and Venture Capital Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxPx.definition: Private Equity, Hedge Funds, and Venture Capital Law encompasses the legal frameworks governing private equity investments, hedge funds, and venture capital financing. It involves regulations related to fund formation, management, investment, compliance, investor rights, and financial transactions within these sectors.
english_labels: Private Equity, Hedge Funds and Venture Capital Law

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxQ9.label: Indecent Exposure
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxQ9.definition: The act of exposing one's private parts in public or in the presence of others in a lewd or offensive manner, which is considered a criminal offense of a less serious nature.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxR0.label: Georgia District Court - Turner County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxR0.definition: Georgia District Court - Turner County refers to a specific court within the Georgia District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Turner County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxRu.label: North Dakota Office of the Attorney General
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxRu.definition: The North Dakota Office of the Attorney General is a government entity responsible for providing legal advice and representation to the state of North Dakota, and is a part of the North Dakota State Courts system.
english_labels: North Dakota Office of the Attorney General

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxSF.label: Rule of 60 Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxSF.definition: A Rule of 60 Clause is a specific type of contractual clause that sets a time limit of 60 days for a party to take certain actions or make certain decisions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxTx.label: Business Risk
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxTx.definition: Distinct from legal risks, those risks to the business's operations (e.g., capital, reputation, financial management, programs)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxWr.label: Oil Crops
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxWr.definition: Oil crops are plants grown specifically for the oil extracted from their seeds, fruits, or nuts, which is used for culinary, industrial, and medicinal purposes. These crops provide essential fatty acids, vitamins, and nutrients and are a significant source of vegetable oils globally.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxZ8.label: Dutch; Flemish
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxZ8.definition: A language spoken in the Netherlands and Belgium, characterized by its use of Dutch and Flemish vocabulary, grammar, and syntax.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rx_T.label: PA499 Other Patent Prosecution - Domestic
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rx_T.definition: Use only for patent prosecution activities for applications that are to be initially filed in the ('domestic') home country or region of the applicant, and that can not be included under a previous code, or as instructed by the client.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxaG.label: California Superior Court - Stanislaus Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxaG.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Stanislaus County, California, with the power to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxcJ.label: PA520 Non-Provisional Application Preparation - International
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxcJ.definition: All actions associated with completing a non-provisional, utility or utility model (but not design or provisional) patent application that is to be filed outside the ('domestic') home country or region of the applicant, including translations, review of any invention disclosure materials or parent applications, drafting of application including pre-filing revision of a parent applications, preparation and execution of formal documents (such as assignments, declarations, information disclosure statements, transmittals, and biological deposits) filing of application, and reporting to the client. Includes PCT International Applications when filed outside the home country of the applicant. Note that government fees and other external expenses are included under E100.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxcz.label: TR230 Clearance Investigation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxcz.definition: All actions associated with determining the final availability and registerability of a particular trademark, including definition of the scope of protection, searching, analyzing the search results, and reporting the results to the client. Also known as a "full" search, a clearance search is the broadest type of trademark search which includes review of pending trademark applications, active trademark registrations, abandoned trademark applications and registrations, public and corporate records, government publications and various databases. Any formal opinion should be prepared under TR710. Work of outside vendors in conducting searches or otherwise assisting investigation should be an expense under E100.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxjb.label: Acquitted
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxjb.definition: "Acquitted" is a legal term used to describe the outcome of a criminal trial in which the defendant is found not guilty of the charges brought against them. It signifies that the court has determined that there is insufficient evidence to prove the defendant's guilt beyond a reasonable doubt, and as a result, they are exonerated and not subject to criminal punishment or convictions for the alleged offense. "Acquitted" typically refers to a formal legal judgment of innocence, often issued by a judge or jury, while "Not Guilty" can denote the absence of sufficient evidence to establish guilt but may not necessarily imply a formal acquittal.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxkT.label: Financial Assets
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxkT.definition: Financial Assets are economic resources that have value and can be owned or controlled with the expectation of generating future income or financial benefits. They can exist in various forms such as cash, stocks, bonds, and real estate.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxkl.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Boone County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxkl.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Boone County: A court of law in Missouri that has jurisdiction over cases within Boone County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxky.label: Privilege
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxky.definition: Privilege refers to a legal protection that allows certain communications or information to be kept confidential between specific parties, such as attorney-client privilege or physician-patient privilege.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxl1.label: Grand River Band of Ottawa Indians
english_labels: Grand River Band of Ottawa Indians

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxmH.label: Yacht
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxmH.definition: A Yacht is a luxury watercraft used primarily for private leisure, recreation, or sports, often equipped with sophisticated amenities and accommodations. Yachts vary in size from small sailing yachts to large motor yachts and are typically associated with opulent lifestyles and maritime enjoyment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxmj.label: Insurance Agreements
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxmj.definition: An Insurance Related Agreement is a general term for contracts related to the insurance sector, covering a variety of relationships, obligations, and terms. These agreements set the foundation for how insurance operations and transactions are handled.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxmk.label: Wildlife and Plants Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxmk.definition: Laws governing the potential impact of human activity on wild animals or plants, whether directly on individuals or populations, or indirectly via habitat degradation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxnn.label: Platelet Deficiency
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxnn.definition: Thrombocytopenia is a medical condition characterized by a low platelet count in the blood, which can lead to increased bleeding and bruising. It results from either decreased production of platelets, increased destruction of platelets, or sequestration of platelets in the spleen.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxoC.label: Invoice Date Received
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxoC.definition: The "Invoice Date Received" concept refers to the specific date on which an invoice was received by the recipient, and is a subcategory of the broader concept of "Invoice Date".

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxoN.label: Human Values For AI
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxoN.definition: Human Values for AI recognize that AI systems are not value-neutral and that their design must incorporate idealized qualities or conditions deemed good by society. Designing AI with human values involves negotiating different value systems, making ethical decisions, and considering governance, policies, and incentives while respecting cultural diversity and social and economic interests

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxoO.label: Motion to Reopen Chapter 13 Case
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxoO.definition: A Motion to Reopen Chapter 13 Case is a request made to the court to reopen a previously closed Chapter 13 bankruptcy case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxpK.label: L520 Appellate Briefs
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxpK.definition: A written legal argument submitted to an appellate court, typically in response to a lower court's decision, falling under the broader category of legal appeals.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxpa.label: Living Will
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxpa.definition: A Living Will is a legal document that allows an individual to express their wishes regarding medical treatment in the event they become incapacitated and unable to communicate those wishes themselves.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxq2.label: Real Estate Regulatory Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxq2.definition: Real Estate Regulatory Services refers to legal services related to working with governmental or authorized entities and procedures regarding the monitoring, licensing, and regulating real estate activities within a jurisdiction. These services relate to changes and compliance with laws, rules, and standards related to property transactions, development, and management.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxq9.label: Telephone Expense
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxq9.definition: Telephone Expense refers to the cost incurred by an individual or organization for using telephone services, which is categorized as an expense in accounting and financial management.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxqI.label: Sign Languages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxqI.definition: A system of communication that uses visual gestures and signs instead of spoken words, used by individuals who are deaf or hard of hearing.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxqb.label: Objection Document
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxqb.definition: An objection is a formal statement made in a trial court or bankruptcy case challenging the validity or legality of a specific action or request, such as a confirmation of a plan, application for professional employment, professional fees, claim, debtor's claim of exemptions, or transfer of claim.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxrG.label: X139 Translation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxrG.definition: Any translation fees including the preparation and keyboarding (typing) of documentation. Excludes general word processing charges (X105).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxtP.label: "Material Adverse Effect" Definition - Exceptions - Economic Conditions
english_labels: "Material Adverse Effect" Definition - Exceptions - Economic Conditions

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxtm.label: Unavailable Declarant Objective
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxtm.definition: The Unavailable Declarant Objective is a hearsay exception that allows the admission of certain statements made by a declarant who is unavailable to testify at a trial or hearing. This exception is based on the principle that the hearsay rule should not exclude reliable evidence when the declarant cannot be present to testify, and the statements fall under specific categories outlined in the Federal Rules of Evidence.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxvD.label: Distributor Agreement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxvD.definition: A Distribution Agreement is a contractual arrangement between a supplier or manufacturer and a distributor that outlines the terms and conditions for the distribution of goods or services. The agreement typically covers issues like pricing, delivery, and geographic territory, as well as the responsibilities and obligations of both parties.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxwN.label: Dyula
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RxwN.definition: A language spoken primarily in West Africa, including in Mali, Ivory Coast, and Burkina Faso.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxwf.label: Elder Abuse
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxwf.definition: The mistreatment or harm inflicted upon an elderly person, which can take the form of financial exploitation or physical abuse.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxzk.label: P230 Environmental
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rxzk.definition: This task includes all fact investigation/due diligence from an environmental perspective.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ry2N.label: New York Supreme Court - Ulster County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ry2N.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Ulster County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Ulster County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of civil and criminal cases.
english_labels: New York Supreme Court - Ulster County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ry2z.label: New Business Intake Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ry2z.definition: New Business Intake Management refers to the process of evaluating and accepting new clients or matters in a law firm, including conflicts checks, risk assessments, and client/matter intake procedures.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ry38.label: Venture Capital Investor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ry38.definition: Individuals or firms that invest in startups and early-stage companies that have strong growth potential.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ry7Q.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Decatur County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ry7Q.definition: A court located in Decatur County, Indiana that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographic area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ry8O.label: Minnesota District Court - Pope County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ry8O.definition: Minnesota District Court - Pope County is a specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Pope County, Minnesota.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ry9h.label: Commissions (Pay)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ry9h.definition: Commissions refers to a percentage-based payment earned by individuals, often salespeople, for each sale or transaction they facilitate. It serves as a motivation to generate business and is directly linked to the volume or value of sales achieved

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ry9v.label: X129 Trial Exhibits
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ry9v.definition: Costs for materials associated with the creation of or obtaining a copy of a Trial Exhibit

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ry9w.label: TR130 Document/File Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ry9w.definition: A narrowly defined task that includes creating and populating document and other databases or filing systems, that does not fit under other task codes below. Includes the planning, design, and overall management of this process. Work of outside vendors in building litigation support databases should be an expense under E100. Calendaring (or "docketing" in the U.S.) should be included under the appropriate task codes below for each matter unless, otherwise instructed by the client.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyAu.label: New York City Court - Salamanca
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyAu.definition: A court located in New York City that handles legal disputes and cases, specifically the Salamanca case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyB6.label: Debtor's Request for Separate Notice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyB6.definition: A Debtor's Request for Separate Notice is a document filed in a bankruptcy case by a debtor requesting that certain parties receive separate notice of important events in the case, such as a hearing or a deadline.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyBj.label: M&A F2 Data Security / Privacy / Data Protection / Cybersecurity Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyBj.definition: A specialized legal practice area within Mergers and Acquisitions law that focuses on advising clients on data security, privacy, data protection, and cybersecurity matters.
english_labels: M&A F2 Data Security / Privacy / Data Protection / Cybersecurity Practice

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyCr.label: Georgia Superior Court - Oconee County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyCr.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia, located in Oconee County and presided over by a judge.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyEz.label: Estate and Inheritance Tax Payment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyEz.definition: Estate and Inheritance Tax Payment refers to the settlement of taxes levied on the transfer of assets from a deceased person's estate to their beneficiaries. Estate tax is usually paid by the estate itself before distribution, while inheritance tax is usually paid by the recipients of the estate assets based on the value they receive.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyIE.label: Damages Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyIE.definition: A damages clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the amount of money that one party must pay to the other in the event of a breach of contract.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyId.label: Upfront Payment Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyId.definition: An upfront payment clause is a provision in a contract that requires a specified amount of money to be paid in advance of the delivery of goods or services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyIt.label: U.S. Territory Courts
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyIt.definition: U.S. Territory Courts are courts established in U.S. territories, such as the Virgin Islands and Guam, that have jurisdiction over cases within their respective territories.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyJc.label: Mediator
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyJc.definition: A mediator is an independent person or body appointed to mediate a dispute.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyK2.label: Billing Application Name
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyK2.definition: A Billing Application Name is a specific identifier used to track and manage the fees associated with a legal engagement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyKc.label: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyKc.definition: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is a chronic inflammatory disease that can affect any organ or body system. It is frequently, but not always, accompanied by constitutional symptoms such as severe fatigue, fever, malaise, and involuntary weight loss, and involves major organ or body system manifestations including respiratory, cardiovascular, renal, hematologic, skin, neurologic, mental, and immune system disorders.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyLD.label: Entity Characteristic
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyLD.definition: Entity Characteristic refers to a distinguishing feature or attribute of a Legal Entity, such as whether it is a Private Company (Not Publicly Traded) or a Public Company (Publicly Traded).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyNi.label: Port of Entry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyNi.definition: "Port of Entry" (POE) is the official location where an individual enters a country, subject to immigration inspection and clearance by authorities, determining their eligibility to enter and stay within the country's borders.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyP4.label: New York Civil Court
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyP4.definition: A court in New York State that handles civil legal matters.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyPf.label: Ménière's Disease
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyPf.definition: Ménière's disease is a chronic disorder of the inner ear characterized by recurrent episodes of vertigo (spinning sensation), tinnitus (ringing or buzzing in the ears), and fluctuating hearing loss. It is associated with an abnormal buildup of fluid in the inner ear, and diagnosis often involves confirming vestibular dysfunction through caloric or other vestibular tests and verifying hearing loss via audiometry.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyQP.label: Washington Superior Court - Grays Harbor County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyQP.definition: Washington Superior Court - Grays Harbor County refers to a specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Grays Harbor County.
english_labels: Washington Superior Court - Grays Harbor County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyRN.label: Contains Line Items
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyRN.definition: Contains Line Items refers to a subclass of Fee Invoice Detail in the context of Engagement Terms, indicating that it includes specific items or charges within a legal services invoice.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyVg.label: New York City Court - Gloversville
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyVg.definition: A court located in Gloversville, New York City that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyW1.label: Citation to Treaties
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyW1.definition: A document's citations to treaties (e.g., international treaties, aboriginal treaties)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyWP.label: Other Construction Material Merchant Wholesalers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyWP.definition: This industry comprises (1) establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of manufactured homes (i.e., mobile homes) and/or prefabricated buildings and (2) establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of construction materials (except lumber, plywood, millwork, wood panels, brick, stone, roofing, siding, electrical and wiring supplies, and insulation materials).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyXF.label: Attributes of Real Estate
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyXF.definition: Attributes of Real Estate refer to specific designations or classifications that a parcel of land or property can possess, influencing its usage, regulations, and value. These attributes, like being a Historical Landmark or Nature Reserve, often come with particular legal frameworks and can be used for zoning or development purposes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyYd.label: Motion to Stay Removal
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyYd.definition: A Motion to Stay Removal is a legal request made to temporarily halt the deportation or removal of an individual from a country.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyZQ.label: L631 ESI stage, preparation and process
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyZQ.definition: Activities and actions related to staging, preparing and processing ESI. Includes culling, date filtering, key word application, ECA and other related.
english_labels: L631 ESI stage, preparation and process

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ryat.label: Reasonable Best Efforts Standard
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ryat.definition: A Reasonable Best Efforts Standard is a legal concept that requires a party to make a good faith effort to achieve a specific goal or outcome, taking into account the circumstances and resources available to them.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ryaz.label: Educational Diplomas and Degrees
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ryaz.definition: Educational Diplomas and Degrees are credentials awarded by educational institutions to signify the completion of a course of study or training in a particular subject. These degrees vary in level, such as associate's, bachelor's, master's, and doctoral degrees, and in field, such as arts, sciences, law, medicine, and engineering. They serve as a qualification for various professions and are commonly used in academic, professional, and formal settings to denote expertise

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rybm.label: Uninsured Driving
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rybm.definition: "Driving Without Insurance" refers to the act of operating a motor vehicle without having the necessary insurance coverage as required by law. This is considered a legal offense in many jurisdictions and may result in penalties, fines, and even suspension of the driver's license.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rybn.label: Georgia District Court - Spalding County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rybn.definition: A court located in Spalding County, Georgia that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ryeq.label: Buddhist Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ryeq.definition: Buddhist Law, while not codified as a formal legal system in most regions, refers to the ethical and moral teachings derived from the teachings of the Buddha, especially the Vinaya, which governs the conduct of Buddhist monastics.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ryhh.label: TR720 Portfolio Analysis and Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ryhh.definition: All action associated with reviewing, analyzing, documenting, and managing a portfolio of trademarks. Includes trademark "due diligence" during transactional analysis.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ryic.label: Settlement Offer
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ryic.definition: A settlement offer is a written proposal made by one party to another in an attempt to resolve a legal dispute outside of court.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyjH.label: Practical Guidance Management
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyjH.definition: Practical Guidance Management is a subcategory of Legal Research that involves the organization and utilization of practical guidance materials to assist in legal decision-making and problem-solving.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyjK.label: Equitable Fraud
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyjK.definition: Equitable Fraud is a type of claim in which a party seeks relief from a court based on the defendant's fraudulent conduct, even if the conduct does not meet the legal definition of fraud.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ryjw.label: Intervenor-Defendant
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ryjw.definition: A person who intervenes or seeks to intervene as a defendant in a civil action.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RykN.label: TR140 Budgeting
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RykN.definition: Covers developing, negotiating, and revising the budget for a matter that does not fit under other task codes below. Cost estimates which are included as part of other activities, such as reporting an Official Communication from a Trademark Office, should be included under the appropriate task codes below, unless otherwise instructed by the client.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RykW.label: Georgia Superior Court - Chattahoochee County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RykW.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over legal matters within Chattahoochee County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ryly.label: Autism Spectrum Disorder with Intellectual Impairment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ryly.definition: Autism Spectrum Disorder with Intellectual Impairment is characterized by the core symptoms of autism, including deficits in social communication and interaction, and restricted, repetitive behaviors or interests. This condition is accompanied by significant limitations in intellectual functioning, affecting cognitive abilities and adaptive functioning.
english_labels: Autism Spectrum Disorder with Cognitive Impairment
Autism Spectrum Disorder with Intellectual Impairment

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RymG.label: X135 Local Counsel
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RymG.definition: Any local counsel fees paid directly by the law firm or legal vendor

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rync.label: X107 Telephone-Local
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rync.definition: Any local telephone charges; if VOIP expense bill as a single line item as opposed to a per call charge

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RypE.label: Litigation Hold Letter
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RypE.definition: A litigation hold letter is a written communication sent to potential custodians of electronically stored information (ESI) advising them of their obligation to preserve relevant ESI in anticipation of or during litigation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rysu.label: oasis:actor
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rysu.definition: A person or organization that plays a role in the creation, management, or dissemination of metadata, as defined within the OASIS standard.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ryu5.label: Waiver Clause
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ryu5.definition: A waiver clause is a provision in a contract that relinquishes a party's right to assert a particular legal claim or defense.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyuQ.label: Motions on Remedies and Relief
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyuQ.definition: Motions on Remedies and Relief refer to requests made in trial courts seeking a specific remedy or relief, such as an increase or reduction in award, equitable relief, or recovery of fees, interest, and costs.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyvC.label: Fraud in the Inducement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyvC.definition: Fraud in the Inducement is a type of fraud claim where a party is deceived into entering a contract or agreement based on false information provided by the other party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyvM.label: X143 Bank Fees
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RyvM.definition: Any reimbursable bank fees associated with the matter. This type of expense is more typically reimbursed outside the US.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ryz3.label: Disapproved Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ryz3.definition: The previously effective law has been disapproved by some authority (e.g., appellate court, judge).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rz1s.label: Lesbian
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rz1s.definition: Lesbian refers to a woman who is attracted to other women. It is a sexual orientation that is part of the LGBTQIA+ spectrum, and like other orientations, the experience of being lesbian can vary among individuals.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rz1y.label: Georgia Superior Court - Carroll County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rz1y.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Carroll County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Carroll County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rz2y.label: Georgia Superior Court - Pike County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rz2y.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Pike County is a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases in Pike County, Georgia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rz5X.label: Georgia District Court - Jefferson County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rz5X.definition: Georgia District Court - Jefferson County is a specific court within the Georgia District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Jefferson County, Georgia.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rz7E.label: Texas District Court - Bexar County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rz7E.definition: A court located in Bexar County, Texas that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rz8Q.label: P500 Negotiation/Revision/Responses
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rz8Q.definition: This phase includes conducting negotiations, revising the initial (P400) transaction documentation as a result of such negotiations, attendance at meetings, and responses thereto (including communications with clients with respect thereto). The review of documents received from non-client third parties should also be coded here.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rz9N.label: Copyright Registration Document
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rz9N.definition: A Copyright Registration Document is the official certificate issued by a copyright office, such as the U.S. Copyright Office, confirming the registration of a specific work. The document serves as public record of the copyright claim and provides prima facie evidence of copyright ownership, facilitating the enforcement of rights in legal disputes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzBu.label: L621 Collection/Recovery
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzBu.definition: Activities and actions related to the collection and/or recovery of a) custodial email residing on the network, server, home share or enterprise archive or journal, hard-drives and removable media, as well as paper files, b) collection and/or recovery of non-custodial data the network, server, group shares, removable media and paper files, and c) decrypting files, cracking passwords, files restoration and other forensic analysis activity. Includes selective collection, searches and source imaging.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzEk.label: Physician
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzEk.definition: A physician or doctor is a person who is licensed to practice medicine and provide medical treatment to patients.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzGX.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Montgomery County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzGX.definition: The Indiana Circuit Court - Montgomery County is a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Montgomery County, Indiana.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzIJ.label: Protected Timberland
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzIJ.definition: Protected Timberland refers to forested land that is designated for conservation and protection from logging and other forms of exploitation. This designation is often made to preserve biodiversity, protect wildlife habitats, and maintain ecological balance.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzLN.label: Reputational Risk
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzLN.definition: The threats and opportunities associated with an organization's reputation and credibility with its partners, stakeholders, and the public — that might damage an organization's public image, credibility, or brand value. These risks can stem from various sources, such as operational failures, unethical behavior, or public controversies, potentially leading to diminished customer loyalty, reduced investor confidence, or decreased market opportunities, ultimately impacting the organization's overall performance and growth prospects.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzN0.label: Advertising, Public Relations, and Related Services Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzN0.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in advertising, public relations, and related services, such as media buying, independent media representation, indoor and outdoor display advertising, direct mail advertising, advertising material distribution services, and other services related to advertising.
english_labels: Advertising, Public Relations, and Related Services Industry

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzPF.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Holt County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzPF.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Holt County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Holt County, Missouri.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzPj.label: Litigation Case Name
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzPj.definition: A Litigation Case Name is a specific identifier used to refer to a legal case in the context of litigation, which may include a short or long name for the case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzQ5.label: Tiv
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzQ5.definition: Tiv (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is spoken in Nigeria by the Tiv people.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzQm.label: Fraud and Economic Torts Law
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzQm.definition: The wrong done by another person or business that occurs in, or affects, commerce.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzRe.label: L656 Redaction
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzRe.definition: Activities and actions related to the development and implementation of a redaction protocol and the actual redaction of data and documents consistent with such a protocol.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzRv.label: Creoles and pidgins, French-based
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzRv.definition: A French-based Creole or Pidgin language, which is a simplified language that develops as a means of communication between groups who do not share a common language, but have frequent contact with each other, and which has evolved from French.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzS5.label: Administrative Negligence
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzS5.definition: Administrative Negligence is a legal concept that refers to the failure of a government agency or official to perform their duties with reasonable care, resulting in harm or injury to individuals or the public.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzVo.label: Joint Venture Formation Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzVo.definition: The creation of a new business entity by two or more parties working together, typically performed by a legal services provider as part of their entity formation services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzWH.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Forest County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzWH.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Forest County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in Forest County, Pennsylvania.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Forest County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzXE.label: Nevada Court of Appeals
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzXE.definition: The Nevada Court of Appeals is a court within the Nevada State Courts system that hears appeals from lower courts and makes decisions on legal disputes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzZs.label: Bankruptcy Chapter 7 Claim
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzZs.definition: A Bankruptcy Chapter 7 Claim is a type of claim made by a creditor in a bankruptcy case under Chapter 7 of the Bankruptcy Code, seeking to recover a debt owed by the debtor.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzaj.label: Right to Effective Assistance of Counsel
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzaj.definition: The "Right to Effective Assistance of Counsel" refers to an individual's entitlement not only to legal representation but to representation that is competent and effective. It means that a lawyer must perform adequately and any significant failure in this duty can lead to a violation of a defendant's rights, potentially resulting in reversals of convictions or other legal remedies.
english_labels: Right to Effective Assistance of Counsel

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzbR.label: Negligent Performance of An Undertaking
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzbR.definition: The Negligent Performance of An Undertaking refers to a legal claim of negligence where a party fails to fulfill their obligation or duty, resulting in harm or damage to another party.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzbz.label: Arizona Superior Court - Gila Cty.
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzbz.definition: Arizona Superior Court - Gila Cty. is a specific court within the Arizona Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Gila County.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzfF.label: Motions on Timing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzfF.definition: A Motion on Timing is a type of procedural motion in a trial court or bankruptcy case that seeks to modify or extend the time frame for a particular action or event, such as setting a hearing or continuing a case.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzfX.label: Abandonment Practice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzfX.definition: Abandonment Practice refers to the legal process of relinquishing ownership or control of an asset, typically in the context of Asset Disposition Practice.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzg8.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzg8.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas is a trial court within the Pennsylvania State Courts system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzgy.label: Mobile Home
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzgy.definition: A Mobile Home is a prefabricated residential structure built in a factory and transported to its site, designed for permanent or semi-permanent habitation. These homes are typically placed in mobile home parks or on private land and can be moved to different locations as needed.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzhJ.label: Bankruptcy Procedural Filings
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzhJ.definition: Bankruptcy Procedural Filings are written or recorded documents related to the legal process of bankruptcy, including petitions, motions, and other court filings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzj0.label: Status - Received
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzj0.definition: Status of "Received" indicates that the relevant authority or agency has successfully received the submitted application or document. This status marks the initial step in the processing journey, with further steps to follow for assessment, review, and decision-making

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzkJ.label: L460 Post-Trial Motions and Submissions
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzkJ.definition: A post-trial motion or submission is a legal request made by a party after a trial has concluded, typically seeking relief or a change in the outcome of the trial.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzkc.label: Soybeans
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzkc.definition: Soybeans are legumes from the Glycine max species, known for their high protein content and versatility in food, feed, and industrial applications. They are cultivated for their seeds, which are processed into products like soy oil, tofu, and soy milk, and used as a key ingredient in animal feed and biodiesel production.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzoL.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Coles County (5th Circuit Court)
english_labels: Illinois Circuit Court - Coles County (5th Circuit Court)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzor.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Union County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzor.definition: A court located in Union County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases.
english_labels: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Union County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzph.label: file_item_nbr
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzph.definition: "The item count of this data element in the invoice file submission. "

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzqZ.label: Real Estate Broker's Liability to Prospective Purchaser for Failure to Inspect and Disclose
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzqZ.definition: The legal responsibility of a real estate broker to a potential buyer for not inspecting and revealing information about a property.
english_labels: Real Estate Broker's Liability to Prospective Purchaser for Failure to Inspect and Disclose

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzqx.label: Contact Short Name
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzqx.definition: Contact Short Name refers to an abbreviated or simplified name used to easily identify a person or entity. This shortened name may be used in databases, communications, or reports, and is usually derived from the client's full legal or DBA name for ease of reference.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzrv.label: Respiratory Failure
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzrv.definition: Respiratory failure is a serious condition in which the respiratory system fails to adequately exchange oxygen and carbon dioxide, leading to insufficient oxygenation of the blood or inadequate removal of carbon dioxide. This condition, resulting from chronic respiratory disorders, requires invasive mechanical ventilation, noninvasive ventilation with bilevel positive airway pressure (BiPAP), or a combination of both treatments for a continuous period of at least 48 hours, or at least 72 hours if postoperative.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzuj.label: Minnesota District Court - Dodge County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzuj.definition: Minnesota District Court - Dodge County is a specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Dodge County, Minnesota.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzvr.label: Stay Execution of Judgment or Order
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzvr.definition: A Stay Execution of Judgment or Order is a legal concept that refers to a request made by a party to temporarily suspend the enforcement of a court's decision or order, typically while an appeal or other legal action is pending.
english_labels: Stay Execution of Judgment or Order

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzwE.label: Fulah
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzwE.definition: A language spoken primarily in West Africa, including countries such as Senegal, Gambia, and Guinea, among others.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzwS.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Crawford County
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/RzwS.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Crawford County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings at the county level in Pennsylvania.
english_labels: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Crawford County

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzy5.label: Patent Regulatory Objectives
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzy5.definition: Patent Regulatory Objectives refer to the specific aims, goals, and plans related to the legal framework governing the registration of patents, including plant, design, and utility patents.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzye.label: Drug / Alcohol Treatment
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Rzye.definition: A program or facility designed to help individuals overcome addiction to drugs or alcohol, which is a condition imposed as part of a criminal sentence.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/S0aq.label: Other General Purpose Machinery Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/S0aq.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing pumps and compressors, material handling equipment, and all other general purpose machinery (except ventilation, heating, air-conditioning, and commercial refrigeration equipment; metalworking machinery; and engines, turbines, and power transmission equipment).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/S12-.label: Advertising, Public Relations, and Related Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/S12-.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in advertising, public relations, and related services, such as media buying, independent media representation, indoor and outdoor display advertising, direct mail advertising, advertising material distribution services, and other services related to advertising.
english_labels: Advertising, Public Relations, and Related Services

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/S1Dz.label: Video Tape and Disc Rental
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/S1Dz.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in renting prerecorded video tapes and discs for home electronic equipment, including renting through vending machines.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/S1TY.label: Funeral Homes and Funeral Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/S1TY.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in preparing the dead for burial or interment and conducting funerals (i.e., providing facilities for wakes, arranging transportation for the dead, selling caskets and related merchandise). Funeral homes combined with crematories are included in this industry.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/S1mU.label: Paper Mills
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/S1mU.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing paper from pulp. These establishments may manufacture or purchase pulp. In addition, the establishments may convert the paper they make. The activity of making paper classifies an establishment into this industry regardless of the output.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/S2M-.label: Other Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment Rental and Leasing
english_labels: Other Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment Rental and Leasing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/S9-h.label: Health and Welfare Funds
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/S9-h.definition: This industry comprises legal entities (i.e., funds, plans, and/or programs) organized to provide medical, surgical, hospital, vacation, training, and other health- and welfare-related employee benefits exclusively for the sponsor's employees or members.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/S9Fl.label: Historical Sites
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/S9Fl.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the preservation and exhibition of sites, buildings, forts, or communities that describe events or persons of particular historical interest. Archeological sites, battlefields, historical ships, and pioneer villages are included in this industry.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/SA8c.label: Taxi and Ridesharing Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/SA8c.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing passenger transportation by automobile or van, not operated over regular routes and on regular schedules. Establishments of taxicab owner/operators, taxicab fleet operators, taxicab organizations, ridesharing services (including arrangement services), and ride hailing services (including arrangement services) are included in this industry.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/SAo8.label: Other Transit and Ground Passenger Transportation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/SAo8.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing other transit and ground passenger transportation (except urban transit systems, interurban and rural bus transportation, taxi and ridesharing services, school and employee bus transportation, charter bus services, and limousine services (except shuttle services)). Shuttle services (except school and employee bus) and special needs transportation services are included in this industry. Shuttle services establishments generally travel within a metropolitan area and its adjacent nonurban areas on regular routes, on regular schedules and provide services between hotels, airports, or other destination points. Establishments in the Special Needs Transportation industry provide passenger transportation for the disabled or elderly. These establishments may use specially equipped vehicles to provide passenger transportation.
english_labels: Other Transit and Ground Passenger Transportation

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/SGXQ.label: Artificial and Synthetic Fibers and Filaments Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/SGXQ.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing cellulosic (e.g., rayon, acetate) and noncellulosic (e.g., nylon, polyolefin, polyester) fibers and filaments in the form of monofilament, filament yarn, staple, or tow or (2) manufacturing and texturizing cellulosic and noncellulosic fibers and filaments.
english_labels: Artificial and Synthetic Fibers and Filaments Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/SGah.label: Electric Power Generation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/SGah.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in operating electric power generation facilities. These facilities convert other forms of energy, such as water power (i.e., hydroelectric), fossil fuels, nuclear power, and solar power, into electrical energy. The establishments in this industry produce electric energy and provide electricity to transmission systems or to electric power distribution systems.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/SKBP.label: Plumbing and Heating Equipment and Supplies (Hydronics) Merchant Wholesalers
english_labels: Plumbing and Heating Equipment and Supplies (Hydronics) Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/SMxN.label: Noncitrus Fruit and Tree Nut Farming
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/SMxN.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) growing noncitrus fruits (e.g., apples, grapes, berries, peaches); (2) growing tree nuts (e.g., pecans, almonds, pistachios); or (3) growing a combination of fruit(s) and tree nut(s) with no one fruit (or family of fruit) or family of tree nuts accounting for one-half of the establishment's agricultural production (i.e., value of crops for market).
english_labels: Noncitrus Fruit and Tree Nut Farming

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/SPXI.label: Automobile Dealers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/SPXI.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing new and used automobiles and light trucks, such as sport utility vehicles, and passenger and cargo vans.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/SXtN.label: Parking Lots and Garages
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/SXtN.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing parking space for motor vehicles, usually on an hourly, daily, or monthly basis and/or valet parking services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Scu_.label: Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment (except Automotive and Electronic) Repair and Maintenance
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Scu_.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the repair and maintenance of commercial and industrial machinery and equipment. Establishments in this industry either sharpen/install commercial and industrial machinery blades and saws or provide welding (e.g., automotive, general) repair services; or repair agricultural and other heavy and industrial machinery and equipment (e.g., forklifts and other material handling equipment, machine tools, commercial refrigeration equipment, construction equipment, and mining machinery).
english_labels: Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment (except Automotive and Electronic) Repair and Maintenance

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Se4m.label: Drilling Oil and Gas Wells
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Se4m.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in drilling oil and gas wells for others on a contract or fee basis. This industry includes contractors that specialize in spudding in, drilling in, redrilling, and directional drilling.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ShaH.label: Administration of Conservation Programs
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ShaH.definition: This industry comprises government establishments primarily engaged in the administration, regulation, supervision, and control of land use, including recreational areas; conservation and preservation of natural resources; erosion control; geological survey program administration; weather forecasting program administration; and the administration and protection of publicly and privately owned forest lands. Government establishments responsible for planning, management, regulation, and conservation of game, fish, and wildlife populations, including wildlife management areas and field stations; and other administrative matters relating to the protection of fish, game, and wildlife are included in this industry.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/SkwH.label: Media Streaming Distribution Services, Social Networks, and Other Media Networks and Content Providers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/SkwH.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily providing media streaming distribution services, operating social network sites, operating media broadcasting and cable television networks, and supplying information, such as news reports, articles, pictures, and features, to the news media. These establishments distribute textual, audio, and/or video content of general or specific interest.
english_labels: Media Streaming Distribution Services, Social Networks, and Other Media Networks and Content Providers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/SquZ.label: RV (Recreational Vehicle) Parks and Campgrounds
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/SquZ.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in operating sites to accommodate campers and their equipment, including tents, tent trailers, travel trailers, and RVs (recreational vehicles). These establishments may provide access to facilities, such as washrooms, laundry rooms, recreation halls, playgrounds, stores, and snack bars.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/StKB.label: Metal Kitchen Cookware, Utensil, Cutlery, and Flatware (except Precious) Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/StKB.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing metal kitchen cookware (except by casting (e.g., cast iron skillets) or stamped without further fabrication), utensils, and/or nonprecious and precious plated metal cutlery and flatware.
english_labels: Metal Kitchen Cookware, Utensil, Cutlery, and Flatware (except Precious) Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/SumC.label: Tax Preparation Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/SumC.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments (except offices of CPAs) engaged in providing tax return preparation services without also providing accounting, bookkeeping, billing, or payroll processing services. Basic knowledge of tax law and filing requirements is required.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/T0X_.label: Lawn and Garden Tractor and Home Lawn and Garden Equipment Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/T0X_.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing powered lawnmowers, lawn and garden tractors, and other home lawn and garden equipment, such as tillers, shredders, yard vacuums, and leaf blowers.
english_labels: Lawn and Garden Tractor and Home Lawn and Garden Equipment Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/T25E.label: Sawmills
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/T25E.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in sawing dimension lumber, boards, beams, timbers, poles, ties, shingles, shakes, siding, and wood chips from logs or bolts. Sawmills may plane the rough lumber that they make with a planing machine to achieve smoothness and uniformity of size.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/T2VB.label: Grain and Field Bean Merchant Wholesalers
english_labels: Grain and Field Bean Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/T3L_.label: Sports and Recreation Instruction
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/T3L_.definition: This industry comprises establishments, such as camps and schools, primarily engaged in offering instruction in athletic activities. Overnight and day sports instruction camps are included in this industry.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/T52A.label: Orange Groves
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/T52A.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in growing oranges.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/T9ZF.label: Truck, Utility Trailer, and RV (Recreational Vehicle) Rental and Leasing
english_labels: Truck, Utility Trailer, and RV (Recreational Vehicle) Rental and Leasing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/TBzE.label: Business and Secretarial Schools
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/TBzE.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in offering courses in office procedures and secretarial and stenographic skills and may offer courses in basic office skills, such as word processing. In addition, these establishments may offer such classes as office machine operation, reception, communications, and other skills designed for individuals pursuing a clerical or secretarial career. Instruction may be provided in diverse settings, such as the establishment's or client's training facilities, educational institutions, the workplace, or the home, and through diverse means, such as correspondence, television, the Internet, or other electronic and distance-learning methods. The training provided by these establishments may include the use of simulators and simulation methods.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/TDBu.label: Legal Counsel and Prosecution
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/TDBu.definition: This industry comprises government establishments primarily engaged in providing legal counsel or prosecution services for the government.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/TDwU.label: Port and Harbor Operations
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/TDwU.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in operating ports, harbors (including docking and pier facilities), or canals.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/TF0a.label: Motor and Generator Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/TF0a.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing electric motors (except internal combustion engine starting motors), power generators (except battery charging alternators for internal combustion engines), and motor generator sets (except turbine generator set units). This industry includes establishments rewinding armatures on a factory basis.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/TFrZ.label: Lessors of Nonfinancial Intangible Assets (except Copyrighted Works)
english_labels: Lessors of Nonfinancial Intangible Assets (except Copyrighted Works)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/TIqR.label: Support Activities for Agriculture and Forestry Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/TIqR.definition: Industries in the Support Activities for Agriculture and Forestry subsector provide support services that are an essential part of agricultural and forestry production. These support activities may be performed by the agriculture or forestry producing establishment or conducted independently as an alternative source of inputs required for the production process for a given crop, animal, or forestry industry. Establishments that primarily perform these activities independent of the agriculture or forestry producing establishment are in this subsector.
english_labels: Support Activities for Agriculture and Forestry Industry

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/TP8b.label: Security Guards and Patrol Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/TP8b.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing guard and patrol services, such as bodyguard, guard dog, and parking security services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/TS52.label: All Other Miscellaneous Crop Farming
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/TS52.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one of the following: (1) growing crops (except oilseeds and/or grains; vegetables and/or melons; fruits and/or tree nuts; greenhouse, nursery, and/or floriculture products; tobacco; cotton; sugarcane; hay; sugar beets; or peanuts); (2) growing a combination of crops (except a combination of oilseed(s) and grain(s); and a combination of fruit(s) and tree nut(s)) with no one crop or family of crops accounting for one-half of the establishment's agricultural production (i.e., value of crops for market); or (3) gathering tea or maple sap.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/TX1k.label: Automotive Glass Replacement Shops
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/TX1k.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in replacing, repairing, and/or tinting automotive vehicle glass, such as passenger car, truck, and van glass.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/T_N2.label: Materials Recovery Facilities
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/T_N2.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) operating facilities for separating and sorting recyclable materials from nonhazardous waste streams (i.e., garbage) and/or (2) operating facilities where commingled recyclable materials, such as paper, plastics, used beverage cans, and metals, are sorted into distinct categories.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/TbJ_.label: Motor Vehicle Seating and Interior Trim Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/TbJ_.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing motor vehicle seating, seats, seat frames, seat belts, and interior trimmings.
english_labels: Motor Vehicle Seating and Interior Trim Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/TdWX.label: Other Chemical and Allied Products Merchant Wholesalers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/TdWX.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of chemicals and allied products (except agricultural and medicinal chemicals, paints and varnishes, fireworks, and plastics materials and basic forms and shapes).
english_labels: Other Chemical and Allied Products Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Tf97.label: Air and Gas Compressor Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Tf97.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing general purpose air and gas compressors, such as reciprocating compressors, centrifugal compressors, vacuum pumps (except laboratory), and nonagricultural spraying and dusting compressors and spray gun units.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/TfrC.label: Social Advocacy Organizations
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/TfrC.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in promoting a particular cause or working for the realization of a specific social or political goal to benefit a broad or specific constituency. These organizations may solicit contributions and offer memberships to support these goals.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Tgba.label: Offices of All Other Health Practitioners
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Tgba.definition: This industry comprises establishments of independent health practitioners (except physicians; dentists; chiropractors; optometrists; mental health specialists; physical, occupational, and speech therapists; and audiologists). These practitioners operate private or group practices in their own offices (e.g., centers, clinics) or in the facilities of others, such as hospitals or HMO medical centers.
english_labels: Offices of All Other Health Practitioners

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ttp4.label: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
english_labels: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/TvZn.label: Paint, Coating, and Adhesive Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/TvZn.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) mixing pigments, solvents, and binders into paints and other coatings; (2) manufacturing allied paint products; and (3) manufacturing adhesives, glues, and caulking compounds.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/TvwW.label: Local Messengers and Local Delivery
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/TvwW.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing local messenger and delivery services of small items within a single metropolitan area or within an urban center. These establishments generally provide point-to-point pick-up and delivery and do not operate as part of an intercity courier network.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/U3L3.label: Other Building Finishing Contractors
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/U3L3.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in building finishing trade work (except drywall, plaster, and insulation work; painting and wall covering work; flooring work; tile and terrazzo work; and finish carpentry work). The work performed may include new work, additions, alterations, maintenance, and repairs.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UDUC.label: Portfolio Management and Investment Advice
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UDUC.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in managing the portfolio assets (i.e., funds) of others on a fee or commission basis and/or providing customized investment advice to clients on a fee basis. Establishments providing portfolio management have the authority to make investment decisions, and they derive fees based on the size and/or overall performance of the portfolio. Establishments providing investment advice provide financial planning advice and investment counseling to meet the goals and needs of specific clients, but do not have the authority to execute trades.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UDhu.label: Industrial Launderers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UDhu.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in supplying, on a rental or contract basis, laundered industrial work uniforms and related work clothing, such as protective apparel (flame and heat resistant) and clean room apparel; dust control items, such as treated mops, rugs, mats, dust tool covers, cloths, and shop or wiping towels.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UEzp.label: Wood Window and Door Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UEzp.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing window and door units, sash, window and door frames, and doors from wood or wood clad with metal or plastics.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UHyS.label: All Other Automotive Repair and Maintenance
