https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UHyS.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing automotive repair and maintenance services (except mechanical and electrical repair and maintenance; body, paint, interior, and glass repair; motor oil change and lubrication; and car washing) for automotive vehicles, such as passenger cars, trucks, and vans, and all trailers.
english_labels: All Other Automotive Repair and Maintenance

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UIlw.label: Pharmacies and Drug Retailers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UIlw.definition: This industry comprises establishments generally known as pharmacies and drug retailers engaged in retailing prescription or nonprescription drugs and medicines.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UIsr.label: Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UIsr.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing complete guided missiles and space vehicles and/or (2) developing and making prototypes of guided missiles or space vehicles.
english_labels: Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UMqc.label: Utility System Construction
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UMqc.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in the construction of distribution lines and related buildings and structures for utilities (i.e., water, sewer, petroleum, gas, power, and communication). All structures (including buildings) that are integral parts of utility systems (e.g., storage tanks, pumping stations, power plants, and refineries) are included in this industry group.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UR_l.label: Petroleum and Petroleum Products Merchant Wholesalers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UR_l.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of petroleum and petroleum products, including liquefied petroleum gas.
english_labels: Petroleum and Petroleum Products Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UUbV.label: Motion Picture Theaters (except Drive-Ins)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UUbV.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in operating motion picture theaters (except drive-ins) and/or exhibiting motion pictures or videos at film festivals, and so forth.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UUls.label: Sewing, Needlework, and Piece Goods Retailers
english_labels: Sewing, Needlework, and Piece Goods Retailers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UZHA.label: Cookie and Cracker Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UZHA.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing cookies, crackers, and other products, such as ice cream cones.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ue8Q.label: General Line Grocery Merchant Wholesalers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ue8Q.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of a general line (wide range) of groceries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UlA0.label: Motion Picture and Video Industries
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UlA0.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in the production and/or distribution of motion pictures, videos, television programs, or commercials; in the exhibition of motion pictures; or in the provision of postproduction and related services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UmtT.label: Metal Can, Box, and Other Metal Container (Light Gauge) Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UmtT.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in forming light gauge metal containers.
english_labels: Metal Can, Box, and Other Metal Container (Light Gauge) Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Uo4w.label: Other Building Equipment Contractors
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Uo4w.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in installing or servicing building equipment (except electrical, plumbing, heating, cooling, or ventilation equipment). The repair and maintenance of miscellaneous building equipment is included in this industry. The work performed may include new work, additions, alterations, maintenance, and repairs.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UrGy.label: Paint, Varnish, and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers
english_labels: Paint, Varnish, and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Usuw.label: Spring and Wire Product Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Usuw.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing steel springs by forming, such as cutting, bending, and heat winding, metal rod or strip stock and/or (2) manufacturing wire springs and fabricated wire products from wire drawn elsewhere (except watch and clock springs).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UyDv.label: Other Metal Container Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UyDv.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing metal (light gauge) containers (except cans).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Uyhu.label: Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Uyhu.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the construction of highways (including elevated), streets, roads, airport runways, public sidewalks, or bridges. The work performed may include new work, reconstruction, rehabilitation, and repairs. Specialty trade contractors are included in this industry if they are engaged in activities primarily related to highway, street, and bridge construction (e.g., installing guardrails on highways).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UzPd.label: Jewelry, Watch, Precious Stone, and Precious Metal Merchant Wholesalers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/UzPd.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of jewelry, precious and semiprecious stones, precious metals and metal flatware, costume jewelry, watches, clocks, silverware, and/or jewelers' findings.
english_labels: Jewelry, Watch, Precious Stone, and Precious Metal Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/V08L.label: Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/V08L.definition: Industries in the Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services subsector group establishments engaged in processes where human capital is the major input. These establishments make available the knowledge and skills of their employees, often on an assignment basis, where an individual or team is responsible for the delivery of services to the client. The individual industries of this subsector are defined on the basis of the particular expertise and training of the services provider. The distinguishing feature of the Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services subsector is the fact that most of the industries grouped in it have production processes that are almost wholly dependent on worker skills. Thus, the establishments classified in this subsector sell expertise. Much of the expertise requires degrees, though not in every case.
english_labels: Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services Industry

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/V5nD.label: Promoters of Performing Arts, Sports, and Similar Events with Facilities
english_labels: Promoters of Performing Arts, Sports, and Similar Events with Facilities

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/VCGR.label: Residential Intellectual and Developmental Disability, Mental Health, and Substance Abuse Facilities
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/VCGR.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing residential care (but not licensed hospital care) to people with intellectual and developmental disabilities, mental illness, or substance abuse problems.
english_labels: Residential Intellectual and Developmental Disability, Mental Health, and Substance Abuse Facilities

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/VCR9.label: Truck Trailer Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/VCR9.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing truck trailers, truck trailer chassis, cargo container chassis, detachable trailer bodies, and detachable trailer chassis for sale separately.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/VGLJ.label: Used Household and Office Goods Moving
english_labels: Used Household and Office Goods Moving

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/VHkg.label: Electronic Connector Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/VHkg.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing electronic connectors, such as coaxial, cylindrical, rack and panel, pin and sleeve, printed circuit, and fiber optic.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/VKr0.label: Broadwoven Fabric Mills
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/VKr0.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in weaving broadwoven fabrics and felts (except tire fabrics and rugs). Establishments in this industry may weave only, weave and finish, or weave, finish, and further fabricate fabric products.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/VLN3.label: Natural Gas Distribution
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/VLN3.definition: This industry comprises: (1) establishments primarily engaged in operating gas distribution systems (e.g., mains, meters); (2) establishments known as gas marketers that buy gas from the well and sell it to a distribution system; (3) establishments known as gas brokers or agents that arrange the sale of gas over gas distribution systems operated by others; and (4) establishments primarily engaged in transmitting and distributing gas to final consumers.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/VNQQ.label: Navigational Services to Shipping
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/VNQQ.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing navigational services to shipping. Marine salvage establishments are included in this industry.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/VO3x.label: Nature Parks and Other Similar Institutions
english_labels: Nature Parks and Other Similar Institutions

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/VOQk.label: Pump and Compressor Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/VOQk.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing pumps and compressors, such as general purpose air and gas compressors, nonagricultural spraying and dusting equipment, general purpose pumps and pumping equipment (except fluid power pumps and motors), and measuring and dispensing pumps.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/VW9d.label: Shellfish Farming
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/VW9d.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in farm raising shellfish (e.g., crayfish, shrimp, oysters, clams, mollusks).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/VXKN.label: All Other Miscellaneous Nonmetallic Mineral Product Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/VXKN.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing nonmetallic mineral products (except pottery, ceramics, and plumbing fixtures; clay building materials and refractories; glass and glass products; cement; ready-mix concrete; concrete products; lime; gypsum products; abrasive products; cut stone and stone products; ground and treated minerals and earth; and mineral wool).
english_labels: All Other Miscellaneous Nonmetallic Mineral Product Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Vbg_.label: Postharvest Crop Activities (except Cotton Ginning)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Vbg_.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in performing services on crops, subsequent to their harvest, with the intent of preparing them for market or further processing. These establishments provide postharvest activities, such as crop cleaning, sun drying, shelling, fumigating, curing, sorting, grading, packing, and cooling.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/VdmG.label: Residential Remodelers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/VdmG.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily responsible for the remodeling construction (including additions, alterations, reconstruction, maintenance, and repairs) of houses and other residential buildings, single-family and multifamily. Included in this industry are remodeling general contractors, for-sale remodelers, remodeling design-build firms, and remodeling project construction management firms.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/VdrH.label: Farm Supplies Merchant Wholesalers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/VdrH.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of farm supplies, such as animal feeds, fertilizers, agricultural chemicals, pesticides, plant seeds, and plant bulbs.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Vg3C.label: Floor Covering Retailers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Vg3C.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing new floor coverings, such as rugs and carpets, laminate and vinyl floor coverings, linoleum flooring, and floor tile (except ceramic tile or hardwood floor coverings only); or retailing new floor coverings in combination with installation and repair services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/VgA6.label: Agents and Managers for Artists, Athletes, Entertainers, and Other Public Figures
english_labels: Agents and Managers for Artists, Athletes, Entertainers, and Other Public Figures

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Vh_0.label: Administration of Human Resource Programs (except Education, Public Health, and Veterans' Affairs Programs)
english_labels: Administration of Human Resource Programs (except Education, Public Health, and Veterans' Affairs Programs)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/VppQ.label: Electric Lamp Bulb and Other Lighting Equipment Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/VppQ.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing electric light bulbs, tubes, and parts (except glass blanks for electric light bulbs and light emitting diodes (LEDs)), electric lighting fixtures (except residential, commercial, industrial, institutional, and vehicular electric lighting fixtures), and nonelectric lighting equipment.
english_labels: Electric Lamp Bulb and Other Lighting Equipment Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Vtva.label: Record Production and Distribution
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Vtva.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in record production and/or releasing, promoting, and distributing sound recordings to wholesalers, retailers, or directly to the public. These establishments contract with artists, arrange and finance the production of original master recordings, and/or produce master recordings themselves, such as digital music and compact discs. Establishments in this industry hold the copyright to the master recording, or obtain reproduction and distribution rights to master recordings produced by others, and derive most of their revenues from the sales, leasing, licensing, or distribution of master recordings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Vym_.label: Other Food Crops Grown Under Cover
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Vym_.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in growing food crops (except mushrooms) under glass or protective cover.
english_labels: Other Food Crops Grown Under Cover

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/W-jG.label: Other Management Consulting Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/W-jG.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing management consulting services (except administrative and general management consulting; human resources consulting; marketing consulting; or process, physical distribution, and logistics consulting). Establishments providing telecommunications or utilities management consulting services are included in this industry.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/W1kQ.label: Fresh Fruit and Vegetable Merchant Wholesalers
english_labels: Fresh Fruit and Vegetable Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/W2f3.label: Other Legal Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/W2f3.definition: This industry comprises establishments of legal practitioners (except lawyers and attorneys) primarily engaged in providing specialized legal or paralegal services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/W6CY.label: Television Broadcasting Stations
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/W6CY.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in broadcasting images together with sound. These establishments operate television broadcasting studios and facilities for the programming and transmission of programs to the public. Programming may originate in their own studio, from an affiliated network, or from external sources.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WBLL.label: Architectural and Structural Metals Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WBLL.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing one or more of the following: (1) prefabricated metal buildings, panels, and sections; (2) structural metal products; (3) metal plate work products; (4) metal framed windows (i.e., typically using purchased glass) and metal doors; (5) sheet metal work; and (6) ornamental and architectural metal products.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WDWA.label: Piece Goods, Notions, and Other Dry Goods Merchant Wholesalers
english_labels: Piece Goods, Notions, and Other Dry Goods Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WE8R.label: Veneer, Plywood, and Engineered Wood Product Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WE8R.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) manufacturing veneer and/or plywood; (2) manufacturing engineered wood members; and (3) manufacturing reconstituted wood products. This industry includes manufacturing plywood from veneer made in the same establishment or from veneer made in other establishments, and manufacturing plywood faced with nonwood materials, such as plastics or metal.
english_labels: Veneer, Plywood, and Engineered Wood Product Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WEmf.label: Metal Ore Mining
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WEmf.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in developing mine sites or mining metallic minerals, and establishments primarily engaged in ore dressing and beneficiating (i.e., preparing) operations, such as crushing, grinding, washing, drying, sintering, concentrating, calcining, and leaching. Beneficiating may be performed at mills operated in conjunction with the mines served or at mills, such as custom mills, operated separately.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WGRe.label: National Security
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WGRe.definition: This industry comprises government establishments of the Armed Forces, including the National Guard, primarily engaged in national security and related activities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WKdl.label: Fine Arts Schools
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WKdl.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in offering instruction in the arts, including dance, art, drama, and music.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WKeb.label: Underground Coal Mining
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WKeb.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) underground mining of bituminous and anthracite coal; (2) developing bituminous and anthracite coal underground mine sites; and (3) underground mining and beneficiating (e.g., cleaning, washing, screening, and sizing) of bituminous and anthracite coal.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WOxD.label: Plumbing, Heating, and Air-Conditioning Contractors
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WOxD.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in installing and servicing plumbing, heating, and air-conditioning equipment. Contractors in this industry may provide both parts and labor when performing work. The work performed may include new work, additions, alterations, maintenance, and repairs.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WQBL.label: Elementary and Secondary Schools
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WQBL.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in furnishing academic courses and associated course work that comprise a basic preparatory education. A basic preparatory education ordinarily constitutes kindergarten through 12th grade. This industry includes school boards and school districts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WVjb.label: Motor Vehicle Steering and Suspension Components (except Spring) Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WVjb.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing and/or rebuilding motor vehicle steering mechanisms and suspension components (except springs).
english_labels: Motor Vehicle Steering and Suspension Components (except Spring) Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WX2_.label: Dried and Dehydrated Food Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WX2_.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) drying (including freeze-dried) and/or dehydrating fruits, vegetables, and soup mixes and bouillon and/or (2) drying and/or dehydrating ingredients and packaging them with other purchased ingredients, such as rice and dry pasta.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WXW-.label: Finfish Fishing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WXW-.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the commercial catching or taking of finfish (e.g., bluefish, salmon, trout, tuna) from their natural habitat.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WYzU.label: Rolling Mill and Other Metalworking Machinery Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WYzU.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing rolling mill machinery and equipment and/or other metalworking machinery (except industrial molds; special dies and tools, die sets, jigs, and fixtures; cutting tools and machine tool accessories; and machine tools).
english_labels: Rolling Mill and Other Metalworking Machinery Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WZm9.label: Boat Building
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WZm9.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in building boats. Boats are defined as watercraft not built in shipyards and typically of the type suitable or intended for personal use. Included in this industry are establishments that manufacture heavy-duty inflatable rubber or inflatable plastic boats (RIBs).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WgeK.label: Corporate, Subsidiary, and Regional Managing Offices
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WgeK.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments (except government establishments) primarily engaged in administering, overseeing, and managing other establishments of the company or enterprise. These establishments normally undertake the strategic or organizational planning and decision-making role of the company or enterprise. Establishments in this industry may hold the securities of the company or enterprise.
english_labels: Corporate, Subsidiary, and Regional Managing Offices

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WleJ.label: Ethyl Alcohol Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WleJ.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing nonpotable ethyl alcohol.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WmIE.label: Office Machinery and Equipment Rental and Leasing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WmIE.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in renting or leasing office machinery and equipment, such as computers, office furniture, duplicating machines (i.e., copiers), or facsimile machines.
english_labels: Office Machinery and Equipment Rental and Leasing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Wnb0.label: Computer and Peripheral Equipment Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Wnb0.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing and/or assembling electronic computers, such as mainframes, personal computers, workstations, laptops, and computer servers; and computer peripheral equipment, such as storage devices, printers, monitors, and input/output devices and terminals. Computers can be analog, digital, or hybrid. Digital computers, the most common type, are devices that do all of the following: (1) store the processing program or programs and the data immediately necessary for the execution of the program; (2) can be freely programmed in accordance with the requirements of the user; (3) perform arithmetical computations specified by the user; and (4) execute, without human intervention, a processing program that requires the computer to modify its execution by logical decision during the processing run. Analog computers are capable of simulating mathematical models and comprise at least analog, control, and programming elements.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WpI6.label: Electrical Contractors and Other Wiring Installation Contractors
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WpI6.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in installing and servicing electrical wiring and equipment. Contractors included in this industry may include both the parts and labor when performing work. These contractors may perform new work, additions, alterations, maintenance, and repairs.
english_labels: Electrical Contractors and Other Wiring Installation Contractors

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WqhP.label: Recyclable Material Merchant Wholesalers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/WqhP.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of automotive scrap, industrial scrap, and other recyclable materials. Included in this industry are auto wreckers primarily engaged in dismantling motor vehicles for the purpose of wholesaling scrap.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Wtfr.label: Regulation of Agricultural Marketing and Commodities
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Wtfr.definition: This industry comprises government establishments primarily engaged in the planning, administration, and coordination of agricultural programs for production, marketing, and utilization, including educational and promotional activities. Included in this industry are government establishments responsible for regulating and controlling the grading and inspection of food, plants, animals, and other agricultural products.
english_labels: Regulation of Agricultural Marketing and Commodities

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Wvnc.label: Other Urban Transit Systems
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Wvnc.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in operating local and suburban ground passenger transit systems (except mixed mode transit systems, commuter rail systems, and buses and other motor vehicles) over regular routes and on regular schedules within a metropolitan area and its adjacent nonurban areas.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Wy4X.label: Linen and Uniform Supply
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Wy4X.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in supplying, on a rental or contract basis, laundered items, such as uniforms, gowns and coats, table linens, bed linens, towels, clean room apparel, and treated mops or shop towels.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Wzrp.label: Motor Vehicle Steering and Suspension Components (except Spring) Manufacturing
english_labels: Motor Vehicle Steering and Suspension Components (except Spring) Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/X025.label: Nondepository Credit Intermediation Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/X025.definition: This industry group comprises establishments, both public (government-sponsored enterprises) and private, primarily engaged in extending credit or lending funds raised by credit market borrowing, such as issuing commercial paper or other debt instruments or by borrowing from other financial intermediaries. Within this group, industries are defined on the basis of the type of credit being extended.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/X1v_.label: Wheat Farming
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/X1v_.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in growing wheat and/or producing wheat seeds.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/X4eX.label: Power-Driven Handtool Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/X4eX.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing power-driven (e.g., battery, corded, pneumatic) handtools, such as drills, screwguns, circular saws, chain saws, staplers, and nailers.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/X5WH.label: Nail Salons
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/X5WH.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing nail care services, such as manicures, pedicures, and nail extensions.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/X7FM.label: Temporary Help Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/X7FM.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in supplying workers to clients' businesses for limited periods of time to supplement the working force of the client. The individuals provided are employees of the temporary help services establishment. However, these establishments do not provide direct supervision of their employees at the clients' work sites.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/X9_F.label: Construction, Mining, and Forestry Machinery and Equipment Rental and Leasing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/X9_F.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in renting or leasing heavy equipment without operators that may be used for construction, mining, or forestry, such as bulldozers, earthmoving equipment, well drilling machinery and equipment, or cranes.
english_labels: Construction, Mining, and Forestry Machinery and Equipment Rental and Leasing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XAFw.label: Residential Intellectual and Developmental Disability Facilities
english_labels: Residential Intellectual and Developmental Disability Facilities

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XCgN.label: Commercial, Industrial, and Institutional Electric Lighting Fixture Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XCgN.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing commercial, industrial, and institutional electric lighting fixtures.
english_labels: Commercial, Industrial, and Institutional Electric Lighting Fixture Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XD3V.label: Construction and Mining (except Oil Well) Machinery and Equipment Merchant Wholesalers
english_labels: Construction and Mining (except Oil Well) Machinery and Equipment Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XEF_.label: Outpatient Care Centers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XEF_.definition: This industry group comprises establishments with medical staff primarily engaged in providing a range of outpatient services, such as family planning, diagnosis and treatment of mental health disorders and alcohol and other substance abuse, and other general or specialized outpatient care.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XEsQ.label: Industrial Building Construction
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XEsQ.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily responsible for the construction (including new work, additions, alterations, maintenance, and repairs) of industrial buildings (except warehouses). The construction of selected additional structures, whose production processes are similar to those for industrial buildings (e.g., incinerators, cement plants, blast furnaces, and similar nonbuilding structures), is included in this industry. Included in this industry are industrial building general contractors, industrial building for-sale builders, industrial building design-build firms, and industrial building construction management firms.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XEst.label: All Other Home Furnishings Retailers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XEst.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing new home furnishings (except furniture, floor coverings, and window treatments).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XFQo.label: Hardware, and Plumbing and Heating Equipment and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XFQo.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of hardware; plumbing and heating equipment and supplies (hydronics); warm air heating and air-conditioning equipment and supplies; and refrigeration equipment and supplies.
english_labels: Hardware, and Plumbing and Heating Equipment and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XHc0.label: Insurance Carriers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XHc0.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in underwriting (assuming the risk, assigning premiums, and so forth) annuities and insurance policies and investing premiums to build up a portfolio of financial assets to be used against future claims. Direct insurance carriers are establishments that are primarily engaged in initially underwriting and assuming the risk of annuities and insurance policies. Reinsurance carriers are establishments that are primarily engaged in assuming all or part of the risk associated with an existing insurance policy (or set of policies) originally underwritten by another insurance carrier. Industries are defined in terms of the type of risk being insured against, such as death, loss of employment because of age or disability, and/or property damage. Contributions and premiums are set on the basis of actuarial calculations of probable payouts based on risk factors from experience tables and expected investment returns on reserves.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XIna.label: Ambulance Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XIna.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing transportation of patients by ground or air, along with medical care. These services are often provided during a medical emergency but are not restricted to emergencies. The vehicles are equipped with lifesaving equipment operated by medically trained personnel.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XLPZ.label: Lawn and Garden Equipment and Supplies Retailers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XLPZ.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing new lawn and garden equipment and supplies.
english_labels: Lawn and Garden Equipment and Supplies Retailers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XMoH.label: Optical Goods Retailers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XMoH.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) retailing and fitting prescription eyeglasses and contact lenses; (2) retailing prescription eyeglasses in combination with the grinding of lenses to order on the premises; and (3) retailing nonprescription eyeglasses.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XPEa.label: Other Transportation Equipment Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XPEa.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing motorcycles, bicycles, metal tricycles, complete military armored vehicles, tanks, self-propelled weapons, vehicles pulled by draft animals, and other transportation equipment (except motor vehicles, boats, ships, railroad rolling stock, and aerospace products), including parts thereof.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XYWT.label: Administration of Urban Planning and Community and Rural Development
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XYWT.definition: This industry comprises government establishments primarily engaged in the administration and planning of the development of urban and rural areas. Included in this industry are government zoning boards and commissions.
english_labels: Administration of Urban Planning and Community and Rural Development

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XaKM.label: Textile and Fabric Finishing and Fabric Coating Mills
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XaKM.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in one of the following: (1) finishing textiles, fabrics, and apparel; (2) converting fabrics and textiles by buying fabric goods in the grey, having them finished on contract, and selling them at wholesale; or (3) coating, laminating, varnishing, waxing, and rubberizing textiles and apparel.
english_labels: Textile and Fabric Finishing and Fabric Coating Mills

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XbuQ.label: Lessors of Nonfinancial Intangible Assets (except Copyrighted Works)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XbuQ.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in assigning rights to assets, such as patents, trademarks, brand names, and/or franchise agreements, for which a royalty payment or licensing fee is paid to the asset holder.
english_labels: Lessors of Nonfinancial Intangible Assets (except Copyrighted Works)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Xcuv.label: All Other Miscellaneous Food Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Xcuv.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing food (except animal food; grain and oilseed milling; sugar and confectionery products; preserved fruits, vegetables, and specialties; dairy products; meat products; seafood products; bakeries and tortillas; snack foods; coffee and tea; flavoring syrups and concentrates; seasonings and dressings; and perishable prepared food). Included in this industry are establishments primarily engaged in mixing purchased dried and/or dehydrated ingredients including those mixing purchased dried and/or dehydrated ingredients for soup mixes and bouillon.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XdrT.label: Machine Shops; Turned Product; and Screw, Nut, and Bolt Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XdrT.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in one of the following: (1) operating machine shops primarily engaged in machining metal and plastic parts and parts of other composite materials on a job or order basis; (2) machining precision turned products; or (3) manufacturing metal bolts, nuts, screws, rivets, and other industrial fasteners.
english_labels: Machine Shops; Turned Product; and Screw, Nut, and Bolt Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XdxS.label: Toy and Hobby Goods and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XdxS.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of games, toys, fireworks, playing cards, hobby goods and supplies, and/or related goods.
english_labels: Toy and Hobby Goods and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XeYL.label: Ship Building and Repairing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XeYL.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in operating shipyards. Shipyards are fixed facilities with drydocks and fabrication equipment capable of building a ship, defined as watercraft typically suitable or intended for other than personal or recreational use. Activities of shipyards include the construction of ships, their repair, conversion and alteration, the production of prefabricated ship and barge sections, and specialized services, such as ship scaling.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Xept.label: Metal Tank (Heavy Gauge) Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Xept.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in cutting, forming, and joining heavy gauge metal to manufacture tanks, vessels, and other containers.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XgsU.label: Stationery Product Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XgsU.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in converting paper or paperboard into products used for writing, filing, art work, and similar applications.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XmPU.label: Offices of Real Estate Agents and Brokers
english_labels: Offices of Real Estate Agents and Brokers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XmPn.label: Paperboard Container Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XmPn.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in converting paperboard into containers without manufacturing paperboard. These establishments use corrugating, cutting, and shaping machinery to form paperboard into containers. Products made by these establishments include boxes, corrugated sheets, pads, pallets, paper dishes, and fiber drums and reels.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XopN.label: Other Services to Buildings and Dwellings
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XopN.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing services to buildings and dwellings (except exterminating and pest control; janitorial; landscaping care and maintenance; and carpet and upholstery cleaning).
english_labels: Other Services to Buildings and Dwellings

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XqSG.label: Insurance and Employee Benefit Funds
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XqSG.definition: This industry group comprises legal entities (i.e., funds, plans, and/or programs) organized to provide insurance and employee benefits exclusively for the sponsor, firm, or its employees or members.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Xrsl.label: Deep Sea Freight Transportation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Xrsl.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing deep sea transportation of cargo to or from foreign ports.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Xuxp.label: Ammunition (except Small Arms) Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Xuxp.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing ammunition (except small arms). Examples of products made by these establishments are bombs, depth charges, rockets (except guided missiles), grenades, mines, and torpedoes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XyZ6.label: Sand, Gravel, Clay, and Ceramic and Refractory Minerals Mining and Quarrying
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/XyZ6.definition: This industry comprises (1) establishments primarily engaged in developing the mine site and/or mining, quarrying, dredging for sand and gravel, or mining clay (e.g., china clay, paper clay and slip clay) or ceramic and refractory minerals and (2) preparation plants primarily engaged in beneficiating (e.g., washing, screening, and grinding) sand and gravel, clay, and ceramic and refractory minerals.
english_labels: Sand, Gravel, Clay, and Ceramic and Refractory Minerals Mining and Quarrying

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Y1eU.label: Recreational Goods Rental
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Y1eU.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in renting recreational goods, such as bicycles, canoes, motorcycles, skis, sailboats, beach chairs, and beach umbrellas.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Y1hw.label: Miscellaneous Financial Investment Activities
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Y1hw.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in acting as agents and/or brokers (except securities brokerages and commodity contracts brokerages) in buying or selling financial contracts and those providing financial investment services (except securities and commodity exchanges; portfolio management; investment advice; and trust, fiduciary, and custody services) on a fee or commission basis.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Y35y.label: Other Miscellaneous Retailers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Y35y.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing miscellaneous specialized lines of merchandise (except motor vehicle and parts dealers; building material and garden equipment and supplies dealers; food and beverage retailers; furniture, home furnishings, electronics, and appliance retailers; general merchandise retailers; health and personal care retailers; gasoline stations and fuel dealers; clothing, clothing accessories, shoe, and jewelry retailers; sporting goods, hobby, and musical instrument retailers; book retailers and news dealers; florists; office supplies, stationery, and gift retailers; and used merchandise retailers).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Y4ca.label: Gasket, Packing, and Sealing Device Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Y4ca.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing gaskets, packing, and sealing devices of all materials.
english_labels: Gasket, Packing, and Sealing Device Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Y7GB.label: Offices of Real Estate Appraisers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Y7GB.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in estimating the fair market value of real estate.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/YB0x.label: Drinking Places (Alcoholic Beverages)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/YB0x.definition: This industry comprises establishments known as bars, taverns, nightclubs, or drinking places primarily engaged in preparing and serving alcoholic beverages for immediate consumption. These establishments may also provide limited food services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/YD11.label: Other Accounting Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/YD11.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments (except offices of CPAs) engaged in providing accounting services (except tax return preparation services only or payroll services only). These establishments may also provide tax return preparation or payroll services. Accountant (except CPA) offices, bookkeeper offices, and billing offices are included in this industry.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/YFbA.label: Other Wood Product Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/YFbA.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing wood products (except establishments operating sawmills and wood preservation facilities; and establishments manufacturing veneer, plywood, or engineered wood products).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/YIWr.label: Sawmill, Woodworking, and Paper Machinery Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/YIWr.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing sawmill and woodworking machinery (except handheld), such as circular and band sawing equipment, planing machinery, and sanding machinery, and/or (2) manufacturing paper industry machinery for making paper and paper products, such as pulp making machinery, paper and paperboard making machinery, and paper and paperboard converting machinery.
english_labels: Sawmill, Woodworking, and Paper Machinery Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/YIWt.label: Cotton Farming
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/YIWt.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in growing cotton.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/YO7K.label: Other Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/YO7K.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing guided missile and space vehicle parts and auxiliary equipment (except guided missile and space vehicle propulsion units and propulsion unit parts) and/or (2) developing and making prototypes of guided missile and space vehicle parts and auxiliary equipment.
english_labels: Other Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/YOnG.label: Community Food Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/YOnG.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the collection, preparation, and delivery of food for the needy. Establishments in this industry may also distribute clothing and blankets to the poor. These establishments may prepare and deliver meals to persons who by reason of age, disability, or illness are unable to prepare meals for themselves; collect and distribute salvageable or donated food; or prepare and provide meals at fixed or mobile locations. Food banks, meal delivery programs, and soup kitchens are included in this industry.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/YOxy.label: Specialized Freight (except Used Goods) Trucking, Long-Distance
english_labels: Specialized Freight (except Used Goods) Trucking, Long-Distance

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/YQwp.label: Prefabricated Wood Building Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/YQwp.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing prefabricated wood buildings and wood sections and panels for prefabricated wood buildings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/YX0S.label: Other Motion Picture and Video Industries
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/YX0S.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing motion picture and video services (except motion picture and video production, distribution, exhibition, and teleproduction and other postproduction services).
english_labels: Other Motion Picture and Video Industries

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/YZD1.label: Aircraft Engine and Engine Parts Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/YZD1.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) manufacturing aircraft engines and engine parts; (2) developing and making prototypes of aircraft engines and engine parts; (3) aircraft propulsion system conversion (i.e., major modifications to systems); and (4) aircraft propulsion systems overhaul and rebuilding (i.e., periodic restoration of aircraft propulsion system to original design specifications).
english_labels: Aircraft Engine and Engine Parts Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/YZvv.label: Other Insurance Funds
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/YZvv.definition: This industry comprises legal entities (i.e., funds (except pension, and health- and welfare-related employee benefit funds)) organized to provide insurance exclusively for the sponsor, firm, or its employees or members. Self-insurance funds (except employee benefit funds) and workers' compensation insurance funds are included in this industry.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Yaxp.label: Deep Sea Passenger Transportation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Yaxp.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing deep sea transportation of passengers to or from foreign ports.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/YeSH.label: Convention and Trade Show Organizers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/YeSH.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in organizing, promoting, and/or managing events, such as business and trade shows, conventions, conferences, and meetings (whether or not they manage and provide the staff to operate the facilities in which these events take place).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/YgCO.label: Regulation, Licensing, and Inspection of Miscellaneous Commercial Sectors
english_labels: Regulation, Licensing, and Inspection of Miscellaneous Commercial Sectors

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Yha6.label: Air-Conditioning and Warm Air Heating Equipment and Commercial and Industrial Refrigeration Equipment Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Yha6.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing air-conditioning (except motor vehicle) and warm air furnace equipment and/or (2) manufacturing commercial and industrial refrigeration and freezer equipment.
english_labels: Air-Conditioning and Warm Air Heating Equipment and Commercial and Industrial Refrigeration Equipment Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/YjA3.label: Supermarkets and Other Grocery Retailers (except Convenience Retailers)
english_labels: Supermarkets and Other Grocery Retailers (except Convenience Retailers)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ymm6.label: Outpatient Mental Health and Substance Abuse Centers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Ymm6.definition: This industry comprises establishments with medical staff primarily engaged in providing outpatient services related to the diagnosis and treatment of mental health disorders and alcohol and other substance abuse. These establishments generally treat patients who do not require inpatient treatment. They may provide a counseling staff and information regarding a wide range of mental health and substance abuse issues and/or refer patients to more extensive treatment programs, if necessary.
english_labels: Outpatient Mental Health and Substance Abuse Centers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Yz4k.label: Electric Lighting Equipment Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Yz4k.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing electric lighting fixtures (except vehicular), nonelectric lighting equipment, lamp shades (except glass and plastics), electric light bulbs, tubes, and parts (except glass blanks for electric light bulbs and light emitting diodes (LEDs)), and lighting fixture components (except current-carrying wiring devices).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ZB8A.label: Mushroom Production
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ZB8A.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in growing mushrooms under cover in mines underground, or in other controlled environments.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ZPOZ.label: All Other Schools and Instruction
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ZPOZ.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in offering instruction (except academic schools, colleges, and universities; business, computer, and management instruction; technical and trade instruction; and fine arts, sports, recreation, and language instruction).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ZQHl.label: Gold Ore and Silver Ore Mining
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ZQHl.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in developing the mine site, mining, and/or beneficiating (i.e., preparing) ores valued chiefly for their gold and/or silver content. Establishments primarily engaged in the transformation of the gold and silver into bullion or dore bar in combination with mining activities are included in this industry.
english_labels: Gold Ore and Silver Ore Mining

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ZUMQ.label: Freight Transportation Arrangement
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ZUMQ.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in arranging transportation of freight between shippers and carriers. These establishments are usually known as freight forwarders, marine shipping agents, or customs brokers and offer a combination of services spanning transportation modes but do not directly provide shipping services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ZWZV.label: Software Publishers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ZWZV.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in software publishing. Establishments in this industry carry out operations necessary for producing and distributing computer software, such as designing, providing documentation, assisting in installation, and providing support services to software purchasers. These establishments may design, develop, and publish, or publish only. These establishments may publish and distribute software through subscriptions and/or downloads.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ZXPX.label: Apparel Accessories and Other Apparel Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ZXPX.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing apparel and accessories (except apparel knitting mills, cut and sew apparel contractors, and cut and sew apparel manufacturing (except contractors)). Jobbers, who perform entrepreneurial functions involved in apparel accessories manufacture, including buying raw materials, designing and preparing samples, arranging for apparel accessories to be made from their materials, and marketing finished apparel accessories, are included. Examples of products made by these establishments are belts, caps, gloves (except medical, safety, sporting), hats, and neckties.
english_labels: Apparel Accessories and Other Apparel Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ZZTY.label: Amusement Arcades
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ZZTY.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in operating amusement (except gambling, billiard, or pool) arcades and parlors.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ZaKN.label: Mayonnaise, Dressing, and Other Prepared Sauce Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ZaKN.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing mayonnaise, salad dressing, vinegar, mustard, horseradish, soy sauce, tartar sauce, Worcestershire sauce, and other prepared sauces (except tomato-based and gravy).
english_labels: Mayonnaise, Dressing, and Other Prepared Sauce Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Zcc0.label: Specialty (except Psychiatric and Substance Abuse) Hospitals
english_labels: Specialty (except Psychiatric and Substance Abuse) Hospitals

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Zd0L.label: Business, Professional, Labor, Political, and Similar Organizations
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Zd0L.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in promoting the interests of their members (except religious organizations, social advocacy organizations, and civic and social organizations). Examples of establishments in this industry are business associations, professional organizations, labor unions, and political organizations.
english_labels: Business, Professional, Labor, Political, and Similar Organizations

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ZeNT.label: Media Buying Agencies
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ZeNT.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in purchasing advertising time or space from media outlets and reselling it to advertising agencies or individual companies directly.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Zftj.label: Air Traffic Control
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Zftj.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing air traffic control (except military) services to regulate the flow of air traffic.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ZjTW.label: Speed Changer, Industrial High-Speed Drive, and Gear Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ZjTW.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing gears, speed changers, and industrial high-speed drives (except hydrostatic).
english_labels: Speed Changer, Industrial High-Speed Drive, and Gear Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ZlY-.label: Gambling Industries
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ZlY-.definition: This industry group comprises establishments (except casino hotels) primarily engaged in operating gambling facilities, such as casinos, bingo halls, and video gaming terminals, or in the provision of gambling services, such as lotteries and off-track betting. Casino hotels are classified in Industry 72112, Casino Hotels.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ZpW1.label: Services for the Elderly and Persons with Disabilities
english_labels: Services for the Elderly and Persons with Disabilities

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Zs8I.label: Seafood Product Preparation and Packaging
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Zs8I.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) canning seafood (including soup); (2) smoking, salting, and drying seafood; (3) eviscerating fresh fish by removing heads, fins, scales, bones, and entrails; (4) shucking and packing fresh shellfish; (5) processing marine fats and oils; and (6) freezing seafood. Establishments known as "floating factory ships" that are engaged in the gathering and processing of seafood into canned seafood products are included in this industry.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ZtNO.label: Industrial Supplies Merchant Wholesalers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ZtNO.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of supplies for machinery and equipment generally used in manufacturing, oil well, and warehousing activities.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Zvvg.label: Sporting and Recreational Goods and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Zvvg.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of sporting goods and accessories; billiard and pool supplies; sporting firearms and ammunition; and/or marine pleasure craft, equipment, and supplies.
english_labels: Sporting and Recreational Goods and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Zxy7.label: Repossession Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Zxy7.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in repossessing tangible assets (e.g., automobiles, boats, equipment, planes, furniture, appliances) for the creditor as a result of delinquent debts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Zys7.label: Baked Goods Retailers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/Zys7.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing baked goods not for immediate consumption and not made on the premises.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_01l.label: Poultry and Egg Production
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_01l.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in breeding, hatching, and raising poultry for meat or egg production.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_1Ev.label: Other Miscellaneous Nondurable Goods Merchant Wholesalers
english_labels: Other Miscellaneous Nondurable Goods Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_3UQ.label: Engine, Turbine, and Power Transmission Equipment Manufacturing
english_labels: Engine, Turbine, and Power Transmission Equipment Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_6Tf.label: Ventilation, Heating, Air-Conditioning, and Commercial Refrigeration Equipment Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_6Tf.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing ventilating, heating, air-conditioning, and commercial and industrial refrigeration and freezer equipment.
english_labels: Ventilation, Heating, Air-Conditioning, and Commercial Refrigeration Equipment Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_Eo9.label: Curtain and Linen Mills
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_Eo9.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing household textile products, such as curtains, draperies, linens, bedspreads, sheets, tablecloths, towels, and shower curtains, from purchased materials. The household textile products may be made on a stock or custom basis for sale to individual retail customers.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_GX1.label: Forest Nurseries and Gathering of Forest Products
english_labels: Forest Nurseries and Gathering of Forest Products

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_KWw.label: Sales Financing Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_KWw.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in sales financing or sales financing in combination with leasing. Sales financing establishments are primarily engaged in lending money for the purpose of providing collateralized goods through a contractual installment sales agreement, either directly from or through arrangements with dealers.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_M0G.label: Structural Steel and Precast Concrete Contractors
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_M0G.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) erecting and assembling structural parts made from steel or precast concrete (e.g., steel beams, structural steel components, and similar products of precast concrete) and/or (2) assembling and installing other steel construction products (e.g., steel rods, bars, rebar, mesh, and cages) to reinforce poured-in-place concrete. The work performed may include new work, additions, alterations, maintenance, and repairs.
english_labels: Structural Steel and Precast Concrete Contractors

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_Q2x.label: Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_Q2x.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in initially underwriting (i.e., assuming the risk and assigning premiums) health and medical insurance policies. Group hospitalization plans and HMO establishments that provide health and medical insurance policies without providing health care services are included in this industry.
english_labels: Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_QUB.label: Home Furnishing Merchant Wholesalers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_QUB.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of home furnishings and/or housewares.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_TqR.label: Support Activities for Road Transportation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_TqR.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) towing light or heavy motor vehicles, both local and long-distance, or (2) providing other services to road network users.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_WI4.label: Welding and Soldering Equipment Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_WI4.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing welding and soldering equipment and accessories (except transformers), such as arc, resistance, gas, plasma, laser, electron beam, and ultrasonic welding equipment; welding electrodes; coated or cored welding wire; and soldering equipment (except handheld).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_WlD.label: Regulation and Administration of Transportation Programs
english_labels: Regulation and Administration of Transportation Programs

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_Xh4.label: Other Traveler Accommodation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_Xh4.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing short-term lodging (except hotels, motels, and casino hotels).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_Ycm.label: Telephone Call Centers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_Ycm.definition: This industry comprises (1) establishments primarily engaged in answering telephone calls and relaying messages and (2) establishments primarily engaged in providing telemarketing services, such as promoting products or services by telephone; taking orders by telephone, facsimile, email, or other communication modes; and soliciting contributions or providing information by telephone. Telephone call centers provide these services on behalf of clients and do not own the products or provide the services that they are representing, or they serve other establishments of the same enterprise.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_aEz.label: Industrial Machinery and Equipment Merchant Wholesalers
english_labels: Industrial Machinery and Equipment Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_crx.label: Coffee and Tea Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_crx.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) roasting coffee; (2) manufacturing coffee and tea concentrates (including instant and freeze-dried); (3) blending tea; (4) manufacturing herbal tea; and (5) manufacturing coffee extracts, flavorings, and syrups.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_dPM.label: Sanitary Paper Product Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_dPM.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in converting purchased sanitary paper stock or wadding into sanitary paper products, such as facial tissues, handkerchiefs, table napkins, toilet paper, towels, disposable diapers, sanitary napkins, and tampons.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_fJ6.label: Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_fJ6.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing operating advice and assistance to businesses and other organizations on administrative management issues, such as financial planning and budgeting, equity and asset management, records management, office planning, strategic and organizational planning, site selection, new business start-up, and business process improvement. This industry also includes establishments of general management consultants that provide a full range of administrative, human resource, marketing, process, physical distribution, logistics, or other management consulting services to clients.
english_labels: Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_mjV.label: Poultry and Poultry Product Merchant Wholesalers
english_labels: Poultry and Poultry Product Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_qfO.label: Bed-and-Breakfast Inns
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_qfO.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing short-term lodging in facilities known as bed-and-breakfast inns. These establishments provide short-term lodging in private homes or small buildings converted for this purpose. Bed-and-breakfast inns are characterized by a highly personalized service and inclusion of a full breakfast in the room rate.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_tQl.label: Converted Paper Product Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_tQl.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in converting paper or paperboard without manufacturing paper or paperboard.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_tg9.label: Plastics Bag and Pouch Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_tg9.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) converting plastics resins into plastics bags or pouches and/or (2) forming, coating, or laminating plastics film or sheet into single-web or multiweb plastics bags or pouches. Establishments in this industry may print on the bags or pouches they manufacture.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_vSm.label: Media Representatives
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_vSm.definition: This industry comprises establishments of independent representatives primarily engaged in selling media time or space for media owners.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_yVe.label: Motor Vehicle Gasoline Engine and Engine Parts Manufacturing
english_labels: Motor Vehicle Gasoline Engine and Engine Parts Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_yz0.label: Photography Studios, Portrait
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/_yz0.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments known as portrait studios primarily engaged in providing still, video, or digital portrait photography services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/a-BS.label: Satellite Telecommunications
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/a-BS.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing telecommunications services to other establishments in the telecommunications and broadcasting industries by forwarding and receiving communications signals via a system of satellites or reselling satellite telecommunications.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/a-WM.label: Support Activities for Crop Production
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/a-WM.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing support activities for growing crops.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/a3Ar.label: Motor Vehicle and Motor Vehicle Parts and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/a3Ar.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of automobiles and other motor vehicles, motor vehicle supplies, tires, and new and used parts.
english_labels: Motor Vehicle and Motor Vehicle Parts and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/a4sG.label: Rubber Product Manufacturing for Mechanical Use
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/a4sG.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing rubber goods (except tubing) for mechanical applications, using the processes of molding, extruding or lathe-cutting. Products of this industry are generally parts for motor vehicles, machinery, and equipment.
english_labels: Rubber Product Manufacturing for Mechanical Use

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/a7qH.label: New Car Dealers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/a7qH.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing new automobiles and light trucks, such as sport utility vehicles, and passenger and cargo vans, or retailing these new vehicles in combination with activities, such as repair services, retailing used cars, and selling replacement parts and accessories.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/aANM.label: Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction
english_labels: Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/aCWA.label: Electrical Contractors and Other Wiring Installation Contractors
english_labels: Electrical Contractors and Other Wiring Installation Contractors

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/aFXV.label: Direct Property and Casualty Insurance Carriers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/aFXV.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in initially underwriting (i.e., assuming the risk and assigning premiums) insurance policies that protect policyholders against losses that may occur as a result of property damage or liability.
english_labels: Direct Property and Casualty Insurance Carriers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/aHms.label: Motorcycle, Boat, and Other Motor Vehicle Dealers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/aHms.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing new and used motorcycles, boats, and other vehicles (except automobiles, light trucks, and recreational vehicles), or retailing these new vehicles in combination with activities, such as repair services and selling replacement parts and accessories.
english_labels: Motorcycle, Boat, and Other Motor Vehicle Dealers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/aJpE.label: Roofing, Siding, and Insulation Material Merchant Wholesalers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/aJpE.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of nonwood roofing and nonwood siding and insulation materials.
english_labels: Roofing, Siding, and Insulation Material Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/aMhL.label: Newspaper Publishers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/aMhL.definition: This industry comprises establishments known as newspaper publishers. Establishments in this industry carry out operations necessary for producing and distributing newspapers, including gathering news; writing news columns, feature stories, and editorials; and selling and preparing advertisements. These establishments may publish newspapers in print or electronic form, including exclusively on the Internet.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/aOJC.label: Other Building Material Dealers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/aOJC.definition: This industry comprises establishments (except home centers, paint and wallpaper retailers, and hardware retailers) primarily engaged in retailing specialized lines of new building materials, such as lumber, fencing, glass, doors, plumbing fixtures and supplies, electrical supplies, prefabricated buildings and kits, and kitchen and bath cabinets and countertops to be installed.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/aOOh.label: Media Streaming Distribution Services, Social Networks, and Other Media Networks and Content Providers
english_labels: Media Streaming Distribution Services, Social Networks, and Other Media Networks and Content Providers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/aTi8.label: Knit Fabric Mills
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/aTi8.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one of the following: (1) knitting weft (i.e., circular) and warp (i.e., flat) fabric; (2) knitting and finishing weft and warp fabric; (3) manufacturing lace; or (4) manufacturing, dyeing, and finishing lace and lace goods. Establishments in this industry may knit only; knit and finish; or knit, finish, and further fabricate fabric products (except apparel).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/aVAT.label: Other Travel Arrangement and Reservation Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/aVAT.definition: This industry comprises establishments (except travel agencies and tour operators) primarily engaged in providing travel arrangement and reservation services.
english_labels: Other Travel Arrangement and Reservation Services

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ac4H.label: Community Housing Services
