These establishments may provide basic alterations, such as hemming, taking in or letting out seams, or lengthening or shortening sleeves.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/pj3F.label: Electromedical and Electrotherapeutic Apparatus Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/pj3F.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing electromedical and electrotherapeutic apparatus, such as magnetic resonance imaging equipment, medical ultrasound equipment, pacemakers, hearing aids, electrocardiographs, and electromedical endoscopic equipment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/po7J.label: Mining and Oil and Gas Field Machinery Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/po7J.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing oil and gas field and underground mining machinery and equipment.
english_labels: Mining and Oil and Gas Field Machinery Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/pqJm.label: Nonferrous Metal (except Copper and Aluminum) Rolling, Drawing, and Extruding
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/pqJm.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) rolling, drawing, or extruding shapes (e.g., bar, plate, sheet, strip, tube) from purchased nonferrous metals and/or (2) recovering nonferrous metals from scrap and rolling, drawing, and/or extruding shapes (e.g., bar, plate, sheet, strip, tube) in integrated mills.
english_labels: Nonferrous Metal (except Copper and Aluminum) Rolling, Drawing, and Extruding

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/pqhu.label: Automobile Driving Schools
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/pqhu.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in offering automobile driving instruction.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/prOp.label: Educational Support Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/prOp.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing non-instructional services that support educational processes or systems.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ptcN.label: Transportation Equipment and Supplies (except Motor Vehicle) Merchant Wholesalers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ptcN.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of transportation equipment and supplies (except marine pleasure craft and motor vehicles).
english_labels: Transportation Equipment and Supplies (except Motor Vehicle) Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/q0dU.label: Custom Roll Forming
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/q0dU.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in custom roll forming metal products by use of rotary motion of rolls with various contours to bend or shape the products.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/q0p4.label: Apparel Accessories and Other Apparel Manufacturing
english_labels: Apparel Accessories and Other Apparel Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/q3pc.label: Other Pipeline Transportation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/q3pc.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in the pipeline transportation of products (except crude oil and natural gas).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/q9Rv.label: Sporting Goods Retailers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/q9Rv.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing new sporting goods, such as bicycles and bicycle parts; camping equipment; exercise and fitness equipment; athletic uniforms; specialty sports footwear; and other sporting goods, equipment, and accessories.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qDsX.label: Cookie, Cracker, and Pasta Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qDsX.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one of the following: (1) manufacturing cookies and crackers; (2) preparing flour and dough mixes and dough from flour ground elsewhere; and (3) manufacturing dry pasta. The establishments in this industry may package the dry pasta they manufacture with other ingredients.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qEWH.label: Wood Container and Pallet Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qEWH.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing wood pallets, wood box shook, wood boxes, other wood containers, and wood parts for pallets and containers.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qGYH.label: Petroleum and Petroleum Products Merchant Wholesalers (except Bulk Stations and Terminals)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qGYH.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of petroleum and petroleum products (except from bulk liquid storage facilities).
english_labels: Petroleum and Petroleum Products Merchant Wholesalers (except Bulk Stations and Terminals)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qHP1.label: Credit Card Issuing Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qHP1.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing credit by issuing credit cards. Credit card issuance provides the funds required to purchase goods and services in return for payment of the full balance or payments on an installment basis. Credit card banks are included in this industry.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qI98.label: Plumbing and Heating Equipment and Supplies (Hydronics) Merchant Wholesalers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qI98.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of plumbing equipment, hydronic heating equipment, household-type water heaters, and/or supplies.
english_labels: Plumbing and Heating Equipment and Supplies (Hydronics) Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qIY5.label: Roofing Contractors
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qIY5.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in roofing. This industry also includes establishments treating roofs (i.e., spraying, painting, or coating) and installing skylights. The work performed may include new work, additions, alterations, maintenance, and repairs.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qTC5.label: Plastics and Rubber Products Manufacturing Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qTC5.definition: Industries in the Plastics and Rubber Products Manufacturing subsector make goods by processing plastics materials and raw rubber. The core technology employed by establishments in this subsector is that of plastics or rubber product production. Plastics and rubber are combined in the same subsector because plastics are increasingly being used as a substitute for rubber; however, the subsector is generally restricted to the production of products made of just one material, either solely plastics or rubber. Many manufacturing activities use plastics or rubber, for example the manufacture of footwear or furniture. Typically, the production process of these products involves more than one material. In these cases, technologies that allow disparate materials to be formed and combined are of central importance in describing the manufacturing activity. In NAICS, such activities (footwear and furniture manufacturing) are not classified in the Plastics and Rubber Products Manufacturing subsector because the core technologies for these activities are diverse and involve multiple materials. Within the Plastics and Rubber Products Manufacturing subsector, a distinction is made between plastics and rubber products at the industry group level, although it is not a rigid distinction, as can be seen from the definition of Industry 32622, Rubber and Plastics Hoses and Belting Manufacturing. In the case of hoses and belting, plastics are used as a substitute for rubber, and the distinction in materials is not useful as a basis for establishment classification. In keeping with the core technology focus of plastics, lamination of plastics film to plastics film as well as the production of bags from plastics only is classified in this subsector. Lamination and bag production involving plastics and materials other than plastics are classified in Subsector 322, Paper Manufacturing.
english_labels: Plastics and Rubber Products Manufacturing Industry

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qWfq.label: Switchgear and Switchboard Apparatus Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qWfq.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing switchgear and switchboard apparatus.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/q_lK.label: Office Supplies (except Paper) Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/q_lK.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing office supplies. Examples of products made by these establishments are pens, pencils, felt tip markers, crayons, chalk, pencil sharpeners, staplers, modeling clay, hand operated stamps, stamp pads, stencils, carbon paper, and inked ribbons.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qaE4.label: Packaged Frozen Food Merchant Wholesalers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qaE4.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of packaged frozen foods (except dairy products).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qazp.label: Fresh Fruit and Vegetable Merchant Wholesalers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qazp.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of fresh fruits and vegetables.
english_labels: Fresh Fruit and Vegetable Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qbFk.label: Drafting Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qbFk.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in drawing detailed layouts, plans, and illustrations of buildings, structures, systems, or components from engineering and architectural specifications.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qcrb.label: Electrical Apparatus and Equipment, Wiring Supplies, and Related Equipment Merchant Wholesalers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qcrb.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of electrical construction materials; wiring supplies; electric light fixtures; light bulbs; and/or electrical power equipment for the generation, transmission, distribution, or control of electric energy.
english_labels: Electrical Apparatus and Equipment, Wiring Supplies, and Related Equipment Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qf3a.label: Other Publishers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qf3a.definition: This industry comprises establishments known as publishers (except newspaper, magazine, book, directory, mailing list, music, and software publishers). These establishments may publish works in print or electronic form, including exclusively on the Internet.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qiKA.label: Beef Cattle Ranching and Farming, including Feedlots
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qiKA.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in raising cattle (including cattle for dairy herd replacements), or feeding cattle for fattening.
english_labels: Beef Cattle Ranching and Farming, including Feedlots

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qkJZ.label: Other Specialized Design Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qkJZ.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing professional design services (except architectural, landscape architecture, engineering, interior, industrial, graphic, and computer systems design).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ql7Y.label: Full-Service Restaurants
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ql7Y.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing food services to patrons who order and are served while seated (i.e., waiter/waitress service) and pay after eating. These establishments may provide this type of food service to patrons in combination with selling alcoholic beverages, providing carryout services, or presenting live nontheatrical entertainment.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qoPJ.label: Formal Wear and Costume Rental
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qoPJ.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in renting clothing, such as formal wear, costumes (e.g., theatrical), or other clothing (except laundered uniforms and work apparel).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qqEe.label: Jewelry, Watch, Precious Stone, and Precious Metal Merchant Wholesalers
english_labels: Jewelry, Watch, Precious Stone, and Precious Metal Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qu8K.label: Pesticide and Other Agricultural Chemical Manufacturing
english_labels: Pesticide and Other Agricultural Chemical Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qwEl.label: Wood Kitchen Cabinet and Countertop Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qwEl.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing wood or plastics laminated on wood kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, and countertops (except freestanding). The cabinets and counters may be made on a stock or custom basis.
english_labels: Wood Kitchen Cabinet and Countertop Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qyKd.label: Seasoning and Dressing Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qyKd.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) manufacturing dressings and sauces, such as mayonnaise, salad dressing, vinegar, mustard, horseradish, soy sauce, tartar sauce, Worcestershire sauce, and other prepared sauces (except tomato-based and gravies); (2) manufacturing spices, table salt, seasoning, and flavoring extracts (except coffee and meat), and natural food colorings; and (3) manufacturing dry mix food preparations, such as salad dressing mixes, gravy and sauce mixes, frosting mixes, and other dry mix preparations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qzjL.label: Grocery and Convenience Retailers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/qzjL.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing a general line of food products. This industry group also includes vending machine operators.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/r-Ao.label: Photographic Equipment and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers
english_labels: Photographic Equipment and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/r1kV.label: Cyclic Crude, Intermediate, and Gum and Wood Chemical Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/r1kV.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) distilling wood or gum into products, such as tall oil and wood distillates; (2) distilling coal tars; (3) manufacturing wood or gum chemicals, such as naval stores, natural tanning materials, charcoal briquettes, and charcoal (except activated); and (4) manufacturing cyclic crudes or cyclic intermediates (i.e., hydrocarbons, except aromatic petrochemicals) from refined petroleum or natural gas.
english_labels: Cyclic Crude, Intermediate, and Gum and Wood Chemical Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/r4ZF.label: Other Investment Pools and Funds
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/r4ZF.definition: This industry group comprises legal entities (i.e., investment pools and/or funds) organized to pool securities or other assets (except insurance and employee benefit funds) on behalf of shareholders, unitholders, or beneficiaries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/r78y.label: Asphalt Paving, Roofing, and Saturated Materials Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/r78y.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing asphalt and tar paving mixtures and blocks and roofing cements and coatings from purchased asphaltic materials and/or (2) saturating purchased mats and felts with asphalt or tar from purchased asphaltic materials.
english_labels: Asphalt Paving, Roofing, and Saturated Materials Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/rA2-.label: All Other Miscellaneous Electrical Equipment and Component Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/rA2-.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing industrial and commercial electric apparatus and other equipment (except lighting equipment, household appliances, transformers, motors, generators, switchgear, relays, industrial controls, batteries, communication and energy wire and cable, wiring devices, and carbon and graphite products). Examples of products made by these establishments are power converters (i.e., AC to DC and DC to AC), power supplies, surge suppressors, and similar equipment for industrial-type and consumer-type equipment.
english_labels: All Other Miscellaneous Electrical Equipment and Component Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/rFxi.label: Other Grain Farming
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/rFxi.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) growing grain(s) and/or producing grain seeds (except wheat, corn, and rice) or (2) growing a combination of grain(s) and oilseed(s) with no one grain (or family of grains) or oilseed (or family of oilseeds) accounting for one-half of the establishment's agricultural production (i.e., value of crops for market). Combination grain(s) and oilseed(s) establishments may produce oilseed(s) and grain(s) seeds and/or grow oilseed(s) and grain(s).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/rJxd.label: Corrugated and Solid Fiber Box Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/rJxd.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in laminating purchased paper or paperboard into corrugated or solid fiber boxes and related products, such as pads, partitions, pallets, and corrugated paper without manufacturing paperboard. These boxes are generally used for shipping.
english_labels: Corrugated and Solid Fiber Box Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/rNN_.label: Packing and Crating
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/rNN_.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in packing, crating, and otherwise preparing goods for transportation.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/rO1o.label: Dry Pea and Bean Farming
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/rO1o.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in growing dry peas, beans, and/or lentils.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/rYn9.label: Services to Buildings and Dwellings
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/rYn9.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in one of the following: (1) exterminating and pest control services; (2) janitorial services; (3) landscaping services; (4) carpet and upholstery cleaning services; or (5) other services to buildings and dwellings.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/rgSO.label: Florists
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/rgSO.definition: This industry comprises establishments generally known as florists primarily engaged in retailing cut flowers, floral arrangements, and potted plants grown elsewhere. These establishments may prepare the arrangements they sell.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/rjaa.label: Financial Transactions Processing, Reserve, and Clearinghouse Activities Industry
english_labels: Financial Transactions Processing, Reserve, and Clearinghouse Activities Industry

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/rjyZ.label: Machine Tool Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/rjyZ.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing metal cutting machine tools (except handtools) and/or (2) manufacturing metal forming machine tools (except handtools), such as punching, sheering, bending, forming, pressing, forging and die-casting machines.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/rlTU.label: Hardwood Veneer and Plywood Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/rlTU.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing hardwood veneer and/or hardwood plywood.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/rm6O.label: Industrial Machinery Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/rm6O.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing industrial machinery, such as food and beverage manufacturing machinery, semiconductor manufacturing machinery, sawmill and woodworking machinery (except handheld), machinery for making paper and paper products, printing and binding machinery and equipment, textile making machinery, and machinery for making plastics and rubber products.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/rszF.label: Computer and Computer Peripheral Equipment and Software Merchant Wholesalers
english_labels: Computer and Computer Peripheral Equipment and Software Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ruux.label: School and Employee Bus Transportation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ruux.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing buses and other motor vehicles to transport pupils to and from school or employees to and from work.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/s37n.label: Powder Metallurgy Part Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/s37n.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing powder metallurgy products using any of the various powder metallurgy processing techniques, such as pressing and sintering or metal injection molding. Establishments in this industry generally make a wide range of parts on a job or order basis.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/s4BR.label: Analytical Laboratory Instrument Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/s4BR.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing instruments and instrumentation systems for laboratory analysis of the chemical or physical composition or concentration of samples of solid, fluid, gaseous, or composite material.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/s7-e.label: Mortgage and Nonmortgage Loan Brokers Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/s7-e.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in arranging loans by bringing borrowers and lenders together on a commission or fee basis.
english_labels: Mortgage and Nonmortgage Loan Brokers Industry

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/s7A6.label: Motorcycle, Bicycle, and Parts Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/s7A6.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing motorcycles, bicycles, tricycles and similar equipment, and parts.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/s7oR.label: Pottery, Ceramics, and Plumbing Fixture Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/s7oR.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in shaping, molding, glazing, and firing pottery, ceramics, plumbing fixtures, and electrical supplies made entirely or partly of clay or other ceramic materials.
english_labels: Pottery, Ceramics, and Plumbing Fixture Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sAT0.label: Personal and Household Goods Repair and Maintenance
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sAT0.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in home and garden equipment and appliance repair and maintenance; reupholstery and furniture repair; footwear and leather goods repair; and other personal and household goods repair and maintenance.
english_labels: Personal and Household Goods Repair and Maintenance

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sDw2.label: Other Pressed and Blown Glass and Glassware Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sDw2.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing glass by melting silica sand or cullet and making pressed, blown, or shaped glass or glassware (except glass packaging containers).
english_labels: Other Pressed and Blown Glass and Glassware Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sH_O.label: Septic Tank and Related Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sH_O.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) pumping (i.e., cleaning) septic tanks and cesspools and/or (2) renting and/or servicing portable toilets.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sKDT.label: Current-Carrying Wiring Device Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sKDT.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing current-carrying wiring devices.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sKbz.label: Fruit and Vegetable Retailers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sKbz.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing fresh fruits and vegetables.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sKdN.label: Chicken Egg Production
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sKdN.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in raising chickens for egg production. The eggs produced may be for use as table eggs or hatching eggs.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sM1l.label: Administration of Veterans' Affairs
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sM1l.definition: This industry comprises government establishments primarily engaged in the administration of programs of assistance, training, counseling, and other services to veterans and their dependents, heirs, or survivors. Included in this industry are Veterans' Affairs offices that maintain liaison and coordinate activities with other service organizations and governmental agencies.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sMNU.label: Travel Trailer and Camper Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sMNU.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) manufacturing travel trailers and campers designed to attach to motor vehicles; (2) manufacturing pick-up coaches (i.e., campers) and caps (i.e., covers) for mounting on pick-up trucks; and (3) manufacturing automobile, utility, and light-truck trailers. Travel trailers do not have their own motor but are designed to be towed by a motor unit, such as an automobile or a light truck.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sMqJ.label: Commercial and Service Industry Machinery Manufacturing
english_labels: Commercial and Service Industry Machinery Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sRje.label: Executive, Legislative, and Other General Government Support
english_labels: Executive, Legislative, and Other General Government Support

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sRxB.label: Luggage and Leather Goods Retailers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sRxB.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing new luggage, briefcases, and trunks, or retailing these new products in combination with a general line of leather items (except leather apparel), such as belts, gloves, and handbags.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sVdl.label: Lessors of Other Real Estate Property
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sVdl.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in acting as lessors of real estate (except buildings), such as manufactured home (i.e., mobile home) sites, vacant lots, and grazing land.
english_labels: Lessors of Other Real Estate Property

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sY75.label: Framing Contractors
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sY75.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in structural framing and sheathing using materials other than structural steel or concrete. The work performed may include new work, additions, alterations, maintenance, and repairs.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/s_xR.label: Inland Water Freight Transportation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/s_xR.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing inland water transportation of cargo on lakes, rivers, or intracoastal waterways (except on the Great Lakes System).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sgRU.label: Glass Container Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sgRU.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing glass packaging, bottling, and canning containers.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sgva.label: Environment, Conservation and Wildlife Organizations
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sgva.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in promoting the preservation and protection of the environment and wildlife. Establishments in this industry address issues, such as clean air and water; global warming; conserving and developing natural resources, including land, plant, water, and energy resources; and protecting and preserving wildlife and endangered species. These organizations may solicit contributions and offer memberships to support these causes.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/shCP.label: Other Electrical Equipment and Component Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/shCP.definition: This industry group comprises establishments manufacturing electrical equipment and components (except electric lighting equipment, household-type appliances, transformers, switchgear, relays, motors, and generators).
english_labels: Other Electrical Equipment and Component Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sjdR.label: Finish Carpentry Contractors
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sjdR.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in finish carpentry work. The work performed may include new work, additions, alterations, maintenance, and repairs.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sjix.label: Warm Air Heating and Air-Conditioning Equipment and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/sjix.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of warm air heating and air-conditioning equipment and supplies.
english_labels: Warm Air Heating and Air-Conditioning Equipment and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/skJ3.label: Cut and Sew Apparel Manufacturing (except Contractors)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/skJ3.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing cut and sew apparel from purchased fabric. Clothing jobbers, who perform entrepreneurial functions involved in apparel manufacture, including buying raw materials, designing and preparing samples, arranging for apparel to be made from their materials, and marketing finished apparel, are included.
english_labels: Cut and Sew Apparel Manufacturing (except Contractors)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/slpO.label: Special Die and Tool, Die Set, Jig, and Fixture Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/slpO.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments, known as tool and die shops, primarily engaged in manufacturing special tools and fixtures, such as cutting dies and jigs.
english_labels: Special Die and Tool, Die Set, Jig, and Fixture Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/t-UR.label: Textile Bag and Canvas Mills
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/t-UR.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing textile bags (except luggage) or other canvas and canvas-like products, such as awnings, sails, tarpaulins, and tents from purchased textile fabrics or yarns.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/t1Z3.label: Fruit and Vegetable Canning
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/t1Z3.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing canned, pickled, and brined fruits and vegetables. Examples of products made in these establishments are canned juices; canned jams and jellies; canned tomato-based sauces, such as catsup, salsa, chili sauce, spaghetti sauce, barbeque sauce, and tomato paste; and pickles, relishes, and sauerkraut.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/t4gt.label: Advertising Material Distribution Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/t4gt.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the direct distribution or delivery of advertisements (e.g., circulars, coupons, handbills) or samples. Establishments in this industry use methods, such as delivering advertisements or samples door-to-door, placing flyers or coupons on car windshields in parking lots, or handing out samples in retail stores.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/t52V.label: Sporting and Athletic Goods Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/t52V.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing sporting and athletic goods (except apparel and footwear).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/t7I_.label: Mining Machinery and Equipment Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/t7I_.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing underground mining machinery and equipment, such as coal breakers, mining cars, core drills, coal cutters, and rock drills, and (2) manufacturing mineral beneficiating machinery and equipment used in surface or underground mines.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/tEn-.label: Metalworking Machinery Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/tEn-.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing metalworking machinery, such as metal cutting and metal forming machine tools; cutting tools; accessories for metalworking machinery; special dies, tools, jigs, and fixtures; industrial molds; rolling mill machinery; assembly machinery; coil handling, conversion, or straightening equipment; and wire drawing and fabricating machines.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/tIcm.label: Other Petroleum and Coal Products Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/tIcm.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing petroleum products (except asphalt paving, roofing, and saturated materials) from refined petroleum or coal products made in coke ovens not integrated with a steel mill.
english_labels: Other Petroleum and Coal Products Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/tXmS.label: Rubber and Plastics Hoses and Belting Manufacturing
english_labels: Rubber and Plastics Hoses and Belting Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/tXmj.label: Reupholstery and Furniture Repair
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/tXmj.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) reupholstering furniture; (2) refinishing furniture; (3) repairing furniture; and (4) repairing and restoring furniture.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/tZIQ.label: Power and Communication Line and Related Structures Construction
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/tZIQ.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the construction of power lines and towers, power plants, and radio, television, and telecommunications transmitting/receiving towers. The work performed may include new work, reconstruction, rehabilitation, and repairs. Specialty trade contractors are included in this industry if they are engaged in activities primarily related to power and communication line and related structures construction. All structures (including buildings) that are integral parts of power and communication networks (e.g., transmitting towers, substations, and power plants) are included.
english_labels: Power and Communication Line and Related Structures Construction

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/tZil.label: Beef Cattle Ranching and Farming
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/tZil.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in raising cattle (including cattle for dairy herd replacements).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/tdQc.label: Lessors of Miniwarehouses and Self-Storage Units
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/tdQc.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in renting or leasing space for self-storage. These establishments provide secure space (i.e., rooms, compartments, lockers, containers, or outdoor space) where clients can store and retrieve their goods.
english_labels: Lessors of Miniwarehouses and Self-Storage Units

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/te1D.label: Support Activities for Air Transportation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/te1D.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing services to the air transportation industry. These services include airport operation, servicing, repairing (except factory conversion and overhaul of aircraft), maintaining and storing aircraft, and ferrying aircraft.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/tg8R.label: Soybean and Other Oilseed Processing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/tg8R.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in crushing oilseeds and tree nuts, such as soybeans, cottonseeds, linseeds, peanuts, and sunflower seeds. Examples of products produced in these establishments are oilseed oils, cakes, meals, and protein isolates and concentrates.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/tmzg.label: Motor Vehicle Body and Trailer Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/tmzg.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing motor vehicle bodies and cabs or (2) manufacturing truck, automobile and utility trailers, truck trailer chassis, detachable trailer bodies, and detachable trailer chassis. The products made may be sold separately or may be assembled on purchased chassis and sold as complete vehicles. Motor homes are units where the motor and the living quarters are contained in the same integrated unit, while travel trailers are designed to be towed by a motor unit, such as an automobile or a light truck.
english_labels: Motor Vehicle Body and Trailer Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/tttt.label: Solid Waste Collection
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/tttt.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) collecting and/or hauling nonhazardous solid waste (i.e., garbage) within a local area; (2) operating nonhazardous solid waste transfer stations; and (3) collecting and/or hauling mixed recyclable materials within a local area.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/tw-E.label: Office Administrative Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/tw-E.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing a range of day-to-day office administrative services, such as financial planning; billing and recordkeeping; personnel; and physical distribution and logistics, for others on a contract or fee basis. These establishments do not provide operating staff to carry out the complete operations of a business.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/tzFa.label: Promoters of Performing Arts, Sports, and Similar Events
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/tzFa.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in organizing, promoting, and/or managing live performing arts productions, sports events, and similar events, held in facilities that they manage and operate or in facilities that are managed and operated by others.
english_labels: Promoters of Performing Arts, Sports, and Similar Events

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/u0-x.label: Other Business Service Centers (including Copy Shops)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/u0-x.definition: This U.S. industry comprises (1) establishments generally known as copy centers or shops primarily engaged in providing photocopying, duplicating, blueprinting, and other document copying services, without also providing printing services (e.g., offset printing, quick printing, digital printing, prepress services) and (2) establishments (except private mail centers) engaged in providing a range of office support services (except printing services), such as document copying services, facsimile services, word processing services, on-site PC rental services, and office product sales.
english_labels: Other Business Service Centers (including Copy Shops)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/u3vW.label: Other Health and Personal Care Retailers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/u3vW.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing health and personal care items (except drugs, medicines, cosmetics, beauty supplies, perfumes, and optical goods).
english_labels: Other Health and Personal Care Retailers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/u9JL.label: Office Supplies, Stationery, and Gift Retailers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/u9JL.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing new office supplies, stationery, gifts, novelty merchandise, and souvenirs.
english_labels: Office Supplies, Stationery, and Gift Retailers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/uCdC.label: All Other Waste Management Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/uCdC.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in waste management services (except waste collection, waste treatment and disposal, remediation, operation of materials recovery facilities, and waste management consulting services).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/uCrd.label: Security Systems Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/uCrd.definition: This industry comprises establishments engaged in (1) selling security systems, such as burglar and fire alarms and locking devices, along with installation, repair, or monitoring services or (2) remote monitoring of electronic security alarm systems.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/uDqF.label: Used Car Dealers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/uDqF.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing used automobiles and light trucks, such as sport utility vehicles, and passenger and cargo vans.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/uF5p.label: Investment Banking and Securities Intermediation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/uF5p.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in underwriting, originating, and/or maintaining markets for issues of securities, or acting as agents (i.e., brokers) between buyers and sellers in buying or selling securities on a commission or transaction fee basis. Investment bankers act as principals (i.e., investors who buy or sell on their own account) in firm commitment transactions or act as agents in best effort and standby commitments. This industry also includes establishments acting as principals in buying or selling securities generally on a spread basis, such as securities dealers or stock option dealers.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/uPen.label: Battery Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/uPen.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing primary and storage batteries.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/uTCc.label: Trusts, Estates, and Agency Accounts
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/uTCc.definition: This industry comprises legal entities, trusts, estates, or agency accounts, administered on behalf of the beneficiaries under the terms of a trust agreement, will, or agency agreement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/uTD3.label: Mobile Food Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/uTD3.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in preparing and serving meals and snacks for immediate consumption from motorized vehicles or nonmotorized carts. The establishment is the central location from which the caterer route is serviced, not each vehicle or cart. Included in this industry are establishments primarily engaged in providing food services from vehicles, such as hot dog carts and ice cream trucks.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/uUK2.label: Ice Cream and Frozen Dessert Manufacturing
english_labels: Ice Cream and Frozen Dessert Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/uWOA.label: Other Consumer Goods Rental
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/uWOA.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in renting consumer goods (except consumer electronics and appliances).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/uWp0.label: Other Activities Related to Real Estate
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/uWp0.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in performing real estate related services (except lessors of real estate, offices of real estate agents and brokers, real estate property managers, and offices of real estate appraisers).
english_labels: Other Activities Related to Real Estate

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/uWsJ.label: Other Communications Equipment Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/uWsJ.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing communications equipment (except telephone apparatus, radio and television broadcast equipment, and wireless communications equipment).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ueoh.label: General Freight Trucking
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ueoh.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing general freight trucking. General freight trucking establishments handle a wide variety of commodities, generally palletized, and transported in a container or van trailer. The establishments of this industry group provide a combination of the following network activities: local pick-up, local sorting and terminal operations, line-haul, destination sorting and terminal operations, and local delivery.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ulsY.label: Narrow Fabric Mills and Schiffli Machine Embroidery
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/ulsY.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) weaving or braiding narrow fabrics in their final form or initially made in wider widths that are specially constructed for narrower widths; (2) making fabric-covered elastic yarn and thread; and (3) manufacturing Schiffli machine embroideries. Establishments in this industry may weave only; weave and finish; or weave, finish, and further fabricate fabric products.
english_labels: Narrow Fabric Mills and Schiffli Machine Embroidery

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/um-T.label: Continuing Care Retirement Communities and Assisted Living Facilities for the Elderly
english_labels: Continuing Care Retirement Communities and Assisted Living Facilities for the Elderly

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/umUc.label: Furniture and Home Furnishings Retailers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/umUc.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing new furniture and home furnishings. Establishments in this industry group with fixed point-of-sale locations may operate from showrooms and have substantial areas for the presentation of their products. Establishments in this industry group may provide incidental services, including interior decorating, product assembly, installation, or repair services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/uvuQ.label: Cattle Ranching and Farming
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/uvuQ.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in raising cattle, milking dairy cattle, or feeding cattle for fattening.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/uwLp.label: Dairy Product (except Dried or Canned) Merchant Wholesalers
english_labels: Dairy Product (except Dried or Canned) Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/uxuU.label: Hotels (except Casino Hotels) and Motels
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/uxuU.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing short-term lodging in facilities known as hotels, motor hotels, resort hotels, and motels. The establishments in this industry may offer food and beverage services, recreational services, conference rooms, convention services, laundry services, parking, and other services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/v1yP.label: Jewelry and Silverware Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/v1yP.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) manufacturing, engraving, chasing, or etching fine and costume jewelry; (2) manufacturing, engraving, chasing, or etching metal personal goods (i.e., small articles carried on or about the person, such as compacts or cigarette cases); (3) manufacturing, engraving, chasing, or etching precious metal solid, precious metal clad, or pewter flatware and other hollowware; (4) stamping coins; (5) manufacturing unassembled jewelry parts and stock shop products, such as sheet, wire, and tubing; (6) cutting, slabbing, tumbling, carving, engraving, polishing, or faceting precious or semiprecious stones and gems; (7) recutting, repolishing, and setting gem stones; and (8) drilling, sawing, and peeling cultured and costume pearls. This industry includes establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing precious solid, precious clad, and precious plated jewelry and personal goods.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/v9vY.label: Polish and Other Sanitation Good Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/v9vY.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing and packaging polishes and specialty cleaning preparations.
english_labels: Polish and Other Sanitation Good Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vBLs.label: Drugs and Druggists' Sundries Merchant Wholesalers
english_labels: Drugs and Druggists' Sundries Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vC_k.label: Warehouse Clubs, Supercenters, and Other General Merchandise Retailers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vC_k.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing new general merchandise (except department stores). These establishments retail a general line of new merchandise, such as apparel, automotive parts, dry goods, hardware, groceries, housewares, and home furnishings, with no one merchandise line predominating. Establishments generally known as warehouse clubs, superstores, or supercenters, and retailing a general line of merchandise in combination with a significant amount and variety of perishable groceries, are included in this industry. This industry also includes establishments primarily engaged in retailing a general line of new and used merchandise on an auction basis.
english_labels: Warehouse Clubs, Supercenters, and Other General Merchandise Retailers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vGIs.label: Other Leather and Allied Product Manufacturing
english_labels: Other Leather and Allied Product Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vGLz.label: Other Similar Organizations (except Business, Professional, Labor, and Political Organizations)
english_labels: Other Similar Organizations (except Business, Professional, Labor, and Political Organizations)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vIw-.label: Diet and Weight Reducing Centers
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vIw-.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing non-medical services to assist clients in attaining or maintaining a desired weight. The sale of weight reduction products, such as food supplements, may be an integral component of the program. These services typically include individual or group counseling, menu and exercise planning, and weight and body measurement monitoring.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vLdf.label: Saw Blade and Handtool Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vLdf.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing saw blades, all types (including those for power sawing machines) and/or (2) manufacturing nonpowered handtools and edge tools.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vQlZ.label: Sporting and Recreational Goods and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers
english_labels: Sporting and Recreational Goods and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vVDX.label: Residential Intellectual and Developmental Disability Facilities
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vVDX.definition: This industry comprises establishments (e.g., group homes, hospitals, intermediate care facilities) primarily engaged in providing residential care services for persons with intellectual and developmental disabilities. These facilities may provide some health care, though the focus is room, board, protective supervision, and counseling.
english_labels: Residential Intellectual and Developmental Disability Facilities

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vVPT.label: Greenhouse, Nursery, and Floriculture Production
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vVPT.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in growing crops of any kind under cover and/or growing nursery stock and flowers. "Under cover" is generally defined as greenhouses, cold frames, cloth houses, and lath houses. The crops grown are removed at various stages of maturity and have annual and perennial life cycles. The nursery stock includes short rotation woody crops that have growth cycles of 10 years or less.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vYKf.label: Power Boiler and Heat Exchanger Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vYKf.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing power boilers and heat exchangers. Establishments in this industry may perform installation in addition to manufacturing power boilers and heat exchangers.
english_labels: Power Boiler and Heat Exchanger Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vYX7.label: Soap and Cleaning Compound Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vYX7.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing and packaging soaps and other cleaning compounds, surface active agents, and textile and leather finishing agents used to reduce tension or speed the drying process.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vYl5.label: Building Equipment Contractors
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vYl5.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in installing or servicing equipment that forms part of a building mechanical system (e.g., electricity, water, heating, and cooling). The work performed may include new work, additions, alterations, maintenance, and repairs. Contractors installing specialized building equipment, such as elevators, escalators, service station equipment, and central vacuum cleaning systems, are also included.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/v_2q.label: Textile Furnishings Mills
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/v_2q.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing woven, tufted, and other carpets and rugs and (2) manufacturing household textile products from purchased materials. The household textile products may be made on a stock or custom basis for sale to individual retail customers.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vfgq.label: Rubber Product Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vfgq.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in processing natural, synthetic, or reclaimed rubber materials into intermediate or final products using processes, such as vulcanizing, cementing, molding, extruding, and lathe-cutting.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/viDF.label: Ground or Treated Mineral and Earth Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/viDF.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in calcining, dead burning, or otherwise processing beyond beneficiation, clays, ceramic and refractory minerals, barite, and miscellaneous nonmetallic minerals.
english_labels: Ground or Treated Mineral and Earth Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/voGu.label: Refrigerated Warehousing and Storage
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/voGu.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in operating refrigerated warehousing and storage facilities. Establishments primarily engaged in the storage of furs for the trade are included in this industry. The services provided by these establishments include blast freezing, tempering, and modified atmosphere storage services.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vp7k.label: Remediation Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vp7k.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) remediation and cleanup of contaminated buildings, mine sites, soil, or ground water; (2) integrated mine reclamation activities, including demolition, soil remediation, waste water treatment, hazardous material removal, contouring land, and revegetation; and (3) asbestos, lead paint, and other toxic material abatement.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vqSW.label: Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vqSW.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing computing infrastructure, data processing services, Web hosting services (except software publishing), and related services, including streaming support services (except streaming distribution services). Data processing establishments provide complete processing and specialized reports from data supplied by clients or provide automated data processing and data entry services.
english_labels: Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vugU.label: Semiconductor and Related Device Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vugU.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing semiconductors and related solid-state devices. Examples of products made by these establishments are integrated circuits, memory chips, microprocessors, diodes, transistors, solar cells, and other optoelectronic devices.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vwGn.label: Metal Heat Treating
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vwGn.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in heat treating, such as annealing, tempering, and brazing, and cryogenically treating metals and metal products for the trade.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vxo-.label: Food Crops Grown Under Cover
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/vxo-.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in growing food crops (e.g., fruits, melons, tomatoes) under glass or protective cover.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/w0Uo.label: Labor Unions and Similar Labor Organizations
english_labels: Labor Unions and Similar Labor Organizations

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/w4DO.label: Wired and Wireless Telecommunications Carriers (except Satellite)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/w4DO.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in operating, maintaining, and/or providing access to switching and transmission facilities and infrastructure that they own and/or lease for the transmission of voice, data, text, sound, and video using wired and wireless telecommunications networks (except satellite). Transmission facilities may be based on a single technology or a combination of technologies. By exception, establishments providing satellite television distribution services using facilities and infrastructure that they operate are included in this industry.
english_labels: Wired and Wireless Telecommunications Carriers (except Satellite)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/w4Fo.label: Clay Building Material and Refractories Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/w4Fo.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in shaping, molding, baking, burning, or hardening clay refractories, nonclay refractories, ceramic tile, structural clay tile, brick, and other structural clay building materials. A refractory is a material that will retain its shape and chemical identity when subjected to high temperatures and is used in applications that require extreme resistance to heat, such as furnace linings.
english_labels: Clay Building Material and Refractories Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/w6qA.label: Small Electrical Appliance Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/w6qA.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing small electric appliances and electric housewares, household-type fans (except attic fans), household-type vacuum cleaners, and other electric household-type floor care machines.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wBIo.label: New Single-Family Housing Construction (except For-Sale Builders)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wBIo.definition: This U.S. industry comprises general contractor establishments primarily responsible for the entire construction of new single-family housing, such as single-family detached houses and town houses or row houses where each housing unit (1) is separated from its neighbors by a ground-to-roof wall and (2) has no housing units constructed above or below. This industry includes general contractors responsible for the on-site assembly of modular and prefabricated houses. Single-family housing design-build firms and single-family construction management firms acting as general contractors are included in this industry.
english_labels: New Single-Family Housing Construction (except For-Sale Builders)

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wBNI.label: Agents and Managers for Artists, Athletes, Entertainers, and Other Public Figures
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wBNI.definition: This industry comprises establishments of agents and managers primarily engaged in representing and/or managing creative and performing artists, sports figures, entertainers, and other public figures. The representation and management includes activities, such as representing clients in contract negotiations; managing or organizing clients' financial affairs; and generally promoting the careers of their clients.
english_labels: Agents and Managers for Artists, Athletes, Entertainers, and Other Public Figures

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wBpX.label: Computer Systems Design and Related Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wBpX.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing expertise in the field of information technologies through one or more of the following activities: (1) writing, modifying, testing, and supporting software to meet the needs of a particular customer; (2) planning and designing computer systems that integrate computer hardware, software, and communication technologies; (3) on-site management and operation of clients' computer systems and/or data processing facilities; and (4) other professional and technical computer related advice and services.
english_labels: Computer Systems Design and Related Services

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wEQe.label: Oil and Gas Pipeline and Related Structures Construction
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wEQe.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the construction of oil and gas lines, mains, refineries, and storage tanks. The work performed may include new work, reconstruction, rehabilitation, and repairs. Specialty trade contractors are included in this industry if they are engaged in activities primarily related to oil and gas pipeline and related structures construction. All structures (including buildings) that are integral parts of oil and gas networks (e.g., storage tanks, pumping stations, and refineries) are included in this industry.
english_labels: Oil and Gas Pipeline and Related Structures Construction

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wIDc.label: Siding Contractors
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wIDc.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in installing siding of wood, aluminum, vinyl, or other exterior finish material (except brick, stone, stucco, or curtain wall). This industry also includes establishments installing gutters and downspouts. The work performed may include new work, additions, alterations, maintenance, and repairs.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wIEt.label: Promoters of Performing Arts, Sports, and Similar Events without Facilities
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wIEt.definition: This industry comprises promoters primarily engaged in organizing, promoting, and/or managing live performing arts productions, sports events, and similar events, such as state fairs, county fairs, agricultural fairs, concerts, and festivals, in facilities that are managed and operated by others. Theatrical (except motion picture) booking agencies are included in this industry.
english_labels: Promoters of Performing Arts, Sports, and Similar Events without Facilities

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wJSr.label: Administration of Housing Programs, Urban Planning, and Community Development
english_labels: Administration of Housing Programs, Urban Planning, and Community Development

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wKJT.label: Unlaminated Plastics Film and Sheet (except Packaging) Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wKJT.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in converting plastics resins into plastics film and unlaminated sheet (except packaging).
english_labels: Unlaminated Plastics Film and Sheet (except Packaging) Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wLPY.label: Marinas
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wLPY.definition: This industry comprises establishments, commonly known as marinas, engaged in operating docking and/or storage facilities for pleasure craft owners, with or without one or more related activities, such as retailing fuel and marine supplies; and repairing, maintaining, or renting pleasure boats.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wOds.label: Soybean Farming
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wOds.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in growing soybeans and/or producing soybean seeds.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wXo7.label: Paper Bag and Coated and Treated Paper Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wXo7.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) cutting and coating paper and paperboard; (2) cutting and laminating paper, paperboard, and other flexible materials (except plastics film to plastics film); (3) manufacturing bags, multiwall bags, sacks of paper, metal foil, coated paper, laminates, or coated combinations of paper and foil with plastics film; (4) manufacturing laminated aluminum and other converted metal foils from purchased foils; and (5) surface coating paper or paperboard.
english_labels: Paper Bag and Coated and Treated Paper Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/waSy.label: Specialized Automotive Repair
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/waSy.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing specialized mechanical or electrical repair and maintenance services (except engine repair and replacement) for automotive vehicles, such as passenger cars, trucks, and vans, and all trailers.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/waxa.label: Amusement and Theme Parks
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/waxa.definition: This industry comprises establishments, known as amusement or theme parks, primarily engaged in operating a variety of attractions, such as mechanical rides, water rides, games, shows, theme exhibits, refreshment stands, and picnic grounds. These establishments may lease space to others on a concession basis.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wb3i.label: Measuring, Dispensing, and Other Pumping Equipment Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wb3i.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing measuring and dispensing pumps, such as gasoline pumps and lubricating oil measuring and dispensing pumps and/or (2) manufacturing general purpose pumps and pumping equipment (except fluid power pumps and motors), such as reciprocating pumps, turbine pumps, centrifugal pumps, rotary pumps, diaphragm pumps, domestic water system pumps, oil well and oil field pumps, and sump pumps.
english_labels: Measuring, Dispensing, and Other Pumping Equipment Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wdv7.label: Environmental Consulting Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wdv7.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing advice and assistance to businesses and other organizations on environmental issues, such as the control of environmental contamination from pollutants, toxic substances, and hazardous materials. These establishments identify problems (e.g., inspect buildings for hazardous materials), measure and evaluate risks, and recommend solutions. They employ a multidisciplined staff of scientists, engineers, and other technicians with expertise in areas, such as air and water quality, asbestos contamination, remediation, ecological restoration, and environmental law. Establishments providing sanitation or site remediation consulting services are included in this industry.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wfbQ.label: Search, Detection, Navigation, Guidance, Aeronautical, and Nautical System and Instrument Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wfbQ.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing search, detection, navigation, guidance, aeronautical, and nautical systems and instruments. Examples of products made by these establishments are aircraft instruments (except engine), flight recorders, navigational instruments and systems, radar systems and equipment, and sonar systems and equipment.
english_labels: Search, Detection, Navigation, Guidance, Aeronautical, and Nautical System and Instrument Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wiaG.label: Fabricated Structural Metal Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wiaG.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in fabricating structural metal products, such as assemblies of concrete reinforcing bars and fabricated bar joists.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wmQ5.label: Lessors of Other Real Estate Property
english_labels: Lessors of Other Real Estate Property

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wnwN.label: Executive and Legislative Offices, Combined
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wnwN.definition: This industry comprises government establishments serving as councils and boards of commissioners or supervisors and such bodies where the chief executive (e.g., county executive or city mayor) is a member of the legislative body (e.g., county or city council) itself.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wvz7.label: Cane Sugar Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wvz7.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) processing sugarcane and/or (2) refining cane sugar from raw cane sugar.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wwL7.label: Aircraft Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wwL7.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) manufacturing or assembling complete aircraft; (2) developing and making aircraft prototypes; (3) aircraft conversion (i.e., major modifications to systems); and (4) complete aircraft overhaul and rebuilding (i.e., periodic restoration of aircraft to original design specifications).

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wxCs.label: Sugar Beet Farming
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/wxCs.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in growing sugar beets.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/x3cn.label: Poured Concrete Foundation and Structure Contractors
english_labels: Poured Concrete Foundation and Structure Contractors

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/x4_-.label: Tobacco Product and Electronic Cigarette Merchant Wholesalers
english_labels: Tobacco Product and Electronic Cigarette Merchant Wholesalers

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/x8qs.label: Printing Ink Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/x8qs.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing printing and inkjet inks and inkjet cartridges.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/xAua.label: Fabricated Pipe and Pipe Fitting Manufacturing
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/xAua.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in fabricating, such as cutting, threading, and bending, metal pipes and pipe fittings made from purchased metal pipe.
english_labels: Fabricated Pipe and Pipe Fitting Manufacturing

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/xC-e.label: Exterminating and Pest Control Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/xC-e.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in exterminating and controlling birds, mosquitoes, rodents, termites, and other insects and pests (except for crop production and forestry production). Establishments providing fumigation services are included in this industry.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/xE0M.label: Crushed and Broken Granite Mining and Quarrying
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/xE0M.definition: This U.S. industry comprises (1) establishments primarily engaged in developing the mine site, and/or mining or quarrying crushed and broken granite (including related rocks, such as gneiss, syenite (except nepheline), and diorite) and (2) preparation plants primarily engaged in beneficiating granite (e.g., grinding or pulverizing).
english_labels: Crushed and Broken Granite Mining and Quarrying

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/xHYp.label: Depository Credit Intermediation Industry
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/xHYp.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in accepting deposits (or share deposits) and in lending funds from these deposits. Within this group, industries are defined on the basis of differences in the types of deposit liabilities assumed and in the nature of the credit extended.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/xLHw.label: Remediation and Other Waste Management Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/xLHw.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in remediation and other waste management services (except waste collection, waste treatment and disposal, and waste management consulting services).
english_labels: Remediation and Other Waste Management Services

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/xM-V.label: Casinos (except Casino Hotels)
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/xM-V.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in operating gambling facilities that offer table wagering games along with other gambling activities, such as slot machines and sports betting. These establishments often provide food and beverage services. Included in this industry are floating casinos (i.e., gambling cruises, riverboat casinos) and casinos with racetracks.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/xMQK.label: Cafeterias, Grill Buffets, and Buffets
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/xMQK.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments, known as cafeterias, grill buffets, or buffets, primarily engaged in preparing and serving meals for immediate consumption using cafeteria-style or buffet serving equipment, such as steam tables, refrigerated areas, display grills, and self-service nonalcoholic beverage dispensing equipment. Patrons select from food and drink items on display in a continuous cafeteria line or from buffet stations.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/xMkL.label: Iron and Steel Pipe and Tube Manufacturing from Purchased Steel
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/xMkL.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing welded, riveted, or seamless pipe and tube from purchased iron or steel.
english_labels: Iron and Steel Pipe and Tube Manufacturing from Purchased Steel

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/xMuZ.label: Electronic and Precision Equipment Repair and Maintenance
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/xMuZ.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in repairing and maintaining one or more of the following: (1) consumer electronic equipment; (2) computers; (3) office machines; (4) communication equipment; and (5) other electronic and precision equipment and instruments, without retailing these products as new. Establishments in this industry repair items, such as microscopes, radar and sonar equipment, televisions, stereos, video recorders, computers, fax machines, photocopying machines, two-way radios, cellular telephones, and other communications equipment, scientific instruments, and medical equipment.
english_labels: Electronic and Precision Equipment Repair and Maintenance

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/xPEL.label: Lessors of Residential Buildings and Dwellings
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/xPEL.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in acting as lessors of buildings used as residences or dwellings, such as single-family homes, apartment buildings, and town homes. Included in this industry are owner-lessors and establishments renting real estate and then acting as lessors in subleasing it to others. The establishments in this industry may manage the property themselves or have another establishment manage it for them.
english_labels: Lessors of Residential Buildings and Dwellings

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/xTRx.label: Telephone Answering Services
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/xTRx.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in answering telephone calls and relaying messages on behalf of clients or for other establishments of the same enterprise.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/xXwV.label: Management of Companies and Enterprises Industry
english_labels: Management of Companies and Enterprises Industry

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/xaeK.label: Nonscheduled Air Transportation
https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/xaeK.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) providing air transportation of passengers and/or cargo with no regular routes and regular schedules or (2) providing specialty flying services with no regular routes and regular schedules using general purpose aircraft. These establishments have more flexibility with respect to choice of airports, hours of operation, load factors, and similar operational characteristics.

https://folio.openlegalstandard.org/xbCV.label: Locksmiths
